title: Identifiability of a linear dynamical reaction-diffusion system with directed interactions from the second-order statistics of a single snapshot
summary: A single spatial snapshot of a system with multiple interacting populations captures positions but not the underlying dynamics that have led to the observation. This work asks what the stationary second-order spatial statistics of a snapshot can reveal about the structure of the linear reaction-diffusion dynamical model, and in particular about the pairwise directed entries of its interaction operator. The observation is the matrix-valued structure factor $S(k)$ as a one-parameter family in the diffusion-inherited dependence on the wavenumber $κ=|k|^2$. The main result is that the directed interaction operator $A$ and the diffusivity matrix $D$ are generically identifiable for any number of interacting populations from $\{S(κ)\}$ up to a single global time rescaling. The findings do not contradict known bounds and the recent result that spatial observational data only determine the Markov equivalence class of the underlying graph. In this work, we identify physical assumptions that lift this barrier. The absolute time scale is not identifiable from a single snapshot of any sample size and requires an external clock. For tumor-immune tissue, the results imply that directed cell-cell interactions are in principle recoverable from one section, that the direction cannot be inferred from the mean densities or a covariance matrix, but from the wavenumber dependence of the cross and autospectra, and that a baseline section determines the interaction structure but not the absolute rates.

AI.tldr: 单帧空间快照的稳态二阶空间统计量可辨识线性反应-扩散动力学中的有向相互作用算子A与扩散矩阵D，但存在一个全局时间尺度不可辨识。
AI.motivation: 观测仅给出空间位置（快照），无法直接反映产生该格局的动力学过程。作者希望探究：单帧稳态二阶空间统计量能在多大程度上揭示线性反应-扩散模型的结构，特别是相互作用算子中的有向成对条目；并试图突破"空间观测数据只能确定图的Markov等价类"这一限制。
AI.method: 将观测建模为矩阵值结构因子S(k)，并视为关于波数κ=|k|²（由扩散继承的参数依赖）的单参数族；在该参数依赖下分析辨识性，找出可提升Markov等价类限制的物理假设。
AI.result: 对于任意数量的相互作用种群，有向相互作用算子A与扩散矩阵D一般可从{S(κ)}中辨识，仅相差一个全局时间重缩放。绝对时间尺度无法从任意样本量的单帧快照中辨识，需外部时钟。以肿瘤-免疫组织为例，有向细胞间相互作用原则上可从单张切片恢复；方向不能由平均密度或协方差矩阵推断，而需借助自谱与交叉谱的波数依赖关系；基线切片可确定相互作用结构但无法确定绝对速率。
AI.conclusion: 结果不与已有界限及"空间观测数据仅确定图的Markov等价类"的结论矛盾，而是通过引入适当的物理假设提升了该限制；单帧快照在无外部时钟时最多辨识到全局时间尺度，但相互作用结构与扩散参数可被恢复。

title: Linear Fitness Subspace in Protein Language Models Enables Sample-Efficient Directed Evolution
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Model-guided directed evolution seeks to identify high-fitness protein variants under limited oracle budgets. Protein language models (PLMs) provide rich representations for this task, but task-agnostic zero-shot scores can be misaligned with a target assay, while supervised search in high-dimensional embedding spaces can make surrogate modeling and uncertainty estimation sample-inefficient. We propose the Linear Fitness Subspace (LFS) hypothesis: within mutation-induced residue-level representation changes, a compact, assay-specific set of directions makes fitness variation linearly accessible from few labeled variants. This is a local, supervision-recoverable statement rather than a claim that protein fitness landscapes or global PLM geometry are universally linear. Building on this observation, we introduce Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES), which estimates an LFS from a small initial sample and performs surrogate modeling, uncertainty estimation, and acquisition in the learned subspace. Across 10 core ProteinGym assays, 87 extended static-validation assays, and an 18-assay budgeted-search evaluation, SGES improves fitness prediction and search efficiency over zero-shot PLMs and recent ML-guided protein optimization baselines. Controlled comparisons with PCA, random projections, label-shuffled PLS, classical mutation features, and acquisition ablations further isolate the benefit of a fitness-aligned site-delta coordinate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"线性适应度子空间"(LFS)假设：突变引起的残基级表示变化中，存在一个紧凑的、与特定实验相关的方向集合，使适应度变化可从少量标注变体中线性获取；并据此提出"子空间引导进化搜索"(SGES)，在学习到的子空间内完成代理建模、不确定性估计与采集。在10个核心ProteinGym实验、87个扩展静态验证实验及18个实验的预算化搜索评估中，SGES在适应度预测与搜索效率上优于零样本PLM及近期ML引导蛋白优化基线；消融实验进一步证实了"适应度对齐的位点-增量坐标"的增益来源。
AI.motivation: 在有限的实验（oracle）预算下识别高适应度蛋白变体是定向进化的核心难题。蛋白语言模型(PLM)虽提供丰富表示，但任务无关的零样本打分可能与目标实验不符；而在高维嵌入空间中进行有监督搜索，会使代理建模与不确定性估计的样本效率低下。因此需要一个既能利用PLM表示、又能在少量标注变体下高效对齐目标实验的方法。
AI.method: 提出LFS假设：在突变诱导的残基级表示变化中，存在紧凑的、特定于实验的方向集合，使适应度变化在少量标注变体下线性可及；该假设为局部、可由监督恢复的陈述，而非断言适应度景观或全局PLM几何普遍线性。基于此提出SGES：从少量初始样本估计LFS，并在学习到的子空间内进行代理建模、不确定性估计与采集。
AI.result: 在10个核心ProteinGym实验、87个扩展静态验证实验以及18个实验的预算化搜索评估中，SGES在适应度预测与搜索效率上均优于零样本PLM及近期ML引导蛋白优化基线。与PCA、随机投影、标签打乱的PLS、经典突变特征及采集函数消融的对照实验，进一步分离出"适应度对齐的位点-增量坐标"所带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: LFS假设表明，适应度相关变化可由低维、实验特异的方向有效刻画；SGES通过在该子空间内建模与搜索，显著提升了有限预算下的预测与优化效率，且其增益源自适应度对齐的表示坐标而非单纯降维。

title: OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes
comment: Accepted at the AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于英国门诊肿瘤语料（290,026份病历，21,564名肺癌及头颈癌患者），构建并评估了肿瘤学专用BERT编码器。结果显示继续预训练的OncoNote-RadBERT语料拟合最佳（困惑度2.10），而从零训练并定制分词器的OncoNoteBERT分词效率最高且掩码探针表现更优（13项中12项达标）。
AI.motivation: 通用生物医学或相邻临床语言模型难以高效表征真实肿瘤门诊病历中的专业术语、肿瘤分期表达、治疗方案、毒性描述及机构特有的去标识化标记，因此需要评估肿瘤学专用编码器与不同适配策略的适用性。
AI.method: 构建受治理的英国门诊肿瘤语料（290,026份病历，21,564名肺癌与头颈癌患者）。将RadBERT、PathologyBERT与两种本地策略对比：OncoNote-RadBERT（继续掩码语言模型预训练）和OncoNoteBERT（使用肿瘤学WordPiece分词器从零训练）。评估指标包括验证集掩码语言建模损失与困惑度、分词碎片化指标、临床术语分词、掩码token探针及探索性表征分析。
AI.result: 零样本评估中外部编码器拟合较差（RadBERT困惑度113.04，PathologyBERT 2035.03）；继续预训练拟合最佳（OncoNote-RadBERT为2.10）；OncoNoteBERT困惑度2.83但分词最高效，子词生育率更低、归一化序列更短；掩码探针中OncoNoteBERT达12/13，OncoNote-RadBERT为7/13。语料拟合与掩码表现的分歧部分源于分词碎片化而非仅语义学习。两个本地模型均将机构占位符表示为单一可学习token。
AI.conclusion: 继续领域适配与定制分词提供互补收益；在将相邻领域编码器应用于肿瘤NLP之前，表征层设计至关重要。

title: A Time-Resolved Framework for Quantifying Neuronal Network State Transitions
summary: Electrophysiological recordings provide powerful tools for characterizing the dynamics of neuronal networks. In vitro neuronal cultures offer a controlled setting for investigating network responses to diverse interventions, including pharmacological and optogenetic stimulation. However, conventional analyses often reduce electrophysiological activity to aggregate measures calculated over fixed temporal windows, providing only a static representation of the network state. Here, we introduce a comprehensive, multiparametric analytical framework designed to characterize both the temporal evolution of network activity and the transitional states induced by external interventions. The framework combines multiple network discriminators with a compositional analysis that resolves electrode-level responses into excited, inhibited, and unchanged states over successive temporal segments. We apply the framework to electrophysiological recordings obtained under pharmacological interventions with 4-aminopyridine (4-AP), optogenetic stimulation, and additional benchmark conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed analysis can reveal subtle and transient responses that may be difficult to detect using conventional aggregate measures, including responses to low-dose pharmacological interventions. These findings highlight the value of temporally resolved and compositional analyses for characterizing heterogeneous neuronal network responses in vitro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多参数分析框架，用于刻画体外神经元网络活动的时间演化及外部干预引起的状态转换，优于传统聚合指标。
AI.motivation: 传统电生理分析将活动简化为固定时间窗上的聚合指标，仅提供网络状态的静态表征，难以捕捉细微、瞬态的网络响应。
AI.method: 该框架结合多种网络判别器与一种组成性分析，将电极层面的响应在连续时间片段上分解为兴奋、抑制和不变三种状态，并应用于4-AP药物干预、光遗传刺激及基准条件下的电生理记录。
AI.result: 该分析能够揭示传统聚合指标难以检测的细微且瞬态响应，包括对低剂量药物干预的响应。
AI.conclusion: 时间分辨与组成性分析对于刻画体外异质性神经元网络响应具有重要价值。

title: Generalizable Robustness Testing of DNN-Based Robotic Navigation Systems via XAI-Guided Search
summary:
**Context:** Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) increasingly control Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), yet small input perturbations can cause unsafe system-level behavior. Existing approaches often optimize perturbations for individual images and evaluate them only in simulation, limiting their generalizability and practical validity.
  **Objectives:** This work aims to generate robustness tests that remain effective across operational observations and to evaluate whether the resulting failures transfer from simulation to a physical robot.
  **Methods:** We propose an explainability-guided multi-objective evolutionary approach that generates sparse perturbations over representative images selected through visual and behavioral clustering. Aggregated Integrated Gradients guide mutations toward influential image regions. We evaluate the approach on a DNN-controlled LeoRover in Gazebo, conduct an ablation study, and validate a stratified subset of perturbations on the physical robot.
  **Results:** The approach achieved a median success rate of 70.0%, compared with 53.85% for unguided search, and increased median hypervolume from 0.65 to 0.73. Multi-image optimization improved the success rate from 50.0% to 57.5%, while XAI guidance further increased it to 70.0%. In the sim-to-real evaluation, simulation achieved 0.95 precision and 0.67 recall, and simulated and physical failure times showed a significant positive correlation of 0.617.
  **Conclusion:** Combining multi-image optimization with explainability-guided search improves robustness testing for DNN-controlled robotic systems. Simulation effectively identifies and prioritizes transferable failures, but physical validation remains necessary because some real-world failures are not reproduced in simulation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种可解释性引导的多目标进化方法，通过聚类选取代表性图像并利用聚合积分梯度引导稀疏扰动生成，用于DNN控制机器人的鲁棒性测试，仿真成功率中位数达70.0%，并验证了仿真到物理机器人的失败可迁移性。
AI.motivation: DNN越来越多地控制信息物理系统（CPS），但输入端的微小扰动即可引发系统级不安全行为；现有扰动优化方法多针对单张图像且在仿真中评估，泛化性和实际有效性不足。
AI.method: 提出可解释性引导的多目标进化方法：先通过视觉与行为聚类选取代表性图像，在其上生成稀疏扰动；用聚合积分梯度（Aggregated Integrated Gradients）引导变异方向指向关键图像区域。在Gazebo中由DNN控制的LeoRover上评估，开展消融实验，并在物理机器人上对分层抽样的扰动子集进行验证。
AI.result: 成功率中位数70.0%，优于无引导搜索的53.85%；超体积中位数由0.65提升至0.73。多图优化将成功率由50.0%提升至57.5%，XAI引导进一步提至70.0%。仿真到现实评估中，仿真精度0.95、召回0.67，仿真与物理失败时间呈显著正相关（0.617）。
AI.conclusion: 多图优化与可解释性引导搜索相结合可提升DNN控制机器人系统的鲁棒性测试效果；仿真能有效识别并优先排序可迁移的失败，但部分真实世界失败无法在仿真中复现，因此物理验证仍不可替代。

title: ElecSafety: Diagnosing Large Language Model Safety Judgments for Microcontroller Boards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively support embedded hardware development, but a plausible recommendation may pose safety risks when acting on the physical hardware. Because electrical safety can be different between every microcontroller board, a practical question is raised: can LLMs have the capability to make the right decision on whether a proposed user operation is safe for the board? Although benchmarks for embedded development exist, they primarily target code generation and hardware design tasks. This highlights the lack of tested board-specific judgment regarding electrical safety. To address this gap, we introduce the ElecSafety benchmark to evaluate whether an LLM can respond with the correct label and derive that label from the proper manufacturer constraints and rules. We extract these constraints from vendor datasheets and hardware manuals. Each scenario is defined by a decisive condition and a gold label (safe, hazardous, or cannot determine) before translating the scenario into natural language. We categorize the scenarios into violation and compliant cases, board-swap, near-boundary, and missing-information. We then evaluated the scenario on six open-weight LLMs under various conditions of rule access and token limitations. The finding shows board rules can improve accuracy, whereas limiting the token has a smaller impact. Even the best configuration remains unreliable on near-boundary and missing-information scenarios, and a correct label often rests on the inaccurate constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ElecSafety 基准，用于评估 LLM 能否对嵌入式硬件操作给出正确的电气安全判断（安全/危险/无法确定），并验证其判断是否源自正确的厂商约束与规则。
AI.motivation: LLM 正逐步支持嵌入式硬件开发，但看似合理的建议在作用于物理硬件时可能带来安全风险。由于不同微控制器板卡的电气安全边界各异，亟需评估 LLM 是否具备针对具体板卡判断用户操作安全性的能力。现有嵌入式基准主要面向代码生成与硬件设计任务，缺乏对板卡特定的电气安全判断测试，这一缺口亟待填补。
AI.method: 构建 ElecSafety 基准：从厂商数据手册与硬件手册中提取约束规则；每个场景先定义决定条件与金标签（safe、hazardous、cannot determine），再转写为自然语言；场景分为违规与合规案例、板卡替换（board-swap）、近边界（near-boundary）及信息缺失（missing-information）等类别。随后在多种规则可访问性与 token 限制条件下，对六个开放权重 LLM 进行评估。
AI.result: 板卡规则可提升准确率，而 token 限制影响较小。即使在最佳配置下，模型在近边界与信息缺失场景中仍表现不可靠；并且正确的标签往往建立在并不准确的约束之上。
AI.conclusion: ElecSafety 揭示了 LLM 在板卡级电气安全判断上的显著不足，表明仅凭标签准确率不足以证明模型真正掌握了正确的电气规则，未来需在规则依从性与边界场景鲁棒性方面进一步改进。

title: Neural networks as decision trees: an analytical solution for learning and neural selectivity
summary: Nonlinear neural networks develop structured internal representations, yet how their geometry is determined by the tasks being learned remains poorly understood. Here, we develop an analytical framework for piecewise-linear feedforward and recurrent networks that links learning, activation-region structure, and neural selectivity. We show that, at any stationary point of gradient-aligned learning, a nonlinear network decomposes into local linear regressions over its activation regions. Deviations from the corresponding least-squares solutions are jointly constrained by network weights shared across regions and vanish in the low-error regime, yielding an approximate piecewise least-squares decomposition of the task. This structure admits a decision-tree interpretation, which we recover numerically by fitting trees to predict network activation patterns from the input. We further derive how the regions in which neurons are active determine the task statistics they capture, thereby organizing neural selectivity into distinct subpopulations. The resulting predictions closely match the selectivity geometry observed in simulated networks and two empirical neural datasets. Finally, we show that neural baseline regulates activation pattern diversity, placing networks along a continuum between coarse, generalizing representations and fine-grained, expressive representations. Together, these results establish activation regions as a unifying framework for describing how nonlinear networks decompose task structure into local computations and how those computations can be revealed through neural activity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分段线性前馈与循环网络的分析框架，揭示非线性网络在梯度对齐学习的不动点处可分解为激活区域上的局部线性回归，并近似等价于任务的分段最小二乘分解，从而统一解释网络内部几何、神经元选择性与树状决策结构。
AI.motivation: 非线性神经网络会发展出结构化的内部表征，但其几何结构如何由所学任务决定仍不清楚。作者希望建立一个能同时连接学习过程、激活区域结构与神经元选择性的分析框架，解释网络如何将任务结构分解为局部计算。
AI.method: 针对分段线性前馈与循环网络建立解析框架：(1) 证明在梯度对齐学习的任意不动点处，网络分解为激活区域上的局部线性回归；(2) 这些解与对应最小二乘解的偏差受跨区域共享权重联合约束，并在低误差区消失，给出任务的近似分段最小二乘分解；(3) 通过将决策树拟合到网络激活模式实现树的数值解释；(4) 推导神经元激活区域如何决定其捕获的任务统计量，从而形成不同神经元亚群。
AI.result: 理论预测与模拟网络以及两个真实神经数据集中观察到的选择性几何高度吻合；同时发现神经基线（baseline）可调节激活模式的多样性，使网络在“粗糙、泛化型表征”与“精细、表达型表征”之间形成连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 激活区域可作为统一框架，描述非线性网络如何将任务结构分解为局部计算，以及这些计算如何通过神经活动被揭示。

title: Mathematical Invariant-Enabled Topological Neural Networks for Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
summary: Existing molecular and materials learning approaches often rely on a limited set of structural representations, which may capture only selected aspects of complex three-dimensional structure. Here, we introduce mathematical invariant-enabled topological neural networks (MITNNs), a framework that represents complex structures through multiple complementary mathematical views and integrates them with topological neural architectures. MITNNs combine multiscale invariants from topology, spectral theory, commutative algebra, differential geometry, and discrete curvature, capturing complementary structural information from the same system. Systematic invariant-subset, architecture-subset, and ensemble analyses show that predictive performance depends on how mathematical representations and neural architectures are paired, with selected combinations outperforming individual models and the aggregation of all available components. Across protein-ligand binding, metal-organic framework properties, mutation-induced protein solubility, and molecular toxicity prediction, MITNN consistently outperforms existing methods. These results establish MITNN as a mathematically multimodal framework for scientific machine learning.

AI.tldr: 提出数学不变量驱动的拓扑神经网络MITNN，融合多种数学表示并适配拓扑神经架构，在多类分子与材料任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有分子与材料学习方法依赖的结构表示较为有限，只能捕捉复杂三维结构的部分信息，缺乏对同一体系多视角、互补性的结构刻画。作者希望引入多种数学不变量作为互补表示，弥补单一表示的表达不足。
AI.method: MITNN将复杂结构表示为多个互补的数学视角，并与拓扑神经架构相结合。其不变量涵盖拓扑、谱理论、交换代数、微分几何与离散曲率等方向的多尺度不变量，用于捕捉同一体系中的互补结构信息。文中还通过不变量子集、架构子集及集成分析，考察数学表示与神经架构的配对方式。
AI.result: 实验表明，预测性能依赖于数学表示与神经架构的具体配对方式，优选的组合优于单一模型，也优于对全部可用组件的简单聚合。在蛋白质-配体结合、金属有机框架性质、突变诱导的蛋白质溶解度以及分子毒性预测任务上，MITNN均稳定优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MITNN确立了数学多模态框架在科学机器学习中的有效性，说明有选择地组合数学不变量与拓扑神经架构能带来显著性能提升。

title: DIBench: Benchmarking Decision Integrity of GUI-based Mobile Agents Under Deceptive Injections
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: As GUI-based mobile agents rapidly progress, rigorous safety evaluation of their autonomous decision-making in realistic app interfaces becomes increasingly critical. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on execution-level anomalies using task success or hijack rates, but fail to capture the in-task goal deviation risk in multi-candidate selection tasks, where the decision may be steered toward an attacker-specified target, even in violation of instruction-implied constraints (e.g., cheapest/highest-rated), without any overt execution anomalies. We present DIBench, a decision integrity benchmark for measuring this risk in mobile agents. DIBench covers 7 commercial and 3 simulated apps with 5 task types. Under a threat model restricted to non-privileged UI content, we construct 8 deceptive injection probe instantiations that can steer critical selections without overt anomalies. The benchmark includes 1,000 clean and 36,672 injected instances, with a unified protocol and integrity metrics for comparison. Experiments spanning 4 agent frameworks and 7 base models show that completion-based evaluation can overestimate agent trustworthiness and miss decision-integrity risks: deceptive injections steer selections and shift early action policies, inflating completion rates and creating a misleading illusion of safety. Common defenses, including detection, image preprocessing, and prompt reminders, yield inconsistent integrity gains. Overall, DIBench provides a unified, reproducible benchmark to quantify the risk of in-task goal deviation in mobile agents and enable comparable evaluations of safety defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIBench，一个针对移动GUI智能体"决策完整性"的基准，用于量化多候选选择任务中被欺骗性注入引导而偏离任务目标的风险，弥补现有以任务完成率/劫持率为核心的评测的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要依赖任务成功率或劫持率来评估执行层面的异常，无法捕捉多候选选择任务中的"任务内目标偏离"风险：决策可能被导向攻击者指定的目标，甚至违背指令隐含约束（如最便宜/评分最高），却不表现出任何明显的执行异常。随着基于GUI的移动智能体快速发展，对其自主决策的安全评测愈发关键。
AI.method: 构建DIBench决策完整性基准：覆盖7个商业应用与3个模拟应用、5类任务；在仅限非特权UI内容的威胁模型下，设计8种欺骗性注入探针实例，可在无显式异常的情况下操纵关键选择；数据集包含1,000个干净实例与36,672个注入实例，并提供统一协议与完整性度量指标。实验覆盖4种智能体框架与7个基座模型。
AI.result: 基于完成度的评测会高估智能体的可信度并遗漏决策完整性风险：欺骗性注入成功引导选择并改变早期动作策略，抬高完成率，制造出误导性的"安全假象"。常见防御手段（检测、图像预处理、提示词提醒）带来的完整性提升并不一致。
AI.conclusion: DIBench为量化移动智能体的任务内目标偏离风险提供了统一、可复现的基准，支持对安全防御进行可比评测。

title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
summary: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出零样本可视化（ZSV）任务：用户用自然语言指定概念，将文档映射到相应概念轴上以可视化文本语料库，并构建基准评测嵌入相似度、直接语义判断与条件似然估计三类方法。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型用于文本语料库的视觉探索具有实用价值，但构建可用的 ZSV 系统涉及特征函数选择、高效实现的权衡以及影响可视化质量的前后处理决策，这些设计问题缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 建立 ZSV 基准，覆盖嵌入相似度、直接语义判断和条件似然估计等方法，在多个数据集与用例上，从语义忠实性、分数保真度和计算成本三个维度评估不同打分方法与设计选择；并将最优方法应用于无标注语料库以考察真实探索场景下的表现。
AI.result: 基于下一 token 概率的打分在所评估方法中提供了最强的实际权衡；在无标注语料上的实验进一步揭示应结合分级轴与二元相关性过滤，并发现离题文档中存在组合式情感偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，论文为构建端到端 ZSV 基线提供了实用指南。

title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GameGo 框架将简短游戏创意种子转化为符合行业实践的产品需求文档，结合动态压缩与数据/基准构建，实现编码智能体端到端生成复杂游戏，并训练出性能优异且媲美前沿模型的 GameGoCoder。
AI.motivation: LLM 在网络前端执行上能力突出，浏览器游戏生成成为重要前沿；但现有工作多依赖复杂多轮流程或仅关注静态评测基准，且从稀疏的用户查询直接生成复杂游戏时，编码智能体会做欠约束假设，导致机制不完整、玩法流程割裂、视觉美感不足。
AI.method: 提出 GameGo 可扩展框架，系统地将简短游戏种子转化为基于行业游戏开发实践的综合产品需求文档（PRD）；为在保留核心玩法约束的同时不限制设计探索，采用任务特定的动态压缩以最大化信息密度并维持指令遵循。基于该流程构建 GameGoData（55,060 条涵盖 2D、2.5D、3D 游戏的开发轨迹）与 GameGoBench（124 个多样化游戏查询的基准），并训练 GameGoCoder。
AI.result: GameGoCoder 在游戏开发基准上超越匹配基线，并与前沿模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数据、基准与模型一体化的端到端游戏合成方案，为直接由编码智能体生成复杂游戏提供可行路径，所有代码、数据集与模型将公开。

title: When Robots Crash: Optimal Asynchronous Gathering at Weber Meeting Nodes
summary: We study the \textit{optimal gathering} problem over a finite set of designated \textit{meeting nodes} for \textit{asynchronous, anonymous,} and \textit{oblivious} mobile robots on an infinite grid under crash faults. The robots have global visibility and strong multiplicity detection, but share neither a coordinate system nor chirality. The objective is to gather all non-faulty robots at a \textsc{Weber Meeting Node}, minimizing the total Manhattan distance from their initial positions. Up to $n-2$ robots may crash permanently, and such crashes are indistinguishable from arbitrary delays. Existing approaches often rely on a designated robot to break symmetry, whose crash may block the remaining robots indefinitely. Instead, our approach enables every robot to independently select the same target from its snapshot, while target-dependent restricted shortest paths preserve the target as a \textsc{Weber Meeting Node}. We prove that, under strong multiplicity detection, optimal gathering is impossible from certain fully symmetric configurations. For all remaining configurations, our algorithm \textsc{CrashTolerantWeberGathering()} selects a unique common target, preserves its optimality throughout the execution, and allows non-faulty robots to progress without waiting for crashed robots, thereby guaranteeing gathering in finite time.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究异步、匿名、无记忆移动机器人在无限网格上、存在崩溃故障情况下的最优聚集问题，提出无需指定领航者的 CrashTolerantWeberGathering() 算法，使每个机器人在强多重检测下独立选出同一 Weber Meeting Node，并在保持其最优性的同时实现有限时间聚集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常依赖指定机器人打破对称性，一旦该机器人崩溃可能导致其余机器人无限等待。作者希望在存在最多 n-2 个永久崩溃、且崩溃与延迟不可区分的情况下，实现无领航者依赖、有限时间完成的最优聚集。
AI.method: 针对无限网格上异步、匿名、无记忆机器人，在全局可见性与强多重检测、但无统一坐标系与手性条件下，让每个机器人基于自身快照独立选择同一目标；算法采用目标相关的受限最短路径，从而保持目标为 Weber Meeting Node。并证明在强多重检测下，某些完全对称配置中不存在最优聚集算法。
AI.result: 证明了强多重检测下部分完全对称配置中最优聚集不可实现；对于其余所有配置，算法能够选出唯一公共目标，执行过程中保持其最优性，并允许非故障机器人不等待崩溃机器人继续推进。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在崩溃故障下保证非故障机器人在有限时间内完成最优聚集，避免因指定机器人崩溃导致阻塞，为无坐标、无手性、匿名异步机器人系统提供了容错最优聚集方案。

title: Medical Image Alignment Assessment as a Test of Generalist Visual Reasoning in Frontier Multimodal Models
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly positioned as general purpose visual reasoners as part of the quest for artificial general intelligence. A key test of this generality is whether they can perform novel visual judgments that humans can make reliably from visual evidence and task instructions, without task-specific parameter optimisation. We investigate this question through the task of medical image alignment assessment, where the goal is to establish whether there is anatomical correspondence between two images. Human visual assessment of image alignment is still the gold standard and most common approach; however, it requires trained operators and is impractical to scale for large datasets. We evaluate recent generations of MLLMs on two exemplar medical image alignment tasks, varying both prompting strategies and image-presentation methods. We compare against a locally fine-tuned MLLM and a task-specific CNN to examine the trade-off between frontier general purpose models and smaller models that require specific task optimisation but can be used locally. We show that are reaching an inflection point, where frontier MLLMs can now perform effective visual assessment of medical image alignment. Models released only a few months ago generalise poorly and, in some settings, perform barely above chance, whereas GPT-6 achieves over 85% across almost all scenarios tested. Fine-tuned local models can match or exceed frontier-model performance on the tasks on which they are trained, but transfer substantially less effectively to unseen settings. These findings identify medical image alignment as a useful test bed for generalist visual reasoning and suggest that frontier multimodal models are beginning to acquire capabilities that could support a common quality-control mechanism across heterogeneous medical-imaging pipelines.

AI.tldr: 前沿多模态大模型（MLLMs）已开始具备医学图像配准评估能力，GPT-6在多数测试场景下准确率超过85%，标志着一个能力拐点；微调本地模型在特定任务可媲美甚至超越前沿模型，但跨场景迁移能力明显不足。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理的通用性是通往通用人工智能的关键检验标准，理想情况下模型应能仅凭视觉证据与任务指令完成新颖的视觉判断，而无需针对特定任务进行参数优化。医学图像配准评估正是这样一个检验场景：判断两幅图像间是否存在解剖对应关系。该任务目前仍以人工视觉评估为金标准，但依赖受过训练的操作人员、难以规模化。因此作者希望借助该任务，检验前沿通用MLLM是否已具备可迁移的视觉推理能力。
AI.method: 作者在两个典型的医学图像配准任务上评估了近年多代MLLM，并系统变化提示策略与图像呈现方式。同时引入本地微调MLLM与任务专用CNN作为对照，以比较"前沿通用模型"与"需任务优化但可本地部署的小模型"之间的权衡。
AI.result: 模型能力呈现明显的时间拐点：仅几个月前发布的模型泛化能力较差，部分设置下仅略高于随机水平；而GPT-6在几乎所有测试场景中准确率超过85%。本地微调模型在其训练任务上可匹配甚至超越前沿模型，但向未见场景迁移的效果显著较差。
AI.conclusion: 医学图像配准可作为检验通用视觉推理能力的有效测试平台，前沿多模态模型正逐渐获得可支撑跨异构医学影像流程通用质量控制机制的能力。

title: TEMPEST: Temporal Embeddings for Scalable Driver Identification via Angular Margin Learning
summary: Scalable driver identification requires embedding models that maintain discriminative performance as fleet size grows, yet existing triplet-loss formulations degrade rapidly with driver pool size and overfit to session-specific patterns under rigorous temporal evaluation. We introduce TEMPEST, a Temporal Convolutional Network embedding model trained with an additive angular margin (ArcFace) loss that enforces global class-level separation in a normalized angular space. TEMPEST maps 60-second multimodal driving windows to compact 96-dimensional embeddings, supporting truly dynamic enrollment without any retraining or classifier refitting. Under rigorous temporal evaluation on a 45-driver dataset, TEMPEST achieves 91.71% Rank-1 accuracy, outperforming the best classical model by 17.9 pp and the strongest triplet-loss baseline by 58.4 pp. TEMPEST degrades by only 4.3 pp when growing the subject pool from 10 to 45 drivers, compared to 22 pp and 32.5 pp for supervised and unsupervised triplet-loss baselines, and its cross-session advantage is corroborated on the public KIA Soul dataset, where it outperforms the best classical model by 7.3 pp within-session and 14.3 pp cross-session. With 720K parameters, a 2.80 MB footprint, and 50-epoch convergence, TEMPEST establishes a rigorous, reproducible baseline for scalable behavioral driver biometric identification.

AI.tldr: TEMPEST：基于TCN+ArcFace的驾驶员身份嵌入模型，在时间严格评估下实现可扩展、免重训的动态注册，45人Rank-1达91.71%。
AI.motivation: 可扩展的驾驶员身份识别要求嵌入模型在车队规模增长时保持判别力，但现有三元组损失（triplet-loss）方法随驾驶员池扩大迅速退化，且在严格时间评估下易过拟合到会话特定模式。
AI.method: 提出TEMPEST：以时间卷积网络（TCN）为骨干的嵌入模型，采用加性角度间隔（ArcFace）损失，在归一化角度空间施加全局类级分离约束；将60秒多模态驾驶窗口映射为96维紧凑嵌入，支持无需重训或分类器重拟合的动态注册。
AI.result: 45驾驶员数据集严格时间评估下Rank-1为91.71%，分别超最佳经典模型17.9个百分点、最强triplet-loss基线58.4个百分点；规模从10扩至45人仅降4.3 pp（监督/无监督triplet基线分别降22 pp与32.5 pp）；公开KIA Soul数据集上会话内超最佳经典模型7.3 pp、跨会话超14.3 pp；模型720K参数、2.80 MB、50轮收敛。
AI.conclusion: TEMPEST为可扩展的行为型驾驶员生物识别提供了严格、可复现的基线，并验证了角度间隔损失在应对驾驶员规模扩展与跨会话泛化方面的优势。

title: Neural Petri flows for chemical reactions
summary: Petri nets have been used to describe chemical processes such as reactions.They map well to chemistry: Places are the bonds between atoms and the free valence of each atom, a token is a unit of bond order, a transition forms or breaks a bond, the conserved quantities are the valence budgets of the atoms, and the enabling rule is the valence rule. These semantics are not guaranteed by learned models of reactions or neural networks that are built on Petri nets that use the net as a scaffold for message passing. Here, we ask what architecture remains a Petri net for every value of its weights. We find the answer in the theory, where all semantics of a net share the firing form $m^\prime=m+Cσ$, locality, as enabling reads only the inputs of a transition, and the enabling rule, and we prove that conservation forces the firing form and that non-negativity forces the enabling rule on local rate laws. This leaves free the rate law, which is the propensity of each transition to fire. We introduce Neural Petri Flow, which learns this rate law, or a readout for classification, and hard-wires the rest as parameter-free layers. On what we denote a valence net, atom mapping, reaction classification, and forward prediction become three tasks on one firing vector. Without training, the minimum firing vector maps 88.8% of the curated Golden set against 85.6% for RXNMapper, and 88.7 against 77.9% of the enzymatic reactions of EnzymeMap. On USPTO-480K, NPF trained on these firing vectors predicts 87.7% of the products and 67.4% when trained on a 1% subset of the training reactions. EC numbers of ECREACT are predicted at the third level for 90.2% of reactions, 5.6 points ahead of the best published method. With electrons as tokens, the same token game predicts 90.5% of the elementary steps of FlowER first, ahead of the published baseline, and every top-1 prediction is a valid molecule without a filter.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Neural Petri Flow（NPF），一种严格保持 Petri 网语义的架构，通过学习速率定律（rate law）并将其余部分硬编码为无参数层，在原子映射、反应分类与正向预测三类任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 Petri 网的化学反应学习模型仅把网结构当作消息传递的脚手架，并不保证 Petri 网的化学语义（守恒量、局部性、使能规则等）。作者希望找到一种无论权重取何值都仍是 Petri 网的架构，从而保证语义正确性。
AI.method: 从理论出发，证明守恒性强制了激发形式 m′=m+Cσ，非负性在局部速率定律上强制了使能规则，仅速率定律（每变迁的激发倾向）保持自由。据此提出 NPF：学习速率定律或其分类读出，其余全部硬连线为无参数层；在 valence net 上，原子映射、反应分类与正向预测成为同一激发向量的三个任务。
AI.result: 无需训练时，最小激发向量在 Golden 集上映射 88.8%（RXNMapper 85.6%），在 EnzymeMap 酶反应上 88.7% 对 77.9%；在 USPTO-480K 上训练后预测 87.7% 产物，仅用 1% 训练子集时达 67.4%；ECREACT 的 EC 号第三层预测 90.2%，领先最佳已发表方法 5.6 个百分点；以电子为 token 时，同一 token game 首次预测 FlowER 基元步骤 90.5%，且每个 top-1 预测无需过滤即为有效分子。
AI.conclusion: NPF 通过将速率定律作为唯一可学习部分、其余硬编码为无参数层，实现了对 Petri 网语义的严格保持，并在多项化学任务上超越已有方法，验证了“始终为 Petri 网”架构的有效性。

title: RMRRT: Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT for Inequality-Aware Steering on Equality Manifolds
summary: This paper presents a motion planning framework that unifies equality and inequality constraints within a single geometric formulation for sampling-based planning in high-dimensional robotic systems. In conventional sampling-based planners, equality constraints are typically enforced through projection, whereas inequality constraints are handled separately through binary validity checks such as collision testing, often leading to inefficient exploration. To address this limitation, we propose Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT (RMRRT), which constructs a unified local geometry for planning on equality-constrained manifolds. RMRRT first builds an ambient barrier metric from inequality-sensitive barrier terms and then induces a tangent-space metric via a (G)-orthogonal projection associated with the equality constraints. The resulting tangent-space metric is used consistently in both steering and nearest-neighbor selection, biasing exploration away from nearby inequality boundaries while preserving first-order equality consistency. In this work, the metric is instantiated from signed-distance-based geometric proxy inequalities to provide collision-informative tangent-space directions; hard feasibility is enforced separately through standard validity checks. Experimental results show that RMRRT achieves a 100% success rate across diverse constrained manipulation tasks in both simulation and real-world settings, while reducing planning time relative to representative constrained planning baselines. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the proposed metric improves exploration quality by reducing rejected samples and shortening path length. Experiment videos and source code are available at: https://rmrrt-anonymous.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出RMRRT框架，用黎曼障碍度量统一等式与不等式约束，实现高效采样式运动规划。
AI.motivation: 传统采样式规划器中，等式约束通过投影强制执行，不等式约束则通过碰撞检测等二元有效性检查单独处理，二者分离导致探索效率低下。
AI.method: RMRRT先由不等式敏感障碍项构建环境空间障碍度量，再经与等式约束相关的G-正交投影诱导切空间度量；该度量在转向和最近邻选择中一致使用，使探索偏离不等式边界并保持一阶等式一致性。度量由基于符号距离的几何代理不等式实例化，硬可行性仍通过标准有效性检查单独保证。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界的多种约束操作任务中，RMRRT实现100%成功率，且相较代表性约束规划基线缩短规划时间；消融实验表明该度量通过减少被拒样本、缩短路径长度提升了探索质量。
AI.conclusion: RMRRT将等式与不等式约束统一为单一几何形式，验证了统一局部几何在采样式规划中的有效性，并提供实验视频与源码。

title: FAPO: Fanout-Aware Post-Mapping Optimization for LUT-Based FPGAs
summary: Reducing logic depth during FPGA technology mapping does not necessarily eliminate fanout bottlenecks in the resulting LUT networks.Replicating heavily loaded LUTs can alleviate these bottlenecks, but the added copies consume area and may increase upstream loading. We propose FAPO, a mapper-independent post-mapping optimizer that jointly refines sink assignments and LUT cuts under a final-area constraint.Replication, cut switching, and recovery are evaluated by the resulting live LUT count.We derive a necessary all-critical-path condition for delay reduction and obtain minimum-copy proposals by minimum cut within a restricted same-cut family.These proposals complement greedy refinement, with mappings selected by full-network area and timing.Experiments on EPFL benchmarks with three initial mappers achieve geometric-mean reductions of up to 14.48% in fanout-aware area--timing product (ATP) with a 5% final-area allowance.VPR evaluation shows a 7.04% reduction in routed critical-path delay relative to ABC if.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAPO——一种与映射器无关的后映射优化方法，在最终面积约束下联合优化sink分配与LUT切割，缓解FPGA映射中的扇出瓶颈。
AI.motivation: FPGA技术映射中降低逻辑深度并不必然消除LUT网络中的扇出瓶颈；而复制高负载LUT虽能缓解瓶颈，却会增加面积并可能加重上游负载，需要在面积约束下权衡。
AI.method: FAPO在最终面积约束下联合精化sink分配与LUT切割，以存活LUT数量评估复制、切割切换与恢复操作。作者推导了延迟缩减所需的必经全关键路径条件，并在受限同切割族内通过最小割获得最少复制提案；该提案与贪心精化互补，依据全网络面积与时序选择映射。
AI.result: 在EPFL基准、三种初始映射器下，允许5%最终面积时，扇出感知的面积—时序积（ATP）几何平均最多降低14.48%；VPR评估显示相较ABC，布线后关键路径延迟降低7.04%。
AI.conclusion: FAPO作为一种映射器无关的后处理优化，可在面积约束下有效缓解扇出瓶颈并改善时序，兼容多种初始映射器。

title: APEX: Active Protection at Execution Boundaries for LLM Agents
summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) hides adversarial instructions in content that large language model (LLM) agents read at runtime. As agents compose heterogeneous capability units, including Tools, MCP servers, and Skills, the carriers of injection multiply, and defenses built to recognize attack patterns fall behind them. We instead shift defense from covering attack patterns to one stable point: whatever the carrier and however the injection propagates, harm materializes only at the \emph{execution boundary}, where the agent turns internal state into an external action or released output. Safety there turns on two conditions, both settled by the trusted task rather than by the run: whether the proposed effect is authorized, and whether the runtime information reaching it is endorsed by that task. We present APEX, an active defense that enforces both at this boundary from a single authorization contract compiled before untrusted execution: \emph{evidence-gated prevention} admits an effect only when the contract justifies it, while \emph{deception-based exposure} makes unendorsed use reveal itself before the effect commits. Protection therefore follows from what the task permits rather than from how an attack is built, and applies uniformly across capability units without attack-specific policies or taint tracking. Against 13 baselines, APEX attains 0\% attack success on five of six benchmarks and 0.56\% on the sixth, holds 0\% under adaptive attacks on all three capability-unit types, and remains effective across defender backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengXR930/APEX_official/tree/official.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APEX，一种针对间接提示注入（IPI）的主动防御方法，通过在“执行边界”上强制执行单一授权契约来阻止攻击，而非依赖识别攻击模式。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体组合工具、MCP服务器、技能等异构能力单元，注入载体不断增多，基于攻击模式识别的防御难以跟上。作者转而寻找一个稳定防御点：无论载体如何、注入如何传播，危害都只在“执行边界”处实现，即智能体将内部状态转化为外部动作或输出时。
AI.method: APEX在执行边界上依据预先编译的授权契约执行两项条件：所提议的效应是否被授权，以及到达该处的运行时信息是否被可信任务背书。具体包括：证据门控预防（evidence-gated prevention），仅当契约证明合理时才允许效应发生；基于欺骗的暴露（deception-based exposure），使未被背书的使用在效应提交前自我暴露。该方法不依赖特定攻击策略或污点追踪。
AI.result: 在13个基线对比下，APEX在六个基准中的五个实现0%攻击成功率，第六个为0.56%；在三种能力单元类型上对自适应攻击均保持0%；并且在不同防御者骨干模型下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 防御有效性源于任务所允许的内容，而非攻击的构造方式，因此可统一适用于各类能力单元，无需攻击特定策略。代码已开源。

title: Capacity, Responsiveness and Alignment: What Makes a Latent Structure Actionable
summary: Localizing latent structures in the activation space of language models (LMs) is central to understanding and controlling their behavior. Yet, localized structures can differ substantially in their causal influence, raising the question of what makes a structure actionable. We tackle this question by casting causal influence as a product of three factors and showing empirically that they act as interpretable, distinct constraints: capacity, measuring the sensitivity of the model's output to movement along the structure, responsiveness, capturing how promotable the concept is given the current context, and alignment, reflecting how well the structure aligns with the context-specific representation of the concept. Across 4 LM families and 50 concepts, we observe that causal effectiveness requires all factors to be high; low capacity and responsiveness reduce it by 84% and 95%, respectively, while low alignment can reverse it, suppressing concept expression. Moreover, we find that causality is context-dependent rather than an intrinsic property of the structure, with causally effective directions forming a low-dimensional subspace that varies across contexts. By restricting the training of linear probes to this subspace, we introduce causal probes that achieve 17%-118% improvement in steering across models, with only 3% reduction in concept detection.

AI.tldr: 本文将潜在结构的因果影响力分解为容量、响应性、对齐性三个可解释因素，并据此提出"因果探针"，显著提升语言模型的概念操控效果。
AI.motivation: 定位语言模型激活空间中的潜在结构是理解与控制模型行为的关键，但不同局部结构的因果影响力差异很大，目前尚不清楚什么样的结构才具有"可操作性"。
AI.method: 将因果影响力建模为三个因素的乘积：容量（输出对沿该结构移动的敏感性）、响应性（在当前语境下该概念的易激发程度）、对齐性（结构与语境特定概念表征的一致程度）；在4个模型家族、50个概念上进行实证分析，并据此将线性探针的训练限制在因果有效方向构成的低维子空间，构造因果探针。
AI.result: 因果有效性需三个因素同时较高；容量低和响应性低分别使因果效力下降84%和95%，对齐性低甚至会反转效果、抑制概念表达；因果性依赖语境而非结构固有属性，因果有效方向构成随语境变化的低维子空间；因果探针在各模型上使操控效果提升17%–118%，概念检测仅下降3%。
AI.conclusion: 因果影响力可被分解为可解释的约束条件，且因果性是语境依赖的；将探针限制于因果有效子空间能在几乎不损失检测能力的前提下大幅提升对语言模型行为的操控。

title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
summary:
Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

AI.tldr: Text2Dashboard 是一个 DataBrain 专用的原型系统，通过 Codex 插件与独立 Agent Runtime，将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘；其核心是"模型提议、确定性软件控制执行"的分工架构。
AI.motivation: 自然语言到分析仪表盘的自动化需求存在，但纯模型驱动的执行缺乏可控性、可审计性与故障恢复能力；作者希望构建一个在受限 schema 下可检查、可审计、可恢复的工作流。
AI.method: 系统由可安装的 Codex 插件与独立 Agent Runtime 组成，结合 schema 约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久化状态与确定性 Hooks（用于审批、审计、检查点、恢复与失败处理）。流水线包括实体消解、元数据发现、只读 SQL 强制、仪表盘编排，以及静态检查、动态预检与浏览器检查。模型仅提出动作，确定性软件负责执行并记录状态转移。
AI.result: 在冻结的真实 DataBrain 任务与受控 Hook 故障上评估：元数据与 SQL 任务严格成功 6/8（元数据选择 4/4，四项 SQL 均满足语义标准，2/4 满足精确输出列契约）；最终版本通过 4/4 单面板仪表盘任务、一个双面板任务及一个既有仪表盘细化任务，一个参数化任务超出步数限制。十个故障场景全部达成既定结果且无未授权外部副作用。模型推理占各组观测运行时 97% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 这些规模小且 DataBrain 专属的结果不足以证明生产就绪性、通用 text-to-SQL 准确性，或相较人工构建仪表盘的效率优势。

title: LLM-Based Multi-Agent Collaboration for Constrained Multi-Objective Container Placement
summary: Container placement in data centers must simultaneously minimize power consumption and maximize affinity preferences, while satisfying multi-resource capacity and anti-affinity constraints. Traditional approaches typically rely on fixed rules, which lack adaptability to dynamic cluster states and are difficult to extend for adaptive decision-making. On the other hand, meta-heuristic methods, although more flexible, are often computationally expensive, slower and prone to getting trapped in local optima. In this work, we propose an adaptive and efficient approach based on an LLM-driven multi-agent collaboration framework, where four specialized agents operate in a closed-loop ReAct cycle at each placement step. A Power Consumption Agent and an Affinity Agent debate over competing objectives, while a Placement Agent resolves conflicts using Tolerance-Gated Arbitration (TGA). A Rearrangement Agent further refines decisions through the Monotone Improvement Rule (MIR) in a post-placement refinement phase. All the agents reason over deterministic, feasibility-filtered candidate tables provided by the environment, ensuring that every proposed action inherently satisfies hard constraints. Based on experimental evaluation using the Google Cluster Trace with a configuration of 100 applications and 25 machines, the proposed framework consumes 8.36% less power and achieves 39.30% higher affinity than the power-greedy baseline. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component, the multi-round debate mechanism, the TGA in the Placement Agent, and the MIR in the Rearrangement Agent, contributes meaningfully to the overall performance, with removal of any single component degrading both power consumption and affinity satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种LLM驱动的多智能体协作容器放置框架，通过多智能体辩论、容差门控仲裁(TGA)与单调改进规则(MIR)实现节能与亲和性兼顾。
AI.motivation: 容器放置需同时最小化功耗、最大化亲和性偏好，并满足多维资源容量与反亲和约束；传统固定规则缺乏对动态集群状态的自适应性，元启发式方法计算开销大、易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 基于LLM驱动的多智能体协作框架，四个专用智能体在每一步放置中运行闭环ReAct循环：功耗智能体与亲和性智能体就冲突目标进行辩论，放置智能体通过容差门控仲裁(TGA)解决冲突；重排智能体在后置精化阶段以单调改进规则(MIR)进一步优化决策。所有智能体在环境提供的确定性、可行性过滤后的候选表上推理，保证动作天然满足硬约束。
AI.result: 在Google Cluster Trace、100个应用与25台机器的配置下，相比功耗贪心基线，功耗降低8.36%，亲和性提升39.30%。消融实验表明多轮辩论机制、放置智能体中的TGA与重排智能体中的MIR均有显著贡献，移除任一组件都会同时恶化功耗与亲和性满足度。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM驱动多智能体协作框架在满足硬约束前提下，有效兼顾功耗与亲和性目标，且各架构组件均具备必要性。

title: RADC: Risk-Aware Dual Caching for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Cache-based test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language models is often hindered by background bias in global representations and unreliable entropy-based cache admission under representation variations. To address these limitations, we propose RADC, which enhances prototype learning through reliable dual caching. RADC introduces a Semantic Foreground Cache that aggregates category-consistent spatial evidence from CLIP representations, yielding foreground prototypes that complement the global cache while mitigating background interference. To reliably manage both caches, Gaussian Risk Admission models multi-view representations as diagonal Gaussian distributions and jointly considers class separation and feature uncertainty to prioritize reliable cache candidates. RADC integrates zero-shot logits with complementary global- and foreground-cache predictions for robust inference. Extensive experiments on cross-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RADC方法，通过语义前景缓存与高斯风险准入的双缓存机制提升视觉语言模型测试时自适应性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于缓存的测试时自适应方法存在两个问题：全局表示受背景偏置干扰，且基于熵的缓存准入机制在表示变化下不可靠。
AI.method: RADC包含两部分：1）语义前景缓存，从CLIP表示中聚合类别一致的空间证据，生成前景原型以补充全局缓存、缓解背景干扰；2）高斯风险准入，将多视图表示建模为对角高斯分布，联合考虑类别分离度与特征不确定性以筛选可靠的缓存候选。推理时融合零样本logits与全局/前景缓存预测。
AI.result: 在跨域和分布外基准上取得了持续的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: RADC通过可靠的双缓存原型学习，有效缓解背景偏置与缓存准入不可靠问题，实现稳健的测试时自适应。

title: When Does External Guidance Help LLM Reasoning? A Bias-Variance Theory of Guidance-Augmented GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, and a recent wave of methods (LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, TAPO) further augments RL with \emph{external guidance} - expert traces, self-explanations, or retrieved thought patterns. Although each method reports empirical gains, none provides convergence rates, bias bounds, or an optimal weighting rule for the guidance signal. We close this gap with \emph{Guidance-Augmented GRPO} (GA-GRPO), a unified theoretical framework that casts external guidance as a stochastic guidance operator G re-writing the question distribution, and analyses the resulting policy-gradient estimator as a biased on-policy estimator whose bias is bounded by the total-variation guidance divergence delta\_G between the guidance-augmented sampling distribution and the policy's own distribution. The framework subsumes vanilla GRPO, LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, and TAPO as special cases obtained by particular choices of G. Under smoothness and bounded-divergence assumptions we prove that GA-GRPO converges at rate O(1/sqrt(T)) to an O(delta sqrt(T))-neighbourhood of the GRPO stationary point, derive the closed-form MSE-optimal guidance weight lambda-star(T, delta, sigma\_0 squared) = sigma\_0 squared / (sigma\_0 squared + R\_max squared delta squared T), and prove a matching minimax lower bound showing the Omega(delta squared T) bias term is unavoidable. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base across nine math and OOD benchmarks confirm that optimal-weight GA-GRPO matches or surpasses TAPO, LUFFY, ExPO, and vanilla GRPO while requiring 31\% fewer GPU-hours, and eight analysis experiments validate each theoretical prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Guidance-Augmented GRPO（GA-GRPO），一个统一理论框架，将LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO等外部引导强化学习方法建模为带偏的on-policy估计器，给出收敛率、偏差界与最优引导权重，并用实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有将外部引导（专家轨迹、自解释、检索思维模式）融入RLVR的方法（LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO）虽报告了经验收益，但都缺乏收敛率、偏差界以及引导信号的最优加权规则，理论基础缺失。
AI.method: 提出GA-GRPO统一框架：将外部引导刻画为改写问题分布的随机引导算子G，把相应策略梯度估计器分析为偏差on-policy估计器；偏差由引导增强采样分布与策略自身分布间的全变差引导散度delta_G界定。该框架通过不同G的取法涵盖vanilla GRPO、LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO作为特例。
AI.result: 在光滑性与有界散度假设下，证明GA-GRPO以O(1/sqrt(T))速率收敛至GRPO稳定点的O(delta sqrt(T))邻域；推导出闭式MSE最优引导权重lambda-star(T, delta, sigma_0^2)=sigma_0^2/(sigma_0^2+R_max^2 delta^2 T)；并证明匹配的minimax下界，表明Omega(delta^2 T)偏差项不可避免。Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base在九个数学及OOD基准上，最优权重GA-GRPO匹配或超越TAPO、LUFFY、ExPO与vanilla GRPO，且GPU小时减少31%；八项分析实验验证了各理论预测。
AI.conclusion: GA-GRPO为外部引导增强的RLVR提供了统一的理论刻画，首次给出一族方法的收敛率、偏差界与最优权重规则，理论下界与实验一致，兼顾理论严谨性与计算效率。

title: Geometric Coherence via Weighted Matching for 3D Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reach-Avoid Games
comment: ICRA 2026 Workshop on Multi-Agent Robotic Systems: Real-World Collaboration and Interaction
summary: We study assignment quality in 3D heterogeneous multi-agent reach-avoid games and identify a recurring failure mode of cardinality-only matching in geometrically structured scenarios, which we term \emph{Geometric Sprawl}. In these cases, multiple maximum-cardinality assignments are available, but some induce spatially incoherent pairings and inefficient pursuit trajectories. Building on the evasion-space framework of Yan et al.~\cite{yan2022}, we introduce a cardinality-first weighted sequential matching method in which the Hamilton--Jacobi--Isaacs interception value $z_I(s,j)$ is used as a secondary assignment weight. Each sequential stage is solved with a min-cost max-flow backend, while the unweighted baseline uses the same solver with the weight term removed. We evaluate both methods on a deterministic 35-scenario benchmark (7 families & 5 initialization variants) under two regimes: a diagnostic stationary-unmatched setting and a hybrid saddle-point setting with goal-directed unmatched evaders. On this benchmark, the weighted method resolves 13 of 15 geometric stress-test instances that cause repeated timeouts for the unweighted baseline in the diagnostic regime, and under the hybrid regime improves mean captures from $3.20$ to $3.91$ (22\% increase) and mean interception height from $3.87$ to $5.36$ (40\% increase). We also report lower path tortuosity and lower angular-effort proxy values, suggesting smoother pursuit trajectories in this first-order simulation model. We release the simulator and benchmark suite at \href{https://github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching}{github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching} to support reproducible evaluation of assignment strategies for 3D reach-avoid games.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究3D异构多智能体reach-avoid博弈中的任务分配质量问题，指出仅基于基数的匹配在几何结构化场景下会出现"几何蔓延"(Geometric Sprawl)失效模式，并提出以HJI拦截值为次级权重的基数优先加权序贯匹配方法，在35场景基准上显著优于无权基线。
AI.motivation: 仅考虑基数的最大匹配在几何结构化场景中存在多种等价最大基数分配，部分分配产生空间不连贯的配对与低效追捕轨迹，即"几何蔓延"失效模式，需引入几何/拦截代价信息来提升分配质量。
AI.method: 基于Yan等人的evasion-space框架，提出基数优先的加权序贯匹配：以HJI拦截值z_I(s,j)作为次级分配权重；每个序贯阶段用最小费用最大流求解，无权基线使用同一求解器但去掉权重项。在确定性35场景基准（7族×5初始化变体）上，于诊断性静止未匹配设置与混合鞍点设置（含目标导向未匹配逃逸者）两种机制下评估。
AI.result: 加权方法在诊断机制下解决了15个几何压力测试实例中的13个（无权基线反复超时）；混合机制下平均捕获数由3.20提升至3.91（+22%），平均拦截高度由3.87提升至5.36（+40%）；路径曲折度与角努力代理指标更低，表明在一阶仿真模型中追捕轨迹更平滑。
AI.conclusion: 以HJI拦截值作为次级权重的基数优先序贯匹配可有效缓解几何蔓延问题，提升3D reach-avoid博弈的分配质量与追捕效率，且不损失最大基数性质；作者开源了仿真器与基准套件以支持可复现评估。

title: An Empirical Fault Vulnerability Exploration of ReRAM-based Process-in-Memory CNN Accelerators
summary: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM)-based Processing-in-Memory (PIM) accelerator is a promising platform for processing massively memory intensive matrix-vector multiplications of neural networks in parallel domain, due to its capability of analog computation, ultra-high density, near-zero leakage current, and non-volatility. Despite many advantages, ReRAM-based accelerators are highly error-prone due to limitations of technology fabrication that lead to process variations and defects. These limitations degrade the accuracy of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (Deep CNNs) running on PIM accelerators. While these CNNs accelerators are widely deployed in safety-critical systems, their vulnerability to fault is not well explored. In this paper, we have developed a fault injection framework to investigate the vulnerability of large-scale CNNs at both software- and hardware-level of inference phases. Faulty ReRAM devices are another reliability challenges due to significant degradation of classification accuracy when CNN parameters are mapped to the accelerators. To investigate this challenge, we map the CNN learning parameter to the ReRAM crossbar and inject faults into crossbar arrays. The proposed framework analyzes the impact of stuck-at high (SaH) and stuck-at low (SaL) fault models on different layers and locations of CNN learning parameters. By performing extensive fault injections, we illustrate that the vulnerability behavior of ReRAM-based PIM accelerator for CNNs is greatly impressible to the types and depth of layers, the location of the learning parameter in every layer, and the value and types of faults. Our observations show that different models have different vulnerabilities to faults. Specifically, we show that SaL further reduces classification accuracy than SaH.

AI.tldr: 提出故障注入框架，评估ReRAM存内计算加速器上大规模CNN推理阶段在软硬件层面的脆弱性，揭示故障类型、层深与参数位置对精度的影响规律。
AI.motivation: ReRAM存内计算加速器因模拟计算、高密度、近零漏电与非易失性，适合并行处理神经网络中内存密集的矩阵-向量乘法。但受工艺制造限制，存在工艺偏差与缺陷，导致器件易发生故障，进而降低深度CNN精度；而这类加速器广泛部署于安全关键系统，其故障脆弱性尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建故障注入框架，覆盖推理阶段的软件层与硬件层。将CNN学习参数映射至ReRAM交叉阵列，向阵列注入故障，采用stuck-at high（SaH）与stuck-at low（SaL）两类故障模型，分析不同层、不同参数位置下的故障影响，并进行大规模故障注入实验。
AI.result: 故障注入实验表明，ReRAM PIM加速器对CNN的脆弱性行为显著受层类型与深度、学习参数在每层中的位置、故障数值与类型影响；不同模型对故障的脆弱性不同。其中SaL对分类精度的降低程度大于SaH。
AI.conclusion: ReRAM PIM加速器上CNN的故障脆弱性具有结构性与位置依赖性，需在软硬件协同设计中针对层类型、参数位置与故障类型采取差异化容错策略，尤其应重点关注SaL故障。

title: TARE: Weigh a Never-Poisoned Twin Before Reading Backdoor-Defense Costs
summary: Backdoor-defense leaderboards print a clean-accuracy drop and read it as removal cost. Measured on the poisoned victim alone, the drop cannot separate removal from what the defense does to any model, and inherits the victim's start, which for three of BackdoorBench's sixteen attacks is a configuration file: WaNet, BPP and Input-Aware ship a MultiStepLR that never fires, so their victims never anneal and are the least accurate in 30/31 public CIFAR cells at $\leq$5%. On PreAct-ResNet18, fine-tuning-family defenses return a low start to their own level, so there the published cost is negative, the benchmark's rating clips the "gain" to zero, and 2 of 48 citing defense papers we read rest a no-cost claim on those cells; TSBD and CGD, re-run with their code, "gain" on a never-poisoned model too. A $2\times2$ editing only that scheduler line isolates the cause, its swapped arms self-registered before they ran: the sign of the fine-tuning family's clean-model cost reverses both ways while its published gain on the annealed victim only shrinks toward zero, 44/44 seeds following the schedule, replicated on BPP, FT-SAM, CIFAR-100 and VGG19-BN and induced in a second toolkit. TARE runs the same defense on a never-poisoned twin of the same recipe, schedule and seed (on BackdoorBench, $\leq$10 poisoned images, admitted only below 5% attack success); what the twin loses is the tare. On the BadNets grid seven of eight defenses charge the twin (Neural Cleanse only where its detector fires), +0.13 (fine-tuning) to +5.70 points (I-BAU); the eighth, ABL, destroys it. Within an attack the start cancels from rankings, so the tare re-orders nothing there; what poisoning adds beyond it is printed under two estimators and not corrected, its removal share unidentified. We ship the three-key patch, a signed tare column (7 attacks $\times$ 8 defenses) and TARE-Z, a twin-free estimator for seed-stable defenses.

AI.tldr: 现有后门防御排行榜把干净准确率下降误当作"移除代价"：该指标混淆了防御对任意模型的影响、继承了受害者模型的初始精度（如WaNet、BPP、Input-Aware因调度器失效而从不退火），导致代价被高估甚至为负。作者提出TARE双胞胎估计器，用未投毒的相同配置模型分离出防御自身代价，并发布补丁、带符号tare列及无孪生估计器TARE-Z。
AI.motivation: 后门防御排行榜普遍以"干净准确率下降"作为移除代价指标。但该指标只在被投毒受害者上测量，无法区分"防御本身的代价"与"投毒造成的精度损失"，还继承了受害者模型的不良起点（三类攻击因MultiStepLR调度器从不触发而从不退火，精度极低），从而系统性地扭曲防御评估与引用结论。
AI.method: 作者通过2×2实验仅修改调度器一行代码来隔离原因；提出TARE方法：对同一配方、调度与种子的未投毒孪生模型运行相同防御，孪生模型所损失的部分即为tare（防御自身代价）；并在BackdoorBench上以≤10张投毒图像、攻击成功率低于5%为门槛进行验证，跨BPP、FT-SAM、CIFAR-100、VGG19-BN及第二套工具包复现；进一步提出无孪生的TARE-Z估计器用于种子稳定防御。
AI.result: 在PreAct-ResNet18上，微调类防御从低起点恢复到自身水平，使已发布代价为负，排行榜将"增益"裁剪为零，48篇引用文献中有2篇据此主张无代价；TSBD与CGD重跑后在从未投毒模型上同样出现"增益"。BadNets网格上8个防御中7个对孪生模型造成损失（+0.13到+5.70点，Neural Cleanse仅在其检测器触发时），ABL则直接摧毁孪生模型。同一攻击内起点从排名中抵消，故tare不改变攻击内排序。
AI.conclusion: 干净准确率下降不能作为后门移除代价的有效度量，其继承了受害者起点并混入防御通用代价。TARE通过未投毒孪生模型分离出防御自身代价，作者发布三项关键补丁、带符号tare列（7攻击×8防御）及无孪生估计器TARE-Z，以纠正已发布代价并重新规范后门防御评估标准。

title: Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementation of RAPTOR, NavTree is the strongest matched-cost hierarchical retriever in our evaluated grid and ties the strongest flat baseline. On long-document multi-hop QA, it is the only hierarchical method that significantly beats BM25 on a class-vs-class basis, corroborated by a reader-free retrieval-recall check. A matched-reader replication of the published abstractive RAPTOR variant, given strong cluster summaries, still loses to NavTree at every multi-chunk budget, at zero indexing cost. The ranking carries across stronger and open-weight readers, a stronger encoder, and a full factorial that isolates leaves-only emission as the structural lever.

AI.tldr: 提出 NavTree：仅叶子输出的确定性平衡分段树检索器，零索引期语言模型调用，仅将树作为导航支架；在长文档 QA 中层级式检索表现最佳，且零索引成本。
AI.motivation: 长文档检索中，扁平 top-k 检索容易聚集在单一区域而遗漏互补证据；RAPTOR 式摘要树通过递归聚类与摘要节点排序缓解该问题，但摘要生成本身需大量索引期语言模型调用，且其收益来源（摘要内容 vs 树结构导航）未被分离。
AI.method: NavTree 在 chunk 上构建确定性平衡分段树（索引期零语言模型调用），将树纯粹用作导航支架：以检索到的顶层叶子为锚点，进行混合词法-稠密的前沿游走，自根节点下降遍历，但仅向 reader 输出叶子 chunk。采用匹配成本评测，对比扁平检索器与 RAPTOR 的抽取式重实现。
AI.result: 在评测网格中，NavTree 是匹配成本下最强的层级式检索器，并追平最强扁平基线；在长文档多跳 QA 上，是唯一在类对类意义上显著优于 BM25 的层级方法，并通过无 reader 的检索召回检验佐证。对已发表抽象式 RAPTOR 变体的匹配 reader 复现实验（即使给定强簇摘要）在每一多 chunk 预算下仍不及 NavTree，且 NavTree 索引成本为零。该排序在更强 reader、开放权重 reader、更强编码器以及隔离"仅叶子输出"这一结构杠杆的全因子实验下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 摘要树在长文档 QA 中的主要收益可能来自导航而非生成的摘要内容；仅叶子输出的树导航即可在零索引成本下取得优于 RAPTOR 及扁平基线的效果，且结论具有良好的稳健性。

title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
summary:
Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance.
  We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

AI.tldr: FluidPD 是一个面向 P/D 分离式 LLM 服务的弹性系统，通过 FluidToken 与 FluidRole 两种机制实现 SLO 感知的原位弹性，无需新增 GPU 即可显著提升 SLO 达成率。
AI.motivation: 现有 P/D 分离系统多采用固定的 prefill/decode 工作节点比例与请求路由。但真实负载既存在短时突发，也存在 prefill-to-decode 需求比例的持续漂移，导致原本配置良好的比例迅速失配，即便集群中仍有空闲算力也会出现延迟 SLO 违规。现有自动扩缩容反应慢、需要备用 GPU，且无法应对短时间尺度的阶段失衡。
AI.method: 提出 FluidPD 系统，包含两种互补机制：1) FluidToken 处理瞬态失衡，在 decode 侧存在空闲时，将有限比例的 prefill 计算卸载到 decode worker；2) FluidRole 处理持续失衡，在原位重新分配正在运行的 worker 的 prefill 与 decode 角色，避免模型重载与引擎重启。两者均由轻量级压力指标（pressure indices）驱动，可在资源压力演化为 SLO 违规前将其暴露。
AI.result: 在 Azure 生产 trace 负载上，FluidPD 相比静态 SGLang 将整体 SLO 达成率最多提升 94.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SLO 感知的原位 P/D 弹性可在不额外配置工作节点的情况下提升服务质量，有效应对短时突发与持续失衡两类负载变化。

title: Repository-Scale Performance Characterization of the IO500 Benchmark
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Performance Measurement, Modeling, and Benchmarking Workshop (PMBS 2026), held in conjunction with SC26, Chicago, IL, November 2026
summary: The IO500 benchmark provides a common basis for evaluating high-performance computing (HPC) storage systems, while its growing submission repository also offers an opportunity to study performance behavior across systems and time. This work presents a repository-scale characterization of 294 post-reset IO500 submissions from 116 sites spanning 2019--2025. We combine descriptive and temporal analysis with phase-level correlation, scale-sensitivity analysis, and benchmark-log examination to investigate how performance characteristics represented by individual benchmark phases relate to composite rankings. The results show strong relationships among phases measuring similar I/O behavior, but weaker and scale-sensitive relationships between bandwidth and metadata performance. Temporal and log-level analyses further reveal information that is not apparent from aggregate scores alone. These findings demonstrate the value of analyzing IO500 results beyond leader-board rankings and identify important considerations concerning system scale, benchmark execution, and repository provenance when using community benchmark data for comparative and longitudinal HPC performance analysis.

AI.tldr: 对2019–2025年116个站点提交的294份IO500基准测试结果进行仓库级特征分析，揭示各测试阶段性能与综合排名之间的关系。
AI.motivation: IO500是评估高性能计算（HPC）存储系统的通用基准，其不断增长的提交仓库为研究系统与时间维度的性能行为提供了契机。现有分析多局限于排行榜排名，本文旨在挖掘排行榜之外的性能特征信息。
AI.method: 结合描述性与时序分析，采用阶段级相关性分析、规模敏感性分析和基准日志审查三种手段，考察单个基准测试阶段所反映的性能特征与综合排名的关联。
AI.result: 测量相似I/O行为的各阶段之间关系密切；但带宽性能与元数据性能之间的关系较弱且对系统规模敏感。时序分析和日志级分析进一步揭示了仅凭综合分数无法发现的信息。
AI.conclusion: 分析IO500结果的价值超越排行榜排名本身；将社区基准数据用于HPC性能的横向比较与纵向分析时，须重点考虑系统规模、基准执行过程和仓库数据来源（provenance）等因素。

title: UniPro: Unified Multi-Mode Medical Image Segmentation from 2D Images to 3D Volumes via Propagation
summary: Medical image segmentation remains fragmented along two axes: segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality. Existing methods are typically developed separately for semantic, in-context, and interactive segmentation, and are further specialized to either native 2D images or 3D volumetric data. In clinical practice, however, segmentation workflows take many forms: a case may be initialized by semantic prediction, reference-guided segmentation, or user interaction. Regardless of how it begins, fine-grained refinement is naturally performed on 2D views; for volumetric scans, such 2D edits must propagate coherently to the rest of the volume. We present UniPro, a unified model that bridges segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality, using propagation to extend 2D segmentation to 3D volumes. Our key insight is that volumetric propagation and in-context segmentation share the same reference-conditioned prediction mechanism, differing only in whether the reference image-mask pairs come from other cases or from previously segmented neighboring slices. Building on this view, UniPro supports semantic, in-context, interactive, and propagation-based segmentation within a single slice-based framework, using class priors, reference exemplars, user clicks, and neighboring-slice predictions as mode-specific conditioning inputs. To improve propagation reliability, UniPro further incorporates bidirectional and 3D supervision to regularize slice-wise propagation beyond per-slice losses. Extensive experiments across diverse modalities and anatomies show that UniPro achieves strong performance across all segmentation settings, enabling annotation-efficient 3D segmentation from sparse 2D initialization and reducing slice-by-slice correction effort.

AI.tldr: UniPro 是一个统一的切片级分割框架，通过"传播"机制将 2D 分割扩展至 3D 体数据，在同一模型内支持语义、上下文参考、交互式和传播式四种分割范式。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割方法在两条轴上彼此割裂：一是分割范式（语义分割、上下文/参考分割、交互式分割各自独立开发），二是数据维度（2D 原生图像与 3D 体数据分别专门化处理）。而临床实际流程往往混合多种形式：病例可能由语义预测、参考引导或用户交互初始化，且细粒度修正天然在 2D 视图上完成，对体数据还需将 2D 编辑一致地传播至整个体数据。因此亟需一个跨越范式与维度的统一模型。
AI.method: 作者的关键洞见是：体数据传播与上下文分割本质共享同一"参考条件预测"机制，区别仅在于参考图像-掩膜对来自其他病例还是来自已分割的相邻切片。基于此，UniPro 在单一基于切片的框架内，将类别先验、参考样例、用户点击、相邻切片预测分别作为各模式的特定条件输入，统一支持语义、上下文、交互式与传播式分割。为提升传播可靠性，模型进一步引入双向监督与 3D 监督，在逐切片损失之外对切片间传播进行正则化。
AI.result: 在多种模态和解剖结构上的大量实验表明，UniPro 在所有分割设定下均取得强劲性能，能够从稀疏的 2D 初始化实现标注高效的 3D 分割，并减少逐切片修正的工作量。
AI.conclusion: UniPro 通过以传播为核心的统一参考条件预测机制，成功弥合了分割范式与数据维度之间的鸿沟，为临床中多样化的分割工作流提供了单一且高效的解决方案。

title: Neutrosophic Ensemble Classification for Uncertainty-Aware Bearing Fault Detection: Evidence from Laboratory and Variable-Speed Industrial Benchmarks
summary: Machine learning classifiers for bearing fault detection produce scalar confidence scores that conflate confident errors with genuinely ambiguous predictions, and the conventional truth/falsity pair (F = 1 - T) is algebraically redundant by construction. We operationalize a refined neutrosophic decomposition of a Random Forest + XGBoost + Logistic Regression ensemble into four indicators -- T-hat (top-class evidence), F-hat (best-competitor evidence), predictive entropy I1-hat, and decision disagreement I2-hat -- evaluated on two bearing benchmarks (CWRU and JNU, 600-1000 rpm) under a leave-one-condition-out protocol. On CWRU, after correcting a file-to-class mapping error, the ensemble reaches 100.00 percent accuracy on three of four held-out loads (92.27 percent on the fourth), leaving too few errors for uncertainty analysis. On JNU, holding out 1000 rpm, accuracy collapses to 40.64 percent, below a majority-class baseline; Logistic Regression (57.91 percent) generalizes far better than the tree ensembles. I1-hat shows a robust association with error beyond T-hat/F-hat, while I2-hat contributes little; standalone Logistic Regression confidence outperforms the full decomposition, a boundary condition we report honestly. Two further results extend this: fusing a time-domain and a frequency-domain model of the same signal and scoring their Jensen-Shannon divergence beats that model own entropy (AURC 0.29 vs. 0.36 on the standard split; 0.54 vs. 0.73 under a harder single-condition reproduction), the only indicator moving correctly under a CWRU-versus-JNU distributional-shift contrast; and, on CWRU alone, literature-verified bearing fault frequencies, correctly demodulated via the envelope spectrum, separate most fault classes almost perfectly (99.57 percent) using three interpretable features. Code, logs, and figures are released for independent verification.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机森林+XGBoost+逻辑回归集成的置信度分解为四个中性论指标（T-hat、F-hat、预测熵I1-hat、决策分歧I2-hat），在CWRU与JNU轴承数据集上以留一工况协议评估；发现I1-hat对误差具有超出T/F的稳健关联，但单独的逻辑回归置信度反而更优，并给出域融合JSD指标与包络谱可解释特征两项扩展结果。
AI.motivation: 传统轴承故障分类器仅输出标量置信度，会把"高置信错误的预测"与"真正模糊的预测"混为一谈；同时常用真/假配对F = 1 − T在代数上由构造定义而冗余，无法提供独立信息。作者希望用更细粒度的不确定性分解来刻画误差来源，并检验其在跨工况泛化下的实际价值。
AI.method: 将RF+XGBoost+LR集成的置信度拆解为四个指标：T-hat（最高类证据）、F-hat（最强竞争类证据）、预测熵I1-hat与决策分歧I2-hat；在两个轴承基准（CWRU、JNU，600–1000 rpm）上采用留一工况（leave-one-condition-out）协议评估。另做两项扩展：融合同一信号的时域与频域模型并用Jensen-Shannon散度评分；以及在CWRU上利用文献验证的轴承故障频率，经包络谱解调提取三个可解释特征进行分类。
AI.result: CWRU上修正文件-类别映射错误后，集成在四个留出载荷中的三个达到100.00%准确率（第四个92.27%），误差过少难以做不确定性分析。JNU上留出1000 rpm时准确率骤降至40.64%，低于多数类基线；逻辑回归（57.91%）泛化显著优于树集成。I1-hat在T/F之外仍与误差稳健相关，I2-hat贡献甚微；单独的逻辑回归置信度优于完整分解（作为边界条件如实报告）。域融合JSD优于该模型自身熵（标准划分AURC 0.29 vs 0.36；更难的单工况复现下0.54 vs 0.73），是唯一在CWRU-vs-JNU分布偏移对比中方向正确的指标。CWRU上经包络谱正确解调的故障频率特征以99.57%准确率几乎完美区分多数故障类。
AI.conclusion: 细化的中性论分解中只有预测熵I1-hat带来超越T/F的增量信息，I2-hat几乎无用，而简单逻辑回归置信度反而更强，说明复杂不确定性分解并非普适增益，存在明确边界条件。与此同时，跨域JSD与包络谱可解释特征分别在同分布偏移监测和单数据集故障分类上表现突出；作者公开代码、日志与图表以供独立验证。

title: Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA
summary: Before deploying runtime recovery for a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, one must establish that an intervention improves success beyond ordinary run-to-run variation and that its complexity adds value over a simple action. We evaluate these questions on frozen $π_{0.5}$ across four RoboTwin tasks. For each test seed, we pair rollouts with and without correction and include a same-seed base-policy re-run as a placebo. Seed-cluster intervals and prespecified comparison rules assess net gains against stochastic outcome changes. Across 3,888 paired episodes, the full pipeline raises success on beat_allowbreak block_allowbreak hammer by $+13.5$\,pp (95\% interval $[+9.4,+17.7]$), with no detectable gain on the other three tasks at the deployed weight. Among failed base episodes on the responsive task, $43.2\%$ succeed on a plain re-run, compared with $63.5\%$ after correction; many nominal rescues therefore reflect the base policy's own variability. A fixed-time trigger and scripted return to an earlier joint configuration produce a net gain with no detected difference from the learned pipeline across two rounds, although our prespecified equivalence criterion is not met consistently. Pausing and a constant-action control do not yield comparable gains. On this benchmark, the decision to intervene depends strongly on the task, and a paired placebo plus a simple retreat baseline are needed to establish what learned correction contributes.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的π0.5策略上，通过配对安慰剂对照评估运行时恢复的真实增益：仅beat block hammer任务有显著提升（+13.5pp），且简单回退基线表现相当，说明需配对对照才能判断学习式纠正的价值。
AI.motivation: 部署运行时恢复前需确立两点：干预带来的成功提升是否超出运行间随机波动，以及其复杂性是否比简单动作更有价值。既有评估常缺少对照，可能把基础策略自身的随机性误判为恢复效果。
AI.method: 在四个RoboTwin任务上评估冻结的π0.5。对每个测试种子，配对有无纠正的rollout，并加入同种子基础策略重跑作为安慰剂。采用种子聚类区间与预先设定的比较规则衡量净增益。共3,888对配对回合，并对比固定时间触发+脚本化回退、暂停和恒定动作等基线。
AI.result: beat block hammer成功率提升+13.5pp（95%区间[+9.4,+17.7]），其余三任务在部署权重下无显著增益。响应任务中失败的基础回合，43.2%在普通重跑中成功，纠正后为63.5%。固定时间触发加脚本化回退在两轮中与学习式流程无显著差异（但预设等价性标准未稳定满足）；暂停与恒定动作对照未获得可比增益。
AI.conclusion: 该基准上是否干预强依赖任务；需配对安慰剂与简单回退基线，才能确立学习式纠正的真实贡献。

title: SVRF: Efficient Register Storage for Long-Vector Architectures
summary: Vector processors exploit data-level parallelism to provide high computational throughput, but very long vectors can make the Vector Register File (VRF) a significant source of area, energy, and register pressure. This cost is exacerbated when vector instructions operate on values with scalar semantics: although such values are architecturally represented using vector registers, they do not require full-width storage. This paper proposes the Scalarized Vector Register File (SVRF), a microarchitectural enhancement that redirects scalar-semantics vector values to a dedicated scalar register file, avoiding unnecessary allocation and access of full-width physical vector registers. The SVRF integrates with vector register renaming while preserving compatibility with the supported vector ISA. We implement and evaluate SVRF in an Register Transfer Level (RTL)-based RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV)-compliant vector processing unit supporting very long vectors. Across representative HPC and AI/ML workloads, the SVRF reduces vector-register pressure and VRF activity without degrading performance. By exploiting the resulting reduction in VRF demand, the proposed design achieves up to 15.8% VRF area reduction and up to 6% total area reduction, while reducing total power by up to 12% in evaluated configurations. Some workloads also achieve up to 1.12X speedup.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SVRF（标量化向量寄存器堆）微架构增强方案，将标量语义的向量值重定向到专用标量寄存器堆，避免全宽物理向量寄存器的无谓分配与访问，在保持性能不降的前提下降低VRF面积、总功耗。
AI.motivation: 向量处理器虽能通过数据级并行提供高吞吐，但超长向量使VRF成为面积、能耗和寄存器压力的重要来源。当向量指令操作具有标量语义的值时，这类值虽架构上用向量寄存器表示，却不需要全宽存储，造成浪费。因此需要针对性减少VRF的不必要占用与访问。
AI.method: 提出SVRF微架构增强：将标量语义的向量值重定向到专用标量寄存器堆，避免全宽物理向量寄存器的分配与访问；SVRF与向量寄存器重命名集成，并保持对所用向量ISA的兼容性。基于RTL实现了一个支持超长向量、符合RVV的向量处理单元并进行评估。
AI.result: 在典型HPC与AI/ML工作负载上，SVRF降低了向量寄存器压力和VRF活动且不损害性能。利用由此减少的VRF需求，设计实现最高15.8%的VRF面积缩减、最高6%的总面积缩减，总功耗最高降低12%；部分工作负载还获得最高1.12倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: SVRF通过将标量语义向量值卸载到专用标量寄存器堆，在不牺牲性能的情况下有效缓解超长向量带来的VRF面积、能耗与寄存器压力问题，并带来面积、功耗收益与部分场景的额外性能提升。

title: Which Image Property Carries the Jailbreak? A Controlled Dissection of Image-to-Text Jailbreaks
summary: Image-to-text jailbreaks place harmful intent in text, image content, or the relationship between them. We examine image-side factors across four published attack families on a 313-prompt StrongREJECT slice, using five multimodal models and an additional appendix evaluation of InternVL3.5-8B. The harmful instruction is held constant across conditions; the baseline matrix uses one draw per prompt, and paired ablations use three draws with an automated rubric judge. A bare harmful query, with or without a benign unrelated image, produces little attack success on most victims, while attack images substantially increase it. First, per-tile entropy and JPEG size do not reliably distinguish attack tiles from size-matched benign distractors, limiting density-only screening. Second, earlier tile-count ladders were confounded by payload visibility. A corrected region-count test found no detectable effect, so the role of tile-count structure remains unresolved. Third, on Qwen3-VL-8B, the E4 manipulation that removes query-specific relatedness lowers ASR by about 0.12. This supports a bounded attribution to the relatedness manipulation, although image-text congruence remains unmeasured. A within-category control reproduces the direction on overlapping stimuli. Five tests survive the global statistical correction, but only E4 supports attribution to one measured descriptor; the within-category result is a robustness check, not a separate attribution. These conclusions remain conditional on the rubric judge.

AI.tldr: 该研究在313条StrongREJECT提示切片上，用5个多模态模型（附录另含InternVL3.5-8B）系统检验四类已发表图像侧越狱攻击的归因：裸有害查询（无论是否配无关良性图）攻击成功率低，攻击图显著提升；逐块熵与JPEG体积无法可靠区分攻击块与等大小良性干扰块；早期块数阶梯受载荷可见性混淆，校正后的区域计数未见效应；仅E4（去除查询相关性的操纵）在Qwen3-VL-8B上使ASR下降约0.12，支持有限归因。结论以评分规约为条件。
AI.motivation: 图像到文本越狱可将有害意图置于文本、图像内容或二者的关系中，但已有研究多报告攻击成功，鲜有对图像侧具体因素的因果归因。作者希望厘清：究竟是图像的哪一属性（块密度/数量、熵与压缩体积、图文相关性）在驱动攻击成功，并检验既有结论是否受混淆变量（如载荷可见性）影响。
AI.method: 在313条StrongREJECT提示切片上，跨四类已发表攻击、5个多模态模型，附录追加InternVL3.5-8B。有害指令在条件间保持恒定；基线矩阵每提示单次采样，配对消融每提示三次采样，并用自动评分规约判定。进行逐块熵与JPEG体积的密度筛查检验；将早期块数阶梯与校正后的区域计数测试区分，以排除载荷可见性混淆；对E4（移除查询相关性的操纵）做归因检验，并以类内对照在重叠刺激上复现方向性；采用全局统计校正控制多重比较。
AI.result: 裸有害查询（含/不含无关良性图）在多数受害模型上ASR很低，而攻击图像显著提高ASR。逐块熵与JPEG大小不能可靠区分攻击块与等大小良性干扰块，限制了仅凭密度的筛查。早期块数阶梯因载荷可见性而混淆，校正的区域计数测试未检出可检测效应，块数结构的作用仍未定。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，E4操纵使ASR下降约0.12，支持对"相关性操纵"的有限归因；类内对照在重叠刺激上复现方向。五项检验通过全局统计校正，但仅E4支持归因至某一可测描述符，类内结果为稳健性检验而非独立归因。
AI.conclusion: 攻击图像是提升越狱成功率的关键图像侧载体，而非一般性的图像存在或图像密度。现有密度类筛查指标（熵、JPEG体积）鉴别力不足；块数结构的效应尚未确定。唯一获得因果支持的图像侧因素是查询相关性（E4），其效应约为0.12 ASR，且受类内稳健性支持但非独立归因。所有结论均以自动评分规约的有效性为条件，图文一致性未被测量，故归因仍属有界。

title: Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms
summary: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal.
