Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过组件级干预分解拒答激活引导，发现拒答方向集中于稀疏的注意力/MLP组件及其部分残差流维度中。
AI.motivation: 激活引导能操控大模型行为，但其干预的机制基础尚不清楚，尤其是拒答行为如何被编码和引导缺乏机制性理解。
AI.method: 在四个开放权重模型上将拒答引导分解为组件级干预，识别足以复现完整行为效果的稀疏注意力与MLP组件的子集，并进一步分析组件内残差流维度的稀疏性。
AI.result: 拒答方向集中在仅占上游组件28--48%的稀疏组件机制中，仍保留88--101%的引导效果；在机制内部，有效引导进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留组件机制基线的85--98%，符合特权基结构。稀疏性体现在两层：被引导的组件以及其中承载信号的维度。
AI.conclusion: 拒答并非弥散编码于整个Transformer中，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成，为理解拒答行为的表征与引导提供了机制基础，并开源代码与实验结果。

title: Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning
summary: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"锚点散度"（Anchor Divergences），通过对比学习、指数族与信息几何的相互作用，建立锚点概率分布与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的对应关系，从而在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似度提供单一固定几何，但语义相似性本质上是上下文相关的：两幅图像可能因同一物体、相同视觉风格或相同临床征象而相似。因此需要一种能在固定表示上指定上下文特定语义几何的方法。
AI.method: 利用对比学习、指数族分布与信息几何三者的相互作用，建立锚点上的概率分布与表示空间上的Bregman几何之间的对应关系；基于该对应定义Anchor Divergences，实现对上下文特定语义几何的建模——建模锚点分布即等价于建模几何本身。
AI.result: 检索实验表明，锚点散度能够有效且高效地指定上下文特定的语义相似性。
AI.conclusion: 对比表示天然蕴含一族几何结构，可针对特定语义结构进行特化；锚点散度提供了一种在固定表示上灵活指定上下文语义几何的实用范式。

title: T-CCL: Resource Efficient and Performant Collective Communication using Tensor Memory Accelerator
summary: Large transformer-based models increasingly depend on multi-GPU execution, which requires frequent collective communication among GPUs. Existing communication libraries often rely on many GPU threads to achieve high bandwidth or low latency, resulting in a large streaming multiprocessor (SM)-side resource footprint. This footprint can limit the resources available to other GPU work, particularly when communication and computation execute concurrently. Thus, efficient collective communication should not only achieve high collective performance but also reduce its SM-side resource usage. This paper presents T-CCL, a resource-efficient collective communication library based on the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) for intra-node communication. T-CCL offloads both data movement and reduction operations to TMA and executes each collective as a pipelined series of asynchronous TMA operations, reducing the SM resources required for collective communication while maintaining high bandwidth. Evaluated across AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter collectives, T-CCL outperforms NCCL by up to 2.4x with unrestricted communication resources and up to 3.42x under restricted resource budgets, remains competitive with NCCL's recent symmetric-memory kernels, and occupies the same or fewer SMs in profiled cases. In a GEMM-collective overlap case study, switching the communication backend from NCCL to T-CCL raises the average operator-level speedup over a sequential baseline from 1.12x to 1.25x on two GPUs and from 1.04x to 1.14x on four GPUs, as T-CCL uses fewer SMs for communication, leaving more SMs available to the overlapped GEMM. Integrated into vLLM as a communication backend, T-CCL improves end-to-end inference throughput over vLLM's automatic backend dispatch by up to 1.31x, outperforming it at every evaluated batch size on both the conversation and decode-heavy workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出基于TMA的节点内集合通信库T-CCL，将数据传输与规约卸载至TMA并以异步流水线执行，在保持高带宽的同时显著降低SM资源占用。
AI.motivation: 现有多GPU集合通信库依赖大量GPU线程以获取高带宽或低延迟，导致SM侧资源占用过大，在通信与计算并发时挤占其他GPU任务资源，因此需要兼顾高性能与低资源开销的集合通信方案。
AI.method: 面向节点内通信设计T-CCL，利用Tensor Memory Accelerator将数据搬移与规约操作卸载至TMA，并把每个集合操作实现为异步TMA操作组成的流水线，以减少SM资源需求；覆盖AllReduce、AllGather、ReduceScatter，并集成到vLLM作为通信后端。
AI.result: 在不受限通信资源下最高较NCCL快2.4倍，在受限资源预算下最高快3.42倍，与NCCL新版对称内存内核性能相当且占用SM数相同或更少；GEMM-集合重叠中，算子级平均加速比在双GPU由1.12倍升至1.25倍、四GPU由1.04倍升至1.14倍；集成vLLM后端后端到端推理吞吐最高提升1.31倍，在会话与解码密集型负载各批量下均优于自动后端调度。
AI.conclusion: T-CCL通过TMA卸载与异步流水线设计，在维持高带宽的同时降低SM资源占用，提升了受限资源下的通信性能与通信-计算重叠效率，并能提升实际推理服务的端到端吞吐。

title: Beyond the Linear Representation Hypothesis: Non-Linear Activation Steering in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which assumes that high-level concepts are encoded as linear directions in activation space. Yet a natural visual concept does not necessarily require a linear visual transition: between sunny and stormy lies an intermediate weather state such as a sky with a few white clouds, not simply a weaker storm; between a caterpillar and a butterfly, the progression is not a caterpillar with continuously growing wings. This raises the question of whether such true intermediate states are also represented nonlinearly by the model. Indeed, when we prompt text-to-image models directly for intermediate attributes, their activations rarely fall along the straight direction connecting the endpoints. Therefore, we propose KANSteer, which models concept traversal as a curve passing through its intermediate states. Seeking a representation that is both simple and interpretable, we propose to use Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), which provide a one-dimensional coordinate whose learned functions define the trajectory. This allows the steering direction to vary along the concept while preserving an interpretable representation. Across several concepts and text-to-image diffusion transformers, we find that their activation trajectories substantially deviate from straight lines, and that KANSteer provide a closer fit and smoother traversal of intermediate attributes than linear steering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KANSteer，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 将概念遍历建模为穿过中间状态的曲线，而非线性方向，从而更准确地拟合与操控文生图扩散模型中的概念表征。
AI.motivation: 线性表征假说（LRH）假设高层概念以激活空间中的线性方向编码，但许多视觉概念的过渡并非线性：晴天到暴风雨之间存在"少许白云的中间天气态"，毛毛虫到蝴蝶也非"不断长翅膀的毛毛虫"。直接提示模型生成中间属性时，其激活很少落在连接两端点的直线上，因此需要检验这些真实中间状态是否被模型非线性地表征。
AI.method: 提出 KANSteer：将概念遍历建模为经过中间状态的曲线。采用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KANs），提供一个一维坐标，其学习到的函数定义轨迹，使引导方向沿概念变化，同时保持可解释的表征。
AI.result: 在多个概念和多种文生图扩散 Transformer 上，模型的激活轨迹明显偏离直线；相比线性引导，KANSteer 对中间属性的拟合更接近、遍历更平滑。
AI.conclusion: 概念在文生图模型激活空间中呈现显著的非线性轨迹，KANSteer 提供了一种简单、可解释且优于线性引导的曲线式概念操控方法。

title: Comparative review of hybrid forecasting models for short-term prediction of building thermal load
summary: In this paper, a comparative review of different hybrid models for short-term forecasting of building thermal demand is carried out. Particularly, the assessment tackles the comparison of data-driven models enhanced with other state-of-the-art techniques. At the first step, the existing techniques reported in the literature are analysed. It is concluded that Metaheuristics or a data-driven model are used to identify the parameters of the basic model. The qualitative evaluation includes for each method the input and output features, main advantages and drawbacks. At the second step, an existing dataset of historical thermal demand from Scottish households, as well as historical weather forecasts are utilized to assess additionally the performance of existing hybrid methods. From the assessment of 13 hybrid methods, the Empirical Modal Decomposition - long short-term memory - Markov (EMD-LSTM-Markov) model can predict with the highest accuracy the day-ahead power pattern of heating and domestic hot water (DHW) demands. Though local power peaks are also accurately predicted, high power swells and spikes are underestimated. Other methods, such as Support Vector Machine - Simulated Annealing (SVM-SA) and Random Forest - Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm - LSTM (RF-ISSA-LSTM) predict a smooth pattern of heating and DHW demand profiles with rapid changes underestimating most power peaks.

AI.tldr: 本文对建筑短期热需求预测的多种混合模型进行了对比综述与实证评估，涵盖文献梳理和基于苏格兰住户历史热需求及气象预报数据的13种混合方法测试。结果表明EMD-LSTM-Markov模型在日前供热与生活热水功率预测中精度最高，但高功率尖峰被低估；SVM-SA与RF-ISSA-LSTM则预测曲线平滑，快速变化时明显低估峰值。
AI.motivation: 建筑热需求（供热与生活热水）的短期预测对能源系统调度与运行至关重要。已有研究提出大量混合模型（数据驱动模型结合元启发式或其他先进技术），但缺乏系统性的比较与统一数据下的实证验证，因此有必要对不同混合模型的预测性能进行对比评估。
AI.method: 采用两步法：第一步对文献中已报道的混合建模技术进行梳理与定性评估，归纳各类方法所用元启发式或数据驱动参数辨识方式，并从输入输出特征、主要优缺点等维度评价；第二步利用苏格兰住户历史热需求数据集与历史气象预报数据，对13种现有混合方法进行统一的定量性能评估。
AI.result: 在所评估的13种混合方法中，EMD-LSTM-Markov模型对日前供热和生活热水（DHW）功率曲线的预测精度最高，且能较准确预测局部功率峰值，但对高功率骤升和尖峰存在低估。SVM-SA与RF-ISSA-LSTM等方法预测出较平滑的供热与DHW需求曲线，在需求快速变化时对多数功率峰值估计不足。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型在建筑短期热需求预测中总体表现良好，但不同方法在峰值捕捉能力上存在明显差异：分解类方法（如EMD-LSTM-Markov）整体精度更优，而部分机器学习组合方法倾向于平滑化预测。未来建模应重点关注高功率骤升与尖峰的准确刻画。

title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robot manipulation systems using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model backbones typically use just one VLA for task execution. However, individual VLAs do not perform well across different task states and environments. We introduce a framework for dynamically composing multiple VLA policies during execution: StepWise Action Policy Routing (SWAP). SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation. SWAP enables robots to select new policies to execute online rather than committing to a single policy for the duration of an episode. We evaluate SWAP on both real-world DROID manipulation tasks and LIBERO simulation experiments. SWAP improves over fixed-policy execution and routing baselines, giving absolute improvements in real-world task success up to 33% while reducing successful trajectory robot action step length by 28.3%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SWAP 框架，将多 VLA 策略的动态组合形式化为离线强化学习问题，通过学习路由评论器在每步决策中选择最合适的策略，实现执行过程中的在线策略切换，在真实世界和仿真任务中均优于固定策略与路由基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 VLA 模型的机器人操作系统中通常仅使用单一 VLA 执行任务，但单个 VLA 在不同任务状态和环境下的表现不够理想，缺乏跨状态与跨环境的泛化能力。
AI.method: SWAP 将策略路由建模为离线强化学习问题，学习一个路由评论器（routing critic），在当前观测下为每个决策步选择最合适的策略。与在整个 episode 内固定使用单一策略不同，SWAP 允许机器人在线选择并切换新策略。评估涵盖真实世界 DROID 操作任务与 LIBERO 仿真实验。
AI.result: SWAP 优于固定策略执行和路由基线，在真实世界任务成功率上取得最高 33% 的绝对提升，同时将成功轨迹的机器人动作步长减少 28.3%。
AI.conclusion: 动态组合多个 VLA 策略并逐步路由，可有效缓解单一策略的局限，提升任务成功率并缩短成功轨迹的动作步数，为多策略协同的机器人操作提供可行方案。

title: Evaluating Inference Compute for Generative AI: A Framework for Enterprise Workloads
summary: LLM deployment is shifting from single-turn completion to agentic trajectories in which a model plans, calls tools, reads results and reasons at test time before acting. This inverts the economics of inference hardware: chat serving amortises weight reads across large batches, whereas agent trajectories are sequentially dependent, run at effective batch one, and make per-token decode latency (TPOT) the dominant term in task completion time. Using a roofline analysis and a closed-form episode-latency model, we show why this regime favours accelerators that keep weights in on-die SRAM (Cerebras WSE-3/3T, Groq/NVIDIA LPU) or compiler-managed tiered memory (SambaNova SN40L/SN50), and why three vendor ecosystems converged in 2026 on disaggregated prefill/decode serving. We show that per-step reliability compounds exponentially in trajectory length-a 2% per-step failure rate erases a 2x decode advantage for a 20-step agent-so determinism and tail latency are first-order performance variables. We then propose a four-layer evaluation framework (silicon, serving system, agent episode, enterprise) with a metric set built on goodput at an agentic SLO and cost per successful episode, a six-axis benchmark protocol over six task families, a paired-bootstrap statistical design, an attestation protocol for vendor-run benchmarks, and TCO, availability and adoption-timing models with explicit break-even conditions. All performance figures are public and labelled by evidence class; we state seven falsifiable hypotheses and the experiments that test them, and argue that the most likely original result is that token-throughput rankings diverge from cost-per-successful-task rankings on long-horizon work.

AI.tldr: 随着LLM从单轮补全转向测试时智能体轨迹，推理硬件经济性发生倒转：解码延迟（TPOT）成为任务完成时间主导项，硬件架构与评估体系需相应重构。
AI.motivation: LLM部署正从单轮补全转向智能体轨迹（智能体在测试时规划、调用工具、读取结果并推理后再行动），这颠覆了推理硬件的经济学：聊天服务通过大批次摊薄权重读取，而智能体轨迹顺序依赖、有效批次为1，使每token解码延迟（TPOT）成为任务完成时间的主导项。作者因此需要解释这一新范式为何偏向特定硬件架构，并建立适配的评估框架。
AI.method: 采用roofline分析与闭式episode延迟模型，论证该范式为何青睐将权重保留在片上SRAM的加速器（Cerebras WSE-3/3T、Groq/NVIDIA LPU）或编译器管理的分层内存（SambaNova SN40L/SN50），并分析2026年三大厂商生态在分离式prefill/decode服务上的趋同。进而提出四层评估框架（硅片、服务系统、智能体episode、企业）、基于智能体SLO下goodput与每成功episode成本的指标集、覆盖六类任务族的六轴基准协议、配对bootstrap统计设计、厂商自跑基准确认协议，以及含明确盈亏平衡条件的TCO、可用性与采用时机模型。
AI.result: 揭示智能体轨迹中每步可靠性呈指数复合：20步智能体下，每步2%失败率会抵消2倍解码优势，因此确定性与尾延迟是一阶性能变量。所有性能数据均为公开并按证据等级标注；提出七个可证伪假设及对应检验实验。
AI.conclusion: 最可能的原创结论是：在长时程任务上，token吞吐排名与每成功任务成本排名出现背离。作者据此主张以goodput与每成功episode成本为核心指标，并给出可检验的假设体系与评估协议，推动智能体时代的推理硬件与基准评估范式转变。

title: Towards a Unified Misuse Monitoring Benchmark
summary: LLM agents increasingly act in multi-actor environments, exposing them to misuse from multiple sources: decomposition attacks, where a harmful request is split into innocuous sub-requests, and prompt injection attacks, where a compromised tool delivers a malicious instruction. Existing evaluations treat these threats separately and ask whether a trajectory is harmful, rather than when it becomes harmful. We propose monitoring the agent's responses, where its actions are externalised, and ask whether the first point where monitors identify harm lands within a harm window (from the agent's first harmful commitment to goal execution). We develop a unified formalism for trace-level misuse monitoring and use it to construct a benchmark of ~6,200 conversation transcripts between a user, an LLM agent, and the external environment, spanning both threats in a shared schema, with a labelled harm window, corresponding benign controls, and matched instances of refusals to these requests. Across 17 monitor configurations, we find that our proposed action-framed monitors perform well on both threats under classical metrics (AUC: 0.95 and 0.99 respectively), while content-framed monitors collapse on injection attacks (AUC: 0.52). We also show that classical position-blind metrics paint an optimistic picture of monitor performance, since all monitors localise decomposition attacks poorly under the interval metric, which measures the ability to localise harm. Broadly, we illustrate the need for a unified study of misuse monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一的轨迹级误用监测形式化方法，构建约6200条对话轨迹的基准，同时覆盖分解攻击与提示注入攻击，并引入"危害窗口"与区间定位指标。实验发现动作框架监测器在两类威胁上表现良好（AUC 0.95/0.99），而内容框架监测器在注入攻击上崩溃（AUC 0.52），且传统位置无关指标会高估监测器性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益在多主体环境中行动，面临多种来源的误用：分解攻击（将有害请求拆分为无害子请求）与提示注入攻击（被污染工具传递恶意指令）。现有评估将两类威胁分开处理，且只判断轨迹是否有害，而非何时变得有害，缺乏统一研究。
AI.method: 提出监测智能体响应（动作被外化）的方法，判断监测器首次识别危害的位置是否落在危害窗口内（从智能体首次有害承诺到目标执行）。建立统一的轨迹级误用监测形式化方法，据此构建约6200条用户-LLM智能体-外部环境对话轨迹基准，两类威胁共享同一schema，包含标注的危害窗口、对应的良性对照及匹配的拒绝实例；在17种监测配置下进行评估。
AI.result: 提出的动作框架监测器在两类威胁上经典指标表现良好（分解攻击AUC 0.95，注入攻击AUC 0.99）；内容框架监测器在注入攻击上崩溃（AUC 0.52）。此外，经典位置无关指标对监测器性能给出过于乐观的图景，因为所有监测器在区间指标下对分解攻击的定位能力都很差。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了统一研究误用监测的必要性：需要同时覆盖多类威胁，并采用能评估危害定位能力的指标，而非仅依赖位置无关的经典指标。

title: Stabilizing language models under continual learning via condition-anchored distillation
summary: Continual adaptation of language models can change their output distribution on prompts learned earlier, while retaining every old prompt-answer pair may be undesirable or impossible. We study condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD): retain a small set of old prompts, use a frozen previous model to reconstruct completions and generation states, and match its predictive distributions while learning the next task. The formulation separates three roles that ordinary replay conflates: conditions select the behavior to protect, teacher generations locate relevant states, and soft targets specify how predictions may change. For autoregressive language generation, teacher-rollout distillation admits an exact chain-rule decomposition of sequence divergence. For masked-diffusion language modeling, our implementation directly controls local denoising drift on teacher-generated completions. In continual adaptation of a 219M masked diffusion language model, CAGD reduces four-task final held-out loss from 2.927 to 1.114 in one task order and from 2.168 to 0.891 in exact reverse. The same soft targets lower final average loss by 0.055 over hard replay when teacher-generated support is held identical. The direction persists on fresh facts and natural instructions across SMDM and Qwen3. On GSM8K, Qwen adaptation preserves answer-format compliance, but exact-match retention is seed-mixed at 0.6B and worsens at 1.7B. These results support condition-anchored functional preservation as a common design principle across the tested language-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 提出条件锚定生成式蒸馏(CAGD)：保留少量旧prompt，用冻结旧模型重建补全与生成状态，在学新任务时匹配其预测分布，实现语言模型持续适应中的功能保持。
AI.motivation: 语言模型持续适应会改变早期已学prompt上的输出分布，而保留全部旧prompt-答案对既不理想也不可行。需要一种能保留旧行为、但代价可控的机制。
AI.method: CAGD形式化分离了普通replay混淆的三种角色：条件(prompt)选择要保护的行为，教师生成定位相关状态，软目标规定预测可如何变化。自回归生成中，教师rollout蒸馏具有序列散度的精确链式分解；掩码扩散语言建模中，直接控制教师生成补全上的局部去噪漂移。
AI.result: 在219M掩码扩散模型持续适应中，四任务最终留出损失从2.927降至1.114(一种任务顺序)，逆序从2.168降至0.891。在教师生成支持相同条件下，软目标比硬replay降低最终平均损失0.055。该方向在SMDM与Qwen3的新事实和自然指令上持续成立。GSM8K上Qwen适应保持答案格式合规，但精确匹配保留在0.6B时受随机种子影响，在1.7B时变差。
AI.conclusion: 条件锚定功能保持可作为所测试语言生成目标间的通用设计原则。

title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
summary: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

AI.tldr: 提出RadOnc-Agent智能体框架，将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段、提供26个可调用函数，由大语言模型控制器完成意图到调用映射并保持纵向状态；在2600条单函数请求、200个跨阶段场景与120个真实患者工作流中分别达到98.79%、96.50%、96.67%的执行成功率，验证了LLM编排异构放疗能力的可行性，但未涉及临床正确性与效用。
AI.motivation: 现有AI在放疗各环节的能力彼此割裂，散落于不同临床阶段、软件环境与数据模态，无法与从治疗决策到随访的纵向工作流相匹配，缺乏统一协调机制。
AI.method: 将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，提供26个可调用函数与会话式接口；由LLM控制器将临床意图映射为受模式约束的调用，保留患者与工作流上下文并路由至专科服务；评估包括2600条单函数请求（7800次重复执行）、200个预设定合成跨阶段场景（600次执行）及来自60份去标识病历的120个工作流实例（360次干净执行），并开展纵向状态移除、模式与身份校验关闭等消融实验。
AI.result: 单函数执行中选定目标函数比例98.79%；脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率96.50%；真实患者工作流完成率96.67%。消融显示：移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率由96.50%降至84.00%；禁用模式与身份校验使后端错配调度由0%升至95.28%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了LLM编排架构协调异构放疗能力与信息、贯通纵向工作流的技术可行性；但未证明临床正确性、临床实用性或前瞻性收益。

title: Memory-Efficient Expert Routing for Distributed MoE Training
summary: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale toward hundreds of experts and higher top-$k$ routing, memory efficiency in distributed training becomes a critical bottleneck. Peak memory is dominated by the MoE block, not attention: every intermediate buffer in the MoE dispatch pipeline is individually scaled by top-k routing. The standard all-to-all dispatcher sends all routed tokens in a single collective step, requiring the full top-$k$-expanded buffer to be constructed at once. In this work, we propose RelayMoE, a ring-based MoE execution model that computes locally as expert weights or tokens circulate, avoiding full top-$k$-expanded dispatch buffers. RelayMoE selects between expert and token routing according to communication volume and overlaps transfers with computation. The ring structure naturally supports memory-efficient MoE recomputation during backward: each hop reconstructs expert intermediates, uses them to compute gradients, and releases them before the next hop. The saved memory supports longer sequences and larger batches, or retains more attention activations to reduce attention recomputation and improve training throughput. We evaluate RelayMoE on 30B$-$57B production MoE models and varied expert configurations. In single-layer MoE experiments, RelayMoE achieves a $2\times$ average speedup over Megatron-LM. In full-model training under the same GPU memory budget, it improves throughput by up to $2.02\times$ and extends the largest tested trainable sequence length by up to $2.85\times$.

AI.tldr: RelayMoE 提出一种环形 MoE 执行模型，通过专家/令牌循环计算避免构建完整的 top-k 扩展分派缓冲区，实现内存高效的 MoE 重计算与前向/反向加速。
AI.motivation: 随着 MoE 模型扩展到数百个专家和更高的 top-k 路由，分布式训练的内存效率成为关键瓶颈。峰值内存主要由 MoE 块而非注意力决定：MoE 分派流水线中每个中间缓冲区都被 top-k 路由单独放大。标准 all-to-all 分派器在单个集合通信步骤中发送所有被路由的令牌，因此必须一次性构造完整的 top-k 扩展缓冲区，导致内存开销巨大。作者希望解决这一内存瓶颈，以支持更长序列和更大批次。
AI.method: 提出 RelayMoE，一种环形（ring-based）MoE 执行模型：在专家权重或令牌循环流动的过程中进行本地计算，从而避免构建完整的 top-k 扩展分派缓冲区。RelayMoE 根据通信量在专家路由与令牌路由之间进行选择，并将传输与计算重叠。该环形结构天然支持反向传播中的内存高效 MoE 重计算：每一跳重建专家中间结果，用其计算梯度，并在进入下一跳前释放，从而节省内存。
AI.result: 在 30B–57B 生产级 MoE 模型及多种专家配置上进行评估。单层 MoE 实验中，RelayMoE 相比 Megatron-LM 平均取得 2 倍加速。在相同 GPU 内存预算下的全模型训练中，吞吐量最高提升 2.02 倍，最大可测试可训练序列长度延长最高 2.85 倍。
AI.conclusion: RelayMoE 通过环形执行模型消除 top-k 扩展分派缓冲区的内存压力，并结合重计算策略显著提升内存效率，为大规模 MoE 分布式训练提供了更长序列、更大批次与更高吞吐的可行路径。

title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
summary: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/

AI.tldr: 提出DistScene框架，通过联合建模环境与物体实现单图组合式3D场景生成，并借助蒸馏利用预训练物体先验。
AI.motivation: 现有单图3D场景生成方法主要将场景表示为物体的集合，缺乏对环境的显式建模，导致物体放置缺少几何上下文。作者希望将环境作为显式场景组件，以提供物体摆放所需的几何背景，从而提升场景级空间一致性。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：1) Scene-Frame Generation，在共享坐标系中联合生成独立的环境与物体组件，使几何与相对位置共同学习；2) Object-Centric Refinement，在局部坐标系中结合场景上下文对每个物体进行细化；3) Object-to-Scene Distillation，通过自动合成并渲染的合成场景，将预训练物体生成先验迁移到场景生成中。
AI.result: 在室内与室外基准上的评测表明，相较所比较的基线方法，DistScene在场景级空间一致性上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 将环境显式建模为场景组件，并借助共享坐标系联合生成与蒸馏预训练物体先验，可有效改善单图组合式3D场景生成的空间一致性。

title: Learning When to Refine: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Budgeted Neural-Operator PDE Solvers
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent PDEs, but autoregressive deployment creates a refinement-allocation problem: prediction errors vary over space and time, while only a finite number of local corrections can be committed along a trajectory. We formulate this as budgeted adaptive neural-operator solving. A global Fourier neural operator advances the full field, a local operator proposes patch-wise residual corrections, and a set-aware selector chooses where to refine. A macro policy decides when and how much of the remaining refinement budget to spend. We introduce rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI), which evaluates feasible refinement counts through actual continuation rollouts of the learned PDE solver, converts long-horizon advantages into conservative policy targets, and accepts an update only when held-out trajectory error improves. On the shallow-water benchmark with a 32-intervention budget, RV-PI achieves a three-seed mean trajectory relative L2 error of 0.6910, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 5.37% and RandomMacro by 2.41%. On the forcing-driven Brusselator benchmark with a 76-intervention budget, RV-PI attains 0.09954, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 2.31% and RandomMacro by 5.32%. These results show that, under a fixed refinement budget, the value of a local correction depends on its downstream effect on the autoregressive trajectory, not only on its immediate error reduction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预算受限的自适应神经算子求解问题，提出RV-PI方法，通过真实 rollout 验证来分配局部修正预算，在浅水与Brusselator基准上取得优于基线的轨迹精度。
AI.motivation: 神经算子虽能快速代理时间相关PDE，但自回归部署时误差在空间和时间上分布不均，而沿轨迹可执行的局部修正次数有限，因此存在"细化预算分配"问题：如何决定在哪、何时、花多少预算做局部修正。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为预算受限的自适应神经算子求解：全局Fourier神经算子推进整个场，局部算子提出分块patch残差修正，集合感知（set-aware）选择器决定细化位置，宏观策略（macro policy）决定何时以及消耗多少剩余细化预算。提出rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI)，通过实际延续rollout评估可行的细化数量，将长时程优势转化为保守的策略目标，且仅当留出轨迹误差改善时才接受更新。
AI.result: 浅水基准（32次干预预算）：RV-PI三随机种子平均轨迹相对L2误差0.6910，较immediate-only策略改进提升5.37%，较RandomMacro提升2.41%。强迫驱动Brusselator基准（76次干预预算）：RV-PI达0.09954，较immediate-only提升2.31%，较RandomMacro提升5.32%。
AI.conclusion: 在固定细化预算下，局部修正的价值取决于它对自回归轨迹的下游影响，而不仅取决于其即时误差削减。RV-PI通过rollout验证的策略改进有效利用了这一性质，验证了"下游效应"作为预算分配依据的重要性。

title: Physical Twins: Accelerating and Enabling Robot Learning with Phantom Platforms
summary: Improvements in human-robot physical interaction (pHRI) can have major implications for physical therapy, search and rescue, and telemedicine. However, a major challenge concerns human constraints and safety in human-robot physical experiments. Concerns about human studies also include repeatability, scalability, and participant diversity. To conduct such experiments, an IRB and willing human participants are required. In this work, we present an improved phantom device, a physical twin, that enables real-world RL-type testing for physically interactive algorithms. The new device not only replicates the ball-and-socket motion of the shoulder but also renders scapular and protraction/retraction motions. The experiments showcase the device's ability to render multiple 3D joint limits and demonstrate a Franka Panda arm sensing limits and interacting with the device as an arm for ADLs (activities of daily living) and pHRI tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的物理孪生“幻影装置”，可复现肩关节球窝运动及肩胛、前伸/后缩运动，用于在无人类受试者条件下开展物理人机交互（pHRI）算法的真实环境强化学习测试。
AI.motivation: pHRI研究对物理治疗、搜救和远程医疗意义重大，但人机物理实验面临人体约束与安全限制，且需IRB审批与受试者参与，导致研究可重复性、可扩展性与参与者多样性难以保证。因此需要一种能替代人类受试者进行真实环境测试的物理装置。
AI.method: 设计并改进了一种幻影装置（物理孪生）：不仅复现肩关节的球窝运动，还能渲染肩胛运动以及前伸/后缩运动。实验中使用Franka Panda机械臂感知关节限位并与该装置交互，模拟作为手臂执行日常生活活动（ADLs）与pHRI任务。
AI.result: 实验表明该装置能够渲染多种三维关节限位，并可支持Franka Panda机械臂感知限位、与装置交互，完成ADLs与pHRI任务场景。
AI.conclusion: 该物理孪生装置能够实现真实环境下的强化学习类测试，规避人类实验的安全与伦理限制，提升pHRI算法研究的可重复性、可扩展性与多样性。

title: Agentic Design Space Exploration for Joint Hardware Configuration Selection and Mapping of AI Inference Workloads on Heterogeneous Edge SoCs
comment: Published at the 2026 ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Machine Learning for CAD (MLCAD '26), Jeju Island, Republic of Korea, September 7-9, 2026
summary: Modern edge Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) integrate heterogeneous processing units (PUs) such as CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, each with distinct performance and energy characteristics. Deploying AI inference workloads on them under real-time latency and energy constraints requires jointly mapping workloads to PUs and configuring each PU (e.g., selecting the number of active cores and the operating frequency). This joint space grows combinatorially, making exhaustive search infeasible. Most prior work on design space exploration (DSE) applies black-box optimization (BBO) such as evolutionary search, where each evaluation returns only aggregate metrics such as latency and energy. Recent LLM-guided DSE relies on the same sparse feedback. We observe that this limits its efficiency: it offers no insight into the design space or the reasons a design choice performs the way it does, and it leaves the reasoning abilities of LLMs largely unused. We present TraceDSE, an agentic DSE flow that performs joint workload mapping and PU configuration selection for AI inference on heterogeneous SoCs. TraceDSE is an iterative proposer-critic loop driven by richer feedback in the form of system execution traces. The LLM proposer agent generates candidate mappings and PU configurations for hardware evaluation. The LLM critic agent, equipped with programmatic trace-analysis tools, analyzes the traces to identify bottlenecks and suggest targeted refinements. This loop yields deeper insight into each design point, higher-quality decisions, and a more effective search. Across four AI inference workloads (models of varying complexity and a multi-model pipeline) on an Intel Meteor Lake SoC, TraceDSE consistently outperforms two state-of-the-art BBO tools, improving Pareto frontier hypervolume by up to 35% over NSGA-II and up to 68% over Bayesian optimization, while requiring ~6-9x fewer hardware evaluations.

AI.tldr: TraceDSE 提出一种基于执行迹（trace）反馈的智能体式设计空间探索流程，通过 LLM 提议者–批评者迭代循环，联合优化异构 SoC 上的 AI 推理工作负载映射与处理单元配置，在更少硬件评估次数下显著提升帕累托前沿质量。
AI.motivation: 现代边缘 SoC 集成 CPU、GPU、NPU 等异构处理单元，在实时延迟与能耗约束下部署 AI 推理，需要联合进行工作负载映射与各 PU 配置（活跃核数、工作频率）。该联合空间呈组合爆炸，穷举不可行。现有设计空间探索（DSE）多采用黑盒优化（如进化搜索、贝叶斯优化），每次评估仅返回延迟、能耗等聚合指标；近期 LLM 引导的 DSE 也依赖同样稀疏的反馈，导致效率受限：既无法揭示设计空间信息与性能成因，也未充分利用 LLM 的推理能力。
AI.method: TraceDSE 是一种智能体式 DSE 流程，采用迭代的"提议者–批评者"（proposer–critic）循环，并以系统执行迹作为更丰富的反馈。LLM 提议者智能体生成候选映射与 PU 配置交由硬件评估；LLM 批评者智能体配备程序化 trace 分析工具，通过分析执行迹定位瓶颈并给出针对性改进建议。该循环将 trace 级诊断信息回馈给搜索过程，从而获得对每个设计点更深入的理解与更高质量的决策。
AI.result: 在 Intel Meteor Lake SoC 上的四个 AI 推理工作负载（复杂度不同的模型及一个多模型流水线）中，TraceDSE 一致优于两种最先进黑盒优化工具：帕累托前沿超体积较 NSGA-II 最高提升 35%，较贝叶斯优化最高提升 68%，同时所需硬件评估次数减少约 6–9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以执行迹作为结构化、可诊断的反馈信号，能让 LLM 的推理能力在 DSE 中真正发挥作用，突破传统黑盒优化仅依赖聚合指标的瓶颈。TraceDSE 在异构 SoC 的联合映射与配置问题上实现了更高的搜索效率与更优的帕累托前沿，表明"迹驱动 + 智能体协作"是设计空间探索的有效新范式。

title: Jailbreaking Open-Weight LLMs via Random Embedding Perturbations
summary: While open-weight models have enjoyed steady progress in capabilities and wide adoption across multiple domains, their safety remains an important concern. One key feature is the ability to refuse or deflect harmful, malicious, or insensitive prompts. In this paper, we expose safety vulnerabilities across six common open-weight LLMs of various sizes that consistently lead to harmful or unsafe responses on the JailbreakBench benchmark dataset. Our proposed attack, Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV), is a simple and fast "jailbreaking" technique that is cheaper than prior approaches, which typically require gradient computations, per-prompt optimizations, or altering internal weights of the models. PEV just adds independent Gaussian noise in the embedding vector representations of the prompt, with no need for further manipulations. To generate unsafe responses, we repeatedly sample additive noise from this distribution. In our experiments, we observe that the average compute cost to get the first successful attack is up to an order of magnitude less than previous attacks. The first successful jailbreak on a new prompt typically arrives within one minute on every tested model, and PEV generates unsafe responses across all models for all prompts in JailbreakBench. No other tested method achieves such results, despite them taking longer to run. More broadly, we believe that understanding the behavior of LLMs under perturbations in the embedding vectors is an important research direction: while perturbations constitute a major security risk, they can also serve as a valuable tool for exploring the dynamical behavior of such models.

AI.tldr: 提出PEV攻击：在提示词嵌入向量上添加独立高斯噪声，无需梯度计算或权重修改，高效破解六种开源大模型的安全对齐。
AI.motivation: 开放权重模型能力与应用快速普及，但其拒绝有害提示的安全对齐仍存在隐患；已有越狱方法成本高，需梯度计算、逐提示优化或修改内部权重，缺乏简单快速且低成本的攻击手段。
AI.method: Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV)：仅在提示的嵌入向量表示上反复采样并叠加独立高斯噪声，不需额外操纵、不需梯度或权重修改。
AI.result: 在JailbreakBench数据集上，PEV对六种不同规模的开源LLM均能产生不安全响应；获得首次成功攻击的平均计算成本比此前方法低至一个数量级，且每个新提示的首次越狱通常在一分钟内完成，所有模型在所有提示上均被成功越狱，其他方法未达此效果。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入向量扰动既是重大安全风险，也可作为探索LLM动态行为的有效工具，值得深入研究。

title: EMODE: Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts for Emotion-Aware Speech Language Modeling
summary: Large speech language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in unified cross-modal understanding and generation, yet paralinguistic cues, especially emotion, remain difficult to preserve. Existing systems typically rely on entangled acoustic representations, which allow the underlying language model to depend excessively on recovered lexical content instead of grounding its behavior in acoustic-prosodic evidence. We address this limitation with EMODE, an emotion-aware speech language model built around \textbf{Dynamic Para-Semantic Experts (DPSE)}. DPSE decomposes continuous speech features into semantic and paralinguistic pathways, routes them dynamically, and fuses them before integration into the language model. To turn this structural decomposition into functional specialization, EMODE is trained with a three-stage curriculum consisting of semantic warm-up, paralinguistic activation, and joint refinement, guided by Orthogonal Expert Guidance (OEG), Semantic-to-Acoustic Alignment (SAA), and Gating Diversity Regularization (GDR). Experiments on SER test, empathetic response evaluation, and the newly constructed bilingual MEPA benchmark show that EMODE improves the balance between lexical fidelity and emotional sensitivity, strengthens affect-grounded response generation, and exposes the value of explicit para-semantic factorization for robust cross-corpus emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: EMODE 是一种情感感知语音语言模型，通过动态副语言专家（DPSE）将语音特征解耦为语义与副语言通道，并配合三阶段课程训练，提升词汇保真与情感敏感的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型多依赖纠缠的声学表示，导致语言模型过度依赖恢复出的词汇内容，而非基于声学-韵律证据进行建模，因此副语言线索（尤其情感）难以保留。
AI.method: 提出 EMODE，其核心为动态副语言专家（DPSE）：将连续语音特征分解为语义路径与副语言路径，动态路由并在融入语言模型前进行融合。训练采用三阶段课程：语义预热、副语言激活、联合精修，并以正交专家引导（OEG）、语义-声学对齐（SAA）与门控多样性正则（GDR）作为指导。
AI.result: 在 SER 测试、共情响应评估以及新构建的双语 MEPA 基准上，EMODE 改善了词汇保真与情感敏感之间的平衡，增强了基于情感的响应生成，并验证了显式副语言-语义因子分解对跨语料情感理解的价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式的副语言-语义因子分解与动态专家路由能有效提升情感感知语音语言模型的鲁棒性与情感理解能力。

title: Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers
summary: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Vision Transformers在缺乏直接指称证据时如何对抽象概念（如"愤怒"）进行视觉接地，提出并验证了一种"转喻式接地机制"。作者用Transcoders在CLIP和DINO编码器上恢复可赋予语义标签的中间特征，追踪其在抽象概念识别电路中的作用。实验在精心构建的图标数据集上发现结构化的转喻电路：感知原语主导浅层，类物体锚点先于抽象目标出现；含渲染文字的图像则走一条独特的感知—文本路径。因果干预验证了转喻中间特征对抽象概念接地具有功能必要性。
AI.motivation: 抽象概念（如情感、心理状态）缺乏直接的视觉指称，而训练数据中抽象标签与视觉信号的对应证据有限。现有可解释性研究多关注具体物体或类别，对ViT如何从有限证据中"接地"抽象语义的中间机制尚不清楚。作者希望揭示一种可解释的中间表征机制——转喻（metonymy），即用具体、可感知的锚点概念架起视觉信号与抽象语义之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 1) 在CLIP与DINO两种视觉编码器上应用Transcoders（稀疏字典式转录器），将中间神经元/特征分解为可解释单元，并将其与具体概念的语义标签关联；2) 在电路层面追踪这些转喻中间特征对抽象概念识别输出的贡献路径；3) 构建经过严格筛选的图标数据集（icon dataset）进行实验；4) 采用因果干预（如消融/激活干预）验证中间特征的功能必要性。
AI.result: 在图标数据集上发现了结构化的转喻电路：浅层以感知原语（perceptual primitives）为主导，类物体锚点（object-like anchors）在抽象目标之前出现，形成从具体到抽象的层级化路径；含渲染文本的图像会转而招募一条独立的"感知—文本"（perceptual-to-textual）路径，而非转喻路径；因果干预表明转喻中间特征是抽象概念接地过程中功能上被真实调用的环节。
AI.conclusion: ViT对抽象概念的接地依赖于一种转喻式机制：通过具体、可解释的锚点概念中介抽象语义，并在网络中形成可追踪、可因果验证的电路。该发现为视觉模型抽象语义的可解释性提供了新视角，也提示模型内部存在分层级的"具体→抽象"表征结构，且不同视觉线索（如图像内文字）会触发替代性处理路径。

title: Byzantine-Tolerant Causal Unicast with Constant Message Space Overhead
summary: Causal message ordering provides essential semantics for distributed applications, yet ensuring it within an asynchronous system subject to Byzantine failures presents fundamental theoretical and practical challenges. Prior research establishes that algorithms cannot guarantee both strong safety and liveness without using cryptography under these conditions. Existing Byzantine-tolerant solutions make synchrony assumptions or suffer from $O(n)$ message space overheads and $O(n^2)$ message complexity, where $n$ is the number of processes in the system, or use cryptography, but may not guarantee strong safety. In this paper, we present a novel Byzantine-tolerant causal ordering algorithm that achieves an optimal $O(1)$ application message space overhead for point-to-point messages. Our approach uses a Sender Permission to Send (SPS) invariant and an \textit{Isolated-Buffer Optimistic Model} for the memory management architecture. To circumvent Byzantine state-pinning and head-of-line blocking attacks, instead of unified causal buffers, we use isolated, per-peer queues equipped with event-driven \textit{Cascading Space Evictions}. We formally prove that our algorithm guarantees system-wide liveness and satisfies a weakened causal safety abstraction called \textit{Congestion-Relaxed Causal Delivery}. Under this model, weak causal safety is strictly preserved for all honest-to-honest communications unless extreme network latency or Byzantine withholding attacks exceed quantifiable local buffer capacities, forcing optimistic queue evictions. This formal guarantee successfully balances causal ordering with high throughput, constant message space overhead, low computational overhead, and strictly bounded local space.

AI.tldr: 提出一种拜占庭容错因果序算法，采用SPS不变量与孤立缓冲乐观模型，实现点对点消息最优O(1)空间开销，并在可量化条件下保证系统级活性与弱因果安全。
AI.motivation: 因果消息序对分布式应用具有重要语义，但在异步且存在拜占庭故障的系统中难以同时保证强安全性与活性。现有方案或依赖同步假设、或具有O(n)空间开销与O(n^2)消息复杂度，或使用密码学却无法保证强安全，因此需要兼顾开销与安全性的新算法。
AI.method: 算法采用"发送者发送许可（SPS）"不变量来约束消息发送；内存管理上使用"孤立缓冲乐观模型"，以按对等节点的隔离队列替代统一因果缓冲，并配合事件驱动的"级联空间驱逐"机制，以抵御拜占庭状态钉扎和队头阻塞攻击。
AI.result: 实现了点对点消息最优的O(1)应用消息空间开销；形式化证明算法保证系统级活性，并满足弱化的因果安全抽象"拥塞松弛因果投递"；在所有诚实节点间通信中严格保持弱因果安全，除非极端网络延迟或拜占庭扣留攻击超出可量化的本地缓冲容量而触发乐观队列驱逐。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在因果序、高吞吐、常量消息空间开销、低计算开销与严格有界本地空间之间取得形式化平衡，为异步拜占庭环境下的因果序提供了一种有理论保证的实用方案。

title: BoT-Feedback: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Biomechanical Evidence for Explainable Human Action Feedback
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning, yet they remain fundamentally limited in Human Action Feedback Generation. Existing methods infer coaching feedback directly from visual observations, producing generic advice, limited interpretability, and physically implausible hallucinations. In contrast, expert human coaches diagnose performance through explicit biomechanical reasoning over joint kinematics, posture, and body dynamics. We introduce BoT-Feedback, a framework that grounds MLLM reasoning in structured biomechanical evidence. Our key contribution is Biomechanics of Thought (BoT), a four-stage reasoning framework that progressively identifies the action, localises the critical body regions, analyses quantitative biomechanical differences between expert and student performances, and synthesises interpretable coaching feedback. To support this reasoning process, we develop a plug-and-play Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP) that converts videos into structured biomechanical descriptors and an alignment strategy that temporally matches expert and student motions. We further introduce BiomAF, a benchmark containing paired teacher-student videos, 3D skeletons, biomechanical attributes, and expert-coaching annotations. Experiments across twelve open- and closed-source MLLMs demonstrate that grounding reasoning in biomechanical evidence consistently improves feedback quality, interpretability, and robustness while substantially reducing biomechanical hallucinations. BoT-Feedback improves the average expert evaluation score from 2.07 to 2.95 (+40%), enabling compact open-source MLLMs to approach the performance of substantially larger proprietary systems for explainable action feedback generation.

AI.tldr: BoT-Feedback 通过将多模态大模型的推理建立在结构化生物力学证据之上，提出四阶段"Biomechanics of Thought"推理框架与即插即用的生物力学数据解析器，并构建配对师生视频基准 BiomAF，使人类动作反馈质量提升约40%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在"人类动作反馈生成"任务上存在核心缺陷：直接从视觉观察推断指导反馈，导致建议泛化、可解释性差，并产生物理上不合理的幻觉。而人类专家教练的反馈依赖对关节运动学、姿态与身体动力学的显式生物力学推理。因此，作者希望将 MLLM 的推理锚定在可量化、可解释的生物力学证据上。
AI.method: 提出 BoT-Feedback 框架，核心是 Biomechanics of Thought（BoT）四阶段推理流程：识别动作→定位关键身体区域→分析专家与学生之间的量化生物力学差异→综合生成可解释的教练反馈。为支撑该推理，设计即插即用的生物力学数据解析器（BDP），将视频转换为结构化生物力学描述符，并引入专家—学生动作的时间对齐策略；同时构建 BiomAF 基准，包含配对的师生视频、3D 骨架、生物力学属性与专家教练标注。
AI.result: 在十二个开源与闭源 MLLM 上进行实验，表明以生物力学证据为推理依据可一致性地提升反馈质量、可解释性与鲁棒性，并显著减少生物力学幻觉。平均专家评分由 2.07 提升至 2.95（约 +40%），使紧凑开源模型在可解释动作反馈生成任务上接近规模大得多的专有系统的水平。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态大模型推理显式地建立在结构化生物力学证据之上，是提升人类动作反馈生成质量、可解释性与可靠性的有效途径，并能显著缩小开源小模型与大型专有系统之间的性能差距。

title: Event-Driven ML Pipeline Orchestration for Manufacturing: An AWS Industry Experience
comment: Accepted in the 14th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Engineering (IC2E 2026). It will be hosted on October 13th-15th, 2026 at Santa Clara, California, USA
summary: We present an industry experience report on three years of operating an event-driven cloud infrastructure for continuous machine learning training in automotive manufacturing. Our system orchestrates GPU-accelerated training of product-specialized model pairs, a physics prediction model and a reinforcement-learning control policy, across multiple plants, coordinating long-running GPU workloads triggered by manufacturing events. The architecture combines Amazon ECS with EC2 GPU capacity providers, SQS-based messaging with dead-letter queues, and an admission-controlled Lambda dispatcher that enforces cluster concurrency limits. A Conductor orchestrator on ECS Fargate initiates dependency-aware retraining chains on a weekly schedule. The entire infrastructure is codified in modular Terraform with multi-account separation. From 40000+ production training jobs we report a 72-78% cost reduction versus always-on GPU infrastructure. A discrete-event simulation confirms that admission control is necessary (naive dispatch loses 65% of jobs) and that queue-draining matches AWS Step Functions latency while eliminating per-job startup overhead. We provide lessons learned and release the simulator and Terraform module skeletons as open-source artifacts.

AI.tldr: 工业经验报告：面向汽车制造场景的连续机器学习训练事件驱动云基础设施，3年内运行4万余个生产训练任务，GPU成本较常开基础设施降低72-78%。
AI.motivation: 汽车制造中产品专用模型对（物理预测模型与强化学习控制策略）需由制造事件触发、跨工厂协调的长时间GPU训练，常开GPU基础设施成本高且难以按需调度，因此需要一套可编排、可准入控制且成本可控的事件驱动云架构。
AI.method: 架构采用Amazon ECS结合EC2 GPU capacity provider承载训练负载，SQS消息与死信队列实现事件驱动，Lambda dispatcher通过准入控制强制集群并发上限；ECS Fargate上的Conductor编排器按周计划发起依赖感知的重训练链。基础设施以模块化Terraform编码并实现多账号隔离。另通过离散事件仿真验证准入控制的必要性并与Step Functions对比。
AI.result: 在40000+生产训练任务上实现相比常开GPU基础设施72-78%的成本降低；仿真表明准入控制不可或缺（朴素派发会丢失65%的任务），且队列排空方案在延迟上与AWS Step Functions相当，同时消除了每任务启动开销。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动+准入控制的GPU训练基础设施可在生产规模下显著降本，并支撑依赖感知的周期性重训练；作者总结了经验教训，并将仿真器与Terraform模块骨架开源。

title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
summary: Humans inherently understand the physical world through an active process. When sensory evidence is insufficient to infer physical properties, we naturally interact with the environment by deciding what information is missing, how to acquire it, and when sufficient evidence has been obtained. In stark contrast, existing multi-sensory robot systems mainly integrate sensory inputs rather than actively acquiring missing evidence through interactions. In this work, we introduce ROMA, an LLM-based system for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception. ROMA integrates vision, audio, tactile, and force sensing into a reasoning-interaction-feedback loop. The model identifies missing evidence and determines the target objects, interactions, and modalities, while a physical interface executes the selected interactions and collects the multi-sensory feedback. To support this capability, we construct ROMI-2K, a large-scale real-world multi-sensory object interaction dataset covering nearly 2,000 objects and 6 atomic interactions with synchronized sensory feedback. Building on these data, we develop a two-stage training framework that aligns sensory modalities and equips the LLM to assess evidence sufficiency, select informative interactions, and reason over the multi-sensory feedback. We further characterize active perception as perception chains, where acquired evidence guides subsequent interactions and reasoning, and establish ROMA Bench to evaluate single-attribute, long-horizon multi-attribute, and intent-driven active perception. Experiments show that ROMA can actively acquire missing evidence and solve complex, long-chain multi-sensory perception tasks that existing methods struggle to handle, laying a strong perceptual foundation for active multi-sensory embodied agents.

AI.tldr: ROMA是一个基于LLM的真实世界物体中心多感官主动感知系统，通过"推理-交互-反馈"循环主动获取缺失证据，并配套构建ROMI-2K数据集与ROMA Bench评测基准。
AI.motivation: 人类在感官证据不足时会主动与环境交互以获取缺失信息，而现有多感官机器人系统多是被动融合感官输入，缺乏主动性。因此需要让机器具备主动决策"缺什么信息、如何获取、何时足够"的能力。
AI.method: 提出ROMA系统，将视觉、听觉、触觉、力觉集成到reasoning-interaction-feedback闭环中，由模型识别缺失证据并决定目标物体、交互方式与模态，物理接口执行交互并采集反馈。构建ROMI-2K大规模真实多感官交互数据集（近2000物体、6种原子交互、同步感官反馈），并采用两阶段训练框架对齐感官模态、使LLM具备证据充分性判断、交互选择与多感官反馈推理能力；以"感知链"刻画主动感知过程。
AI.result: 建立ROMA Bench，评估单属性、长时程多属性及意图驱动的主动感知。实验表明ROMA能主动获取缺失证据，解决现有方法难以处理的长链多感官复杂感知任务。
AI.conclusion: ROMA为主动式多感官具身智能体奠定了坚实的感知基础。

title: A Pipelined FPGA Architecture for Banded Sparse Matrix Dense Matrix Multiplication in Longformer
summary: Sparse attention mechanisms have become increasingly important for transformer models processing long input sequences due to their lower computational and memory complexity compared to full self-attention. Longformer achieves this through a sliding-window attention mechanism that produces a structured banded sparse attention matrix. However, existing sparse transformer accelerators primarily target attention generation or unstructured sparsity, leaving sparse matrix--dense matrix multiplication (SpMM) for structured sparse attention largely unexplored. This paper presents a pipelined FPGA architecture for accelerating banded SpMM in Longformer. The proposed design exploits the predictable sparsity pattern of Longformer's attention matrix through a custom row-wise storage scheme with implicit indexing, eliminating the overhead of conventional sparse matrix formats while enabling regular memory accesses. The architecture employs parallel processing elements, pipelined adder trees, and a dual-path computation strategy to maximize throughput and hardware utilization. Implemented in Verilog and evaluated on an RFSoC platform using Vivado 2024.2, the accelerator sustains one complete dot-product result per clock cycle after an initial latency of 11 cycles while maintaining power consumption below 2.9 W. Operating at 100 MHz, the design achieves over 100 million dot-product outputs per second, demonstrating the effectiveness of directly exploiting structured sparsity for sparse transformer acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向Longformer带状稀疏注意力矩阵的SpMM流水线FPGA加速架构，利用可预测稀疏模式设计行式隐式索引存储，配合并行PE、流水线加法树与双路径计算，在RFSoC平台实现每周期一个点积结果、功耗低于2.9 W、100 MHz下每秒超1亿次点积输出。
AI.motivation: Longformer采用滑动窗口注意力产生结构化带状稀疏注意力矩阵，具有较低计算与内存复杂度。但现有稀疏Transformer加速器主要针对注意力生成本身或非结构化稀疏，对结构化稀疏注意力的稀疏-稠密矩阵乘法（SpMM）研究不足，缺少专用加速方案。
AI.method: 针对Longformer带状SpMM提出流水线FPGA架构：利用注意力矩阵可预测的稀疏模式，设计带隐式索引的行式存储方案，省去传统稀疏格式开销并实现规则内存访问；采用并行处理单元（PE）、流水线加法树和双路径计算策略以提升吞吐率与硬件利用率。使用Verilog实现，并在RFSoC平台上基于Vivado 2024.2进行评估。
AI.result: 在11个时钟周期初始延迟后，加速器可每时钟周期产生一个完整点积结果；功耗低于2.9 W；在100 MHz频率下每秒实现超过1亿次点积输出。
AI.conclusion: 直接利用结构化稀疏性可有效加速稀疏Transformer计算，验证了所提存储方案与流水线架构在带宽规则访问、资源利用与能效方面的优势。

title: Efficient Auditing of Adversarial AI Agent Behavior from Agent Traces
summary: AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) can perform complex tasks but may harm the systems they operate in, either intentionally or unintentionally. Existing agent monitoring approaches rely on rule-based guardrails or LLM-based trace auditing. However, rule-based guardrails can be bypassed through obfuscation and may miss harmful actions beyond their predefined rules, whereas applying an LLM to audit every action is costly. We present a two-stage agent trace auditing framework. The first stage uses single-event and trace-sequence rules to select pending actions for inspection; the second uses an LLM audit agent to examine each selected action in the context of the agent's preceding trace before execution. We jointly refine the gate rules and audit instructions using training data, allowing the framework to adapt to complex agent behaviors rather than relying solely on predefined rules. On the public benchmark OpenAgentSafety, our framework reduces the average number of LLM audits from 8.15 to 2.33 per run and token usage from 47.8k to 14.6k, with a detection rate of 72.8\% compared with 81.5\% when every action is audited. In two simulated multi-agent case studies, the framework flags all malicious traces while reducing audit token usage by more than 80\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段智能体轨迹审计框架，通过规则筛选待检动作再用LLM审计，联合优化门控规则与审计指令，在OpenAgentSafety上大幅降低审计次数与token消耗，同时保持较高检出率。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的AI智能体可能有意或无意地危害所操作的系统。现有方法中，基于规则的护栏易被混淆绕过且难以覆盖预设规则之外的有害行为，而用LLM审计每个动作成本过高。因此需要一种兼顾成本与检测能力的审计方案。
AI.method: 提出两阶段智能体轨迹审计框架：第一阶段使用单事件规则与轨迹序列规则筛选出待检查的动作；第二阶段由LLM审计智能体在动作执行前，结合智能体此前的轨迹上下文对每个被选动作进行审查。同时利用训练数据联合优化门控规则与审计指令，使框架适应复杂智能体行为。
AI.result: 在公开基准OpenAgentSafety上，平均每次运行的LLM审计次数从8.15降至2.33，token用量从47.8k降至14.6k，检出率为72.8%，而全量审计为81.5%。在两个模拟多智能体案例研究中，框架标记出所有恶意轨迹，同时将审计token用量降低80%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段框架通过规则筛选与LLM审计相结合并联合优化，在显著降低审计成本的同时保持了可接受的检测性能，为智能体安全监控提供了高效可扩展的方案。

title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
summary: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.

AI.tldr: 在仅有裁决标签、无人工证据标注的条件下，小型语言模型仅凭裁决进行后训练可恢复部分证据：label-only训练达到准确率0.896、span F1 0.564；拒绝采样达到0.797与0.556。
AI.motivation: 许多审查流程只保留最终裁决，其背后的证据段落未被标注，因为标注证据的成本远高于记录决策。作者希望衡量：在没有人工证据标签的任何阶段，仅用裁决对小型语言模型进行后训练，能多大程度恢复这些证据。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI上，将人类证据span留出至评估阶段；仅用裁决进行label-only训练；并采用拒绝采样——当生成的推理轨迹其裁决与记录一致时保留，再依据自动的来源接地（source-grounding）分数从中挑选一条。
AI.result: label-only训练：准确率0.896，span F1 0.564；拒绝采样：0.797与0.556（训练前为0.747与0.493）。逐字引用率在label-only训练下由0.597升至0.729，在拒绝采样下升至0.701。六个系统中匹配裁决与吻合人类证据span两种得分仅弱相关，且系统排名不同。
AI.conclusion: 匹配记录裁决与吻合人类证据span并非一回事，因此在引用需可复核时，准确率是不佳的指导指标。单一种子、单一语料无法断定哪种方法更优，但两种方法都在无人标注证据的情况下改善了证据质量。

title: Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA框架，将LLM智能体的具体交互经验逐步抽象为情节描述、可复用流程与带适用条件的原理，并支持检索实例化与动作校正，形成执行—抽象反馈闭环，在ScienceWorld与ALFWorld上提升任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽具交互能力，但持续进化受限：微调依赖参数访问且计算昂贵，不适于大规模和闭源模型；外部记忆虽免改参数，却多聚焦经验表示与组织，知识仍与具体任务和上下文紧耦合，泛化不足。核心难题在于如何把具体交互转化为抽象、可复用的知识，用以指导超越个别经验的新决策。
AI.method: SAGA框架：将交互轨迹逐步转化为情节描述、可复用流程和带显式适用条件的原理，同时保留与执行证据的链接；检索到的原理被实例化为任务特定指导，并通过纠正性反馈与重采样来精炼候选动作；由此构建执行—抽象反馈闭环，使累积知识指导未来交互，新经验持续更新分层记忆。
AI.result: 在ScienceWorld与ALFWorld上实验显示任务性能提升；消融研究凸显了上下文实例化与动作调控对于利用原理级知识的重要性。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过经验落地的分层抽象与执行反馈闭环，在不修改模型参数的前提下实现LLM智能体的自我进化，验证了抽象原理对跨任务决策的指导价值，以及实例化与动作调控的关键作用。

title: Productivity in HPC: A Critical Review from SLOC and Performance Portability to AI-Assisted Programming
summary: Productivity has long been recognized as a central concern in high-performance computing (HPC), yet it still lacks a workable formal definition and a broadly accepted metric for quantified assessment. Recent attempts to incorporate productivity into performance-portability analysis have introduced code-divergence, convergence, and semantic measures, but have not established a convincing formal relationship between productivity and performance portability. More recent language and compiler systems, including JACC, Mojo, JLIR, and Accl++, pursue productive performance portability through higher-level abstractions, multi-level intermediate representations, automatic kernel generation, and runtime compilation. These systems demonstrate substantial engineering progress, while productivity is still commonly represented through programmability, ecosystem reuse, code size, or reduced implementation burden rather than direct measurement of human effort. This paper presents a critical review of HPC productivity measurement, tracing its development from source lines of code (SLOC), static complexity, and empirical usability studies to development-time models and semantic approaches. We also examine how automated migration and artificial-intelligence(AI)-assisted programming weaken the correspondence between code transformation and human effort, shifting effort toward verification, correction, and performance tuning. The reviewed methods are compared in terms of what they measure, directness, objectivity, reproducibility, practicality, and their relationship to performance and portability. We conclude by identifying the principal limitations and open challenges for quantified HPC productivity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文对高性能计算（HPC）生产力测量方法进行了批判性综述，梳理了从代码行数、静态复杂度、可用性研究到开发时间模型和语义方法的发展脉络，并指出现有方法难以在生产力与性能可移植性之间建立有力的形式化关系，最后总结了量化评估的主要局限与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 生产力长期是HPC的核心关切，但缺乏可用的形式化定义与广泛接受的量化度量。已有工作尝试将代码分歧、收敛性和语义度量引入性能可移植性分析，却未建立生产力与性能可移植性之间令人信服的形式化关系；而JACC、Mojo、JLIR、Accl++等新语言与编译器系统虽在工程上取得进展，仍多以可编程性、生态复用、代码规模或实现负担间接表征生产力，而非直接测量人力投入。因此有必要对HPC生产力测量进行系统批判性梳理。
AI.method: 采用批判性综述方法：追踪HPC生产力测量的发展历程，涵盖代码行数（SLOC）、静态复杂度、经验可用性研究、开发时间模型和语义方法；考察自动化迁移与AI辅助编程如何削弱代码变换与人力投入之间的对应关系；并从测量内容、直接性、客观性、可复现性、实用性以及与性能和可移植性的关系等维度对现有方法进行比较。
AI.result: 现有HPC生产力度量方法在直接性、客观性、可复现性和实用性方面各有取舍，尚无一种方法能同时满足量化评估需求并建立生产力与性能可移植性之间的形式化关系。自动化迁移和AI辅助编程将人力投入从代码变换转移到验证、纠错和性能调优，进一步削弱了以代码变换间接测量人力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别出量化HPC生产力评估的主要局限与开放挑战，强调需要更直接、客观且可复现的生产力度量，并在生产力与性能、可移植性之间建立更有说服力的形式化联系。

title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
summary: Melt-pool monitoring is central to qualifying metal additive manufacturing (AM), yet no public event-camera benchmark exists for this domain. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond timing instead of reading full frames, giving the temporal resolution AM transients demand at a fraction of the data rate. We present SynAM-E (Synthetic AM Events), the first public multi-source simulated event-camera benchmark for metal-AM melt-pool monitoring: 85 physics-calibrated event shards from 15 sources across 8 institutions, with public baselines and fixed cross-machine evaluation splits. On a single-machine case study, event-spatial monitoring matches dense-frame accuracy (0.874 versus 0.863 macro-F1), and the absolute intensity that events discard adds only +0.006 under fusion. On the NIST Additive Manufacturing Metrology Testbed (AMMT) build, a near-sensor event-rate counter recovers a raw-frame-confirmed 528.7 Hz intensity oscillation at ~380 times less sensor readout than the frame stream requires. A compact 93 k-parameter spiking model runs at 15 times lower modeled inference energy for a 0.073 macro-F1 cost. Every cross-source task includes a built-in trust test against camera identity shortcuts: process-type classification passes while material classification remains confounded by camera band, a corpus-structural limitation the release documents and the trust test exposes.

AI.tldr: 提出首个公开的金属增材制造熔池监测事件相机仿真基准SynAM-E（85个事件分片、15个来源、8家机构），含公开基线与固定跨机划分；实验表明事件监测在单机精度上与密集帧持平，并能在近传感器端以约1/380读出量恢复528.7 Hz振荡。
AI.motivation: 熔池监测是金属增材制造（AM）质量认证的核心，但该领域缺乏公开的事件相机基准。事件相机以微秒级时间分辨率记录逐像素亮度变化，能在远低于全帧的数据率下提供AM瞬态过程所需的时间分辨能力，因此需要构建相应基准以推动该方向研究与可比评估。
AI.method: 构建SynAM-E：首个公开的多源仿真事件相机基准，包含来自8家机构15个来源的85个物理标定事件分片，提供公开基线与固定的跨设备评估划分。采用事件—空间监测模型与脉冲（spiking）模型进行评测，并在NIST增材制造计量测试台（AMMT）上使用近传感器事件率计数器进行验证；同时设计针对相机身份捷径的内置可信度测试。
AI.result: 单机案例中，事件—空间监测达到与密集帧相当的精度（macro-F1 0.874 vs 0.863），事件所丢弃的绝对强度在融合下仅贡献+0.006。在NIST AMMT构建中，近传感器事件率计数器以约为帧流1/380的传感器读出量，恢复了经原始帧确认的528.7 Hz强度振荡。一个9.3万参数的紧凑脉冲模型以约1/15的建模推理能耗运行，macro-F1 代价为0.073。跨源任务内置可信度测试显示：工艺类型分类通过，而材料分类仍受相机波段混淆影响。
AI.conclusion: SynAM-E填补了金属AM熔池监测领域公开事件相机基准的空白，证明事件相机在保持精度与降低读出/能耗方面具备优势，并通过可信度测试揭示了材料分类中相机波段导出的语料结构性局限；该局限已在发布说明中记录并由可信度测试显式暴露。

title: Learning from Unreliable Trajectories: Adversarially-Robust Federated Q-Learning
summary: We study federated reinforcement learning in which multiple agents interact with a common Markov decision process and communicate through a central server to collaboratively learn the optimal state-action value function. Our goal is to understand whether the sample-efficiency benefits of collaboration can be retained when a fraction of the agents behave adversarially and transmit arbitrarily corrupted information. To address this problem, we introduce Robust Async-Fed-Q, an epoch-based federated learning algorithm that combines variance-reduced estimation of the Bellman optimality operator at the agents with robust aggregation at the server. We establish high-probability finite-time guarantees showing that the proposed method preserves the statistical gains of collaboration among the honest agents while tolerating adversarial corruption. In particular, the effect of the adversarial agents decreases as the amount of data collected by each honest agent grows and eventually vanishes in the infinite-sample limit. We complement these guarantees with information-theoretic lower bounds that characterize the unavoidable statistical cost of adversarial corruption, leading to the first nearly matching upper and lower bounds for adversarially robust federated reinforcement learning. We further extend our framework to accommodate single-trajectory Markovian sampling and heterogeneous partial coverage, where different agents may explore different regions of the state-action space and learning relies on their collective coverage. Finally, our epoch-based design substantially improves the best known communication complexity for federated Q-learning under asynchronous sampling.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究存在对抗性智能体的联邦强化学习，提出Robust Async-Fed-Q算法，结合方差缩减的Bellman最优算子估计与服务器端鲁棒聚合，给出高概率有限时间保证与信息论下界，并刻画了对抗污染不可避免的统计代价。
AI.motivation: 作者希望理解：当一部分智能体表现对抗性并传输任意损坏信息时，协作带来的样本效率优势是否仍能保留。同时，联邦Q学习在异步采样下的通信复杂度也有待改进。
AI.method: 提出Robust Async-Fed-Q：一种基于epoch的联邦学习算法，在智能体端对Bellman最优算子进行方差缩减估计，在服务器端进行鲁棒聚合。并将其扩展到单轨迹马尔可夫采样和异构部分覆盖场景，不同智能体探索状态-动作空间的不同区域并依赖集体覆盖进行学习。
AI.result: 建立高概率有限时间保证，表明方法在容忍对抗损坏的同时保留诚实智能体间协作的统计增益；对抗智能体的影响随每个诚实智能体数据量增长而减小，并在无限样本极限下消失。补充信息论下界刻画对抗污染不可避免的统计代价，得到对抗鲁棒联邦强化学习首个近乎匹配的上下界。epoch设计显著改进了异步采样下联邦Q学习已知最佳通信复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对抗鲁棒联邦强化学习提供了首个近乎匹配的上下界，并证明在存在对抗智能体时仍可保留协作的样本效率收益，同时在异步采样与异构覆盖场景下改进了通信复杂度。

title: Learning Modular Policy for Multi-Floor Object Navigation:A Factorized Framework for Diagnostic Study
summary: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) in multi-floor scenarios presents a challenge due to sparse rewards caused by long-horizon decision-making. In this paper, we propose a diagnostic study based on a modular framework with an effective learnable policy to analyze failure factors in multi-floor scenarios. To achieve an effective policy for diagnosis, we design the hierarchical factorization policy that deconstructs a single global policy into an intra-floor exploration policy and an inter-floor switching policy. To providing an effective initialization for Reinforcement Learning (RL), the lightweight intra-floor policy is learned by distilling the exploration logic of Visual Language Models (VLMs). Under idealized assumptions, we show that the factorized policy is theoretically equivalent to a single global policy at the policy-representation level. Experiment results indicate that perception performance and stair climbing stability are the primary bottlenecks in multi-floor navigation.

AI.tldr: 针对多楼层ObjectNav因长时序决策导致稀疏奖励、难以诊断失败原因的问题，本文提出基于模块化框架与可学习策略的诊断研究：设计分层分解策略，将单一全局策略拆分为楼层内探索策略与楼层间切换策略，并利用VLM探索逻辑蒸馏初始化轻量楼层内策略；理论上证明在理想假设下分解策略与单一全局策略在策略表示层面等价；实验表明感知性能与爬楼梯稳定性是多楼层导航的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 多楼层场景下的Object-goal navigation（ObjectNav）存在长时序决策引发的稀疏奖励问题，导致训练困难且失败原因难以定位。论文旨在通过一个带有可学习策略的模块化框架进行诊断性研究，分析多楼层导航中的失败因素与瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构建模块化诊断框架；2) 设计分层分解策略（hierarchical factorization policy），将单一全局策略解构为楼层内探索策略（intra-floor exploration policy）与楼层间切换策略（inter-floor switching policy）；3) 采用Visual Language Models（VLMs）的探索逻辑蒸馏来学习轻量化的楼层内策略，为强化学习（RL）提供有效初始化；4) 从策略表示层面进行理论分析。
AI.result: 理论上，在理想化假设下，分解后的策略与单一全局策略在策略表示层面等价。实验结果表明，感知性能（perception performance）与爬楼梯稳定性（stair climbing stability）是多楼层导航中的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 多楼层ObjectNav的核心瓶颈在于感知能力与爬楼过程的稳定性；所提出的分层分解策略及基于VLM蒸馏的初始化方式可作为有效的诊断工具，并为后续改进多楼层导航策略提供了方向。

title: A Shape-Adaptive Architecture with Disaggregated Quantization for Efficient LLM Serving
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have become the backbone of modern AI applications, but pose significant challenges for efficient inference. Their autoregressive generation divides execution into two phases: prefill, dominated by large GEMMs, and decoding, dominated by small GEMVs. Modern serving systems further introduce complexity through continuous batching and prefill-decoding disaggregation, leading to dynamic workloads and phase separation. However, existing accelerators remain poorly aligned with these system-level behaviors, resulting in inefficiencies in LLM serving.
  In this work, we present DynaCore, a unified architecture for efficient LLM serving via system-architecture co-design. We observe that the compute tile a systolic array executes, its Minimum Efficient Unit (MEU), spans all three GEMM dimensions. DynaCore reshapes the MEU along all three: spatially it trades array width against height asymmetrically, raising weight delivery while leaving the input path untouched, and temporally Split-K maps the reduction onto the array, folding partial sums through the interconnect the array already has. To exploit phase separation, we further propose disaggregated quantization, applying dual-side quantization to prefill and weight-only quantization to decoding, with an inner-product mixed-precision datapath that keeps output width invariant to precision. A runtime scheduling framework then selects an MEU per batch. Evaluation with real-world serving traces shows that DynaCore substantially reduces service-level latency over quantization and reconfigurable accelerators, improving TTFT by 3.50x and 2.97x and TPOT by 36.55x and 8.02x, respectively.

AI.tldr: DynaCore提出一种系统-架构协同设计的统一加速器，通过重塑脉动阵列的最小高效单元（MEU），配合分离式量化与运行时调度，显著降低LLM服务级延迟。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM服务系统采用连续批处理与prefill-decoding分离，导致工作负载动态且两阶段特性迥异（prefill以大规模GEMM为主，decoding以小规模GEMV为主）。现有加速器与这些系统级行为不匹配，造成推理效率低下。
AI.method: 提出DynaCore统一架构。观察发现脉动阵列执行的计算块（MEU）横跨三个GEMM维度，故从三方面重塑MEU：空间上以非对称方式在阵列宽度与高度间折中，提升权重交付而不影响输入路径；时间上用Split-K将归约映射到阵列，通过既有互连折叠部分和。针对阶段分离提出分离式量化——prefill用双重量化，decoding用仅权重量化，并设计内积混合精度数据通路使输出位宽不随精度变化。最后由运行时调度框架按批次选择MEU。
AI.result: 基于真实服务trace的评测表明，相比量化加速器与可重构加速器，DynaCore大幅降低服务级延迟，TTFT分别提升3.50x和2.97x，TPOT分别提升36.55x和8.02x。
AI.conclusion: DynaCore验证了系统-架构协同设计在LLM服务中的有效性，通过MEU重塑、分离式量化与运行时调度的结合，实现了对动态、阶段分离工作负载的高效适配。

title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic. Existing agent-memory systems (e.g., MemGPT, Zep, A-MEM) gate retrieval by content, ownership, and role, not derivation, missing a cached insight that embeds a forbidden column. We introduce the Analytical Memory Unit (AMU), a memory schema that attaches a full derivation (lineage) graph to every cached result, gated by a retrieval policy that serves a hit only when the requester is authorised for every column touched. Provided lineage recording is complete, we prove by construction that the policy blocks retrieval of results derived from a sensitive column outside the requester's permissions, at O(n) worst case -- a conditional design guarantee, not an empirical claim, that excludes derived features encoding sensitive information without naming their source. Eliminating measured leakage required 75-90% recorded lineage completeness, so we treat 90% as a conservative deployment target. Across six experiments, lineage-gated retrieval removes the 18.8-25.5% cross-department leakage naive content-gated memory suffers, keeping 81.5-82.6% of memory reuse at 13.8 microsecond worst-case overhead. A real-agent proof-of-concept with LLM-generated SQL is consistent with the guarantee: zero leaks over 9 round-trips, two conflicts caught automatically -- though a feasibility demonstration, not evidence of production viability. This offers a practical governance layer for shared agent memory, complementing source-layer access control and supporting EU AI Act compliance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Analytical Memory Unit (AMU) 记忆模式，为每个缓存结果附加完整派生（lineage）图，并用基于派生信息的检索策略对记忆命中进行门控；在 lineage 记录完整的前提下构造性证明可阻止越权敏感列的派生结果检索（O(n) 最坏复杂度），并在六项实验中消除 18.8–25.5% 的跨部门泄漏，保留 81.5–82.6% 的记忆复用率。
AI.motivation: 企业共享记忆存储的 AI agent 存在两类未被解决的问题：一是敏感数据可通过"请求者本无法自行推导"的合法计算结果泄漏；二是不同部门可能以相互冲突的逻辑静默计算同名 KPI。现有 agent 记忆系统（MemGPT、Zep、A-MEM）仅按内容、所有权和角色门控检索，而不按派生关系门控，因而会漏掉嵌入了禁忌列的缓存洞察。
AI.method: 提出 Analytical Memory Unit (AMU) 记忆模式：为每个缓存结果附加完整的派生（lineage）图；检索策略仅在请求者对所有被触及列均获授权时才返回命中。基于"lineage 记录完整"的前提，用构造法证明该策略可阻止检索源自请求者权限之外敏感列的派生结果，最坏复杂度为 O(n)。此外开展六项实验，并以 LLM 生成 SQL 的真实 agent 概念验证进行验证。
AI.result: 在六项实验中，lineage 门控检索消除了朴素内容门控记忆的 18.8–25.5% 跨部门泄漏，同时保留 81.5–82.6% 的记忆复用率，最坏情况开销为 13.8 微秒。消除可测量泄漏需要 75–90% 的 lineage 记录完整度，故将 90% 作为保守部署目标。真实 agent 概念验证（LLM 生成 SQL）与理论保证一致：9 轮往返零泄漏，并自动捕获两处冲突。
AI.conclusion: AMU 为共享 agent 记忆提供了一层实用的治理机制，可与源层访问控制互补，并支持 EU AI Act 合规。需强调其保证是"条件性设计保证"而非经验性主张：它不覆盖未标明来源却编码了敏感信息的派生特征；且真实 agent 演示仅为可行性验证，尚不构成生产可用性的证据。

title: WavePrune: One period is often enough for RoPE
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes token positions by rotating each two-dimensional channel of the query and key vectors at a channel-specific frequency, making the attention logits invariant to a common shift of positions. However, this rotation is periodic, and it leads to position aliasing where relative positions separated by a full rotation period become hard to tell apart. To address this, we propose WavePrune, which restricts each channel to its first rotation period. We show that it removes the distractions in attention maps created by position aliasing and improves overall long-context performance. Specifically, WavePrune raises the HELMET score on four of five models we test without any extra tuning (e.g., 35.7 -> 40.0 on Qwen3-8B). When pretraining models from scratch, WavePrune also achieves lower validation loss at extrapolated lengths than pretraining without it. Because WavePrune restricts each channel to a sliding window, it induces a fine-grained sparsity that our hardware-aligned CUDA kernels exploit for 1.15x prefill and 1.24x decoding speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 32K context. Together, these results show that RoPE's periodic structure, widely regarded as essential, is largely redundant beyond the first rotation period.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WavePrune，通过将RoPE每个通道限制在首个旋转周期内来消除位置混叠，无需额外微调即可提升长上下文性能，并借助CUDA内核实现加速。
AI.motivation: RoPE通过频道特定频率旋转二维通道来编码位置，使注意力logits对位置的整体平移具有不变性。但其旋转具有周期性，导致相隔一个完整旋转周期的相对位置难以区分，即位置混叠（position aliasing）。这种混叠会在注意力图中引入干扰，损害长上下文表现。
AI.method: WavePrune将每个通道限制在其第一个旋转周期内。由于该限制使每个通道形成一个滑动窗口，从而产生细粒度稀疏性，作者设计了硬件对齐的CUDA内核来利用该稀疏性进行加速。
AI.result: 在测试的五个模型中的四个上，WavePrune无需额外调优即可提升HELMET分数（如Qwen3-8B从35.7提升至40.0）。从头预训练时，WavePrune在外推长度下取得更低的验证损失。其CUDA内核在32K上下文下相比FlashAttention-2实现1.15倍prefill和1.24倍解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，RoPE的周期性结构虽被广泛认为是必要的，但超出第一个旋转周期后的部分是冗余的；限制每个通道在首个周期内可消除位置混叠干扰并提升长上下文性能。

title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
summary: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AegisFlow，一个基于 LLM 的智能体自愈框架，通过 Watchdog 与 Repair 双智能体闭环，结合 MAPE-K 与数字孪生验证，实现数据管道的自动检测与修复，将 MTTR 降低约 98%。
AI.motivation: 传统数据管道极其脆弱，常因上游 schema 漂移、API 契约变更或网站 DOM 修改而失败。现有可观测性工具仅向工程师发出告警，导致平均修复时间（MTTR）高、运维疲劳严重，检测与解决之间缺乏自动闭环。
AI.method: 提出 AegisFlow 智能体框架：由 Watchdog 智能体采集运行时遥测数据，由 Repair 智能体基于大语言模型自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；核心机制为 Parallel Shadow Patching 非侵入式执行模型，依托 MAPE-K 循环，在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁；框架与部署方式无关，可作为插件集成至现有管道编排系统。
AI.result: 在五类常见故障场景中评估：MTTR 平均从 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟，改进约 98.1%；补丁成功率达 92%。其中 JSON schema 变更场景成功率 96%，标点漂移 98%，Shadow DOM 场景最低为 85%。可释放约 98% 的数据工程值班时间。
AI.conclusion: AegisFlow 通过智能体闭环与数字孪生验证实现了数据管道的高效自愈，大幅降低 MTTR 并将工程师精力从救火转向创新；其插件化、部署无关的设计使其易于落地于现有编排系统。

title: Mosaic: GPU Sharing with Latency Guarantees through Kernel-Level Interference Prediction
summary: GPUs are increasingly in demand for AI workloads, yet often remain substantially underutilized, motivating workload colocation. However, colocation introduces interference that can degrade latency-critical workloads. Existing approaches mitigate interference using either heuristic-based scheduling or interference predictors. Heuristics rely on coarse-grained metrics that overlook important interference sources, while predictors often depend on simulator-specific or similarly coarse metrics. However, GPU interference is complex and arises from multiple mechanisms, including thread-block placement, memory hierarchy contention, and intra-SM resource contention. We present Mosaic, a kernel-level interference predictor that explicitly models these mechanisms using a combination of analytical and lightweight learned models. Across four GPU architectures, Mosaic reduces prediction error by up to an order of magnitude compared to prior predictors. We integrate Mosaic into a scheduler, MosaicSched, that performs online kernel admission control and selects between full-GPU colocation and SM partitioning to maximize best-effort throughput while satisfying latency SLOs. Across all workloads, MosaicSched keeps the p99 latency below or very close to the target SLO.

AI.tldr: Mosaic是一个kernel级GPU干扰预测器，通过解析模型与轻量学习模型结合显式建模thread-block放置、存储层次争用和SM内资源争用等干扰机制，并将其集成到调度器MosaicSched中实现在线kernel准入控制和全GPU共置/SM分区选择。
AI.motivation: GPU在AI负载下常严重利用不足，工作负载共置可提升利用率，但会引入干扰并恶化延迟敏感型负载。现有方法要么用启发式调度依赖粗粒度指标、忽略关键干扰源，要么用依赖模拟器特定或同样粗粒度指标的预测器，难以刻画GPU干扰的复杂多机制本质。
AI.method: 提出Mosaic，一个kernel级干扰预测器，显式建模thread-block放置、存储层次争用与SM内资源争用等多种干扰机制，采用解析模型与轻量学习模型相结合的方式；并将Mosaic集成到调度器MosaicSched中，执行在线kernel准入控制，并在全GPU共置与SM分区之间进行选择。
AI.result: 在四种GPU架构上，Mosaic相较先前预测器最多将预测误差降低一个数量级；MosaicSched在所有工作负载上使p99延迟保持在目标SLO以下或非常接近目标SLO。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模GPU多机制干扰的kernel级预测方法能显著提升预测精度，并支撑调度器在满足延迟SLO的同时最大化best-effort吞吐。

title: Visual-Invariance-Augmented Feature Optimal Alignment for Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transferable adversarial examples, especially in black-box settings where only open-source surrogate models are accessible. Existing targeted transfer attacks mainly align adversarial and target samples using global image-level features, such as encoder [CLS] embeddings. However, such coarse alignment insufficiently exploits patch-level visual structures, limiting transferability across heterogeneous closed-source MLLMs. We propose IAU-FOA, a visual-invariance-augmented feature optimal alignment attack with adaptive unbalanced transport, to improve targeted transferability against closed-source MLLMs. IAU-FOA aligns adversarial and target samples at both global and local levels: a cosine-based objective narrows their global semantic gap, while patch tokens are clustered into compact local patterns and matched through optimal transport for fine-grained feature alignment. Balanced optimal transport enforces fixed marginal masses even for local clusters without reliable counterparts, potentially introducing misleading alignment gradients. We therefore introduce confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport to relax these constraints for weakly matched clusters, aiming to reduce unreliable local alignment and improve adversarial transferability. We further study the effect of input transformations and propose visual-invariance augmentation, which applies bidirectional pixel-intensity rescaling and per-channel white-balance adjustment to simulate exposure, contrast, illumination, and color-temperature variations. This strategy encourages adversarial perturbations to generalize across different visual encoders. Extensive experiments on open-source and closed-source MLLMs show that IAU-FOA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transferable attack methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA.

AI.tldr: 提出IAU-FOA攻击方法，通过全局-局部特征对齐、置信度自适应非平衡最优传输和视觉不变性增强，提升对闭源MLLM的定向迁移攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有定向迁移攻击仅用全局图像级特征（如CLS嵌入）对齐对抗样本与目标样本，忽略patch级视觉结构，导致跨异构闭源MLLM迁移性不足。
AI.method: IAU-FOA在全局与局部两级对齐：余弦目标缩小全局语义差距；patch token聚类为紧凑局部模式，经最优传输进行细粒度匹配。针对无可靠对应局部簇的平衡传输会引入误导梯度，提出置信度自适应非平衡传输以放松弱匹配簇的约束。此外研究输入变换影响，提出视觉不变性增强，采用双向像素强度缩放与逐通道白平衡调整模拟曝光、对比度、光照和色温变化。
AI.result: 在开源和闭源MLLM上的大量实验表明，IAU-FOA持续优于最先进的迁移攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: 全局-局部对齐结合非平衡最优传输与视觉不变性增强可有效提升对抗样本对闭源MLLM的定向迁移性，代码已开源。

title: AttSVD:Prompt-Adaptive Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Attention-Guided SVD
