summary: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers grows linearly with context length and dominates memory at long context. Most training-free remedies evict low-importance tokens, an irreversible choice along the sequence axis. We instead keep every token and store it more cheaply along the "feature" axis. We therefore propose AttSVD, a new "interpretable" low-rank compression whose basis is derived from each prompt's own attention geometry: an online, per-prompt truncated SVD that keeps only the directions attention actually reads, cutting persistent per-head KV memory in proportion to the retained rank. We propose two decode-time caching strategies, accumulating and streaming, for short and long generation regimes. Furthermore, we propose two refinements that make compression adaptive. A per-matrix energy rule sizes the logit space and the attention mass independently. An attention-aware basis truncates only in the spaces attention actually reads, preserving both the attention logits and the attention output. The same factors also provide free, per-head interpretability insights into the effective rank and the geometry attention consumes. Across multiple models, on both an agentic benchmark and the full LongBench suite AttSVD stays on par with the dense cache while using up to 50% of the KV-cache memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 AttSVD，一种沿特征轴对 KV 缓存做低秩压缩的无训练方法，基于每个 prompt 自身的注意力几何构建在线截断 SVD 基，在多个模型与基准上以最多 50% 的 KV 缓存内存达到与稠密缓存相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归 Transformer 的 KV 缓存随上下文长度线性增长，在长上下文中主导显存开销。现有免训练方案多沿序列轴不可逆地逐出低重要性 token，会丢失信息。本文转而保留全部 token，沿特征轴以更低成本存储。
AI.method: 提出 AttSVD：一种可解释的低秩压缩，其基由每个 prompt 自身的注意力几何导出，即在线、逐 prompt 的截断 SVD，仅保留注意力实际读取的方向，使每头持久 KV 内存按保留秩成比例下降。提出两种解码期缓存策略——累积式与流式，分别适配短、长生成场景。另提出两项自适应细化：逐矩阵能量准则，独立设定 logit 空间与注意力质量的规模；注意力感知基截断，仅在注意力实际读取的空间中截断，从而同时保持注意力 logit 与注意力输出。
AI.result: 在多个模型上，于一个 agentic 基准与完整 LongBench 套件中，AttSVD 在使用最多 50% KV 缓存内存的情况下，性能与稠密缓存相当。同时，这些因子还能免费提供逐头的可解释性洞见，如有效秩及注意力所消耗的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 沿特征轴而非序列轴压缩 KV 缓存是可行且高效的；AttSVD 通过 prompt 自适应的低秩基与自适应压缩策略，在显著降低 KV 内存的同时保持性能，并附带可解释性收益。

title: ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction
summary: World action models jointly learn visual predictionand robot actions, providing a way to use observations ofscene evolution for policy learning. Their video and actionlosses, however, provide no explicit target for the geometricconsequences of a demonstrated action sequence. Moreover,visual features taken after temporal attention can contain futureobservations, making them unsuitable as the sole current visualinput to an auxiliary predictor. We introduce ACG-WAMand its auxiliary objective, the Action-Conditioned GeometricJoint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (ACG-JEPA), whichpredicts geometric features at several horizons from the currentobservation and intervening actions, using the future slot of afrozen VGGT encoding of each current and future image pairas the target. We apply this supervision from the head and wristcameras to a shared visual embedding before temporal mixing,and remove the teacher and auxiliary modules at inference.On 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ACG-WAM achieves 93.46%success in clean scenes, with the best randomized success(92.68%) and mean across both settings (93.07%) among thecompared methods; across three tasks on a real robot, itachieves 85.00% success and 91.67% partial completion score,exceeding Motus by 10.00 and 9.17 percentage points, respec-tively. Code:https://github.com/RoboOpus/ACG-WAM.Website:https://RoboOpus.github.io/ACG-WAM.

AI.tldr: 提出ACG-WAM及其辅助目标ACG-JEPA，通过对当前观测与干预动作预测多时间尺度的几何特征，提升机器人策略学习效果，在仿真和真实任务中均取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有World action models的video与action损失未对动作序列的几何后果提供显式监督目标；且视频特征经时间注意力后可能包含未来观测信息，不适合作为辅助预测器的唯一当前视觉输入。
AI.method: 引入ACG-WAM及辅助目标ACG-JEPA：以冻结VGGT编码的当前与未来图像对的future slot为目标，从当前观测和介入动作预测多个时间尺度的几何特征；在时间混合前，将头部与手腕相机的监督应用于共享视觉嵌入；推理时移除教师和辅助模块。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0的50个任务上，干净场景成功率93.46%，随机化成功率92.68%（最优），两种设置均值93.07%（最优）；在真实机器人三个任务上成功率85.00%、部分完成得分91.67%，分别超过Motus 10.00和9.17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过ACG-JEPA显式几何特征监督，ACG-WAM在不增加推理开销的情况下有效提升策略学习的几何感知与泛化能力，仿真与真实实验均验证其优越性。

title: Beyond No-Good Benders Cuts: Exact Realizability for Discretely Tunable Clock Trees
summary: Useful-skew schedules can satisfy timing constraints yet remain unrealizable by a fixed clock tree with discrete tuning choices. We formulate this mismatch as exact membership in a finite relative-latency set and develop a checkable feedback interface between the scheduler and the tree model. Arithmetic certificates explain unrealizable targets, while tree-specific contraction reduces the structural size of the exact relations projected onto selected sinks. These relations become realizability cuts that can exclude more candidates than a no-good on the same certificate support, including discrete holes that linear inequalities cannot separate. Controlled experiments confirm fewer oracle calls and faster projection construction. They also expose important limits: globally minimum certificates can cost more than they save, compact arithmetic feedback can fail on non-parity obstructions, and direct monolithic optimization remains faster on the tested additive models. The contribution is an exact, independently verifiable scheduler--tree interface, rather than a claim of universal solver acceleration or physical signoff.

AI.tldr: 论文将"有用偏斜调度与固定时钟树不可实现"之间的不匹配形式化为相对延迟集合的精确成员判定问题，构建了调度器与时钟树模型之间可检验的反馈接口。
AI.motivation: 有用偏斜（useful-skew）调度能满足时序约束，但在具有离散调节选项的固定时钟树中往往不可实现。现有流程缺乏对这类不可实现目标的精确、可验证的检测与反馈机制。
AI.method: 把不匹配建模为有限相对延迟集合的精确隶属问题；设计调度器与树模型间的可检验反馈接口；用算术证书解释不可实现目标；采用树特定收缩（tree-specific contraction）压缩投影到选定汇点的精确关系的结构规模；将所得关系转化为可实现性割（realizability cuts）。
AI.result: 可实现性割比基于同一证书支持的 no-good 能排除更多候选，包括线性不等式无法分离的离散空洞；受控实验显示 oracle 调用次数更少、投影构造更快。局限：全局最小证书可能代价高于收益，紧凑算术反馈在非奇偶（non-parity）障碍下可能失效，且在测试的加性模型上直接整体优化仍更快。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于一个精确、可独立验证的调度器—时钟树接口，而非声称通用求解器加速或物理签核。

title: A Resilient Runtime-Verification Fabric for Security Monitoring of Critical Edge-IoT Infrastructure
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Critical Information Infrastructures Security (CRITIS 2026)
summary: Protecting critical infrastructure increasingly depends on continuously verifying large IoT fleets against formal security specifications at runtime. Yet the runtime-verification (RV) pipelines proposed for this task are typically single-host prototypes whose monitors read a shared log file, with no resilience to the failures such deployments incur: a crash or overload silently drops events, clock skew corrupts the ordering metric monitors require, a time-triggered "node has gone silent" property cannot fire when the network itself falls silent, and one slow consumer stalls the pipeline. Each failure is silent: the monitor keeps emitting verdicts over a corrupted view. We present RV-Fabric, a resilient delivery layer that carries the hierarchy over two brokers (MQTT for device ingest, a durable stream broker for backend delivery) and re-establishes five continuity guarantees: durable delivery under crashes, a trusted event order, progress under total silence, consumer isolation and flow control under bounded overload, each an invariant conditioned on broker durability. Above the transport, RV-Fabric makes evidence completeness part of runtime-verification semantics: every verdict carries a status (sound, degraded, incomplete or unavailable) derived from delivery gaps, retention pressure and liveness, so an incomplete stream cannot yield an unqualified all-clear. Under controlled fault injection on a containerised testbed, measured against a fault-free oracle using the real MonPoly engine, the shared-log baseline misses six of seven injected incidents, reporting each as an unqualified all-clear, whereas RV-Fabric preserves all seven; removing a delivery mechanism reintroduces silent loss, removing isolation costs only timeliness. Two published critical-infrastructure datasets, water-SCADA and IoT/IIoT, replay end-to-end.

AI.tldr: 提出RV-Fabric：面向大规模IoT关键基础设施运行时验证的弹性投递层，基于双broker（MQTT+持久化流broker）重建五项连续性保证，并将证据完整性纳入RV语义（verdict携带sound/degraded/incomplete/unavailable状态）。故障注入测试中，共享日志基线漏检7个事件中的6个并给出无条件全清，而RV-Fabric全部保留。
AI.motivation: 现有面向关键基础设施IoT队列的运行时验证（RV）流水线多为单主机原型，监控器读取共享日志文件，缺乏对故障的弹性：崩溃或过载会静默丢事件、时钟偏移破坏监控所需的事件排序、网络静默时"节点沉默"的时间触发属性无法触发、单个慢消费者会阻塞整条流水线；且每种故障都是静默的，监控器仍在被污染视图上持续输出判定。
AI.method: RV-Fabric作为弹性投递层，通过两个broker承载层级结构（MQTT用于设备接入，持久化流broker用于后端投递），重新建立五项连续性保证：崩溃下的持久投递、可信事件顺序、全静默下的进展、消费者隔离、有界过载下的流控，每项均为以broker持久性为条件的不变量；在传输层之上，将证据完整性纳入RV语义，每个verdict由投递间隙、保留压力和活性推导出状态（sound/degraded/incomplete/unavailable），使不完整流无法给出无条件的全清结论。在容器化测试台通过受控故障注入，以无故障oracle为基准、使用真实MonPoly引擎进行评估，并在两个已发表的关键基础设施数据集（water-SCADA与IoT/IIoT）上端到端回放。
AI.result: 受控故障注入实验中，共享日志基线漏检7个注入事件中的6个，并将每个误报为无条件全清；RV-Fabric则全部保留7个事件。消融显示：移除某一投递机制会重新引入静默丢失，移除隔离仅损失时效性。water-SCADA与IoT/IIoT两个数据集可端到端回放。
AI.conclusion: RV-Fabric通过双broker弹性投递层与"证据完整性"语义，解决了单主机共享日志RV流水线在崩溃、时钟偏移、网络静默和过载下的静默失效问题，使不完整流无法产生无资格的全清判定；实验中显著优于共享日志基线，并具备机制层面的可解释性（各保证的缺失分别导致静默丢失或时效性下降）。

title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
summary: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).

AI.tldr: Fiorillo v0.5：一个开源模型，用Qwen3-4B-Base加LoRA与决策头微调，对随机对照试验文章片段问答给出三种效应方向的答案概率，在证据推断任务上四项预注册标准全部通过。
AI.motivation: 希望构建一个可复用、可审计的开源模型，自动从随机对照试验文章中判断干预相对比较组对结局的作用方向（显著增加、显著减少或无显著变化），并以预先注册的验收标准约束其发布，而非事后挑选指标。
AI.method: 基座为Qwen3-4B-Base，附加低秩适配器与一个决策头，仅在2,657篇训练文章中1,431篇许可允许复用的文章上针对Evidence Inference 2.0（EI）微调；输入为截断至6,144 token的文章，输出每个答案的概率。四项验收标准在本版本测试预测前已注册于Open Science Framework，以EI公开标签的测试集为判定依据。
AI.result: 测试集（333篇文章、1,218个提示）上：期望校准误差0.0168（上限0.05）；log loss比先验低0.8603（95%区间0.8104–0.9078），比读取同输入的Gemma 4 31B-it低0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；macro-F1为0.9248 对 0.8668，四项标准全部通过。仅用干净文章训练，准确率损失0.0123（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）。无文章输入时macro-F1降至0.4384，仅给标题可提升0.0939（0.0655–0.1234），可能源于标题本身陈述了试验结果或使用了"recall"等词汇；交换干预与比较组位置后，0.6652的方向性答案发生反转。
AI.conclusion: 按发布版本运行的模型文件，其预测与评估结果在事先设定的限度内一致，表明发布可复现。模型以Apache License 2.0发布（DOI 10.57967/hf/10722）。

title: EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search
summary: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

AI.tldr: 提出EPOCH——一种证据治理架构，通过任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立复现来规范评估反馈，在AlgoTune、Math14、AgentHPO等基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有AI研究智能体多以优化评估器反馈为目标，缺乏对反馈如何被解释、质疑与复用的治理机制，导致脆弱候选被误判为发现，基准提升、有限证书与定理级结论被混为一谈，可信度不足。
AI.method: EPOCH构建证据治理式发现循环，融合显式任务契约（task contracts）、类型化记忆（typed memory）、主动证伪（active falsification）、准入检查（admission checks）与独立复现（independent replay），使每个候选按其支撑主张的强度与范围接受评估。
AI.result: 在AlgoTune上取得最优聚合性能，平均归一化得分0.65（最强基线0.53）；Math14均值最高为0.57；官方测试复现下呈现良好留出表现；AgentHPO描述性聚合领先；在十个发现问题上实现可执行构造改进、算法优化、反例与有证明支持的结果等进展。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明证据治理是通向更可信AI科研智能体的必要环节，使智能体不仅产出更强解，也产出更可信的科学发现，将搜索转化为数学与计算领域的具体进步。

title: NCCL M2N: A Layout- and Topology-Aware Collective for Distributed Tensor Resharding
summary: Distributed training and rollout generation often use different tensor layouts, requiring model weights to be resharded across distinct process groups. This M-to-N redistribution is not directly expressed by standard collectives. Flat direct sends duplicate traffic across destination replicas, while gather-then-broadcast concentrates network injection at one root and transfers data that destinations do not need. For DeepSeek-V3 on 256 GPUs, legacy all-gather plus broadcast accounts for 29.4% of the reported reinforcement-learning step time. We present NCCL M2N, a layout- and topology-aware collective primitive for distributed tensor resharding. Given source and destination meshes and placements, it derives the required transfer regions and a global communication schedule. Its hierarchical route balances source contributions across eligible destination ranks, forwards one copy between destination NVLink domains, and completes local replication over NVLink. Network transfer and local replication overlap, avoiding replica-multiplied source egress. An aggregate data-movement model captures the limits of both stages. We evaluate NCCL M2N on up to 256 GB200 GPUs in an NVL72 cluster with NDR InfiniBand. A single FFN-MoE layer transfer achieves up to 7.9x speedup over flat direct sends (9.8 ms versus 77.3 ms). In a separate 256-GPU DeepSeek-V3 NeMo-RL experiment, NCCL M2N reduces reported weight-sync time from 5.78 s to 2.77 s, a 2.09x speedup over legacy all-gather plus broadcast, and reduces step time by 12.7%.

AI.tldr: NCCL M2N 是一种面向分布式张量重分片的布局与拓扑感知集合通信原语，通过分层路由调度降低跨进程组的权重再分配开销，在 256 GPU 规模实验中显著提速 DeepSeek-V3 的 RL 训练。
AI.motivation: 分布式训练与 rollout 生成常采用不同张量布局，需在不同进程组间对模型权重进行 M-to-N 重分片，而标准集合通信无法直接表达该操作。扁平直发会在目标副本间产生重复流量，gather-then-broadcast 则把网络注入集中于单根并传输目标不需要的数据。在 256 GPU 上运行 DeepSeek-V3 时，传统 all-gather + broadcast 占 RL 步骤时间的 29.4%，因此亟需一种布局与拓扑感知的重分片原语。
AI.method: 提出 NCCL M2N，输入源/目标 mesh 及 placement，推导所需传输区域与全局通信调度。采用分层路由：在可用目标 rank 间均衡源贡献，在目标 NVLink 域之间仅转发一份副本，再通过 NVLink 完成本地复制；网络传输与本地复制重叠，避免源出口流量随副本数倍增。同时建立聚合数据移动模型刻画两阶段的能力上限。
AI.result: 在 NVL72 集群、最多 256 块 GB200 GPU 与 NDR InfiniBand 上评估：单个 FFN-MoE 层传输相比扁平直发最高提速 7.9x（9.8 ms vs 77.3 ms）。在独立的 256 GPU DeepSeek-V3 NeMo-RL 实验中，权重同步时间从 5.78 s 降至 2.77 s，相比传统 all-gather + broadcast 提速 2.09x，步骤时间减少 12.7%。
AI.conclusion: NCCL M2N 通过布局与拓扑感知的分层调度，有效解决了 M-to-N 权重重分片中的重复流量与注入瓶颈问题，在超大规模 GPU 集群上为 RL 训练提供了显著的端到端加速。

title: Hierarchy-GBP: Accelerating Factor Graph Inference via Abstraction and Recovery
summary: Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) is a distributed inference algorithm that passes messages in graphical models, making it attractive for scalable spatial intelligence. However, we find GBP most effective locally: it rapidly smooths message errors that vary sharply between neighbor variables, but corrects global errors across distant graph regions incrementally through long-range message propagations. We propose Hierarchy-GBP (H-GBP), an iterative, two-stage framework that accelerates GBP by first solving these global errors with a coarse graph approximation (abstraction) and projecting the results back to the original graph (recovery), then refining the remaining local errors with GBP. We prove H-GBP convergence to the optimum by deriving the combined matrix operator of our abstraction and recovery steps and analyzing its spectral radius. Experiments on linear sparse graphs show that H-GBP converges fundamentally faster than standard GBP. Moreover, we validate H-GBP on two important spatial problems: Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) and Bundle Adjustment (BA). H-GBP markedly accelerates large-scale PGO and achieves state-of-the-art runtime across all tested BA scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段的Hierarchy-GBP（H-GBP）框架，通过粗图近似（abstraction）与回投（recovery）先消除全局误差、再用GBP精修局部误差，从理论上证明了收敛性，并在PGO与BA任务上显著加速。
AI.motivation: Gaussian Belief Propagation（GBP）作为分布式推理算法，适合大规模空间智能任务，但作者发现GBP的强项是局部性：它能快速平滑邻居变量间剧烈变化的局部消息误差，而对远距离图区域间的全局误差只能依靠长程消息传播逐步修正，因此在大规模稀疏图上收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 提出H-GBP：一种迭代的两阶段框架。第一阶段用粗图近似（abstraction）求解全局误差，并将结果投影回原图（recovery）；第二阶段用标准GBP精修剩余的局部误差。理论上推导abstraction与recovery复合而成的矩阵算子，并通过分析其谱半径证明H-GBP收敛到最优解。
AI.result: 在线性稀疏图上，H-GBP的收敛速度从根本上快于标准GBP；在两个重要空间任务上得到验证：H-GBP显著加速大规模Pose Graph Optimization（PGO），并在所有测试规模的Bundle Adjustment（BA）上达到state-of-the-art运行时间。
AI.conclusion: H-GBP利用误差的局部/全局分离特性，以"粗解全局+细修局部"的两阶段迭代实现GBP的加速，兼具理论收敛保证与在PGO、BA等空间问题上的实证优势。

title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Recursive Entropic Risk Reinforcement Learning with a Generative Model
summary: In this paper, we study the sample complexities of value and policy learning in finite discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) under recursive entropic risk preferences with risk parameter \(β\neq 0\), assuming access to a generative model of the MDP. We provide a refined analysis of model-based risk-sensitive Q-value iteration (MB-RS-QVI), a plug-in model-based method introduced in prior work, and derive \((\varepsilon,δ)\)-PAC guarantees for both learning the optimal \(Q\)-value function and an \(\varepsilon\)-optimal policy. Our bounds improve the exponential dependence on the effective horizon \(1/(1-γ)\) compared with the best existing guarantees for this setting. In particular, they match the existing lower bounds in their exponential dependence on \(|β|/(1-γ)\), as well as in \(S\), \(A\), \(\varepsilon\), and \(|β|\), up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our analysis removes the exponential gap between the previously known upper and lower bounds, leaving only a polynomial gap in the effective horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限折扣MDP在递归熵风险偏好下的值与策略学习样本复杂度，改进了基于模型的乐观Q值迭代的PAC保证，将有效视界上的指数差距缩小为多项式差距。
AI.motivation: 递归熵风险偏好下风险敏感强化学习的样本复杂度尚不清晰，已有上界与下界在有效视界1/(1-γ)上存在指数级差距，需要更精细的分析来弥合该差距。
AI.method: 在可访问生成模型的假设下，对已有的基于模型的plug-in方法MB-RS-QVI进行精细分析，针对风险参数β≠0推导学习最优Q值函数与ε-最优策略的(ε,δ)-PAC保证。
AI.result: 所得到的界在有效视界1/(1-γ)上的指数依赖优于该设定下最好的已有保证，并在|β|/(1-γ)、S、A、ε及|β|的指数依赖上与已有下界匹配（至多对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 该分析消除了此前后验上界与下界之间的指数差距，仅剩有效视界上的多项式差距，显著推进了风险敏感MDP样本复杂度的理解。

title: ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration
summary: Rapid adaptation to a new environment requires a robot to acquire useful knowledge about local objects, states, and interactions from limited experience. Systems that combine a reasoning agent with a frozen vision-language-action model (VLA) can adapt through execution feedback and memory, making the choice of experience central to their effectiveness. Repeated practice of a target task may refine a familiar solution while leaving other interactions relevant to changed conditions untested. We introduce ProactiveVLA, which uses proactive environment exploration to acquire reusable knowledge for deployment-time adaptation. After completing an initial task, the agent allocates the remaining interaction budget to self-proposed goals covering object affordances, state-changing interactions, and compositions of interactions. It verifies execution outcomes and consolidates both task-directed and exploratory experience into memory that guides subsequent planning and control. ProactiveVLA outperforms the baselines under the same turn budget on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen. On LIBERO-Pro Goal-T, with at most one VLA primitive invocation allowed during evaluation, ProactiveVLA completes 48% of instances, compared with 19% for the state-of-the-art task-refinement baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProactiveVLA，将主动环境探索与冻结的 VLA 模型结合，通过自我提出的探索目标获取可复用知识并存入记忆以指导后续规划与控制，在相同交互预算下优于任务精炼基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在有限经验下快速适应新环境，需获取关于局部物体、状态与交互的知识。现有将推理智能体与冻结 VLA 结合的系统依赖执行反馈与记忆，因此经验选择至关重要；而仅重复练习目标任务会精炼熟悉方案，却遗漏与变化条件相关的其他交互。
AI.method: ProactiveVLA 在完成初始任务后，将剩余交互预算分配给自我提出的目标，覆盖物体可供性、改变状态的交互以及交互组合；随后验证执行结果，并将任务导向经验与探索经验共同整合入记忆，用于指导后续的规划与控制。
AI.result: 在相同轮次预算下，ProactiveVLA 在 LIBERO-Pro 与 RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen 上超过基线。在 LIBERO-Pro Goal-T 上，当评估阶段最多允许一次 VLA 原语调用时，ProactiveVLA 完成 48% 的实例，而最先进的任务精炼基线仅完成 19%。
AI.conclusion: 主动探索所获得的可复用经验能显著提升部署时适应能力，在严格交互预算下相较任务精炼更具优势。

title: CACHEFORGE: LLM-Guided End-to-End Generative Cache Replacement Policy for Performance and Hardware Efficiency
summary:
Modern cache replacement designs saturate because they operate within fixed representational structures, hand-crafted and heuristic based feature-engineered predictors, or offline imitation models that cannot generate new decision logic on their own. At the same time, replacement is shaped by the causal interaction of prefetching, thrashing, spatial locality, and access-type behavior, producing an enormous design space that is difficult to traverse manually. Prior approaches typically rely on heuristics, parameter tuning, or imitation of an offline optimal policy, capturing correlations rather than synthesizing new mechanisms. As a result, their performance gains often plateau and they overfit under dynamic workload conditions.
  CACHEFORGE is the first framework to evolve cache-replacement policies end-to-end by embedding a large language model inside a governed hardware-aware loop. In each iteration, the LLM proposes new C++ replacement logic, the policy is evaluated under a trace-based CRC-2 ChampSim simulator, and the framework enforces feasibility through reward shaping, structural checks, dynamic mutation, temperature scheduling, and cross-policy crossover. This closed-loop generation-evolution loop specifically designed for cache replacement policy enables the discovery of compact policies that satisfy hardware constraints while exploring algorithmic transformations beyond fixed predictor structures.
  Across SPEC CPU2006, CACHEFORGE outperforms all CRC-2 baselines. It improves the total hit rate by 27.36%, 19.69%, 13.72%, 13.15%, 11.83%, and 5.73% over MPPPB, ReD, Hawk-eye, SHiP++, LIME, and LRU, respectively. On memory-intensive workloads, it increases IPC by 10.15%, 7.89%, 6.34%, 3.64%, 3.12%, and 2.71% over LRU, MPPPB, LIME, ReD, SHiP++, and Hawkeye.

AI.tldr: CACHEFORGE 是将大语言模型嵌入硬件感知闭环中、端到端演化缓存替换策略的首个框架，在 SPEC CPU2006 上全面超越 CRC-2 基线，命中率最高提升 27.36%、IPC 最高提升 10.15%。
AI.motivation: 现有缓存替换设计受限于固定的表示结构、手工启发式特征工程预测器或离线模仿模型，无法自行生成新的决策逻辑；同时替换策略受预取、抖动、空间局部性与访问类型行为的因果交互影响，设计空间巨大且难以人工遍历。既有方法依赖启发式、参数调优或模仿离线最优策略，仅捕捉相关性而非合成新机制，导致性能增益趋于饱和，并在动态负载下过拟合。
AI.method: CACHEFORGE 将大语言模型嵌入受约束的硬件感知演化闭环：每轮迭代中 LLM 生成新的 C++ 替换逻辑，在基于 trace 的 CRC-2 ChampSim 模拟器上评估，并通过奖励塑形、结构检查、动态变异、温度调度与跨策略交叉来保证可行性与演化多样性。该生成—演化闭环专为缓存替换策略设计，可发现满足硬件约束的紧凑策略，并探索超越固定预测器结构的算法变换。
AI.result: 在 SPEC CPU2006 上，CACHEFORGE 优于所有 CRC-2 基线：总命中率相对 MPPPB、ReD、Hawk-eye、SHiP++、LIME、LRU 分别提升 27.36%、19.69%、13.72%、13.15%、11.83%、5.73%；在访存密集型负载上，IPC 相对 LRU、MPPPB、LIME、ReD、SHiP++、Hawkeye 分别提升 10.15%、7.89%、6.34%、3.64%、3.12%、2.71%。
AI.conclusion: 通过把 LLM 作为策略生成器嵌入硬件感知的闭环演化流程，可自动合成硬件可行且紧凑的缓存替换策略，突破固定预测器结构与离线模仿范式的性能瓶颈，在命中率与 IPC 上取得一致的显著提升。

title: Polar: LLM-Powered Synthesis of Real-World Cyber Evidence for Prioritization and Mitigation
summary: Cyber threat analysis increasingly depends on evidence distributed across vendor advisories, vulnerability databases, and threat intelligence sources. Turning these fragmented observations into timely decisions requires models to connect technical severity with evolving exploitation evidence and available defensive actions. We present POLAR, an LLM-powered framework for synthesizing real-world cyber evidence into threat-centric assessments for prioritization and mitigation. POLAR first disentangles overlapping incidents and grounds each threat in source-linked evidence. For prioritization, it infers severity metrics from cyber evidence and combines the resulting assessment with temporally ordered exploitation signals to estimate near-term exploitation likelihood. For mitigation, it links the synthesized threat data to authoritative remediation knowledge and organizes applicable actions according to threat urgency and operational constraints. We evaluate POLAR on real-world vulnerability evidence collected from public resources and compare it with multiple baselines. Across heterogeneous incidents and zero-day settings, POLAR improves threat ranking and mitigation retrieval while producing evidence-linked intermediate assessments that support analyst inspection. The results establish evidence synthesis as a practical foundation for LLM-based cyber decision support across related security tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出POLAR——一个由LLM驱动的框架，将分散的网络威胁证据合成为以威胁为中心的评估，用于优先级排序与缓解。
AI.motivation: 网络威胁分析依赖分散在厂商公告、漏洞数据库和威胁情报源中的证据，将这些碎片化观测转化为及时决策，需要模型把技术严重性、不断演变的利用证据和可用防御措施联系起来。
AI.method: POLAR首先对重叠事件进行解耦，并将每个威胁锚定到可溯源证据；在优先级排序上，从网络证据推断严重性指标，并结合按时间排序的利用信号估计近期被利用可能性；在缓解上，将合成的威胁数据链接到权威修复知识，并按威胁紧急度与操作约束组织可用措施。
AI.result: 在从公开资源收集的真实漏洞证据上评估，与多个基线对比；在异构事件和零日场景下，POLAR改进了威胁排序与缓解检索，并生成可溯源的中间评估以支持分析师审查。
AI.conclusion: 证据合成可作为LLM驱动的网络决策支持在相关安全任务中的实用基础。

title: Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain
summary: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法英生物医学翻译的低资源场景，联合使用知识蒸馏与量化压缩模型，在保持翻译质量的同时实现69%体积缩减、98.21%推理加速与98.46%碳排放降低。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练Transformer在多语言机器翻译上表现优异，但部署成本高。知识蒸馏与量化是常用的可持续压缩手段，然而在专业领域低资源条件下，前者受限于领域平行语料稀缺，后者随比特精度下降而性能退化。因此作者希望在生物医学术语密集、平行数据有限的法英翻译任务中，探索二者联合应用的可行性。
AI.method: 以法英生物医学翻译为对象，将知识蒸馏与量化结合应用于学生模型；设计并比较多种微调策略，使压缩后的学生模型适配该专业领域，并采用协同蒸馏与量化的联合优化方案。
AI.result: 协同蒸馏并量化的学生模型相较原始基线实现69%的模型体积缩减、98.21%的推理速度提升、98.46%的CO2排放降低，且翻译质量无损失。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术能够在资源受限条件下产出高效、高性能的翻译模型，适合翻译服务提供商在低资源专业领域部署。

title: When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value
summary: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分层诊断框架发现，交通预测精度的提升并不必然带来信号控制决策的改善；收益取决于时间可观测性、动作可辨识性、动力学一致性与目标对齐。
AI.motivation: "更好的预测→更好的控制"这一隐含假设缺乏验证。作者旨在厘清预测改进为何难以转化为信号控制的操作收益，并提供一个可诊断预测价值流失环节的协议。
AI.method: 使用中国宣城29天重建需求数据（其中7天留作测试）开展分层诊断：评估点预测、保形区间、依赖感知场景，以及匹配的闭环控制器；进行接口审计以发现决策时刻泄漏与可控动作有效性；修正时间接口后，用穷举联合动作搜索将因果预测与五秒事件"神谕"对比，并设置合成阳性对照。
AI.result: 入口级与流向级预测相对历史均值分别降低MAE 4.03%与3.92%；名义90%保形区间边际覆盖率为90.72%，但在事后高需求子集上仅75.66%。接口审计发现决策时泄漏，且9个受控交叉口中仅2个存在多种有效动作。合成阳性对照显示未来信息可将内部rollout成本降低61.5%；但在冻结测试日，因果预测与事件神谕相对匹配的无未来rollout分别使排队车·秒增加6.09%与3.39%，神谕使溢流暴露降低3.78%，配对日bootstrap区间跨越零。
AI.conclusion: 预测价值并非自动兑现：其转化依赖于时间可观测性、动作可辨识性、动力学一致性与目标对齐四个条件。所提协议可实际用于诊断预测改进未能带来运营收益的环节。

title: TRANSIT: Transparent Scale-in for Multi-Node LLM Training
summary: TRANSIT is a transparent scale-in framework to enable multi-node model training on fewer GPUs while maintaining training efficiency by transparently leveraging CPU DRAM as an extension of GPU memory during distributed training. It achieves this through a user-space interposition layer, requiring no modifications to the application, training framework, cluster scheduler, device driver, or operating system. Furthermore, TRANSIT achieves higher efficiency by leveraging a zero-copy data path for CPU-GPU transfers. We evaluate TRANSIT on dense and MoE models across scales up to 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs and multiple parallelism configurations over a RoCE network. Our evaluation shows that TRANSIT can: (a) outperform state-of-the-art framework-managed offloading techniques, achieving up to 68%, 59%, and 42% higher per-GPU throughput than TorchTitan, ZeRO-Offload, and ZeRO-Infinity, respectively, (b) enables training with 50% fewer GPUs while maintaining over 90% of baseline per-GPU throughput, (c) lower per-node network traffic by up to 33%, and (d) improve per-GPU throughput by up to 35% in communication-bound settings.

AI.tldr: TRANSIT 是一种透明的 scale-in 框架，通过用户态拦截层将 CPU DRAM 作为 GPU 显存扩展，无需改动应用、训练框架、调度器、驱动或操作系统，实现用更少 GPU 完成多节点训练并保持效率。
AI.motivation: 在分布式训练中，GPU 显存容量限制了模型规模与并行配置，而通过 CPU DRAM 卸载（offloading）来扩展显存通常需要修改应用或框架，并带来额外开销与效率损失。作者希望在不改动软件栈任何组件的前提下透明地实现显存扩展。
AI.method: TRANSIT 采用用户态拦截层（user-space interposition layer），无需修改应用、训练框架、集群调度器、设备驱动或操作系统；并利用零拷贝（zero-copy）数据路径优化 CPU-GPU 传输效率。
AI.result: 在最高 64 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU、RoCE 网络、多种并行配置下，对稠密模型与 MoE 模型进行评估：(a) 相比 TorchTitan、ZeRO-Offload、ZeRO-Infinity，每 GPU 吞吐分别最高提升 68%、59%、42%；(b) 在仅用一半 GPU 时仍保持基线每 GPU 吞吐的 90% 以上；(c) 单节点网络流量最多降低 33%；(d) 在通信受限场景下每 GPU 吞吐最多提升 35%。
AI.conclusion: TRANSIT 提供了一种透明、高效且可扩展的显存扩展方案，可在不修改现有软件栈的情况下，用更少 GPU 维持高训练效率，并在吞吐、网络流量及通信受限场景中均取得显著收益。

title: State-Aware Interaction MIL for Rare Joint Molecular Phenotype Prediction in Colorectal Cancer and Lung Adenocarcinoma
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Joint molecular phenotype prediction is complicated by small joint-positive populations and overlapping histological features across alternative molecular states. Existing computational pathology approaches typically predict biomarkers independently or formulate the joint-positive phenotype as a binary endpoint. Independent prediction does not model interactions between biomarker-specific histological representations, whereas binary joint prediction collapses the double-negative and two single-positive configurations into a single negative class. We propose State-Aware Interaction MIL, a weakly supervised method that preserves biomarker-specific histological representations, models their interaction, and supervises the complete four-state molecular configuration. We evaluate the proposed approach for joint BRAF+/MSI+ prediction in colorectal cancer and EGFR+/TP53+ prediction in lung adenocarcinoma using frozen UNI2-h and CONCH pathology foundation-model representations. With UNI2-h, State-Aware Interaction MIL achieved an average precision of 0.5566 in colorectal cancer (joint-positive prevalence 6.8%) compared with 0.5161 for NaiveMTL, and 0.2784 in lung adenocarcinoma (joint-positive prevalence 8.6%) compared with 0.2525 for IndependentPair. With CONCH, State-Aware achieved an average precision of 0.4410 compared with 0.3932 for DirectJoint in colorectal cancer and 0.1659 compared with 0.1226 for DirectJoint in lung adenocarcinoma. These results indicate that pathology foundation-model representations contain predictive information for rare joint molecular phenotypes and that preserving biomarker-specific representations within a structured molecular-state formulation can improve prediction of these phenotypes from histopathology.

AI.tldr: 提出 State-Aware Interaction MIL，一种弱监督多实例学习方法，保留生物标志物特异性的组织学表征并建模其交互，对完整四状态分子构型进行监督，用于联合分子表型预测。
AI.motivation: 联合分子表型预测面临两个困难：联合阳性人群规模小（罕见），且不同分子状态间存在重叠的组织学特征。现有计算病理方法要么独立预测各生物标志物，无法建模生物标志物特异性组织学表征之间的交互；要么将联合阳性作为二分类终点，将双阴性与两种单阳性构型合并为单一阴性类，损失了分子状态信息。
AI.method: 提出 State-Aware Interaction MIL：在弱监督多实例学习框架下，保留每个生物标志物特异的组织学表征，显式建模生物标志物之间的交互，并对完整的四状态分子构型（双阴性、两种单阳性、双阳性）进行监督。使用冻结的 UNI2-h 与 CONCH 病理基础模型表征，在结直肠癌的 BRAF+/MSI+ 与肺腺癌的 EGFR+/TP53+ 联合预测任务上评估。
AI.result: UNI2-h 表征下，结直肠癌平均精度 0.5566（联合阳性患病率 6.8%），优于 NaiveMTL 的 0.5161；肺腺癌 0.2784（患病率 8.6%），优于 IndependentPair 的 0.2525。CONCH 表征下，结直肠癌 0.4410 优于 DirectJoint 的 0.3932；肺腺癌 0.1659 优于 DirectJoint 的 0.1226。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型表征中包含针对罕见联合分子表型的预测信息；在结构化分子状态建模框架内保留生物标志物特异性表征，可提升从组织病理图像预测此类联合分子表型的性能。

title: QiYao-I: A Manifold Based Foundation Model for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting is a challenging yet important problem in real-world applications, where observations are often irregularly sampled and asynchronously recorded across variables. Existing time series foundation models are mostly built on regularly sampled sequences, making them difficult to generalize to irregular time intervals and asynchronous cross-variable dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose QiYao-I, a manifold based foundation model for irregular multivariate time series forecasting. Specifically, we introduce a novel sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention mechanism that maps real timestamps into a learnable temporal manifold feature space and injects temporal manifold biases into attention layers, enabling the model to capture both irregular time intervals and local sampling structures. Further, we propose a dynamic variable interaction mechanism with frequency awareness. It selectively performs cross-variable message passing under asynchronous observations. Extensive experiments on real-world irregular multivariate forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that QiYao-I achieves superior performance compared with both time series foundation models and end-to-end irregular forecasting models, showing strong generalization ability in zero-shot and few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 提出QiYao-I，一种基于流形的不规则多元时间序列预测基础模型，通过采样条件化时间流形注意力和频率感知动态变量交互机制，实现不规则采样与异步跨变量建模，在零样本和少样本场景下优于现有基础模型与端到端模型。
AI.motivation: 现实应用中的多元时间序列常存在不规则采样与变量间异步观测，而现有时间序列基础模型多基于规则采样序列构建，难以泛化到不规则时间间隔和异步跨变量依赖，因此需要专门面向不规则多元时间序列的基础模型。
AI.method: 提出QiYao-I模型，包含两个核心机制：（1）采样条件化时间流形注意力机制，将真实时间戳映射到可学习的时间流形特征空间，并向注意力层注入时间流形偏置，从而同时捕捉不规则时间间隔与局部采样结构；（2）频率感知的动态变量交互机制，在异步观测条件下选择性地执行跨变量消息传递。
AI.result: 在真实世界不规则多元预测基准上的大量实验表明，QiYao-I相较时间序列基础模型和端到端不规则预测模型均取得更优性能，并在零样本与少样本设置下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: QiYao-I验证了将时间流形建模与频率感知变量交互相结合可有效应对不规则多元时间序列预测，且作为基础模型具备良好的零样本与少样本泛化能力。

title: LEAP: Making Privileged Geometry Supervision Effective for Visuomotor Learning
summary: Privileged 3D supervision uses additional geometric information during training to guide RGB-based visuomotor policy learning, without requiring geometric inputs at deployment. However, low reconstruction error does not ensure that visual representations capture geometry useful for control. We identify three limitations that weaken this supervision: proprioceptive shortcuts, dominant-view reliance, and reconstruction objectives dominated by task-irrelevant geometry. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Encoding with Aligned Privileged Geometry (LEAP). Our framework uses an auxiliary decoder to reconstruct point clouds within the manipulation workspace from visual features alone, while retaining proprioception for action prediction. Alongside full reconstruction, we introduce wrist-view dropout and partial reconstruction targets matched to the retained wrist, encouraging the encoder to capture complementary local geometry. The auxiliary decoder is removed at inference, leaving only RGB observations and robot state as policy inputs. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and real-world tasks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements over Diffusion Policy and ACT, with only a small increase in parameter count and no reduction in inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAP框架，通过在工作空间内对齐特权几何信息来增强RGB视觉运动策略的几何表征，在仿真与真实任务中稳定超越Diffusion Policy和ACT，且推理开销不变。
AI.motivation: 特权3D监督在训练时利用额外几何信息指导RGB视觉运动策略学习，部署时无需几何输入。但低重建误差并不保证视觉表征学到对控制有用的几何信息，现有监督存在三类缺陷：本体感觉捷径、主导视角依赖、重建目标被任务无关几何主导。
AI.method: LEAP采用辅助解码器，仅从视觉特征重建操作工作空间内的点云，而动作预测仍保留本体感觉输入。除完整重建外，引入腕部视角dropout以及与保留腕部匹配的部分重建目标，促使编码器捕获互补的局部几何。推理阶段移除辅助解码器，仅保留RGB观测与机器人状态作为策略输入。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、ManiSkill及真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，LEAP相较Diffusion Policy与ACT取得一致且显著的性能提升，参数增幅很小，推理速度无下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过将特权几何监督限定在操作工作空间、并配合视角dropout与部分重建目标，可有效缓解重建监督的三类缺陷，在不增加部署成本的前提下提升RGB视觉运动策略的几何表征质量与控制性能。

title: CHiRP: Control-Flow History Reuse Prediction
comment: Author manuscript of MICRO 2020. 15 manuscript pages plus publication-notice page
summary: Translation Lookaside Buffers (TLBs) play a critical role in hardware-supported memory virtualization. To speed up address translation and reduce costly page table walks, TLBs cache a small number of recently-used virtual-to-physical address translations. TLBs must make the best use of their limited capacities. Thus, TLB entries with low potential for reuse should be replaced by more useful entries. This paper contributes to an aspect of TLB management that has received little attention in the literature: replacement policy. We show how predictive replacement policies can be tailored toward TLBs to reduce miss rates and improve overall performance. We begin by applying recently proposed predictive cache replacement policies to the TLB. We show these policies do not work well without considering specific TLB behavior. Next, we introduce a novel TLB-focused predictive policy, Control-flow History Reuse Prediction (CHiRP). This policy uses a history signature and replacement algorithm that correlates to known TLB behavior, outperforming other policies. For a 1024-entry 8-way set-associative L2 TLB with a 4KB page size, we show that CHiRP reduces misses per 1000 instructions (MPKI) by an average 28.21% over the least-recently-used (LRU) policy, outperforming Static Re-reference Interval Prediction (SRRIP), Global History Reuse Policy (GHRP) and SHiP, which reduce MPKI by an average of 10.36%, 9.03% and 0.88%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文关注TLB替换策略，提出面向TLB的预测性替换策略CHiRP，通过历史签名与替换算法降低缺失率，性能优于LRU、SRRIP、GHRP和SHiP。
AI.motivation: TLB容量有限，需通过有效替换策略仅保留复用潜力高的条目以加速地址转换并减少页表遍历开销，而文献中对TLB替换策略关注较少。
AI.method: 先将已有的预测性缓存替换策略应用于TLB，发现其未考虑TLB特定行为而效果不佳；随后提出新颖的TLB专用预测策略CHiRP，采用与已知TLB行为相关的历史签名和替换算法。
AI.result: 在1024条目、8路组相联、4KB页面的L2 TLB上，CHiRP相比LRU平均降低MPKI 28.21%，优于SRRIP（10.36%）、GHRP（9.03%）和SHiP（0.88%）。
AI.conclusion: 预测性替换策略经针对TLB行为定制后可显著降低缺失率并提升整体性能，CHiRP在TLB替换策略方面表现最优。

title: From Sandbox to Enforcement: Confidence-Qualified Threat Intelligence for Critical Infrastructure
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Critical Information Infrastructures Security (CRITIS 2026)
summary: Security operations centres and national incident-response teams defending critical infrastructure collect abundant threat data yet struggle to turn it into actionable intelligence. A malware sandbox produces detailed behavioural evidence, but as a large, unranked report whose confidence is unstated. We present CG-CTI, an operational pipeline that converts live sandbox output (CAPEv2) into STIX 2.1, correlates it in a knowledge graph with other critical-infrastructure sensors, and attaches to every intelligence object an explicit confidence status derived from provenance, cross-source corroboration, and observation durability. This status gates automated action: only corroborated intelligence is eligible for automated enforcement, while lower-confidence objects are routed to analyst review or kept as context. A grounded language-model stage then narrates the confidence-qualified evidence, where each statement either cites a supporting object or is marked unsupported, so fabricated references are removed before analyst review. We implement CG-CTI within the CYBERGUARD project, whose consortium includes Romania's national cyber-security directorate, and evaluate it against the live sandbox on a labelled malware corpus, measuring conversion validity, indicator yield, technique coverage, corroboration, enforcement eligibility, latency, and summary grounding. CG-CTI turns fragmented sandbox output into corroborated, confidence-ranked, and auditable intelligence for critical-infrastructure defence.

AI.tldr: 提出 CG-CTI 流水线，将 CAPEv2 沙箱输出转为 STIX 2.1，经知识图谱关联后为每个情报对象附加显式置信状态，并据此分级触发自动化处置与分析师审查，最终由接地语言模型生成可溯源叙述。
AI.motivation: 安全运营中心与国家事件响应团队在防护关键基础设施时收集了大量威胁数据，却难以转化为可执行情报。恶意软件沙箱虽能产出详尽行为证据，但输出为冗长、未排序且置信度不明的报告，导致自动化与人工研判均缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 构建 CG-CTI 运行化流水线：将实时沙箱输出（CAPEv2）转换为 STIX 2.1；在知识图谱中与其他关键基础设施传感器数据进行关联；基于溯源、跨源佐证与观测持续性为每个情报对象计算显式置信状态；以该状态作为自动化动作的门控（仅被佐证的情报可自动执行，低置信对象转人工审查或仅作上下文）；引入接地语言模型生成叙述，每句须引用支撑对象，否则标记为无支撑，从而在分析师审查前剔除虚构引用。
AI.result: 在 CYBERGUARD 项目（含罗马尼亚国家网络安全主管机构参与的联盟）中实现，并针对标注恶意软件语料在实时沙箱环境下评估，度量转换有效性、指标产出量、技术覆盖度、佐证程度、执法/处置资格、延迟以及摘要接地性。
AI.conclusion: CG-CTI 能将碎片化沙箱输出转化为经佐证、按置信度排序且可审计的情报，服务于关键基础设施防御。

title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
comment: Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全自动轻量级合成框架，将每个API建模为有限状态机，生成状态有效的多轮工具调用轨迹数据，用于微调小语言模型。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型部署成本低且可运行于私有基础设施，但基座模型在多轮工具调用上表现不足；而微调需要各API的专属数据，这类数据稀缺。现有合成方法成本过高：需要针对不同领域构建模拟运行环境，且每生成一轮对话需多次调用LLM，难以支撑大规模微调。
AI.method: 将每个API建模为有限状态机（FSM），用抽象状态刻画系统，决定各工具何时可被调用，从而产出状态有效的工具序列；再通过单次LLM调用将序列翻译为完整示例。训练时不以多样性为目标，而是设定关于对话轮数、工具序列和任务复杂度的目标分布来控制数据。
AI.result: 以生成轨迹微调SLM来衡量数据质量：相比未变异的基线，基于FSM的生成显著提升下游准确率；与已有工作相比，全准确率达到70.7%，优于63.4%与53.7%，同时所用token数减少3.6–6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: FSM建模+单次LLM调用+目标分布控制的合成流程，可在低成本、少token条件下生成高质量多轮工具调用训练数据，有效提升小语言模型的工具调用能力。

title: Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks
summary: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究用冻结协议分离速度误差、联合路径上界覆盖、路由选择与实现损失，发现联合覆盖提升并不必然带来更好的路由效用。
AI.motivation: 学界尚不清楚更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖率能否改善路由决策，因此需要将预测质量与下游路由效用解耦评估。
AI.method: 采用冻结协议，分别刻画速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖、路由选择与实现损失；使用北京和成都处理后的道路速度数据，构建离线代理任务，每城150个OD对、3条候选路径、14个测试日；比较原始90分位路径时间上界与经联合校准上界在最小上界路由规则下的表现，并单独进行成都预测器对比。
AI.result: 联合覆盖率在北京M1由83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1由75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2由74.01%升至90.64%；但C2使迟到率分别增加0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均出行时间分别增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。成都预测器对比中，速度MAE降低14.91%伴随C0下迟到率降低1.4571个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不能作为下游路由效用的替代指标；离线结果不足以确立在线或因果收益。

title: FailBench: Evaluating Fault Tolerance Across Distributed Training Architectures
summary: Distributed deep learning relies on data, pipeline, tensor, and hybrid parallelism, yet fault-tolerance mechanisms are typically evaluated only on the architecture for which they were designed. This leaves practitioners with little guidance when choosing mechanisms across architectures. FailBench provides a unified evaluation harness covering seven distributed training architectures, eight crash-fault-tolerance mechanisms and a no-FT baseline, and single, concurrent, and cascading fail-stop failures. We evaluate 142 (architecture, mechanism, trace) combinations on an 8xV100 cluster, with per-rank checkpoint states ranging from 205 MB to 2.7 GB. Three findings emerge. First, no mechanism is universally best: on A2, disk checkpointing has the lowest steady-state overhead (0.5%), in-memory replication restores fastest (~17 ms), and just-in-time checkpointing avoids periodic steady-state checkpoint cost but incurs ~0.9 s upon failure. When process-group re-formation takes seconds, mechanisms differ more in runtime overhead than restore speed. Second, gossip training increases sample throughput by 17.9% after losing a worker, yet shows no detectable improvement in loss progress over a matched no-fault baseline. Third, mechanism cost depends strongly on architecture: in-memory replication overhead ranges from 3.7% to 176%. We translate these findings into a decision framework for selecting fault-tolerance mechanisms and release FailBench as an open artifact.

AI.tldr: FailBench 统一评测了七种分布式训练架构、八种崩溃容错机制与无容错基线，在 8xV100 集群上运行 142 个组合，发现不存在普适最优机制，容错开销高度依赖架构与故障类型，并据此提出选型决策框架。
AI.motivation: 分布式深度学习依赖数据、流水线、张量和混合并行，但容错机制通常只在为其设计的架构上评估，跨架构选型缺乏指导，实践者缺少可比证据。
AI.method: 构建 FailBench 统一评测框架，覆盖 7 种分布式训练架构、8 种崩溃容错机制及 1 个无容错基线，支持单点、并发和级联 fail-stop 故障；在 8xV100 集群上评测 142 个（架构, 机制, 轨迹）组合，各 rank 检查点状态为 205 MB 至 2.7 GB。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 无普适最优机制——A2 上磁盘检查点稳态开销最低（0.5%），内存复制恢复最快（约 17 ms），即时检查点免去周期性稳态开销但故障时需约 0.9 s；当进程组重构需数秒时，机制差异更多体现在运行时开销而非恢复速度。(2) gossip 训练在丢失一个 worker 后样本吞吐提升 17.9%，但相比匹配的无故障基线，损失进展无可检测改善。(3) 机制开销强依赖架构，内存复制开销在 3.7% 至 176% 之间变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究将上述结果转化为容错机制选型决策框架，并将 FailBench 作为开源工件发布，为跨架构容错机制选择提供依据。

title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old-new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL. Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old-new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基础会话本身仅含少量类别的广义小样本类增量学习（G-FSCIL）设定，提出利用可信合成知识稳定增量学习的框架。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法假设基础会话数据充足，但在基础与增量数据均稀缺时，初始表征弱、语义漂移、类边界不稳定。直接混合生成样本会引入语义噪声并加剧新旧类冲突。
AI.method: 基于冻结的潜在扩散模型构建类特定合成候选池，在首次观测时进行类反演并复用条件嵌入按需生成；学习兼顾语义一致性与视觉多样性的知识筛选策略，并在基础会话中蒸馏为可迁移选择策略复用；进一步设计边界稳定的增量适应方案，包括合成信息驱动的原型初始化与双向边界校准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法一致优于现有FSCIL基线，遗忘更低，且新旧类之间平衡更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过筛选可信合成知识并结合边界稳定适应，可有效缓解G-FSCIL中的监督稀缺与新旧类冲突问题。

title: Learning to Remember: Distilling Memory Retention for Compact Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning models, particularly recurrent neural networks and their variants, such as long short-term memory, have significantly advanced time series analysis. These models capture complex, sequential patterns in time series, enabling real-time assessments. However, their high computational complexity and large model sizes pose challenges for deployment in resource-constrained environments, such as wearable devices and edge computing platforms. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a solution by transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student), thereby retaining high performance while reducing computational demands. Current KD methods, originally designed for computer vision tasks, neglect the unique temporal dependencies and memory retention characteristics of time series models. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel KD framework termed Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation (MemKD). MemKD leverages a specialized loss function to capture memory retention discrepancies between the teacher and student models across subsequences within time series data, ensuring that the student model effectively mimics the teacher's behaviour. This approach facilitates the development of compact, high-performing recurrent neural networks suitable for real-time, time series analysis tasks. We provide additional experiments, in-depth theoretical analysis, and insights into the proposed framework across extended time series benchmarks. Our experiments demonstrate that MemKD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KD methods. Additionally, we demonstrate that it can match the teacher model's performance across a wide range of compression levels, achieving notable reductions in parameter count and memory usage without a significant loss in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出MemKD知识蒸馏框架，利用损失函数捕捉教师与学生模型在时序子序列上的记忆保持差异，实现紧凑循环神经网络的高性能实时时序分析。
AI.motivation: 循环神经网络及其变体（如LSTM）虽推动了时序分析发展，但计算复杂度高、模型体积大，难以部署于可穿戴设备与边缘计算等资源受限环境。知识蒸馏可将大模型知识迁移至小模型，但现有KD方法主要针对计算机视觉设计，忽略了时序模型特有的时序依赖与记忆保持特性。
AI.method: 提出MemKD（Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation）框架，设计专门的损失函数，捕捉教师模型与学生模型在时序数据各子序列上的记忆保持差异，促使学生模型有效模仿教师行为，从而构建紧凑且高性能的循环神经网络。
AI.result: 在扩展的时序基准上进行补充实验、深入理论分析与洞察，结果显示MemKD显著优于现有最先进KD方法，且在多种压缩水平下均能达到与教师模型相当的性能，参数量和内存占用显著降低，精度无明显损失。
AI.conclusion: MemKD通过关注时序记忆保持差异，弥补了现有KD方法在时序模型上的不足，为资源受限环境下的实时时序分析提供了高效、可行的紧凑循环神经网络解决方案。

title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出BRACE全身跟踪器，将地形顺应与力/力矩变换折入参考轨迹，使机器人能在斜坡上遵循平地参考并施加/补偿手部力，仅凭本体感知运行。
AI.motivation: 现有全身跟踪参考均在平地、空载条件下录制，跟踪器既不知机器人与物体的力交互，也不知所站地形。已有控制器只解决其中一个方面：具备力能力的策略可指令末端力但不规定全身姿态；地形自适应跟踪器则把负载当作需抑制的扰动而非可指令的力旋量。二者之间存在缺口。
AI.method: BRACE将负载与坡度一并折入跟踪参考：地形顺应将落脚点与根位抬升到局部表面；力旋量变换求解产生目标手部力的手部位移，及其诱导的质心与压力中心偏移，并受教师特定的手臂出力限制约束。通过DAgger将"施力"与"补偿"两个教师蒸馏为单一flow-matching学生策略，仅依赖本体感知，无需高度图或实测力旋量，从而远程操作者只需提供平地轨迹。
AI.result: 在Unitree-G1上开展了大量实验，仿真与真机实验均表明BRACE能够施加力、补偿力并应对多种地形。
AI.conclusion: BRACE通过把地形顺应与力旋量变换显式折入参考，弥合了"力能力"与"地形自适应"两类跟踪方法的缺口，实现了单一本体感知策略在斜坡与负载条件下跟踪平地参考的效果，使远程遥操作者只需提供平地轨迹即可。

title: A gem5-based Simulation Framework for Computing-in-DRAM
summary: Computing-in-Memory using DRAM (CIMD) has demonstrated substantial energy and throughput gains for memory-bound workloads consisting of bulk-bitwise operations, by performing computation directly within DRAM subarrays. Realizing CIMD, however, requires a redesign of the memory controller and careful mapping of operands onto the memory arrays. Presently, accurate FPGA-based testbeds exist, but they are costly and labor-intensive, while open-source simulators are largely trace-based and cannot execute full application runs. The only full-application CIMD simulator available, included with MIMDRAM, is built on an outdated version of gem5 and its toolchains. We present gem5-CIMD, a full-application CIMD simulation framework built on the latest version of gem5. We extend the simulated instruction set from four bitwise operations to sixteen CIM instructions spanning arithmetic, relational, conditional, and utility operations across a range of data types and bitwidths (4 to 64 bits). A complete memory-management stack comprising multi-level huge-page support, a CIM-aware allocator, and a subarray-aware address-mapping scheme ensures that CIM operands are co-located in the same DRAM subarray. In addition, gem5-CIMD is aware of the DRAM refresh interval and faithfully models and schedules the mandatory refresh operations when needed. We provide a CIM standard library intended as a compiler target and evaluate gem5-CIMD on multiple case studies including an end-to-end KNN workload. The simulator sources, including the evaluated workloads, are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 gem5-CIMD，一个基于最新版 gem5 的全应用级 DRAM 存内计算（CIMD）仿真框架，将指令集扩展至 16 条 CIM 指令，并集成完整的存储管理栈与刷新建模，公开源码与工作负载。
AI.motivation: CIMD 能显著提升内存受限型按位运算工作负载的能效与吞吐，但其实现需重新设计内存控制器并精细映射操作数。现有 FPGA 测试平台成本高、工作量大，开源仿真器多为 trace-based 无法运行完整应用，唯一可用的全应用 CIMD 仿真器（随 MIMDRAM 提供）基于过时 gem5 与工具链。
AI.method: 构建于最新版 gem5 之上：将仿真指令集从 4 条按位操作扩展为 16 条 CIM 指令，覆盖算术、关系、条件与实用操作，支持 4 至 64 位多种数据类型与位宽；实现包含多级大页支持、CIM 感知分配器与子阵列感知地址映射方案的完整存储管理栈，确保操作数位于同一 DRAM 子阵列；同时感知 DRAM 刷新间隔，忠实建模并按需调度强制刷新操作；并提供作为编译器目标的 CIM 标准库。
AI.result: 在多个案例研究中评估 gem5-CIMD，包括端到端 KNN 工作负载；仿真器源码与所评估工作负载均公开可用。
AI.conclusion: gem5-CIMD 提供了一个现代化、全应用级的 CIMD 仿真框架，弥补了现有 FPGA 测试平台成本高与开源仿真器能力不足的空白，并通过刷新建模、存储管理与标准库支持提升了 CIMD 研究的可复现性与实用性。

title: Evaluating Behavioral Context for Interpretable IAM Policy Risk Scoring in Cloud Environments
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Peer-reviewed and accepted at IEEE Conference ID# 71863; to appear in the IEEE Xplore proceedings
summary: IAM policy analysis typically emphasizes the authorization capabilities encoded in a policy, but security analyst review priority may also depend on the behavioral and environmental context surrounding a policy event. This paper evaluates whether contextual information provides measurable incremental value for interpretable IAM policy risk prioritization beyond policy and effective-authorization information. AWS is used as the experimental cloud provider because its IAM and audit-telemetry ecosystem enables controlled evaluation using AWS IAM Context Bench, a benchmark containing 534 real AWS experimental observations across policy, environment, and behavioral scenarios, including matched cases where policy and environment remain fixed while behavioral context changes. Three Explainable Boosting Machine models are evaluated under the same leakage-controlled grouped cross-validation protocol: a policy-centric baseline, a policy-plus-environment model, and a full-context model incorporating CloudTrail telemetry. The full-context model substantially reduces analyst-priority prediction error relative to the policy-centric baseline and closely tracks the reference priority ordering. In matched same-policy context pairs, the policy-centric model remains invariant, whereas the full-context model separates benign and suspicious behavioral conditions with high directional accuracy. The results also show improved concentration of high-priority cases at the top of simulated analyst review queues. These findings indicate that behavioral and environmental context can provide useful incremental information for analyst-oriented IAM risk prioritization while preserving an interpretable additive model structure. The formulation is applicable beyond AWS conceptually, although cross-provider validation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文评估在IAM策略风险优先级排序中，行为与环境上下文是否能在策略与有效授权信息之外提供可测量的增量价值；实验表明融合CloudTrail遥测的上下文模型显著降低优先级预测误差。
AI.motivation: 传统IAM策略分析侧重于策略编码的授权能力，但安全分析师的审查优先级可能还取决于策略事件周围的行为与环境上下文，该视角此前缺乏受控的定量评估。
AI.method: 以AWS为实验云平台，构建AWS IAM Context Bench基准，包含534个覆盖策略、环境与行为场景的真实实验观测，并含策略与环境固定、仅行为上下文变化的匹配样本；在相同的防泄漏分组交叉验证协议下比较三个Explainable Boosting Machine模型：以策略为中心的基线、策略+环境模型、以及纳入CloudTrail遥测的全上下文模型。
AI.result: 全上下文模型相对策略基线大幅降低分析师优先级预测误差，并高度贴合参考优先级排序；在同策略匹配对中，策略中心模型输出不变，而全上下文模型能以高方向准确率区分良性与会话可疑的行为条件；模拟分析师审查队列中高优先级案例的集中度也得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 行为与环境上下文可为面向分析师的IAM风险优先级排序提供有用的增量信息，同时保持可解释的加性模型结构；该建模思路在概念上可推广至AWS之外的云平台，跨提供商验证为未来工作。

title: JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: When an LLM judge scores an output, its score distribution retains uncertainty and disagreement information that is lost after scalar compression. We introduce JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that assigns example-specific weights to cached judge score distributions and fuses them before computing a final score. A protocol study shows that score-range choice is unstable across judge--dataset settings and that soft scoring usually outperforms hard decoding. On the original 10-cell benchmark, JudgeMoE improves mean Spearman over uniform log pooling by $+0.079$. Applying the same configuration to six additional cells yields a $+0.0393$ mean gain over the strongest local single judge across 16 cells, with positive differences in 12/16 cells and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.0091$. Validation-based analyses further show that the preferred aggregation method depends on the task and judge pool.

AI.tldr: 提出 JudgeMoE,一种对缓存评判器分数分布进行样本特异权重融合的轻量聚合器,在 16 个设置上平均优于均匀对数池化与最强单评判器。
AI.motivation: LLM 评判器给出分数时,标量压缩会丢失分数分布中的不确定性与分歧信息;同时分数区间选择在不同评判器-数据集组合下不稳定,需要更稳健的聚合方式。
AI.method: JudgeMoE:为每个样本分配特定权重,对缓存的评判器分数分布进行加权融合,再计算最终分数;并开展协议研究比较分数区间选择与软/硬打分。
AI.result: 原始 10 单元基准上,mean Spearman 比均匀对数池化提升 +0.079;同配置扩展至另外 6 个单元后,16 个单元相对最强本地单评判器平均提升 +0.0393,12/16 单元为正,单侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 p=0.0091。
AI.conclusion: 软打分通常优于硬解码,最优聚合方法依赖任务与评判器池;JudgeMoE 提供了有效且轻量的分布级聚合方案。

title: Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents
summary: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopoPlanner，一种拓扑一致的规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形，作为拓扑感知上下文供 LLM 进行工具规划，在四类基准上优于提示型与图增强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体任务规划器擅长处理顺序或类 DAG 结构，但难以应对现实中工具编排常见的验证-纠正循环、分支汇聚合并、可复用中间状态等工作流模式。
AI.method: 将工具依赖图提升为细胞工作流复形；通过余层（cosheaf）一致的细胞检索获取与请求相关的闭合子复形；在检索到的拓扑上进行多维结构推理；并将所得的细胞表示接入规划 LLM 以生成工具序列。
AI.result: 在四个工具规划基准上，针对拓扑引导的循环、合并及循环-合并工作流，TopoPlanner 在不同本地 LLM 骨干上均一致优于基于提示与图增强的基线。
AI.conclusion: 以拓扑结构作为 LLM 规划的上下文表示，能有效处理循环、汇聚与可复用状态等复杂工作流模式，验证了拓扑一致性框架在工具编排任务中的有效性与普适性。

title: When Can Stateless Recovery Defeat Byzantine Quorum Safety? A Tight Normal Form for Single-Step BFT
comment: To be appeared at ICDCN 2027 as a Short Paper
summary: Byzantine quorum safety relies on correct replicas refusing to sign conflicting values. A replica that loses its protocol state during recovery but retains its identity and signing key may forget an earlier vote. We study certificates formed by matching signed votes from at least $q$ of $n$ replicas, assuming that each correct replica avoids conflicting votes between recoveries. If two conflicting certificates form, their overlap has size between $2q-n$ and $b+c$, where $b$ counts Byzantine replicas and $c$ counts correct identities that recovered during the execution considered. Our main result decomposes the slack $b+c-(2q-n)$ into four nonnegative counts: extra signers in the first certificate, extra signers in the second, identities in neither certificate, and Byzantine or recovering identities outside their overlap. Zero slack forces an exact signer partition. With $n=3f+1$ replicas, threshold $q=2f+1$, at most $f$ Byzantine replicas, and exactly one correct recovery event, any conflicting pair forces exactly $f$ Byzantine replicas, all in the overlap together with the recovered replica; each certificate has a disjoint side of $f$ correct replicas. A minimal protocol attains this form. We distinguish certificate formation from acceptance, give a sufficient check using configured fault and recovery caps, and explain why durable vote records written before signature release prevent the conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拜占庭仲裁安全性：当正确副本在恢复后丢失协议状态但保留身份与签名密钥时，可能遗忘先前投票，从而导致冲突证书。作者将两冲突证书的重叠规模界定在 2q−n 与 b+c 之间，并把松弛量 b+c−(2q−n) 分解为四个非负计数，给出零松弛下的精确签名者划分，以及在 n=3f+1、q=2f+1、至多 f 个拜占庭副本、恰有一次正确恢复事件时冲突对的结构刻画，并提出可实现的极简协议与基于签名前持久投票记录的预防方案。
AI.motivation: 拜占庭仲裁安全性通常假设正确副本不会对冲突值签名，但副本在恢复过程中可能丢失协议状态而保留身份与签名密钥，从而遗忘先前投票。这种"恢复导致的重复投票"会破坏基于签名的证书安全性，因此需要明确：在存在恢复事件时，冲突证书究竟能形成到何种程度，其重叠结构由哪些因素决定，以及如何通过协议设计加以防止。
AI.method: 1) 定义由至少 q 个（共 n 个）副本的匹配签名投票构成的证书，假设每个正确副本在两次恢复之间避免冲突投票。2) 分析两个冲突证书的形成条件，证明其重叠规模介于 2q−n 与 b+c 之间，其中 b 为拜占庭副本数，c 为所考虑执行期间发生恢复的正确身份数。3) 将松弛量 b+c−(2q−n) 分解为四个非负计数：第一证书中的额外签名者、第二证书中的额外签名者、两证书均未包含的身份、以及位于重叠之外但属于拜占庭或恢复身份者；零松弛对应签名者的精确划分。4) 在 n=3f+1、q=2f+1、至多 f 个拜占庭副本、恰有一次正确恢复事件的参数下刻画冲突对的结构，并给出达到该结构的极简协议。5) 区分证书形成与证书接受，给出使用配置的故障上限与恢复上限的充分检查条件，并论证签名前写入持久投票记录可防止冲突。
AI.result: 重叠规模被证明落在 [2q−n, b+c] 区间内；松弛量被完全分解为四个非负计数，零松弛时强制签名者精确划分。在 n=3f+1、q=2f+1、至多 f 个拜占庭副本、恰有一次正确恢复事件的设定下，任何冲突对都强制恰好 f 个拜占庭副本，且全部位于与恢复副本共同的重叠中，同时每个证书各有一个由 f 个正确副本组成的互不相交的侧面。该结构可由一个极简协议达到。此外，论文给出了基于配置故障与恢复上限的充分检查，并说明在签名释放前写入持久投票记录可防止冲突。
AI.conclusion: 拜占庭仲裁安全性在存在状态丢失恢复时会退化，其退化程度由重叠区间与四计数松弛分解精确刻画。零松弛对应于无冗余的签名者划分，而在标准 3f+1 设定下冲突必然要求拜占庭副本与恢复副本共同构成重叠。通过区分证书形成与接受、施加配置的故障与恢复上限检查、并在签名前持久化投票记录，可以避免此类冲突，从而保证正确副本不签署冲突值的传统假设在恢复场景下依然可被工程化地维持。

title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
comment: This is submitted to IEEE Journal
summary: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DTFormer，一个 RGB-D-Text 三模态语义分割框架，通过文本引导的语义对齐模块（TSAM）将语言先验作为语义原型，对多模态特征实施显式语义正则，从而提升分割判别能力。
AI.motivation: 主流 RGB-D 语义分割模型主要依赖像素级监督学习特征，缺乏高层语义约束，语义判别性有限。作者试图验证：引入语言先验等外部知识，能否为主流 RGB-D 分割模型注入更强的语义判别能力。
AI.method: 提出三模态（RGB-D-Text）框架 DTFormer。核心是文本引导语义对齐模块 TSAM：先将文本线索编码为一组语义原型，再在编码器与解码器的多个层级上，显式地将 RGB-D 多模态特征与这些原型对齐，从而对表示学习施加强语义正则，引导网络学习更具判别性的特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DTFormer 取得一致性性能增益，同时保持结构简单、计算高效。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义对齐是一种有效且实用的途径，可提升 RGB-D 语义分割性能；语言先验能够增强主流分割模型的语义判别性。

title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
summary: Injecting skills into a frozen language model currently costs a million parameters and a reinforcement-learning pipeline. We introduce \method{}, a System-1 decision operator trained by behavior cloning that lowers this cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. The default operator uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M-parameter operator trained with reinforcement learning, exceeds or achieve comparable performance, while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no loss in accuracy. A rank-4 variant with 23K parameters, 1/58 of the strongest published skill operator, suffices for SearchQA and near-suffices for LiveMath, where higher rank still helps; the same recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones, with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training. The gap to prior work is trainability, and it is set jointly by initialization and architecture: the initialization of prior operators zeroes the gradient of both large factor matrices at the first optimization step, whereas our zero-initialized output projection inside a shared low-rank backbone receives a gradient immediately, which a gradient-flow probe confirms directly. The gain isn't chain-of-thought compression: 23 of 57 LiveMath points beat the base model's best-of-8 sampling, and a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway, not writing it earlier. Gains track the base model's headroom across 13 base--task pairs, and skills compose as approximately linear operators that can be added, interpolated, and hot-swapped at inference time. Code on https://github.com/rlisml/decisionsteer.

AI.tldr: 提出 decisionsteer，一种基于行为克隆训练的 System-1 决策算子，以约低两个数量级的参数代价把技能注入冻结语言模型，并可直接作用于推理阶段。
AI.motivation: 向冻结语言模型注入技能现有方案需百万级参数和强化学习流程，训练代价高；且先前算子的初始化与架构导致梯度受阻、难以训练，成为与已有工作差距的关键。
AI.method: 用行为克隆训练决策算子；默认算子 330K 参数，另有 rank-4 变体 23K 参数；采用共享低秩骨干 + 零初始化输出投影，使首个优化步即获得梯度，并用梯度流探针验证。推理时把 3,685 token 的 deliberation 折叠为 6-token 决策；技能可近似线性组合、插值与热插拔。
AI.result: 330K 参数算子匹配 1.33M 强化学习算子且性能相当或更优，准确率无损地把 3,685-token 推理压缩为 6-token 决策；23K 的 rank-4 变体为最强已发布技能算子的 1/58，在 SearchQA 足够、LiveMath 接近足够；跨 5 任务、3 骨干迁移，训练后数月发布的 LiveMath 题仍保持 OOD 增益；23/57 个 LiveMath 点超过基模型 best-of-8 采样；logit-lens 显示算子沿模型既有后层通路放大答案而非提前写入；增益随 13 组 base–task 的 headroom 变化。
AI.conclusion: 与先前工作的差距源于可训练性，由初始化与架构共同决定；零初始化输出投影在共享低秩骨干中保证即时梯度，是性能与效率提升的关键。该算子实现低成本技能注入、可组合与推理期热插拔。

title: Behavioral Cloning Mystery
summary: Behavioral cloning (BC), despite its simplicity, exhibits many counterintuitive phenomena in the real world. For example, the performance of BC often keeps increasing as the model overfits more to the dataset, and fully closed-loop policies often completely fail without action chunking. Unfortunately, properly studying these anecdotal phenomena ("behavioral cloning mysteries") is challenging: in the real world, datasets and experiments are costly and not fully controllable; in simulation with synthetic data, these phenomena are often not easily observed partly due to the discrepancy between scripted policies and human demonstrations. In this work, we propose OCBench, a robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that have similar properties to human demonstrations. We show that, by mimicking key properties of human demonstrations, OCBench reproduces many anecdotal BC-related phenomena in controlled settings. With its GPU-accelerated environments and scripted policies, we demonstrate how OCBench enables scientific studies of previously reported BC-related phenomena by analyzing and refuting various hypotheses. Project page: https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench

AI.tldr: 提出 OCBench——一个具备可控制脚本策略的机器人操作基准，其策略性质接近人类演示，可在受控环境下复现多种"行为克隆谜题"现象，并借助 GPU 加速环境开展科学化分析。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆（BC）虽简单，但在真实世界表现出诸多反直觉现象：BC 性能常随模型对数据集过拟合而持续提升；去掉动作分块（action chunking）后，完整闭环策略往往彻底失效。然而系统研究这些"BC 谜题"十分困难：真实世界数据集与实验成本高且难以完全控制；在合成数据的仿真中，由于脚本策略与人类演示之间存在差异，这些现象又往往不易被观察到。
AI.method: 提出 OCBench：一个机器人操作基准，配备可控的脚本策略（scripted policies），这些策略具备与人类演示相似的关键属性。基于 GPU 加速的环境与脚本策略构建可控实验平台。
AI.result: 通过模仿人类演示的关键属性，OCBench 在受控设置下成功复现了多个与 BC 相关的传闻性现象；并借助其 GPU 加速环境与脚本策略，对以往报道的 BC 相关现象展开分析、检验并驳斥了多种假设。
AI.conclusion: OCBench 为行为克隆相关现象提供了可复现、可控制的科学化研究平台，使此前难以验证的"BC 谜题"得以系统分析与假设检验。

title: On the Impact of Degradation-Balanced Scheduling in Manycore Systems
summary: Electromigration degradation in manycore systems depends strongly on how runtime workload is distributed across cores. Task placement affects power, temperature, and current density, which in turn shape the spatial distribution of degradation over time. However, a scheduler that ranks cores only by their current reliability state may not always distinguish among candidate cores, especially when reliability values are close at decision time. In this case, scheduling decisions can be driven by secondary factors rather than by long-term degradation balance. This paper studies degradation-balanced scheduling and proposes a Reliability-Balanced (RB) policy that predicts the full-task effect of each candidate assignment. RB penalizes added imbalance in electromigration exposure, stress, active time, and task count while guarding the predicted Rvalue floor. On randomized continuous mixed workloads, the proposed scheduler preserves completed tasks while improving average Rvalue by 0.37% and minimum Rvalue by 4.35%. It reduces Rvalue, exposure, stress, and active-time standard deviation by 10.84%, 9.39%, 8.35%, and 16.38%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向多核系统电迁移退化的均衡调度问题，提出可靠性均衡（RB）策略，通过预测每个候选任务分配的全程影响来平衡退化，在随机连续混合负载下改善了Rvalue均值与最小值并显著降低多项指标的标准差。
AI.motivation: 多核系统电迁移退化强烈依赖运行时负载在核间的分布；任务放置影响功耗、温度与电流密度，进而决定退化随时间的空间分布。仅按当前可靠性状态对核排序的调度器在可靠性值接近时难以区分候选核，导致决策被次要因素左右，无法实现长期退化均衡。
AI.method: 提出可靠性均衡（RB）策略，预测每个候选分配的整任务（full-task）影响；在保护预测Rvalue下界的前提下，对电迁移暴露、应力、活跃时间与任务数的不均衡增量进行惩罚。
AI.result: 在随机连续混合负载下，保持完成任务数量的同时，平均Rvalue提升0.37%，最小Rvalue提升4.35%；Rvalue、暴露、应力与活跃时间的标准差分别降低10.84%、9.39%、8.35%与16.38%。
AI.conclusion: 基于整任务影响预测与多维度不均衡惩罚的RB调度策略，可有效改善退化均衡性，缩小核间差异并提升最小可靠性水平，同时不牺牲任务完成量，为多核系统可靠性感知调度提供了可行方案。

title: Simple Extremely Lossy Functions from Small-Exponent Hashing
summary:
Extremely Lossy Functions (ELFs) are a standard model primitive that captures many useful properties of random oracles (Zhandry, Crypto 2016). While there are many variations of ELFs with additional properties, every construction (excluding obfuscation) has followed essentially the same template of bootstrapping from a sequence of ELFs secure only against fixed-size adversaries, and every construction was based on only the exponential hardness of DDH (or $k$-Lin), an assumption that is only reasonable over elliptic curves.
  We introduce and construct Extremely Lossy Trapdoor Hashing (ELTDH), a stronger notion that implies all known variations of ELFs. Our construction achieves ELTDH in one go, without bootstrapping from schemes secure for only fixed-size adversaries, which makes it simpler and more efficient than existing ELFs. We assume exponential security of the small-exponent discrete logarithm, together with polynomial security of decisional composite residuosity (DCR). Exponential security is only required in the size of the secret exponent, not the size of the group, so the assumption plausibly holds for multiplication modulo $N^2$ (and for many other cryptographic groups), despite the subexponential-time discrete logarithm attacks from index calculus. Our results diversify the assumptions underlying ELFs, while also giving a simpler construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并构造了 Extremely Lossy Trapdoor Hashing (ELTDH)，一个蕴含所有已知 ELF 变体的更强原语，并给出了一步式构造，简化并提升了效率，同时将 ELF 的基础假设从椭圆曲线上的 DDH 扩展到小指数离散对数的指数安全性与 DCR。
AI.motivation: 现有 ELF 构造几乎都依赖于"从仅对固定规模敌手安全的 ELF 逐级自举"的模板，且仅基于 DDH（或 k-Lin）的指数硬度——这一假设只在椭圆曲线上合理。作者希望打破这一模板、简化构造，并多样化 ELF 所依赖的假设。
AI.method: 引入并构造 Extremely Lossy Trapdoor Hashing (ELTDH)，其强于所有已知 ELF 变体。构造不通过固定规模敌手安全的方案自举，而是一步到位；假设为小指数离散对数的指数安全性与 decisional composite residuosity (DCR) 的多项式安全性，其中指数安全仅要求关于秘密指数规模而非群规模。
AI.result: ELTDH 蕴含所有已知 ELF 变体；因其无需自举，构造更简单、更高效。假设在模 N² 乘法群（及许多其他密码群）上可信成立，尽管存在来自 index calculus 的次指数时间离散对数攻击。
AI.conclusion: 工作多样化了 ELF 的底层假设，并给出了更简单的构造，突破了此前对 DDH 指数硬度和固定规模自举模板的依赖。

title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Website: https://berkearda.github.io/croissantminer/
summary: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.
