AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向 Croissant 元数据模式的端到端抽取评测基准（602 篇论文，含 102 篇人工验证金标与 500 篇 LLM 银标），并比较单遍抽取与四类智能体架构，发现单遍全上下文抽取一致优于分解式智能体方案，长文本 RAI 字段差距最大。
AI.motivation: Croissant 已成为机器可读数据集元数据标准，但其字段填充仍需人工阅读数据集文档，成本高且劳动密集；同时社区缺乏一个与社区标准模式对齐的端到端元数据抽取评测基准。
AI.method: 构建覆盖完整 Croissant 模式（含核心字段与 Responsible AI 字段）的基准：602 篇论文，其中 102 篇带人工验证金标、500 篇带 LLM 生成银标。在此基准上评测多种抽取系统，涵盖前沿模型、开放权重模型与智能体架构，并采用两层评测框架：规则评分结合经人工审计筛选的 LLM 评判器。
AI.result: 单遍抽取一致优于所评测的四种智能体架构；在不同骨干模型上，分解式智能体变体的准确率均低于单次全上下文抽取。最大差距出现在长文本 RAI 字段上，这类字段需要综合与解释散落于全文的信息，而非从单一位置复制，当前系统表现远未可靠。
AI.conclusion: 作者公开基准、评测代码、评判器审计、在线演示以及面向新系统开放的排行榜，以推动 Croissant 元数据自动抽取研究。

title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

AI.tldr: 提出MOTIVE多视角自验证框架，通过可靠性引导的选择性重思考提升VLM推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLM在多模态推理中易产生看似合理但错误的答案；现有自验证方法依赖单一验证标准或固定提示，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。
AI.method: 首先系统分析验证器能力与提示设计对验证性能的影响；据此提出MOTIVE，从互补验证视角评估候选答案，通过正确性锚定的多视角验证学习得到对齐正确性的可靠性分数；推理时该分数决定接受或重思考（不确定时触发历史引导的重思考）。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准和VLM主干上，MOTIVE持续优于强自验证与自纠正基线；可靠验证改善了接受-重思考决策并减少不必要推理轮次。
AI.conclusion: 无需外部评判者即可实现更可靠、高效的自验证，提升多模态推理的可靠性与效率。

title: A Private IPFS Data Sanctuary for Verifiable Digital Collection Objects
summary: Background: Galleries, libraries, archives and museums (GLAM) increasingly produce scientific collection data whose digital state must remain identifiable, recoverable, and verifiable after acquisition. A staging architecture should provide redundancy without requiring every measurement to depend on one workstation or storage path. Methods: We evaluated a private seven-node InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) deployment at the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin. Five Raspberry Pi 5 edge peers and two archive-class peers contributed NVMe-backed repositories across two wired zones linked by a shared wireless path. Two real raw-acquisition folders were recovered by content identifier (CID), a large machine-learning model-weight folder was ingested, and sustained telemetry from two edge and two archive nodes was compared. Results: Raw acquisition A (6.20 GB) materialized in 34.0 s (182 MB/s effective logical rate) and raw acquisition B (5.19 GB) in 14.092 s (368 MB/s). A 156.1 GB model-weight folder was recursively added in approximately 300 s (520 MB/s logical ingest). Four sustained telemetry series comprised 857.3 logged node-hours and 27,616 valid block-stat probes, all reporting successful local block access. Conclusion: The prototype demonstrates a practical institution-local distributed file system (DFS) for content-addressed acquisition staging. Museum-specific object identifiers can remain stable at the collection-object level while each imported measurement automatically receives a content-derived state identity. Replication intentionally distributes identical blocks across failure domains, while content addressing enables reuse of unchanged blocks within repositories. This combination supports verifiable digital collection objects and a federated storage model for collaborating GLAM institutions.

AI.tldr: 在柏林自然博物馆部署七节点私有IPFS集群（五个Raspberry Pi 5边缘节点+两个归档级节点，NVMe存储，跨两个有线区并由共享无线链路连接），验证了面向GLAM科学采集数据的本地分布式内容寻址暂存架构的可行性与性能。
AI.motivation: GLAM（美术馆、图书馆、档案馆与博物馆）机构产生的科学采集数据在入库后必须保持可识别、可恢复、可验证的数字状态；现有方案往往使每次测量依赖单一工作站或单一存储路径，缺乏冗余。作者希望构建一种不依赖单点、具备冗余能力的暂存架构。
AI.method: 构建并评估一个七节点私有IPFS部署：5个Raspberry Pi 5边缘节点与2个归档级节点提供NVMe支持的存储库，分布于两个有线区，经共享无线路径互联。实验包括：通过内容标识符（CID）恢复两个真实原始采集文件夹、摄入一个大型机器学习模型权重文件夹，并对比两个边缘节点与两个归档节点的持续遥测数据。
AI.result: 原始采集A（6.20 GB）在34.0 s内完成可用（有效逻辑速率182 MB/s）；采集B（5.19 GB）在14.092 s内完成（368 MB/s）；156.1 GB模型权重文件夹递归添加约耗时300 s（逻辑摄入520 MB/s）。四条持续遥测序列共857.3节点小时、27,616次有效块状态探测，全部报告本地块访问成功。
AI.conclusion: 该原型验证了机构本地的内容寻址采集暂存DFS的实用性。博物馆专有对象标识可在藏品对象层保持稳定，而每次导入的测量自动获得由内容派生的状态标识。复制有意将相同块分散至不同故障域，内容寻址则支持库内未变更块的复用，从而支撑可验证的数字藏品对象及面向GLAM协作机构的联邦存储模型。

title: Anchor and Adapt: Asymmetric Prompt Adaptation for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: In few-shot industrial anomaly detection, the few normal target images provide no direct defect supervision, making anomaly prompts difficult to learn from these samples alone. Some vision-language methods therefore use manually specified descriptions to supply explicit anomaly semantics. However, constructing these descriptions requires product-specific effort, and their effectiveness depends on prompt selection. We propose Anchor and Adapt, a two-stage prompt learning framework that separates the acquisition of anomaly semantics from adaptation to target normal appearance. Stage I learns transferable normal and abnormal anchors from annotated auxiliary data. Stage II keeps these anchors fixed and adapts an additional normal branch using the few target normal samples. The inherited and adapted normal branches jointly characterize target normality, with text-anchor regularization encouraging consistency with the generic normal prior and separation from the abnormal anchors. This design retains learned anomaly knowledge while reducing dependence on category-specific anomaly templates, without requiring synthetic anomaly generation. Cross-dataset experiments between MVTec-AD and VisA under 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings demonstrate competitive detection and localization performance. Controlled ablations assess the roles of transferred anchors, asymmetric adaptation, dual-normal representations, and anchor regularization.

AI.tldr: 提出"Anchor and Adapt"两阶段提示学习框架：先在辅助标注数据上学习可迁移的正常/异常语义锚点，再固定锚点、用少量目标正常样本自适应额外正常分支，实现少样本工业异常检测，无需人工描述或合成异常。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中，少量正常目标图像缺乏直接缺陷监督，异常提示难以从头学习；现有视觉-语言方法依赖人工编写产品专属的异常描述，构建成本高且效果敏感于提示选择。
AI.method: 两阶段提示学习框架。阶段I：从有标注的辅助数据中学习可迁移的正常与异常锚点；阶段II：固定这些锚点，利用少量目标正常样本自适应一个额外的正常分支。继承的正常分支与自适应正常分支联合刻画目标正常性，并通过文本锚点正则化，使表示既与通用正常先验保持一致，又与异常锚点保持分离。无需合成异常生成。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD与VisA之间的跨数据集实验，在1-shot、2-shot、4-shot设置下，检测与定位性能均具竞争力。消融实验评估了迁移锚点、非对称自适应、双正常表示与锚点正则化的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留已学异常知识的同时降低了对类别专属异常模板的依赖，避免了人工描述与合成异常生成，为少样本工业异常检测提供了可迁移、低成本的提示学习方案。

title: Do Neural PDE Solvers Learn the Right Dynamics?
summary: Neural PDE solvers can achieve low prediction errors, but do they reproduce the dynamics of the systems they model? Prediction scores alone offer an incomplete answer: they measure agreement with reference solutions but provide limited insight into how errors accumulate, nearby states diverge, or extreme events arise. We propose an evaluation framework that directly examines these behaviors in deterministic and stochastic neural solvers. By evolving ensembles of nearby initial states and comparing them with direct numerical simulation, we assess three complementary aspects of learned dynamics: error formation, ensemble geometry, and extreme events. Experiments on two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow reveal limitations that conventional scores can obscure. Smaller trajectory errors can reflect weaker error amplification despite less accurate local updates. Models can match an ensemble's overall spread and effective dimension while failing to capture the spatial directions where nearby states diverge. Similarly, matching overall event frequencies can conceal failures to predict persistent extreme events. These findings show that improved prediction accuracy does not necessarily imply greater dynamical fidelity. Our framework makes this distinction measurable, providing concrete criteria for evaluating whether advances in neural PDE solvers better capture the underlying dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套评估框架，通过考察误差形成、集合几何与极端事件三方面，揭示神经PDE求解器在预测精度之外的真实动力学保真度。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE求解器通常以预测误差衡量性能，但低误差未必意味着复现了系统动力学。单靠预测分数无法说明误差如何累积、邻近状态如何发散以及极端事件如何产生，因此需要一个直接检验这些动力学行为的评估框架。
AI.method: 作者针对确定性与随机神经求解器提出评估框架：演化邻近初始状态组成的集合，并与直接数值模拟对比，从三个互补维度评估学习到的动力学——误差形成、集合几何、极端事件。实验在二维Kolmogorov流上进行。
AI.result: 实验揭示了传统分数所掩盖的局限：较小的轨迹误差可能源于更弱的误差放大而非更准确的局部更新；模型可匹配集合整体离散度与有效维度，却无法捕捉邻近状态发散的空间方向；匹配总体事件频率也可能掩盖对持续性极端事件的预测失败。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度的提升并不必然意味着动力学保真度的提升。该框架使这一区分可度量，为评估神经PDE求解器的进展是否更好地刻画底层动力学提供了具体标准。

title: Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
summary: An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of $1.74\times10^{-4}$ within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由视觉语言模型引导的电磁数字孪生在线标定框架，用Unitree G1机器人与NVIDIA Sionna实现材料电导率在线校准与测量路径规划。
AI.motivation: 电磁数字孪生为移动机器人提供无线环境态势感知，但其精度依赖随环境变化的材料电导率；在线标定存在初始化敏感和测量路径代价高的问题。
AI.method: 以Unitree G1机器人和NVIDIA Sionna为平台，调用视觉语言模型两次：一是材料分类，将可见材料经ITU-R P.2040映射为电导率先验，用于Sionna对累积RSS测量做梯度下降；二是路径点规划，利用RSS标定残差与图像覆盖度在线选择下一测量位置。
AI.result: 真实室内场景中，在20 m行程内实现归一化平均绝对电导率误差1.74×10⁻⁴；随机初始化无法收敛，随机路径点所需行程超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型提供的材料先验与覆盖度感知路径规划可显著提升电磁数字孪生在线标定的收敛性与测量效率，降低行程代价。

title: ECO: Energy-Oriented Configuration Optimization for Attention FFN Disaggregated LLM Serving
summary: Energy-efficient LLM serving requires minimizing serving GPU energy while meeting latency and throughput service-level objectives (SLOs). Attention--FFN disaggregation (AFD) enables separate resource allocation and operating controls for attention and expert computation, but their energy effects remain coupled through the execution pipeline. Realizing its energy-saving potential therefore requires navigating a hierarchical configuration space in which deployment structures constrain admissible controls and shape their end-to-end effects. Finding low-energy configurations that meet SLOs is challenging because physical evaluations are costly and only a small fraction of candidates can be measured. We present Energy-Oriented Configuration Optimization (ECO), which jointly searches deployment structures and their admissible operating controls under a limited measurement budget. ECO constructs a structure-aware energy prior from calibrated stage behavior and pipeline dependencies, then learns residual prediction errors with a Gaussian process. Its cost-aware constrained Bayesian optimization prioritizes measurements according to expected energy improvement while accounting for SLO feasibility, execution success, and evaluation cost, and returns the lowest-energy measured feasible configuration. Across all 16 scenarios on A6000 and A100 with Qwen and DeepSeek, ECO's frozen configurations, evaluated on disjoint requests, reduce serving energy by 40.5\% and increase output token rate by 20.7\% on average relative to baselines while meeting target SLOs. Across the 8 A6000 scenarios, its selected feasible energy averages 33.1\% below generic constrained Bayesian optimization and 25.8\% below genetic search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Energy-Oriented Configuration Optimization（ECO），在有限测量预算下联合搜索 AFD 部署结构及其可允许的运行控制参数，以降低 LLM 推理 GPU 能耗并满足 SLO。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务的能效优化需在满足延迟与吞吐 SLO 的前提下最小化 GPU 能耗。Attention–FFN 解耦（AFD）可分别配置注意力与专家计算的资源和运行控制，但二者能耗效应通过执行流水线相互耦合，形成"部署结构约束可用控制、控制又影响端到端效果"的层级配置空间。物理评估成本高，只能测量极少数候选配置，因此低能耗且满足 SLO 的配置搜索十分困难。
AI.method: ECO 在有限测量预算下联合搜索部署结构与可允许运行控制。其首先基于校准的各阶段行为与流水线依赖构造结构感知的能耗先验，再用高斯过程学习残差预测误差；随后采用代价感知的约束贝叶斯优化，依据期望能耗改善对测量排序，同时考虑 SLO 可行性、执行成功率与评估代价，最终返回已测量的最低能耗可行配置。
AI.result: 在 A6000 与 A100 上、基于 Qwen 与 DeepSeek 的全部 16 个场景中，ECO 冻结的配置在不相交请求上评估，相较基线平均降低服务能耗 40.5%、提升输出 token 速率 20.7%，且满足目标 SLO。在 8 个 A6000 场景中，其选出的可行配置能耗平均比通用约束贝叶斯优化低 33.1%、比遗传搜索低 25.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知先验结合残差高斯过程与代价感知约束贝叶斯优化，能在有限测量预算下有效求解 AFD 的层级配置空间，显著降低 LLM 服务能耗并提升吞吐，同时保证 SLO 达标，优于通用约束贝叶斯优化与遗传搜索。

title: NetAgent: Multi-Task Agentic Network Traffic Analysis Made Practical
summary:
Network traffic analysis is central to network security, spanning tasks from intrusion detection to encrypted traffic classification. Existing approaches either train task-specific models that generalize poorly or rely on costly traffic foundation models that still struggle under distribution shift. We present NetAgent, the first agentic framework for multi-task traffic analysis. Through a carefully designed agent loop, NetAgent supports complex task understanding, on-the-fly decomposition and orchestration, dynamic replanning, and long-horizon analysis, without task-specific training. It introduces five key designs: (1) knowledge-augmented workflow planning that maps attack knowledge to traffic features to bridge the semantic gap; (2) a comprehensive tool action space with 150+ verified tools extracted from 50+ published systems; (3) a unified code execution space for flexible action composition; (4) a three-tier memory for long-term knowledge consolidation; and (5) sandboxing and runtime repair for reliable execution.
  Across 9 major benchmarks, NetAgent outperforms all baselines (23 single-task and 5 multi-task) on nearly all tasks and generalizes substantially better to unseen traffic distribution (90.04% F1 vs. 2.74% and 3.04% for the best single-task and multi-task baselines) and under realistic background shift (4.85-point F1 drop vs. 74.88-point and 74.80-point drop for the best single-task and multi-task baselines). These results reveal that existing methods owe much of their reported success to overfitting dataset-specific patterns and degrade sharply in realistic network environments, while NetAgent's agentic design remains accurate, generalizable, and robust.

AI.tldr: NetAgent：首个面向多任务流量分析的智能体框架，无需任务特定训练，通过智能体循环实现任务理解、动态编排与长程分析，在9个基准上超越23个单任务与5个多任务基线，显著提升分布外泛化与背景漂移鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有网络流量分析方法存在两类局限：一是训练任务专用模型，泛化能力差；二是依赖高成本的流量基础模型，在分布偏移下仍表现不佳。因此需要一个能支持多任务、免任务特定训练且稳健的通用分析框架。
AI.method: 提出智能体框架NetAgent，借助精心设计的智能体循环支持复杂任务理解、即时分解与编排、动态重规划及长程分析。五项关键设计：(1) 知识增强的工作流规划，将攻击知识映射到流量特征以弥合语义鸿沟；(2) 构建150+经校验工具、来自50+已发表系统的综合工具动作空间；(3) 统一代码执行空间以灵活组合动作；(4) 三层记忆实现长期知识固化；(5) 沙箱与运行时修复保障可靠执行。
AI.result: 在9个主要基准上，NetAgent在几乎所有任务上优于全部基线（23个单任务与5个多任务）。对未见流量分布泛化显著更好（F1 90.04% vs. 单任务与多任务最佳基线的2.74%与3.04%）；在真实背景偏移下F1仅下降4.85点，而最佳基线分别下降74.88点与74.80点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，现有方法的高分多源自对数据集特定模式的过拟合，在真实网络环境中性能急剧退化；而NetAgent的智能体设计保持准确、可泛化且稳健，为多任务流量分析提供了新范式。

title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
comment: Published at COLM 2026. Project page: https://iii.baulab.info
summary: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控设定下发现，隐式决策任务的持续微调可自发涌现出准确自我报告；忠实自我报告伴随偏好表征向浅层迁移的结构变化，并可用决策与自我报告任务间的归因相似度作为机制性签名加以区分。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对自身的陈述既具后果性，又难以仅从行为上验证，如何区分看似合理的虚构（confabulation）与真正的内省成为关键问题。既有自我报告研究仅在行为层面观察到模型可能忠实或不忠实，缺乏对两种计算模式的机制性区分手段。
AI.method: 使用低秩适配器（LoRA）训练模型代表虚构角色，依据潜在线性偏好函数做决策；隐式决策任务持续微调，且不提供显式自我报告监督。通过权重消融与冻结层实验考察偏好表征的层级位置变化；使用归因修补（attribution patching）度量决策任务与自我报告任务之间的归因相似度。
AI.result: 隐式决策任务的持续微调可在无显式监督下涌现出对所学偏好的准确自我报告。权重消融与冻结层实验表明，随训练进行偏好表征向更早的层迁移，支持"忠实自我报告要求偏好位于既有言语化机制可访问之处"的假设。归因修补显示，忠实模型在决策与自我报告任务间的归因相似度显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 至少在本文受限设定下，忠实与不忠实的自我报告可通过网络结构本身加以区分，且该机制性签名无需理解报告内容即可判定；这为从计算结构而非仅行为层面识别真实内省提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

AI.tldr: 提出 SSRFT 框架，将安全对齐重构为"安全角色内化"，通过构建 SRQA 数据集实现更鲁棒、更泛化的安全对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）依赖大量攻击特定监督和算力，且存在浅层安全对齐与过度拒答问题，亟需一种不依赖显式拒答模式的对齐范式。
AI.method: SSRFT 从心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示和安全角色描述构建 Safe-Role QA（SRQA）数据集；合成角色一致的回答并进行验证与场景扩展，使模型内化安全价值与原则而非拒答模式。
AI.result: 在多种 Base 与 Instruct 模型上，SSRFT 比标准 SFT 获得更鲁棒、更可泛化的安全对齐；对 prefilling 攻击鲁棒性显著增强，对未见越狱领域泛化更好，同时降低对良性查询的过度拒答并保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 安全角色内化可作为以拒答为中心的安全对齐的有效替代方案。

title: Beyond Marginal Monitoring: Distributed Joint-Distribution Testing for Data Concept Drift in Large Scale E-Commerce Operations
summary: Concept drift threatens production machine learning, yet the empirical behavior of multivariate two-sample drift detectors at scale remains under-characterized. Existing benchmarks rarely address the hundreds of millions of rows and high-cardinality features typical of industrial-operational datasets. We evaluate five multi-column two-sample tests (marginal, projection-based, and kernel embedding methods) across three complementary environments: the Harvard Dataverse, a validated Failing Loudly reproduction (mean absolute error between 0.030 and 0.053), and a novel synthetic-injection benchmark on the 137.5-million-row Trendyol collection-ranking feature table. Testing four drift types across two severity-scope regimes, we demonstrate that distributed Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Random Fourier Features on Apache Spark scales robustly. Averaged over the four drift types in the strong regime and under a calibrated threshold, it achieves a Pearson correlation of r = 0.940 with expected drift magnitude, an 80.4% true positive rate, and a 3.2% false positive rate. Conversely, the per-dimension Kolmogorov-Smirnov test failed due to statistic saturation from ID-like columns under asymmetric sampling, establishing a critical constraint for large-scale sampling design. At weak configurations (realized-flip fractions of at most 0.57%), detectors struggled to reliably discriminate, highlighting the need for future intensity-grid power analyses to distinguish fundamental sensitivity bounds from scalable threshold shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了五种多变量双样本漂移检测器在超大规模工业数据上的表现，发现基于Spark的分布式RFF-MMD最为稳健，而逐维KS检验因统计量饱和而失效。
AI.motivation: 概念漂移威胁生产环境的机器学习，但现有基准很少覆盖数亿行、高基数特征的工业运行数据集，多变量双样本漂移检测器在该规模下的经验行为仍缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 在三个互补环境（Harvard Dataverse、经验证的 Failing Loudly 复现、以及在1.375亿行 Trendyol 数据集上的新型合成注入基准）中评测五类多列双样本检验方法（边际法、投影法与核嵌入法），覆盖四种漂移类型与两种严重程度范围设置。
AI.result: 分布式RFF-MMD在Apache Spark上可稳健扩展：在强漂移范围、校准阈值下，四种漂移类型平均达到与期望漂移强度的Pearson相关 r=0.940、真阳性率80.4%、假阳性率3.2%；逐维KS检验因ID类列在非对称采样下统计量饱和而失效；弱配置（实际翻转比例≤0.57%）下各检测器均难以可靠区分。复现实验的MAE介于0.030–0.053。
AI.conclusion: 大规模多变量漂移检测中，基于RFF-MMD的分布式实现是可行且稳健的方案；ID类列与采样偏差会使边际检验失效，构成大规模采样设计的关键约束；弱漂移强度下的敏感性边界尚需通过强度网格功效分析加以区分。

title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
summary: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: WiSPER：两阶段WiFi CSI多人3D姿态估计框架，用姿态感知掩码预测预训练加条件残差流精炼，MPJPE降至63.72 mm。
AI.motivation: WiFi CSI多人3D姿态估计中，不同人的反射信号重叠且无法直接对应到个体关节；现有掩码嵌入目标虽无需显式姿态监督即可建模无线关系，但结构化解码器仍会保留坐标误差。
AI.method: 提出WiSPER两阶段框架：第一阶段PAMEL（姿态感知掩码嵌入学习）在同一CSI上下文上耦合掩码隐变量预测与辅助姿态集合监督，引导编码器从部分观测进行关节定位；第二阶段ReFT（Transformer残差流精炼）生成一组姿态候选以适应可变人数，并借助粗坐标与逐关节解码器特征进行条件流精炼。训练使用成对CSI与姿态标注，推理仅需CSI。
AI.result: 在PiW3D数据集上总体平均逐关节位置误差为63.72 mm，相对WiFi-JEPA降低40.0%；两人和三人场景MPJPE分别降低42.1%和38.1%；姿态监督预训练配置误差低于纯CSI的JEPA；启用训练后的残差精炼器使总体MPJPE在各配置下降低13.8%–15.6%。
AI.conclusion: 姿态感知预训练与条件残差流精炼相结合可显著提升WiFi CSI多人3D姿态估计精度，且推理阶段无需姿态标注。

title: EVFormer: An Egocentric Vision-EMG Bidirectional Attention Model for Bimanual Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric bimanual hand pose estimation is important for virtual interaction, wearable control, and rehabilitation, but visual observations are often degraded by self-occlusion, hand-hand contact, and object manipulation. We propose EVFormer, a multimodal framework that combines the current RGB frame with the preceding 200 ms of bilateral wrist surface electromyography (sEMG) to estimate 44 finger and wrist joint angles. EVFormer separately encodes visual spatial features and sEMG temporal features, enables cross-modal information exchange through sequential bidirectional cross-attention, and integrates the two modalities using feature-wise gated fusion. We evaluate EVFormer in a single-participant feasibility study using one synchronized public EgoEMG recording with chronologically separated training, validation, and test splits. On 296 test samples, EVFormer achieves a mean absolute error of 11.482 degrees, compared with 13.228-13.610 degrees for vision-only, sEMG-only, late-fusion, and training-mean baselines. This corresponds to relative error reductions of 13.20% compared with the vision-only model and 14.23% compared with late fusion. EVFormer also achieves the lowest error in four of the five evaluated gesture classes. These results provide preliminary evidence that feature-level interaction between egocentric vision and sEMG can improve bimanual hand pose estimation. Further evaluation across participants, recording sessions, sensor placements, and real-world interaction conditions is required to establish the generalizability of the approach.

AI.tldr: EVFormer：融合RGB帧与前200ms双侧手腕sEMG，通过双向交叉注意力和门控融合估计44个手指/手腕关节角，MAE 11.482°优于单模态与后融合基线。
AI.motivation: 第一视角双手姿态估计对虚拟交互、可穿戴控制与康复很重要，但视觉观测常受自遮挡、手-手接触和物体操作的干扰而退化，单一视觉模态不足。
AI.method: EVFormer为多模态框架：输入当前RGB帧与之前200 ms的双侧手腕sEMG；分别编码视觉空间特征与sEMG时序特征；通过顺序双向交叉注意力进行跨模态信息交换；采用特征级门控融合（feature-wise gated fusion）整合两模态，回归44个手指与手腕关节角。
AI.result: 在单个公开EgoEMG同步录制（单人可行性研究，按时间划分训练/验证/测试）上，296个测试样本的MAE为11.482°，而仅视觉、仅sEMG、后融合及训练均值基线为13.228–13.610°；相较仅视觉降低13.20%，相较后融合降低14.23%；在五类手势中的四类取得最低误差。
AI.conclusion: 初步证明第一视角视觉与sEMG的特征级交互可提升双手姿态估计；方法泛化性仍需跨被试、跨录制会话、跨传感器位置及真实交互条件的进一步评估。

title: TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting
summary: Robotic haircutting requires controlled tool motion near the head while simultaneously accounting for communication, visual feedback, tool actuation, and interruption handling. Existing studies still lack an operator-in-the-loop reference for analyzing these coupled behaviors before human trials or stronger autonomy. This paper presents TeleHairing, a closed-loop teleoperation architecture for mannequin-based robotic haircutting evaluation under local, relay, and remote deployment conditions. Logged timing shows that the main remote latency increase occurs before the robot-side control endpoint: overall timing reached 190.5~ms in remote mode, while robot-side command queue, control processing, and control-to-robot timing remained similar across modes. Trajectory analysis shows that the larger remote command-following error was dominated by the terminal withdrawal segment rather than accumulated uniformly over the path; excluding this segment reduced remote root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 45.1 mm to 9.6 mm. Detection-loss trials further show that rebase events resumed motion without a large target jump under the tested condition. These results clarify how deployment, execution, and interruption affect the robotic haircutting teleoperation loop, providing a quantitative reference for future autonomy, safety, and user-facing studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TeleHairing——面向假人模型机器人理发评估的闭环遥操作架构，在本地、中继与远程三种部署条件下量化分析了时延、轨迹跟踪与中断处理特性。
AI.motivation: 机器人理发需在头部附近控制刀具运动，同时兼顾通信、视觉反馈、刀具驱动与中断处理。现有研究缺乏"操作者在环"的参考基准，难以在人体试验或更高自主性之前分析这些耦合行为。
AI.method: 构建闭环遥操作系统TeleHairing，基于假人模型开展理发评估；在本地、中继、远程三种部署模式下记录时序日志，进行轨迹跟踪误差分析，并开展检测丢失（detection-loss）试验考察重定位（rebase）事件后的运动连续性。
AI.result: 远程模式总时延达190.5 ms，主要时延增量发生在机器人侧控制端点之前；机器人侧命令队列、控制处理及控制到机器人时延在各模式间相近。远程命令跟踪误差主要由末端撤回段主导，剔除该段后远程RMSE由45.1 mm降至9.6 mm。检测丢失试验中，重定位事件恢复运动未出现大目标跳变。
AI.conclusion: 结果阐明了部署条件、执行过程与中断处理对机器人理发遥操作环路的影响，为未来自主性、安全性与用户研究提供了定量参考。

title: Lachesis: Lifetime-Aware KV Cache Placement for Agent Serving across HBM and High-Bandwidth Flash
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly dominated by agentic workloads, in which agents and their sub-agents accumulate context as KV cache across many requests, consuming substantial memory. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) is a promising solution, providing an order of magnitude greater capacity at HBM-class read bandwidth, but its finite write endurance is the key limiting factor. Our key insight is that KV cache should be placed across HBM and HBF by its lifetime. Placing shorter-lived data in HBM lets HBM absorb more of an agent run's writes and sends less of them to HBF. As the lifetime of KV cache in agentic serving is dictated by the harness, the program that orchestrates the agents, we analyze its behavior and identify three axes along which lifetime diverges, temporal, structural, and inter-worker. Guided by these observations, we present Lachesis, a lifetime-aware KV cache placement layer between the agent harness and the serving engine. At write time, it places each segment in HBM or HBF according to its lifetime, and frees its blocks once the segment is no longer read. In trace-driven simulation, Lachesis extends HBF lifetime by 1.19-3.13x over HBM-first placement, reaching 3.3-12.2 device-years. Even under continuous 24x7 operation at the full load a tight SLO admits, HBF outlasts its five-year warranty on the multi-agent trace.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lachesis，一种面向 agentic serving 的寿命感知 KV cache 放置层，依据片段生命周期将 KV cache 分配于 HBM 与 HBF，从而显著延长高带宽闪存（HBF）的写入寿命。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务日益以 agentic 工作负载为主，agent 及其子 agent 跨多个请求累积 KV cache，占用大量内存。HBF 能以 HBM 级读带宽提供约一个数量级的容量，但其有限的写入耐久度是关键瓶颈，因此需要减少写入 HBF 的数据量。
AI.method: 核心洞察是按生命周期将 KV cache 跨 HBM 与 HBF 放置：短生命周期数据放入 HBM，使 HBM 吸收 agent 运行的更多写入，减少送往 HBF 的写入。由于 agentic serving 中 KV cache 的生命周期由编排 agent 的 harness 决定，作者分析其行为并识别出生命周期分化的三个维度：时间（temporal）、结构（structural）和跨 worker（inter-worker）。基于此实现 Lachesis，位于 agent harness 与 serving engine 之间的寿命感知 KV cache 放置层：写入时按片段生命周期将其放入 HBM 或 HBF，并在片段不再被读取时释放其块。
AI.result: 在 trace 驱动仿真中，相比 HBM-first 放置，Lachesis 将 HBF 寿命延长 1.19-3.13 倍，达到 3.3-12.2 设备年（device-years）。即使在严格 SLO 允许的满载下 7×24 小时持续运行，在多 agent trace 上 HBF 仍能超过其五年保修期。
AI.conclusion: 按 KV cache 生命周期在 HBM 与 HBF 间进行放置，可有效缓解 HBF 写入耐久度限制；Lachesis 通过利用 agent harness 暴露的生命周期分化，显著提升 HBF 使用寿命，使其在真实负载下具备可行性。

title: Deep Defence on Wheels: A Dual Intrusion Detection System Architecture for Comprehensive In-Vehicle Network Security
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables, ACM Transactions on Embedded Computing Systems
summary: Increasing connectivity to the outside world and the lack of inbuilt security mechanisms have made legacy intra-vehicular networks vulnerable to cyberattacks. Initial research focused on maximising detection accuracy for known and unknown attacks, often using large, full-precision machine learning models. However, embedding IDSs into vehicular electronic systems also requires low detection latency, energy efficiency and minimal electronic control unit (ECU) resource overhead to process about 2,000 CAN frames/s. Lightweight models must balance accuracy with these deployment constraints. We propose a dual IDS framework comprising supervised and unsupervised learning-based solutions, each optimised for real-time, resource-constrained automotive platforms. A quantised LSTM-based IDS (QLSTM-IDS) achieves over 99.9% detection accuracy for DoS/Flooding, Fuzzing and Spoofing/Malfunction attacks using a single model architecture evaluated on two widely used datasets. The model is trained using the Brevitas quantisation-aware training library, transformed into a dataflow accelerator with custom blocks compatible with AMD's FINN toolchain, and synthesised using Vitis HLS. Complementing this, an 8-bit quantised convolutional autoencoder-based IDS (QCAE-IDS), quantised using AMD's Vitis-AI toolchain, detects previously unseen anomalies that alter CAN-ID sequence patterns with over 99% accuracy. An integration architecture enables both models to operate on a single FPGA, bridging the network interface IP and processing system to minimise software overhead. QLSTM-IDS achieves 0.25 ms inference latency and 0.8 mJ energy consumption per message, while QCAE-IDS achieves 0.42 ms and 1.1 mJ per block. Both solutions are deployed and evaluated on the ZCU104 SoC (XCZU7EV FPGA), demonstrating a flexible hardware/software co-design for real-time detection of known and unknown attacks on high-speed CAN buses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双IDS框架（监督式QLSTM-IDS与无监督式QCAE-IDS），针对车载CAN网络在资源受限FPGA上实现实时、低功耗、高精度的入侵检测，并可协同部署于单块FPGA。
AI.motivation: 车载网络对外连接增多且缺乏内建安全机制，易受网络攻击。已有研究多追求检测精度而采用大型全精度模型，但嵌入式IDS还需满足低延迟、低能耗与ECU资源开销约束（约2000帧/秒），因此需要轻量化模型在精度与部署约束间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出双IDS框架：1）监督式量化LSTM-IDS（QLSTM-IDS），用Brevitas量化感知训练库训练，转换为兼容AMD FINN工具链的数据流加速器，经Vitis HLS综合；2）无监督8-bit量化卷积自编码器IDS（QCAE-IDS），用Vitis-AI工具链量化，检测改变CAN-ID序列模式的未知异常；3）设计集成架构使两模型在单块FPGA上运行，桥接网络接口IP与处理系统以降低软件开销。
AI.result: QLSTM-IDS对DoS/Flooding、Fuzzing、Spoofing/Malfunction攻击检测精度超99.9%（单模型架构，两个数据集评估），推理延迟0.25 ms、每消息能耗0.8 mJ；QCAE-IDS对未见异常检测精度超99%，延迟0.42 ms、每块能耗1.1 mJ。二者均在ZCU104 SoC（XCZU7EV FPGA）上部署评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了面向高速CAN总线的软硬件协同设计，可在资源受限平台上实时检测已知与未知攻击，兼顾高精度、低延迟与低能耗。

title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
summary: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.

AI.tldr: TIDE 2.0：一套MIT许可、可在本地硬件运行的两阶段临床文本去标识引擎，将"识别"与"匿名化"解耦，采用密钥化加密生成代理值、按患者平移日期以保留时间间隔，并发布蒸馏自大模型的识别器TIDE2-Sentry；在两个机构金标注语料上，默认配置域内span级召回0.88、精度0.88，跨机构召回0.77、精度0.87。
AI.motivation: 临床笔记承载患者诊疗的大部分记录，但只有在去除受保护健康信息（PHI）后才能用于研究。仅把去标识当作"检测问题"并不充分：直接抹除会连同临床内容一起删除，日期置空会破坏纵向分析所需的时间间隔，而每次出现都分配新的随机代理值会切断同一患者笔记之间的关联。因此需要一种既能合规去标识、又能保留研究可用性与跨笔记可链接性的方案。
AI.method: 提出TIDE 2.0，由两个可分离阶段组成：可替换的识别器与密钥化匿名器，均运行在机构自有硬件上。代理值以密码学方式生成，不保存链接表；日期按每位患者的、保持区间的偏移量平移；在给定密钥下，同一取值在所有出现位置获得相同代理值；新密钥下产出的发布版本无法与先前发布版本关联。另发布识别器TIDE2-Sentry，由大语言模型蒸馏得到。在两个机构的金标注语料上评估，采用span级精度与召回，并按PHI类别分别汇报。
AI.result: 默认配置在两个机构金标注语料上达到span级召回：域内0.88，第二机构语料0.77；精度分别为0.88与0.87，并给出各PHI类别的召回与精度。
AI.conclusion: 去标识不应仅被当作检测问题；将互换式识别与密钥化匿名分离，可在不建链接表的前提下兼顾合规性、纵向时间间隔保留与同一患者笔记内的取值一致性。TIDE 2.0开源，识别器以受限研究使用协议提供，便于机构在自有环境中运行、审查与扩展。

title: Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking
summary: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"离线AI模块"工作流的端到端语音优先离线AI技术栈进行基准评测：在Jetson Orin NX与Raspberry Pi 5两种硬件上，评估3个2-5B指令微调模型、4种量化格式的解码速度、延迟、内存、功耗及多语言质量，结论为Q4_K_M量化在两级硬件上均实现最佳体积-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 面向非洲语言社区（语音为主要交互方式、网络不可靠或缺失）实现可落地、低功耗、社区可及的完全离线语音AI部署，需验证该离线技术栈在低成本硬件上的实际可行性与质量表现。
AI.method: 构建三个相互支撑的组件：模块化语音优先离线架构、低成本硬件参考物料清单（BOM）、面向2-5B参数指令微调模型的可复现量化与基准测试流水线。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX（TierB）与Raspberry Pi 5（TierA）上，对3个指令微调模型×4种量化格式进行评测；部署指标含解码吞吐、对话延迟、内存与功耗；多语言质量采用MasakhaNEWS主题分类准确率（英语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语、约鲁巴语）及逐语言困惑度漂移；语音识别采用Ethio-ASR在阿姆哈拉语与奥罗莫语上进行，覆盖两个硬件层级。
AI.result: Q4_K_M量化在两级硬件上均为最佳体积-质量权衡：TierB上gemma-4-E2B-it在Q4_K_M下达到28.8 tokens/s解码吞吐与89.2%主题分类准确率；TierA上三个模型均可在16GB内存预算内运行。
AI.conclusion: 该离线语音优先AI技术栈可在低功耗、社区可及的硬件上实用部署，Q4_K_M被推荐为2-5B指令微调模型在TierA/TierB两类硬件上的默认量化方案。

title: GPU Acceleration of Awkward Arrays: Using Python cuda.compute
summary:
Awkward Array is a widely used library in high-energy physics (HEP) for representing and manipulating nested, variable-length data in Python. Previous CHEP contributions have explored GPU acceleration for Awkward Array, demonstrating the feasibility and performance benefits of CUDA-based backend while also identifying limitations related to irregular data access, fine-grained kernel launches, and composability of operations. In this contribution, we present recent developments that build directly on these earlier efforts by introducing a CUDA execution model for Awkward Array based on the Python CUDA Core Compute Libraries (CCCL).
  Using CCCL, we eliminate the need for custom CUDA kernels and can instead use a high-level Python interface. The CCCL-based approach also enables fusion of multiple Awkward operations into a reduced number of CUDA kernels, addressing kernel launch overhead observed in earlier GPU implementations. Lazy execution allows expression graphs to be constructed and optimized prior to kernel generation, improving performance for analysis workflows involving jagged arrays, combinatorial operations, and reductions. In contrast to earlier approaches, this design also emphasizes extensibility, allowing user-defined Python code to be incorporated into GPU execution paths with minimal boilerplate and without breaking existing analysis semantics.
  We present performance studies that demonstrate improvements over previously reported eager GPU execution strategies for representative HEP analysis patterns. These developments extend the GPU capabilities of Awkward Array toward a more composable and sustainable backend, aligned with the needs of Python-based analysis at the HL-LHC and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 Python CUDA Core Compute Libraries（CCCL）为 Awkward Array 引入新的 CUDA 执行模型，通过惰性执行与算子融合消除自定义核函数需求，降低核启动开销并提升可扩展性，在典型 HEP 分析模式上优于此前的即时 GPU 执行方案。
AI.motivation: Awkward Array 是高能物理（HEP）中处理嵌套、变长数据的常用 Python 库。此前的 CHEP 工作已验证 CUDA 后端 GPU 加速的可行性与收益，但暴露出不规则数据访问、细粒度核函数启动以及算子可组合性不足等局限，本文旨在直接针对这些问题改进 GPU 后端。
AI.method: 采用基于 Python CCCL 的 CUDA 执行模型：借助其高层 Python 接口免除自定义 CUDA 核函数；通过算子融合将多个 Awkward 操作合并为更少的 CUDA 核以缓解核启动开销；引入惰性执行，先构建并优化表达式图再生成核；设计上强调可扩展性，允许以极少样板代码将用户自定义 Python 代码纳入 GPU 执行路径且不破坏既有分析语义。
AI.result: 面向代表性 HEP 分析模式的性能研究显示，该方案相较此前报道的即时（eager）GPU 执行策略取得性能提升，尤其在涉及 jagged 数组、组合操作与归约的分析工作流中表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动 Awkward Array 的 GPU 能力向更可组合、更可持续的后端演进，契合 HL-LHC 及未来阶段基于 Python 的数据分析需求。

title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
comment: The first three authors contributed equally, and their order was determined by drawing lots. Project Lead: Jiuming Liu. Corresponding Author: Ayush Tewari. Project page: https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/
summary: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 提出Artemis——一种基于几何、具有显式记忆共享的多智能体世界模型，通过显式重建3D世界地图与几何引导的扩散Transformer生成器，提升多视角一致性与背景动态建模能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型正从单智能体转向多智能体，但主流方法采用跨注意力实现隐式智能体通信，缺乏显式几何约束与统一3D状态，导致多视角一致性差、难以恢复视野外智能体；且多数方法假设静态背景，无法表征不受控的背景动态。
AI.method: 从多智能体观测中重建显式3D世界地图以约束统一3D状态；设计动作引导的几何注入模块，同时渲染分解的前景-背景控制图，并经GeoAdapter块注入扩散Transformer；GeoAdapter可区分非智能体的不受控动态，并以其自身多帧历史位置为条件提供一致运动线索；采用渐进式视频rollout中的关键帧渐进更新重建的3D世界地图；并构建来自CARLA模拟器的新数据集MA-CARLA。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在生成视频的视觉保真度和跨视角一致性方面优于现有方法；Artemis支持2D视频与3D点图维护的同步多模态rollout，可扩展至两个以上智能体及多相机场景。
AI.conclusion: Artemis通过显式3D世界地图与记忆共享，将几何约束引入多智能体世界模型，有效解决多视角一致性与非受控背景动态问题，具备良好的可扩展性与多模态生成能力。

title: Uncertainty in Representation Learning on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) methods represent entities and predicates in continuous vector spaces to infer missing knowledge. Despite strong benchmark performance, their predictions often lack principled reliability guarantees, limiting their use in high-stakes applications. Moreover, uncertainty arises throughout the KGE pipeline, from incomplete or probabilistic input knowledge to stochastic training and prediction. This thesis systematically investigates three sources of uncertainty in KGE: knowledge uncertainty, arising from incomplete, noisy, or probabilistic input knowledge; algorithmic uncertainty, induced by randomness in model training; and predictive uncertainty, concerning the reliability of model outputs. To address algorithmic uncertainty, the thesis demonstrates that models trained under identical settings can produce substantially different predictions and introduces a voting-based aggregation framework to mitigate this instability. To quantify predictive uncertainty, it adapts conformal prediction to KGE, constructing answer sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees and extending them to provide predicate-conditional reliability guarantees. To support reasoning under knowledge uncertainty, it develops statistically valid prediction intervals for confidence-scored triples and an embedding-based approach to approximate probabilistic reasoning over statistical ontologies with formal soundness guarantees. Together, these complementary, model-agnostic methods provide a practical and theoretically grounded approach to uncertainty in KGE, advancing beyond predictive accuracy toward reliable and uncertainty-aware knowledge graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本论文系统研究知识图谱嵌入中的三类不确定性——知识不确定性、算法不确定性与预测不确定性，并提出投票聚合、保形预测、统计有效预测区间与嵌入式概率推理等模型无关方法，为KGE提供可靠且具理论保障的不确定性感知推理。
AI.motivation: KGE方法虽在基准测试上表现优异，但其预测往往缺乏有原则的可靠性保证，限制了在高风险场景中的应用；此外，不确定性贯穿KGE全流程，包括输入知识的不完整或概率性、训练与预测的随机性等。
AI.method: 1）针对算法不确定性：通过实验表明相同设置下训练的模型会产生显著不同的预测，并引入基于投票的聚合框架以缓解不稳定；2）针对预测不确定性：将保形预测适配到KGE，构建具有无分布覆盖保证的答案集，并扩展为谓词条件可靠性保证；3）针对知识不确定性：为带置信度评分的三元组开发统计有效的预测区间，并提出基于嵌入的方法以形式化可靠性保证近似统计本体上的概率推理。
AI.result: 验证了模型训练不稳定性的存在并给出投票聚合缓解方案；实现了具无分布覆盖保证的答案集与谓词条件可靠性保证；构建了统计有效的预测区间，并实现了具形式可靠性保证的统计本体概率推理近似。
AI.conclusion: 这些互补、模型无关的方法为KGE中的不确定性提供了实用且具理论基础的解决途径，推动知识图谱推理从单纯追求预测精度迈向可靠且不确定性感知的推理。

title: AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation
summary: Deformable-object manipulation is essential for robotic tasks such as folding laundry and handling food, where robots must control shape changes as well as object motion. Predictive soft-body simulation supports these tasks by anticipating deformation under external interactions. However, spatial neighborhoods can misrepresent deformation dependencies, introducing local errors that accumulate over successive predictions. Models fitted to individual scenes must also accommodate changes in object geometry and manipulation conditions. In this work, we propose AIM, an Adaptive Interaction Modeling framework that treats real-to-sim soft-body simulation as a local-global interaction modeling problem. AIM uses motion history and geometry to adapt particle relations over current spatial neighbors and retained connections, while geometry-conditioned global communication coordinates object-wide responses. A unified kinematic control-point interface represents different manipulation configurations, and multi-step autoregressive supervision trains the model on its own predicted trajectories. Experiments on PhysTwin and PGND demonstrate improved motion accuracy and visual fidelity, with a 20.0% reduction in future-prediction tracking error relative to PhysTwin and a 22.8% reduction in mean long-horizon particle error across six object categories relative to PGND. The framework further supports transfer across actions, object instances, and scenes, including zero-shot transfer from robot interactions to human manipulation without target-domain dynamics fitting.

AI.tldr: 提出AIM框架，将真实到仿真的软体仿真建模为局部-全局交互问题，通过自适应粒子关系与几何条件全局通信提升可变形物体操作预测精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 可变形物体操作（如叠衣、处理食物）需同时控制形状变化与物体运动，依赖预测性软体仿真。但现有方法存在两问题：(1) 空间邻域无法准确表征形变依赖关系，导致局部误差在多步预测中累积；(2) 针对单一场景拟合的模型难以适应物体几何与操作条件的变化。
AI.method: AIM将real-to-sim软体仿真视为局部-全局交互建模问题：(a) 利用运动历史与几何信息，在现有空间邻居与保留连接之上自适应调整粒子关系；(b) 采用几何条件化的全局通信协调物体整体响应；(c) 设计统一运动学控制点接口表示不同操作配置；(d) 使用多步自回归监督，在模型自身预测轨迹上训练。
AI.result: 在PhysTwin与PGND数据集上，运动精度与视觉保真度均提升：相较PhysTwin，未来预测跟踪误差降低20.0%；相较PGND，在六类物体上长时域平均粒子误差降低22.8%。框架还支持跨动作、跨物体实例、跨场景迁移，包括无需目标域动力学拟合的从机器人交互到人类操作的零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: AIM通过自适应交互建模有效缓解局部误差累积与场景适配问题，在精度、长时域稳定性与跨域泛化上均优于基线，为可变形物体操作提供了可迁移的预测性软体仿真方案。

title: Trail: Scalable and Low-Cost Temporal TLB Prefetching via Page-Table-Embedded Deltas
summary: Address translation is a major bottleneck in data-intensive workloads. TLB prefetching can hide translation latency, but existing spatial prefetchers struggle with irregular accesses, while temporal prefetchers store address deltas in fixed-capacity hardware that cannot scale with application memory footprints. Our characterization of 200 translation-intensive workloads reveals that each virtual memory region has a small, recurring set of deltas, and over 94% of deltas fit in 18 signed bits. We introduce Trail, a temporal TLB prefetcher that stores deltas in unused bits of leaf page table entries (PTEs). When a region triggers a page table walk, Trail identifies the region that last triggered a walk from the same instruction and records their delta in that source region's PTE. When a later walk fetches the source region's PTE cache block, Trail retrieves its deltas without additional memory accesses and prefetches translations for likely destination regions into the TLBs and cache hierarchy. Storing multiple deltas per PTE cache block improves coverage, while using existing PTE bits allows metadata capacity to scale with the application's memory footprint without additional metadata storage. Across 200 workloads and 100 multiprogrammed mixes, Trail improves single-core (four-core) performance by 5.7% (11.5%) on average over a baseline without TLB prefetching, outperforming the best prior standalone TLB prefetcher by 1.7% (2.5%). Trail requires only a 64-entry hardware table to track per-instruction page table walk history. Trail is freely available at https://github.com/CMU-SAFARI/Virtuoso/tree/trail-artifact-release.

AI.tldr: Trail 是一种时序 TLB 预取器，将地址增量存储在叶子页表项（PTE）的未用位中，随应用内存足迹扩展元数据容量，在 200 个负载上平均提升单核 5.7%、四核 11.5%。
AI.motivation: 地址翻译是数据密集型负载的主要瓶颈，TLB 预取可隐藏翻译延迟，但现有空间预取器难以处理不规则访问，时序预取器受限于固定容量的硬件增量存储，无法随应用内存足迹扩展。
AI.method: 对 200 个翻译密集型负载进行特征分析，发现每个虚拟内存区域具有小而重复出现的增量集合，且超过 94% 的增量可用 18 位有符号数表示。Trail 将增量存储在叶子 PTE 的未用位中：当某区域触发页表遍历时，识别同一指令上次触发遍历的区域并在源区域 PTE 中记录二者增量；后续访问取到源区域 PTE 缓存块时即可无额外访存地取回增量，并向 TLB 与缓存层级预取目的区域的翻译。每个 PTE 缓存块存储多个增量以提升覆盖率，仅需 64 项硬件表跟踪每指令的页表遍历历史。
AI.result: 在 200 个负载与 100 个多程序混合负载上，相比无 TLB 预取的基线，Trail 平均提升单核性能 5.7%、四核性能 11.5%，优于最佳已有独立 TLB 预取器 1.7%（2.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 利用 PTE 中未用位存储时序增量，可在不增加元数据存储的前提下使容量随应用内存足迹扩展，有效缓解地址翻译瓶颈，且硬件开销极低。

title: Understanding and Enhancing Backdoor Persistency in LLM Agent Post-Training
summary: Developers can build LLM agents by adapting third-party models through benign post-training. We study a supply-chain threat in which an attacker supplies a model with a backdoor: hidden behavior that produces malicious outputs when a particular input pattern appears. Focusing on software-engineering agents, we ask whether such backdoors survive the developer's supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and subsequent task-level reinforcement learning (RL). We observe that benign SFT substantially reduces attack success, but subsequent RL often preserves the residual behavior and sometimes even increases attack success. Our analysis of backdoor erosion during SFT identifies two factors that may favor survival: initial backdoor strength and gradient compatibility with benign training. These factors motivate PersistBD, which refines an already-backdoored model before release to improve its persistency through the benign post-training process. On Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, PersistBD raises attack success from 20% to 74% after SFT and from 20% to 76% after SFT-RL, while maintaining comparable benign task performance. Together, our results show that backdoors can remain active through benign post-training and that adversaries can deliberately increase their persistence. This highlights a supply-chain risk for AI developers and motivates stronger techniques for detecting and mitigating inherited backdoors when adapting third-party models into agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/uiuc-kang-lab/PersistBD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示LLM智能体供应链后门威胁：第三方模型植入的后门经开发者良性SFT与任务级RL后仍可存活，并提出PersistBD提升后门持久性。
AI.motivation: 开发者常通过良性后训练适配第三方模型构建LLM智能体，但第三方模型可能自带后门（特定输入触发恶意输出）。作者关注此类后门能否在开发者自身的SFT与任务级RL中存活，以评估供应链风险。
AI.method: 以软件工程智能体为场景，在Qwen2.5-Coder-7B上进行后门植入-良性SFT-RL的流程实验；分析SFT中后门侵蚀的两个影响因素（初始后门强度、与良性训练的梯度兼容性）；据此提出PersistBD，在模型发布前对已植入后门的模型进行精炼，以增强其穿透良性后训练的能力。
AI.result: 良性SFT显著降低攻击成功率，但后续RL常保留残余后门行为，有时甚至提升攻击成功率；PersistBD将SFT后攻击成功率从20%提升至74%，SFT-RL后从20%提升至76%，同时良性任务性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 后门可在良性后训练中保持活跃，且攻击者可主动提高其持久性，构成AI开发者的供应链风险；需加强检测与缓解第三方模型继承后门的技术。

title: Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis
summary: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.

AI.tldr: Kurate 利用大语言模型，结合论文及其关联文档（试验注册、方案等），对 4,347 篇论文（含 3,913 项随机试验）从 8 个研究设计与报告维度进行证据质量评估，并将每个判断链接到具体文本证据；与专家标注对比显示较高一致性，证明大规模质量评估可行。
AI.motivation: 现有科学检索系统只能找到与问题相关的论文，但一般无法评估这些论文所提供证据的质量，缺乏对研究设计、报告规范性等质量维度的自动化、可追溯评判手段。
AI.method: 提出 Kurate 系统，使用大语言模型同时分析论文及其相关文档（如试验注册与方案），对每篇论文在 8 个维度上打分：统计功效、因果识别、预注册、选择性报告、测量效度、分析预设、报告透明度、利益冲突与资助；每个判断均链接到其依据的文本段落。将系统应用于 4,347 篇论文语料（其中 3,913 篇报告随机试验），并与 60 份留出临床试验文档的专家标注进行对比验证。
AI.result: 语料中论文最常在统计功效、选择性报告和分析预设方面存在问题，平均质量在不同临床领域间存在差异。与专家标注对比，Kurate 提取信息在 221/242 个方案评分点（AC1=0.94）和 294/370 个结果发表评分点（AC1=0.81）上与专家标签一致。以一项高质量临床试验为示例，展示了单篇论文总体评级如何分解为多个判断，且每个判断均链接到其注册、方案和已发表报告中的具体证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，这种大规模证据质量评估是可行的，并可用于回答元科学研究问题。

title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

AI.tldr: JIVEAdapter是一种多任务加性低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的Joint结构与任务特有的Individual结构，并施加近正交惩罚与自适应秩分配，实现共享与特定信号的可解释分离。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩适配器多为单任务且以乘性方式表示权重更新，缺乏对跨任务共享信息与任务特有信息的显式刻画。
AI.method: 受统计中JIVE方法启发，将每个权重更新分解为全体任务共享的Joint结构与各任务Individual结构；惩罚Individual与Joint近正交以保持可解释性；在共享Joint池与任务Individual池间自适应分配秩；Joint可联合学习或逐任务增量学习后冻结，作为新任务先验复用。
AI.result: 在DeBERTaV3-base上的GLUE与SuperGLUE任务中，在匹配每任务有效秩条件下，性能与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需MoE等额外模块；当存在相关held-in任务时，冻结的Joint可通过复用该任务的Individual（仅需廉价的逐方向缩放）服务于held-out任务，否则训练一个小的新Individual。
AI.conclusion: JIVEAdapter以加性分解方式显式分离共享与任务特有信号，兼具参数效率与可解释性，并支持共享部分的冻结复用与高效迁移。

title: DySCo: Dynamic Sharding for Collaborative Edge-Cloud LLM Inference with Depth-Synchronized Batching
summary: Pervasive intelligent applications are increasingly deployed on mobile and Internet of Things (IoT) edge devices. Consequently, Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support these applications. Yet, due to their high resource demands, LLMs are mostly deployed in the cloud. Layer-wise edge-cloud inference lets resource-constrained edge devices contribute computation to LLMs they cannot host in full. However, heterogeneous split points introduce two coupled inefficiencies. First, edge execution and communication create idle gaps between cloud invocations. Second, requests arriving at different model depths cannot be conventionally batched. We present DySCo, a collaborative runtime that keeps KV caches local and introduces dyForward, a model-aware layer-range executor that runs configurable contiguous layer ranges from resident model shards without reloading weights. For multi-edge serving settings, we introduce depth-synchronized batching (DSB), which advances heterogeneous requests to the deepest cut and batches their common suffix. Experiments across heterogeneous devices, two model families, and local and wide-area links show that idle gaps increase the latency of subsequent GPU forward calls even when waiting time is excluded, adding up to 25 ms of additional cloud-side suffix latency per decoding step in our measurements. At an average concurrency of eight, DSB improves throughput by 275% over FIFO, 48% over exact-match batching, and 79% over round-robin interleaving while reducing mean per-session latency. Together, these results show that requests with different edge-cloud splits can reuse resident cloud weights and share batched suffix computation. The artifact repository for this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/Large-scale-Sustainable-Computing-LSC/dysco-artifact

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DySCo协同运行时系统，通过本地KV缓存、模型感知的分层执行器dyForward和深度同步批处理（DSB），解决分层边缘-云LLM推理中的空闲间隙与批处理难题，显著提升吞吐并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: LLM资源需求高，多部署于云端；分层边缘-云推理允许资源受限的边缘设备参与计算。但异构切分点带来两个耦合的低效问题：(1) 边缘执行与通信在云调用之间产生空闲间隙；(2) 到达不同模型深度的请求无法按常规方式批处理。
AI.method: 提出DySCo协同运行时：保持KV缓存本地化，并引入dyForward——一种模型感知的分层范围执行器，可在不重新加载权重的情况下从常驻模型分片运行可配置的连续层范围。针对多边缘服务场景，提出深度同步批处理（DSB）：将异构请求推进到最深的切分点，并对其公共后缀进行批处理。
AI.result: 在异构设备、两个模型家族及局域网与广域链路实验中，空闲间隙会增加后续GPU前向调用的延迟（即使排除等待时间），测量中每解码步最多增加25ms的云侧后缀延迟。在平均并发度为8时，DSB相比FIFO吞吐提升275%，相比精确匹配批处理提升48%，相比轮询交替提升79%，同时降低平均每会话延迟。
AI.conclusion: 具有不同边缘-云切分点的请求能够复用常驻云权重并共享批处理后缀计算。工件仓库已公开：https://github.com/Large-scale-Sustainable-Computing-LSC/dysco-artifact

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
summary: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了巴基斯坦旁遮普省的作物产量预测原型（RF、XGBoost、SVR、Ridge堆叠集成 + MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器 + SHAP解释的Web应用），通过数据审计发现高精度源于重复行导致的数据泄漏，去重后与FAOSTAT长表上均显示简单线性趋势优于所有机器学习模型，且叶片健康特征无增益，报告了这些负面发现。
AI.motivation: 产量预测对农资投入、仓储和进口决策有价值，但小型农业表格在新季节上往往无法复现所报告的高精度，作者意在检验此类“高精度”结论是否稳健可信。
AI.method: 以合并的Kaggle衍生表（414行）为基础，采用Random Forest、XGBoost、支持向量回归及Ridge堆叠集成，并搭配MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，部署为带SHAP解释的Web应用；进一步通过数据审计、按整年留出（leave-one-year-out）、去重、FAOSTAT长表（1990–2024，70个观测）以及独立县级小麦面板（36个县、13季）进行验证。
AI.result: 随机80/20划分下集成模型R2达0.991，但审计显示表内仅46个独立观测（因每年9条温度记录连接使每个作物-年份重复9次）；按整年留出时XGBoost在同一行上R2从0.994降至-0.20。去重后及FAOSTAT长表上，每作物线性趋势（留一年RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha）优于所有未提供年份信息的模型（0.84–1.06）。农药使用与全国温度变化均无法解释趋势残差；Kaggle表中的农药增益在FAOSTAT上消失（该序列多为插补且两版本不一致）。县级小麦面板显示旁遮普大部分变异为空间性，县均值加共同趋势即可匹敌学习模型。叶片分类器在留出PlantVillage图像上准确率99.87%，在去除近重复后对336张未见病叶召回96.4%，但无叶片图像与产量记录配对，健康评分系人为构造且无增益。
AI.conclusion: 小型农业表格上的极高R2多由重复观测造成的数据泄漏所致；在去重与更长、更可靠的序列上，简单线性趋势与空间均值基线即可匹敌复杂机器学习模型，叶片健康特征亦无贡献。作者将负面发现与原型一并报告，提示应重视数据独立性与基线对照。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Unsupervised Monitoring of Transmission Systems Using End-of-Line Testing Data: A Case Study at Ford Motor Company
summary: Sensing technologies have advanced rapidly across industries ranging from energy to automotive manufacturing. These systems generate high-dimensional (HD) data characterized by complex nonlinear patterns and strong temporal dependencies. Traditional statistical monitoring methods are often limited in their ability to capture such nonlinear structure. Likewise, many analytical approaches used in End-of-Line testing rely on predefined thresholds and heuristic rules, which restrict their ability to detect informative anomaly signatures in HD temporal data. In contrast, while modern deep learning and generative AI models offer strong predictive capabilities, they are often unsuitable in applications where data are costly to collect and where the monitoring system must remain interpretable, low-latency, computationally efficient, and usable by non-technical practitioners. To overcome these limitations, we propose an advanced multivariate monitoring framework for HD data. The framework operates in two stages. In the first stage, the data are preprocessed to remove incomplete and non-informative samples and to temporally align time series data. In the second stage, nonlinear dimensionality reduction is performed, followed by anomaly detection through a control chart based phase I monitoring procedure. The framework can be used in both unsupervised and supervised settings, depending on the availability of ground truth labels during training. Moreover, its flexible and modular structure allows practitioners to adapt its components to different domains and operational requirements. We evaluate the proposed framework on real production data from an automotive manufacturing environment at Ford Motor Company. The proposed method achieves higher accuracy, recall, and F1 score than the company's existing model, improving these metrics from 0.50, 0.30, and 0.429 to 0.625, 1.00, and 0.769, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向高维时间序列数据的两阶段多元监控框架：先进行数据预处理与时间对齐，再进行非线性降维并基于控制图进行Phase I异常检测，支持有监督/无监督两种模式，并在福特汽车真实产线数据上验证优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 传感技术在各行业（能源、汽车制造等）快速发展，产生的高维数据具有复杂非线性模式和强时间依赖性。传统统计监控方法难以捕捉非线性结构；终端测试（End-of-Line）中常用方法依赖预设阈值和启发式规则，难以识别高维时序数据中的有效异常特征。而现代深度学习和生成式AI虽预测能力强，但在数据采集成本高、且要求可解释、低延迟、计算高效、便于非技术人员使用的场景中并不适用。
AI.method: 提出一种面向高维数据的先进多元监控框架，分两阶段：第一阶段对数据预处理，剔除不完整及无信息样本，并对时间序列进行时间对齐；第二阶段进行非线性降维，随后通过控制图进行Phase I监控的异常检测。该框架可根据训练时是否有真实标签，在无监督与有监督两种设置下使用；其模块化灵活结构允许从业者针对不同领域和运行需求调整各组件。在福特汽车公司真实汽车制造生产数据上进行评估。
AI.result: 在福特汽车真实生产数据上，所提方法在准确率、召回率和F1分数上均优于公司现有模型，分别从0.50、0.30、0.429提升至0.625、1.00、0.769。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段模块化多元监控框架在高维时序异常检测中兼顾了非线性建模能力与可解释性、低延迟、计算效率及易用性，适配工业实际需求，并在真实汽车制造场景中显著超越现有方法，具有较好的可推广性和领域适应性。

title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
summary: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RoboCap——一个250克、六摄像头、双IMU的可穿戴帽子硬件，以及Grounded API——一套与设备无关的3D算法套件，用于大规模采集野外第一人称（ego-centric）操作数据，并在公开基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 第一人称操作数据对扩展机器人学习具有潜力，但目前数据稀缺。大规模采集需要将符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级精度的3D算法垂直整合，而这一精度此前尚无公开验证的成果。该工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 硬件方面，设计RoboCap：重量250克、配备六个摄像头与双IMU的可穿戴帽子，支持野外第一人称数据采集。算法方面，提出Grounded API：一套与设备无关的3D算法套件，并针对RoboCap进行了调优。核心在于硬件、标定与3D算法的协同设计。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上达到当前最优性能：在多种场景与设备配置下取得领先的SLAM效果；在第一人称场景下取得领先的深度估计效果；在适配到第三方设备时取得领先的手部跟踪效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件、标定与3D算法的垂直整合，RoboCap与Grounded API实现了此前未被公开验证的厘米级精度，为大规模野外第一人称操作数据采集提供了可行方案，并验证了其跨设备泛化能力。

title: X-OPM: Explainable Automatic Digital On-Chip Power Modeling for Enhanced Robustness
summary: Proactive power management systems reduce processor dynamic power through runtime power prediction and power-aware scheduling. Accurate, stable and low-overhead digital on-chip power meters (OPMs) are crucial for improving the prediction quality. Recent studies have explored various modeling methods, including using linear models, decision trees, and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to construct OPMs. However, most current approaches train models end-to-end without analyzing the physical interpretability of features, affecting their ability to generalize to unseen workloads. Grounded in the design principles of synchronous digital VLSI circuits, X-OPM introduces a robust feature engineering framework that uses tree-based models to capture feature interactions and linear models for prediction. It also incorporates a human-in-the-loop workflow to balance model accuracy against modeling effort. Evaluated on a commercial C906 vector processor, X-OPM consistently achieves $R^2 > 0.93$ across all workloads with sampling window size set below $8$ cycles. In contrast, state-of-the-art methods including APOLLO, COBIT, and standard MLPs fail to generalize across all test cases. Layout with commercial EDA tools shows that X-OPM incurs an area overhead below $0.1\%$, which is on par with lightweight tree-based and linear models, and significantly smaller than MLP-based models.

AI.tldr: X-OPM提出一个基于同步数字VLSI电路设计原则的鲁棒特征工程框架，采用树模型捕捉特征交互、线性模型做预测，并加入人在回路工作流，在C906向量处理器上实现采样窗口小于8周期时所有工作负载 $R^2>0.93$，面积开销低于 $0.1\%$。
AI.motivation: 主动功耗管理系统依赖运行时功耗预测与功耗感知调度来降低处理器动态功耗，而精确、稳定、低开销的数字片上功耗计（OPM）是提升预测质量的关键。现有方法（线性模型、决策树、多层感知机等）多采用端到端训练，缺乏对特征物理可解释性的分析，导致对未见工作负载的泛化能力不足。
AI.method: X-OPM基于同步数字VLSI电路的设计原理，构建鲁棒的特征工程框架：使用树模型捕捉特征交互，使用线性模型进行预测；同时引入人在回路（human-in-the-loop）工作流，在模型精度与建模工作量之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在商用C906向量处理器上评估，采样窗口小于8周期时，X-OPM在所有工作负载上均达到 $R^2>0.93$；而APOLLO、COBIT及标准MLP等最先进方法在所有测试用例中均无法泛化。使用商用EDA工具进行布局，X-OPM面积开销低于 $0.1\%$，与轻量级树模型和线性模型相当，且显著小于基于MLP的模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入物理可解释的特征工程与人在回路工作流，X-OPM在保持低面积开销的同时，显著提升了片上功耗计在跨工作负载场景下的泛化能力与预测精度。

title: BVI: Lightweight, Data-Centric Blockchain-Based Verification of Identity Claims
summary: A person who answers an unexpected call claiming to come from a bank has no way to check the claim. Australian text messaging has labelled a message as unverified when the sender identifier is not registered since 1 July 2026, but a voice call still arrives with nothing behind it, and voice cloning has removed the last cue recipients relied on. We present BVI, which answers one question for the recipient: did the calling party prove it holds a credential a registered organisation issued for this call? BVI keeps the organisational record, its authorised channels and its revocation state on a public ledger in a directly queryable form, and puts all decision logic in the handset, which performs eleven checks, pays no transaction fee and holds no full-chain state. We define ten attack classes plus the case in which revocation cannot be resolved, compare them in a 10-by-4 coverage matrix spanning BBCA, the content digest, the detector and composed BVI, and run 27 automated scenario tests against isolated Hardhat fixture states of the BVI contract; all 27 pass. For media substitution and synthetic speech, the contract tests validate commitment and gating properties rather than claiming detector accuracy. The mandatory per-session anchor costs about 91.5k gas and is invariant in call duration and hop count; each participating intermediary additionally contributes one optional attestation write. In a 20,000-session-per-cell path simulation, at one quarter carrier participation BVI detects 20.6 per cent of randomly located in-path rewrites versus 0.1 per cent for the every-hop comparison, while identity and content evidence remain available even when path evidence is indeterminate. We also quantify the throughput ceiling of the anchoring design.

AI.tldr: BVI是一种面向语音来电的凭证验证方案：将注册组织的授权渠道与撤销状态以可直接查询的形式存于公共账本，全部判定逻辑放在手机端，通过十一项检查判断主叫方是否持有该组织为本次通话签发的凭证。
AI.motivation: 电信场景中，接听自称来自银行的陌生来电者无从核验其身份；澳大利亚自2026年7月1日起对未注册发送方标识的短信标注为"未验证"，但语音呼叫仍缺乏任何可核验依据，且语音克隆已消除了接收者过去依赖的最后线索（声音特征）。Author需要一种能回答"主叫方是否证明了其持有某注册组织为本次呼叫签发的凭证"的机制。
AI.method: 方案将组织记录、授权渠道及撤销状态以可查询形式置于公共账本，判定逻辑全部置于手机端（执行11项检查，不付交易费、不保存全链状态）。定义10类攻击及撤销不可解析的情形，构建10×4覆盖矩阵（BBCA、内容摘要、检测器、组合BVI），针对BVI合约的隔离Hardhat固定状态运行27项自动化场景测试。指标上测量每会话锚定的gas开销，并对20,000会话/蜂窝的路径仿真评估检测率与吞吐上限。
AI.result: 27项场景测试全部通过；对媒体替换与合成语音，合约测试验证的是承诺与门控性质而非检测器精度。每会话强制锚定约91.5k gas，且不随通话时长与跳数变化，每个参与中间节点额外贡献一次可选证明写入。在20,000会话/蜂窝的路径仿真中，四分之一运营商参与率下BVI对随机位置路径内改写的检测率为20.6%，而逐跳比对仅0.1%；即使路径证据不确定，身份与内容证据仍可用。
AI.conclusion: BVI以链上可查询的组织凭证记录与端上判定逻辑，为语音来电提供可验证的凭证持有证明，在低运营商参与率下仍显著优于逐跳比对，且锚定成本与通话时长、跳数无关；同时论文量化了锚定设计的吞吐上限。

title: Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"洞见溯源"任务，构建InsightProv-v0数据集，识别评审洞见源自人类、LLM或混合贡献，并提出两阶段对抗框架去除捷径信号，揭示了洞见来源的深层可识别特征。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM日益参与科学写作和同行评审，仅检测"谁写了文本"已不足够，还需判断"谁贡献了底层洞见"。现有文本作者归属方法可能依赖语言与文本作者身份捷径，导致原始数据上的高性能具有误导性。
AI.method: 构建InsightProv-v0数据集：源自4,057篇科学论文与12,660条人类评审，使用GPT-4o、Gemini、DeepSeek模拟不同LLM参与程度，并进行句子级来源标注。提出两阶段对抗框架，抑制捷径信号同时保留与溯源相关的信息。
AI.result: 模型在原始数据上表现强劲，但在逐步去偏的评估下性能显著下降，说明其依赖捷径信号。分析表明：论文依据与邻近评审上下文提供互补的溯源信号；人类、混合与AI洞见在信息来源与失败模式上存在系统性差异。AI洞见多接近通用或论文已提供的信息，人类洞见则更多引入外部知识与独立判断。
AI.conclusion: 措辞可被LLM改写，但思想的来源留下更深层、更持久的信号，表明洞见溯源具有内在可识别性。

title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
summary: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出两种闭式投影算子（链间范德华投影与配体距离几何投影），在推理阶段作用于扩散模型去噪后的清洁坐标估计，使AF3式共折叠模型在不重训练、不增加采样开销的情况下恢复物理有效性，同时保持结构精度。
AI.motivation: AlphaFold 3式共折叠模型虽结构精度高，但大量输出物理无效：界面链重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性中心反转。现有方案要么用物理势引导采样器（成倍增加采样成本与显存，大复合物无法推理），要么微调模型（耗时且与特定架构绑定）。作者观察到物理有效性不同于结构精度，可在推理时从采样器已有量中完全验证。
AI.method: 将物理有效性建模为约束推理问题，引入两个作用于扩散模型去噪后清洁坐标估计 x̂0 的闭式投影算子：一是链间范德华投影，推开冲突最严重的原子对；二是配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子均为局部、稀疏、带位移上限，无需网络前向、梯度或重要性采样，不修改去噪器及其权重，可即插即用于任意AF3式采样器。
AI.result: 在Boltz-2与OpenFold-3两个独立模型上，跨五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体与复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集）验证：恢复完美物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时与显存开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为通用、模型无关的物理有效全原子结构预测提供了实用路径，无需重训练即可嵌入任意AF3式采样流程。

title: vTen: Tensor-Centric Verification Framework for Domain-Specific Accelerators
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC '26), Long Beach, CA, USA
summary: The semantic gap between tensor-centric software models and signal-level hardware testbenches creates significant productivity bottlenecks in verifying Domain-Specific Accelerators (DSAs). Existing frameworks like Cocotb suffer from prohibitive synchronization overheads due to fine-grained interactions. To address this, we propose vTen, a data-centric framework that strictly decouples verification intent from execution mechanics. By leveraging a declarative DSL and kernel-granular batching, vTen minimizes host-simulator interaction frequency. Evaluation on a production-scale 3D U-Net accelerator demonstrates that vTen achieves a 2x performance improvement in simulation latency and a 60.3% reduction in code complexity compared to Cocotb.

AI.tldr: 提出vTen，一种数据中心验证框架，通过声明式DSL与kernel粒度批处理解耦验证意图与执行机制，降低主机-仿真器交互频率，在3D U-Net加速器上较Cocotb仿真延迟降低2倍、代码复杂度降低60.3%。
AI.motivation: 张量中心（tensor-centric）的软件模型与信号级（signal-level）硬件testbench之间存在语义鸿沟，导致DSA验证效率低下；现有框架（如Cocotb）因细粒度交互产生大量同步开销，形成生产力瓶颈。
AI.method: vTen采用数据中心（data-centric）设计，严格解耦验证意图（verification intent）与执行机制（execution mechanics）；借助声明式领域特定语言（DSL）和kernel粒度批处理（kernel-granular batching）最小化主机与仿真器的交互频率。
AI.result: 在生产规模（production-scale）3D U-Net加速器上评估，vTen相比Cocotb实现仿真延迟2倍性能提升，代码复杂度降低60.3%。
AI.conclusion: vTen通过解耦验证意图与执行机制并批量化交互，有效缓解DSA验证中的同步开销瓶颈，同时提升仿真性能并显著降低代码复杂度，验证了数据中心框架在DSA验证中的有效性。

title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
summary: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy.
