Using two EU-funded SME-facing GRC platforms, CYBERFORT and CYBER-BRIDGE, as examples, we (i) describe the amplification mechanism in concrete data-model terms, (ii) propose a six-dimension scoring framework for evaluating any GRC tool's exposure to the effect, (iii) instantiate the framework on a thirteen-tool comparison covering enterprise IRM, mid-market platforms, compliance-automation tools, and the two EU SME projects, and (iv) outline a measurement protocol that a consortium with access to production self-assessment data can run. The thirteen-tool comparison is a structured design assessment, not an empirical measurement of user behaviour. The EU SME platforms score lowest on the amplifier dimensions because their burden-reduction design deliberately trades sign-off granularity for throughput; we report this as a design trade-off, not a verdict on the platforms. Our contribution is the framing and the measurement protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"放大器效应"概念:多框架GRC平台通过跨框架控制映射、AI问题关联与答案自动传播,会把单次乐观作答或形式化签署静默复制为跨框架的多项合规证据。作者以CYBERFORT和CYBER-BRIDGE为例描述该机制,提出六维评分框架,对13款工具作设计性评估,并给出测量协议。
AI.motivation: 多框架GRC平台为减轻中小企业在EU CRA、NIS2、GDPR下的重复合规负担,广泛采用跨框架控制映射、AI建议的问题关联以及答案与证据的自动传播。这些机制在提升效率的同时,会把单一人为偏见(一处乐观评级、一次形式化签署、一份AI起草答案)放大为多框架、多义务的合规证据。作者认为这是平台设计属性(粗粒度签署、无门槛传播)而非个体用户失误,但现有研究缺乏对该风险的界定与评估手段。
AI.method: 1) 以具体数据模型术语刻画"放大器效应"的放大机制;2) 提出六维评分框架,用于评估任一GRC工具对该效应的暴露程度;3) 在覆盖企业级IRM、中端平台、合规自动化工具及两个EU中小企业项目共13款工具上实例化该框架,进行结构化设计评估;4) 设计一套需生产环境自评数据访问权限的联盟方可执行的测量协议。
AI.result: 13款工具对比显示,两个EU中小企业平台在放大器维度上得分最低,原因在于其减负设计有意以签署粒度换取处理吞吐量。作者强调这是设计权衡的呈现而非对平台的定论。需要说明的是,该13款工具对比属结构化设计评估,并非对用户行为的实证测量。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献在于"放大器效应"这一概念框架及配套测量协议,而非实证结论。研究提示GRC平台设计者与采购方需在效率与签署粒度之间权衡,并通过六维评分识别暴露风险,后续可由具备生产数据的联盟开展实证测量。

title: Detecting LLM-Assisted Vietnamese Writing via Keystrokes under Behavioral Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Thanh Dong and An Ngo contributted equally. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: We study the robustness of keystroke dynamics for detecting large language model (LLM)-assisted writing. We introduce a Vietnamese keystroke dataset capturing realistic writing modes, including bona fide composition, transcription, and paraphrasing. We also define a behaviorally grounded threat model in which users deliberately alter typing patterns. To implement the threat model, we create behaviorally manipulated variants of the data designed to evade keystroke-based detection. We evaluate four keystroke modeling approaches: temporal and rhythmic representations, and sequential representations modeled with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and TypeNet, under user-independent and context-independent settings. The results show that sequential models outperform feature-based approaches in most cases and that keystroke signals encode discriminative information about the writing process. However, detection is not uniformly robust: transcription is reliably identified, while paraphrasing and adversarially manipulated samples are frequently misclassified as bona fide when not explicitly modeled. To address this, we incorporate adversarial training using behaviorally manipulated data, which substantially improves separability and robustness. These results suggest that keystroke-based detection depends critically on exposure to diverse writing behaviors, and that strong performance under limited conditions does not generalize to realistic or adversarial settings without targeted modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究击键动力学在检测LLM辅助写作中的鲁棒性，构建越南语击键数据集并定义行为威胁模型，比较四类建模方法后发现顺序模型整体更优，但转述与对抗操纵样本易被误判，引入对抗训练可显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM辅助写作的普及，需要可靠的检测手段，而击键动力学作为行为特征具有潜力；然而在真实写作模式（原创、转录、转述）及用户故意改变打字模式的情形下，其鲁棒性尚不明确，缺乏相应数据集与威胁模型。
AI.method: 构建包含真实写作模式的越南语击键数据集；定义行为化的威胁模型，并据此生成行为操纵的对抗变体；评估四类击键建模方法：时间与节奏特征表示、以及用1D-CNN和TypeNet建模的顺序表示，在用户无关和上下文无关设置下进行实验；并采用基于行为操纵数据的对抗训练。
AI.result: 顺序模型在多数情况下优于基于特征的方法，表明击键信号携带写作过程的判别信息；但检测鲁棒性不均衡：转录可被可靠识别，转述和对抗操纵样本在未显式建模时大量被误判为原创；引入对抗训练后，可分性与鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于击键的检测关键依赖于对多样写作行为的覆盖；在有限条件下取得的高性能若缺乏针对性建模，难以泛化到真实或对抗场景。

title: SPECTRUM: Proximal Spectral Modulation for Looped Self-Distillation
summary: A model that learns from its own outputs inherits more than their correctness: it inherits which solutions it produces. We formulate Looped Self-Distillation, a self-evolution framework for code generation in which a model repeatedly generates and learns from its own raw outputs, under a fixed information budget, without ongoing external assessment or test-based selection of the generated samples. We identify a consequential separation: correctness can improve while the breadth of correct implementations contracts. We introduce SPECTRUM, which re-estimates loss-sensitive key/value geometry from a fixed reference anchor at each round and converts it into full-rank proximal spectral modulation. All generated completions train a single student, whose subsequent inference requires no intervention. After five rounds of experiments on MBPP, SPECTRUM retains 89.9% of the initial model's 64-sample correct AST richness, compared with 66.4% for Vanilla self-distillation and 65.5% for a subspace-projection control. The advantage persists at matched correct-sample counts. Without further training or recalibration, the resulting student also achieves higher matched-correct richness than Vanilla SD on HumanEval+ and APPS Intro, demonstrating transfer of the diversity benefit. These findings establish correct-solution retention as a complementary objective of recursive self-improvement (RSI) and show that generation-time intervention can improve the solution repertoire retained by subsequent students.

AI.tldr: 在固定信息预算、无外部评估与测试筛选的条件下，论文提出 Looped Self-Distillation 自演化框架，并指出正确率提升与正确实现多样性收缩可分离；提出 SPECTRUM 方法，通过从固定参考锚点重新估计损失敏感的 K/V 几何并转化为满秩近端谱调制，在 MBPP 五轮实验中保留初始模型 64 样本正确 AST 丰富度的 89.9%（Vanilla SD 66.4%，子空间投影对照 65.5%），并迁移至 HumanEval+ 与 APPS Intro。
AI.motivation: 模型从自身输出中学习时，不仅继承输出的正确性，也继承其"能产生哪些解"。现有递归自改进（RSI）研究多关注正确率，忽视了正确解实现多样性的收缩问题。作者试图揭示正确性提升与正确实现广度收缩之间的分离现象，并将"正确解保留"确立为 RSI 的互补目标。
AI.method: 提出 Looped Self-Distillation 自演化框架：模型在固定信息预算下反复生成并学习自身原始输出，不依赖持续外部评估或基于测试的样本筛选。核心方法 SPECTRUM 在每一轮从固定参考锚点重新估计损失敏感的 key/value 几何结构，并将其转换为满秩近端谱调制（full-rank proximal spectral modulation）。所有生成补全用于训练单一学生模型，后续推理无需任何干预。
AI.result: MBPP 五轮实验：SPECTRUM 保留初始模型 64 样本正确 AST 丰富度的 89.9%，Vanilla 自蒸馏为 66.4%，子空间投影对照为 65.5%。在匹配正确样本数量条件下优势依然存在。无需额外训练或重校准，所得学生在 HumanEval+ 与 APPS Intro 上取得高于 Vanilla SD 的匹配正确丰富度，表明多样性收益具有迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 正确解保留应作为递归自改进的互补目标；生成时干预（generation-time intervention）能够改善后续学生模型所保留的解空间广度，说明自演化过程中多样性并非必然随正确率提升而牺牲。

title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.

AI.tldr: 本文探索仅用语言完成跨视角地理定位：用 MLLM 将地面全景与卫星瓦片转成结构化文本描述，无需任何训练，在 VIGOR 数据集的 9,826 对图像上分三种设定评估，发现描述能保留场景结构但丢失细粒度外观信息。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位通常作为图像检索问题求解，通过联合训练的嵌入在地面图像与卫星瓦片间匹配。此类模型精度高，但依赖大规模配对监督，且无法说明匹配依据、缺乏可解释性。作者因此提出一个不同的问题：不训练任何模型，仅凭语言能在多大程度上解决该任务。
AI.method: 提示多模态大语言模型（MLLM）分别将每张地面全景和每张卫星瓦片描述为结构化文本，通过比较这些描述进行定位，全流程无训练。评估使用美国四座城市的 9,826 对 VIGOR 数据，分三种设定：(1) 直接用描述相似度在全库排序；(2) 先用粗略先验将候选缩小到十个相邻瓦片，再用 MLLM 判别器打分结构一致性；(3) 将判别器置于训练好的视觉检索器之上做重排序。
AI.result: 设定一：描述忠实但不具区分性——两视角描述高度一致，但全库按描述相似度排序几乎无法召回正确瓦片（Recall@1 仅 0.39%）。设定二：缩小到十个相邻瓦片后，描述变得有用，MLLM 判别器打分的结构一致性使随机排序的准确率翻倍，并达到强词法基线的水平；同时能指出两描述中哪些字段一致、哪些冲突。设定三：在训练视觉检索器之上，对排序错误的查询，用图像重排序有效，而用描述重排序无效（Recall@1 分别为 23.5% 与 10.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 场景结构能通过语言转换得以保留，而区分邻近地点所需的细粒度外观细节无法保留。基于语言的方法可作为迈向可解释地理定位的一步，但无法替代视觉细粒度信息。代码与提示词已公开。

title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 macro2mind，利用预测市场价格轨迹作为行为推理的监督信号，通过 GRPO 训练语言模型进行显式社会行为推理，在方向预测与用户模拟上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有用于模拟个体行为响应的大语言模型，其行为推理要么继承自预训练，要么从个体级标注中习得。前者缺乏针对性，后者行为多样性有限且对推理过程本身缺乏监督，导致模型的群体行为推理能力受限。
AI.method: 提出 macro2mind，从预测市场价格轨迹中学习行为推理，用市场信号以 GRPO 训练语言模型。采用社会行为分解，将行为推理显式化为预测步骤：推断代表性市场参与者群体、预测其对新闻的解读与信念更新、推理群体间交互，并聚合为价格。同时使用 hindsight-regret 课程与难度感知采样，聚焦于后见之明识别出的群体能显著改进预测的样本，并优先选择当前策略仍可学习的样本。
AI.result: 在 SWM-Bench 上，macro2mind 于 Polymarket 数据上取得最优的方向准确率与相关性。仅在市场数据上训练，即可零样本迁移至 Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM 和 CAD 四个用户模拟基准，并在零样本方法中表现具有竞争力。作为数据生成器，其将下游模拟器在未见用户上的准确率提升 15.5 个百分点，优于其骨干模型生成的数据 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 预测市场为行为推理提供了大规模、具有行为多样性的监督信号；通过显式社会行为分解与课程化 GRPO 训练，模型学得的推理可迁移至用户模拟任务，并能作为高质量数据生成器进一步提升下游模拟器性能。

title: AeroBuoy: A Drone Deployable, 3D Printed, Autonomous Robotic Buoy for Environmental Inspection in Remote and Hazardous River Systems
comment: 7 pages. Accepted version. Published in the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). Winner of the IROS 2025 Best Paper Award on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics in memory of Motohiro Kisoi. Reuben O'Brien and Angus Lynch contributed equally
summary: Monitoring of waterways such as remote and hazardous rivers and streams is important so as to assess the impact of external factors including construction runoff or climate change. Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, or access protected water bodies but they have several shortcomings in terms of maneuverability. This paper proposes an environmental inspection system consisting of an autonomous data collection buoy which is designed to be deployed to inaccessible river systems using a drone. The system can perform a drop off and pickup of the buoy depending on the requirements of a particular location and monitoring task. Utilising the natural flow of the river the buoy autonomously steers down, using GPS and magnetometers so as to maintain the desired trajectory. The buoy is capable of measuring water temperature but it can also be equipped with a range of sensors such as water oxygen meter, sonar for river bed inspection, or turbidity for water clarity. This paper describes the system design, presents an analysis of the self-righting capabilities of the buoy, and shows a full system demonstration at the Ōrewa River in Auckland, New Zealand.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可空投/回收的自主水质监测浮标系统，依靠河流自然水流漂流，结合GPS与磁力计自主控制航向。
AI.motivation: 偏远、危险或受管控的河流难以监测，而自主机器人船在机动性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 设计可空投/回收的自主数据采集浮标，利用河流自然水流下行，通过GPS与磁力计保持期望轨迹；可搭载水温、溶氧、声呐、浊度等多种传感器。
AI.result: 给出系统设计、浮标自扶正能力分析，并在新西兰奥克兰Ōrewa河完成全系统演示。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为偏远或危险水体提供了可行的自主环境监测方案。

title: Plug-and-Play Quantum-Resistant BLE Pairing for Medical Implants via NFC Out-of-Band
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on E-health Networking, Application & Services (IEEE HealthCom 2026), October 19-21, 2026, New York, USA
summary: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) pairing establishes the cryptographic foundation for secure device communication. However, mainstream man-in-the-middle (MITM)-resistant pairing methods, such as Numeric Comparison and Passkey Entry, require user interfaces that implantable medical devices (IMDs) inherently lack, making Near-Field Communication (NFC)-assisted Out-of-Band (OOB) pairing an attractive alternative. Existing NFC-assisted OOB schemes authenticate a classical BLE key exchange that remains vulnerable to quantum attacks, while the NFC channel itself is susceptible to eavesdropping and active injection under stronger threat models. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight, plug-and-play NFC-based OOB pairing protocol that performs a post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism (KEM) entirely over the NFC channel, ensuring that no shared secret is transmitted over NFC while reducing long-range radio-frequency (RF) exposure during pairing. The proposed protocol requires no modifications to the BLE stack and inherently resists RF battery-depletion attacks. Evaluation on an IMD-class proof-of-concept testbed demonstrates that post-quantum OOB pairing is practical on resource-constrained devices, reducing projected battery life by less than 0.57\% for Kyber-1024 and 0.56\% for FireSABER under an operational usage model relative to the MITM-vulnerable Just Works method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级即插即用的NFC-OOB配对协议，将后量子KEM完全在NFC信道内执行，无需修改BLE协议栈，在植入式医疗设备上实现抗量子、抗MITM且抗RF电池耗尽攻击的BLE配对。
AI.motivation: BLE配对是安全通信的密码学基础，但主流抗MITM配对方法（Numeric Comparison、Passkey Entry）依赖用户界面，而植入式医疗设备（IMD）天然缺乏此类界面，因此NFC辅助的OOB配对成为有吸引力的替代方案。现有NFC-OOB方案存在两大缺陷：一是其认证的BLE密钥交换基于经典密码学，易受量子攻击；二是NFC信道在更强威胁模型下易遭窃听与主动注入。因此需要一种同时具备后量子安全性与OOB信道安全性的配对方案。
AI.method: 设计轻量级、即插即用的NFC-OOB配对协议：将后量子密钥封装机制（KEM）完全置于NFC信道内执行，确保共享密钥不通过NFC传输，同时减少配对期间的长距离射频（RF）暴露；协议无需修改BLE协议栈；通过IMD级概念验证测试平台进行性能评估。
AI.result: 在IMD级概念验证测试平台上，后量子OOB配对在资源受限设备上具有实用性：相较于易受MITM攻击的Just Works方法，在给定运行使用模型下，Kyber-1024使预计电池寿命减少不足0.57%，FireSABER减少0.56%。
AI.conclusion: 该协议在资源受限的植入式医疗设备上实现了实用的后量子NFC-OOB配对，兼顾抗量子攻击、OOB信道安全与低能耗开销，且无需修改BLE协议栈，天然抵抗RF电池耗尽攻击。

title: Readout Stability in Prefill-Only Decision Models:Zero-Label Prediction and Inference-Time Compute Allocation
summary: Prefill-only decision models inspired by the Jev model score every candidate in a menu during a single forward pass and never decode, which makes one call one to two orders of magnitude cheaper than a same-scale generative language model. We show that this read-out structure comes with a testable property. When an intervention changes only the candidate menu and leaves the input text fixed, the post-intervention accuracy is already determined by the cached first-pass distribution. The estimator restricts the pass-1 probabilities to the menu, renormalizes, and reads off the argmax; it uses no labels and no second forward pass. Across seven model families, ten datasets and two task types, menu-only interventions are predicted to within 4.2 points, and for one family the prediction is exact. A probability-level variant of the same estimator errs by 21.0 points, so the property lives in the ranking rather than in the probabilities and is not recovered by calibration. Same-scale generative language models do not share the property. On those models the same estimator errs by 1.6 to 15.8 points and degrades as the model grows. The property turns inference-time compute into a decision that can be made before deployment. Uniform extra passes buy calibration but almost no accuracy; at matched cost a confidence cascade outperforms every scheme that re-asks the same model, and curating the menu beats enlarging the model, with a 0.8B model on a curated 5-candidate menu reaching 95.4% on CLINC150 against 80.0% for a 4B model on the full 150-label menu.Code and data are available at https://github.com/rlisml/jev-cascade.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了仅预填充（prefill-only）决策模型的一个可检验性质：当干预仅改变候选菜单而输入文本固定时，后干预准确率可由缓存的首次前向分布（pass-1）确定，无需标签与二次前向。基于此性质可构建廉价置信级联与菜单筛选策略，在匹配成本下显著优于同规模生成式模型。
AI.motivation: 仅预填充决策模型（如受Jev模型启发）在一次前向中对菜单所有候选打分、不进行解码，单次调用成本比同规模生成式语言模型低1–2个数量级。然而，这种读出结构是否带来某种可被验证与利用的性质尚不清楚。作者希望回答：当干预只改变候选菜单而输入固定时，模型的判断能否在部署前就被确定，从而将推理期算力转化为可预先做出的决策。
AI.method: 作者提出一种无标签估计器：将pass-1概率限制在候选菜单上、重新归一化并读取argmax，用以预测仅菜单干预后的准确率（不使用标签与第二次前向）。同时构建概率级变体（在该分布上直接做概率校准/读出）作为对照，并考察同规模生成式语言模型是否具备相同性质。随后设计置信级联策略，与均匀增加前向次数、重复询问同一模型等方案在匹配成本下进行对比，并比较“精选菜单”与“扩大模型”的收益。
AI.result: 在7个模型家族、10个数据集、两类任务上，菜单级干预的准确率被预测在4.2个百分点以内，其中一个家族达到精确预测。概率级变体误差达21.0个百分点，说明该性质存在于排序而非概率中，且无法通过校准恢复。同规模生成式语言模型不具此性质，估计器误差1.6–15.8个百分点且随模型增大而恶化。均匀增加前向次数仅提升校准几乎不提升准确率；匹配成本下置信级联优于所有重复询问同一模型的方案；精选菜单优于扩大模型：0.8B模型在精选5候选菜单上于CLINC150达到95.4%，而4B模型在完整150标签菜单上仅80.0%。
AI.conclusion: 仅预填充决策模型具有“菜单干预下准确率由首次前向排序预先确定”的可检验性质，使推理期算力可转化为部署前即可完成的决策。该性质依赖于排序而非概率，生成式语言模型不具备。基于此的置信级联与菜单筛选以更低成本取得更高准确率，凸显数据/菜单侧优化相对模型规模扩张的性价比。代码与数据已公开。

title: Can Semantic Geometry Teach an AI Judgement?
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Four bounded studies of semantic measurements for pre-action judgment; consequence-graph hypothesis remains untested
summary:
How can an AI agent determine what rules to follow? One rule permits an action. Another imposes a condition, exception, or conflicting obligation. Deterministic systems can resolve those relationships when they have been specified. When they remain implicit in language, an agent can follow one rule while missing another that should stop it. Refusing every unresolved action avoids that risk, but also blocks permissible actions.
  We wanted the agent to make the distinction and still act. Our initial hypothesis was that geometric measurements could supply a basis for judgment. We represented actions and policies as vectors, then tested whether their geometry could identify governing policies and interpret the action's relation to them.
  Across four studies, the tested approaches did not establish reliable pre-action judgment. In the final synthetic study, a lexical router recovered every governing and blocking policy while reducing median policy checks by 97.7%. The composed pipeline nevertheless escalated all 2,304 test actions, including those it should have allowed. Supplying every policy to the same downstream mechanism changed no decision. Finding the policies had not solved the problem of interpreting them.
  This result led us to revise our hypothesis: judgment in AI agents requires developing a consequence graph. Such a graph would connect the actor and authority to policy conditions, exceptions, and the changes an action would produce. Follow-on studies will ask whether making those relationships explicit helps the agent distinguish when to act, stop, or seek review.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI智能体如何判断该遵循哪条规则。作者尝试用几何向量方法识别主导政策并解释行动与政策的关系，四项研究均未能实现可靠的事前判断；最终合成研究中词法路由器虽能召回全部主导与阻断政策、将中位政策检查量降低97.7%，但组合流水线仍升级了全部2,304个测试动作。作者据此修正假设，提出智能体判断需构建"后果图"，显式连接行动者、权威与政策条件、例外及行动后果。
AI.motivation: 当规则间的关系（许可、条件、例外、冲突义务）在自然语言中保持隐含时，智能体可能只遵循某条规则而漏掉本应阻止它的另一条规则；而一律拒绝所有未明确动作虽规避风险，却会阻断本应被允许的动作。研究动机在于让智能体在区分许可与阻断的同时仍能行动。
AI.method: 作者以向量表示动作与政策，检验其几何关系能否识别主导政策并解释动作与政策的关系；随后在最终合成研究中引入词法路由器进行政策检索，并将检索结果接入同一下游决策机制（含穷举提供全部政策的对照条件）。
AI.result: 四项研究均未建立可靠的事前判断。最终合成研究中，词法路由器召回了全部主导与阻断政策，中位政策检查量下降97.7%，但组合流水线升级了全部2,304个测试动作，包括本应允许的动作；向同一下游机制提供全部政策亦未改变任何决策，表明"找到政策"并未解决"解释政策"的问题。
AI.conclusion: 作者修正原有假设，认为AI智能体的判断需要构建"后果图"：将行动者与权威同政策条件、例外及行动将产生的变化相连接。后续研究将检验显式化这些关系是否有助于智能体区分何时行动、停止或请求复核。

title: Localize Any Object in X-Ray Security Scans without Human Annotation
summary: Universal object localization in X-ray security inspection is critical for automated threat detection in safety-critical venues. However, unlike everyday RGB images that dominate web-scale visual data, X-ray scans exhibit distinct color patterns, ambiguous boundaries, and compositional structures caused by volumetric superposition. These gaps hinder the direct zero-shot transfer of dense perception foundation models trained on web-scale RGB data. Moreover, annotated X-ray data is scarce and requires expert labeling, limiting both the training of generalizable X-ray native models and the adaptation of RGB foundation models for X-ray data via fine-tuning. Given these challenges, the bright promise of highly generalizable perception models, enabled by data scaling laws in the RGB domain, remains largely out of reach for X-ray inspection. To this end, we introduce LAO-X, a self-supervised adaptation framework that Locates Any Object in X-ray scans using diverse synthesized image--annotation pairs with granularity-aware supervision. LAO-X first designs a saliency-guided X-ray object mining module to separate diverse object instances, which are then used for physics-guided synthesis in the absorbance domain. LAO-X further incorporates an occlusion-controlled curriculum strategy to fine-tune a Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) localizer, progressively adapting it to X-ray scans with increasing object counts and overlap levels. Experiments on six X-ray benchmarks show that LAO-X substantially improves category-agnostic localization, achieving 2\% to 23\% mAP gains over SAM2 and X-ray specific baselines in heavily cluttered scenarios, entirely without human-annotated labels.

AI.tldr: 提出LAO-X自监督适配框架，利用合成图像-标注对与粒度感知监督，使SAM2无需人工标注即可在X射线安检场景中实现通用物体定位。
AI.motivation: X射线安检中的通用物体定位对自动威胁检测至关重要，但X射线图像与RGB图像存在域差异：颜色模式独特、边界模糊、体叠加导致的组成结构复杂，使基于网络规模RGB数据训练的密集感知基础模型难以零样本迁移；同时X射线标注数据稀缺且需专家标注，限制了X射线原生模型的训练与RGB基础模型的微调适配。
AI.method: LAO-X包含三步：1）显著性引导的X射线物体挖掘模块，用于分离多样化的物体实例；2）在吸光度域进行物理引导的图像合成，生成多样化的图像-标注对；3）遮挡控制的课程学习策略，对SAM2定位器进行渐进式微调，逐步提升物体数量与重叠程度。
AI.result: 在六个X射线基准上，LAO-X显著提升类别无关定位性能，在高度杂乱场景中相较SAM2及X射线专用基线取得2%~23%的mAP增益，且完全不依赖人工标注。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督合成数据与课程化适配，LAO-X在无人工标注条件下有效弥合RGB基础模型与X射线域之间的差距，为X射线安检中的通用物体定位提供了可扩展方案。

title: What Must Replay Preserve? Separating Correctable Bias from Class Correspondence
summary: Class-incremental learning must recognize all classes seen so far without task labels. Logit replay methods such as DER and DER++ mitigate forgetting by matching the model's past predictions on stored examples. Deleting this matching reveals its benefit, but the resulting accuracy cost cannot show whether the stored scores themselves are needed, or whether the cost survives correction of the classifier's bias toward recent classes. We propose a diagnostic framework that treats a cached prediction as temporally heterogeneous supervision: it separates classes known when an example was stored from classes learned afterward, edits each group, and evaluates every model before and after a task-level offset that leaves within-task predictions unchanged. On CIFAR-100 with DER++, suitable fixed constants replace the unrefreshed stored scores of later-learned classes within an equivalence margin of 1 percentage point, and the offset reduces the cost of deleting their matching from 14.9 to 1.8 points. Reassigning the non-gold scores of classes known at storage, which preserves their values and each task's target probability, costs 4.3 points before and 4.0 after the offset, and a parallel cost persists in image distillation. In the tested fixed-head setting, the large cost of deleting later-class matching is thus mostly correctable by this offset, whereas the smaller cost of disrupting class correspondence persists. Code and data are available at anonymous.4open.science/r/replay-preserve-E22B.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断框架：将缓存预测视为时间异质监督，检验logit replay中存储分数对各类别的必要性。
AI.motivation: Logit replay（如DER、DER++）通过匹配存储样本上的历史预测缓解遗忘。删除该匹配会暴露其收益，但仅凭准确率损失无法判断：损失是源于存储分数本身，还是仅源于分类器对近期类的偏置。
AI.method: 将缓存预测区分为存储时已知类与之后学习类，分别编辑两组；在保持任务内预测不变的task-level offset前后评估模型；在CIFAR-100上对DER++测试固定常数替换、组内重分配，并与图像蒸馏对照。
AI.result: CIFAR-100+DER++：固定常数可在1个百分点等价范围内替换后学类的未刷新分数；offset使删除匹配的代价从14.9降至1.8点。重分配存储时已知类的非gold分数（保持数值与任务目标概率）代价为offset前4.3点、后4.0点；图像蒸馏中类似代价持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 在固定分类头设定下，删除后学类匹配的大部分代价可由该offset校正，而破坏类对应关系的较小代价持续存在。

title: What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
summary: Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个模拟基准，建模高程图难表征的隐微危险与执行偏差，并配套闭环VLN+运动控制框架，仿真评估并在Unitree G1实物上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN基准虽实现了物理可执行导航，但假设所有危险可由高程图观测、且实现运动与期望运动高度一致，忽略了真实环境中语义模糊危险与运动策略避障导致的指令-执行不匹配。
AI.method: 构建同时建模高程隐微危险与执行偏差的新基准；提出闭环VLN+运动控制框架，持续将高层导航与实际机器人状态重新对齐；在仿真中评估导航，并在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上验证运动策略。
AI.result: 语义输入降低了对高程图难以表征危险的接触；抗偏差机制提升了导航成功率。
AI.conclusion: 人形机器人导航评估需同时考量路径完成度与危险规避两个维度。

title: Preparing an AI-Augmented SIEM for the EU Cyber Resilience Act: A Practitioner Case Study
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, makes product cybersecurity a lifecycle obligation for products with digital elements on the EU market: risk assessment, vulnerability handling, conformity documentation, and Article 14 incident- and vulnerability-reporting readiness must be operational before market placement. Small and medium-sized enterprises that build security products are doubly exposed, since their products are in scope while their customers expect them to be exemplary. This case study documents a CRA preparedness pilot for one such product, SEUXDR, an AI-augmented security monitoring product with a large-language-model active-response component, on the open-source CYBERFORT platform. We contribute a reproducible six-step recipe (Scope and Classify, Asset Registration, Produce Evidence, Map to CRA, Gap and Actions, Audit Pack), two end-to-end traceability threads, and a pilot snapshot tracing product risks through baseline and AI-specific controls and policies to CRA objectives. It offers practitioners a replicable starting point for translating CRA legal text into operational preparedness for incident response, vulnerability reporting, and conformity assessment.

AI.tldr: 该文以案例研究形式记录了一款AI增强安全监控产品（SEUXDR，含大模型主动响应组件）在开源CYBERFORT平台上开展《欧盟网络弹性法案》（CRA，Regulation (EU) 2024/2847）合规准备试点，提出可复现的六步流程与端到端可追溯链条，为中小企业将CRA法律条文转化为可运营的合规准备提供起点。
AI.motivation: CRA将产品网络安全转变为投放欧盟市场前必须履行的全生命周期义务（风险评估、漏洞处理、合规文档、第14条事件与漏洞报告就绪），而构建安全产品的中小企业面临"双重暴露"：自身产品属适用范围，同时客户又期待其成为合规范例。现有工作缺乏将CRA法律文本转化为可落地运营准备的可复现方法，尤其是针对含AI/大模型组件的产品。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，针对AI增强安全监控产品SEUXDR（含大语言模型主动响应组件），在开源CYBERFORT平台上开展CRA准备度试点。核心产出为可复现的六步配方：范围界定与分类（Scope and Classify）、资产登记（Asset Registration）、证据生成（Produce Evidence）、映射至CRA（Map to CRA）、差距与行动（Gap and Actions）、审计包（Audit Pack）；并构建两条端到端可追溯线索，形成将产品风险经基线控制与AI特有控制、策略追溯至CRA目标的试点快照。
AI.result: 试点形成了：（1）可复现的六步CRA准备流程；（2）两条端到端可追溯线索；（3）一份试点快照，将产品风险通过基线控制与AI特有控制及策略，逐层追溯至CRA目标，覆盖事件响应、漏洞报告与合规评估三个关键环节。
AI.conclusion: 该案例为从业者提供了可复制的起点，用于将CRA法律文本转化为事件响应、漏洞报告与合规评估方面的可运营准备；对同时受CRA约束又需以身作则的中小安全产品厂商具有直接参考价值，并展示了在开源平台上实现CRA可追溯性与证据管理的可行性。

title: Does Steering Break Your Model? A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Suite for LLM Steering Methods
summary: Activation steering provides a lightweight and flexible way to control large language model (LLM) behavior. However, effective steering requires more than inducing the intended behavior: it should also limit unintended changes and remain robust across inputs and training data. Existing evaluations cover these dimensions only in fragments. As a result, the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects have not been systematically characterized. We introduce SteerScope, a two-axis, multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly characterizes steering outcomes and method properties through 15 metrics. We score target efficacy and side effects on language quality, task capabilities, and safety and reliability, and further assess generalization and data dependence through steering-specific metrics for sample efficiency and sample sensitivity. Rather than comparing methods at a single operating point, we characterize the trade-offs between efficacy and side effects. Under matched models, tasks, and evaluation protocols, we benchmark 23 methods spanning 4 families, including prompting, LoRA, and SFT as baseline methods, and release the suite as an extensible codebase. We find that current activation steering methods do not yet surpass the Prompt Steering baseline in their overall balance between steering efficacy and side effects: across both model scales, no evaluated activation steering method achieves higher efficacy without incurring greater composite side effects. We further uncover a consistent coupling between steering efficacy and side effects. Under OOD prompts, target efficacy is often preserved, whereas side effects tend to become more pronounced, particularly through declines in instruction relevance and fluency. Methods also exhibit sharply different sample-efficiency profiles.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SteerScope——一个双轴、多维度的激活引导评估套件，用 15 项指标同时刻画引导效果、副作用、泛化性与数据依赖性，并对 4 个方法族共 23 种方法进行统一基准测试，揭示效果与副作用之间的耦合关系。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）是控制 LLM 行为的轻量灵活手段，但有效的引导不仅需诱导目标行为，还应限制非预期改变，并在不同输入与训练数据下保持稳健。现有评估仅零散覆盖这些维度，效果与副作用之间的权衡未被系统刻画，因此需要一套统一、多维、可扩展的评估方案。
AI.method: 提出 SteerScope：一个双轴、多维度评估套件，通过 15 项指标联合刻画引导结果与方法属性。在语言质量、任务能力、安全与可靠性上分别评分目标效果与副作用，并用引导专属指标（样本效率、样本敏感性）评估泛化性与数据依赖性。不局限于单一工作点比较，而是刻画效果—副作用的权衡曲线。在匹配模型、任务与评估协议下，对涵盖 4 个方法族的 23 种方法（含 prompting、LoRA、SFT 作为基线）进行基准测试，并将套件开源为可扩展代码库。
AI.result: 1）现有激活引导方法在效果与副作用的整体平衡上尚未超过 Prompt Steering 基线：在两个模型规模下，没有一种被评估的激活引导方法能在不带来更高复合副作用的前提下取得更高效果。2）发现引导效果与副作用之间存在一致的耦合关系。3）在 OOD 提示下，目标效果通常得以保持，但副作用更明显，尤其体现为指令相关性下降与流畅度降低。4）各方法在样本效率上表现出显著差异。
AI.conclusion: SteerScope 系统性地揭示了激活引导中效果—副作用的权衡与耦合特性，表明当前激活引导方法尚未在总体平衡上超越提示基线，且 OOD 场景下副作用加剧、样本效率差异明显。该套件为后续引导方法的公平比较与改进提供了可扩展的统一基准。

title: Internalizing Agent Experience into Diffusion Model Weights via On-Policy Context Distillation
summary: Wrapping an image generation model in an agentic harness can effectively boost Text-to-Image task performance: the harness can leverage memory, skills, workflow orchestration, result verification, and iterative refinement to continually construct and revise prompts, thereby eliciting better images. These gains, however, remain external to the diffusion model and are realized only while the full harness runs. We propose Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation (D-OPCD), which treats the agent-improved prompt as privileged context and distills the knowledge encoded in the agent harness into the weights of the diffusion model, so that the model retains part of the harness's benefit when conditioned on the original query alone. Using a Text-to-Image agent equipped with our proposed Auto Skill Evolver (ASE), we show that D-OPCD can internalize harness capabilities into the generator's weights, raising the average direct-generation score from 60.52 to 65.09 across four benchmarks. With this knowledge absorbed into the weights, the harness can shed its saturated skills and resume evolving: a second ASE round on the updated generator improves on a skill-free harness by additional 1.83 points, pointing toward text-to-image systems in which harness and model keep improving each other through continual co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出 Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation (D-OPCD)，将 T2I agent 框架的能力蒸馏进扩散模型权重，使模型仅凭原始 query 即可保留部分框架收益，实现框架与模型的持续协同进化。
AI.motivation: 将图像生成模型包裹在 agentic harness 中可显著提升 Text-to-Image 性能（借助记忆、技能、工作流编排、结果验证与迭代精炼来构建和修改 prompt），但这些收益是外部的、仅在完整 harness 运行时才存在，模型权重本身并未获益。作者希望把 harness 中编码的知识内化到扩散模型权重中，使模型在仅给定原始 query 时也能保留部分能力。
AI.method: 提出 D-OPCD：把 agent 改进后的 prompt 视为 privileged context，在 on-policy 设定下将 agent harness 的知识蒸馏到扩散模型权重中。配套提出 Auto Skill Evolver (ASE)，构建具备技能演化能力的 Text-to-Image agent，并与 D-OPCD 联合使用。蒸馏后，框架可丢弃已饱和的技能并继续演化，形成新一轮 ASE。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，D-OPCD 将平均直接生成分数从 60.52 提升至 65.09。知识吸收进权重后，harness 得以卸载饱和技能并恢复演化：在更新后的生成器上进行第二轮 ASE，相比无技能 harness 额外提升 1.83 分。
AI.conclusion: D-OPCD 能将 agent harness 的能力内化到生成器权重中，使框架与模型相互促进、持续协同进化，为 Text-to-Image 系统提供了一条"harness 与模型共同迭代提升"的路径。

title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
summary: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute-noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 to 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E and AttrP scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched Semantic Surgery baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HGSS——一种免训练的组合式概念擦除框架，通过层级跨度定位与动态属性绑定解决文本侧路由失败问题，在SEE与UnlearnCanvas上取得更优的擦除与保留效果。
AI.motivation: 部署中的文生图扩散模型需要移除受限概念，但权重编辑方法需逐目标重训且改动checkpoint；免训练方法虽部署友好，却在组合式提示上出现文本侧路由失败——擦除目标可能经由相关类别而非其词面名称被调用，且其修饰词会迁移到被保留对象上。
AI.method: HGSS同时提升文本侧擦除的路由信号与编辑算子：一是层级跨度定位，借助词法、分类学与语义证据解析擦除目标跨度，并防御宽泛上位词与复合词核心的假阳性；二是动态属性绑定，在早期去噪阶段通过反事实参考与保留感知的交叉注意力目标精化文本条件，维持幸存属性—名词绑定。全程不更新模型权重、不新增可学习参数。
AI.result: 在SEE上，HGSS将层级规避从29.54降至10.02，属性泄漏约减半，在报告的方法中取得最佳Neighbor E与AttrP；在UnlearnCanvas上，六指标平均值略优于匹配的Semantic Surgery基线，达到当前最优。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的组合式概念擦除可通过层级语义定位与属性绑定编辑得到有效实现，在不改动模型权重的前提下同时改善擦除彻底性与保留保真度。

title: Few-Shot Bioactivity Prediction with Meta-Learning under Assay Heterogeneity
summary: Accurate bioactivity prediction is a central challenge in early-stage drug discovery, as individual assays often contain too few measurements to train reliable models independently. Meta-learning offers a principled approach to this few-shot setting, but assay heterogeneity may limit its effectiveness. Here, we test this hypothesis and show that meta-learning performance degrades as meta-training tasks become more heterogeneous. To address this, we introduce MetaHeta, a meta-learning framework that accounts for assay heterogeneity by conditioning predictions on auxiliary data from related assays, with relatedness defined flexibly from available assay information. The architecture of MetaHeta combines linear attention over large auxiliary datasets with exact attention over scarce task-specific context, enabling efficient scaling to the former without compromising exact attention over the latter. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on assays from ChEMBL and BindingDB, improving few-shot bioactivity prediction and downstream compound prioritization in retrospective Bayesian optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MetaHeta 元学习框架，通过引入相关测定（assay）的辅助数据缓解测定异质性，从而提升小样本生物活性预测。
AI.motivation: 早期药物发现中单个测定数据量不足，难以独立训练可靠模型；元学习适合小样本场景，但测定间的异质性可能削弱其效果。
AI.method: 首先验证元学习性能随元训练任务异质性增加而下降的假设；随后提出 MetaHeta，将预测条件化于相关测定的辅助数据，相关性强弱灵活地依据可得测定信息定义。其架构结合对大规模辅助数据的线性注意力与对稀缺任务专属上下文的精确注意力。
AI.result: 在来自 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB 的测定上验证，改善了小样本生物活性预测，并在回溯性贝叶斯优化中提升了下游化合物优先级排序效果。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模测定异质性可有效提升元学习在小样本生物活性预测及下游任务中的表现。

title: An Autonomous, 3D Printed, Waterjet-Powered, Open-Source Robotic Trimaran for Environmental Inspection and Monitoring
comment: 8 pages. Accepted version. Published in the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS). Finalist for the IROS 2024 Best Application Paper Award
summary: Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, hard to reach, or access protected water bodies. This paper introduces such a platform in the form of an autonomous, cost-effective, waterjet-powered robotic trimaran. Motivated by the need for an efficient aquatic monitoring, particularly in Aotearoa - New Zealand's diverse environments, the trimaran provides an efficient, low-cost, and easy to replicate alternative to resource-intensive research vessels. The proposed platform, costs $600-1,500 USD to develop (depending on the sensing system configuration), weighs under 5 kg, and excels in bathymetry and water quality testing. The trimaran can reach speeds of up to 2 m/s offering obstacle avoidance of natural features, such as rocks. Utilizing off-the-shelf components and 3D printing technology, the proposed platform offers excellent reproducibility and robustness while operating in shallow waters with its jet propulsion system. The paper presents in detail the design characteristics, the sensing system employed, testing results focusing on bathymetry, and highlights the ability of vessel and the potential for future research and data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本、可复现的自主水翼喷射三体无人船，用于偏远或受保护水域的环境监测，成本600–1500美元、重不足5 kg、最高航速2 m/s，擅长水深测量与水质检测。
AI.motivation: 偏远、危险、难以抵达或受保护的水体缺乏高效监测手段，传统科考船资源消耗大；尤其在新西兰（Aotearoa）多样水域环境下，亟需经济、易复制的自主监测平台。
AI.method: 设计并实现自主、低成本、水翼（waterjet）推进的三体无人船；采用现成商用组件与3D打印技术；配备传感系统，具备对岩石等自然障碍物的避障能力，并在浅水中运行。
AI.result: 平台开发成本600–1500美元（视传感配置而定），重量低于5 kg，最高航速2 m/s，可避障；在水深测量与水质测试任务中表现良好，并展示出良好的可复现性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该三体无人船为资源密集型科考船提供了高效、低成本且易复制的替代方案，具备良好的可复现性，并为进一步研究与数据采集提供了潜力。

title: Don't Let One Lie Survive A Hundred Truths: A Selective Bayesian Trust Estimator for Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles to see beyond their own sensors but makes them dependent on messages they cannot independently verify. A compromised collaborator can surgically conceal a single safety-critical object or inject a non-existing one while correctly reporting many others. Existing Bayesian trust mechanisms pool agreement across objects, which, while effective against blatant untargeted attacks, either incurs high false-positive rates (FPR), or allows unrelated correct reports to dilute persistent attack evidence for stealthy single-object attackers. To address this problem, we propose SABER, a selective two-tier Bayesian trust estimator. The first tier maintains broad agent and object trust, preserving the ability to downweight benign but low-quality contributors. Cumulative-sum screening selects agent--object pairs with persistent omissions or unsupported reports for focused Bayesian assessment. The second tier checks these pairs against other agents' evidence and maintains a separate, reference-weighted Beta state for each. The lowest pair score constrains agent trust, preventing unrelated reports from diluting a targeted attack. We establish sufficient conditions for stronger attacker-side trust reductions with bounded additional benign false alarms at fixed thresholds. Compared with state-of-the-art CP defenses, SABER improves attack detection while reducing benign FPRs. On OPV2V, SABER improves defense ROC-AUC over MATE by up to 0.427 in late fusion and 0.337 in intermediate fusion. Against advanced intermediate-fusion data fabrication attacks, it increases detection rates over ROBOSAC and LUCIA by up to 96.40 and 67.07 percentage points, respectively, while reducing FPRs.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性两层贝叶斯信任估计器SABER，通过CUSUM筛选持续性单目标攻击的智能体-对象对并进行针对性贝叶斯评估，在提升攻击检测率的同时降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 协同感知使联网车辆依赖无法独立验证的消息，被攻陷的协作者可隐蔽地掩盖或注入单个安全关键对象。现有贝叶斯信任机制在对象间池化一致性，对显式无目标攻击有效，但对隐蔽单目标攻击要么误报率高，要么被无关的正确报告稀释攻击证据。
AI.method: SABER为两层贝叶斯信任估计器。第一层维护广域智能体与对象信任，保留对低质量良性贡献者降权的能力；采用累积和（CUSUM）筛选存在持续性遗漏或无支撑报告的智能体-对象对。第二层对这些对结合其他智能体证据进行检验，并为每对维护独立的、以参考为权重的Beta状态，以最低的对评分约束智能体信任。
AI.result: 在固定阈值下给出了攻击方信任下降更强且良性误报有界的充分条件。相比现有CP防御，SABER提升检测同时降低良性FPR。在OPV2V上，后融合中防御ROC-AUC较MATE最多提升0.427，中融合提升0.337；针对先进中融合数据伪造攻击，检测率较ROBOSAC和LUCIA分别最多提升96.40和67.07个百分点，且FPR更低。
AI.conclusion: SABER通过选择性两层贝叶斯信任估计与CUSUM筛选，有效解决隐蔽单目标攻击证据被稀释的问题，在理论与实验上均优于现有协同感知防御方法。

title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 42 tables. Project page: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/Sansi/
summary: Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the generator's F1 by 7.7 points.

AI.tldr: 提出SanSi，将预训练循环语言模型改造为类型化决策模型，在单次运行中同时服务1至8次循环的推理预算，在10,027项测试决策上达到72.0%准确率。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型单次前向即给出各选项概率，属于快速直觉的System 1；而生成式推理则较慢。作者希望研究介于两者之间的形态——循环复用同一批层以在不生成token的情况下修正隐状态，称为System 1.5，从而在速度与推理深度之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将预训练循环语言模型转为类型化决策模型：在每次循环后读取选项概率，并用恰当评分规则（proper scoring rule）对每次循环都进行训练，使单一模型在一次运行中即可支持1至8次循环的不同预算。
AI.result: 在来自59个来源的10,027项测试决策上，SanSi准确率达72.0%：比同结构、同训练方法的非循环模型高13.5个百分点，比更新的同规模非循环模型高5.3个百分点，仅比参数量为其三倍的模型低1.8个百分点。在两个深度控制任务上，循环可将可解深度扩展至训练未见深度，而更大的单次前向模型在此失败。作为无金标准答案的强化学习策略优化评判器，SanSi使生成器F1提升7.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 循环式的System 1.5决策在不生成token的前提下提升了决策准确率与深度泛化能力，并且单一模型可覆盖多档推理预算，还能作为强化学习评判器带来实际增益。

title: MemMux: Runtime Verification and Honest Resource Attribution for Fleets of Parallel Coding Agents
summary: Developers increasingly run a fleet of coding agents side by side on one workstation. The tools they reach for, terminal multiplexers like tmux and a new generation of agent managers, were built to arrange windows, not to govern memory. When ten agents each spawn language servers, test runners, and browsers, no standard tool can say how much memory belongs to which agent, confirm that a terminated agent's descendants are gone, notice a child that has escaped its agent, or keep the machine off the swap cliff when an OOM kill would silently discard uncommitted work. We treat these as runtime-verification problems: an agent-hosting substrate should continuously emit observable signals an operator or auditor can check while agents run. We present MemMux, a local runtime that turns resource governance into checkable signals (per-agent attribution, complete reclamation, escaped-process visibility, bounded footprint under overcommit, and monitoring overhead), with a claims-disciplined benchmark against tmux, a purpose-built agent multiplexer, and a raw-process baseline on identical workloads. Under a binding memory budget on a Linux host, MemMux keeps the fleet under budget (7.5 GiB) with zero swap by admitting a subset and reclaiming under pressure, while the ungoverned tools run every agent, pin the machine at its RAM ceiling (2x over budget), and spill about 2 GiB into swap. MemMux reclaims 100% of a terminated agent's process subtree where the raw baseline strands half of it, and it alone surfaces escaped children (10 of 10 detected). We report the cost: the 1 Hz attribution scan runs near 0.6% CPU at one agent but 2.7% at ten, above our 2% target. Running the harness on real Claude Code sessions shows 100% attribution and low overhead carry over to live agent trees. We release the engine, benchmark, and a one-command reproducer.

AI.tldr: MemMux是一个面向多编码代理并行运行的本地运行时，将资源治理（内存归属、回收、逃逸进程可见性、超配下的内存受限、监控开销）转化为可验证信号；在绑定内存预算下比tmux等基线更优（保住预算、零swap、100%回收、10/10检测逃逸子进程），但1Hz归属扫描在十个代理时CPU开销2.7%，高于2%目标。
AI.motivation: 开发者在一台工作站上并行运行多个编码代理，每个代理会派生语言服务器、测试运行器和浏览器。现有工具（tmux、代理管理器）只用于排布窗口，无法治理内存：无法判定内存归属于哪个代理，无法确认已终止代理的子孙进程已消失，无法发现逃逸出代理的子进程，也无法在OOM杀死静默丢弃未提交工作时让机器避开swap悬崖。作者将这些问题视为运行时验证问题，即托管代理的底层应持续发出可观测信号，供操作者或审计者在代理运行时检查。
AI.method: 将资源治理设计为可检查信号：每个代理的归属、完整回收、逃逸进程可见性、超配下的受限内存占用、监控开销。构建MemMux本地运行时，并在相同工作负载下与tmux、专用代理多路复用器以及原始进程基线进行有节制的基准对比；在Linux主机上设定绑定的内存预算；运行1 Hz归属扫描；并在一命令可复现的环境中运行真实Claude Code会话测试其可迁移性。
AI.result: 在绑定内存预算下，MemMux通过接纳子集并在压力下回收，使代理群保持在预算内（7.5 GiB）且零swap；未治理工具会运行所有代理，使机器顶到RAM上限（超预算2倍），并溢出约2 GiB到swap。MemMux回收了已终止代理进程子树的100%，而原始基线遗留一半；且只有它暴露了逃逸子进程（10/10检测到）。代价方面：1 Hz归属扫描在一个代理时CPU约0.6%，十个代理时为2.7%，高于2%目标。在真实Claude Code会话上，100%归属和低开销可延续到真实代理树。
AI.conclusion: MemMux表明可将代理资源治理转化为可检查的运行时信号，并在内存受限、进程回收与逃逸检测上显著优于现有工具；主要局限是监控开销随代理数量增长而超出目标。作者发布引擎、基准和一命令复现脚本。

title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
summary: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TC3-VQA数据集，用于训练和评估视觉语言模型在战术战伤救治中连接视觉证据与临床指南的能力。
AI.motivation: TC3要求救援人员将伤情视觉观察与既定临床指南相结合，而开发支持该过程的视觉语言模型需要将可见证据与可追溯的救治原则相链接的监督数据。
AI.method: 从公开的TC3教学与现场视频及权威TC3文档构建数据集，包含581个条目、11个概念和1860个问题，涵盖干预识别、救治原则、临床推理、操作指导及视觉信息不足时的拒答；基于指南的答案保留原文段落与字符偏移；构建流程结合视觉标注、段落检索、蕴含检查和跨模型家族验证；问答对附带设备框、解剖标签、时间片段和来源元数据；通过自动化审计及两名医生和两名医学生的评分评估标注质量。
AI.result: 数据集覆盖11个概念、1860个问题，并保留88个条目的专家人工评分，用于刻画标注质量。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为将视觉语言模型适配到TC3、研究视觉证据与临床知识的联系以及评估识别、原则回忆和拒答能力提供了资源。

title: When Attention Does Not Explain the Peak: Temporal Reference vs. Forecast Output in Attention-Based Time-Series Forecasting
comment: NeurIPS 2026: Accepted to the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop
summary: Attention maps are often interpreted as evidence of what a forecasting model uses when making predictions. In our load-forecasting model, a CLS representation of historical demand queries 24 future exogenous horizon tokens through cross-attention, inviting a temporal interpretation in which highly attended horizons may appear to explain forecast peak timing. We test this interpretation using a horizon-level attention descriptor, $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$. Across 31 day-aligned windows of the Panama load dataset, the forecast achieves a median peak-time error of 0 h and a 51.6% exact-match rate, whereas the argmax of $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$ has a median error of 5 h and 0% exact match. The forecast peak is closer to the observed peak in 27 of 31 windows. This dissociation is not merely an argmax artifact: within $\pm1$ h, attention reaches only $1.16\times$, $1.11\times$, and $1.14\times$ the uniform baseline around observed, predicted, and weekly-naive peaks, respectively, indicating weak and non-selective concentration. Yet the attention profile is structured, with cross-window consistency of 0.83. Replacing 12 future weather features with their training-set means makes the profile nearly uniform, showing sensitivity to future weather variation rather than fixed horizon position alone. The dissociation is also reproduced across three random-seed runs. These results show that structured, input-sensitive, and reproducible horizon-level cross-attention need not provide a valid peak-selective explanation of forecast behavior. The observed behavior is instead consistent with an internal horizon-reference role for integrating future exogenous information, although this functional role is not causally established.

AI.tldr: 在负荷预测模型中，虽然horizon级cross-attention具有结构性和输入敏感性，但其注意力分布与预测峰值时序并不同步，不能作为预测行为的有效解释。
AI.motivation: 注意力图常被解读为模型做预测时"使用了什么"的证据，作者希望检验"高度被关注的预测时段可以解释预测峰值时序"这一时间性解释是否成立。
AI.method: 构建负荷预测模型，以CLS表征查询24个未来外生horizon token，通过cross-attention生成horizon级注意力描述子Ψ_out；在Panama负荷数据集31个对齐日窗口上，比较Ψ_out的argmax与预测峰值相对观测峰值的时间误差，并以±1 h内注意力相对均匀基线的倍数评估集中度与选择性；同时用训练集均值替换12个未来天气特征、并重复三个随机种子以检验结构与可复现性。
AI.result: 预测中位峰值时间误差为0 h、精确匹配率51.6%，而Ψ_out的argmax中位误差为5 h、精确匹配率为0%；31个窗口中27个窗口预测峰值更接近观测峰值。±1 h内注意力仅为均匀基线的1.16×、1.11×、1.14×（分别对应观测峰值、预测峰值、周naive峰值），集中度弱且无选择性。但注意力分布具有结构，跨窗口一致性为0.83；替换未来天气特征为训练集均值后分布近乎均匀，说明其对未来天气变化敏感。该解离在三个随机种子下均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、输入敏感且可复现的horizon级cross-attention并不必然构成对预测行为的有效峰值选择性解释；该行为更符合一个用于整合未来外生信息的"内部horizon参考"作用，但该功能角色尚未被因果性验证。

title: RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing
summary: We present RACER, a hierarchical control framework for wheel-based quadruped racing that combines an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker. The planner augments a nominal unicycle kinematic model with a neural residual term to capture the closed-loop tracking behavior of the RL policy. To train this residual model under limited real-world data, we propose Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA), a two-stage approach that pre-trains on large-scale simulation data for broad coverage and then fine-tunes on a small real-world dataset with a low-rank constraint. In simulation, we empirically validate our engineering choices by showing (A) Residual dynamics improve the overall performance of our pipeline by capturing the tracking error of RL velocity tracker at high-speed cornering. (B) Residual dynamics trained with both source-domain and target-domain data gives racing performance significantly better than the residual dynamics trained with only target-domain data. (C) Low-rank constraint at target-domain adaptation gives higher success rates and higher performance than full-tune and from-scratch when domain gap in ground coefficient or joint gain increases.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RACER分层控制框架，将MPPI规划器、学习到的残差动力学模型与低层RL速度跟踪器结合，用于轮式四足机器人竞速；并提出LoRRA两阶段残差适配方法以在有限真实数据下训练残差模型。
AI.motivation: 轮式四足竞速需要高速且精确的控制，但低层RL速度跟踪器存在闭环跟踪误差（尤其高速过弯时），且真实世界数据有限，难以直接训练准确的残差动力学模型。
AI.method: RACER采用分层控制：MPPI规划器基于标称独轮车运动学模型，并加入神经残差项以刻画RL策略的闭环跟踪行为。残差模型训练采用LoRRA两阶段方法：先在大规模仿真数据上预训练以获得广泛覆盖，再用低秩约束在少量真实数据上微调。
AI.result: 仿真验证表明：(A) 残差动力学通过捕捉RL速度跟踪器在高速过弯时的跟踪误差，提升了整体流程性能；(B) 同时用源域和目标域数据训练的残差动力学，竞速性能显著优于仅用目标域数据训练；(C) 在地面系数或关节增益域差距增大时，目标域适配中的低秩约束相比全量微调和从头训练具有更高成功率和更高性能。
AI.conclusion: 将残差动力学与MPPI规划、RL速度跟踪器结合的分层框架可有效提升轮式四足竞速性能；LoRRA通过仿真预训练加低秩真实微调，在有限数据与域差距下实现更优适配。

title: Where does a rust speedup come from? Language and algorithm effects in sliding window threat scorer
summary: Rewriting a hot path from Python into Rust is a common way to speed up security analytics, and large speedups are routinely reported. A rewrite usually changes the language and the algorithm at once, so a single factor can credit the language with a gain that comes from a better algorithm. We study this on a sliding window threat scorer modelled on the traffic light calculator of the SentinelSphere platform. Five implementations, three in Python and two in Rust, produce bit identical scores, confirmed by a shared checksum, and we time them from 100 to one million events in a bounded and a burst regime. The language alone contributes between about 4 and 29 times. Replacing a per event rescan of the window by an incremental update contributes more than 11,000 times in the burst regime, so the end to end factor reaches about 195,000 times when the window keeps filling and levels off near 13,000 times when it does not. A power law fit to the timings reported for the original rewrite gives growth exponents of 1.85 for Python and 0.88 for Rust, the signature of an algorithmic difference. Performance claims for security tooling should therefore report the language and algorithm contributions separately.

AI.tldr: 将热路径从 Python 重写为 Rust 时，语言与算法变更常被混为一谈；本研究以滑动窗口威胁评分器为例，分离二者的性能贡献。
AI.motivation: 安全分析中常见"Python 重写为 Rust"的加速报告，但重写通常同时改变语言与算法，导致单一因素（语言）可能窃取了本属于算法改进的收益，因此有必要将语言与算法贡献分开量化。
AI.method: 以 SentinelSphere 平台交通灯计算器为原型的滑动窗口威胁评分器为对象，实现五个版本（三个 Python、两个 Rust），通过共享校验和确认评分完全一致；在 100 到一百万事件规模、有界与突发两种负载模式下进行计时；并用幂律拟合原始重写报告的计时数据。
AI.result: 仅语言因素带来约 4 至 29 倍加速；用增量更新替代逐事件窗口重扫描在突发模式下贡献超过 11,000 倍，端到端加速在窗口持续填充时达约 195,000 倍，在窗口不再增长时趋于约 13,000 倍；幂律拟合指数为 Python 1.85、Rust 0.88，符合算法差异特征。
AI.conclusion: 安全工具的性能声明应分别报告语言贡献与算法贡献，避免将算法收益错误归因于语言迁移。

title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
summary: Tool-using agents make consequential changes to external state, yet correct outcomes do not guarantee that their actions were supported by evidence established beforehand. We study where this evidence-to-action chain breaks as agents move from deciding whether to act to executing single actions and dependent workflows. Across ten model-harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution. For this analysis, we introduce SafeActBench, comprising 656 cases across six operational domains and five protocols that progress from static action judgment and investigated non-action to single- and multi-action workflows. A provenance-bound Evidence Ledger and deterministic trajectory evaluator track what information was established, when actions occurred, and whether downstream dependencies were satisfied. These results show that failures arise not only from missing information, but also from how agents use established evidence when deciding and executing actions.

AI.tldr: 论文研究工具型智能体从"是否行动"判断到执行单步及依赖型工作流的证据-行动链条断裂问题，提出SafeActBench基准与"证据账本"评测框架，发现强静态评估常伴随弱交互执行。
AI.motivation: 工具型智能体会对外部状态产生实质改变，但正确结果并不能保证其行动有事先建立好的证据支撑。现有评测多关注最终结果而非证据到行动的链条，作者希望定位该链条在何处断裂。
AI.method: 覆盖十种"模型-框架"配置；提出SafeActBench，含六大操作域、656个案例、五种协议，从静态行动判断、经调查后的不行动，推进到单步与多步工作流；并设计溯源性"证据账本（Evidence Ledger）"与确定性轨迹评测器，追踪哪些信息已建立、行动发生时机及下游依赖是否满足。
AI.result: 强静态行动评估可与明显更弱的交互执行并存；失败常在执行前出现——智能体调查不充分即停止，或在必要证据未建立前就行动；一旦获得必要证据，单步执行通常可靠，而多步工作流还额外暴露未解决的前置条件与执行不完整问题。
AI.conclusion: 失败不仅源于信息缺失，也源于智能体在决策与执行时如何使用已建立的证据；评测需超越结果正确性，转向证据-行动链条的溯源式分析。

title: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
summary: A team of coding agents can look fine agent by agent yet fail as a team: each passes its own tests while the merged result is broken, and single-agent evaluation never catches it. As teams run several LLM coding agents in parallel on one codebase, the agents collide: two rewrite the same function, one codes against a contract a teammate just changed, and integration fails after the work is done. Most coordination tools react (watch for a conflict, then warn), but at agent speed the warning arrives after the wasted edit. We recast the problem as scheduling: take each work item's declared scope, partition the work into disjoint scopes, and order merges along the producer->consumer graph, all up front. We build this planner into Nerveplane and evaluate it with NP-Bench, an environment-grounded three-arm benchmark (no coordination; reactive detection; proactive planning) that verifies integration off a real git merge, both in a deterministic simulation and with live agents. The planner lifts clean-integration from 1/9 to 9/9 scenarios and cuts merge conflicts from 13 to 0, with a gap that grows in the number of agents. On a live breaking contract change it rescues an outcome both baselines miss on every seed: the clean-integration rate rises from 0 (no coordination and reactive detection) to 1.0 on a frontier model and 0.6 on a small one, while agents respect assigned scopes (0/5 leakage). A cross-session memory drops the repeated-mistake rate from 1.00 to 0.00 on strong and weak models alike. We also report a negative result: routing facts to agents does not rescue long-context accuracy at window-fitting scales; its value is cost and capacity, not attention. Across two capability tiers and two vendors, the benefit did not shrink as models got stronger, because it comes from how work is allocated, not model reasoning.

AI.tldr: 将多智能体并行编码冲突问题重构为事前调度问题：先按声明的作用域切分工作、沿生产者→消费者图排定合并顺序，在 Nerveplane 中实现并以 NP-Bench 三臂基准验证，干净集成从 1/9 升至 9/9，冲突从 13 降至 0。
AI.motivation: 多智能体编码团队常出现“单体测试全过、合并后失败”的情况，单智能体评测无法发现；并行智能体会相互碰撞（重复改写同一函数、按已被队友更改的契约编码），导致集成失败。现有协调工具多为事后反应式（检测冲突后告警），在智能体速度下告警往往来得太晚，浪费已经发生的编辑。因此需要从事前调度层面解决工作分配与合并顺序问题。
AI.method: 将问题重构为调度：依据每个工作项声明的作用域，将工作划分为互不相交的作用域，并沿生产者→消费者依赖图预先确定合并顺序。该规划器被实现为 Nerveplane，并用 NP-Bench 评测——一个基于真实环境、三臂对照的基准（无协调 / 反应式检测 / 主动式规划），通过真实 git merge 验证集成效果，覆盖确定性仿真与真实智能体两种设置。另测试跨会话记忆对重复错误率的影响，以及把事实路由给智能体对长上下文准确率的作用。
AI.result: 规划器将干净集成从 1/9 提升至 9/9 场景，合并冲突从 13 降至 0，且差距随智能体数量增加而扩大。在实时破坏性契约变更中，两个基线在所有随机种子上均失败，规划器将干净集成率从 0 提升至前沿模型的 1.0、小模型的 0.6，且智能体遵守分配作用域（5 次中 0 次泄漏）。跨会话记忆将重复错误率从 1.00 降至 0.00，强、弱模型一致。负面结果：将事实路由给智能体并不能在窗口受限规模下挽救长上下文准确率，其价值在于成本与容量而非注意力。在两个能力层级与两家厂商上，收益未随模型增强而缩小。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体编码失败的本质是工作分配与合并顺序问题，而非模型推理能力不足，因此主动式调度规划优于事后冲突检测；其收益源于工作如何被分配，故不随模型变强而衰减，在跨能力层级与厂商上保持稳定。

title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
summary: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究冻结的V-JEPA 2视频世界模型是否保留对被遮挡物体的表征，发现预测器在隐藏区域上迅速丢失被遮挡物体信息，而编码器本身能读到物体存在，且可通过少量训练廉价地安装"物体恒存"先验。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能追踪可见物体，但其对不可见（被遮挡）物体保留了什么信息尚不清楚。作者希望检验潜在预测器是否具备"物体恒存"（object permanence）这一能力。
AI.method: 让冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器面对被隐藏的物体，将预测器对隐藏区域的预测与编码器对两个仅在该区域不同的世界的表征进行比较；并用编码器自身的探针读取预测器输出。同时用合成容器场景进行仅预测器的微调训练实验，并设置两组匹配对照，另评估IntPhys-2019基准及不同评分规则的影响。
AI.result: 预测器部分保留静止物体、完全丢失容器内携带的物体，并在0.3秒内（管mask下0.5秒；ViT-H在90%掩码率下保留至1.1秒）丢失运动物体，投影中仅残留基线14-60%的痕迹。而编码器以1.00的准确率读取物体存在，容器内容可解码3.5秒；但盒子关闭半秒后，预测器输出仅2%场景含小球。三千步仅预测器训练可将恒存信念从0.05提升到1.00（对照匹配），并使IntPhys-2019从84.2%升至93.3%，但无容器的课程同样有效，基准归因随评分规则变化。继续用管mask训练可在操作类和网络风格视频上获得1.1-1.6秒运动物体保留，说明缺陷并非潜在预测固有。VideoMAE几乎无保留，Cosmos仅保留静止隐藏物体。
AI.conclusion: 物体恒存缺失存在于预测器一侧而非编码器或潜在预测范式本身，并且可通过低成本训练作为先验安装，但其在基准上的效果依赖评分规则与训练习惯。

title: SchemaFill: Efficient LLM Tool Calling via Slot-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: LLM agents interact with external systems by generating structured tool calls. Given a user request, conversational context, and a catalog of tool schemas, a tool-calling model must select tools and generate their arguments, potentially producing multiple calls in a single response. Standard autoregressive decoding generates these calls token by token, incurring substantial latency for requests involving multiple calls or many argument fields. The explicit argument structure offers opportunities for parallel generation, but later argument values may depend on preceding fields and calls, so independently generated values can differ from the target model's output. We present SchemaFill, a framework for efficient LLM tool calling through slot-parallel speculative decoding. SchemaFill generates future slot values concurrently as candidates, without requiring advance knowledge of the actual call sequence or argument values. Candidates spanning multiple fields and calls are concatenated for verification by the target model under the actual output prefix. Only verified tokens are committed, and the target supplies corrections when candidates disagree. This applies target verification while exploiting parallelism across slots and calls. On Glaive and BFCL, SchemaFill achieves up to a 4.05$\times$ improvement in end-to-end throughput over autoregressive decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill.

AI.tldr: 提出 SchemaFill 框架，通过槽位并行投机解码加速 LLM 工具调用生成，端到端吞吐量最高提升 4.05 倍。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 依靠生成结构化工具调用来与外部系统交互。标准自回归解码逐 token 生成，当请求涉及多次调用或大量参数字段时延高。结构化参数虽有并行生成潜力，但后续参数值可能依赖前面的字段和调用，独立并行生成的结果会与目标模型输出不一致。
AI.method: SchemaFill 采用槽位并行投机解码：在无需预知实际调用序列和参数值的情况下，并发生成未来槽位值作为候选；将跨多个字段和调用的候选拼接后，在实际输出前缀下交由目标模型验证，仅提交被验证通过的 token，当候选存在分歧时由目标模型给出修正，从而在槽位和调用层面实现并行并施加目标验证。
AI.result: 在 Glaive 和 BFCL 数据集上，SchemaFill 相比自回归解码端到端吞吐量最高提升 4.05 倍。代码见 https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill。
AI.conclusion: SchemaFill 利用工具调用结构中的槽位并行性进行投机解码，在保证目标模型验证正确性的前提下显著降低多调用、多参数场景的生成延迟。

title: Entropy-Gated Belief Coordination for Decentralized Multi-Agent Search Under Intermittent Communication
summary: We study decentralized multi-agent target search where homogeneous agents communicate intermittently at Poisson-distributed times. Standard unconditional belief fusion wastes communication opportunities by synchronizing agents during high-entropy exploration, when diverse independent beliefs provide better coverage than a premature consensus. We introduce \emph{entropy-gated belief coordination}, in which agents skip fusion while their collective entropy ratio exceeds a threshold~\(θ\) and merge only during exploitation, consistent with the bifurcation structure of nonlinear opinion dynamics and the submodular structure of the per-step information gain objective. We further derive \(\Istep(α,β)\), the expected mutual information per observation step between two agents' binary sensors, as an interpretable, communication-free measure of sensor informativeness that motivates the gating design and guides system-level analysis. Experiments across 103{,}680 trials (nine grid sizes up to \(100{\times}100\), Poisson communication timing, four target movement patterns) show that the Entropy-Gated Trust-Decay Planner (\textsc{EG-TDP}), which adds a detection-probability planner switch in exploitation mode, achieves mean belief quality \(\bar{Q}=0.300\) (mean belief mass at the true target cell, averaged across all trials and steps), a \(58.9\%\) gain over arithmetic mean and a \(37.4\%\) gain over visit-weighted fusion. On representative configurations, EG-TDP also outperforms a joint-Bayesian reference that uses all agents'~observations at every step, despite operating under random intermittent contact only.

AI.tldr: 提出熵门控信任衰减规划器（EG-TDP），在泊松间歇通信下按熵比阈值门控信念融合，平均信念质量 Q̄=0.300，较算术平均提升 58.9%，并在部分配置上超过全观测联合贝叶斯参考。
AI.motivation: 分散式多智能体目标搜索中通信机会稀缺，而无条件信念融合会在高熵探索阶段过早同步，浪费通信资源并削弱独立观测带来的覆盖优势。
AI.method: 引入熵门控信念协调：当集体熵比超过阈值 θ 时跳过融合，仅在利用阶段合并，设计依据为非线性意见动力学的分岔结构与信息增益目标的次模性；同时推导每步期望互信息 Istep(α,β) 作为无需通信的传感器信息量度量，用于指导门控设计；EG-TDP 在利用模式中额外加入检测概率规划器切换。
AI.result: 在 103,680 次试验（9 种网格至 100×100、泊松通信时序、4 种目标运动模式）中，EG-TDP 取得平均信念质量 Q̄=0.300，较算术平均提升 58.9%、较访问加权融合提升 37.4%；在代表性配置下，即使仅依赖随机间歇接触，也优于每步使用全部智能体观测的联合贝叶斯参考。
AI.conclusion: 按熵阈值门控融合能有效利用通信机会、保留探索多样性，形成优于常规融合策略的分散式目标搜索方案，并可在间歇通信条件下逼近甚至超越完全信息基线。

title: Quantifying the Privacy Posture of Operator-Side 5G/O-RAN Profiles
summary: Operator-side network profiles derived from 5G/ORAN traffic carry personal data such as ephemeral subscriber identifiers, slice-level KPIs, and control-plane signalling, and must be anonymised before release to a federated-learning aggregator, threat-intelligence exchange, or ML training pipeline. We study how much re-identification risk remains after standard operator-side anonymisation. We quantify privacy posture with k-anonymity, l-diversity and t-closeness, aggregate them into a composite Privacy-Posture Index (PPI), and measure residual re-identification across eight transformation configurations on internal PCAP captures and the public Idaho Labs 5GAD corpus, under a full-QI syntactic bound and two simulated adversaries. The evaluation is modest in scale, and we read its trends as indicative rather than definitive. Three findings emerge. Pseudonymisation alone leaves re-identification unchanged; material privacy gains arise when quasi-identifiers are coarsened through generalisation, optionally combined with suppression. A downstream classification task then shows that suppression-heavy releases retain majority-class utility but sacrifice much of their minority-class recall, a cost the aggregate metrics hide. Finally, the standard kmin-based PPI correlates only modestly with the disclosure bound and not at all with the partial-knowledge attack, whereas a mean-class-size variant PPI correlates strongly with all three disclosure/attack measures; we therefore read PPI as a regulator-facing summary, not a security bound. The profiles are produced by passive operator-side monitoring with rule-based DPI; our contribution is the privacy-quantification layer that computes these metrics, applies the transformation policy, and exposes both through an inspectable dashboard.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究运营商侧5G/ORAN网络流量画像在标准匿名化后仍残留的重识别风险，提出复合隐私态势指数（PPI），在内部PCAP与公开5GAD语料上比较八种变换配置，发现泛化（可结合抑制）带来实质隐私收益，抑制过多会损害少数类召回，且PPI仅宜作为面向监管的概括性指标而非安全界。
AI.motivation: 运营商侧网络画像含临时用户标识、切片级KPI与控制面信令等个人数据，在共享给联邦学习聚合器、威胁情报交换或ML训练前必须匿名化；但标准匿名化后究竟残留多少重识别风险、现有隐私指标是否可靠，尚缺乏量化评估。
AI.method: 用k-匿名、l-多样性和t-紧密度量化隐私态势，聚合成复合隐私态势指数（PPI）；在内部PCAP抓包与公开Idaho Labs 5GAD语料上，对八种变换配置测量残余重识别，采用全准标识符（QI）语法上界及两种模拟攻击者；并对比kmin版PPI与均值类规模变体PPI同三类披露/攻击指标的相关性，另设下游分类任务考察效用。
AI.result: 仅做假名化不改变重识别风险；通过泛化对QI进行粗化（可结合抑制）才产生实质隐私收益；抑制过多的发布保留多数类效用但显著损失少数类召回，而聚合指标掩盖了这一代价；标准kmin版PPI与披露上界仅中等相关、与部分知识攻击完全不相关，均值类规模变体PPI则与三类披露/攻击指标均强相关。
AI.conclusion: PPI应被理解为面向监管者的概括性总结，而非安全界。评估规模有限，趋势仅作指示性而非确定性结论。作者贡献在于隐私量化层：计算上述指标、执行变换策略，并通过可检查的仪表板呈现二者；画像数据由被动式运营商侧监测与规则型DPI产生。

title: No Transformer Beats Six Covariates: Long-Horizon Prediction of Depressive Symptoms from Childhood Essays
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) models can detect depression-related language in text written near the time symptoms are measured, but whether pretrained transformers can predict depressive symptoms from text written twelve years earlier is largely untested. In the National Child Development Study, a British birth cohort, we predict probable depressive symptoms at age 23 from essays the same people wrote at age 11. Our baseline, a logistic regression on six childhood covariates, outperforms every text model that sees only the essay: seven fine-tuned transformers, a bag-of-words model, frozen embeddings and four zero-shot large language models. Its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) is 0.737 against 0.670 for the best transformer on the primary seed, and no added text score detectably raises the baseline's AUC-ROC. None of the five domain-pretrained transformers detectably beats its general-domain control after Bonferroni correction. For long-horizon prediction, the baseline remains the model to beat.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用英国出生队列NCDS，用11岁作文预测23岁可能的抑郁症状，发现仅含六个童年协变量的逻辑回归基线（AUC-ROC 0.737）优于所有仅看作文的文本模型（最佳Transformer 0.670），且文本分数未能显著提升基线性能。
AI.motivation: NLP模型能从症状测量时间附近的文本中检测抑郁相关语言，但预训练Transformer能否从早十二年的文本预测抑郁症状尚缺乏检验。作者希望评估长时程（long-horizon）预测中文本模型相对童年协变量的增量价值。
AI.method: 在National Child Development Study（英国出生队列）中，以23岁可能的抑郁症状为结果，输入同一批人11岁时写的作文。比较对象包括：六个童年协变量的逻辑回归基线、七个微调Transformer、bag-of-words模型、frozen embeddings、四个零样本大语言模型；并对五个领域预训练Transformer与其通用域对照进行Bonferroni校正比较。
AI.result: 基线逻辑回归AUC-ROC为0.737，主种子下最佳Transformer仅0.670，所有仅看作文的模型均不及基线；加入文本分数后基线AUC-ROC没有可检测的提升；五个领域预训练Transformer在Bonferroni校正后均未可检测地优于其通用域对照。
AI.conclusion: 对于跨十二年的长时程抑郁症状预测，仅基于童年协变量的简单基线仍是难以超越的模型；仅凭早期作文文本的预训练Transformer、词袋、冻结嵌入及零样本大模型均未显示增量预测价值。

title: Does the Model Use the Feature? Separating Steering from Mechanism in LLMs
summary: Internal features in LLMs are often interpreted as mechanisms when they track a concept and their manipulation changes a related behavior. Yet steering can push a feature far outside its natural range, where its effects need not reflect the model's own computation. We examine this inference and propose an empirical contract whose tests evaluate features at values observed on natural inputs. One test copies a feature's value from an input that shows a behavior into a matched input that does not (installation) or the reverse (removal); the other restores the feature after an upstream edit (downstream rescue). Installation measures how far the feature suffices for the behavior; removal and downstream rescue measure how much the model uses it. Applied to three kinds of representations, the two strengths separate sharply. The published unknown-entity latent strongly steers knowledge abstention, yet installing observed values from either published latent into matched prompts transfers only a small fraction of the natural known--unknown abstention contrast. Dense known--unknown directions show opposite asymmetries between installation and removal in Gemma and Llama, and how fully a released subject--verb agreement feature set reproduces and restores the behavior depends on how its values are written into the model. Tracking a concept and steering a behavior therefore do not by themselves show that the model uses a feature, and each conclusion holds only for the intervention tested.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个"经验性契约"来检验LLM内部特征是否真是模型自身计算机制：只在自然输入上观测到的特征取值范围内做干预（安装/移除）与下游救援测试，发现跟踪概念并操纵行为并不足以证明模型使用了该特征。
AI.motivation: 当前普遍将LLM内部特征解释为机制，依据是它们跟踪某概念、且操纵该特征会改变相关行为。但操纵（steering）常把特征推到远超自然范围之外，此时效应未必反映模型真实的内部计算。因此需要一种更严格、基于自然输入取值的检验方法来评估特征是否为模型所实际使用。
AI.method: 提出经验性契约，其测试仅在自然输入上观测到的特征值处评估特征。包含两类测试：(1) 安装与移除——将呈现某行为的输入中的特征值复制到匹配的无此行为的输入中（安装），或反向操作（移除），用以衡量特征对行为的充分性；(2) 下游救援——在上游编辑之后恢复该特征的值，用以衡量模型对该特征的依赖程度。对三类表示进行应用。
AI.result: 充分性与依赖度两种强度出现明显分离。已发表未知实体潜变量对知识性弃答有强引导作用，但将已观测值安装到匹配提示上时，仅能传递自然已知—未知弃答对比的一小部分；dense 已知—未知方向在 Gemma 与 Llama 中表现出安装与移除之间相反的不对称性；已发布的主动—动词一致性特征集能否完整复现并恢复行为，取决于其取值如何写入模型。
AI.conclusion: 跟踪概念与操纵行为本身并不能证明模型使用了某特征；且每个结论仅对所测试的具体干预成立。评估特征是否为机制时，须在自然取值范围内做安装、移除与下游救援等检验，并限定结论的作用范围。

title: Identity-Conditioned Score Fusion for Open-Set Person Re-Identification
summary: Robust person re-identification often combines complementary cues such as face, gait, and body shape. While adaptive fusion typically targets query quality, model strength also varies across identities. We introduce identity-conditioned score fusion, a framework that tailors weights to each gallery identity without training. By contrasting intra-identity consistency against cross-identity impostors, it extracts identity-specific profiles that couple with query-conditioned adaptation via a parameter-free rule. This widens the separation between true and false matches while preserving score calibration. Evaluations on three clothes-changing person re-identification benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms statistical, rank-based, and learned baselines, achieving up to an 8.8% absolute reduction in the false non-identification rate and demonstrating the value of identity-conditioned fusion in open-set person re-identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出身份条件化分数融合框架，无需训练即可为每个图库身份定制融合权重，在三个换装行人重识别基准上取得优于统计、排序和学习类基线的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒行人重识别通常融合人脸、步态、体形等互补线索，但自适应融合主要关注查询质量，忽略了模型强度本身也随身份不同而变化。
AI.method: 提出身份条件化分数融合：通过对比同一身份内部一致性与跨身份冒充者，提取针对每个图库身份的特征画像，并以无参数规则与查询条件化自适应相结合，从而在保持分数校准的同时扩大真伪匹配的分离度。
AI.result: 在三个换装行人重识别基准上，方法持续超越统计类、基于排序和基于学习的基线，假非识别率最多实现8.8%的绝对下降。
AI.conclusion: 身份条件化融合在开放集行人重识别中具有重要价值。

title: Muon Is Theoretically Wrong For Convolutions, But Empirically Effective
summary: Muon, an optimizer known for its efficiency, has a clear interpretation for matrix-valued updates, but convolutional kernels are stored as four-dimensional tensors. Standard implementations reshape these tensors into matrices, a shortcut which breaks the theoretical understanding behind Muon. To investigate this, we formalize the corresponding optimization objective directly in convolutional operator geometry and introduce Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS), which approximates the polar factor in this geometry while preserving kernel support. When applied in fast training experiments, Conv-NS and reshape-based Muon are both computationally efficient and achieve comparable accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet classification tasks. However, as one could expect a theoretically aligned Conv-NS to outperform reshape-based Muon, we investigate this mismatch between practice and theoretical understanding, with the hypothesis that exact convolutional orthogonalization may overconstrain updates. These findings highlight Muon's strong practical performance while opening directions for its further development on convolutions. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/thib-s/muonconv-cifar10-airbench}{github conv-muon}.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Muon优化器在卷积核（四维张量）上的理论基础与实践差异，提出直接在卷积算子几何中形式化的Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS)，实验发现其与基于reshape的Muon在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上效率与精度相当，并假设精确卷积正交化可能过度约束更新。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器对矩阵更新的解释清晰，但卷积核以四维张量存储，标准实现将其reshape为矩阵，这一捷径破坏了Muon背后的理论理解。作者希望探究如何在卷积算子几何中正确形式化优化目标，并厘清理论对齐方法与实践中reshape方法表现相近的原因。
AI.method: 作者直接在卷积算子几何中形式化相应优化目标，提出Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS)，在保持核支撑（kernel support）的同时近似该几何下的极因子（polar factor）。随后在快速训练实验中，将Conv-NS与基于reshape的Muon在CIFAR-10和ImageNet分类任务上进行对比。
AI.result: Conv-NS与基于reshape的Muon均具有计算高效性，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet分类任务上取得可比精度。尽管理论对齐的Conv-NS预期应优于reshape-based Muon，实际并未观察到这一优势。作者据此假设精确卷积正交化可能过度约束更新（overconstrain updates），导致实践与理论理解之间的错位。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了Muon在实际中的强劲表现，同时为卷积场景下Muon的进一步发展打开了方向。代码已公开于 https://github.com/thib-s/muonconv-cifar10-airbench 。

title: Dynamics Modeling of a Multi-UAV Slung Load System Using a Discrete-Link Cable Approach
comment: Presented at ICRA 2026 as an accepted paper
summary: A common assumption to simplify the problem of controlling a multi-UAV slung load system (MUSLS) is that the flexible cables can be modeled as massless rigid rods. In this work, we propose an alternative Euler-Newton derived dynamical model which uses a series of rigid links to model the flexible cables. The model is specifically designed to allow efficient simulation using Featherstone's articulated body algorithm. We perform real-world validation of this model on gentle, aggressive, and tension-engagement maneuvers and run a parameter sweep to determine the number of links, joint damping, and joint friction to achieve the greatest model fidelity. The model closely matches real-world flight data with mean load translation errors below 132 mm (5.5% of the cable length) and orientation errors below 11.4 degrees.
