We make the real-world flight data publicly available for the development of future cable models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于刚体铰链串联建模柔性缆索的多无人机吊挂负载系统（MUSLS）动力学模型，采用欧拉-牛顿法推导，适配Featherstone铰接体算法以高效仿真，并通过实测飞行数据验证其保真度。
AI.motivation: 多无人机吊挂负载系统控制研究中，常将柔性缆索简化为无质量刚性杆，这种假设忽略缆索柔性，降低模型精度。作者希望建立更贴近真实缆索动力学的模型，同时保持仿真计算效率。
AI.method: 采用欧拉-牛顿法推导动力学模型，用一系列刚性连杆串联表示柔性缆索，并将模型结构设计为可用Featherstone铰接体算法高效仿真。在温和、剧烈及张力介入三类机动下进行实飞验证，并通过参数扫描确定连杆数、关节阻尼和关节摩擦的最优取值。
AI.result: 模型与真实飞行数据高度吻合：负载平移平均误差小于132 mm（约为缆索长度的5.5%），姿态误差小于11.4度。作者将实飞数据公开，供后续缆索模型研究使用。
AI.conclusion: 用多刚体连杆链建模柔性缆索并结合Featherstone算法，可在保证仿真效率的同时显著提升MUSLS模型保真度，且经多类机动实测验证可靠，公开数据有助于推动缆索建模研究。

title: ASCENT: First-Order Optimal Fine-Tuning with Recalibration for Safety--Utility Co-Enhancement
summary: Supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve the downstream utility of large language models (LLMs) but may compromise their safety. Existing safety-preserving methods constrain downstream updates using safety-related parameters or subspaces, but mainly focus on safety preservation rather than joint safety and utility enhancement, lack a theoretical characterization of the optimal safety-related subspace and safety-preserving task update, and typically rely on a static safety subspace that may become outdated during fine-tuning. To address these limitations, we propose ASCENT, a downstream fine-tuning framework for safety--utility co-enhancement through first-order optimal safety-aware periodic calibration and task optimization. We model safety as a function of LLM parameters $S(θ)$ and use its first-order approximation to characterize safety changes under parameter updates. Under a fixed rank and Frobenius-norm budget, we prove that the update constructed from the top-$r$ singular components of the safety-function gradient maximizes the estimated safety change, and use it for periodic calibration to preserve and improve safety. We further derive a unique safety-preserving task update that stays close to the original task update while penalizing negative effects on the estimated safety change. ASCENT alternates these optimal task and calibration updates to jointly enhance safety and utility. Experiments across multiple LLM families and downstream tasks show that ASCENT improves downstream utility by up to 20.3\% and reduces attack success rate by up to 35.5\%, achieving state-of-the-art safety and utility across all evaluated settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-LLM-Safety/ASCENT.

AI.tldr: 提出ASCENT框架，通过一阶最优安全感知的周期性校准与任务优化，实现下游微调中安全与效用的协同增强，兼顾理论最优子空间推导与动态校准。
AI.motivation: 监督微调能提升大模型下游效用，但可能损害安全性。现有保安全方法多基于安全相关参数或子空间约束更新，主要关注安全保持而非安全与效用协同提升，缺乏对最优安全相关子空间与保安全任务更新的理论刻画，且多依赖静态安全子空间，在微调过程中可能过时失效。
AI.method: 将安全建模为参数函数S(θ)，用其一阶近似刻画参数更新引起的安全变化；在固定秩与Frobenius范数预算下，证明由安全函数梯度前r个奇异分量构造的更新可最大化估计的安全变化，并用于周期性校准；进一步推导唯一保安全任务更新，使其贴近原始任务更新同时惩罚对估计安全变化的负面影响；交替执行最优任务更新与校准更新。
AI.result: 在多类LLM家族与下游任务上，ASCENT将下游效用最高提升20.3%，攻击成功率最高降低35.5%，在所有评估设置中达到安全与效用的最优表现。
AI.conclusion: ASCENT通过理论最优的安全子空间构造与周期性校准，实现了下游微调中安全与效用的联合增强，并优于现有保安全方法。

title: Reading, Not Manipulating: Leveraging Router Logits for Multimodal Safety in MoE Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face compositional safety risks where harmful intent emerges from the interaction between visual and textual inputs. As mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs become increasingly common, recent work has explored various safety interventions, including prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and routing-based expert steering. However, these methods show inconsistent improvements across models and evaluation distributions, and the intervention into model behavior or internal states introduce safety-utility tradeoffs by over-refusal. Rather than manipulating internal states to steer model behavior, we instead ask whether routing states can serve as diagnostic signals for multimodal safety. We find that router logits indeed provide highly predictive signals of whether a multimodal input is safe or not. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight router-logit safety detector that reads out routing signals during prompt prefill and identifies unsafe requests before generation, without modifying model parameters or expert routing. Across Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL, the proposed detector substantially reduces safety errors on the HoliSafe benchmark and resoundingly generalizes to out-of-distribution safety benchmarks featuring different safety patterns, including MISHard and MM-SafetyBench. The success of the proposed router-logit detector also suggests a broader perspective on model internals: rather than focusing only on manipulating internal components to steer behavior, simply reading naturally emerging signals and linking them to an external safety mechanism can provide a simple, effective, and non-intrusive complement to existing safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MoE视觉语言模型的router logits可高度预测多模态输入的安全性，据此提出一个轻量级、非侵入式的router-logit安全检测器，在生成前识别不安全请求，在多个基准上显著降低安全错误并具备良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型存在组合式安全风险，即有害意图源于视觉与文本输入的交互。随着MoE架构VLM日益普及，已有安全干预手段（提示、监督微调、路由专家调控）在不同模型与评测分布上提升不稳定，且对模型行为或内部状态的干预会因过度拒答带来安全-效用权衡。因此作者转向一个新问题：路由状态能否作为多模态安全的诊断信号，而非用于操控模型行为。
AI.method: 作者先验证router logits能够高预测性地指示多模态输入是否安全，随后提出一个轻量级router-logit安全检测器：在prompt prefill阶段读取路由信号，在生成之前判别不安全请求，全程不修改模型参数，也不改动专家路由。该方法将模型内部自然涌现的信号外接到一个外部安全机制。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL与Kimi-VL上，该检测器在HoliSafe基准上大幅减少安全错误；并强力泛化到具有不同安全模式的分布外基准，包括MISHard与MM-SafetyBench。
AI.conclusion: router-logit检测器的成功提供了关于模型内部表征的更广义视角：与其只关注操控内部组件来引导行为，不如直接读取自然涌现的信号并将其链接到外部安全机制，从而为现有安全干预提供一种简单、有效且非侵入式的补充。

title: A Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation
summary: Deterministic benchmark scores show that an agent received credit, but not whether that credit was earned, reported honestly, or would hold on a second run. We introduce a Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation, an additive post-hoc framework that reports, beside each recorded score, whether it should be believed. It verifies four properties: whether the result is supported by the benchmark's own grading logic, whether a passing answer was earned through traceable computation, whether the agent's completion claim matches what occurred, and whether the result is stable under repeated execution. The first three use only saved artifacts; the fourth re-runs the agent. Model judgments only label evidence under majority voting; all verdicts follow deterministic rules and never modify the recorded score. Applied to five agent configurations on 108 tasks from Agents' Last Exam, every model shows passing runs with no traceable computation (at rates varying tenfold), confirmed false completion claims, and unstable results: 18-46% of tasks do not stay in one score band over five runs. Only 22.6% of recorded passes clear all four checks (95% CI 15.0-32.6, n=84). Measuring what an agent can do and verifying that it did it are different problems, and current benchmarks address only the first.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信任层"（Trust Layer），一个附加式事后评估框架，在记录分数旁标注该分数是否可信，通过对四种属性（依据评测评分逻辑、可追溯计算、完成声明一致性、重复执行稳定性）的验证来提高智能体评测的可信度。
AI.motivation: 确定性基准分数只能表明智能体获得了分数，却无法说明该分数是否真实获得、是否被诚实报告、是否在重跑时依然成立。测量智能体能力与验证其确实做到是两类不同的问题，而现有基准只解决了前者。
AI.method: 该框架为附加式、事后（post-hoc）设计，不修改原始记录分数。验证四项属性：（1）结果是否得到基准自身评分逻辑的支持；（2）通过的答案是否源于可追溯的计算过程；（3）智能体的完成声明是否与实际发生的情况一致；（4）结果在重复执行下是否稳定。前两项仅使用已保存的工件，第四项需重跑智能体。模型判断仅以多数投票方式标注证据，所有裁定遵循确定性规则。
AI.result: 在 Agents' Last Exam 的 108 个任务、五种智能体配置上应用：所有模型均出现通过但无可追溯计算的运行（比例相差十倍）、被证实的虚假完成声明，以及不稳定结果——18%–46% 的任务在五次运行中无法保持在同一分数区间。仅有 22.6% 的记录通过项能通过全部四项检查（95% CI 15.0–32.6，n=84）。
AI.conclusion: 测量智能体能做什么与验证其确实做过是不同的问题，当前基准仅触及前者。该信任层通过附加式确定性验证，为记录分数提供可信度标注，揭示了现有评测结果中被掩盖的真实性与稳定性缺陷。

title: SimCortex v2: Joint Cortical Surface Reconstruction with Near-Zero Collisions and Self-Intersections
summary: Reconstructing cortical WM and pial surfaces from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a prerequisite for surface-based neuroanatomical analysis, yet remains challenging because the cortex is thin and tightly folded. Reconstruction methods can produce geometric artifacts such as mesh self-intersections and collisions between cortical surfaces, and although recent deep learning methods have reduced reconstruction time from hours to minutes, these artifacts persist. We propose SimCortex v2, a deep learning framework for simultaneous reconstruction of the left and right WM and pial surfaces from T1-weighted MRI. SimCortex v2 estimates topologically correct initial surfaces from a volumetric segmentation and refines all four jointly using multi-scale stationary velocity fields predicted by a ribbon-conditioned, U-Net-like network. We evaluated SimCortex v2 on 560 cases from 14 cohorts, thirteen of them unseen during training, spanning ages 6-89, healthy and clinical populations, and scanners from three vendors. SimCortex v2 matched the surface-distance accuracy of the strongest baseline (average symmetric surface distance 0.253 mm) while showing no detected inter-surface collision in 92.14% of cases and the lowest self-intersection fraction (0.044%) among learning-based methods, whereas every baseline produced at least one collision in every case. Source code, configuration files, pretrained weights, preprocessed data, and the exact evaluation splits are publicly released.

AI.tldr: SimCortex v2 是一个深度学习框架，可从 T1 加权 MRI 同时重建左右半球的白质与软脑膜表面，并显著减少几何伪影。
AI.motivation: 皮层薄且折叠紧密，表面重建易产生网格自相交与皮层表面间碰撞等几何伪影；现有深度学习方法虽将重建时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，但伪影问题仍未解决。
AI.method: 基于体积分割估计拓扑正确的初始表面，利用带状条件（ribbon-conditioned）的类 U-Net 网络预测多尺度平稳速度场，对四个表面联合细化。
AI.result: 在来自 14 个队列的 560 例（13 个队列训练中未见过）上评估，覆盖 6-89 岁、健康与临床人群及三家厂商扫描仪；表面距离精度与最强基线持平（平均对称表面距离 0.253 mm），92.14% 的病例未检测到表面间碰撞，自相交比例（0.044%）为学习类方法中最低，而所有基线在每个病例中至少产生一次碰撞。
AI.conclusion: SimCortex v2 在保持高精度重建的同时有效抑制几何伪影，提升重建质量，并公开源代码、配置、预训练权重、预处理数据与评估划分。

title: LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library
summary: UAVs that act as relays or base stations need accurate air-to-ground path-loss predictions for rate adaptation and placement, but propagation conditions change as a UAV moves between suburban, urban and high-rise areas, and the same areas are often revisited. Online regressors that adapt by forgetting must relearn each environment from scratch, whereas a single model trained on all data averages incompatible regimes. We propose LiLib, a lightweight continual-learning scheme in which a UAV maintains a small library of recursive-least-squares experts. A windowed residual test detects drift; a short probe phase then either reuses the best stored expert or creates a new one. In simulations based on four standard urbanization profiles, LiLib reduces prediction RMSE from 5.89 dB (best sliding-window baseline) to 4.03 dB (p < 0.001), lowers the error shortly after a return to a known environment from 12.3 dB to 5.7 dB, and recovers 99% of the throughput of a regime-aware oracle in rate adaptation. The library stores four experts in under 0.5 KB, and identifies regimes with 92% purity without labels. When a second UAV is initialized with the library of a peer, its error after environment changes halves. LiLib does not reach the oracle, and similar regimes may be merged when shadowing is strong. The results indicate that, for recurring drift, remembering is more effective than re-adapting.

AI.tldr: 提出LiLib——一种轻量级持续学习方案，无人机维护小型递归最小二乘（RLS）专家库，通过窗口残差检测漂移并复用或新建专家，实现空对地路径损耗的准确预测。
AI.motivation: 无人机作为中继或基站需要精确的空对地路径损耗预测以进行速率自适应和布点；但无人机在郊区、城区和高层建筑区间移动时传播条件不断变化，且常会重回旧环境。在线回归器通过遗忘来适应会导致每个环境都需从头重新学习；而单一模型在全部数据上训练则会平均掉不兼容的不同regime。
AI.method: LiLib：无人机维护一个由少量递归最小二乘（RLS）专家组成的小型库；使用加窗残差检验检测漂移；检测到漂移后进入短探测（probe）阶段，决定复用库中最佳专家或创建新专家。基于四个标准城市化剖面进行仿真验证。
AI.result: 预测RMSE由最佳滑动窗口基线的5.89 dB降至4.03 dB（p < 0.001）；重返已知环境后短期内误差由12.3 dB降至5.7 dB；在速率自适应中恢复regime感知oracle吞吐量的99%；专家库以不足0.5 KB存储4个专家，无标签下regime识别纯度为92%；当第二台无人机用同伴的专家库初始化时，环境变化后误差减半。
AI.conclusion: LiLib无法完全达到oracle水平，且在强阴影下相似regime可能被合并。结果表明，对于反复出现的漂移场景，“记忆”比重适应更有效。

title: SURGE: Sonar-fUsed Reconstruction and localization via image-gated Graph Estimation
summary: Remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) are widely used to explore and inspect underwater environments such as caves, shipwrecks, and submerged infrastructure. These missions require accurate 3D understanding of the surrounding environment, which depends on both reliable vehicle localization and metric scene reconstruction. However, external positioning is often unavailable underwater, requiring small ROVs to rely primarily on onboard perception. Optic vision provides rich visual and geometric information but suffers from scale ambi- guity and trajectory drift, whereas 2D imaging sonar provides metric range but incomplete 3D geometry. Existing underwater reconstruction approaches typically address these limitations separately or assume known sensor poses, leaving localization and reconstruction disconnected. We present SURGE, a camera sonar framework that jointly estimates the ROV trajectory and target location by integrating visual and acoustic observations within a factor graph, then uses the recovered metric poses for sonar Gaussian splatting. Experiments on real underwater RGB sonar observations show that SURGE substantially improves localization consistency over conventional vision based pose estimation and produces a more compact, natively metric reconstruction than RGB Gaussian splatting baselines.

AI.tldr: SURGE 是一个相机-声呐因子图框架，联合估计 ROV 轨迹与目标位置，并将恢复的度量位姿用于声呐高斯泼溅重建。
AI.motivation: ROV 在水下探测中需要精确 3D 理解，但外部定位常不可用，光学视觉存在尺度模糊与轨迹漂移，2D 成像声呐提供度量距离却缺乏完整 3D 几何，现有方法往往单独处理这些限制或假设已知传感器位姿，导致定位与重建脱节。
AI.method: 提出 SURGE：在因子图中融合视觉与声学观测，联合估计 ROV 轨迹和目标位置，再利用恢复的度量位姿进行声呐高斯泼溅。
AI.result: 在真实水下 RGB-声呐观测上，SURGE 相比传统基于视觉的位姿估计显著提升定位一致性，并生成比 RGB 高斯泼溅基线更紧凑、原生度量的重建。
AI.conclusion: 联合视觉-声学观测与因子图优化可实现定位与重建的耦合，在无外部定位的水下场景中同时改善 ROV 位姿一致性和度量重建质量。

title: Systematically Optimized CNN-Transformer with Focal Loss for Imbalanced Intrusion Detection on NSL-KDD
summary: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) struggle with imbalanced datasets like NSL-KDD, especially in detecting rare R2L and U2R attacks. This work describes a systematically optimized and explainable framework using a CNN-Transformer architecture to improve performance on highly imbalanced data. We decided to use XGBoost for feature selection and Focal Loss as the main mechanism for minority class learning. We used Optuna for end-to-end hyrate=0.00042, batch size=256, and Focal Loss γ), using a thoughtful data splitting process to prevent data leakage. Critically, our ablation studies pointed out that while Focal Loss (optimally at γ = 1.5) substantially enhanced minority recall, adding oversampling methods like SMOTE caused precision degradation via over-correction. Our final model, using only tuned Focal Loss, achieved 98.73% overall accuracy on the NSL-KDD test data, with significantly balanced F1-scores of 84.63% (R2L) and 69.66% (U2R) over baseline approaches. Additionally, we performed SHAP analysis to understand model predictions, understand salient features (e.g., service http, logged in), and explain the persistent U2R precision challenge due to feature overlap. This study presents a comprehensive pipeline for imbalanced IDS, providing methodological insights, and demonstrates that tuned Focal Loss can be a sufficient and effective strategy for class balancing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个系统优化且可解释的CNN-Transformer入侵检测框架，结合XGBoost特征选择、Optuna超参优化与调优的Focal Loss（γ=1.5），在NSL-KDD上达到98.73%总体准确率，并显著提升R2L与U2R少数类检测性能，同时证明单独使用Focal Loss即可有效处理类不平衡，无需SMOTE等过采样。
AI.motivation: 入侵检测系统在NSL-KDD等不平衡数据集上表现不佳，尤其难以检测稀有的R2L和U2R攻击；现有方法在少数类学习与精度之间难以平衡，且普遍缺乏可解释性，亟需一个系统优化、可解释且针对高度不平衡数据的检测框架。
AI.method: 采用CNN-Transformer架构；使用XGBoost进行特征选择；以Focal Loss作为少数类学习的主要机制；利用Optuna进行端到端超参数优化（学习率=0.00042，batch size=256，Focal Loss的γ）；设计严谨的数据划分流程以避免数据泄漏；并通过消融实验对比Focal Loss与SMOTE等过采样方法的效果；最后借助SHAP分析解释模型预测。
AI.result: 最终模型仅使用调优后的Focal Loss（γ=1.5），在NSL-KDD测试集上取得98.73%的总体准确率，R2L的F1-score为84.63%，U2R的F1-score为69.66%，均显著优于基线方法；消融实验表明Focal Loss大幅提升少数类召回率，而引入SMOTE等过采样方法会因过度校正导致精度下降；SHAP分析识别出service http、logged in等显著特征，并解释了U2R因特征重叠而持续存在的精度难题。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为不平衡入侵检测提供了一套完整流程，并给出方法论层面的洞见：经过调优的Focal Loss可以作为一种充分且有效的类别平衡策略，无需依赖SMOTE等过采样方法；同时通过SHAP增强了模型可解释性，为后续研究提供了参考。

title: APEX: Speculate smarter, not deeper
summary: Speculative decoding reduces large language model inference latency by drafting multiple tokens before target-model verification, but its effectiveness depends on both the proposal mechanism and draft depth. Fixed configurations cannot respond to changes in predictability, repetition, and acceptance during generation, so deeper drafting can increase wasted computation without proportional speedup. We introduce APEX, a learned controller that balances decoding speed and draft-token waste through request-level expert selection and block-level depth adaptation. APEX-Router selects among EAGLE-3, n-gram, and draft-model speculation for each request, while APEX-Depth adjusts draft length at each verification block using causal decoding signals and recent verifier feedback. APEX models accepted draft length as censored survival feedback, learning position-wise rejection hazards, block execution costs, and an action utility that balances throughput, accepted progress, and wasted tokens. This allows the controller to adapt speculation while retaining the target model's verification procedure. We integrate APEX into vLLM and evaluate it with Qwen3-8B across six workloads, achieving up to 5.24X speedup over autoregressive decoding. Across the aggregate evaluation, APEX-S achieves 4.27X speedup, while APEX-B achieves 3.27X speedup with a 41.0% relative reduction in wasted-token percentage compared with fixed n-gram speculation at k=16, providing distinct operating points for balancing acceleration and draft-token utilization.

AI.tldr: APEX 是一种学习式控制器，通过请求级专家选择与块级草稿深度自适应，在投机解码中动态平衡加速与草稿令牌浪费。
AI.motivation: 固定投机解码配置无法应对生成过程中可预测性、重复性与接受率的变化，加深草稿可能增加无效计算而无法获得成比例加速，因此需要自适应控制机制。
AI.method: APEX 包含 APEX-Router 与 APEX-Depth：前者为每个请求在 EAGLE-3、n-gram 与草稿模型投机间选择专家；后者在每个验证块利用因果解码信号与近期验证器反馈调整草稿长度。它将接受草稿长度建模为删失生存反馈，学习位置级拒绝风险、块执行成本及权衡吞吐、被接受进度与浪费令牌的动作效用，同时保留目标模型的验证流程。系统集成于 vLLM。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与六个工作负载上，APEX 相较自回归解码最高取得 5.24X 加速；聚合评估中 APEX-S 达 4.27X，APEX-B 达 3.27X，并在 k=16 的固定 n-gram 投机基线下将浪费令牌百分比相对降低 41.0%。
AI.conclusion: APEX 通过请求级专家选择与块级深度自适应，为投机解码提供可平衡加速与草稿令牌利用率的不同工作点，并可与目标模型验证流程兼容地集成。

title: The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 26 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". Code: https://github.com/ziwang11112/right-memory-wrong-context
summary: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure. We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.

AI.tldr: 提出检索可采性验证框架，区分可采/不可采/未决三种记忆-查询对状态，在匹配必需证据召回率下比较路线，并追踪记忆ID的提示暴露与答案披露。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆代理会检索到对当前请求不可采的信息（属于其他主体、违反政策或生命周期状态不兼容）。召回率和最终答案准确率无法揭示该问题：路线可能因遗漏必需证据而看似安全，正确答案也可能源于不可采的提示暴露。
AI.method: 为每个记忆-查询对赋予三种状态（可采、不可采、未决）；在匹配必需证据召回率下比较路线并给出未决情形的界限；追踪记忆ID在提示暴露中的流转，并将暴露与目标级披露相关联；在独立的非汇合人群上分阶段评估。
AI.result: 对RHELM和MemOps两个公开基准的冻结排序做事后top-20重分析，覆盖3,767条查询：释放锚点均位于可信查询命名空间内，命名空间内分数不变，故命名空间外过滤不会降低其排名；top-20锚点召回率由0.432升至0.533，80%召回可行性由0.237升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%。在冻结的72例开发诊断中，释放元数据参照可保留必需证据，而两种纯文本验证器在1%必需锚点误拒限下均无法检出违规。在1,523对基准原生案例中，命名空间路由对应三个阅读器上0.053–0.068的判定准确率增益，但召回率亦变化，故为观察性比较。在16个受控暴露场景中，四个阅读器只有其一关于相关-不可采字面披露的95%置信区间排除零（+0.156，95% CI [0.031, 0.312]）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对候选支持、可采性、提示暴露与答案披露分别进行独立验证，而非仅依赖召回率或最终答案准确率。

title: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
summary: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoWM，一个直接预测未来场景几何的几何世界模型，避免递归展开，在深度、相机位姿和3D几何预测上优于现有世界模型并显著降低推理时间。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶与机器人需要对3D场景几何及其随时间演化进行建模。现有世界模型范式通过预测未来图像或隐表示再恢复几何，未显式建模几何结构，且依赖递归展开以覆盖较长预测时域，导致误差累积与计算成本上升。
AI.method: GeoWM 直接预测指定未来时刻的场景几何，无需递归展开。核心是用几何基础模型把观测RGB帧转换为几何历史，作为条件输入流匹配（flow-matching）Transformer，以预测指定未来时域的几何。此外引入轻量相机运动预测器估计未来视点，并将观测几何投影到预测视点作为有效的几何先验。
AI.result: 在涵盖城市驾驶、空中飞行和动态操作四个数据集上的实验表明，GeoWM 在深度、相机位姿和3D场景几何预测方面优于所评估的世界模型，同时在更长预测时域下大幅降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: 直接、非递归地预测未来场景几何并辅以未来视点投影先验，是提升长期几何预测精度与效率的有效范式。

title: Sample-Optimal Estimation of the Fréchet Inception Distance
summary: The Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is widely used to evaluate generative models, but its empirical plug-in estimator suffers from finite-sample bias [BSAG18, CF20]. We study the sample complexity $n$ of estimating FID to error $ε$ between $d$-dimensional Gaussians with bounded mean distance and covariances, when one distribution is known. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We establish tight finite-sample $Θ(\frac{d^2}{n})$ bias and $Θ(\frac{d}{n} + \frac {d^2} {n^2})$ variance bounds for the empirical plug-in estimator, establishing a $\gtrsim d^2$ sample complexity. (2) To debias the empirical plug-in estimator, we generalize the ${\rm FID}_\infty$ estimator of [CF20] to extrapolation methods of arbitrary order $k$. We further prove tight bias and variance bounds of $Θ(\frac{d^{k + 2}}{n^{k + 1}})$ and $Θ(\frac d n + \frac{d^2}{n^2})$ for any order-$k$ extrapolation under our framework. (3) We introduce Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD), a new, computationally efficient FID estimation algorithm using debiasing techniques inspired by U-statistics. We show that RTD achieves an $O(\frac d {ε^2})$ sample complexity, and prove that this is optimal. We provide a complementary empirical evaluation of our new estimators. Our experiments on synthetic Gaussians validate the predicted residual bias and support the tightness of our bounds. On ImageNet with Inception embeddings, RTD achieves the lowest mean estimation error at the standard 50K sample budget, while our second-order variance-aware extrapolation estimator (VALE$_2$) uses only 10K samples to achieve accuracy comparable to FID$_\infty$ at 50K samples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了已知一个高斯分布的情况下，FID经验plug-in估计器的有限样本偏差与方差，提出了紧致的样本复杂度界、任意阶外推去偏框架及基于U统计量的RTD算法，并证明RTD达到最优O(d/ε²)样本复杂度，实验验证了理论与在ImageNet上的有效性。
AI.motivation: FID广泛用于评估生成模型，但其经验plug-in估计器存在有限样本偏差。作者希望在分布为有界均值距离与协方差的高斯、且其中一个分布已知的设定下，精确刻画估计FID到误差ε所需的样本复杂度n，并设计更高效的估计器。
AI.method: 1) 对经验plug-in估计器建立有限样本的偏差Θ(d²/n)与方差Θ(d/n + d²/n²)紧界；2) 将[CF20]的FID_∞估计器推广为任意阶k的外推方法，并证明其偏差Θ(d^{k+2}/n^{k+1})与方差Θ(d/n + d²/n²)的紧界；3) 受U统计量启发提出计算高效的Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD)算法。
AI.result: 理论上证明经验plug-in估计器需要约d²量级的样本复杂度，RTD达到O(d/ε²)样本复杂度并证明其为最优。合成高斯实验验证了预测的残余偏差与界的紧致性；在ImageNet的Inception嵌入上，RTD在标准50K样本预算下取得最低平均估计误差，二阶方差感知外推估计器VALE₂仅用10K样本即可达到FID_∞在50K样本下的精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了FID估计的紧致有限样本理论刻画，提出的任意阶外推去偏框架和RTD算法显著降低了样本复杂度，并在合成与真实数据上验证了理论的有效性与实用性。

title: Risk-Sensitive Crowd Navigation with Adaptive Ellipsoidal Conformal Prediction
summary: Safe crowd navigation under distribution shift requires uncertainty representations that capture structured human-motion prediction errors and safety objectives that account for rare but consequential failures. Existing uncertainty-aware methods typically represent prediction errors using isotropic regions, which can be either overly conservative or poorly aligned with directional motion uncertainty. We introduce a risk-aware navigation framework that uses anisotropic conformal ellipsoids to translate structured prediction uncertainty into an episode-level conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) signal that regulates the Lagrangian safety penalty. In particular, adaptive ellipsoidal conformal prediction (AECP) captures directional prediction errors and adaptively calibrates uncertainty regions under distribution shift, while the resulting CVaR-regulated navigation policy is optimized using Lagrangian proximal policy optimization. We evaluate our proposed method under both in-distribution settings and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings involving shifts in pedestrian motion patterns. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our method maintains competitive in-distribution performance while improving success rates by 5.68-7.44 percentage points and reducing collision rates by 5.44-6.64 percentage points across OOD settings. We further deploy the trained policy without fine-tuning on a physical robot with onboard perception and CPU-only inference, showing that the full pipeline is feasible in physical crowd navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种风险感知人群导航框架，用各向异性保形椭球将结构化预测不确定性转化为回合级CVaR信号以调节拉格朗日安全惩罚，在OOD场景下显著提升成功率并降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 分布偏移下的人群导航需要能刻画结构化行人运动预测误差的不确定性表示，以及能应对罕见但后果严重失败的安全目标。现有不确定性感知方法多采用各向同性区域表示预测误差，要么过于保守，要么与方向性运动不确定性对齐不佳。
AI.method: 提出风险感知导航框架：1）自适应椭球保形预测（AECP）捕捉方向性预测误差，并在分布偏移下自适应校准不确定性区域；2）将结构化预测不确定性转化为回合级条件风险价值（CVaR）信号，用于调节拉格朗日安全惩罚；3）采用拉格朗日近端策略优化（Lagrangian PPO）优化所得CVaR调节导航策略。
AI.result: 在分布内与分布外（OOD，涉及行人运动模式偏移）设置下评估。相比最先进基线，分布内性能保持竞争力，OOD下成功率提升5.68–7.44个百分点，碰撞率降低5.44–6.64个百分点。训练策略无需微调即可部署到搭载机载感知、仅用CPU推理的实体机器人上，验证全流程可行性。
AI.conclusion: 各向异性保形椭球结合CVaR调节的安全约束可有效应对分布偏移下的人群导航，兼顾分布内性能与OOD鲁棒性，并具备实体机器人部署可行性。

title: Explainable Rule Mining of IPv6 Extension-Header Presence Patterns from Paired-Vantage Captures
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
summary: IPv6 extension headers (EHs), such as fragmentation, segment routing, and in-situ telemetry, are operationally important yetwidely dropped in transit, and characterising their behaviour from packet captures is a recurring measurement problem. We ask whetheran explainable miner can recover human-readable rules of EH behaviour, and we contribute two reusable tools: a negative-control protocol that diagnoses whether a mined "temporal" network rule reflects genuine cross-packet dynamics or mere within-packetco-occurrence, and a sender-conditioned, per-family EH-retention measurement. Applying an interpretable temporal-logic rule miner to the JAMES paired-vantage dataset, we recover a portable Fragment-EH rule that the protocol reveals to be a within-packet,near-definitional co-occurrence rather than a temporal pattern, so the temporal-logic machinery does no work for this dominant rule;the retention measurement independently recovers the expected within-window ordering of EH observability. Our main result istherefore an honest, controlled negative finding, corroborated by executed decision-tree and large-language-model baselines: on theevaluated JAMES traces network-temporal structure does not carry the dominant Fragment-EH signal, and we supply the controls thatestablish when it would, validated on a synthetic positive control containing a genuine cross-packet dependency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两个可复用工具——诊断“时间性”规则是否仅为包内共现的阴性对照协议，以及发送方条件化的按族EH保留度测量——并将可解释时序逻辑规则挖掘应用于JAMES配对观测点数据集，得到一个诚实的受控阴性结论：主导的Fragment-EH规则实为包内近乎定义性的共现，而非跨包时间模式。
AI.motivation: IPv6扩展头（EH，如分片、段路由、带内遥测）在运营上重要却常在中转中被丢弃，从抓包中刻画其行为是反复出现的测量难题。作者追问：可解释的挖掘器能否恢复人类可读的EH行为规则；同时希望厘清所挖掘的“时间性”网络规则究竟反映真实的跨包动态，还是仅为包内共现。
AI.method: 将可解释的时序逻辑规则挖掘器应用于JAMES配对观测点（paired-vantage）数据集；设计阴性对照协议来诊断挖掘出的“时间性”规则是否源自真正的跨包动态；并构建发送方条件化、按EH族的保留度测量；辅以已执行的决策树与大语言模型基线；另用含真实跨包依赖的合成阳性对照进行验证。
AI.result: 恢复出一条可移植的Fragment-EH规则，但阴性对照协议显示它属于包内、近乎定义性的共现，而非时间模式，故时序逻辑机制对该主导规则不起作用；保留度测量独立地复现了EH可观测性在窗口内的预期排序；决策树与LLM基线得出相同结论。合成阳性对照验证了对照方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一个诚实、受控的阴性发现：在所评估的JAMES流量中，网络时间结构并不承载主导的Fragment-EH信号；同时给出可判定“何时时间结构才会起作用”的对照方法，并配套两个可复用工具。

title: One Step at a Time: Trading LLM Autonomy for Process Predictability
summary: Organizations automating operational processes need more than a correct outcome: they need to predict how a process will run, know which one actually ran, and inspect it step by step. When an agent is the executor that predictability is normally lost: the prescribed procedure goes into the system prompt, and only a final answer comes back. We deliver the procedure step by step over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead: a server releases one step at a time, the agent executes it, and each step returns a structured step_output. This trades autonomy for predictability, and two properties then follow by construction, independent of the executor. The execution path is prescribed before the run, so the process is predictable in advance rather than reconstructed afterwards; and the completed step records form a machine-readable execution log that downstream tooling can audit and optimize step by step. Evaluating 15,475 trials across 13 SOP-Bench domains and four open-weight executors from frontier (Kimi K2.5) to lightweight (Ministral 3 8B), we find step-level delivery makes the executed process predictable and inspectable for every executor, and additionally raises accuracy when the executor is small. Across all four, process adherence rises significantly (76-95% to 95-99%) and ungrounded answers (correct outputs produced without executing the SOP) near-vanish, falling from 2.1-4.5% to 0.2-0.3% of trials (all 95% CIs exclude zero); under prompt-based delivery, 31-49% of correct answers on know_your_business bypass the SOP entirely, even for the frontier executor. Accuracy is where the executor's capability enters: the lightweight executor gains +6.5pp grounded accuracy because supplying the process externally removes a reconstruction burden it cannot carry, while capable ones trade a small raw-accuracy decrement for a predictable, auditable process.

AI.tldr: 通过MCP逐步下发流程步骤而非在系统提示中一次性给出，可将智能体执行过程变为事前可预测且可审计的机器可读日志，显著提升流程遵循度并消除无依据回答，对轻量级执行器还能提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 组织在自动化运营流程时不仅需要正确结果，还需要事前预测流程走向、确认实际执行的流程，并能逐步审查。但当智能体作为执行器时，流程被放入系统提示且只返回最终答案，这种可预测性通常丧失。作者希望通过改变流程下发方式来恢复可预测性与可审查性。
AI.method: 提出基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的逐步下发机制：服务器一次释放一个步骤，智能体执行该步骤，每步返回结构化的step_output。该设计以牺牲自主性换取可预测性，并由此构造性地获得两个与执行器无关的性质：执行路径在运行前即被规定（事前可预测而非事后重建）；完成的步骤记录构成机器可读的执行日志，供下游工具审计与逐步优化。在13个SOP-Bench领域、4个开放权重执行器（从Kimi K2.5到轻量级Ministral 3 8B）上共评估15,475次试验。
AI.result: 步骤级下发使所有执行器执行的过程都变得可预测、可审查，并在执行器较小时额外提升准确率。四类执行器的流程遵循度显著提升（76-95%升至95-99%），无依据回答（未执行SOP却产出正确输出）几乎消失，从2.1-4.5%降至0.2-0.3%（所有95%置信区间均不含零）。提示词下发模式下，即便前沿执行器在有知识任务上也有31-49%的正确答案完全绕过SOP。准确率方面体现执行器能力差异：轻量级执行器因外部提供流程而卸下其无法承担的重建负担，有依据准确率提升+6.5个百分点；能力强的执行器则以少量原始准确率下降换取可预测、可审计的流程。
AI.conclusion: 将流程通过MCP逐步下发，能以牺牲自主性为代价换取与执行器无关的可预测性与可审计性，普遍提升流程遵循度并消除无依据回答；准确率的收益依执行器能力而异，轻量级模型获益明显，强模型则以轻微准确率代价获得可控流程。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory
summary: Agentic memory allows LLM agents to reuse past experience, yet retrieved memories can also distort inference even when they are benign, correctly stored, and appropriately retrieved. We study this failure mode, which we call memory over-reliance. Across benchmarks and memory architectures, we find that memory is useful when past experience transfers to the current task, but can become misleading when only part of the evidence transfers. Failures are strongest under partial query-memory overlap, a pattern further confirmed by controlled experiments thatvary the amount of overlapping evidence. Motivated by this finding, we propose MEMTRIM, a plug-and-play framework that indexes memory evidence at write time and controls its reuse at read time. MEMTRIM removes repeated or conflicting evidence while preserving useful memory-specific information, requires no retraining, and applies to both embedding-based and structured memory systems.Experiments show that MEMTRIM reduces memory overreliance while preserving the benefits of useful memory across models and memory settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM智能体的"记忆过度依赖"失效模式，并提出即插即用框架MEMTRIM，通过写入时索引证据、读取时控制复用，在不重训练的前提下减少过度依赖同时保留有用记忆的收益。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆可让LLM智能体复用过往经验，但即便记忆是良性的、被正确存储且被恰当检索，检索到的记忆仍可能扭曲推理。作者将这一失效模式称为"记忆过度依赖"，并指出过往经验能够迁移到当前任务时记忆有用，而当只有部分证据迁移时记忆会产生误导，由此驱动对该问题的研究。
AI.method: 作者跨多个基准与记忆架构开展研究，发现失败在查询与记忆部分重叠时最严重，并通过改变重叠证据量的受控实验加以验证。基于此，提出MEMTRIM：一个即插即用框架，在写入时对记忆证据建立索引，在读取时控制其复用，去除重复或冲突的证据，同时保留有用的记忆特有信息，无需重训练，适用于基于嵌入与结构化的记忆系统。
AI.result: 实验表明，MEMTRIM在多种模型和记忆设置下均降低了记忆过度依赖，同时保留了有用记忆带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 记忆过度依赖是一种在良性记忆条件下依然存在的普遍失效模式，尤其在查询与记忆部分重叠时最为突出；通过在写入与读取两端对记忆证据进行索引与复用控制，可以在不重训练的情况下有效缓解该问题并保留记忆的正面价值。

title: WildMatch: Weakly Supervised Image Matcher Adaptation for Wildlife Re-Identification
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://wildmatch.gmum.net
summary: Individual animal re-identification from camera-trap imagery is an instance retrieval problem central to non-invasive wildlife monitoring: a query image must retrieve the correct individual from a reference set of known animals. This requires computer vision models to recognize distinctive local patterns in fur, skin, or other visual markings. Current approaches either learn global embeddings as a classification problem, requiring many labeled images per individual while largely ignoring local evidence, or apply off-the-shelf, domain-agnostic image matchers. Although such matchers are pretrained on large and diverse image collections, adapting them to wildlife imagery is challenging because available datasets are small and lack correspondence-level annotations. We study weakly supervised adaptation of a pretrained keypoint matcher using only identity labels, without keypoint-level or geometric correspondence ground truth. We mine informative image pairs with the pretrained matcher, derive weak positive and negative supervision from identity agreement, and contrastively fine-tune the matching network to strengthen correspondences for same-identity pairs and suppress them for different identities. Across open-source wildlife re-identification datasets, our approach improves accuracy over off-the-shelf matchers and a state-of-the-art local--global fusion method. Under an open-world protocol with held-out individuals, it learns a transferable correspondence prior rather than memorizing training identities. To our knowledge, this is the first study of matcher-level, identity-supervised adaptation for animal re-identification. Our method enables data-efficient specialization of image matching models to wildlife domains using identity annotations already available in typical monitoring datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅用身份标签的弱监督方法，通过挖掘图像对并对预训练关键点匹配器进行对比微调，实现动物个体重识别，在开放世界设定下优于现成的匹配器和局部-全局融合方法。
AI.motivation: 动物个体重识别是相机陷阱影像监测的核心任务，需要模型识别皮毛、皮肤等独特的局部花纹。现有方法存在两类不足：一是将全局嵌入作为分类问题学习，需要每个个体大量标注图像，且基本忽略局部证据；二是直接使用领域无关的现成图像匹配器，虽经大规模多样化图像预训练，但因野生动物数据集规模小、缺乏对应级标注，难以适配。因此需要一种数据高效、能利用现有身份标注的适配方法。
AI.method: 采用弱监督适配预训练关键点匹配器，仅使用身份标签，无需关键点级或几何对应真值。具体地：用预训练匹配器挖掘信息量高的图像对；根据身份一致性推导弱正、弱负监督信号；对匹配网络进行对比微调，增强同身份图像对的对应关系，抑制不同身份图像对的对应关系。
AI.result: 在多个开源野生动物重识别数据集上，该方法在准确率上超过现成匹配器和一种最先进的局部-全局融合方法。在留出个体的开放世界协议下，模型学到的是可迁移的对应先验，而非记忆训练身份。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对动物重识别的匹配器级、身份监督适配研究。该方法利用典型监测数据集中已有的身份标注，实现了图像匹配模型向野生动物领域的数据高效特化。

title: Will the Judge Flip? Predicting Position-Sensitive LLM Judgments from Residual Stream Activations
comment: It was submitted to neurips workshop (JUDGE workshop) and received a review score 6.5 combined with one strong accept and one above threshold accept
summary: The order in which candidate responses are presented can change an LLM judge's verdict. Detecting such a position flip ordinarily requires judging each pair in both orders, which doubles the number of judgments. We investigate whether residual stream activations recorded immediately before the initial verdict can predict a flip. We use nested grouped cross-validation to evaluate regularized linear probes on 534 JudgeBench pairs for three Qwen3 judges and Llama-3.1-8B. The linear probes achieve AUROCs of .621-.850 and outperform a combined baseline that uses verbalized confidence, verdict-label logits, response lengths, and the judge's initial choice by .062-.113 AUROC. Linear probes trained on JudgeBench and then frozen achieve AUROCs of .685-.853 on 1,802 MT-Bench comparisons without MT-Bench fitting or recalibration. These results show that pre-verdict activations support prediction of susceptibility to candidate order and outperform the non-activation predictors evaluated here.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，LLM评判器在判断候选回答时存在位置翻转现象，而判读前的残差流激活可预测这种翻转，线性探针AUROC达0.621-0.850，优于非激活基线预测器。
AI.motivation: 候选回答的呈现顺序会改变LLM评判器的裁决（位置翻转）。通常检测这种翻转需要对每对回答以两种顺序各评判一次，使评判量翻倍。本文旨在探究能否利用初始裁决前记录的残差流激活来预测翻转，从而避免重复评判。
AI.method: 采用嵌套分组交叉验证，在534个JudgeBench配对上评估正则化线性探针，涉及三个Qwen3评判器和Llama-3.1-8B。将线性探针与一个综合基线对比，该基线使用语言化置信度、裁决标签logits、回答长度及评判器初始选择。此外，将在JudgeBench上训练后冻结的探针直接应用到1,802个MT-Bench比较上，不做MT-Bench拟合或重校准。
AI.result: 线性探针AUROC为0.621-0.850，比综合基线高出0.062-0.113 AUROC。在JudgeBench训练并冻结的探针在MT-Bench上达到0.685-0.853 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 裁决前的激活能够预测对候选顺序的敏感性，且优于本文评估的非激活预测器，表明残差流激活可作为预测位置翻转的有效信号，无需重复评判即可检测翻转。

title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
summary: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks. However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io

AI.tldr: MobileVISTA：一种将固定位姿演示转化为多样化位姿扰动训练数据的数据生成框架，联合增强自我中心视觉观测与动作重定向以补偿基座位姿变化，提升移动操作策略对分布外位姿的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 端到端模仿学习策略在单一机器人位姿采集的演示数据上训练时十分脆弱：部署时仅厘米级的位姿偏差就会使自我中心观测与末端执行器轨迹偏离训练分布，导致性能急剧下降。现有方法假设相机刚性安装在驱动链之外，或假设大部分机器人几何结构不在画面中，无法适配相机既受运动学链影响又需观察该链的自我中心平台（如人形机器人）。
AI.method: 提出MobileVISTA数据生成框架，将规范位姿下采集的演示转化为多样化的位姿扰动训练数据，通过两方面联合实现：(1) 增强自我中心视觉观测；(2) 对动作进行重定向以补偿基座位姿变化。该方法无需额外采集演示，也无需训练生成模型，并专门面向相机随驱动链运动、机器人占据画面大部分区域的自我中心平台。
AI.result: 在涵盖人形与双臂形态的仿真任务以及真实Galaxea R1 Pro平台上进行验证：使用MobileVISTA增强数据训练的策略对测试时遇到的此前分布外位姿展现出更强的鲁棒性，且无需额外演示采集或训练生成模型。此外，在人形机器人上收益最大，因其相机随驱动链运动且机器人占据画面大部分区域。
AI.conclusion: MobileVISTA通过视觉观测增强与动作重定向的联合数据生成，有效缓解了自我中心移动操作策略对位姿偏差的脆弱性；其在相机位于驱动链上、机器人占据大部分视野的人形平台上收益尤为显著，为无需额外数据采集提升策略鲁棒性提供了可行途径。

title: When Tools Lie: Reliability of Mathematical Agents Under Corrupted Tool Feedback
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MathAI) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Mathematical problem solving often requires deterministic computational steps that agents delegate to tools and implicitly trust. Yet tools can fail silently, returning plausible but incorrect results. How well can agents detect and correct corrupted tool call outputs? We study this through a controlled corruption framework where a hidden interceptor replaces tool call results with plausible incorrect information on targeted problems. We evaluate agents across 31 problems under four verification designs including no verification (baseline), mandatory same-context reflection, optional fresh-context verification, and optional structural verification. Without verification, corruption causes dramatic accuracy loss, from 100% down to 72.4%. Mandatory reflection fully recovers this performance to 100%. Optional verification improves accuracy only when models actively invoke it. Our results show that checking frequency is strongly associated with robustness differences, while unequal invocation prevents a controlled comparison of verifier quality. A supporting recovery experiment shows that full problem restart succeeds in 100% of cases after explicit detection. These findings demonstrate that verifier availability and verification policy are separate components of mathematical-agent reliability. Mandatory policies enforce verification while optional policies depend on the model's own choice to invoke it.

AI.tldr: 通过受控腐蚀框架研究数学智能体对工具调用错误输出的检测与纠正能力，发现强制反思可完全恢复性能至100%。
AI.motivation: 数学问题求解常依赖智能体委托给工具并默认信任的确定性计算步骤，但工具可能静默失败并返回看似合理却错误的结果，因此需研究智能体检测和纠正被腐蚀工具调用输出的能力。
AI.method: 构建受控腐蚀框架，由隐藏拦截器在目标任务中将工具调用结果替换为看似合理的错误信息；在31个问题上评估智能体在四种验证设计下的表现：无验证（基线）、强制同上下文反思、可选新上下文验证、可选结构化验证，并辅以恢复实验。
AI.result: 无验证时腐蚀导致准确率从100%骤降至72.4%；强制反思将性能完全恢复至100%；可选验证仅在模型主动调用时提升准确率。恢复实验表明，显式检测后完全重启问题在100%的案例中成功。
AI.conclusion: 检查频率与鲁棒性差异强相关，但不均等的调用妨碍了对验证器质量的受控比较；验证器可用性与验证策略是数学智能体可靠性的两个独立组成部分——强制策略强制执行验证，可选策略则依赖模型自身选择。

title: Nucleus Speculative Decoding: Plausibility-Aware Verification Beyond Exact Distribution
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens that are verified by a target model in parallel. However, the standard acceptance rule focuses on exact distribution correction and rejects tokens that remain highly plausible under the target model when the draft model assigns excess probability. This conservative verification limits the number of draft tokens retained after each verification forward pass. We introduce Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD), a relaxed verification method that incorporates target-model plausibility into speculative decoding. NSD accepts a draft token if it satisfies the standard acceptance rule or belongs to the target model's nucleus. We theoretically characterize the distributional deviation introduced by our method and show that the single-step error is exactly determined by the draft model's excess probability within the target nucleus. We further derive sequence-level fidelity bounds that quantify how local deviations accumulate over autoregressive decoding. Experiments across multiple target models and proposal mechanisms demonstrate that NSD consistently improves speculative decoding efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance. Our method achieves throughput speedups of up to $5.16\times$ over autoregressive decoding and up to $3.15\times$ over standard speculative decoding. These improvements coincide with longer accepted lengths, allowing more output tokens to share the cost of each target verification pass. Analysis shows that plausibility-aware verification provides an effective approach for relaxed verification and speculative decoding efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Nucleus-Speculative-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Nucleus Speculative Decoding (NSD)，通过将目标模型的 nucleus（高概率核心集）纳入验证准则来放宽投机解码的接受规则，从而提升推理效率。
AI.motivation: 标准投机解码的接受规则只关注精确的分布校正，会拒绝那些在目标模型下仍然高度合理、仅因 draft 模型分配了过高概率而被拒的 token，导致每次验证后保留的草稿 token 数量受限，验证效率不高。
AI.method: NSD 放宽验证准则：当草稿 token 满足标准接受规则，或落入目标模型的 nucleus（核心高概率集）时即被接受。作者从理论上刻画了该方法引入的分布偏差，证明单步误差恰好由草稿模型在目标 nucleus 内的超额概率决定，并进一步推导了序列级保真度上界，量化局部偏差在自回归解码中的累积效应。
AI.result: 在多种目标模型和提案机制上的实验表明，NSD 持续提升投机解码效率，同时保持有竞争力的任务性能。吞吐量相比自回归解码最高加速 5.16×，相比标准投机解码最高加速 3.15×，且加速伴随更长的接受长度，使更多输出 token 分摊每次目标验证的开销。
AI.conclusion: 基于合理性的验证（plausibility-aware verification）是放宽验证规则、提升投机解码效率的有效途径。

title: Rule-Based Languages for Neurosymbolic AI
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of Rules and Reasoning - 10th International Joint Conference, RuleML+RR 2026, Vilnius, Lithuania
summary: Logic programming is increasingly used as the symbolic component of neurosymbolic AI systems. We survey the main rule-based languages in this setting, namely Datalog, answer set, and probabilistic logic programs, along four axes: semantics, expressiveness, neural integration, and evaluation mechanism. We analyse over 50 recent systems and applications, comparing formalism usage across four research areas: databases and programming languages, machine learning, vision, and robotics. We provide a decision matrix mapping application scenarios to required features and close by outlining open problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了神经符号AI中基于规则逻辑程序（Datalog、答案集程序、概率逻辑程序）的研究，从语义、表达力、神经集成与求值机制四个维度分析50余个近期系统，并跨数据库/编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四大领域进行比较，最终给出面向应用场景的决策矩阵并展望开放问题。
AI.motivation: 逻辑编程正日益成为神经符号AI系统的符号化组件，但该领域规则语言多样、系统分散，缺乏对其语义、表达力与神经集成方式的系统性比较，研究者难以根据应用需求选择合适的形式化工具。
AI.method: 采用综述与比较分析方法：选取Datalog、答案集程序（ASP）和概率逻辑程序三类主流规则语言，沿语义、表达力、神经集成、求值机制四条轴线展开分析；对50余个近期系统与应用进行考察，并在数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四个研究领域间对比形式化方法的使用情况。
AI.result: 系统梳理了三类规则语言在四个维度上的特性差异，揭示了不同研究领域对逻辑形式化的偏好模式，并构建了将应用场景映射到所需特性的决策矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑编程作为神经符号AI符号组件具有多路径可行性，不同语言在语义与集成方式上各有取舍；通过决策矩阵可辅助场景选型，同时指出了若干尚待解决的开放问题。

title: Semantic Capability Acquisition and Specialization During Vision-Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary:
Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) is typically evaluated at a single downstream checkpoint, obscuring whether a semantic capability was never acquired or emerged earlier and later declined during specialization. We ask how semantic capabilities are acquired, when they peak, how well they transfer, and what remains at deployment. We study these dynamics as a semantic capability trajectory, tracking identity- and attribute-based capabilities over training.
  We formulate a trajectory-based framework that separates capability acquisition, capability-specific optima, and later specialization, and introduce Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) to study how the representation of supervision shapes what is acquired. Across six pretrained backbones spanning DFN, MetaCLIP, and OpenAI CLIP, we show that fine-tuning can acquire semantic capability beyond the pretrained state, including gains observed on held-out evaluations. Unstructured name-and-attribute supervision produces strong name-and-attribute retrieval with comparatively weak name-free attribute-profile retrieval, whereas SSR yields substantially stronger name-free attribute-profile retrieval and is further strengthened by stochastic name-branch dropout. Different capabilities can peak at different stages, so a checkpoint selected by target class-name retrieval need not coincide with a transferable semantic optimum. Continued optimization can therefore preserve strong target class-name retrieval while reducing previously acquired transferable semantic capability. In a representative diagnostic study, this late specialization is consistent with reduced cross-modal semantic accessibility while substantial image-only class structure remains available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语义能力轨迹"框架，将微调过程中的能力获取、能力特定最优与后期专业化分离，并引入结构化语义路由（SSR），揭示不同能力在不同阶段达到峰值、目标类别名检索最优并不等于可迁移语义最优。
AI.motivation: 现有对视觉-语言模型（VLM）微调的评估通常在单一的下游检查点进行，无法判断某项语义能力是从未获得，还是曾出现但随后在专业化过程中退化。因此需要研究语义能力如何被获取、何时达到峰值、迁移效果如何，以及部署时还保留了什么。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹的分析框架，将能力获取、能力特定最优与后期专业化相分离；并引入结构化语义路由（Structured Semantic Routing, SSR）来研究监督信号的表征如何塑造所获取的能力。在 DFN、MetaCLIP 和 OpenAI CLIP 三类共六个预训练骨干上进行验证，并加入随机名称分支 dropout。
AI.result: 微调可在预训练状态之外获得语义能力，包括在留出评估上的增益。非结构化的"名称+属性"监督可产生较强的名称-属性检索，但无名称属性画像检索较弱；SSR 显著提升无名称属性画像检索，随机名称分支 dropout 进一步增强。不同能力在不同阶段达到峰值，依据目标类别名检索选择的检查点不一定对应可迁移的语义最优；持续优化在维持目标类别名检索的同时会降低已获得的可迁移语义能力。
AI.conclusion: 语义能力具有非单调轨迹，能力特定最优因任务而异。诊断研究显示，后期专业化与跨模态语义可及性下降一致，而仅图像端的类别结构仍大量保留。这提示仅用单一检查点的目标类检索指标评估微调具有误导性，需以轨迹视角和结构化监督设计来保障可迁移语义能力。

title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.

AI.tldr: SoloQ：一种免校准的扩散大语言模型（dLLM）低比特量化框架，通过结构化的K-RPBH旋转将权重与激活映射到具有可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基，实现数据无关量化，并在多个dLLM上保持4-bit精度、降低内存与加速推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过双向扩散式token生成，是自回归模型的有力替代方案，但模型规模增长与推理成本高导致部署困难：全序列去噪需反复执行计算密集型前向传播，块扩散模型还引入内存密集的KV-cache。低比特权重-激活量化因此具有吸引力，但现有dLLM训练后量化方法依赖校准数据，而激活分布在掩码状态和去噪步之间会发生漂移，导致校准不可靠。
AI.method: 提出免校准量化框架SoloQ。核心是将权重和激活映射到具有可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基，从而实现数据无关量化。具体结合：结构化的K-RPBH旋转与轻量级重缩放校正；旋转后可预测的分布支持分布匹配码本与硬件原生NVFP4。针对块扩散模型，进一步采用commit-time KV-cache量化，在不扰动当前正在去噪的块的前提下压缩持久状态。
AI.result: 在全序列dLLM（LLaDA、Dream）和块扩散dLLM（Fast-dLLM v2、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）上，SoloQ在4-bit量化下保持精度，并在知识与推理密集型基准上优于基于校准的基线方法。采用NVFP4时，峰值内存最多降低2.61倍，端到端推理最多加速2.24倍。
AI.conclusion: SoloQ验证了免校准量化在扩散大语言模型上的可行性与有效性，通过可预测旋转分布与commit-time KV-cache量化，兼顾精度保持与内存、速度收益，为dLLM的高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: ProCut: Probabilistic Cutting Topology for Autonomous Electrosurgical Tissue Dissection
summary: Accurately modeling and tracking the deformation of soft tissue is critical for a wide range of interventional and surgical procedures. However, current methods struggle in scenarios involving topological changes, such as cutting and dissection, due to the inherent non-linearity and discontinuity introduced by explicit changes in connectivity. In this work, we present a novel, fully differentiable framework that enables robust estimation and modeling of topological changes during deformable tracking. Our method introduces a continuous, sigmoid-based formulation to smooth the otherwise discrete event of tissue cutting, making it amenable to gradient-based optimization within a differentiable Position-Based Dynamics (PBD) simulation. To account for uncertainty and improve robustness in the presence of noisy visual data, we incorporate Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) for particle-based probabilistic inference, generating multiple hypotheses for topological state estimation. Building on this foundation, we develop an autonomous dissection algorithm for thin-shell tissues that leverages topological updates to guide closed-loop cutting trajectory control. We evaluate our approach in both simulated and real-world electrosurgical environments, demonstrating significant improvements in topological estimation accuracy and dissection precision over existing methods. Our results highlight the potential of this framework to advance automation in soft-tissue surgical procedures by enabling reliable perception and control in the presence of complex structural changes.

AI.tldr: 提出一个完全可微的软组织结构变形跟踪框架，用sigmoid连续化形式平滑离散切割事件，结合SVGD粒子概率推断处理拓扑变化，并实现薄壳组织自主解剖的闭环切割轨迹控制。
AI.motivation: 软组织变形建模与跟踪对介入及外科手术至关重要，但现有方法在涉及切割、剥离等拓扑变化时表现不佳，原因是连接关系的显式改变带来非线性和不连续性，难以进行梯度优化与鲁棒估计。
AI.method: 1）在可微的Position-Based Dynamics（PBD）仿真中，引入基于sigmoid的连续化公式，将原本离散的切割事件平滑化，使其可接受梯度优化；2）引入Stein Variational Gradient Descent（SVGD）进行基于粒子的概率推断，生成多个拓扑状态假设，以应对噪声视觉数据带来的不确定性并提升鲁棒性；3）在此基础上提出针对薄壳组织的自主解剖算法，利用拓扑更新引导闭环切割轨迹控制。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实电外科环境中进行评估，结果显示该方法在拓扑估计精度和解剖精度上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过在复杂结构变化下实现可靠的感知与控制，展示了推进软组织手术自动化的潜力。

title: Surviving the Router: Optimizing Skill Injections for Retrieval and Execution
summary: AI agents increasingly rely on modular third-party "skills" that are dynamically selected by skill routers to execute complex tasks. While recent studies highlight the threat of prompt injections embedded in these skills, existing evaluations often assume settings where the malicious skill is already selected for execution. We show that this assumption can substantially overestimate attack success. In realistic multi-skill environments, injected skills must first compete for retrieval, reducing the effective attack success rate (ASR) of existing injections by 87-97%. To address this limitation, we introduce CORSA (Cluster Optimization for Router-Aware Skill Attacks), a router-aware attack that optimizes skill injections for both retrieval and execution across clusters of related tasks. We evaluate skill injection attacks under router-managed multi-skill settings by extending the benchmark introduced by SkillRouter with eight malicious payload categories. CORSA uses successive optimization stages to first improve retrieval and then optimize end-to-end attack success, while we evaluate user utility and injection naturalism separately. Our experiments show that CORSA substantially improves both retrieval and end-to-end attack success over existing skill injections while preserving user utility, and that the resulting attacks transfer across different router architectures and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有技能注入攻击评估假设恶意技能已被选中，高估了攻击成功率；真实多技能环境下注入须先竞争检索，ASR下降87-97%。作者提出路由感知攻击CORSA，联合优化检索与执行，显著提升检索与端到端攻击成功率，并保持用户效用，且可跨路由器架构与LLM骨干迁移。
AI.motivation: AI代理依赖模块化第三方"技能"，由技能路由器动态选择以执行复杂任务。已有研究虽揭示了技能中嵌入提示注入的威胁，但其评估多假设恶意技能已被选中执行，这一不现实假设会显著高估攻击成功率。真实多技能环境中，注入技能须先通过检索竞争，导致现有注入的有效ASR大幅下降，因此需要面向路由器机制的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出CORSA（Cluster Optimization for Router-Aware Skill Attacks），一种路由感知攻击，针对相关任务簇联合优化技能注入的检索与执行。评估上扩展SkillRouter基准，加入八类恶意载荷类别，以模拟路由器管理的多技能设置。CORSA采用分阶段连续优化：先提升检索命中，再优化端到端攻击成功率，同时分别评估用户效用与注入自然度。
AI.result: 现有注入在真实多技能设置下ASR下降87-97%。CORSA在检索与端到端攻击成功率上均显著优于现有技能注入方法，同时保持用户效用；所得攻击可跨不同路由器架构与LLM骨干迁移。
AI.conclusion: 仅假设恶意技能已被选中的评估会严重高估技能注入威胁；攻击需面向路由器检索阶段进行优化。CORSA证明路由感知的联合优化可实质提升攻击有效性并保持可用性与隐蔽性，且具备跨架构与跨模型的迁移性，提示需重视路由器管理环境下的技能注入防御。

title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement
summary: As LLMs increasingly assist in moral reasoning, omission bias, the tendency to prefer inaction even when equivalent framings reverse substantive outcomes, poses a significant risk of skewed decision-making. Yet omission bias remains underexplored in LLM evaluation, with the few existing studies limited in scale and focused largely on utilitarian-deontological conflicts. To address this gap, we introduce OMIT, a benchmark consisting of 218 paired-frame scenarios across 10 conflict types, constructed by leveraging disagreement patterns from an LLM-based, five-perspective philosophical persona panel (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism). Evaluating eight LLMs, we find that omission bias is pervasive but inversely correlates with model size within families. We further evaluate four inference-time interventions and find that interventions encouraging models to consider moral principles before committing to a yes/no answer reduce omission bias and increase frame-consistent responses, although lower omission bias rates can also coincide with shifts toward action-biased responses. Ultimately, this work contributes not only the OMIT benchmark, but also a methodology for using diverse philosophical disagreement signals to evaluate framing-sensitive inaction preferences and the distributional effects of mitigation attempts in LLMs under complex moral conflicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OMIT基准（218个配对框架场景、10类冲突），基于五种哲学人设（功利主义、义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）的分歧模式构建，评估8个LLM发现遗漏偏见普遍存在且与模型规模呈族内负相关；四类推理时干预中"先思原则再作答"可降低遗漏偏见并提升框架一致性，但低遗漏偏见也可能伴随行动偏向。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与道德推理，而遗漏偏见（omission bias，即在框架等价却实质结果反转时偏好不作为）会导致决策偏斜风险。现有LLM评估对此探索不足：研究规模有限，且多集中于功利主义—义务论冲突，缺乏对多种道德冲突类型和框架敏感性的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建OMIT基准：利用基于LLM的五视角哲学人设小组（功利主义、义务论、德性伦理、关怀伦理、契约论）的分歧模式，生成218个配对框架场景，覆盖10类冲突类型。随后评估8个LLM的遗漏偏见，并测试4种推理时干预策略对偏见与框架一致性的影响。
AI.result: 遗漏偏见在八个模型中普遍存在，且在模型族内与模型规模呈负相关（模型越大偏见越低）。四种推理时干预中，促使模型在给出是/否答案前先考量道德原则的干预，能降低遗漏偏见并提升框架一致响应；但较低的遗漏偏见率也可能同时伴随向行动偏向（action-biased）响应的转移。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献不仅在于OMIT基准，还提供了一套方法论：利用多元哲学分歧信号评估LLM在复杂道德冲突下对框架敏感的不作为偏好，以及缓解尝试带来的分布性效应。

title: Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization: Learning to Reason with Adaptive Rationale Scaffolding
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is often limited by reward sparsity: when a model fails to discover correct trajectories for difficult problems, the optimization process receives little useful signal and may stagnate. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by incorporating off-policy demonstrations, expert traces, or model-generated solutions, but they typically require the auxiliary data to match the format of the reinforcement-learning task, often relying on rejection sampling from stronger models to obtain suitable training trajectories. We introduce Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a framework that adaptively leverages ground-truth rationale information according to the model's current capability while preserving its freedom to explore. Rather than treating reference solutions as fixed imitation targets, RGPO uses them as temporary scaffolds: rationales help the model generate improved responses, after which only higher-reward, model-generated solutions are transferred back to the original unguided setting. This design allows training to exploit available ground-truth information without requiring off-policy data to follow the same format as the RL task. Across both language-only and vision-language reasoning settings, RGPO consistently improves performance over RLVR baselines, and ablation studies show that adaptive rationale guidance is a key contributor to these gains. These results suggest that RGPO offers a practical and general approach for reducing reward sparsity, stabilizing reinforcement learning, and improving reasoning performance in both text-only and multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization（RGPO）框架，通过将真实推理解释作为临时脚手架自适应引导模型生成更优响应，并仅将高奖励的模型自生成解回传至原始无引导设置，从而在不要求离线数据格式一致的前提下缓解奖励稀疏问题，在纯语言与视觉语言推理任务上一致优于 RLVR 基线。
AI.motivation: On-policy 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的核心范式，但其效果常受限于奖励稀疏：当模型无法为难题发现正确轨迹时，优化过程缺乏有效信号而停滞。现有方法虽通过离线示范、专家轨迹或模型生成解来缓解，但通常要求辅助数据与 RL 任务格式一致，往往依赖更强模型的拒绝采样来获得合适训练轨迹，成本高且通用性受限。
AI.method: 提出 RGPO，根据模型当前能力自适应利用真实推理解释信息，同时保留其探索自由。该方法不把参考解当作固定模仿目标，而是作为临时脚手架：先借助 rationale 帮助模型生成改进后的响应，随后仅将更高奖励、由模型自身生成的解回传至原始无引导设定。该设计使训练可利用真实信息而无需离线数据遵循 RL 任务格式。
AI.result: 在纯语言与视觉语言推理设置中，RGPO 一致优于 RLVR 基线；消融实验表明自适应 rationale 引导是性能提升的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: RGPO 为缓解奖励稀疏、稳定强化学习并提升纯文本与多模态模型的推理性能提供了一种实用且通用的方法。

title: ElasticFit: Fit-Aware 3D Object Insertion via VLM Reasoning and Generative Adaptation
summary:
Inserting objects into existing 3D scenes requires more than selecting a plausible location:
  the inserted object must also fit local geometry while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility.
  Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and generative models enable semantic reasoning and visual content creation, they offer limited 3D grounding and geometric control when an inserted object must fit into constrained local spaces.
  We introduce \textbf{ElasticFit}, a VLM-guided framework for fit-aware object insertion centered on a novel scene-grounded representation.
  Given a language instruction and rendered scene observations, ElasticFit infers structured fitting cues that specify where the object should be grounded, what volume it should occupy, how it should be oriented, and its adaptation mode (rigid placement, uniform scaling, or elastic fitting).
  These cues convert high-level VLM reasoning into explicit 3D constraints that condition object generation and guide downstream geometric fitting.
  ElasticFit then generates a scene-conditioned object prior, reconstructs it in 3D, and refines the mesh through mode-specific fitting while enforcing collision avoidance, contact consistency, and physical grounding.
  In fixed-asset baseline comparisons, ElasticFit improves spatial relation success from 50.8\% to 69.7\% and support success from 48.3\% to 91.7\% over the strongest baseline, while providing novel support for generative "make-it-fit" insertions in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: ElasticFit：一种VLM引导的适配感知（fit-aware）3D物体插入框架，通过场景锚定的结构化拟合线索将高层语义推理转化为显式3D约束，并结合生成先验、三维重建与模式特定几何拟合实现刚体放置、均匀缩放与弹性形变三类插入。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景物体插入不仅要选择合理位置，还需满足局部几何适配、语义意图与物理合理性；而现有VLM与生成模型虽具备语义推理与视觉内容生成能力，却缺乏3D grounding与几何控制，难以在受限局部空间中精确放置物体。
AI.method: 提出ElasticFit框架，核心是新颖的场景锚定表示：输入语言指令与场景渲染观测，由VLM推断结构化拟合线索（grounding位置、占据体积、朝向、适配模式：刚体放置/均匀缩放/弹性拟合）；将VLM高层推理转化为显式3D约束以条件化物体生成并引导下游几何拟合；随后生成场景条件物体先验、重建为3D并做模式特定网格精修，同时施加碰撞避免、接触一致性与物理接地约束。
AI.result: 在固定资产（fixed-asset）基线对比中，ElasticFit将空间关系成功率从最强基线的50.8%提升至69.7%，支撑（support）成功率从48.3%提升至91.7%，并在复杂场景下支持生成式"make-it-fit"插入。
AI.conclusion: ElasticFit通过VLM引导的结构化拟合线索与显式3D约束，有效弥合语义推理与几何控制之间的差距，在空间关系与物理支撑指标上显著优于基线，并拓展了生成式适配插入的能力边界。

title: The Implicit Bias of Hyperbolic Representation Learning for Multiclass Data: A Busemann Risk Perspective
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: We study the implicit bias of Riemannian gradient flow for hyperbolic multiclass classification with fixed class prototypes in hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Our framework accommodates general permutation invariant relative margin (PERM) losses, a class that includes cross entropy and other standard multiclass losses. Our analysis is based on a decomposition: at large radius, the distance to each prototype splits into a radial term and a direction-dependent term described by the Busemann function. This yields two main results. First, we prove a radial dichotomy: the sign of a drift coefficient $μ$ determines whether the radius is pushed toward the ideal boundary or back toward the interior; if the positive drift persists, then $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$, while persistent negative drift returns the trajectory to the large-radius threshold in finite time. Second, we show that the boundary direction converges to a critical point of the Busemann risk on $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$. These results provide a rigorous asymptotic perspective on two phenomena we refer to as boundary saturation and near-boundary clustering in hyperbolic representation learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究双曲空间 $\mathbb{H}^n$ 中、类别原型固定时多分类任务的黎曼梯度流的隐式偏置，适用于一般的置换不变相对间隔（PERM）损失。作者通过将大半径下到原型的距离分解为径向项与 Busemann 函数刻画的方​​向项，证明了一个径向二分定理（漂移系数 $\mu$ 的符号决定半径被推向理想边界还是在有限时间内返回内部）以及边界方向收敛到 Busemann 风险的临界点，从而为双曲表示学习中的边界饱和与近边界聚类现象提供了严格的渐近刻画。
AI.motivation: 双曲空间因能高效表示层次结构而被广泛用于表示学习，但已有工作多为经验观察，缺乏对优化动力学渐近行为的严格理论分析。论文旨在建立黎曼梯度流在固定原型双曲多分类中的隐式偏置理论，解释并量化边界饱和与近边界聚类这两类现象的成因与条件。
AI.method: 1) 设定：在 $\mathbb{H}^n$ 上以固定类原型进行多分类训练，采用一大类置换不变相对间隔（PERM）损失（含交叉熵等标准多分类损失）；优化动力学为黎曼梯度流。2) 关键分解：在大半径区域，向每个原型的距离被拆分为径向项与仅依赖方向、由 Busemann 函数描述的方向相关项。3) 借助该分解导出漂移系数 $\mu$，并分别分析半径与边界方向的演化：对半径证明径向二分；对方向证明其收敛到 $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$ 上 Busemann 风险的临界点。
AI.result: 主要得到两个结果：(1) 径向二分：漂移系数 $\mu$ 的符号决定半径走向——若正漂移持续存在，则 $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$（对数式趋向理想边界）；若负漂移持续存在，则轨迹在有限时间内回到大半径阈值。(2) 边界方向收敛：轨迹在无穷远处的方向收敛到定义在边界 $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$ 上的 Busemann 风险的临界点。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为双曲表示学习中的边界饱和（正漂移下半径对数增长趋近边界）与近边界聚类（方向收敛于 Busemann 风险临界点）提供了严格的渐近理论解释，表明这两类现象由损失的 PERM 结构与漂移系数符号所支配，而非特定损失或经验调参的偶然结果。

title: ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction
summary: Dexterous manipulation policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world because of errors in contact timing and force regulation. Yet these policies can retain useful multi-finger coordination for task progression. We propose ReDex, a framework for adapting a simulation-trained base policy to the real world by correcting local contact failures and incorporating tactile feedback. Starting from a proprioception-only base policy, ReDex allows a human operator to physically correct contact failures at selected fingers under compliant control during real-world rollouts, while the frozen base policy continues to control the remaining fingers. These rollouts combine base policy execution, human-corrected finger motion, and fingertip force observations. We reconstruct force-informed targets from these rollouts to train a standalone force-conditioned policy via behavior cloning. This design reduces human correction effort, enables learning of contact regulation from real-world interaction, and introduces force feedback into a proprioception-only policy without tactile simulation or complex full-hand teleoperation. We evaluate ReDex on two challenging, contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on real hardware. Compared with sim-to-real transferred base policies, ReDex increases Object Flipping success rate from 14\% to 86\% across two objects and average Screwdriver Rotation progress from 26.0% to 95.3% across three objects.

AI.tldr: ReDex：通过人手局部修正接触失效并注入力反馈，将仿真训练的本体感觉策略适配到真实世界，显著提升接触密集型灵巧操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的灵巧操作策略常因接触时序误差与力调节误差难以迁移到现实。尽管这些策略保留有用的多指协调能力用于任务推进，但其局部接触层面的失效阻碍了实际部署。
AI.method: 以仅本体感觉的仿真基策略为起点，在真实rollout中由人类操作员在柔顺控制下对选定手指的接触失效进行物理修正，冻结的基策略继续控制其余手指。收集的数据包含基策略执行、人类修正的手指运动与指尖力观测。从这些rollout中重建力信息目标，通过行为克隆训练独立的力条件策略。该设计无需触觉仿真或复杂全手遥操作。
AI.result: 在真实硬件上两个接触密集型灵巧操作任务中评估：相比sim-to-real迁移的基策略，ReDex将Object Flipping成功率从14%提升至86%（两个物体），Screwdriver Rotation平均进度从26.0%提升至95.3%（三个物体）。
AI.conclusion: ReDex通过局部接触修正与力反馈注入，有效降低人类修正负担，实现了从真实交互中学习接触调节，并将力反馈引入仅本体感觉策略，显著改善sim-to-real迁移效果。

title: Rethinking Visual Provenance: Detection and Watermarking Across Direct Visual Generation and LLM-Driven Code Rendering
comment: 46 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Conceptual research agenda; no experiments. Video: https://youtu.be/14SMl0d_e48. Project page: https://zhenggao-30.github.io/Rethinking-Visual-Provenance/
summary: AI systems create images and videos with image/video generation models or by writing code and graphics descriptions that are then rendered. These routes can produce similar visible artifacts but expose different representations, intervention points, and provenance evidence. We develop a production-centered framework that compares detection and watermarking across both routes. An explicit verification specification distinguishes passive inference, message recovery, and authenticated provenance. We organize image, video, source-code, and rendering-aware watermarks by production stage. We examine the different requirements of generated images and video, plots and SVG, programmable video, and agent-composed workflows. Documented Claude, OpenAI, and rendering-tool interfaces connect the framework to concrete systems. We pose ten scoped research questions on identifiability, observability, fair comparison across stages, recoverable payload, reconstruction, synchronization, composition, hybrid local contribution, and private production-event authentication. The result is a conceptual research agenda grounded in published methods, inspected interfaces, and elementary boundary examples. It reports no experiments and claims no new theorems; its appendix results are elementary calculations, and documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以生产流程为中心的框架，用于比较图像/视频生成两条路径（生成模型直接产出 vs. 代码+图形描述后渲染）中的检测与水印问题。
AI.motivation: AI系统可通过生成模型或代码+图形描述渲染两条路径产出图像/视频，二者可见伪影相似，但暴露的表征、干预点和溯源证据不同，现有研究缺乏对这两条路径的系统性对比。
AI.method: 构建以生产为中心的概念框架：提出显式验证规范区分被动推断、消息恢复与认证溯源；按生产阶段组织图像、视频、源代码和渲染感知水印；考察生成图像与视频、图表与SVG、可编程视频及智能体组合工作流的不同需求；结合已公开的Claude、OpenAI及渲染工具接口进行对接。
AI.result: 提出十个限定范围的研究问题，涵盖可识别性、可观测性、跨阶段公平比较、可恢复载荷、重建、同步、组合、混合本地贡献及私有生产事件认证；并给出基于已发表方法、接口检视与基础边界示例的概念性研究议程。未报告实验、未提出新定理，附录结果为基础计算，文档与源码检视仅确立接口而非实证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该文定位为概念性研究议程，为跨生成与渲染两条路径的检测与水印研究提供组织框架和研究方向，而非实证或理论贡献。

title: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DyPAM，一种在query和key表示上直接调制位置信息贡献的PEFT方法，通过输入条件化、维度级、头级与层级调制实现细粒度自适应，在推理基准上优于现有PEFT基线。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法多采用统一、静态的适配方式，忽略了注意力在维度、头、层和输入token上的结构化异质性；同时RoPE等位置编码引入维度相关的位置结构，使统一适配次优。
AI.method: DyPAM直接作用于query和key表示，调节位置信息对注意力的贡献，结合输入条件化的维度级调制与头级、层级的结构化调制，在不修改预训练主干的前提下对齐RoPE诱导的结构进行细粒度适配。
AI.result: 在多个主干模型上的数学与常识推理基准实验中，DyPAM持续优于现有强PEFT基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对位置注意力的结构化、细粒度动态调制是一种有效的PEFT策略，能够在不改动预训练主干的情况下提升下游推理性能。

title: Trajectory-Retrieval Speculative Decoding: When Does a Model's Own History Help?
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning increases sequential decoding cost while creating a growing history of potentially reusable continuations. We investigate when this history supplies useful drafts and complements an existing drafter. Controlled source comparisons reveal trajectory-specific reuse, motivating our method Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR). TLAR retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current trajectory and uses recent verification outcomes to adapt retrieval activation and candidate width. TLAR combines retrieved continuations with model-generated drafts in a shared candidate tree, preserving the target model's output distribution through exact verification. Across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing, our evaluation connects source reuse, incremental acceptance, and execution cost. Combining TLAR with strong retrieval baselines improves token acceptance under matched verification budgets and increases end-to-end throughput over the draft-model baseline. These findings support generated trajectories as runtime memory for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 提出TLAR方法，利用长链推理轨迹中的可复用续写作为草稿，与草稿模型结合以加速解码。
AI.motivation: 长链思维链推理增加顺序解码成本，但积累了大量潜在可复用的续写历史；研究何时这些历史能提供有用草稿并与既有草稿模型形成互补。
AI.method: 受控来源对比揭示轨迹特定的复用现象；提出轨迹局部自适应检索（TLAR）：从当前轨迹检索近似匹配的续写，利用近期验证结果自适应调整检索激活与候选宽度，将检索续写与模型生成草稿合并为共享候选树，并通过精确验证保持目标模型输出分布。
AI.result: 在代码调试、数学和开放式写作任务上，评估关联来源复用、增量接受与执行成本；TLAR与强检索基线结合，在相同验证预算下提升token接受率，并相较草稿模型基线提高端到端吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 生成轨迹可作为运行时记忆用于自适应推理加速。

title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
summary: Protective perturbations aim to stop malicious instruction-guided editing of personal photos, but they are optimized and evaluated at the editor's working resolution, whereas shared photos have 10 megapixels or more and editors first downscale them by an unknown factor. We model this resize as a frequency-selective channel. In this model, a perturbation computed at the native resolution decays with the downscaling factor and is weak even without a resize, and a perturbation computed at a fixed working resolution protects only a window of scales. The best worst-case protection over an unknown range of scales degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, and averaging over scales does not reach it. Guided by this analysis, we propose SRIM, which samples a grid of anchor scales covering the whole range, with weights that favor the currently weakest scale, at the cost of standard expectation over transformation. On full-resolution photos of 9 to 30 megapixels and downscaling factors from 2 to 8, SRIM raises the worst-case disruption of FLUX.2-klein edits from 0.192 LPIPS, attained by the strongest published protection, to 0.463. At equal visibility, it roughly doubles the protection. The same protected photos also protect against the 9B model and against FLUX.2-dev, with worst cases of 0.450 and 0.386 against at most 0.184 for published protections, and SRIM leads on InstructPix2Pix as well.

AI.tldr: 该文将图像缩放建模为频率选择性信道，提出SRIM，通过在最弱尺度加权采样多尺度锚点以优化最坏情况保护，在9–30MP全分辨率照片上显著提升对指令式编辑的防护效果。
AI.motivation: 现有防护性扰动（protective perturbation）在编辑器的工作分辨率下优化与评估，但实际分享的照片往往高达千万像素以上，编辑器会先以未知因子下采样。此缩放会使在原生分辨率上计算的扰动随下采样因子衰减，导致在真实使用场景中的防护失效。因此需要研究在未知尺度范围下的最坏情况防护。
AI.method: 将缩放建模为频率选择性信道。分析表明：原生分辨率计算的扰动随下采样衰减且即使不缩放也较弱；固定工作分辨率计算的扰动仅保护有限尺度窗口。对未知尺度范围的最坏情况防护随范围宽度仅对数下降，且按尺度取平均无法达到该界。据此提出SRIM：采样覆盖整个范围的锚点尺度网格，并以偏向当前最弱尺度的权重进行优化，代价是放弃对变换的标准期望优化。
AI.result: 在9–30MP全分辨率照片及2–8倍下采样下，SRIM将FLUX.2-klein编辑的最坏情况破坏从最强已发表防护的0.192 LPIPS提升至0.463；在相同可见性下防护约翻倍。相同受保护照片亦对9B模型和FLUX.2-dev有效，最坏情况分别为0.450与0.386（已发表防护至多0.184），且在InstructPix2Pix上也领先。
AI.conclusion: 在真实高分辨率与未知缩放场景中，面向最弱尺度的多尺度锚点优化（SRIM）能显著提升最坏情况防护，优于既有方法，并在多个编辑模型与设置上保持领先。

title: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
summary: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated market trajectories, yet under nonstationarity these training paths may not represent future market conditions. We propose WRAP (Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation), a drift-aware adversarial training framework derived from a two-budget distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulation. The formulation is anchored to a weighted empirical reference distribution whose fixed baseline weights are chosen to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift. Around this reference distribution, the ambiguity set addresses two complementary forms of distributional misspecification by allowing an adversary to reweight the observed trajectories subject to a $φ$-divergence constraint and perturb their paths subject to an optimal-transport (OT) constraint. We derive a joint first-order expansion in which the leading-order increase over the nominal expected loss decomposes into a reweighting contribution determined by the dispersion of hedging losses across trajectories and a transport contribution determined by the sensitivity of the loss to path perturbations. This expansion yields an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack that replaces the distributional inner supremum with a tractable first-order approximation. Across stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion (GAD), the experiments show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training providing the largest gains under nonstationarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WRAP，一种由双预算分布鲁棒优化（DRO）推导的漂移感知对抗训练框架，用于深度对冲：它以 φ-散度对轨迹重加权、以最优传输（OT）约束扰动路径，并通过联合一阶展开构造有限维可计算对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 深度对冲依赖历史或模拟轨迹学习交易策略，但在市场非平稳条件下，训练路径可能无法代表未来市场分布（时间漂移与采样不确定性），导致策略泛化性不足。现有方法难以同时刻画"样本分布偏移"与"路径级扰动"两类分布误设。
AI.method: 提出 WRAP（Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation）。构建双预算 DRO：以加权经验参考分布为锚，基线权重固定以平衡采样不确定性与时间漂移；歧义集允许对手同时（1）在 φ-散度约束下对观测轨迹重加权，（2）在最优传输约束下扰动路径。推导关于名义期望损失的联合一阶展开，将分布内层上确界替换为一阶近似的有限维对抗攻击。损失增量的主阶项分解为重加权项（由对冲损失跨轨迹的离散度决定）与传输项（由损失对路径扰动的敏感度决定）。
AI.result: 在平稳与非平稳 Heston 动力学以及广义仿射扩散（GAD）上的实验表明：重加权与传输两种机制带来互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳情形下取得最大增益。
AI.conclusion: WRAP 通过统一的重加权与路径扰动对抗机制，把分布鲁棒对冲目标转化为可求解的有限维一阶攻击，有效缓解非平稳市场下的分布漂移问题，验证了两类误设机制互补且联合训练最优。

title: Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, TIGER improves early sample efficiency and reduces measured safety violations while matching or improving final success rates relative to prior RL and IL-RL baselines on the evaluated tasks.
