AI.tldr: TIGER 是一种面向稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作任务的奖励构造与预训练框架，将动作分块模仿策略用作任务空间进展估计器而非控制器或动作先验，通过密集进展奖励与模仿引导的前瞻信号提升早期样本效率与安全性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作任务中，在线强化学习样本效率低，且早期探索易产生偏离流形的动作，导致安全违规，现有模仿学习与 RL 结合方法多把模仿策略当作可执行控制器或动作先验，泛化与效率受限。
AI.method: TIGER 将动作分块的模仿策略视为局部任务空间进展估计器：通过控制器感知的动作到运动映射，把预测的动作块转换为短时域末端执行器参考轨迹；RL 智能体据此获得稠密的进展奖励，同时稀疏环境奖励仍为主导目标。预训练阶段利用模仿引导的前瞻信号，对预测能在任务空间取得进展的动作放宽保守价值惩罚，以减少早期在线 RL 的偏离流形探索。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，TIGER 相比既有 RL 与 IL-RL 基线，在评估任务上提升了早期样本效率，减少了实测安全违规次数，并取得持平或更高的最终成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将模仿策略重塑为任务空间进展估计器并结合模仿引导的前瞻信号，可有效缓解稀疏奖励操作任务中 RL 的样本效率与安全性问题，同时不牺牲最终任务成功率。

title: FBAN: A Fully Homomorphic Encryption Compatible Bottleneck Attention Network for Privacy-Preserving Behavioral Authentication
comment: 20 pages. This paper has been accepted at the 28th International Conference on Information and Communications Security (ICICS 2026)
summary:
Continuous authentication (CA) strengthens session security by repeatedly verifying the user during device interaction, yet it inherently relies on highly sensitive behavioral traces (e.g., fine-grained touch dynamics) that are often outsourced to cloud/edge services for scalable inference. This raises a fundamental privacy-in-use challenge: protecting behavioral features during computation, not only in transit or at rest. Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) offers a principled solution, but deploying modern CA models under FHE remains difficult due to non-linearities and attention-style operations that incur high ciphertext cost.
  We propose FBAN, a TFHE-compatible Bottleneck Attention Network and an end-to-end encrypted CA framework. FBAN is designed for integer-only execution via a two-stage pipeline (floating-point pretraining followed by quantization-aware training) and is compiled into TFHE circuits for homomorphic inference. We further specify a client-server protocol with session-bound blinding and decrypt-and-return verification, enabling the server to authenticate users without observing raw behavioral features. We provide a cryptographic security analysis against an honest-but-curious server under TFHE IND-CPA security, and formalize resistance to replay and impersonation without the TFHE secret key. Experiments on two public touchscreen datasets demonstrate that FBAN achieves strong authentication utility under encrypted inference while maintaining a lightweight model footprint, with TFHE parameters instantiated at $\geq 128$-bit security.

AI.tldr: 提出FBAN——一种TFHE兼容的瓶颈注意力网络与端到端加密持续认证框架，实现整数化全同态推理，在保护行为特征隐私的同时保持认证性能。
AI.motivation: 持续认证依赖细粒度行为轨迹（如触摸动态），通常外包至云/边缘进行推理，引出"使用中隐私"挑战：需在计算过程中保护行为特征，而非仅传输与存储阶段。FHE虽为原则性方案，但现代CA模型含非线性与注意力操作，密文计算开销大，难以落地。此外，需在服务器不接触原始特征的前提下完成认证。
AI.method: 1) FBAN：TFHE兼容的瓶颈注意力网络，采用两阶段流水线（浮点预训练+量化感知训练）实现纯整数执行，并编译为TFHE电路进行同态推理；2) 客户端-服务器协议：引入会话绑定盲化（session-bound blinding）与解密返回验证（decrypt-and-return verification）；3) 安全性分析：在TFHE IND-CPA安全下针对诚实但好奇服务器建模，形式化分析抗重放与抗冒充（无TFHE密钥时不可行）。
AI.result: 在两个公开触摸屏数据集上，FBAN在加密推理下取得较强认证效用，同时保持轻量模型规模；TFHE参数实例化达到≥128比特安全级别。
AI.conclusion: FBAN证明可在TFHE下高效部署带注意力机制的持续认证模型，兼顾隐私保护与认证性能，为隐私内计算的行为生物认证提供可行路径。

title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.

AI.tldr: ReFold 是一种免训练的渲染层上下文压缩方法，通过可逆地折叠跨轮冗余内容，在长程 LLM 智能体任务中降低 token 消耗与 KV 缓存开销，同时不损害任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体每步都会重发不断增长的交互历史，导致上下文与成本随步数膨胀直至超出上下文窗口。现有上下文管理方法依赖额外模型调用、启发式规则或训练策略进行预测，带来运行时开销、破坏前缀缓存，并且永久丢弃内容且无法保证恢复。
AI.method: 提出 ReFold：一个免训练的渲染层，保留底层交互历史，仅压缩模型渲染出的上下文。无需辅助预测器即可去除两类跨轮冗余：一是先前轮次已展示的内容，用占位符替换；二是智能体自报已完成的轮次，折叠为一行摘要。两种操作均采用分块渲染，每隔数步重写一次缓存前缀，而非每步重写。所有删除严格可逆，误删只需从历史中恢复一次，而非永久丢失。因其作用于渲染层，可即插即用于标准 ReAct 风格框架。
AI.result: 在五个长程基准和两个前沿 LLM 上评估：token 消耗最多降低 2.5 倍，每会话 KV 缓存内存减半，任务成功率不下降。在有限上下文预算下，避免最多 92% 的强制压缩。在并发服务负载下，请求排队延迟最多降低 100%，推理加速最多 1.7 倍，推理成本最多降低 3.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReFold 通过可逆、分块、免训练的渲染层压缩，在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下显著降低长程智能体的 token、内存与推理成本，并提升并发服务效率，具备良好的通用性与即插即用性。

title: Evaluating Escalation Signals for LLM Routing: Targets, Controls, and Five Ways to Fool Yourself
summary: Deciding when to escalate a query from a small language model to a larger one requires a cheap signal that predicts, before the large model is called, whether escalating would help. Semantic entropy, originally developed to detect hallucinations, is a natural candidate: it measures how much a model's sampled answers disagree in meaning, and high disagreement often signals an unreliable answer. We test it across three benchmarks and two model families. On GSM8K, with a small/large pair about twelve times apart in size, semantic entropy reliably distinguishes the small model's mistakes (AUROC 0.871) and improves routed accuracy over random escalation by up to nine points at matched cost. An earlier strong-looking result on a synthetic benchmark proved misleading: a simple rule based only on question difficulty, with no model involved, matched semantic entropy almost exactly. This paper's main contribution is a set of checks that catch this before it is reported as real. We show that scoring a cheap, question-only difficulty estimate alongside any signal reveals whether the signal adds real information or just tracks how hard a question looks; that two reasonable definitions of "escalation worked" can produce very different results on the same data; that a benchmark can leave almost no room for any signal to beat simply always using the large model; and that the true cost of live sampling can make routing more expensive than calling the large model directly. For a cheaper alternative that reuses cached past outcomes, we show how to predict whether it will work on a new dataset -- confirmed by correctly forecasting a collapse from AUROC 0.908 to chance level (0.518) ahead of time. We offer these as a general checklist for evaluating escalation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文测试语义熵作为"小模型→大模型"升级路由信号的有效性，并主要贡献一套评估检查清单，用于识别信号是否只是追踪问题难度、评估口径歧义、基准无提升空间及真实采样成本等陷阱。
AI.motivation: 升级查询需要在大模型调用前就有廉价信号预测"升级是否有用"。语义熵作为检测幻觉的自然候选信号，看似有效，但作者发现其在合成基准上的"强结果"具有误导性，因此需要一套方法来检验信号是否真正提供信息而非伪相关。
AI.method: 在三个基准、两个模型家族上测试语义熵。核心贡献是四项检查：(1) 将仅依赖问题的廉价难度估计与任意信号一同打分，以判断信号是否仅追踪问题表面难度；(2) 对比两种"升级成功"定义；(3) 检查基准是否为信号留出胜过"始终用大模型"的空间；(4) 核算实时采样的真实成本；并对复用缓存结果的更廉价替代方案，预测其在新数据集上的表现。
AI.result: GSM8K上，小/大约12倍差异的模型对，语义熵能可靠区分小模型错误（AUROC 0.871），在同等成本下相比随机升级可将路由准确率提升最多9个百分点。但合成基准上，一个不涉及任何模型的纯问题难度规则几乎完全匹配语义熵，说明原结果误导。对缓存替代方案，成功提前预测其AUROC从0.908崩溃至随机水平（0.518）。
AI.conclusion: 语义熵在真实基准上是有用的升级信号，但此类结果极易被难度混杂、评估定义、基准饱和与采样成本等因素掩盖。作者提出的检查清单可作为评估升级信号的通用规范，避免将伪效果误报为真实贡献。

title: LARK: A Low-Cost, Accurate, Occlusion-Resilient, Kalman Filter-Assisted Tracking System for Image-Guided Surgery
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, including appendices. Supplementary document included as an ancillary file. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/ApZ8q9DjB-4
summary: Image-guided surgery (IGS) depends on accurate tracking of surgical instruments to provide real-time navigation relative to anatomical structures. Commercial stereo infrared trackers are accurate but prone to occlusion and cost-prohibitive for many settings. This work presents LARK, a multi-camera optical tracking system using commodity RGB hardware and multi-view redundancy and fusion. We develop and evaluate two complete tracking methods: multi-view monocular pose fusion and multi-view triangulation. Both methods are assessed under varying occlusion levels using a precision-machined grid and an anatomical head phantom, and compared against a gold-standard stereo infrared system. With five cameras and adaptive Kalman filtering, LARK achieves median target registration errors of 0.64 mm for point localization with triangulation and 0.73 mm for trajectory tracking with pose fusion on the machined grid. Camera-subset experiments show graceful degradation in adaptive pose-fusion accuracy as fewer views remain available. With tracking hardware costing under $1,000 USD, LARK provides a low-cost platform for image-guided surgery research. Hardware designs and software are publicly available at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/software/ , and datasets at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/data/ .

AI.tldr: LARK：一种基于多相机RGB硬件与多视角冗余融合的低成本光学跟踪系统，在遮挡下实现亚毫米级精度。
AI.motivation: 商用立体红外跟踪器虽精度高，但易受遮挡且成本高昂，限制了图像引导手术在多数场景的普及，因此需要低成本且抗遮挡的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用商用RGB相机搭建多相机光学跟踪系统，提出并评估两种完整跟踪方法：多视角单目位姿融合与多视角三角测量；结合自适应卡尔曼滤波，利用多视角冗余进行融合，并在不同遮挡程度下测试。
AI.result: 在精密加工栅格与解剖头部体模上评估：五相机配合自适应卡尔曼滤波时，三角测量点定位中位目标配准误差0.64 mm，位姿融合轨迹跟踪误差0.73 mm；相机子集实验显示自适应位姿融合精度随可用视角减少而平缓退化；硬件成本低于1000美元。
AI.conclusion: LARK以低成本商用硬件实现与金标准立体红外系统可比的亚毫米级跟踪精度，并具备遮挡下的稳健性，为图像引导手术研究提供低成本平台，硬件设计与软件及数据集已公开。

title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
summary: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论解释：多语言模型中层跨语言表示相似，源于数据存在跨语言共享的抽象层级与语言特有的表层结构；用概率上下文无关文法生成合成语言，证明贝叶斯最优预测器的信念传播消息在逐层编码时能复现该现象。
AI.motivation: 观察到多语言模型中间层对翻译句子的表示相似（与柏拉图表示假设相关），但缺乏理论解释，本文旨在提供机制性说明。
AI.method: 假设数据有隐藏层级结构，抽象层跨语言共享、表层语言特定；用PCFG生成共享上层规则、不共享下层规则的合成语言；将贝叶斯最优下一词预测器视为信念传播，把其消息逐层编码，得到分析性预测，并与同数据训练的Transformer对比验证。
AI.result: 理论预测与训练模型高度吻合：跨语言相似性在中层达到峰值，且与语言特定结构共存；相似性随语言接近度、模型质量和数据暴露增加而增强；区分“相似性”（共享邻域几何）与“对齐”（共享坐标），后者在语码混合数据充足时出现；预测逐层减去可由前层线性预测的成分可提升跨语言相似性，并在预训练LLM中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多语言模型中层跨语言表示相似提供了可解释机制，厘清相似与对齐的区别，并对表示处理（层间线性成分去除）给出可验证预测。

title: Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导视觉提示模块PG-VP，将不可见危险转为虚拟障碍，使冻结的VLA导航模型绕开辐射/热源，无需重训。
AI.motivation: RGB相机无法感知辐射、温度骤升等不可见风险；而为每种风险单独训练新编码器、采集数据并重训模型成本高昂。
AI.method: PG-VP是一种即插即用的多模态感知模块：复用冻结VLA模型避障能力。检测到邻近辐射或热源时，进行物理引导风险评估以确定规避方向，并在连续帧上叠加移动的同一虚拟障碍（动态视觉提示）；无危险时不渲染，策略行为不变。
AI.result: 在OmniNav上，于R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen划分测试，分别以84.9%和83.2%概率引导策略采取预期低风险动作，导航成功率代价为6.8和7.9个百分点；真实机器人上无需重训即有效避障，热源与辐射源的最差10%平均轨迹安全性分别提升63.45%和32.59%。
AI.conclusion: PG-VP以固定的视觉提示模式统一处理不同危险类型，实现免重训的不可见危险规避，为安全关键场景提供可扩展的即插即用方案。

title: HE-OFT: Privacy-Preserving One-Shot Federated Fine-Tuning under Homomorphic Encryption
comment: Technical report. 32 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/CRYPTO-KU/HE-OFT
summary: Many organizations adapt large pretrained models to their own tasks by fine-tuning on private data. Several of these parties often hold data for the same task and wish to fine-tune a model together without pooling that data. Federated learning (FL) enables joint fine-tuning, but reconstruction attacks on shared intermediate values (the model or its gradients) remain a privacy risk. A one-shot protocol that exchanges one encrypted contribution exposes no intermediate value. Such a protocol still gives the trained model to every participant, which is not permitted where the model is a regulated or proprietary asset. We present HE-OFT, the first cryptographically secure one-shot federated fine-tuning protocol in which no party receives the trained model. Each client fine-tunes a low-rank adapter and a classifier head on a frozen public backbone and keeps the adapter. The client uploads one encrypted head displacement, which the server combines under multiparty CKKS and never decrypts. A quorum of clients returns only the predicted label to the querier. On four text classification tasks and one vision task, HE-OFT reaches 61 to 79 per cent accuracy, against 20 to 48 per cent for a client training alone. HE-OFT keeps 85 to 96 per cent of the accuracy of a disclosed model. A test-time query takes 443.1 to 1713.1 s on one core, or 56.1 to 255.1 s with level restoration on a GPU. Restoring levels at the server cuts the traffic per query from up to 1.6 GiB to 13.5 MiB.

AI.tldr: HE-OFT 是首个加密安全的一次性联邦微调协议，任何参与方都无法获得训练好的模型本身。客户端在冻结的公共骨干网络上训练低秩适配器与分类头，仅上传一份加密的头部位移，由服务器在多方 CKKS 下聚合且永不解密，最终仅向查询方返回预测标签。
AI.motivation: 组织通常用私有数据微调大模型，多方希望联合微调而不共享数据。联邦学习可支持联合微调，但共享中间值（模型或梯度）存在重构攻击风险；一次性交换加密贡献可避免暴露中间值，但传统协议仍会把训练好的模型交给每个参与方，当模型属于受监管或专有资产时不可接受。因此需要一种既无中间值泄露、又不向任何参与方披露最终模型的方案。
AI.method: 客户端在冻结的公共骨干网络上微调低秩适配器与分类头，并本地保留适配器；随后上传一份加密的分类头位移，服务器在多方 CKKS 同态加密下进行组合且从不解密；由客户端法定人数（quorum）仅向查询方返回预测标签。引入服务器端层级恢复（level restoration）以降低开销。
AI.result: 在 4 个文本分类任务和 1 个视觉任务上，HE-OFT 达到 61%–79% 准确率，而单独训练的客户端仅为 20%–48%；相对公开模型的准确率保留 85%–96%。单次测试查询在单核上耗时 443.1–1713.1 秒，GPU 上结合层级恢复为 56.1–255.1 秒。服务器端层级恢复将每次查询流量从最高 1.6 GiB 降至 13.5 MiB。
AI.conclusion: HE-OFT 实现了首个不向任何参与方交付训练模型的加密安全一次性联邦微调协议，在保证隐私与模型保密性的同时取得了显著优于单独训练的准确率，并通过层级恢复大幅降低查询时延与通信量，具备实际可行性。

title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://visual-abstention.github.io
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化了"视觉弃答"（visual abstention）问题，提出DoD基准（1,050对可行-不可行请求，覆盖7类任务）与VisTA训练方法，使统一多模态模型在生成前判断任务可行性。VisTA-BAGEL对不可行请求拒绝率达93.0%（最强编辑模型仅0.4%），误拒率仅0.8%，同时可行编辑完成率74.3%，超过8个评测模型。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）整合了理解与生成能力，但其生成行为很少受"对任务的理解"所支配。当请求的视觉变换在任务规则下不可能实现时，模型理应识别出不存在有效解并拒绝生成，但现有模型普遍缺乏这种能力，表现为无视冲突、凭空规划编辑（描述图中不存在的物体）或悄悄将请求替换为可完成的任务。
AI.method: 1）形式化"视觉弃答"（visual abstention）：在任务规则下变换不可行时，模型应识别无有效解、明确陈述并拒绝生成；2）提出Draw-or-Decline（DoD）基准，含1,050对可行-不可行请求，覆盖7个任务类别，联合度量编辑成功率与不可行请求拒绝率；3）提出VisTA（Visual Transformation and Abstention）训练方法，成对使用可行与不可行样本，使模型在决定是否生成之前先进行可行性判断；4）基于BAGEL训练得到VisTA-BAGEL。
AI.result: 评测8个UMMs发现编辑能力与弃答能力是两种彼此独立的能力：最强编辑模型编辑准确率68.4%，但在普通指令下对不可行请求的拒绝率仅0.4%。显式提示模型报告不可行性虽提高文本拒绝率，却降低了编辑准确率。VisTA-BAGEL在无任何提示的情况下拒绝93.0%的不可行请求（相较最强编辑模型的0.4%），误拒可行请求仅0.8%；且不以牺牲编辑能力为代价，完成74.3%的可行编辑，优于全部8个被评测UMMs。
AI.conclusion: 编辑能力与弃答能力相互独立，提示无法同时兼顾二者；而通过在训练中成对引入可行与不可行样本、将可行性判断置于生成之前，VisTA可在显著提升弃答能力的同时保持甚至提升编辑性能，为统一多模态模型的可靠生成提供了有效路径。

title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
summary: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

AI.tldr: 对1,119条带标签的智能体动作进行实证检验，发现运行时门控的误差并不按乘法叠加：两个LLM裁判约等价1.2–1.4层，规则层加一个裁判约1.86–2.09层，远低于朴素乘法假设。
AI.motivation: 运行时门控（runtime gates）常被串联部署，其隐含假设是各层错误独立且相互叠加，即"误差相乘"、层数越多防护越强。本文质疑这一假设，并引入可量化的等价层数指标来检验门控堆叠的真实组合效应。
AI.method: 使用来自三个语料库的1,119条带标签智能体动作，在无自适应对手条件下评估由1个确定性规则层和4个LLM裁判组成的门控堆叠（其中3个重新采集并记录每次调用所用服务模型）。将堆叠效果折算为"乘法等价层数"n_mult并给出完美耦合下的下界。采用两种miss定义（STRICT：升级人工计为未拦截；PRIMARY：升级计为已捕获），并报告φ相关系数、显著性、下界区间，同时做第三方厂商裁判与云规则包的对照，以及耦合难度份额的探针敏感性分析。
AI.result: STRICT下任意两个裁判组合约1.2–1.4层（φ中位数+0.430，6/6对显著，下界1.02–1.17）；规则层加一个裁判约1.86–2.09层（φ中位数+0.014，0/4显著，下界1.01–1.09）。PRIMARY下区间分别为1.21–1.57与1.80–2.13。第三方厂商裁判落入裁判带；云规则包使规则层单层miss率降低20%但未增加新的联合覆盖；单层准确率不能预测其增量贡献；耦合的难度份额不可识别（31.8%–61.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 运行时门控的错误并不按乘法叠加，堆叠带来的实际防护增量显著低于乘法假设，且单层准确率无法预测组合收益。需警惕服务模型版本漂移：某裁判层在112批次中50批被供应了未请求的模型版本（集中于外部语料），该事件推翻了一条预声明分析规则，且评审裁决的计分方式反转了五条结论。作者对两种计分均予报告。

title: AIMS: Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis for Scalable Novel View Rendering
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis methods achieve strong generalization from posed multi-view inputs, but scaling them to large input view sets remains challenging. Transformer-based approaches that jointly process all input-view tokens incur rapidly increasing computation and memory as the number of views grows, while simple view subsampling discards potentially useful observations. We introduce Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis (AIMS), a scalable framework that decouples the number of available observations from the number of views processed by the global synthesis model. AIMS selects a fixed set of spatially distributed anchor views using farthest point sampling, groups nearby observations around each anchor, and uses a lightweight learnable integrator to fuse their information into enriched anchor representations. This allows additional observations to contribute to synthesis while keeping the downstream global view budget fixed. Evaluations on RealEstate10K and ScanNet demonstrate a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off against transformer-based and Gaussian-based baselines. AIMS achieves 29.41 dB and 17.73 dB PSNR on the two datasets, respectively, with rendering averaging 7.24 ms per view.

AI.tldr: AIMS 将可用观测数与全局合成模型处理的视图数解耦，用最远点采样选锚视图并聚合邻近观测，实现可扩展的前馈新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 前馈新视角合成泛化能力强，但扩展到大规模输入视图集困难：基于 Transformer 的方法对所有输入视图 token 联合处理，计算和内存随视图数迅速增长；简单视图下采样又会丢弃有用观测。
AI.method: 提出 Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis（AIMS）：用最远点采样选取固定数量、空间分布的锚视图；将邻近观测按锚分组；用轻量可学习的 integrator 把分组信息融合为增强的锚表示，使额外观测能参与合成，同时保持下游全局视图预算固定。
AI.result: 在 RealEstate10K 和 ScanNet 上分别达到 29.41 dB 和 17.73 dB PSNR，每视图渲染平均 7.24 ms，相较 Transformer 类和高斯类基线具有更优的质量—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: AIMS 通过“锚视图+分组融合”策略，在固定全局视图预算下有效利用大量观测，兼顾合成质量与计算效率，为大规模输入视图的前馈新视角合成提供了可扩展方案。

title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
summary: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.

AI.tldr: 开放对比决策模型CLM-v0.1-8B在多个公开基准上接近随机水平（0.351–0.593），与掷硬币无显著差异；同参数量奖励模型与生成式裁判显著更强。其原始置信度过度自信（最大+0.401），但单温度池化校准可将ECE降至≤0.062；决策顺序翻转率极低（0.0002），长度偏好偏移小（-0.023）。然而基于置信度的级联在0.97保留门槛下仍需将92.3%–100%样本升级给强裁判。
AI.motivation: 针对以开放式对比决策为形式的裁判模型，检验其是否具备可作为评判依据的判别与置信度信号，并在预注册冻结的评测协议下与生成式裁判、奖励模型及平凡基线进行公平对照，以判断该类模型能否独立充当评审或能否通过级联方式有效节省强裁判调用。
AI.method: 在五个公开偏好基准与一个带真实标签的幻觉基准上评测，所有评分在见到任何测试样本之前完成预注册冻结；对比对象包括生成式裁判、奖励模型与平凡基线；采用逐项预测并公开；分析指标涵盖准确率、与随机翻转的统计等价性（Benjamini-Hochberg 校正）、期望校准误差（单温度池化校准）、决策顺序翻转率、长度偏好偏移，以及置信度门控级联在0.97保留门槛下的升级比例。
AI.result: CLM-v0.1-8B在四选一最佳为0.351（随机0.250）、成对为0.593（随机0.500），在RM-Bench与JudgeBench上与掷硬币统计不可区分，对HaluEval全部输出同一个恒定标签，与"总选第一项"平凡基线同为0.581。同参数量裁判全面更高：奖励模型0.764–0.976，生成式裁判0.611–0.778，且所有与CLM的差距经BH校正后显著。原始置信度过度自信最高达+0.401，单温度池化校准后在留出校准项上ECE≤0.062，且校准后置信度在六个基准中的三个上能以高于随机的水平排序自身错误。决策顺序翻转率为0.0002（生成式裁判0.2188），长度偏好偏移-0.023（生成式裁判-0.217）。置信度门控级联在0.97保留门槛下需将0.923–1.000的样本升级至强裁判。
AI.conclusion: CLM-v0.1-8B作为裁判在硬公开基准上接近随机，不具备独立评审能力；其对决策顺序与长度等表面扰动不敏感，说明排序信号虽稳定但缺乏判别力。其置信度虽可被单温度校准修复，但对近乎随机的裁判而言校准后置信度几乎不含可用于筛选的"可信信息"，因此置信度门控级联无法有效节省强裁判调用，几乎全部样本仍须升级给强裁判。

title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
summary: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenSplatGraph统一框架，从在线高斯开放词汇语义地图直接构建持久3D场景图，实现语言引导的目标定位与结构化关系推理。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境下的机器人感知需要稠密3D建图与语义理解。现有的3D高斯泼溅建图方法虽能提供高保真几何与高效开放词汇感知，但将语义表示为非结构化特征场，限制了以对象为中心的推理；而3D场景图虽能显式建模对象及其关系以支持结构化推理，却多基于稀疏几何表示构建，未能充分利用稠密语义地图。二者存在割裂，亟需统一。
AI.method: 提出OpenSplatGraph框架：（1）在稠密语义地图上引入可靠性感知语义场，维护轻量级观测统计，实现置信度感知、查询条件化的对象提取；（2）将提取的对象实例关联到持久图节点，随观测与查询增量更新对象属性与关系；（3）将稠密语义建图与持久对象中心表示紧耦合，兼顾语言引导定位与结构化关系推理，并保持高斯建图的几何保真度。
AI.result: 在标准3D场景理解基准与真实机器人实验中，OpenSplatGraph在在线开放词汇感知及下游机器人任务上取得具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过紧耦合稠密高斯语义建图与持久对象中心表示，OpenSplatGraph弥合了非结构化语义场与结构化场景图之间的鸿沟，为在线开放词汇感知与机器人任务提供了统一有效的解决方案。

title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PFaithBench，通过配对（支持/非支持上下文）方式评估大模型忠实性，发现忠实性是"作答-弃答"权衡，多数模型偏向过度作答，并揭示训练数据构成对忠实性的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 现有忠实性评估多在单个"问题-上下文"实例上孤立评估，无法捕捉忠实行为的基本要求：模型应随可用上下文变化而调整回答，即证据充分时作答、不充分时弃答。这种实例级评估忽视了模型在上下文变化下自适应切换的能力。
AI.method: 提出配对忠实性基准PFaithBench，对同一问题分别在支持性上下文与非支持性上下文下测试模型能否在"作答"与"弃答"之间正确切换。评估覆盖7个模型家族共39个模型，并开展不同数据构造下的忠实性训练研究。
AI.result: 结果表明忠实性本质上是作答与弃答之间的权衡，多数模型存在强烈的作答偏好，主要错误来自过度作答（上下文不足时仍编造回答）。训练对作答/弃答数据的具体构成高度敏感：用不匹配来源构造数据会使模型依赖数据集特定捷径而非真正判断上下文充分性；增加作答监督数据提升作答性能但加剧过度作答，增加弃答数据减少幻觉却导致过度弃答。
AI.conclusion: 忠实性应作为"作答-弃答"的动态切换能力来评估，而非孤立的实例级判断。训练数据在作答与弃答之间的配比与来源匹配性显著影响忠实性表现；未来需设计更合理的数据构造以规避捷径学习和两类失衡问题。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

AI.tldr: MemCo是一个以记忆为中心的LLM智能体协作框架，通过互补的局部与全局记忆空间及动态路由机制，提升智能体在未见交互环境中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在交互环境中需通过观察、行动和反馈进行序贯决策。记忆虽能帮助复用经验，但现有工作孤立设计记忆，收集足够轨迹成本高昂；共享记忆方法虽能跨任务汇聚经验，却面临检索粒度难题——检索到的记忆要么过于具体而无法保持当前情境接地，要么过于粗略而无法支撑下一步行动。
AI.method: 提出MemCo，一种面向泛化的记忆中心协作框架。它维护互补的局部与全局记忆空间：局部保留环境特定细节，全局则从局部轨迹中归纳出可迁移的工作流。在线交互时，MemCo依据智能体当前状态与决策阶段路由相关的局部和全局记忆，使其能复用其他智能体经验，同时避免盲目迁移环境特定细节。
AI.result: 在交互式决策基准上的实验表明，与孤立记忆和共享记忆基线相比，MemCo提升了任务成功率并减少了冗余探索。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层记忆与状态感知的路由，MemCo有效缓解了共享记忆的粒度困境，实现了对环境特定细节与可迁移工作流的兼顾，为LLM智能体在未见交互环境中的泛化提供了可行方案。

title: CETUS: How Far Do Representations Trained on Earth Transfer to Cassini SAR of Titan?
comment: Research work at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/CETUS
summary: Cassini synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images reveal the dunes, plains, and lake basins of Titan, providing an instance of representations learned from Earth imagery for planetary terrain classification. Cross-domain Evaluation of Earth-to-Titan Transfer Using SAR (CETUS) compares features from DINOv2, DOFA and CROMA with classical image measurements and features from an untrained vision transformer on the U.S. Geological Survey's Cassini SAR mosaic. The classifiers learn terrain labels from an expert geomorphological map and predict those labels in geographically separate Titan regions. Under logistic regression settings, pretrained encoders achieve higher mean macro F1 than the combined classical features. Encoder rankings change when feature scaling, optimization, and regularization change together. Further training on Titan improves DINOv2 performance, degrades DOFA performance, and leads to mixed results for CROMA under the tested settings. Architectural and input processing differences prevent these comparisons from isolating the effect of pretraining. Classifier fitting and performance on individual terrain classes matter when assessing representation transfer for planetary mapping. Since the map draws partly on the same radar observations, the scores measure agreement with expert interpretation.

AI.tldr: CETUS基准在Cassini SAR影像上比较DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA等预训练编码器与传统影像特征及未训练ViT的地球到土卫六迁移能力，以专家地貌图为标签进行跨区域分类评测。
AI.motivation: 评估地球影像预训练表征能否迁移用于行星地形分类，需要在地球域外的目标域（土卫六）上做跨域检验，并厘清预训练本身、架构与输入处理各自对迁移性能的贡献。
AI.method: 以USGS Cassini SAR镶嵌图为数据源，从专家地貌图获取地形标签，在逻辑回归设置下比较DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA特征、经典影像测量特征与未训练ViT特征；在地理上分离的土卫六区域进行标签预测，并改变特征缩放、优化与正则化的组合，同时在土卫六上继续训练以观察影响。
AI.result: 逻辑回归设置下，预训练编码器的平均宏F1高于经典特征组合；当特征缩放、优化与正则化同时变化时，编码器排名发生改变。继续在土卫六上训练后，DINOv2性能提升，DOFA性能下降，CROMA结果不一。架构与输入处理的差异使比较无法单独分离预训练效应。
AI.conclusion: 行星制图中的表征迁移评估需重视分类器拟合与各地形类别的表现；由于地图部分基于同一雷达观测，所得分数反映的是与专家解释的一致性，而非独立的真值准确率。

title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
summary: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResearchTrails 数据集，从 Git 仓库的 commit 历史中抽取人类科研探索轨迹，用以弥补现有科学语料只记录最终成果、缺失探索过程的不足，并验证其在经验检索与模型训练等任务中的价值。
AI.motivation: 构建科研 AI 系统的关键挑战是支持"科学探索"——即通过一系列研究决策与行动系统性地探究未知现象以获取新知识的过程。然而现有科学语料库普遍缺失这一过程：研究论文主要记录最终结果，而非产生这些结果的研究轨迹，导致模型无法学习科学发现过程中的中间决策信息。
AI.method: 提出 ResearchTrails 数据集，以 Git 仓库的提交历史（commit histories）作为科研探索的代理信号；设计自动化、可扩展的流水线，从仓库提交中抽取结构化的研究轨迹，捕获方法、实验与消融实验的连续变化，并对数据集进行特征刻画与信号分析。
AI.result: 数据集刻画表明，这些轨迹包含关于中间研究决策的有意义信号，其信息超出最终论文所披露的内容；在多个用例中验证了 ResearchTrails 的效用，包括在测试时检索人类研究经验作为外部技能，以及在研究轨迹上训练模型以提升对新研究决策的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，AI 系统不仅可以从科学的最终产物中学习，还可以从发现过程本身中学习，为面向科学探索的 AI 系统提供了一条可行路径。

title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
summary: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.

AI.tldr: 提出BiGym 2.0，将BiGym适配到Unitree G1人形机器人，涵盖20项家务任务与统一全身控制器，并系统基准测试了VLA微调、模仿学习、示范驱动强化学习及编码智能体四类方法。
AI.motivation: 人形家务操作要求手臂在身体平衡、迈步与姿态变换的同时执行动作，现有基准难以在统一全身控制条件下对多种学习方法进行公平评测，因此需要一个面向人形机器人的标准化任务套件与评测框架。
AI.method: 基于Unitree G1构建BiGym 2.0，包含20项家务任务与统一全身控制器用于示范采集和评测；每项任务提供60条原生人类虚拟现实示范，含同步多相机视角与全身执行记录；在相同在线强化学习交互预算下，对视觉-语言-动作微调、模仿学习、示范驱动强化学习以及冷启动编码智能体进行基准对比，各方法共享相同的机载视角、本体感受与全身控制器。
AI.result: 在九项任务均值上视觉-语言-动作微调表现最佳；编码智能体生成的程序在该均值上超越全部示范驱动强化学习基线，并在双臂伸展任务上领先；跨工作空间堆叠任务仍未解决，π_{0.5}在取盒任务上得分偏低，多物体运输对模仿学习、示范驱动强化学习和编码智能体均较困难。
AI.conclusion: BiGym 2.0为人形全身家务操作提供了统一评测平台，揭示了不同学习范式的优劣与若干开放难题；所有环境、人类示范与评测记录均已开源。

title: ARIA: Audio-Driven Melody-Tone Relation Modeling for Cantonese Lyric Authoring
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, including references and appendices. Author-prepared version
summary: Cantonese lyric writing requires close alignment between lexical tones and melodic pitch. Existing melody-guided lyric generation methods typically rely on symbolic melody to generate lyrics. However, in real songwriting scenarios, melodies are often expressed as raw singing audio or hummed recordings, where pitch is implicit, noisy, and unstructured, making these methods difficult to apply directly. To address this limitation, we propose ARIA, a two-stage audio-driven melody-tone relation modeling framework for Cantonese lyric authoring that generates Cantonese lyrics from singing recordings with provided character-level timestamps. Specifically, we first design a Tri-Stream Relation-Aware Tone Estimator (TRATE) to predict 0243 sequences from timestamped singing audio by modeling multi-stream acoustic cues and relational tonal structure. We then propose a Decoupled Retrieval-Augmented Tone-Conditioned Lyric Generator (DRA-TCLG) to generate fluent lyrics conditioned on predicted tonal plans with retrieval-enhanced lexical guidance. Moreover, we construct a large-scale aligned audio-Jyutping-0243 dataset from real Cantonese singing recordings to support this new task. Experimental results demonstrate that ARIA achieves strong performance in both 0243 prediction and tone-consistent lyric generation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: ARIA：一个两阶段、音频驱动的粤语旋律—声调关系建模框架，可从带字符级时间戳的演唱录音直接生成粤语歌词。
AI.motivation: 粤语歌词创作需使字调与旋律音高紧密对齐。现有旋律引导的歌词生成方法多依赖符号化旋律，但真实创作场景中旋律常以原始演唱音频或哼唱录音形式存在，其音高隐式、含噪、非结构化，导致这些方法难以直接适用。
AI.method: 方法包含两阶段：1）设计三流关系感知声调估计器（TRATE），通过建模多流声学线索与关系化声调结构，从带时间戳的演唱音频预测 0243 序列；2）提出解耦检索增强的声调条件歌词生成器（DRA-TCLG），以预测的声调计划为条件，结合检索增强的词汇引导生成流畅歌词。此外，从真实粤语演唱录音构建大规模对齐的音频-Jyutping-0243 数据集以支撑该新任务。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ARIA 在 0243 预测与声调一致的歌词生成两项任务上均取得强劲性能，验证了所提框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将粤语歌词生成从符号旋律扩展到真实音频输入，通过声调估计与检索增强生成的两阶段解耦设计，结合新构建的大规模对齐数据集，为音频驱动的粤语歌词创作提供了有效方案。

title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
summary: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个 2×2 纵深防御框架，将内部激活引导与外部记忆处理分离，用于缓解长时记忆检索引发的谄媚行为，并在 MemSyco-Bench 上评估四个开源模型和五种记忆防御配置。
AI.motivation: 长时记忆让大模型能跨交互维持个性化上下文，但检索到的用户历史会诱发"记忆诱导谄媚"，使模型偏好存储的用户信念而非客观证据。现有防御主要作用于检索上下文，且很少与内部行为偏差联合评估。
AI.method: 构建 2×2 纵深防御框架，将内部激活引导与外部记忆处理分开。从 100 对提示中提取谄媚引导方向，在 MemSyco-Bench（全部 1,550 项答案；防御条件在固定 250 项子样本上评判）上评估四个开源模型、10 个引导系数和 5 种记忆防御配置，并使用三个 LLM 评判员。五种配置中三种为新增：重写每条记忆、对每条记忆执行保留/重写/丢弃的路由门（Router Gate）、丢弃全部记忆；另两种为 MemSyco 基线。
AI.result: 选择性 Router Gate 过滤比完全移除记忆保留了显著更多的 MemSyco 平均准确率，且该分离在模型被引导向谄媚时依然存在。在 Llama 3.1 8B 配合 Router Gate 时，温和反向引导（α=-1.5）将评判员平均谄媚率从 35.80% 降至 31.32%，平均准确率从 43.99% 变为 43.31%；该下降在三个评判员下方向一致，但在 149 项上不具统计显著性（配对 p=0.08 至 0.63）。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是设计中真正站得住脚的部分；数据未能表明反向引导对其有增量贡献。

title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
summary: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的旋转-反射群等变视觉Transformer（REViT-v2），基于窗口化群卷积自注意力与分层特征架构，首次将群等变ViT扩展到百万参数级并在ImageNet规模数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有群等变视觉Transformer（ViT）难以扩展到大规模参数和实用尺寸图像的数据集（如ImageNet），可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 采用窗口化群卷积自注意力（windowed group-convolutional self-attention）结合分层特征架构（hierarchical feature architecture），构建旋转-反射群等变的ViT。
AI.result: 成功将群等变ViT扩展到百万级参数规模，并在ImageNet等实用尺寸图像的大规模数据集上完成验证；代码与预训练权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: 所提REViT-v2证明了群等变视觉Transformer在大规模参数与数据下具备可扩展性。

title: Exact Unlearning via Quantized Sufficient Statistics
comment: 33 pages, 20 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Exact unlearning requires a deployed predictor to match one rebuilt without the information named by a deletion request. Existing general-purpose exact methods localize retraining through disjoint shards, but every request still invalidates a model, and smaller shards reduce the data available to each constituent predictor. We introduce Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS), which separates a small frozen schema from mutable, sum-decomposable content. The schema learns global structure; the content stores local prediction corrections as additive statistics indexed by quantized regions. Deleting content is therefore exact subtraction rather than optimization. We distinguish two guarantees: QSS-L exactly removes a label while retaining the unlabelled input, whereas QSS-E exactly removes both input and label by learning the schema without deletable examples. A deletion takes the arithmetic fast path with probability $1-ρ$ and triggers a full rebuild with probability $ρ$; all reported expected latencies include both events. Across 15 vision, text, and tabular datasets at $ρ=0.5\%$, QSS-L is within 2 percentage points of SISA on 11 tasks and provides 4--483$\times$ lower expected deletion latency on the low-class-count tasks where a compact schema is effective. QSS-E quantifies the additional accuracy cost of removing every trace of an input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量化充分统计量（QSS），将模型分为冻结的全局结构与可加性、按量化区域索引的可变内容，从而使删除操作变为精确的算术减法而非重新优化。
AI.motivation: 现有精确遗忘方法（如基于不相交分片的SISA）虽能通过局部重训实现精确删除，但每次删除请求仍会使一个模型失效，且分片越小则每个子预测器可用的数据越少，导致效率与精度难以兼得。作者希望实现一种无需优化、可直接通过减法完成精确删除的机制。
AI.method: QSS将模型分解为两部分：一个小的冻结模式（schema）学习全局结构，以及可变的、可求和分解的内容（content）。内容以加性统计量的形式存储局部预测修正，并按量化区域建立索引，因此删除内容即为精确的减法操作。作者区分两种保证：QSS-L 精确移除标签但保留未标注输入；QSS-E 通过在无可删除样本的情况下学习模式，精确移除输入与标签两者。删除以概率 1-ρ 走算术快路径，以概率 ρ 触发完全重建，所有报告的期望延迟均包含这两种事件。
AI.result: 在15个视觉、文本和表格数据集上，当 ρ=0.5% 时，QSS-L 在11个任务上精度与 SISA 相差不超过2个百分点，在紧凑模式有效的低类别数任务上期望删除延迟降低4–483倍。QSS-E 则量化了移除输入所有痕迹所额外付出的精度代价。
AI.conclusion: QSS 通过将删除转化为对可加性内容的精确减法，实现了比基于分片的精确遗忘方法更低的期望删除延迟，同时保持接近的精度；其两种变体分别对应仅移除标签与完全移除输入两类精确遗忘保证。

title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
summary: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.

AI.tldr: GaugeBench 通过在不改变机器人物理机制的前提下改写其描述约定（如关节轴方向、关节角零点、连杆/关节顺序与命名），发现策略权重在等价重述的机器人上性能从 4030.6 骤降至 51.6，甚至低于 98 个真正未见机器人的 1489.6，说明"换描述"可能比"换机器人"更具破坏性。
AI.motivation: 机器人描述不仅定义物理机构，还编码了关节轴方向、关节角零点、连杆与关节顺序及命名等任意约定。形态感知策略依赖这些描述构建的接口，而跨具身评估通常固定这些约定、只更换机器人。因此作者提出一个未被回答的问题：当机器人机制不变、但其描述发生变化时，行为能否保持？
AI.method: 提出 GaugeBench 基准：在物理等价约定下重写固定机构，验证其物理与策略接口保持一致，然后评估同一策略权重。系统性地分解不同约定变化（轴反转、关节角零点变化、顺序重排）以及不同接口通道（关节状态与力矩坐标 vs. 描述派生特征）的影响，并在 ModuMorph 与一个无关的 PyBullet 框架上复现，最后测试缓解手段。
AI.result: 三个 MetaMorph 策略在 80 个熟悉机器人上得分 4030.6，但在等价重述的同一批机器人上仅 51.6，而 98 个真正保留的机器人得分为 1489.6。仅轴反转即可复现崩溃，关节角零点变化几乎无害，顺序重排介于两者之间；仅改变关节状态与力矩坐标就足以导致失败，而仅改变描述派生特征则不会。该现象在 ModuMorph 和无关 PyBullet 框架中同样出现。此外，精确的双描述传输能恢复原控制器，跨等价轴约定训练可将轴反转下的保留回报从 3.6% 提升到 80.6%。
AI.conclusion: 研究将机制鲁棒性与表示鲁棒性区分开来，表明跨具身评估应同时测试二者，而非仅关注机器人形态变化；通过恰当训练或描述传输可以缓解描述变化带来的失效。

title: MARCO: The Radioactive Watermark for Protein Generative Models
summary: Protein Generative Models (PGMs) have revolutionized structural biology by enabling the design of complex 3D protein structures from sequence data. However, this breakthrough introduces a dual-use challenge, exposing high-value PGMs to economic risks like unauthorized model extraction and biosecurity threats such as biohazard synthesis. To mitigate these threats, we propose \textbf{MARCO} (\textsc{COnformation waterMARk}), the first radioactive watermarking framework specifically tailored for PGMs. MARCO establishes a Dual-Layer defense that simultaneously protects intellectual property and ensures the forensic traceability of potential biosecurity misuses. (i) To preserve efficiency, MARCO iteratively embeds watermarks during diffusion reverse denoising via an auxiliary encoder-decoder, allowing the original PGM parameters to remain frozen for broad compatibility. (ii) To preserve biophysical fidelity and maximize robustness, we employ specialized loss functions targeting $C_α$-atom pairwise distances and torsion angles ($ψ, φ$) within an adversarial training framework integrated with stochastic attack simulations. (iii) Crucially, MARCO exhibits ``radioactivity'' where the watermark automatically transfers to the outputs of any pirate models trained on the watermarked data, effectively countering model extraction attacks. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MARCO achieves superior fidelity and robustness while successfully validating watermark transferability.

AI.tldr: MARCO是首个面向蛋白质生成模型(PGM)的"放射性"水印框架，通过双层防御同时保护知识产权与实现生物安全溯源。它在扩散反向去噪过程中迭代嵌入水印，冻结原模型参数，并用针对Cα原子对距离与扭转角的专用损失及对抗训练保证保真度与鲁棒性；水印还能自动转移到基于水印数据训练的盗版模型上。
AI.motivation: PGM使从序列数据设计复杂三维蛋白质结构成为可能，但带来双重用途风险：一方面高价值模型面临未授权模型提取等经济风险，另一方面存在生物危害合成等生物安全威胁。现有工作缺乏针对PGM的水印方案，因此需要一种既能保护知识产权、又能对潜在生物安全滥用进行取证溯源的技术。
AI.method: 提出MARCO(COnformation waterMARk)"放射性"水印框架，建立双层防御。具体做法：(i)在扩散反向去噪过程中通过辅助编码器-解码器迭代嵌入水印，保持原PGM参数冻结以兼容广泛模型；(ii)设计针对Cα原子对距离及扭转角(ψ, φ)的专用损失函数，结合随机攻击模拟的对抗训练框架，以保持生物物理保真度并最大化鲁棒性；(iii)赋予水印"放射性"，使其自动转移到任何在含水印数据上训练的盗版模型输出中，抵御模型提取攻击。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，MARCO在保真度与鲁棒性方面均表现优越，同时成功验证了水印的可转移性。
AI.conclusion: MARCO为PGM提供了兼顾知识产权保护与生物安全溯源的水印方案，其冻结参数、结构感知损失与"放射性"转移机制在实验中有效，可作为应对PGM双重用途风险的可行防御手段。

title: Pseudowords as probes: Large Language Models show little of the sublexical sensitivity that governs human pseudoword processing
summary: Systematicity, the probabilistic mapping of form to meaning, permeates language at all levels, and sublexical cues have been shown to govern human pseudoword processing. Yet whether LLMs exhibit comparable sensitivity to these cues remains unclear. We tested five LLMs on two Italian two-alternative forced-choice pseudoword experiments and compared their responses with a human behavioural baseline. LLMs aligned more reliably with humans when real-word options provided a lexical familiarity cue than in the pseudoword-only condition, where they fell substantially below fastText, a character-n-gram model. In addition, the sublexical cosine-similarity cue that reliably drove human--fastText agreement did not consistently transfer to human--LLM alignment, and reasoning-token expenditure bore no consistent relation to human processing difficulty. These findings suggest that LLMs do not necessarily share the sublexical cues that govern human pseudoword processing; we discuss tokenization and training-data coverage as candidate explanations.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了五个大语言模型与人类在意大利语假词二选一加工任务上的表现，发现LLM仅在含真实词的熟悉度线索条件下与人类一致，而在纯假词条件下的次词汇线索敏感性低于fastText模型，表明LLM未必具备驱动人类假词加工的次词汇线索机制。
AI.motivation: 系统性（形式到意义的概率映射）普遍存在于语言各层级，且次词汇线索已被证明支配人类假词加工。然而，LLM是否对人类所依赖的这些次词汇线索具有可比敏感性尚不清楚，作者希望借此检验LLM与人类在次词汇加工层面的对齐程度。
AI.method: 选取五个LLM，在两项意大利语二选一强制选择假词实验中进行测试，并与人类行为基线比较；同时以fastText（字符n元语法模型）作为参照，考察次词汇余弦相似度线索在人类-fastText一致性与人类-LLM一致性之间的迁移情况，并分析推理token消耗与人类加工难度的关系。
AI.result: 当真实词选项提供词汇熟悉度线索时，LLM与人类的一致性更可靠；而在纯假词条件下，LLM表现显著低于fastText。能够稳定驱动人类-fastText一致性的次词汇余弦相似度线索并未一致迁移到人类-LLM对齐中；推理token消耗与人类加工难度也无稳定关系。
AI.conclusion: LLM未必共享支配人类假词加工的次词汇线索。作者将分词（tokenization）与训练数据覆盖度列为可能的解释因素。

title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
summary: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出2D-FET-Bench V2基准，用128个基于显微图像轮廓的FET版图任务，检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成逐片定制的器件版图构建。
AI.motivation: 二维剥离薄片的FET版图通常需针对每个薄片人工绘制，接触与栅极位置需匹配其显微图像中的位置和外形。目前缺乏可执行基准来检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成这种薄片定制化的版图构建任务。
AI.method: 构建128个任务，包含带孔薄片和多薄片任务；每个任务给定文本器件规格与轮廓坐标，智能体生成带类型的多边形与路径操作并渲染为GDSII；采用确定性验证器检查几何与结构要求，另有完整性检查确保给定轮廓不变；脚本化参考版图通过全部任务以证明可解；评测六个模型及GPT5.6-Luna的七种工作流/脚手架变体，每任务五次尝试。
AI.result: 六模型面板中最佳配置为GPT5.6-Luna搭配ReAct-3：尝试通过率62.3%，覆盖率80.5%（至少一次成功），一致性43.8%（五次全成功）。ReAct-3较单次Plan-and-Execute的pass@1高27.0个百分点，但token消耗为其2.46倍。对五个ReAct-3配置下每个已覆盖任务各抽一份通过验证器的版图做专家审核，接受率为56.4%至63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准用于评估几何与结构层面的FET版图构建能力，表明任务全部可解，但现有语言模型智能体在可靠性与一致性上仍明显不足，且验证器通过并不等同于专家认可。

title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
summary: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is hard: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.

AI.tldr: PhysLDM 提出统一的时空隐空间扩散范式，用于体素级可变形体的单次（one-shot）高保真神经仿真，实现高压缩、高精度与零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率三维体积网格的长时程预测困难：自回归方法易累积误差，原生分辨率的多帧直接预测计算代价过高；因此需要紧凑的时空隐表示。此外，确定性回归与生成式扩散哪种预测范式更合适尚不明确。
AI.method: 1) 构建整体式时空 VAE，避免标准时序压缩（如常见视频 VAE）的"阶梯"伪影；2) 在该可靠隐空间上系统比较回归与扩散方法；3) 基于"复杂可变形动力学常呈混沌、确定性回归易产生非物理平均"的发现，采用隐扩散模型生成物理合理的轨迹；4) 仅在 Objaverse 规模数据集上进行纯运动学训练。
AI.result: 在米级场景上达到约 2.48 mm 重建精度，token 压缩率最高 78x；单一 PhysLDM 可零样本泛化到未见过的 OOD 数据集（GSO、Toys4K）；模型可微性支持高效求解逆问题与高阶设计优化。
AI.conclusion: PhysLDM 是首个面向体积可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与隐扩散范式，为神经仿真提供了可扩展且鲁棒的方法。

title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: https://drmoet.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出DRMoET，将逐层专家视为内生的鲁棒性分组，以熵正则化软最大规则优化高损失路由结果，提升MoE路由鲁棒性与下游性能。
AI.motivation: MoE通过每token仅激活少量专家扩展容量，但稀疏性带来隐藏的可靠性问题：路由不完美时，负载均衡模型可能将token发送到对相应输入训练不足的专家。仅均衡流量不足以保证可靠性。
AI.method: DRMoET：一种即插即用目标，将逐层专家视为内生鲁棒性分组，优化高损失路由结果而非单纯均衡流量；通过基于EMA平滑、激活加权专家损失的熵正则化softmax规则更新每层专家分布，强化合理的非top路由路径，同时保持标准MoE计算。
AI.result: 在FLAME-MoE配方下，746M总参数与10.3B总参数规模上，DRMoET下游平均优于标准FLAME-MoE及无辅助损失均衡基线。10.3B总参数、67B训练token时，七任务平均从0.6625提升至0.6767，无辅助损失均衡基线为0.6431。机理分析显示专家损失方差更低而平均损失几乎不变，强制中间k误路由下超额损失降低4.3%，领域-专家专业化提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明路由鲁棒性——不仅是利用率均衡——是可靠稀疏MoE扩展的实用目标。项目页与代码见https://drmoet.github.io/。

title: Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models
summary: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.

AI.tldr: 提出将隐空间扰动建模为对学习隐动力学的合理但与悲观扰动，并借共形预测校准不确定性集，通过博弈论联合优化机器人动作与最坏隐扰动，用于策略引导。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒优化需要显式动力学与物理意义明确的扰动，而世界模型的状态空间与动力学均从高维观测学习得到，难以定义能忠实反映底层系统不确定性的隐空间扰动。核心挑战在于如何在WM隐空间中构造既合理又具鲁棒意义的扰动。
AI.method: 1）将隐空间扰动定义为对学习隐动力学的扰动，诱导悲观但合理的转移；2）结合动力学感知相似性度量与分布外检测，排除不合理隐状态，构造合理隐动力学集合；3）用共形预测校准该不确定性集，避免过度悲观；4）以博弈论优化联合求解鲁棒动作与最坏隐扰动；5）应用于隐空间安全滤波与生成式控制策略的采样-验证引导两种范式。
AI.result: 受控仿真实验表明该隐扰动可在WM隐空间直接实现鲁棒决策；Franka机械臂硬件实验显示，隐扰动建模支持鲁棒策略引导，安全滤波失败率降低70%，采样式策略引导失败率降低54%。
AI.conclusion: 通过共形校准的隐动力学不确定性集与博弈论联合优化，可在世界模型隐空间中实现有理有据的鲁棒决策与策略引导，并在真实机械臂任务上显著减少失败。

title: Case-Level Verification in Scanner-LLM Cascades: Overcoming the Alert Aggregation Bottleneck to Expand the FRR-TPR Trade-off Space
comment: Accepted at the 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Data Analysis (ICDA 2026). To appear in the ACM International Conference Proceedings Series (ICPS). 17 pages
summary: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) scanners achieve high recall but also produce a large number of false positives, resulting in substantial manual triage costs. Large Language Models (LLMs), when used for independent detection, achieve extremely high recall (95.4%-100%) but also exhibit prohibitively high false positive rates (49.6%-85.0%), precluding their use as standalone replacements for scanners. A natural solution is a two-stage cascade consisting of scanner detection followed by LLM verification. However, a verification-granularity issue that has long been overlooked in practice creates a structural bottleneck: alert aggregation binds multiple true and false cases into a shared decision unit, such that removing a false positive inevitably eliminates true positives aggregated within the same alert group. This creates a trade-off bottleneck between the False-positive Reduction Rate (FRR) and the True-positive Rate (TPR). We formalize this bottleneck by showing that the alert-level false-positive set is a subset of the case-level false-positive set, and introduce a Case-Level, per-case verification strategy that shifts the decision granularity from the alert level to the instance level, independently replaying HTTP requests and making an independent determination for each detected case. Evaluation on the dual testbeds of Damn Vulnerable Web Application (DVWA) and WebGoat shows that the empirically best Alert-Level operating point achieves FRR=42.86% (TPR=51.7%). The Case-Level Baseline achieves FRR=47.6%, an improvement of 4.7 percentage points (+4.7 pp), while the Case-Focused Evidence Verification Prompt (CEV-Prompt) increases TPR from 55.2% to 62.1% at the same FRR.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对DAST扫描器与LLM级联验证中的"验证粒度"问题，提出案例级逐案例验证策略（含CEV-Prompt），在DVWA与WebGoat上将FRR提升4.7个百分点，并在同FRR下将TPR从55.2%提升至62.1%。
AI.motivation: DAST扫描器召回率高但误报量大，人工分诊成本高；LLM独立检测召回率极高（95.4%-100%）却误报率过高（49.6%-85.0%），无法单独替代扫描器。自然的解决方案是"扫描器检测+LLM验证"的两阶段级联，但实践中长期被忽视的验证粒度问题形成结构性瓶颈：告警聚合把多个真阳与假阳绑定为同一决策单元，剔除假阳必然连带删除同组真阳，从而在FRR与TPR之间形成权衡瓶颈。
AI.method: 形式化该瓶颈，证明告警级假阳集合是案例级假阳集合的子集；提出案例级（Case-Level）逐案例验证策略，将决策粒度从告警级下移到实例级，独立重放HTTP请求并对每个检测案例单独判定；并设计案例聚焦证据验证提示（CEV-Prompt）以增强验证效果。
AI.result: 在DVWA与WebGoat双测试平台上，告警级经验最优工作点为FRR=42.86%（TPR=51.7%）；案例级基线达到FRR=47.6%，提升4.7个百分点；CEV-Prompt在相同FRR下将TPR从55.2%提升至62.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将验证粒度从告警级细化为案例级可有效缓解误报削减与真阳保留之间的结构性瓶颈，配合CEV-Prompt可在不牺牲FRR的前提下显著提升TPR。

title: Leveraging a four-quadrant approach for evaluating Redpine Science
summary: Redpine Science gives models and agents a single access point to a wide range of peer-reviewed literature, queried directly through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and an API. This report evaluates Redpine Science on two levels: the relevance of the retrieved chunks, and a model's answer when it has access to Redpine Science compared to web search. Both public and expert-validated benchmarks are used. Public benchmarks are a widely accepted way to test model development and are comparable across labs, but risk saturation and memorization. To address this, we complement them with an expert-validated question set. In total, this report presents four evaluations. On ScholarQABench SciFact, the public answer-quality benchmark reported here, an agent with Redpine Science answers 94.4% of claims correctly against 87.6% with no retrieval. On the expert-validated question set, an agent with Redpine Science states 80.1% of the required claims against 70.2% for an agent restricted to web search. On the 668 queries of a public retrieval benchmark whose gold paper Redpine holds, stripped of any model reasoning, Redpine Science places the correct source paper in its top ten results for 83.1% of queries (Recall@10), against 79.3% for the benchmark's creator. A blinded expert relevance panel places Redpine Science's Precision@5 at 75.2% against 39.8% for the PubMed search tool. We release the expert-validated question set and instructions to reproduce every headline result above, at https://github.com/redpine-ai/benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 报告通过公共基准与专家验证题集双重评估Redpine Science，在答案质量、检索召回与相关性精度上均优于无检索、网页搜索、基准创建者及PubMed工具。
AI.motivation: 公共基准存在饱和与记忆化风险，难以真实反映模型能力；因此需引入专家验证题集作为补充，以更可靠地评估文献检索与问答系统的实际表现。
AI.method: 构建Redpine Science作为经MCP与API访问同行评审文献的统一入口；设计四项评估：公共答案质量基准ScholarQABench SciFact、专家验证题集、公共检索基准（668条查询，去除模型推理）、盲审专家相关性小组，并与无检索、网页搜索、基准创建者及PubMed搜索工具对比。
AI.result: ScholarQABench SciFact上正确率94.4%（无检索87.6%）；专家题集必需要点覆盖80.1%（网页搜索70.2%）；检索Recall@10为83.1%（基准创建者79.3%）；盲审Precision@5为75.2%（PubMed为39.8%）。
AI.conclusion: Redpine Science在答案质量与检索相关性上均取得一致优势，且公开了专家验证题集与复现说明，支持结果可重复验证。

title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

AI.tldr: 该研究在20名慢性踝关节不稳者中评估时序卷积分类器对GOOD/BAD步态周期标签的判别性能（LOSO交叉验证），并考察自适应反馈干预中模型在线更新与人体响应。
AI.motivation: 自适应步态生物反馈可能支持慢性踝关节不稳患者的重复练习，但其评估需同时关注模型性能与人体响应两个方面。
AI.method: 采用被试留出（LOSO）交叉验证评估时序卷积分类器对协议定义、基于角度推导的GOOD/BAD步态周期标签的分类表现（n=20）；自适应干预组7名参与者3周内完成9次训练，每次分析一次动作捕捉记录；对失败训练后更新的模型与其父模型进行离线比较，比较数据集为用于候选选择的同次验证子集及随后首次自适应训练记录；在基线、训练后及7天保留期，比较自适应组与10名顺序入组对照者的额面踝关节角度。
AI.result: 20个留出折的平均折级AUROC为0.948，对超出角度阈值BAD周期的敏感度为0.941，对符合角度阈值GOOD周期的特异度为0.366；候选模型BAD类F1在同次子集上平均高0.187，在随后首次记录上高0.118；训练后自适应组经基线校正的额面踝关节角度较对照组低5.168度（95%CI 1.766-8.569度更低），保留期对比结果不确定。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了重复生物反馈使用中群体模型的判别能力与离线个体化更新效果，并给出非随机化的训练后额面踝关节角度关联；但不能确立独立的临床步态分类能力，也不能证明模型更新具有因果获益。

title: Disentangling Dual Image References in Frequency Aware Diffusion Models for Personalized Generation
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, to appear at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Personalized image generation aims to synthesize text-driven images conditioned on reference images, while mainly casting the generation as image customization for foreground and style transfer for background. Previous arts of diffusion models suffers from the text misalignment with background for image customization and foreground for style transfer during the denoising process. Such facts, as we observed, rooted from the entanglement among hybrid frequency bands during the denoising process. To address such salient limitation, in this paper, we study personalized generation based on dual references - customization and color and style reference - and propose a paradigm to disentangle these Dual image references within Frequency-aware Diffusion Models, dubbed Dual-FDM, to simultaneously tackle two crucial personalized image generation tasks: customization style transfer and color style transfer, by disentangling different frequency bands via mask strategy within frequency domain. For customization style transfer, we replace the mid-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from the foreground of the customized reference. For color style transfer, we substitute the low-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from both the foreground and background of the color reference. Both the substituted frequency bands are used as the key and value to reconstruct the query foreground and background of the denoised personalized image.Extensive experiments validate the superiority of Dual-FDM over the state-of-the-art diffusion models for personalized image generation. Our code can be accessed from https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-FDM，通过频域掩码解耦双重参考图像（定制参考与颜色/风格参考）的不同频段，统一解决定制风格迁移与色彩风格迁移中的文本错位问题。
AI.motivation: 个性化图像生成主要分为前景的图像定制与背景的风格迁移。已有扩散模型在去噪过程中存在文本与背景（图像定制场景）、文本与前景（风格迁移场景）错位的问题，作者观察发现其根源在于去噪过程中混合频段之间的相互纠缠。
AI.method: 基于双重参考（定制参考 + 颜色与风格参考）的个性化生成范式，在频域内以掩码策略解耦不同频段。定制风格迁移：用定制参考前景的中频段替换风格参考背景的中频段；色彩风格迁移：用颜色参考前景与背景的低频段替换风格参考背景的低频段；被替换的频段作为key与value，用于重建去噪后个性化图像的前景与背景query。
AI.result: 大量实验验证Dual-FDM在个性化图像生成上优于现有最先进的扩散模型。代码已开源：https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域中的双参考频段解耦，可有效缓解文本错位问题，并在定制风格迁移与色彩风格迁移上取得领先性能。

title: Can LLM-assisted regularization increase forecast accuracy for migration flows in low data regimes?
summary: Predicting migration flows remains a significant challenge for traditional gravity-based forecasting models, which primarily rely on structured socio-economic indicators such as economic disparity, political stability, and geographic distance. This work investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can improve migration forecasting by extracting contextual migration-related signals from news articles and incorporating them into a weighted Lasso forecasting framework through feature-specific regularization penalties. The proposed framework uses hierarchical LLM inference pipelines to classify migration-related push--pull signals from news data and evaluates the resulting forecasting performance across multiple migration corridors between November 2021 and November 2022, including Mexico--United States, Ukraine--Poland, and Syria--Turkey. Experimental results showed mixed performance across migration corridors and modeling strategies, and no single regularization approach consistently outperformed the others across all experiments. The best-performing Mexico configuration, which consisted of a gravity-based model augmented with the proposed push--pull ratios, achieved a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 17.15%, while the strongest Syria configuration achieved a MAPE of 29.29% using Direct LLM-Lasso. For Ukraine, the best-performing configuration used LLM-Assisted Regularization (AR) and achieved a MAPE of 41.05%. Overall, the results suggest that contextual article-derived features and LLM-guided regularization can improve migration forecasting under certain conditions, although migration corridor characteristics, article volume, and hyperparameter configuration strongly influenced performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索用大语言模型从新闻中抽取迁移推拉信号，并以特征特定正则化融入加权Lasso预测框架，但实验显示效果因迁移走廊而异，无单一策略占优。
AI.motivation: 传统基于引力模型的迁移流预测主要依赖经济差距、政治稳定性和地理距离等结构化社会经济指标，难以捕捉新闻中的情境性迁移信号，作者希望验证大语言模型能否弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 采用分层式大语言模型推理流程，对新闻数据进行迁移相关推拉信号分类，并将抽取的特征通过特征特定正则化惩罚融入加权Lasso预测框架，在2021年11月至2022年11月间的多条迁移走廊上进行评估。
AI.result: 各迁移走廊与建模策略表现不一，无单一正则化方法在所有实验中持续最优：墨西哥最佳配置（引力模型加推拉比值）MAPE为17.15%，叙利亚最佳配置（Direct LLM-Lasso）MAPE为29.29%，乌克兰最佳配置（LLM-Assisted Regularization）MAPE为41.05%。
AI.conclusion: 文章衍生的情境特征与大语言模型引导的正则化在特定条件下可提升迁移预测效果，但迁移走廊特征、文章数量与超参数配置对性能影响显著。

title: Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane
summary: In mill yards, log loaders clear dense piles by a sequence of bundle grasps: hundreds of logs rest in contact, and each removal changes the pile available to the next grasp. A learned policy chooses where to place and orient the grapple from unsegmented point clouds and runs on a trailer-mounted hydraulic forestry crane. The policy classifies at which observed point to grasp and predicts depth and grapple orientation there. The same network outputs support behavior cloning (BC), reinforcement learning (RL), and deployment. BC learns from successful top-of-pile demonstrations; RL explores for improvements by fine-tuning the cloned policy (BC$\to$RL) or by training from scratch. In simulation, BC clears 98 of 100 piles of 200 logs, while BC$\to$RL improves load stability. Twelve field trials compare a geometric heuristic, RL from scratch, BC, and BC$\to$RL through complete grasp-transport-deposit cycles. BC and BC$\to$RL deposit 93.8% and 88.9% of pooled inventory, against 80.4% for the heuristic. BC$\to$RL deposits logs on 83.6% of its cycles, against 79.6% for the heuristic and 65.7% for BC, while its simulated stability gain does not carry over to the crane testbed. Trained entirely in simulation and run unchanged on the crane, the learned policies clear more than the hand-filtered heuristic while observing unfiltered clouds that still contain the storage rack's rails and poles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于未分割点云的抓取策略，用于原木装载机在密集原木堆中作业，支持行为克隆、强化学习及两者结合，并在仿真与真实林业起重机上验证。
AI.motivation: 密堆原木相互接触，每次抓取都会改变剩余可抓取状态，传统几何启发式方法依赖人工滤波，难以适应非结构化、含支架等干扰的真实点云环境，需要学习型策略提升清理效率与稳定性。
AI.method: 策略输入未分割点云，先分类抓取点，再预测该点处深度与抓斗朝向；同一网络可支持行为克隆（BC）、强化学习（RL）与部署。BC从堆顶成功示范学习，RL可在克隆策略上微调（BC→RL）或从头训练，并在仿真中训练后直接迁移到拖车式液压林业起重机。
AI.result: 仿真中BC清除100堆（每堆200根原木）中的98堆，BC→RL提升负载稳定性。12次现场试验对比几何启发式、从头RL、BC与BC→RL：BC与BC→RL分别沉积93.8%与88.9%的总库存，启发式为80.4%；循环成功率BC→RL为83.6%，启发式79.6%，BC为65.7%；仿真的稳定性增益未在真实起重机上复现。
AI.conclusion: 完全在仿真中训练并原样部署的学习策略，在含存储架轨道与立柱的未滤波点云上，仍能比人工滤波的启发式方法清除更多原木，证明学习型抓取策略在真实林业起重机上的有效性与可迁移性。

title: Federated Bayesian Surveillance of Mechanical Thrombectomy Adverse Events: A Population Risk Layer for Surgical Digital Twins
comment: Presented at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) Workshop on Surgical Digital Twins (SurgTwin). 3 pages, 1 figure
summary: Learned surgical simulators and world models can roll out plausible procedural futures, but they carry no grounded estimate of how often interventional devices actually harm patients. We propose treating population-scale adverse-event surveillance as a distinct belief layer of the surgical digital twin, and we evaluate a federated Bayesian protocol for learning it under formal privacy guarantees. Each site holds per-class Gamma-Poisson posteriors over adverse-event rates and exchanges only Rényi-differentially-private natural-parameter updates. We benchmark on the complete FDA MAUDE cohort for thrombus-retrieval catheters (product code NRY): 8,617 reports, of which 6,491 are classified by transparent keyword rules into five thrombectomy complication classes and partitioned across $K=8$ manufacturer sites. At a matched privacy budget of $(\\varepsilon \\approx 2.09, \δ= 10^{-5})$, the conjugate protocol attains a held-out Poisson score of -5.78 per test event versus -26.58 for FedAvg with differential privacy.
