We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"余量(headroom)"框架：探针分数应对照两个参考点——下界(简单输入已能预测的部分)与上界(完整输入能预测的部分)，二者之差即模型可证明"超出简单输入"的计算范围；并证明余量在两种情形下消失。
AI.motivation: 探针是可解释性的主力工具，但探针分数缺乏固定含义：R²=0.6 可能只反映输入本身已泄露的信息，同一分数在不同数据上含义不同，因此需要一个相对基准来解读探针分数。
AI.method: 提出将每个探针分数对照下界(声明式简单输入的可预测度)与上界(完整输入的可预测度)，取二者之差为 headroom；在上下文元分析(需推断研究间隐藏异质性以正确加权)的 transformer 上做验证，其中两个参考点均已知，并考察分布偏移情形；随后分析真实模型 scGPT，并重新审视四项有影响力的 LLM 探针研究(地理、Othello 棋盘状态、真值、用户人口统计)。
AI.result: 分布偏移下探针分数下降、预测误差上升 12–15 倍，但模型恢复的 headroom 占比相近，说明是数据丢失信息而非表征退化；scGPT 仅部分编码生物变异性；四项 LLM 探针研究中，部分结论在下界之上成立，另一些则基本可由输入文本本身解释。
AI.conclusion: 探针分数必须相对于下界与上界来解读，headroom 才能刻画模型是否计算了超出简单输入的内容；该框架可区分"数据丢信息"与"表征丢信息"，并重估既有探针结论的有效性。

title: Beyond Scalar IoU: Structured Verification from Rollout Groups for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural framework for adapting pretrained models to video temporal grounding, where generated temporal intervals can be scored directly against ground truth intervals. Yet existing overlap verifiers typically score each rollout independently, leaving the joint structure of the rollout group unused. We introduce SUTURE, which conditions verification on the rollout group and exploits its structure at two complementary scales: disagreement across rollouts controls how strongly the target is reweighted, while coverage at each position determines where reward mass is redistributed. We show that the resulting verifier admits an exact decomposition into the standard IoU term and a covariance correction determined by the rollout group. A local gradient diagnostic finds a preference for responses covering relatively less supported target regions in the analyzed groups. Across five temporal grounding benchmarks, SUTURE improves grounding performance at every reported IoU threshold. Its trained policy also shows less video-start anchoring in reasoning traces: for later events, the first temporal mention more often overlaps the annotated target. Together, these results show that the joint structure of a rollout group can support a more informative temporal verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SUTURE，一种在视频时序定位中利用 rollout 组联合结构的可验证奖励验证器，通过组内分歧重加权目标、按位置覆盖率重分配奖励，并在五个基准上提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重叠度（如 IoU）的验证器对每个 rollout 独立打分，忽略了同一 rollout 组的联合结构信息，导致奖励信号信息量不足。
AI.method: SUTURE 以 rollout 组为条件进行验证，在两个尺度上利用组结构：组内 rollout 间的不一致程度控制目标的重加权强度；各位置的覆盖率决定奖励质量的再分配位置。作者证明该验证器可精确分解为标准 IoU 项与由 rollout 组决定的协方差修正项，并用局部梯度诊断分析响应偏好。
AI.result: 在五个时序定位基准上，SUTURE 在所有报告的 IoU 阈值下均提升定位性能；训练策略在推理轨迹中表现出更少的视频起始锚定现象——对于较晚发生的事件，首次时序提及更常与标注目标重叠。
AI.conclusion: rollout 组的联合结构可支撑更具信息量的时序验证器，为 RLVR 在视频时序定位中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Classification from Whole-Slide Images
summary: Gastric adenocarcinoma (GA) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and accurate histopathological subtype classification from whole-slide images (WSIs) is essential for effective treatment planning. While multimodal approaches that integrate pathology report text with WSIs can improve classification, existing methods often depend on computationally expensive transformer architectures and large language models. We propose a multimodal knowledge distillation (MKD) framework that combines a pretrained WSI image encoder and a clinical text encoder using Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) to efficiently model cross-modal interactions during training. Each WSI is represented as a bag of patches paired with a slide-level diagnostic caption. The teacher model learns fused image-text representations for subtype classification, while the student model distills this knowledge to enable accurate image-only inference. We evaluate our method on the PatchGastric benchmark dataset and achieve at least 3.35% higher mean accuracy than state-of-the-art approaches, without relying on transformer-based fusion, multi-task learning, or large language models. The source code is available at https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态知识蒸馏（MKD）框架，结合预训练WSI图像编码器与临床文本编码器，利用低秩多模态融合（LMF）在训练中高效建模跨模态交互；教师模型学习图文融合表征用于胃腺癌亚型分类，学生模型蒸馏知识以支持仅图像推理。在PatchGastric基准上平均准确率较SOTA至少提升3.35%，且无需Transformer融合、多任务学习或大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 胃腺癌（GA）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，基于全切片图像（WSI）的组织病理学亚型准确分类对治疗规划至关重要。多模态方法融合病理报告文本与WSI可提升分类性能，但现有方法往往依赖计算开销高昂的Transformer架构与大语言模型，成本高、效率低。
AI.method: 提出多模态知识蒸馏（MKD）框架：输入为WSI的patch包（bag of patches）与切片级诊断文本描述；使用预训练WSI图像编码器与临床文本编码器，通过低秩多模态融合（LMF）高效建模跨模态交互；教师模型学习融合的图文表征进行亚型分类，学生模型蒸馏该知识，实现仅需图像的推理。
AI.result: 在PatchGastric基准数据集上，平均准确率较当前最先进方法至少提升3.35%，且不依赖基于Transformer的融合、多任务学习或大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: MKD结合LMF可在不引入高开销架构的前提下有效利用多模态信息提升胃腺癌亚型分类性能，并通过蒸馏实现图像单模态推理，兼顾性能与效率。源码已开源。

title: RELACE: retrospective likelihood-based action credit estimation for long-horizon language agents
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) avoids a separate critic by estimating advantages from rollout groups. For multi-turn agents, however, trajectory-level supervision provides coarse, noisy credit: terminal rewards do not locate errors and can penalize useful actions alongside mistakes. Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and subsequent methods refine supervision through state-conditioned comparisons, but their credit estimates remain sensitive to downstream decisions and outcomes. We introduce RELACE, Retrospective Likelihood-based Action, a critic-free framework that integrates retrospective action assessment with state-conditioned advantage estimation. RELACE evaluates executed actions through teacher-forced likelihood scoring under both their original contexts and outcome-augmented contexts. Comparing these likelihoods yields a trajectory-normalized retrospective factor that captures outcome-dependent changes in action plausibility, rather than hindsight plausibility alone. We use this factor to reweight discounted task returns and construct local advantages by comparing weighted returns among actions from equivalent states within a task. This couples retrospective relevance with observed reward, producing fine-grained credit that complements trajectory-level GRPO supervision. Temporal smoothing and success-protecting masking further stabilize the local signal. RELACE requires neither auxiliary value nor reward models nor additional autoregressive rollouts for credit estimation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate substantial improvements over GRPO, GiGPO, and HCAPO. With the 1.5B model, RELACE achieves $96.35\%$ success on ALFWorld and $79.43\%$ on WebShop, surpassing GiGPO by $5.47$ and $5.60$ percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 RELACE：一种无需 critic 的多轮智能体策略优化框架，通过"回溯似然"打分与状态条件优势估计，生成细粒度信用分配，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上显著超越 GRPO、GiGPO 与 HCAPO。
AI.motivation: GRPO 用 rollout 分组估计优势以省去 critic，但多轮智能体的轨迹级监督过于粗糙且噪声大：终端奖励无法定位错误出处，且会把有用动作与错误动作一并惩罚。GiGPO 等后续方法用状态条件比较细化监督，但其信用估计仍对下游决策与结果敏感（受事后结果影响），因此需要一种既无 critic、又能给出细粒度且对结果变化可解释的信用分配方法。
AI.method: RELACE（Retrospective Likelihood-based Action）在教师强制（teacher-forced）下，对已执行动作分别在"原始上下文"和"结果增强上下文"中做似然打分；两者似然之差经轨迹归一化得到回溯因子，用以刻画结果依赖下动作合理性的变化，而非单纯的事后合理性。用该因子对折扣任务回报重新加权，并在同一任务内对等价状态下的动作比较加权回报，构造局部优势，从而把回溯相关性与观测奖励耦合，补充轨迹级 GRPO 监督。此外引入时间平滑与成功保护掩码稳定局部信号。该方法不需要辅助价值模型、奖励模型，也不需额外自回归 rollout 来估计信用。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行实验，RELACE 相较 GRPO、GiGPO 与 HCAPO 均有显著提升。1.5B 模型下，ALFWorld 成功率达 96.35%，WebShop 达 79.43%，分别超过 GiGPO 5.47 和 5.60 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RELACE 以无 critic、无额外价值/奖励模型、无额外自回归采样的轻量设定，实现了结果感知的细粒度信用分配，可与轨迹级 GRPO 监督互补，在多轮智能体任务上取得一致且显著的性能增益。

title: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Models to Unknown Visual Disruptions During Execution
summary: Visual disruptions can arise while a robot is executing a task, leaving a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to respond without knowing the disruption type or timing. We introduce Self-supervised Adaptation from Leftover Trajectories (SALT), which uses the leftover trajectory, the unexecuted part of the previous action chunk, as self-supervision for test-time adaptation. Because consecutive chunks overlap in time, the leftover provides a temporally aligned target for the current prediction over the same future control interval. At the onset of a visual shift, the leftover can retain a plan formed before the corruption, so updating the policy toward it anchors the adaptation across the shift (Transition Anchoring). SALT keeps the adapted policy and regenerates the current chunk, whose leftover becomes the target at the next replan, carrying the correction forward along the execution trajectory (Sequential Correction Propagation). Supervision comes entirely from the policy's own predictions, requiring no disruption annotations, expert actions, or target-domain demonstrations, and a lightweight adaptation gate calibrated only on nominal trajectories decides when updates begin. On LIBERO-10, SALT increases average success across five persistent visual corruptions from 43.9% to 53.2% with SmolVLA and from 58.7% to 66.0% with GR00T N1.7, while largely preserving nominal performance. On a real robot, it raises task progress averaged over digital and physical disruptions from 0.49 to 0.61.

AI.tldr: SALT 利用上一动作块未执行的"剩余轨迹"作为自监督目标，在测试时对 VLA 策略进行自适应更新，以应对视觉扰动。
AI.motivation: 机器人在执行任务时可能遭遇视觉扰动，而 VLA 策略在响应时并不知晓扰动的类型与发生时刻，缺乏标注或目标域演示数据也使得测试时自适应困难。
AI.method: 以剩余轨迹（上一动作块未执行部分）作为自监督信号：利用相邻动作块在时间上的重叠，为当前对同一未来控制区间的预测提供时间对齐目标。通过 Transition Anchoring 在视觉突变发生时用扰动前形成的计划锚定更新，通过 Sequential Correction Propagation 让修正沿执行轨迹逐次传递；监督完全来自策略自身预测，并设仅用正常轨迹校准的轻量自适应门控决定更新时机。
AI.result: LIBERO-10 上五种持续性视觉损坏下，SmolVLA 平均成功率从 43.9% 提升至 53.2%，GR00T N1.7 从 58.7% 提升至 66.0%，且基本保持正常性能；真实机器人上数字与物理扰动的平均任务进度从 0.49 提升至 0.61。
AI.conclusion: SALT 无需扰动标注、专家动作或目标域演示，即可在测试时利用自身剩余轨迹实现视觉扰动下的策略自适应，并保持正常条件下的性能。

title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
summary: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示激活引导（activation steering）去偏方向主要编码的是模型置信度而非偏见表征，其"去偏"效果实为降低模型置信度、促使模型拒答所致，提醒谨慎解读此类结果。
AI.motivation: 激活引导作为轻量级推理时去偏技术被广泛使用，但已有工作报告引导向量泛化能力差、会意外损害模型性能且难以迁移到新数据集。作者希望弄清去偏方向实际编码了什么，以解释其性能不稳定的原因。
AI.method: 通过对比抗偏见提示与偏见提示的激活，得到线性去偏方向，并将其作为引导干预，在偏见基准和通用知识基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 该方向主要由模型置信度主导，在激活空间中从高概率词区域指向低概率词区域，而非编码有意义的偏见表征。沿该方向引导确实降低测得偏见，但这源于模型置信度下降：在QA基准上引导驱使模型拒答，并附带改善了公平性指标。实验表明置信度是隐空间中区分偏见与抗偏见提示的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 难以分离出与模型置信度解耦的线性偏见表征，基于引导的去偏结果应谨慎解读：引导看似降低偏见，实则并非纠正模型内在偏好，而是使其变得不那么自信，甚至在无关偏见的任务上也是如此。

title: VALSE: Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models
summary: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for vertical adaptive layer skipping, proving three foundational results: (i) an Expected FLOPs formula (theorem 2) giving a closed-form expression for the computational cost of arbitrary per-sample skip schedules as a function of layer-wise skip probabilities; (ii) function-space superset (theorem 10) and strict inclusion (theorem 11) theorems showing that skip-layer models are strictly contained in---yet meaningfully approximate---the full-layer function space, with an explicit separating example; and (iii) a structural duality between VALSE and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (proposition 6), positioning vertical depth-wise sparsity as the orthogonal counterpart to horizontal width-wise sparsity. Building on this theory, we propose VALSE (Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficiency), a per-sample, non-contiguous layer skipping method: a lightweight difficulty estimator scores each input from the first few layers, and per-layer gates selectively skip redundant layers---including arbitrary middle layers while retaining deeper ones---so that only the necessary depth is activated for each input, whose feasibility is preliminarily assessed at prototype scale.

AI.tldr: 本文建立垂直自适应跳层的理论框架，证明FLOPs闭式公式、跳层模型与全层函数空间的严格包含关系及其近似性、以及VALSE与MoE的结构对偶性，并据此提出按样本、非连续跳层的VALSE方法，在原型规模上初步验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有层跳过/稀疏计算工作缺乏对逐样本跳层调度计算成本的闭式刻画，也未明确跳层模型相对于全层模型在函数空间上的表达边界，且尚未系统揭示深度方向稀疏与宽度方向稀疏（MoE）之间的结构关系。因此需要一个统一的理论框架来支撑垂直自适应跳层的设计与分析。
AI.method: 理论方面：推导任意逐样本跳层调度的期望FLOPs闭式表达（定理2），给出跳层模型函数空间被全层函数空间严格包含但可有效近似的结论（定理10、11，并给出分离样例），以及VALSE与MoE的结构对偶性（命题6）。方法方面：提出VALSE，由轻量难度估计器利用前几层为每个输入打分，并通过逐层门控选择性跳过冗余层（含任意中间层而保留更深层），实现非连续、按样本的深度激活。
AI.result: 得到三项理论结果：期望FLOPs的闭式公式；跳层模型函数空间严格包含于全层函数空间的包含性与近似性定理，并给出显式分离示例；VALSE与MoE的深度-宽度对偶关系。方法层面，VALSE在原型规模上对其可行性进行了初步评估。
AI.conclusion: 垂直深度方向稀疏与水平宽度方向稀疏（MoE）构成正交对偶，逐样本非连续跳层在理论上具备清晰的计算成本刻画与表达边界，VALSE作为该框架的实例在原型规模上具备初步可行性，为后续规模化验证奠定基础。

title: Can We Model the Artifacts Explicitly? Disentangle Artifacts via Pairwise Edit Relations for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image Manipulation Localization (IML) is commonly formulated as a fully supervised learning task that estimates the optimal manipulation mask $y$ for a given image $x$. In this work, we first reveal the latent nature of artifacts and thus reinterpret IML as a latent-variable problem, $P(y|x)=\int P(y|z)\,P(z|x)\,dz$, where $z$ denotes the artifacts. Following this interpretation, we pinpoint the cause for the current IML models' insufficiency as their implicit artifacts modeling strategy, highlighting the necessity of modeling $z$ in an explicit manner. Without direct labels, feature disentanglement is the most appropriate solution for this explicit modeling. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage learning paradigm with the Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) and Standard Localization (SL) phases to estimate $P(z|x)$ and $P(y|z)$ via edit relations. To support our edit-relation-based learning, we further curate EditGroup-45K, a source-anchored dataset organized into edit groups for pair construction. Extensive experiments show that our PAL paradigm yields consistent improvements across diverse IML architectures, and empirical analyses further verify that PAL does capture artifacts explicitly through feature disentanglement. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/venus-guangjian/PAL

AI.tldr: 该论文将图像篡改定位（IML）重新解释为隐变量问题，指出既有模型不足源于隐式伪影建模，并提出两阶段 PAL 范式显式建模伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有 IML 方法通常采用全监督学习直接拟合 P(y|x)，其隐式伪影建模策略难以充分刻画篡改痕迹，导致定位能力受限。
AI.method: 将 IML 形式化为 P(y|x)=∫P(y|z)P(z|x)dz（z 为伪影），用特征解耦显式建模 z；提出两阶段学习范式：Pairwise Artifacts Learning（PAL）估计 P(z|x)，Standard Localization（SL）估计 P(y|z），并基于编辑关系统一学习；同时构建源锚定、按编辑组组织的 EditGroup-45K 数据集以支持配对样本构造。
AI.result: 在多种 IML 架构上取得一致性提升；实证分析验证 PAL 确实通过特征解耦显式捕获伪影。
AI.conclusion: 显式伪影建模是提升 IML 的关键，PAL 范式通用且有效，配套数据集与代码已开源。

title: Towards Explainable Benchmarking for Data-driven Post-Wildfire Debris Flow Prediction
summary: Post-wildfire debris flows (PFDFs) are destructive sediment-laden hazards triggered when intense rainfall strikes recently burned terrain, destabilizing hillslopes and threatening infrastructure, local economies, and community safety. Data-driven methods have been proposed to learn predictive patterns directly from historical PFDF observations. However, the current research landscape of data-driven PFDF prediction remains highly fragmented across feature spaces, model architectures, and evaluation protocols, making rigorous comparison and the derivation of scientific insights difficult. Moreover, existing studies lack a systematic investigation into the relative importance of heterogeneous factors (e.g., meteorological conditions, terrain characteristics, soil properties, and burn severity) in triggering PFDF. To address these limitations, we present a unified benchmark for data-driven PFDF prediction, enabling fair and comprehensive evaluation across diverse models and feature configurations. Furthermore, to better understand the underlying drivers of PFDF formation, we propose a reinforcement learning-based feature selection framework that identifies factors whose perturbations render positive and negative events indistinguishable, thereby discovering the regional underlying mechanisms of PFDF occurrence across regions. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的灾后泥石流（PFDF）预测基准及基于强化学习的特征选择框架，用于公平评估不同模型并识别区域触发机制。
AI.motivation: PFDF危害严重，现有数据驱动研究在特征空间、模型架构和评估协议上高度碎片化，难以进行严谨比较与科学洞察，且缺乏对气象、地形、土壤、火烧严重度等异质因素相对重要性的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建统一的数据驱动PFDF预测基准，支持跨模型与特征配置的公平综合评估；提出基于强化学习的特征选择框架，通过识别使正负样本变得不可区分的扰动因素来揭示PFDF发生的区域内在机制。
AI.result: 提供一个可公开获取的统一基准与代码，实现多样化模型和特征配置的公平比较，并识别出对PFDF发生具有关键影响的特征因素。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为PFDF预测研究提供了标准化评估平台，并通过强化学习特征选择加深了对PFDF区域触发机制的理解，代码与基准已开源。

title: Commit While Futures Agree: Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking for Robot Manipulation
summary: Action-chunking policies predict multi-step control sequences, but a fundamental question remains: how much of a predicted action chunk should be committed before replanning? Existing systems typically execute a fixed-length prefix, implicitly assuming that the same execution horizon remains trustworthy across states. Some adaptive methods estimate this horizon from the similarity or stability of predicted actions. However, different actions may lead to the same successful outcome, whereas similar actions can produce different futures, suggesting that commitment should be determined by agreement among imagined futures rather than by similarity in action space. To this end, we propose Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking (CA$^3$C), an inference-time framework built on a simple principle: commit while imagined futures agree, and replan when they diverge. Without modifying or retraining the base policy, CA$^3$C uses an action-conditioned world model to imagine the future consequences of multiple candidate action chunks under the same sampling noise. Using these imagined consequences, we formulate execution-horizon estimation as a Bayesian change-point inference problem and select the execution candidate through future consensus. Across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robot manipulation tasks, CA$^3$C consistently improves diverse action-chunking policies, achieving up to a 71.8% relative reduction in failure rate over the corresponding base policies.

AI.tldr: 提出CA³C推理时框架，依据"想象未来"的共识而非动作空间相似度来决定动作块的执行长度，在多个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上最高将失败率相对降低71.8%。
AI.motivation: 动作分块策略会预测多步控制序列，但"重规划前应执行多少预测动作"仍是根本问题。现有系统通常执行固定长度前缀，隐含假设执行时域在各状态间同样可信；部分自适应方法依据预测动作的相似性或稳定性估计时域。然而不同动作可能带来相同成功结果，相似动作也可能产生不同未来，说明执行承诺应由"想象未来之间的一致性"而非动作空间相似度决定。
AI.method: 提出CA³C（Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking），一种推理时框架，原则是"想象未来一致则继续执行，出现分歧则重规划"。无需修改或重训基础策略：使用动作条件世界模型，在同一采样噪声下想象多个候选动作块的未来后果；将执行时域估计形式化为贝叶斯变点推断问题，并通过未来共识选择执行候选。
AI.result: 在多个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上，CA³C一致地提升多种动作分块策略，相比对应基础策略最高实现71.8%的失败率相对下降。
AI.conclusion: 以结果（想象未来）一致性而非动作相似性作为执行承诺准则，可在不重训基础策略的前提下有效提升动作分块策略的鲁棒性，作为一种通用推理时增强手段。

title: Incidental information contaminates patient notes and disrupts clinical reasoning in large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly relied upon to support ambient documentation and clinical reasoning. Here we examine the impact of a failure mode shared between these two applications by assessing their sensitivity to information incidental to the patient encounter. In 576 patient-clinician dialogues, we found that frontier models inserted small-talk exchanges into 35% of notes, while mean quality scores changed by at most 0.20 points on five-point scales. In 3.7% of frontier notes, models misattributed the asides or used them clinically. In 57 mock recorded consultations, background speech from a separate patient encounter at -10 dB leaked into 48.2% of transcripts, with contamination detected in 5.3% of downstream notes generated by four open-weight models. We propose a dual encoding hypothesis of clinical reasoning and distraction in LLMs, with preliminary evidence that LLM components associated with disruption by incidental information also support clinical reasoning. These findings support evaluating resistance to incidental information before clinical use, with safeguards that prevent contamination while preserving clinical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了大语言模型在临床场景中对"偶然信息"的敏感性：在576段医患对话中，前沿模型将闲聊写入35%的病历，并在3.7%的病历中误用这些旁白；在57段模拟问诊中，背景语音在-10 dB下渗入48.2%的转写文本，导致5.3%的下游病历污染。作者提出"临床推理与干扰的双重编码假说"。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于环境文书（ambient documentation）和临床推理两类任务，二者共享一种失败模式——对与患者就诊无关的偶然信息（incidental information）的敏感性，但该问题此前缺乏系统评估。作者旨在揭示此类干扰对临床输出的实际影响及其与临床推理能力的潜在关联。
AI.method: 两项实验：（1）576段患者-临床医生对话，评估前沿模型是否将闲聊等旁白纳入病历，及其对病历质量评分和临床使用的影响；（2）57段模拟录制的问诊，在-10 dB条件下注入来自另一患者就诊的背景语音，检测其向转写文本的渗漏及四个开放权重模型生成的病历污染情况。此外提出并初步验证"双重编码假说"。
AI.result: 前沿模型在35%的病历中插入了闲聊内容，但平均质量评分在五点量表上变化至多0.20分；3.7%的前沿病历中出现旁白归属错误或被用于临床判断。背景语音在48.2%的转写文本中渗漏，5.3%的下游病历被污染。初步证据显示，易受偶然信息干扰的模型组件同时也参与临床推理。
AI.conclusion: 临床使用前应评估模型对偶然信息的抵抗能力，并设计既防止污染又保留临床推理能力的防护措施。

title: BioStudyBench: Evaluating Agents on Post-Cutoff Biomedical Studies
summary: We evaluate whether AI agents can match the reported findings of published biomedical studies using public data. Existing evaluations do not consistently separate analysis from prior knowledge or retrieval of the published answer. We introduce BioStudyBench, a benchmark of 25 long-horizon analysis tasks drawn from studies first published between July and September 2026, after the developer-reported knowledge cutoffs of the models we evaluate, semi-automatically filtered down from 404,019 PubMed records. In each task, the agent receives a neutral research question but no data files, so it must find and download the relevant public data, search the literature through tools that return only records dated before its cutoff, and report findings through data analysis. To measure gains over prior knowledge, we run every task both with and without access to data and tools. Across eight models, access to data and tools raises the pass rate by 47 percentage points on average over the no-data baseline. Open-weight models across sizes trail closed-weight models, with the best open-weight model passing 81.3% of tasks against 94.7% for the best closed-weight model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BioStudyBench基准，用25个长周期分析任务考察AI智能体能否独立复现已发表生物医学研究的结论，通过有无数据/工具对比，量化数据分析相对于先验知识的增益。
AI.motivation: 现有对AI智能体的评估未能一致地将“分析能力”与“先验知识或对已发表答案的检索”区分开，因此难以判断智能体是真在做分析还是依赖记忆中的结论。
AI.method: 构建BioStudyBench，从404,019条PubMed记录半自动筛选出25个发表于2026年7—9月（晚于所评估模型的知识截止时间）的长周期分析任务。任务只给中性的研究问题而不提供数据文件，智能体须自行检索并下载相关公开数据、通过仅返回截止日期前文献的工具查阅文献、经数据分析报告结论。每个任务均在“有数据与工具”和“无数据”两种条件下运行以衡量相对先验知识的增益。
AI.result: 在八个模型上，接入数据与工具使通过率平均比无数据基线提高47个百分点；开放权重模型整体落后于闭源权重模型，最佳开放权重模型通过81.3%的任务，而最佳闭源模型为94.7%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在获得数据与工具后可显著超越先验知识表现，说明数据分析能力是可测且可提升的；但开放权重模型与闭源模型之间仍存在明显差距。

title: TF-PRVR: Training-Free Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos containing moments relevant to a given text query. Despite recent progress, existing PRVR methods suffer from two key limitations: a fixed video decomposition scheme that causes semantic dilution, and source-domain overfitting induced by task-specific training. In this paper, we propose TF-PRVR, the first training-free framework for PRVR. TF-PRVR leverages frozen vision-language features to construct video-specific hierarchical representations. It derives temporal semantic signals from frame-level features and applies frequency-based multi-scale analysis to identify adaptive temporal boundaries, producing hierarchical segments with coherent event-level semantics. Built on these segments, TF-PRVR constructs a unified multi-scale graph and propagates query relevance across temporally and semantically related nodes. A moment-aware scoring strategy then aggregates temporally aligned relevance across scales, emphasizing consistently supported moments while suppressing isolated false responses. Without task-specific training, TF-PRVR preserves the general-purpose alignment capability of pre-trained vision-language models and avoids dataset-specific overfitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance across datasets with diverse visual and temporal characteristics, suggesting a practical direction for training-free PRVR.

AI.tldr: 提出首个免训练的部分相关视频检索框架 TF-PRVR，利用冻结的视觉-语言特征构建视频特定的层次化表示，并通过多尺度图传播与时刻感知打分获取相关性，避免语义稀释与源域过拟合。
AI.motivation: 现有 PRVR 方法存在两大局限：固定的视频分解方案导致语义稀释；任务特定训练引起源域过拟合。
AI.method: TF-PRVR 基于冻结的视觉-语言特征构建视频特定的层次化表示；从帧级特征导出时序语义信号，并结合频率多尺度分析识别自适应时序边界，生成具有连贯事件级语义的层次分段；在分段上构建统一多尺度图，在时序与语义相关的节点间传播查询相关性；再用时刻感知打分策略跨尺度聚合时序对齐的相关性，突出持续获得支持的片段并抑制孤立误响应。
AI.result: 在视觉与时序特性多样化的多个数据集上实验，性能表现一致，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TF-PRVR 无需任务特定训练即可保留预训练视觉-语言模型的通用对齐能力，避免数据集特定过拟合，为免训练 PRVR 提供了可行方向。

title: Dynamic Budget Allocation for LLM Evaluation under Hard Resource Constraints
summary: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions through their time-to-event: the number of interaction steps required to produce an event of interest, such as a successful jailbreak or agentic task completion. Under limited compute, interactions may be terminated before the event occurs, so that event times are only partially observed (censored). Existing allocation methods for calibrating time-to-event bounds satisfy the budget only in expectation and can exceed the available budget on a particular evaluation run. Enforcing a hard constraint is particularly challenging as the cost of a trajectory is initially unknown. We introduce Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP), a budget allocation that satisfies hard resource constraints and adaptively reallocates unused budget. We show how to use HARP to construct lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the time-to-event and to estimate evaluation metrics such as the jailbreak rate on a fixed benchmark. Although HARP induces dependence in acquisition decisions across different trajectories, we prove that HARP never exceeds the target budget, that its LPBs have finite-sample coverage guarantees, and that its metric estimates are unbiased. Experiments on agentic task success, LLM jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations show that HARP achieves coverage close to the nominal level with low variance, while never exceeding the given budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HARP，一种硬预算约束下的自适应预算分配方法，用于校准大语言模型多轮交互中的时间-事件预测下界与评估指标估计。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互评估中，交互步数（时间-事件）常因计算预算有限而被截断，导致事件时间仅被部分观测（删失）。现有分配方法仅能在期望意义上满足预算，单次运行可能超支，且轨迹成本事先未知，硬约束难以实现。
AI.method: 提出Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP)：一种满足硬资源约束并自适应重新分配未使用预算的分配策略；基于HARP构造时间-事件的预测下界（LPB），并估计固定基准上的评估指标（如越狱率）。尽管HARP在轨迹间引入采集决策的依赖性，作者仍对其预算、覆盖率与无偏性进行理论证明。
AI.result: 理论上证明HARP从不超出目标预算，其LPB具有有限样本覆盖保证，且指标估计无偏。实验涵盖智能体任务成功、LLM越狱、有害内容生成与RAG幻觉，结果显示HARP覆盖率接近名义水平、方差低，且从不超预算。
AI.conclusion: HARP为受限算力下的多轮LLM评估提供了满足硬预算约束的实用方案，兼顾覆盖率的有限样本保证与指标估计的无偏性，在多种任务上表现稳定。

title: IronMan: Information-Constrained Video-Action Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Video Action Models (VAMs) couple visual dynamics modeling with action generation for robot manipulation. However, video representations are not naturally suited to action generation, as exposing the action policy to excessive visual detail can impair its generalization ability. Therefore, we introduce IronMan (Information-constRained videO-actioN learning for robot MANipulation), a robust video-action learning framework built on the information bottleneck principle. The core principle of this framework is to impose information constraints that suppress irrelevant visual information while preserving action-relevant dynamics cues. IronMan employs a dynamics-aware bottleneck that distills noisy, entangled one-step video features into compact world representations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong in-distribution (ID) performance and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness while maintaining efficient inference. IronMan achieves success rates of 99.0% on LIBERO and 79.4% on RoboTwin clean2clean, outperforming all the evaluated baselines. Under OOD shifts, IronMan achieves a success rate of 79.1% on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding the strongest baseline by 10.4 percentage points. Project page: https://youngsoul0731.github.io/ironman-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出IronMan框架，基于信息瓶颈原理约束视频表示中的冗余视觉信息，保留与动作相关的动态线索，提升机器人操作的泛化性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视频动作模型（VAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成耦合用于机器人操作，但视频表示并不天然适合动作生成：动作策略接触过多视觉细节会损害其泛化能力。
AI.method: IronMan（Information-constRained videO-actioN learning for robot MANipulation）建立在信息瓶颈原理之上，施加信息约束以抑制无关视觉信息、保留动作相关动态线索；核心组件为dynamics-aware bottleneck，将含噪、纠缠的单步视频特征蒸馏为紧凑的世界表示。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界实验中均表现良好：LIBERO成功率99.0%，RoboTwin clean2clean 79.4%，优于所有评估基线；OOD场景下LIBERO-Plus成功率79.1%，超出最强基线10.4个百分点，且保持高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过信息约束压缩视频表示、保留动作相关动态，IronMan在分布内性能与分布外鲁棒性上均取得领先，同时维持高效推理，验证了信息瓶颈视角对视频-动作学习的有效性。

title: Generative AI translations in high-stakes emergency messaging
summary: Emergency messaging such as extreme-weather reports and earthquake instructions can involve high stakes, to the extent that translation errors can lead to tragic consequences. The use of machine translation or generative artificial intelligence might therefore not be recommended. On the other hand, time savings in the initial translation can allow greater investments of resources in revision and authorization processes, as well as a wider range of target languages. An experiment with generative AI translations of an earthquake instruction text from English into Chinese and Spanish shows that use of discourse-specific prompts can considerably improve understandability and actionability, although the translations may still not be trusted by translators. Human revision is still required, not only to detect errors but also because of the ethical need for someone to take responsibility for any errors or delays in such messaging.

AI.tldr: 针对紧急信息（如地震指引）的翻译，实验表明：使用话语特定提示的生成式AI翻译可显著提升可理解性与可执行性，但译者仍不信任该结果，人工审校仍不可或缺，不仅是纠错，更出于伦理责任归属的需要。
AI.motivation: 紧急信息（极端天气报告、地震指令）涉及高风险，翻译错误可能造成悲剧性后果。因此机器翻译或生成式AI的使用往往不被推荐；但初始翻译的时间节省可让更多资源投入审校与授权流程，并覆盖更多目标语言，这一权衡值得实证检验。
AI.method: 开展实验：将一份地震指令文本从英语翻译为中文和西班牙语，采用生成式AI进行翻译，并对比使用"话语特定提示"（discourse-specific prompts）的效果，考察译文质量与译者态度。
AI.result: 使用话语特定提示可显著（considerably）提升译文的可理解性（understandability）与可执行性（actionability）；但译文仍可能无法获得译者的信任。
AI.conclusion: 人工审校仍然必要：既用于发现错误，也出于伦理要求——必须有人对此类信息中的错误或延误承担责任。

title: Explore, Then Commit: Measurement-Efficient Scientific Law Discovery with Language Models
comment: 19 pages, including Supplementary Material S1; code and data included as ancillary files. Preprint
summary: Scientific law discovery requires selecting measurements and converting evidence into a governing equation. We evaluate an explore-then-commit protocol in which a large language model proposes hypotheses, a programmatic planner gathers measurements, and a fresh prompt synthesizes the final law from fixed observations. The protocol combines structured probes, automatic numerical diagnostics, restricted measurement batches, and optional interpreter access. Across 576 NewtonBench trials, we compare eight configurations on 12 physics modules using GPT-4.1-mini and a medium-difficulty GPT-4.1 replication. On medium tasks, interpreter-enabled planners use 8.6 versus 22.5 measurements per trial for GPT-4.1-mini and 8.9 versus 43.0 for GPT-4.1. Their mean magnitude-based root-mean-squared logarithmic error falls from 2.514 to 0.202 and from 0.626 to 0.149, respectively. An additional audit retains incomplete and invalid submissions in a coverage-sensitive analysis. Observed symbolic-accuracy gains are less consistent across modules, and random acquisition is competitive with disagreement scoring. Measurement savings occur in every module, but unequal batch constraints prevent attributing them solely to acquisition quality. These results support the complete protocol as a promising measurement-efficient configuration, while leaving its causal components and generalization beyond noiseless direct-equation tasks unresolved.

AI.tldr: 论文评估"探索-提交"协议：LLM提出假设、程序化规划器采集测量、新提示从固定观测合成定律，在NewtonBench上比较8种配置，发现启用解释器可大幅减少测量次数并降低误差，但符号准确率提升不稳定且因果归因未定。
AI.motivation: 科学定律发现需选择测量并将证据转化为支配方程。本文关注如何让LLM在此过程中测量高效地发现定律，并检验解释器访问等协议组件的作用。
AI.method: 采用"探索-提交"协议：LLM提出假设，程序化规划器采集测量，新提示基于固定观测合成最终定律。结合结构化探针、自动数值诊断、受限测量批次与可选解释器访问。在NewtonBench上执行576次试验，用GPT-4.1-mini及中等难度GPT-4.1复现，比较12个物理模块上的8种配置。
AI.result: 中等任务上，启用解释器的规划器每试验测量次数从22.5降至8.6（GPT-4.1-mini）、从43.0降至8.9（GPT-4.1）；平均基于量级的均方根对数误差分别从2.514降至0.202、从0.626降至0.149。额外审计保留不完整与无效提交进行覆盖敏感分析。符号准确率提升跨模块不均衡，随机采集与分歧评分相当。所有模块均有测量节省，但不等批次约束使其无法单独归因于采集质量。
AI.conclusion: 完整协议是有前景的测量高效配置，但其因果组件及在无噪声直接方程任务之外的泛化仍待解决。

title: Dynamic Alignment and Calibration for Multimodal Learning
summary: Dynamic multimodal learning aims to learn robust representations by adaptively modeling information discrepancies across modalities. However, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: (i) static cross-modal alignment strategies usually impose uniform constraints on all samples while overlooking sample-wise variations, potentially leading to unreasonable over-alignment; and (ii) confidence- or uncertainty-aware fusion methods often fail to adequately account for feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities. For modality pairs with significant feature magnitude differences or small confidence gaps, it might be unreliable to strictly align fusion weights according to confidence. To address these issues, we propose an Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning framework (ACML). Specifically, ACML incorporates a dynamic cross-modal triplet alignment module, which enforces strong semantic consistency for high-confidence positive pairs while encouraging diverse representation learning between high- and low-confidence positive pairs according to their confidence gaps. Additionally, ACML introduces a difference-aware attention calibration strategy that adaptively adjusts attention regularization based on feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities, thereby mitigating biases caused by unreasonable fusion constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate that ACML consistently achieves superior performance and robustness over recent state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACML 框架，通过动态跨模态三元组对齐与差异感知注意力校准，缓解静态对齐的过度对齐问题和融合中忽视特征幅度—置信度差异的问题，在多模态基准上取得优于现有方法的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态动态学习存在两点不足：(i) 静态跨模态对齐对所有样本施加统一约束，忽略样本级差异，易导致不合理的过度对齐；(ii) 置信度/不确定性感知融合方法未充分考虑模态间的特征幅度与置信度差异，当特征幅度差异大或置信度差距小时，按置信度严格分配融合权重并不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning（ACML）框架，包含两个核心模块：一是动态跨模态三元组对齐模块，对高置信度正样本对施加强语义一致性约束，同时依据置信度差距在高、低置信度正样本对之间鼓励多样化表征学习；二是差异感知注意力校准策略，根据模态间的特征幅度与置信度差异自适应调整注意力正则化，以缓解不合理融合约束带来的偏差。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ACML 的性能与鲁棒性持续优于近期最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: ACML 通过样本级动态对齐与差异感知校准，有效克服静态对齐的过度对齐及融合权重分配偏差问题，是一种性能更优、鲁棒性更强的多模态学习方案。

title: Multigroup Fairness and Omniprediction: Separations and Equivalences
summary:
Omniprediction is a learning guarantee which requires a single predictor to be competitive relative to the best hypothesis from a benchmark class for any loss chosen from a family of loss functions. Loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI for short) is a stronger notion that implies omniprediction. It requires the predicted distribution on labels to be indistinguishable from the true distribution to tests that depend on the loss functions and the benchmark class. Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions that generalize classical notions of calibration and accuracy in expectation. Most known learning algorithms for omniprediction (both for the standard notion and for strengthenings like loss OI) rely on some version of these multigroup fairness notions, or on an intermediate notion called calibrated multiaccuracy. We ask if this is necessary: Does omniprediction require some form of multigroup fairness?
  We show that the answer is no for (plain) omniprediction, and yes for loss OI. First, a sequence of works shows that multicalibration or calibrated multiaccuracy imply omniprediction. We rule out even a weak converse, by showing that omniprediction for proper losses does not imply even accuracy in expectation, a much weaker notion than any of calibration, multiaccuracy, or multicalibration. Second, prior work showed how to achieve loss OI from a combination of calibration and multiaccuracy. We show a converse: loss OI is equivalent to a form of calibrated multiaccuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了omniprediction是否必然要求某种形式的多群体公平性。结论是：对（普通）omniprediction而言并非必要；但对loss OI而言，loss OI等价于一种calibrated multiaccuracy形式。
AI.motivation: 已有omniprediction学习算法多依赖multicalibration、calibrated multiaccuracy等多群体公平性概念，作者追问：omniprediction是否本质上需要某种多群体公平性。
AI.method: 通过证明两类反向结论进行分析：一是否定omniprediction与多群体公平性之间的弱逆命题；二是建立loss OI与calibrated multiaccuracy之间的等价关系。
AI.result: 对proper losses的omniprediction不能推出even accuracy in expectation，从而排除了与calibration、multiaccuracy、multicalibration的弱逆命题；同时证明loss OI等价于一种calibrated multiaccuracy形式。
AI.conclusion: 普通omniprediction不要求多群体公平性；而更强的loss OI则恰好等价于一种calibrated multiaccuracy，说明强化后的omniprediction保证确实需要多群体公平性。

title: Reactive Task-Oriented Robot-Human Handovers via Generative Hypothesis Selection
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: When humans hand each other objects, they incorporate both geometric and semantic information into this process. For example, passing a knife with the handle towards the recipient, rather than the blade, is both more ergonomic and safer. Recent state-of-the-art methods for task-oriented robot-human handovers have progressed from modeling object geometry to incorporating object affordances. However, they often forgo predicting the explicit, task-specific hand poses a human selects to utilize an object. Since many objects support multiple interaction modalities, e.g., a claw hammer used to strike or pull nails, this variability must be modeled to achieve robust task-oriented handovers. To tackle this, we propose a novel approach, GENESIS-Handover (GENErative HypotheSIS), which leverages VLM image generation to produce a variety of task-specific hand-object interaction hypotheses. These hypotheses are matched in real time to the observed human hand pose, enabling inference of the most suitable handover configuration. By leveraging VLMs as priors of plausible hand-object interactions, the method produces task-conditioned handover strategies for previously unseen object-task pairs. We evaluate the standalone interaction proposal module before deploying the full system on a mobile manipulator. In a user study with 12 participants across five task-object pairs, 83.3% perceived our method to have better task understanding than the previous state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出GENESIS-Handover方法，利用VLM图像生成产生任务特定手-物交互假设，并实时匹配观测手姿以推断最优交接配置，实现面向新任务-新物体对的泛化交接。
AI.motivation: 人类交接物体时会同时考虑几何与语义信息（如递刀时手柄朝向对方更省力且更安全）。现有任务导向的机器人-人交接方法虽从几何建模发展到引入物体可供性（affordance），但普遍忽视了对"特定任务下人类所选择显式手部姿态"的预测。由于同一物体常支持多种交互方式（如羊角锤可敲击也可拔钉），这种交互多样性必须被建模，才能实现鲁棒的任务导向交接。
AI.method: 提出GENESIS-Handover（GENErative HypotheSIS），利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的图像生成能力生成多种任务特定的手-物交互假设；将这些假设与实时观测到的人手姿态进行匹配，从而推断最合适的交接配置。方法把VLM作为合理手-物交互的先验，从而产生面向任务条件的交接策略，且适用于未见过的物体-任务组合。先在独立模块上评估交互提议模块，再将完整系统部署于移动操作机械臂上。
AI.result: 先对独立的交互提议模块进行评估，再将完整系统部署到移动操作平台上测试。在覆盖5组任务-物体对、12名被试的用户研究中，83.3%的参与者认为该方法相比此前的最优方法具有更好的任务理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过以VLM生成作为手-物交互先验并实时匹配人手姿态，GENESIS-Handover能够为未见的任务-物体组合生成任务条件下的交接策略，并在用户研究中验证了其任务理解优于先前最优方法，说明显式建模任务特定手姿对鲁棒的任务导向交接至关重要。

title: InterCorrect: Intersection-Aware Correction of Demographic Model Merging for Fair ASR
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often show uneven performance across demographic groups, and errors can be especially difficult to address for speakers belonging to multiple demographic groups. This work studies demographic-aware model merging for fair Speech-LLM-based ASR. Starting from a SLAM-ASR-based model, we fine-tune only the connector on demographic-specific subsets and merge the resulting subgroup-adapted connectors into a global model. We then identify critical cross-axis demographic pairs using subgroup WER and task-vector conflict, and apply intersection-specific correction vectors to the global merged model. Experiments on Fair-Speech show that global demographic merging improves overall WER over the base model, while intersection correction provides additional gains for several merging strategies. In particular, TIES with WER-based correction achieves the best overall WER, reducing it from 7.38\% to 5.13\%. Subgroup and disparity analyses further show that the proposed approach improves performance across demographic axes, while highlighting that lower average WER does not always imply reduced subgroup disparity.

AI.tldr: 该文研究面向公平语音大模型ASR的人口统计感知模型合并方法，通过合并子群适配的connector并针对交叉轴子群施加校正向量，在Fair-Speech上将整体WER从7.38%降至5.13%。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在不同人口统计群体上表现不均衡，而同时属于多个人口统计群体的说话人（交叉子群）的误差尤其难以处理，现有公平性方法对此关注不足。
AI.method: 以SLAM-ASR模型为起点，仅在人口统计特定子集上微调connector，并将各子群适配后的connector合并为全局模型；利用子群WER与任务向量冲突识别关键交叉轴子群对，再对全局合并模型施加交叉子群特定的校正向量。
AI.result: 在Fair-Speech上，全局人口统计合并相较基座模型改善整体WER，交叉校正对多种合并策略带来额外增益；TIES结合基于WER的校正取得最佳整体WER，由7.38%降至5.13%。子群与差异分析表明该方法在各方言轴上均有提升，但也显示平均WER更低并不必然意味着子群差异更小。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计感知的模型合并与交叉子群校正是提升Speech-LLM ASR公平性的有效途径，但公平性评估需同时关注平均性能与子群差异，二者并非总是一致。

title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
summary: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"实验模型类修正"问题：发现策略联合提出结构编辑与诊断实验，检验该编辑是否必要；用类级可区分性目标与随时有效的序贯证据触发结构修正。
AI.motivation: 已有科学发现系统在固定假设空间内优化实验，存在失效模式：当所有候选都遗漏同一缺失机制时，候选间分歧会崩塌，即使模型类系统性错误也无法察觉。作者希望把"理论应使哪些机制可表达"与"在哪里采集证据"合并为一个序贯决策问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为实验模型类修正：策略同时输出结构编辑与用于检验该编辑必要性的诊断实验。方法耦合两个组件：(1) 类级可区分性目标，要求单一共享参数化必须解释所有被选实验；(2) 随时有效的序贯证据，仅当当前模型类被拒绝后才触发结构修正。
AI.result: 在400个留出受控动力学环境中，联合策略以32次真实实验预算达到89.5%精确恢复，比最强匹配基线提升10.0个百分点，且执行的实验与候选拟合更少。学到的"修正—实验"配对可迁移到未见机制组合、留出但可表达的基元、参数外推与实验成本偏移；当真机制超出编辑语法时，88%情况下检测出库不足，误支持率5.5%。修正增益亦迁移到ODEBench、ODEBase模型库任务及DiscoverPhysics世界。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将"理论应使哪些机制可表达"与"何处采集证据"视为单一序贯决策问题，是可行且有效的科学发现视角。

title: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
summary: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1840 videos (460 real and 1380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which video metadata are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF's generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了 CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF) 数据集，含1840段视频（460真实、1380由Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2生成），覆盖16类犯罪与事故场景，用于评测深度伪造检测模型。
AI.motivation: 商业视频生成工具普及，使低成本伪造监控视频成为可能，在高风险场景（如犯罪报案、选举）中可误导应急响应或扰乱政治讨论。现有深度伪造数据集存在两局限：（1）侧重良性网络内容，而非可能具恶意活动的监控素材；（2）依赖较旧或开源生成器，不能代表最新生成系统。
AI.method: 构建CCDF视频深度伪造数据集，包含1840段视频（460真实、1380生成），覆盖16类犯罪与事故类别，生成内容来自三个领先商业系统：Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2。数据集为高度真实、小规模、人工标注，面向检测模型评测。发布三个版本：原始生成数据、清洗版（标准化真实与合成样本的视频元数据，防止检测器利用琐碎线索）、篡改版（模拟低成本后处理攻击）。用十个近期最先进检测器（涵盖不同检测路径）进行评测。
AI.result: 在CCDF上评测十个近期最先进检测器，结果显示这些方法无法可靠区分CCDF的生成视频与真实视频，尽管它们在现有数据集上报告了强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果进一步证实现有数据集不适合评估某些特定威胁，需针对商业生成系统与恶意活动场景构建更贴近现实的评测基准。

title: Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow
summary: Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将稀疏自编码器的推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，提出无编码器模型BeFOND，在合成数据和语言模型激活上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）广泛用于揭示神经网络的可解释特征，但当特征相互重叠或激活频率很低时，可靠恢复仍然困难。这些挑战同时涉及两个问题：推断哪些特征解释输入，以及学习表示这些特征的字典。
AI.method: 作者将推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，并据此实例化出BeFOND——一个无编码器（encoder-free）的稀疏编码模型，具有闭式推断与学习动力学。方法中引入循环"explaining away"以减少重叠特征间的干扰，并利用Fisher预条件补偿稀有特征学习缓慢的问题。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，BeFOND提升了字典恢复和稀有特征检测能力，且随叠加程度（superposition）增加，相对摊销（amortized）基线的优势不断扩大。在语言模型激活上，它提升了单特征概念检测与选择性干预效果，以远少于预训练参考SAE的训练数据超越后者；其特征质量随字典宽度持续提升，而所评估的基线大多趋于平台。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，在统一的概率框架内改进推断与学习，能够更好地利用数据和字典容量，从而解释并干预神经表示。

title: Vector Map Quality Metrics for Contextual Autonomous Driving Systems
summary: Ensuring safety in autonomous driving requires continuous map maintenance supported by reliable quality indicators. In this context, it is crucial to identify when and where map updates should be triggered, for instance through crowdsourced data, and under which conditions a new map compilation should be deployed. This paper focuses on effective metrics for assessing the quality of vector maps and guiding such decisions. We present a new metric called GOSPAM designed to measure map discrepancies in terms of location errors, existence, and completeness. Through detailed simulations on both point and polyline feature maps, we analyze its sensitivity to common map degradation such as bias, false positives, false negatives, and coordinate errors. The results demonstrate that GOSPAM offers a unified and interpretable measure that effectively captures various forms of map deviation, making it a strong candidate for map quality assessment in automotive applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GOSPAM指标，用于衡量矢量地图在位置误差、存在性与完整性方面的差异，并通过仿真分析其对常见地图退化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全依赖持续的地图维护和可靠的质量指标，需要判断何时何地触发地图更新、以及何时部署新的地图编译，因此需要有效的地图质量评估指标。
AI.method: 提出GOSPAM指标，用于从位置误差、存在性和完整性角度度量地图差异；并在点和折线特征地图上进行详细仿真，分析其对偏置、假阳性、假阴性和坐标误差等常见退化的敏感性。
AI.result: GOSPAM能够统一且可解释地捕捉多种形式的地图偏差。
AI.conclusion: GOSPAM是汽车应用中地图质量评估的有力候选指标。

title: Towards In-Parameter Memory Augmentation for Large Language Models
summary: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. \textbf{In-parameter memory} offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: \textbf{Parameter Placement}, which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and \textbf{Parameter Acquisition Time}, which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦"参数内记忆"：在部署推理时将携记忆的参数对象（参数、适配器等）插入前向过程，以补充策略性ICL的不足，并用"参数位置"与"参数获取时间"两个正交轴组织现有方法。
AI.motivation: LLM及LLM智能体需融入预训练后获得的知识（领域事实、用户偏好、文档、交互经验）。上下文学习与基于ICL的智能体框架虽灵活，但占用上下文容量，且随上下文长度增长带来重复的离散化编码开销，因此需要互补的记忆载体。
AI.method: 综述以"参数内记忆"为对象，界定可复用记忆信息以模型参数、适配器或其他类参数对象表示，并在推理时组合进前向传播。采用两个正交维度进行分类：参数位置（Embedding、Attention、FFN层或涉及两层以上的Hybrid）与参数获取时间（部署中在线获取 vs 部署前离线获取）。同时厘清概念边界并进行方法比较。
AI.result: 系统梳理并归类了在部署阶段以参数化记忆增强LLM的方法，明确了"位置"与"获取时间"的二维分类框架，给出了跨类别方法的对比。
AI.conclusion: 参数内记忆可作为ICL的互补基础；未来开放方向包括记忆间的干扰、安全性、与ICL的协同设计以及递归自我改进。

title: Measuring climate backlash in Twitter and Reddit archives: Lexical definitions, recorded responses and participant turnover
summary: Social media archives are often used to study resistance to climate action, but words, response counters and observed participants do not measure the same social process. We examine four supplied Twitter and Reddit archives by processing all registered files without sampling and applying transparent, non-exclusive lexical rules. The study links frame co-occurrence to source-specific temporal and response models, then separates event-period changes among returning authors from participant turnover. Renewable-energy terms accompany cost-related language on Reddit, yet narrower backlash phrases sharply reduce cross-source contrasts and reverse the sign of the Paris Agreement contrast in submissions. Cross-discourse history does not improve eligible primary-context forecasts. Denial/hoax terms are associated with higher recorded Twitter likes, whereas Reddit response associations depend on frame, outcome and author specification. Around the 2019 global climate strike, returning-author expression and participant turnover both contribute to increased protest-language shares. An archive endpoint prevents the corresponding Climate Twitter migration inference. Most crossed-cluster estimates lack released intervals, and joint author/month response covariance estimates fail, restricting formal inference. These results show how operational definitions, platform-specific response fields and observation boundaries shape what can be claimed about climate backlash. The contribution is an archive-based account of these measurement consequences, rather than a measure of individual opposition, persuasion or advocacy-induced backlash.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过处理全部Twitter与Reddit档案（无抽样、透明的非排他性词法规则），考察气候行动抵制话语中框架共现、来源特异的时间与响应模型，区分回归作者的事件期变化与参与者更替，并揭示操作定义、平台响应字段与观测边界对结论的限制。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体档案常被用于研究对气候行动的抵制，但词语、响应计数与观测到的参与者并不测量同一社会过程，存在测量效度问题，需厘清不同操作化与平台字段如何塑造可主张的结论。
AI.method: 处理四份给定的Twitter与Reddit档案，全部注册文件无抽样处理，采用透明的非排他性词法规则；将框架共现与来源特异的时间模型、响应模型相链接；把回归作者的事件期变化与参与者更替分离；并检验跨话语历史对预测的作用及各类推断限制。
AI.result: Reddit上可再生能源术语与成本相关语言共现，但更窄的抵制短语显著削弱跨来源对比，并反转《巴黎协定》对比的符号；跨话语历史未改善合格的主语境预测；否认/骗局术语在Twitter上与更高记录点赞相关，Reddit的响应关联取决于框架、结果与作者设定；2019年全球气候罢工前后，回归作者表达与参与者更替均提升抗议语言占比；档案终点阻碍相应Climate Twitter迁移推断；多数跨簇估计缺释放区间，作者/月份联合响应协方差估计失败，限制正式推断。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供基于档案的测量后果说明，强调操作定义、平台特异响应字段与观测边界如何塑造关于气候抵制的可主张结论；其贡献不在于测量个体反对、说服或倡导引发的抵制，而非个体层面的推论。

title: Revisiting Numerical Forecasting Models for Language-Based Trajectory Prediction
summary: Language-based trajectory predictors represent coordinates as discrete tokens and learn auxiliary tasks such as destination and group reasoning. This formulation enables the model to capture behavioral intent and social context beyond coordinate dynamics alone. However, token-level objectives provide only indirect guidance for continuous coordinate-space dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce MoRE (Mixture of Reward Experts), a refinement framework that transfers numerical forecasting priors into a pretrained language-based predictor through reinforcement learning. Five frozen numerical predictors provide complementary coordinate-level knowledge of motion and interactions. Their predictions are converted into expert rewards and combined through an uncertainty-weighted consensus that penalizes disagreement. A ground-truth reward anchors the prediction to the target trajectory. To focus refinement on difficult cases, MoRE refines the policy using the top 1% of training samples ranked by predictive entropy. Expert predictions are computed once and cached before PPO training, so the experts are not run during policy updates or inference. In this way, MoRE combines the contextual modeling of the language-based predictor with coordinate-level feedback from numerical experts. On ETH-UCY, MoRE reduces ADE from 0.22 to 0.20 m and FDE from 0.32 to 0.29 m. Relative to the base policy, ADE decreases by 17.9% on SDD and 12.7% on NBA. On ETH-UCY, MoRE also reduces collision rates and better matches ground-truth pedestrian spacing, without increasing measured inference memory or latency. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/MoRE/.

AI.tldr: MoRE（Mixture of Reward Experts）是一种精炼框架，通过强化学习将数值预测先验迁移至预训练的语言基轨迹预测器，在ETH-UCY上将ADE从0.22降至0.20 m、FDE从0.32降至0.29 m，且不增加推理内存或延迟。
AI.motivation: 语言基轨迹预测器将坐标离散为token并学习目的地、群体推理等辅助任务，能捕捉行为意图与社会情境，但token级目标仅为连续坐标空间动力学提供间接引导，存在目标与表示之间的不对齐问题。
AI.method: 五个冻结的数值预测器提供互补的坐标级运动与交互知识，其预测被转换为专家奖励，通过不确定性加权共识（惩罚分歧）组合，并以真实轨迹奖励作为锚点。仅对按预测熵排序的前1%训练样本进行策略精炼。专家预测在PPO训练前一次性计算并缓存，故更新与推理阶段均不运行专家。
AI.result: ETH-UCY上ADE由0.22降至0.20 m，FDE由0.32降至0.29 m；相对基础策略，SDD上ADE下降17.9%，NBA上下降12.7%；ETH-UCY上碰撞率降低、行人间距更接近真实分布，且实测推理内存与延迟未增加。
AI.conclusion: MoRE将语言基预测器的情境建模能力与数值专家的坐标级反馈相结合，以低额外推理开销有效提升连续坐标空间的预测精度与社会合规性。

title: Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering
summary: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fed-BRDECS，一种隐私保护且异构感知的联邦深度嵌入聚类框架，用局部可计算的样本稳定性损失替代全局软分配归一化目标，并通过预测均衡采样与质心级重启应对非独立同分布数据。
AI.motivation: 联邦深度聚类需从去中心化无标签数据中学习聚类友好表示并保护客户端隐私，但 DEC 类目标依赖全局软分配统计量，要求客户端泄露敏感信息；同时客户端数据存在非独立同分布（non-IID）问题。
AI.method: 以局部可计算的样本稳定性损失替代全局归一化的聚类目标，避免传输本地软分配分布；引入预测均衡采样，在无需真实标签的情况下对本地稀有预测簇过采样；采用质心级重启，周期性刷新有偏或失活的质心。
AI.result: 在图像与文本聚类基准上，于 IID 和 non-IID 划分下均持续优于代表性联邦聚类与深度聚类基线；在联邦时间序列异常检测任务中提升了基于重构的检测器且未增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: Fed-BRDECS 在保护隐私的同时有效缓解统计量与数据异构问题，兼具聚类性能与跨任务适用性，可扩展至联邦异常检测场景。

title: Navigation with RF Cues: Embodied Perception Action under Multipath Uncertainty
summary: Smart factory inspection requires robots to reach connected equipment without a prior map or known target coordinates. Radio frequency (RF) signals from the target can provide directional cues to complement visual observations when occlusion or poor lighting limits target detection. However, multipath propagation can distort these cues, making it difficult to infer the target's true direction from instantaneous RF measurements. To enable navigation research under these conditions, we first construct a Habitat Sionna RT benchmark that uses detailed scene geometry and assigned material properties to generate aligned visual and RF observations in response to robot actions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an uncertainty aware multimodal navigation framework that jointly estimates target direction and its uncertainty from a history of RF, visual, and pose observations. These estimates inform action selection alongside visual context. Experiments in unseen scenes show relative improvements of 18.2% in success rate (SR) and 11.5% in success weighted by path length (SPL) over the strongest evaluated baseline.

AI.tldr: 构建Habitat Sionna RT基准，提出不确定性感知多模态导航框架，联合估计目标方向与不确定性，在未见场景中SR提升18.2%、SPL提升11.5%。
AI.motivation: 智能工厂巡检要求机器人无先验地图与目标坐标到达相连设备；视觉在遮挡或弱光下失效，RF信号可提供方向线索，但多径传播会扭曲瞬时RF测量，难以推断真实方向，且缺乏相应导航研究基准。
AI.method: 先构建Habitat Sionna RT基准，利用详细场景几何与材质属性，针对机器人动作生成对齐的视觉与RF观测；再提出不确定性感知多模态导航框架，从RF、视觉与位姿观测历史中联合估计目标方向及其不确定性，并结合视觉上下文指导动作选择。
AI.result: 在未见场景实验中，相比最强基线，成功率（SR）相对提升18.2%，路径长度加权成功率（SPL）相对提升11.5%。
AI.conclusion: RF与视觉融合并显式建模不确定性可有效缓解多径干扰，提升无先验地图下的目标导航性能；所提基准为该类研究提供可复现平台。

title: Evidence-Bound Reasoning: Neuro-Semantic Verification of Biomedical AI in Glioblastoma Radiogenomics
summary: Background: Biomedical AI can generate plausible explanations without reliably verifying whether each statement is supported by patient-specific evidence. We developed a neuro-semantic verification framework that converts radiomic measurements into addressable evidence records and machine-checkable claims. Methods: UPenn-GBM radiomics were aligned with de novo CaPTk extraction from standardized MRI and expert-validated segmentations in an independent multicenter cohort. The shared space comprised 1,728 features from T1, T1GD, T2, and FLAIR MRI across three tumor regions. Reference-defined semantic states were derived from 611 UPenn cases. We evaluated cross-cohort transportability, model-linked provenance, deterministic verification, controlled predictive degradation, and an LLM claim-extraction pilot; MGMT prediction served only as a transport stress test. Results: Median semantic-state agreement was 0.786 (weighted kappa 0.709), ranging from 0.918 for morphologic to 0.252 for intensity features. The external evidence ledger contained 1,655 model-linked records for 331 patients. The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark. In a 24-case pilot, GPT-5.6 Sol reproduced 72/72 prespecified atomic claims, and the frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions. During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000. External MGMT discrimination was weak (ROC AUC 0.543). Conclusions: Verifiability can be engineered and evaluated independently of predictive performance. LLMs may structure explanations, while final evidence-consistency checking remains deterministic.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出神经语义验证框架，将放射组学测量转化为可寻址证据记录与机器可验证声明，实现独立于预测性能的“可验证性”工程化。
AI.motivation: 生物医学AI能生成看似合理的解释，却无法可靠验证每条陈述是否有患者特异性证据支持，解释的可靠性缺乏保障。
AI.method: 将UPenn-GBM放射组学与独立多中心队列中基于标准化MRI及专家验证分割的CaPTk提取结果对齐；共享空间涵盖T1、T1GD、T2、FLAIR四个序列、三个肿瘤区域的1,728个特征；基于611例UPenn病例定义参考语义状态；评估跨队列可迁移性、模型关联溯源、确定性验证、受控预测退化及LLM声明抽取试点，MGMT预测仅作迁移压力测试。
AI.result: 语义状态一致性中位数0.786（加权kappa 0.709），形态学特征0.918至强度特征0.252；外部证据账本含331例患者1,655条模型关联记录；验证器在6,620条声明损坏基准上达100%精确集合准确率；24例试点中GPT-5.6 Sol复现72/72预设原子声明，冻结验证器恢复24/24预期条件；受控退化下ROC AUC由0.899降至0.500而验证准确率保持1.000；外部MGMT判别较弱（ROC AUC 0.543）。
AI.conclusion: 可验证性可独立于预测性能进行工程化设计与评估；LLM可负责组织解释结构，而最终证据一致性检查仍应由确定性方法完成。

title: Learning Explainable Representations of Complex Game-playing Strategies
summary: As part of learning to play complex games, human players develop develop abstractions for concepts and strategies of gameplay consistent with game rules to improve their performance. These concepts are applied to explain other players' actions, and to inform their own actions in-game. Understanding other players' strategies is a crucial part of such improvement, but requires time and effort. In this paper, we propose a strategy similar to human cognition for training RL agents to synthesize learned strategies and policies as executable procedures based on sequences of gameplay actions. We present methods to automatically learn such programs to play chess and to solve tasks in a grid-based environment. We show that the learned strategies produce effective actions, and can be learned from gameplay data.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴人类认知，提出让强化学习智能体基于游戏行为序列，将习得策略综合为可执行程序的方法，并在国际象棋与网格环境中验证其能生成有效动作且可从博弈数据中学习。
AI.motivation: 人类玩家在复杂游戏中会形成与规则一致的概念与策略抽象，用以解释他人行为并指导自身决策；理解他人策略是提升水平的关键，但耗时费力。作者希望借鉴这种认知机制，让RL智能体也能自动归纳可解释的策略。
AI.method: 提出一种类似人类认知的策略学习框架，训练强化学习智能体，从游戏行为序列中合成习得策略与策略程序（可执行过程）。具体给出自动学习此类程序的方法，用于下国际象棋以及在网格类环境中求解任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，学习到的策略能够产生有效动作，并且可以从博弈数据中学习得到。
AI.conclusion: 将策略表示为可执行程序是一种可行的、类人认知的强化学习途径，可用于国际象棋和网格环境等任务，并支持从游戏数据中归纳有效策略。

title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok, a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: DensiTok 是一种即插即用模块，通过在低维隐空间中对前馈 3DGS 模型的内部几何 token 进行稠密化补全，显著提升稀疏视图重建质量。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3DGS 在输入图像数量减少时质量急剧下降。其瓶颈在于重建头之前：从少量无位姿视角生成的内部表示对未观测区域缺乏证据，导致空洞、悬浮物和模糊。常见的补救方法是合成额外视图再重新编码，但计算昂贵且本质上不具 3D 一致性。
AI.method: DensiTok 直接对内部几何 token 进行稠密化：将其压缩到紧凑隐空间，在相机几何条件下以单步流匹配补全未观测视角的隐表示，再解码回 token 供原重建头使用。该模块可集成到不同预训练预测器中，骨干网络与重建头保持冻结，无需图像合成或额外编码器前向。
AI.result: 在三个预训练骨干和两个基准上，DensiTok 一致地改善了稀疏视图重建效果，并弥合了与稠密视图重建之间的大部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过在隐空间稠密化内部几何 token 而非合成像素证据，DensiTok 为稀疏视图前馈 3DGS 提供了一种高效、可插拔且具 3D 一致性的改进方案。

title: What pass@k Cannot Measure: Evaluating Diversity and Capability Retention after Post-Training
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training (non-archival)
summary: pass@$k$, the fraction of problems a model solves within $k$ sampled attempts, is the field's default protocol for deciding whether reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training on verifiable rewards improved a model. At the population level, pass@$k$ depends only on a problem's probability of a correct sample, with no term for how it is distributed across outputs. We show this gap is not academic. Training Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on grade-school math with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and with rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT, training on the model's own shortest verifier-passed rollout) moves three complementary diversity measures (token-level entropy, answer-level entropy, unique answers per prompt) in opposite directions, with zero overlap across three seeds per arm. The gap survives restricting to verifier-correct completions only (lexical diversity among correct solutions is 15% lower for GRPO, after controlling for length) and a count-controlled check isolating diversity among incorrect answers alone, ruling out that GRPO's higher accuracy alone explains it. Yet pass@8 and pass@32 show no consistent winner on GSM8K, and a hard MATH-500 subset shows the same pattern: separation only at low $k$. Compared against the starting checkpoint, no trained arm significantly improves hard-problem coverage: RFT is significantly worse, while GRPO is statistically indistinguishable from it - so GRPO's pass@1 edge over RFT reflects a smaller loss relative to Base, not a capability gain, a missing-control issue, not a failure of pass@$k$. On GSM8K, only pass@1, with no role in detecting diversity by construction, separates the arms cleanly, rewarding the arm whose correct solutions are least diverse. We argue this is a concrete instance of a standard evaluation protocol missing a property it is routinely used to certify.

AI.tldr: pass@k仅依赖单题正确采样概率，无法刻画正确样本在输出间的分布；GRPO与RFT在多样性上反向变化但pass@8/32无一致优势，暴露该协议的结构性盲区。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机在于揭示当前强化学习后训练评估默认使用的pass@k协议的理论缺陷：在总体层面，pass@k仅由某题产生正确样本的概率决定，完全不含正确样本在多个输出间如何分布的项。作者认为这一缺口并非纯学术问题，而是可能导致实际评估结论失真——例如把"损失更小"误读为"能力提升"，或奖励正确解多样性最低的模型。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，以小学数学题分别用GRPO与RFT（在模型自身最短且通过验证的rollout上训练）进行后训练，每个设置跑三个随机种子。评估三个互补多样性指标：token级熵、答案级熵、每提示唯一答案数。并通过两项控制检验：仅限验证器正确完成的词法多样性（控制长度）、仅针对错误答案的计数控制多样性。再在GSM8K上考察pass@1/8/32，并在MATH-500困难子集上复现，且与初始检查点(Base)对比困难题覆盖率。
AI.result: 三个多样性指标在GRPO与RFT间呈相反方向变化，且三个种子间零重叠。仅看验证正确的完成时，控制长度后GRPO的词法多样性低15%；仅看错误答案的计数控制检验排除了"GRPO仅因准确率更高而多样性更高"的解释。但pass@8与pass@32在GSM8K上无一致赢家，困难MATH-500子集同样只在低k处出现分离。相对Base，没有任何训练臂显著提升困难题覆盖率：RFT显著更差，GRPO与Base统计上不可区分；GRPO相对RFT的pass@1优势只是相对Base损失更小，而非能力增益。GSM8K上仅pass@1能干净区分两臂，而pass@1按构造不承担检测多样性的角色，结果反而奖励了正确解多样性最低的臂。
AI.conclusion: pass@k存在系统性的结构盲区：它无法刻画正确样本的分布结构，因而在高k下失去区分度，并在低k下可能奖励多样性更低的模型；GRPO的pass@1表面优势实为相对Base的损失更小，属于缺失对照的问题而非pass@k本身的失效。作者主张这是标准评估协议缺失其常被用来认证之属性的一个具体实例。

title: Reactive Exploration of Unknown Environments for Redundant Robots using Virtual Model Control
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: The exploration of confined, occluded, and partially known spaces poses significant challenges in robotic manipulation. The overall pose of the robotic arm must be carefully controlled to respect tight geometric constraints while avoiding newly discovered obstacles. We address this problem by proposing an active exploration approach for redundant robotic arms with an eye-in-hand camera configuration. Our approach navigates and acquires information in real-time based on a novel scoring method that directly selects a target voxel from the unexplored space using the robot's current state and expected information gain. To move the robot safely toward the target voxel, we utilize Virtual Model Control, which guarantees compliance and enables whole-body reactive obstacle avoidance without the need for path replanning. Simulated and real-robot experiments in both confined and open environments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving over $90\%$ mapping coverage across all tested environments in under $120$ seconds without colliding with obstacles.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向冗余机械臂（眼在手相机）的主动探索方法，通过新颖评分选择未探索体素目标，结合虚拟模型控制实现安全导航与全身反应式避障，在受限与开放环境中均实现>90%建图覆盖率且无碰撞、用时少于120秒。
AI.motivation: 受限、被遮挡及部分已知空间中的机器人操作极具挑战：机械臂整体位姿需在满足紧凑几何约束的同时避开新发现的障碍。现有方法在探索此类空间时难以兼顾实时性、安全性与避障效率（往往依赖路径重规划）。
AI.method: 1）针对冗余机械臂+眼在手相机配置的主动探索框架；2）基于机器人当前状态与期望信息增益的新颖评分方法，直接从未探索空间中选择目标体素，实现实时导航与信息获取；3）采用虚拟模型控制（Virtual Model Control）驱动机械臂安全趋近目标体素，保证柔顺性并实现全身反应式避障，无需路径重规划。
AI.result: 在受限与开放环境的仿真及真机实验中，所有测试环境均实现超过90%的建图覆盖率，用时均低于120秒，且未与障碍发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 该主动探索方法在受限与开放空间中均表现出高效、安全的探索与建图能力，验证了评分驱动目标选择与虚拟模型控制相结合的可行性。

title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge
comment: counterfactual citation perturbation, evidence attribution verification, financial document question answering, Jev, LLM-as-a-judge, probabilistic source verification, tabular numerical reasoning
summary: Financial reports repeat values across periods, metrics and accounting lines, allowing an LLM-generated calculation to be numerically correct while citing the wrong financial role. We evaluate what probabilistic evidence verification adds beyond number matching using Jev as a source-support verifier for GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces. A signed-number-at-pointer baseline explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. To isolate the remaining role-recognition problem, we hold operands and arithmetic fixed, move citations between same-number cells, and retain controls that express equivalent facts. These contrasts reveal both wrong-role citations that pass and valid alternative citations that are withheld. Explicit column labels improve selected wrong-role decisions while also lowering support for some equivalent evidence. A constructed follow-up on 36 new source pages, labeled by a non-author reviewer, extends this evaluation and exposes the same tradeoff between detecting role errors and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation that identifies what a probabilistic financial verifier distinguishes when numerical matching is held fixed. For LLM-based financial assistants, it makes numerical correctness, cited-role support and acceptance outcomes separately assessable.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控实验评估概率型财务验证器Jev在数值匹配固定不变的前提下，能否识别LLM计算轨迹中的"角色错误引用"问题。
AI.motivation: 财务报告在不同期间、指标和会计科目间重复出现相同数值，导致LLM生成的计算可能数值正确却引用了错误的财务角色。验证器需要超越简单数字匹配，回答"概率证据验证"究竟额外提供了什么信息。
AI.method: 以Jev作为GPT-4.1-mini计算轨迹的来源支持验证器；建立"带符号数字-指针"基线；在固定操作数与算术的前提下，将引用在同数值单元格间移动，并保留表达等价事实的对照项，以隔离角色识别问题；另在36个新源页面上构建后续实验，由非作者评审标注。
AI.result: 带符号数字-指针基线已能解释相对于精确引用检查的大部分恢复能力；对比实验同时揭示出通过检验的错误角色引用与被错误拒斥的合法替代引用；显式列标签改善了部分错误角色判断，但也降低了对某些等价证据的支持度；后续实验复现了检测角色错误与保留合法引用之间的同一权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的贡献在于提出一种受控评估方法，明确概率型财务验证器在数值匹配被固定时所真正区分的对象，使LLM财务助手的数值正确性、引用角色支持度与接受结果可被分别评估。

title: Towards the Automatic Synthesis of Interpretable Chess Tactics
summary: State-of-the-art reinforcement learning agents are capable of outperforming human experts at games like chess, Go and StarCraft II. These agents do not simply take advantage of their digital hardware in being able to react and calculate faster than humans, but employ better strategies that lead to more victories. Interpreting these strategies would give human players valuable insight into how to improve their play. In this preliminary work, we propose a symbolic sub-policy model for playing chess. Inspired by chess tactics, our model attempts to incorporate domain knowledge to improve interpretability. We adapt patterns learned by an inductive logic programming system called PAL to derive our model. We contribute a divergence metric to evaluate our model against a random baseline, and find a set of tactics that is able to suggest moves of similar playing strength to a human beginner. Finally, we propose a computational evaluation scheme for the model by augmenting an off-the-shelf engine with it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于国际象棋的符号化子策略模型，借助归纳逻辑编程系统PAL学习棋类战术模式，并设计散度指标与计算评估方案。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体在国际象棋、围棋、星际争霸II等游戏中超越人类专家，其优势不仅来自硬件速度，更源于更优策略。解读这些策略可为人类玩家提供改进棋艺的洞见，而现有方法在可解释性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 受国际象棋战术启发，构建符号化子策略模型以融入领域知识提升可解释性；采用归纳逻辑编程系统PAL学习到的模式来推导该模型；提出散度指标用于对比模型与随机基线的表现；并设计通过将模型增强到现成引擎上的计算评估方案。
AI.result: 所得到的战术集合能够给出与国际象棋初学者棋力相近的走子建议；散度指标验证了模型相对随机基线的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该初步工作表明符号化子策略建模在提升强化学习策略可解释性方面具有潜力，为后续结合计算评估方案的系统研究奠定基础。

title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
summary: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.

AI.tldr: EmbodiedSmith：通过递归自改进统一资产、场景与任务生成的具身数据生成框架，支持复杂本体与物理现象，提升任务生成成功率与策略泛化。
AI.motivation: 机器人体基座模型扩展需要多样化训练数据与可靠评测环境。仿真虽可扩展，但现有生成管线受限于预定义资产与技能、场景生成与任务生成脱节、对复杂本体与物理支持不足。
AI.method: 提出 EmbodiedSmith 框架，以递归自改进（RSI）实现可扩展具身数据生成。将资产、场景与任务生成统一到同一管线，支持自主创建与语言驱动定制。核心为智能体式精化循环：场景生成预判下游任务需求，任务生成引导针对性场景编辑，实现场景与任务相互迭代改进。框架支持移动操作臂、人形机器人与灵巧手，并涵盖可变形物体与流体交互。
AI.result: 提升任务生成成功率，包括长时程任务；支持多种复杂本体与物理现象，扩展生成数据中的行为与物理现象范围。大量实验验证了数据质量、多样性与生成效率；下游策略实验表明数据多样性提升可改善泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedSmith 提供灵活仿真引擎，可用于机器人预训练与评测，通过统一生成与联合精化缓解现有管线局限，并证明数据多样性对泛化的促进作用。

title: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究离线数据下主动特征获取策略的学习与评估，指出用PFN总预测熵作奖励会因数据覆盖不均衡引入认知偏差，提出改用后验期望（偶然）熵进行评估。
AI.motivation: 主动特征获取需要在有限离线数据上学习并评估策略。现有方法常以PFN输出的总预测熵作为奖励，但在数据覆盖不均衡时会惩罚对稀疏观测特征的获取，因为总熵混淆了认知不确定性与偶然不确定性。
AI.method: 使用prior-data fitted networks（PFNs）在不做任务特定训练的情况下输出后验预测分布；在评估特征获取时，以“后验期望（偶然）熵”替代PFN输出的总预测熵，从而剥离由离线数据不足导致的认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实证评估表明，该方法一致降低了价值估计偏差，并给出具有良好经验覆盖率的可信区间，进而可改善下游策略选择。
AI.conclusion: 在离线主动特征获取中，应区分并剔除认知不确定性对奖励的影响，采用后验期望偶然熵进行特征获取评估，可获得更低偏差、更可靠的价值估计与策略选择。

title: Energy-Aware Path Following: Comparative Analysis of Reinforcement Learning and NMPC for Electric Vehicles
