AI.method: 以传统霍夫变换（HT）与单应性估计（homography estimation）辅助目标检测模型，对角度变化的图像进行校正；为此新建一个数据集，用以评估校正效果，并在不同角度变化与单图像目标密度场景下开展分析实验，比较多种目标检测模型的检测表现。
AI.result: 在多个目标检测模型上的大量实验表明，对倾斜图像进行图像校正能够提升杂货商品的检测精度；同时结果也显示校正效果受图像拍摄角度和目标密度限制。
AI.conclusion: 图像校正是提升倾斜、密集货架场景下商品识别精度的有效补充手段，但其收益存在角度与密度上的边界，需结合具体拍摄条件与场景密度加以权衡，并为后续数据集与算法研究提供依据。

title: Interpretable Hypergraph Learning via Neural Additive Models
summary: Hypergraphs offer a natural framework for modeling networked data, where dependencies among entities are governed by higher-order interactions. While hypergraph learning methods such as hypergraph neural networks have demonstrated remarkable predictive performance, most existing approaches rely on black-box message-passing architectures, making it difficult to disentangle the contributions of node attributes and higher-order structural information. To address this challenge, we introduce the hypergraph neural additive network (HGNAN), an inherently interpretable framework for learning on hypergraph-structured data. HGNAN extends classical neural additive models to higher-order relational data by integrating feature-wise nonlinear decomposition with hypergraph-aware structural aggregation, enabling transparent prediction for both node- and hyperedge-level tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that HGNAN achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art hypergraph learning methods while providing intrinsic and meaningful interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出超图神经加性网络（HGNAN），将神经加性模型拓展到高阶关系数据，兼顾可解释性与预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有超图学习方法多为黑盒消息传递架构，难以区分节点属性与高阶结构信息的贡献，缺乏透明性。
AI.method: 将经典神经加性模型扩展到高阶关系数据，结合逐特征非线性分解与超图感知的结构聚合，支持节点级与超边级任务的透明预测。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HGNAN性能与最先进超图学习方法相当，同时提供内在且有意义的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: HGNAN为超图结构数据提供了兼具竞争性性能与内在可解释性的学习框架。

title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出VOMMI便携式示范采集与学习框架，将RGB示范通过离线轨迹重建与在线视觉-运动条件化接入VLA后训练，无需遥操作或专用传感设备，且无需人机运动学校准。
AI.motivation: 具身智能面临数据稀缺，便携式移动操作示范可缓解该问题，但从RGB观测获取可靠、低成本、无需机器人本体的运动监督仍很困难：现有方法依赖遥操作或额外传感硬件，直接使用估计的视觉里程计（VO）轨迹会因累积漂移与不完善运动监督导致不一致。
AI.method: VOMMI同步身体视角与手部视角，分别捕获导航上下文与局部物体交互，无需人-机器人运动学对应校准；R2-VO利用稀疏几何锚点离线精化示范轨迹，并在多个预测时域上生成因果局部运动token用于在线策略条件化；动作组残差适配器仅将上述token注入基础分支。
AI.result: 每个任务使用500条便携式轨迹（其中75条用于RGB-VO评测），并以200条机器人示范作参考。仅用便携式示范后训练的策略，其基座速度误差比用机器人采集示范训练的策略低18.2%，末端平移精度相当；离线重建使身体流与手部流的绝对轨迹误差相对各自最佳基线平均降低24.6%；完整系统在三个真机任务上较OpenPI 0.5平均成功率提升8.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VOMMI证明可从便携RGB示范中获得可靠运动监督并有效用于VLA后训练，在降低采集成本与硬件依赖的同时，于导航与操作指标上优于机器人示范基线，并在真机任务上取得更高成功率。

title: PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
summary: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.

AI.tldr: PERSIST 是一个面向多会话多说话人语音对话的持久记忆系统，通过显式建模 Who/What/When 与 3W 联合评分实现高效检索，并配套提出 SpokenTrace 诊断基准。
AI.motivation: 现代语音助手常被多个用户共享，需要回答关于先前对话的问题（如"我原本计划何时离开？"），或根据历史交互为不同用户定制行为。这不仅是检索主题相似段落的问题，还要求助手识别当前说话人、恢复相关历史状态并将其与后续修改区分开来。
AI.method: PERSIST 将跨会话历史组织为可读的事件记录，并采用 3W 联合评分机制进行检索，融合语义内容、声学说话人身份和时间状态三个维度。为支持实时全双工交互，系统复用对话主干的中间表示，避免对查询音频重复编码，将检索延迟从 578.42 ms 降至 7.03 ms。此外提出 SpokenTrace 基准，沿记忆任务和说话人-查询类型分解评估。
AI.result: 在 SpokenTrace 上，PERSIST 取得 85.08% 的端到端任务准确率，并将 all-support EM@3 从 BGE-large 的 49.01% 提升至 82.10%。
AI.conclusion: PERSIST 表明，显式建模 Who/What/When 能有效解决多说话人长期记忆中的回忆、说话人归属与时间状态追踪问题，并借助表示复用显著降低检索延迟；SpokenTrace 为相关能力提供了可诊断的评测手段。

title: The Failure Is in the Readout: Fine-Grained Emotion Recognition Benchmarks Measure Elicitation, Not Perception
summary: Fine-grained emotion recognition supports therapy tools and social robots, but it needs facial data, which raises privacy and data-protection concerns. EmoNet-Face-HQ answers that with generated portraits, expert-rated over a $40$-category taxonomy far finer than the usual six to eight basic emotions. Under the protocol it ships with, vision-language models (VLMs) score poorly on that taxonomy, and the benchmark concludes that a dedicated fine-tuned model is necessary: Empathic-Insight-Face (EIF; Small/Large). We show that off-the-shelf VLMs match or beat that fine-tuned model when the answer is not generated but read from the logits, as one binary query per category. We keep the benchmark's images, taxonomy and ratings, and change only how the answer is read. Experts agree at $κ_w = 0.468$ on the five categories they measure most reliably. Generatively, no interval among eleven open-weight VLMs lies entirely above that anchor ($κ_w=0.268$-$0.486$). Under verification all eleven clear it, each of them significantly better at $κ_w=0.507$-$0.586$. Three also significantly beat EIF sitting at $κ_w = 0.551$ (Small; $0.534$ Large). The gain comes from the graded probability and not from asking a yes/no question: as a control, thresholding those same probabilities to yes/no costs 142% of the average gains and drops binarization below generative elicitation to $κ_w=0.254$-$0.423$. A replication on real photographs (FACES) is weaker and mixed: of the ten models that pass a validity gate, six gain, three are neutral to positive and one is negative, so the effect is not confined to synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 该工作表明，在EmoNet-Face-HQ细粒度情绪基准上，通过从logits读取逐类别二分类概率（验证式解码）可让现成VLM超越专用微调模型EIF；11个开放权重VLM全部显著优于专家一致性锚点，3个显著超过EIF。增益源于分级概率而非yes/no提问本身，真实照片复现效果较弱且混合。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情绪识别可支撑治疗工具与社交机器人，但依赖人脸数据，带来隐私与数据保护问题。EmoNet-Face-HQ以生成式人像、专家标注的40类细粒度分类体系回应此问题，但原协议下VLM表现差，并据此得出"必须使用专用微调模型EIF"的结论。作者质疑这一结论，认为差距可能来自答案读取方式而非模型能力。
AI.method: 保留基准的图像、分类体系与专家评分，仅改变答案读取方式：不再生成式输出，而是对每个类别进行一次二分类查询，从logits中读取分级概率作为答案。以专家加权一致性κ_w=0.468作为锚点，对比11个开放权重VLM的生成式与验证式表现，并设置阈值化二分类控制实验以分离"分级概率"与"yes/no提问"的贡献。最后在真实照片数据集FACES上复现。
AI.result: 专家在5个最可靠类别上一致性为κ_w=0.468。生成式下11个VLM的区间为κ_w=0.268–0.486，无一完全高于锚点；验证式下全部11个均显著超过锚点，达κ_w=0.507–0.586，其中3个显著超过EIF（Small为0.551，Large为0.534）。控制实验显示，将同样概率阈值化为yes/no会损失平均增益的142%，并使二值化表现降至κ_w=0.254–0.423，低于生成式。在FACES真实照片上复现较弱且混合：10个通过有效性门槛的模型中6个提升、3个中性到正向、1个为负。
AI.conclusion: VLM在细粒度情绪识别上的劣势并非能力不足，而是评估协议选择所致；以logits读取分级概率的验证式协议可使现成VLM达到甚至超越专用微调模型，且增益来自分级概率本身。该效应不限于合成数据，但在真实照片上更弱且不一致，提示协议改进的收益受数据域影响。

title: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
summary: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses acquired evidence to select each modality before its encoder runs. SeMA executes only selected encoder and fusion branches, updates a fixed-size state, and predicts after each acquisition without recomputing earlier branches. We supervise every acquisition prefix under randomized modality subsets and orders to encourage consistent predictions across acquisition orders. ARC combines a set-dependent marginal-utility prior with residual fitted-Q learning to select the next available modality or stop, without inspecting unacquired inputs or retaining acquisition order. Across six multimodal classification datasets and eleven baselines, SemARC achieves 3.2% higher macro-F1 and 61.4% lower total inference GFLOPs on average relative to each dataset's most accurate baseline. End-to-end latency falls by 44.0% across GPU and CPU and by 47.2% on Android INT8 relative to the fastest measured baseline, on average. Under varying runtime modality missingness, SemARC still skips available modalities, matching or exceeding the best baseline macro-F1 in 21 of 24 conditions with 14.8% lower total GFLOPs on average. SemARC thus offers a practical path toward efficient multimodal inference across heterogeneous devices.

AI.tldr: SemARC 将顺序模态聚合器与自适应运行时控制器结合，在编码前依据已获取证据选择模态，实现高效多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态系统通常编码全部可用输入，即使子集已足够预测；自适应获取虽可降本，但顺序融合使预测依赖顺序，决策需区分同一获取集合的因子级多种历史。
AI.method: 提出 SemARC，耦合顺序模态聚合器 (SeMA) 与自适应运行时控制器 (ARC)：SeMA 仅执行被选编码器与融合分支，更新固定大小状态，逐次获取后预测且不重算前序分支；在随机模态子集与顺序下监督每个获取前缀以保持顺序一致性；ARC 结合集合相关边际效用先验与残差拟合 Q 学习选择下一模态或停止，不查看未获取输入、不保留获取顺序。
AI.result: 在六个多模态分类数据集与十一个基线上，相对各数据集最准基线平均宏 F1 提升 3.2%、总推理 GFLOPs 降低 61.4%；端到端延迟在 GPU/CPU 平均降低 44.0%，Android INT8 降低 47.2%；运行时模态缺失变化下，24 个条件中 21 个匹配或超越最佳基线宏 F1，平均总 GFLOPs 降低 14.8%。
AI.conclusion: SemARC 为异构设备上的高效多模态推理提供了实用路径。

title: UWB Meets Crazyflow: Simulating Degraded Feedback at Scale for Aerial Robotics
comment: Accepted to 1st Workshop on Robot Meets GNSS and Ranging for Seamless Autonomy @ ICRA 2026
summary: In this work, we introduce Crazyflow, an accurate, differentiable simulator built on JAX. By leveraging jit compilation via XLA, Crazyflow unifies physics and control into a single differentiable computation graph, enabling massive parallelization on accelerated hardware without sacrificing modeling accuracy. This architecture achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing baselines, capable of training deployable reinforcement learning agents in seconds. To highlight its highly modular design, we demonstrate how easily Crazyflow can be extended by integrating a complete, high-fidelity Ultra-Wideband (UWB) and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) simulation pipeline coupled with a full-state Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). This capability allows for massive parallel controller evaluation under realistic, degraded state feedback with minimal impact on GPU throughput. By combining speed, accuracy, and extensibility, Crazyflow serves as a foundational tool for the next generation of aerial robotics research.

AI.tldr: Crazyflow 是基于 JAX 的精确可微无人机仿真器，通过 XLA jit 编译将物理与控制统一为单一可微计算图，实现加速硬件上的大规模并行，训练可部署强化学习智能体仅需数秒；并展示了 UWB/IMU 与 EKF 模块化扩展，支持退化状态反馈下的并行控制器评估。
AI.motivation: 空中机器人研究需要兼顾速度、精度与可扩展性的仿真工具。现有基线在建模精度与并行训练效率之间难以兼得，且控制器在真实退化状态反馈下的规模化评估缺乏低成本手段。
AI.method: 构建于 JAX 之上的可微仿真器 Crazyflow；借助 XLA 的 jit 编译，将物理仿真与控制统一到单一可微计算图中，在加速硬件上实现大规模并行，同时不牺牲建模精度。采用高度模块化设计，并以集成完整的超宽带（UWB）与惯性测量单元（IMU）高保真仿真管线及全状态扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）作为扩展性示例。
AI.result: 相较现有基线取得数量级加速，可在数秒内训练出可部署的强化学习智能体；UWB/IMU+EKF 扩展可在逼真的退化状态反馈下进行大规模并行控制器评估，且对 GPU 吞吐影响极小。
AI.conclusion: Crazyflow 融合速度、精度与可扩展性，可作为新一代空中机器人研究的基础性工具。

title: How Well Do LLMs Reason with Noisy Evidence? An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark
summary: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisualNoiseQA，一个面向噪声视觉反馈下主动推理的基准：纯文本 LLM 需通过迭代查询一个有噪声、随机的 VLM（视为随机视觉传感器）来解决 VQA 问题，并利用自洽性给出的经验不确定性信号决定追问内容与停止时机。
AI.motivation: 现实推理并非静态问答，智能体需要主动从常常带有噪声、不可靠的工具或传感器中获取信息。然而现有主动推理基准大多假设环境反馈可信，或仅引入噪声而未提供显式、可校准的不确定性信号，导致"当证据本身不确定时 LLM 应如何推理"这一问题仍未得到研究。
AI.method: 构建 VisualNoiseQA 基准：文本 LLM 为解决 VQA 问题，迭代查询一个固定的、现成的 VLM，并将其建模为随机视觉传感器；每次查询采样多次，通过自洽性（self-consistency）暴露经验不确定性信号，使推理器能从不同角度探测、决定下一步提问及停止时机。构建流程自动化且可扩展：从多样的 VQA 数据源与两个带噪 VLM 出发，仅保留传感器回答不一致但人类可解的题目。
AI.result: 在涵盖感知、图表理解与知识密集型推理的 1,000 个实例上评估了多种 LLM 推理器，检验其如何利用不确定性信号进行鲁棒推理。
AI.conclusion: VisualNoiseQA 为研究不同 LLM 如何利用不确定性信号实现鲁棒主动推理提供了一个可控的实验平台。

title: View Matters: Keyframe-Guided Text-Driven 3D Gaussian Editing
summary: Text-driven 3D Gaussian editing commonly does not distinguish the editing reliability of rendered views, although different viewpoints provide supervision of substantially different quality. Views that clearly show the scene and match the edit instruction provide reliable guidance, while less informative views may weaken the edit when all views are treated equally. We present View Matters, a view-importance-aware framework that conducts editing around reliable keyframes. Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) identifies reliable views using geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit relevance. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) then propagates their editing signals asymmetrically to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence, while Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves this reliability preference during 3DGS optimization. Across 23 scene-prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the highest average CLIP text-image similarity of 0.2822 and directional similarity of 0.2564 among the evaluated methods, with a four-minute editing time. Additional adjacent-view analysis indicates that the fidelity-oriented editing process maintains cross-view coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出 View Matters 框架，通过视角重要性感知的 3D 高斯编辑，以可靠关键帧引导编辑并抑制低质量视角的噪声影响。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的 3D 高斯编辑通常不区分各渲染视角的编辑可靠性，而不同视角提供的监督质量差异显著。信息充分且与编辑指令匹配的视角能提供可靠引导，低信息量视角在等权处理时会削弱编辑效果。
AI.method: 框架包含三个模块：关键帧重要性估计（KIE）基于几何可见性、语义显著性与编辑相关性识别可靠视角；关键帧引导编辑（KGE）将关键帧编辑信号非对称地传播至非关键帧，避免噪声反向影响；重要性感知优化（IAO）在 3DGS 优化中保持该可靠性偏好。
AI.result: 在 23 组场景-提示对上，CLIP 文本-图像相似度平均达 0.2822、方向相似度达 0.2564，均为所评估方法中最高，编辑耗时约四分钟。相邻视角分析表明该保真导向的编辑过程维持了跨视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并利用视角重要性可有效提升文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑的可靠性与质量，在编辑精度与跨视角一致性上优于现有方法。

title: Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
comment: 15 pages. Accepted (poster) at DynaFront 2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
summary: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $Σ$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $Σ$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We give a self-contained Bayesian regret bound for the idealized Gaussian sampler whose information gain splits into a $K\log T$ term from the $K$-cluster structure and a ridge term that grows to $d\log T$: the $\sqrt{d/K}$ improvement over independent sampling is a finite-horizon transient, exact only as the within-cluster correlation tends to one. The correlated sampler reduces regret by 19% over CTS on 16 synthetic Bernoulli families at $T=2{,}500$ (6-7% at $T=25{,}000$ with data-adaptive kernels) and by 41% on the Microsoft MIND-small news benchmark ($d=200$ real articles), while pseudo-observation warm starts give nothing. An LLM-free ablation with a simulated oracle of controlled quality shows that on unstructured instances the gain is a property of the kernel shape (a random partition, or a plain tempering of the sampling noise, reproduces it), while belief injection at matched oracle quality never helps.

AI.tldr: 该论文对组合汤普森采样（CTS）做最小改动：用LLM一次性生成臂的分区，经RBF核构造正定相关矩阵Σ，采样时按Σ相关、Beta后验仅用真实奖励更新；给出理想高斯采样器的贝叶斯遗憾界，并在合成与真实新闻基准上验证相关性采样可显著降低遗憾。
AI.motivation: CTS对每个臂独立采样后验，其探索动态忽略了臂间关系，导致在存在结构的相关臂集合上探索效率低。作者希望在不让LLM注入错误信念的前提下，仅借助LLM提供的臂间关系来改进采样动态。
AI.method: LLM仅被查询一次以给出臂的分区；分区经簇秩上的RBF核转为正定相关矩阵Σ；每轮后验样本以Σ为协方差抽取，而Beta后验仍只用真实奖励更新（LLM只塑造采样器移动方式而非其信念）。作者为对应理想化高斯采样器给出自包含贝叶斯遗憾界，并做LLM‑free消融（随机分区、采样噪声退火、匹配质量的模拟oracle、伪观测热启动）。
AI.result: 遗憾界的信息增益分解为来自K簇结构的K log T项与增长至d log T的岭项，相对独立采样的√(d/K)改进是有限时域瞬态，仅在簇内相关趋于1时精确。相关采样器在16个合成Bernoulli族上T=2,500时较CTS降低19%遗憾（T=25,000且自适应核时6–7%），在Microsoft MIND-small新闻基准（d=200篇真实文章）上降低41%；伪观测热启动无增益。消融显示在无结构实例上增益来自核形状本身，而等质量下的信念注入始终无益。
AI.conclusion: LLM的价值在于提供臂间关系的核形状以相关性化采样噪声，而非注入信念；该改进是有限时域瞬态且依赖簇内相关强度，在结构化真实任务上收益显著，伪观测热启动与信念注入无效。

authors: A. H. T. E. De Silva
title: HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection
summary: Autonomous aerial parcel collection remains constrained by package-transfer operations that require manual loading, landing, or dedicated ground infrastructure. This letter presents HexaGripper, a single-actuator, winch-deployed six-plate gripper for autonomous collection of cuboid parcels. The proposed mechanism provides synchronized grasping with a wide capture region and tolerance to positional misalignment during pickup. The system integrates vision-based alignment, range sensing, winch deployment, and state-based control to enable autonomous collection while maintaining UAV separation from the pickup surface. Experimental evaluation covered static grasping, capture-workspace assessment, and end-to-end outdoor aerial collection. Static experiments achieved 100% pickup success (15/15 trials) across three parcel geometries, while workspace experiments achieved successful pickup at all 28 tested positions up to a 150 mm radial offset. End-to-end outdoor aerial collection achieved an 80% success rate (4/5 trials). These results demonstrate the feasibility of mechanically synchronized, winch-deployed grasping for landing-free autonomous aerial parcel collection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HexaGripper——一种单驱动、绞车下放的六板夹爪，用于无人机自主拾取长方体包裹，实现免着陆收集。
AI.motivation: 自主空中包裹收集受限于需人工装载、着陆或专用地面设施的中转操作，亟需一种免着陆、免基础设施的自主拾取方案。
AI.method: 采用单执行器驱动的六板夹爪，通过绞车下放，实现机械同步抓取；结合视觉对准、测距传感、绞车下放与状态机控制，使无人机与拾取表面保持距离完成自主收集。实验涵盖静态抓取、捕获工作空间评估与端到端户外空中收集。
AI.result: 静态实验在三种包裹几何形状下拾取成功率100%（15/15）；工作空间实验在28个测试位置、径向偏移达150 mm时全部成功；端到端户外空中收集成功率80%（4/5）。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明机械同步、绞车下放的抓取方式用于免着陆自主空中包裹收集具有可行性。

title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
summary: The rapid progress of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) has shown that they largely outperform single agents on coding, math, and QA tasks, where executable tests provide a binary success signal. Whether this advantage transfers to real scientific data analysis remains untested. We introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to answer two questions: whether MAS outperform single agents on complex scientific data analysis tasks, and if so, by how much and at what additional cost. ST-Bench contains 100 data science tasks adapted from published Earth science studies across hydrology, agriculture, and wetland methane research, expanded into 2,067 queries grounded in additional published studies and validated by domain experts. Using ST-Bench, we evaluate five recent MAS generation methods under two training protocols, against single-agent baselines on the same GPT-5 backbone. Nine of the ten MAS configurations exceed the cheapest single-agent baseline, with the strongest reaching nearly three times its composite score. This gain is primarily attributable to coverage: trained workflows produce realistic numerical metrics on a larger fraction of queries, while the quality of those metrics, conditional on producing realistic output, is comparable to that of the single-agent baseline. The strongest configuration requires approximately four times the single-agent inference time, whereas a more economical workflow captures the majority of the benefit at less than twice the cost. MAS specialization confers measurable benefit on scientific data analysis, but the benefit is conditional rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ST-Bench 基准（100 个地球科学数据分析任务、扩展为 2,067 条查询），用于检验 LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）在真实科学数据分析中是否优于单智能体。结果显示 10 种 MAS 配置中有 9 种超过最廉价的单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分接近其三倍，但推理时间约为四倍。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统在编码、数学、问答等可执行测试提供二值成功信号的任务上显著优于单智能体，但这一优势能否迁移到缺乏此类信号的复杂科学数据分析任务尚属未知；同时，其增益幅度与额外计算成本也未量化。
AI.method: 构建 ST-Bench：包含 100 个源自已发表地球科学研究（水文学、农业、湿地甲烷）的数据科学任务，扩展为 2,067 条基于其他已发表研究并由领域专家验证的查询。在同一 GPT-5 主干模型上，采用两种训练协议评估五种近期 MAS 生成方法，并与单智能体基线对比。
AI.result: 10 种 MAS 配置中有 9 种超过最廉价的单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分接近其 3 倍。增益主要来自覆盖率提升：训练得到的工作流在更大比例的查询上产出符合实际的数值指标，而条件于产出合格输出时，其指标质量与单智能体基线相当。最强配置推理时间约为单智能体的 4 倍，而更经济的流程以不到 2 倍成本获得大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: MAS 的专门化分工在科学数据分析上带来可测量的收益，但该收益是条件性的而非普适的；实践中需在性能增益与推理成本之间权衡。

title: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIE-PS，一种基于学习的事件相机光度立体框架，通过将同一像素相邻事件与对应光照方向配对构建"物理辐照事件"（PIE），并以其有符号事件率作为不依赖对比度阈值的特征（PIEF），结合PIE-GNN与可靠性分级注意力（RGA）实现稠密法向重建。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围，适合运动光照下的光度立体，但原始事件稀疏且依赖未知对比度阈值，直接从事件触发模型推导的物理求解器需已知阈值、要求每像素足够事件并逐像素独立优化，难以实用。
AI.method: 从事件触发模型推导相邻事件、光照运动与表面法向的物理关系；将同一像素相邻事件与对应光照方向配对构成PIE，定义有符号事件率作为PIEF特征（无需阈值）；用PIE-GNN把每个PIE作为图节点并编码光照对几何以共享时空上下文；用RGA预测可靠性权重以抑制不可靠PIE；最后进行像素级聚合得到稠密法向。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，PIE-PS优于现有基于事件的光度立体方法及直接物理求解器基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入无需对比度阈值的物理事件特征并结合图神经网络与可靠性加权，可有效克服原始事件的稀疏性与阈值未知问题，实现稠密且鲁棒的事件光度立体法向重建。

title: Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity
summary: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 提出有限深度框架估计策略灵敏度，近似策略Hessian与混合导数，给出截断误差界并验证于追逃博弈。
AI.motivation: 将RL策略迁移到行为发生变化的其他智能体时，通常需要大量新交互数据；策略灵敏度可一阶预测局部最优策略随行为参数的变化，但其计算依赖二阶导数且影响沿未来交互传播，计算代价高。
AI.method: 构建有限深度框架，借助参考环境信息近似策略Hessian与混合导数来估计灵敏度；引入可调传播深度，在轨迹上对导数传播进行截断；刻画被有限深度传播忽略的导数贡献，推导近似导数与所得策略灵敏度的截断误差界。
AI.result: 误差界随传播深度非增，满时域传播时消失；在信念驱动的追逃博弈中，深度增加使导数估计误差整体下降，估计精度与策略自适应均优于基线；基于灵敏度的初始化相比直接迁移提升零样本回报，并对目标环境的后续微调有优势。
AI.conclusion: 有限深度传播为二阶策略灵敏度估计提供了可控近似与理论保证，可有效支持跨行为变化的策略迁移与初始化，并利于目标环境微调。

title: Mitigating Concept Drift in QoS Prediction for Teleoperation of Autonomous Vehicles Using Historic Data
comment: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
summary: Teleoperation serves as the fallback solution to autonomous driving but reliable functions of the teleoperation require a certain amount of mobile network resources, which cannot be guaranteed at all times. Therefore, predictive quality of service (pQoS) is introduced as a concept to increase the resilience of the teleoperation. In this paper, based on a data measurement campaign, we propose a prediction framework to prediction two important network KPIs of teleoperation: uplink data-rate and round-trip latency. Furthermore, we introduce a method to alleviate the performance degradation of machine-learning-based prediction models on previously unseen data due to concept drift by incorporating historic data into the prediction pipeline. Additionally, we introduce the metric of critical scenario detection to evaluate the prediction performance specifically for teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个预测框架，用于预测远程驾驶的两个关键网络KPI（上行数据速率与往返时延），并通过引入历史数据缓解概念漂移导致的模型性能下降，同时提出关键场景检测指标以评估面向远程驾驶的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 远程驾驶是自动驾驶的后备方案，但其可靠运行依赖一定量的移动网络资源，而这类资源无法始终得到保证，因此需要引入预测性服务质量（pQoS）来提升远程驾驶的韧性。
AI.method: 基于一次数据测量活动（data measurement campaign）构建预测框架，用于预测远程驾驶的两个关键网络KPI：上行数据速率和往返时延；并将历史数据纳入预测流程，以缓解基于机器学习的预测模型在未见数据上因概念漂移而产生的性能退化；同时提出关键场景检测这一指标。
AI.result: 提出了可预测上行数据速率与往返时延的预测框架；通过融入历史数据减轻了概念漂移带来的性能下降；并提出关键场景检测指标，用于专门评估远程驾驶场景下的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: pQoS有助于提升远程驾驶的韧性，所提预测框架与历史数据融合方法及关键场景检测指标，为面向远程驾驶的网络KPI预测与评估提供了可行途径。

title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, ED Track, Spotlight
summary: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. Each baseline starts from an open-weight model and is post-trained on OTel-derived data using an open training recipe, then evaluated on held-out OTel evaluation partitions. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.1% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.947 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 87.8%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: Open Telco (OTel) 是面向电信领域的开放 AI 资源，发布派生数据集与 30 个全参数后训练基线模型（涵盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排器、17 个语言模型）。截至 2026-05-03 模型下载超 1600 万次、获 157+ 媒体覆盖；后训练在三个模型族上均带来性能提升：嵌入检索 NDCG@10 达 93.1%，重排 MRR@10 达 0.947，语言模型正确率达 87.8%。
AI.motivation: 电信领域缺乏统一的开放资源：数据来源分散、缺少留出评测集，且嵌入、重排与上下文接地 LLM 的模型与训练配方未打通。OTel 旨在提供可复现的起点，供社区扩展数据并改进模型。
AI.method: 在已有开放电信数据集与基准之上，构建统一资源：发布用于检索、重排、指令微调与安全/弃答的派生数据集，并给出来源记录与留出评测分区；每个基线均从开放权重模型出发，使用开放训练配方在 OTel 派生数据上进行全参数后训练，随后在留出分区上评测。共覆盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排器和 17 个语言模型。
AI.result: 后训练在三个模型族上均提升性能：嵌入检索达到 93.1% NDCG@10，重排达到 0.947 MRR@10，语言模型正确率达到 87.8%。社区参与度高：截至 2026-05-03 模型下载量超 1600 万次，项目获 157+ 篇全球媒体报道。
AI.conclusion: OTel 以可复现形式发布，作为电信 AI 的统一起点，并邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排模型、构建更强的上下文接地电信 LLM。

title: MacJEPA: Missingness-Robust Audio-Visual Recognition from Untrimmed Egocentric Videos
summary: Audio-visual models improve egocentric action recognition by exploiting complementary cues, yet typically assume that both streams remain available at inference. Existing missing-modality methods operate on trimmed, single-event clips in which a stream is entirely present or absent, whereas real sensors fail and recover within long, untrimmed observations. We redefine egocentric modality missingness as temporally localized sensor outages within untrimmed, multi-event observations, with whole-clip absence as the limiting case. We introduce \textbf{MacJEPA}, a missing-modality-robust \textbf{Ma}sked-\textbf{c}ontext query \textbf{JEPA} that recognizes visual actions and acoustic events from supplied interval queries over audio-visual context. Window-local modality dropout simulates these sensor outages during training. MacJEPA further repurposes masking in JEPA from a self-supervised pretext into a supervised robustness objective, aligning masked and clean latent representations of both multimodal content tokens and the task-conditioned queries. All objectives are optimized jointly with recognition in a single stage, requiring no test-time adaptation. Across Epic-Kitchens-100 and Epic-Sounds, a single checkpoint remains competitive under complete input and consistently surpasses published missing-modality baselines when either the dominant or auxiliary stream is removed. MacJEPA thus unifies strong full-input recognition with temporal missing-modality robustness in a single model operating on untrimmed multi-event videos.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新定义了自我中心（egocentric）场景下的模态缺失问题，提出MacJEPA模型，在未裁剪、多事件视频中应对时间局部的传感器中断，单一模型在全输入与缺失模态下均保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频模型提升自我中心动作识别时，通常假设推理阶段两个流都可用；已有的缺失模态方法仅针对裁剪后的单事件片段，其中某个流要么完全存在要么完全缺失。而真实传感器会在长时间、未裁剪的观测中反复失效并恢复，因此需要新的问题定义与方法。
AI.method: 将自我中心模态缺失重新定义为未裁剪多事件观测中时间局部化的传感器中断，整段缺失为其极限情形。提出MacJEPA（缺失模态鲁棒的掩码上下文查询JEPA），基于给定的区间查询从音视频上下文中识别视觉动作与声学事件。训练时采用窗口局部模态dropout模拟传感器中断；将JEPA中的掩码从自监督 pretext 改造为监督鲁棒性目标，对齐多模态内容token与任务条件查询在掩码与干净情况下的隐表示。所有目标与识别任务在单阶段联合优化，无需测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-100与Epic-Sounds上，单一checkpoint在完整输入下保持竞争力，且在去除主导流或辅助流时持续超越已发表的缺失模态基线。
AI.conclusion: MacJEPA在单一模型中统一了强全输入识别与时间缺失模态鲁棒性，可运行于未裁剪多事件视频。

title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

AI.tldr: 提出掩码频带功率预测（MBP）这一任务对齐的自监督预训练目标，在睡眠分期任务上优于波形重建与离散码本预测，但增益不具跨任务普适性。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督EEG模型多采用掩码波形重建或离散码预测，前者对相位敏感、与下游标签的物理含义不匹配，后者需学习码本且目标间接。作者希望寻找与下游任务（如睡眠分期依赖节律功率）在物理量及时空尺度上对齐的预训练目标。
AI.method: 提出掩码频带功率预测（MBP）：对掩码的通道-时间片段预测固定的窄带对数谱能量。控制变量包括匹配的主干网络、预训练数据（2,388小时）与训练步数，跨三个预训练种子比较频带功率与波形目标，并设计2×2的tokenizer×target实验；在ISRUC与HMC睡眠分期上采用严格线性探针（全标签及1%标签）评估，并对比手工谱特征基线与全量微调，同时在运动想象、抑郁筛查、警觉度回归上测试迁移性。
AI.result: MBP在全标签下比原始及频带波形重建高1.6–2.8个平衡准确率点，1%标签下高4.7–7.3点；目标效应大于tokenizer效应。冻结特征平衡准确率达0.7916/0.7425，手工谱基线为0.7636/0.7227，但1%标签时差距约1点。全量微调达0.8107/0.7669。在运动想象、抑郁筛查、警觉度回归上未观察到增益。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标应依据下游标签相关的物理量及空间、时间尺度来选择与对齐；MBP在强节律线索任务（睡眠分期）上有效，但其优势不普适，提示任务对齐而非通用重建才是有利设计原则。

title: Sensor-Layout-Agnostic Navigation via Geometric Observation Canonicalization
summary: Existing visual navigation policies are inherently bound to fixed camera configurations, creating a fundamental barrier to zero-shot deployment across heterogeneous robot sensor layouts. To overcome this limitation, we present an embodiment-informed navigation policy capable of generalizing across diverse depth sensor configurations on a specific aerial platform. Instead of implicitly learning spatial alignments, our approach explicitly unprojects depth measurements from arbitrary depth sensor payloads, varying in sensor count, mounting extrinsics, and intrinsics, into a shared robot-centric frame, stitching them into a unified spherical range image and a binary validity mask. This mask allows the downstream policy to explicitly distinguish covered space from unobserved blind spots. Trained via reinforcement learning with aggressive camera randomization, our policy generalizes zero-shot to unseen layouts featuring up to seven cameras, scaling success rates from 78% to 95% as total spatial sensing coverage increases. Finally, real-world flight trials on a physical quadrotor, conducted in an obstacle-filled corridor and an outdoor forest, validate the policy's zero-shot transfer across camera configurations and its resilience to sudden online sensor dropouts.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"具身感知"的空中导航策略，通过将任意深度传感器布局的测量显式反投影到机器人中心坐标系并拼接为统一球面距离图像与有效性掩码，实现对未见相机配置的零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航策略与固定相机配置强耦合，导致其无法零样本部署到传感器布局异构的机器人平台上。论文旨在打破这一限制，使策略能泛化到同一空中平台上不同数量、不同外参和内参的深度传感器配置。
AI.method: 不依赖隐式学习空间对齐，而是显式地将来自任意深度传感器载荷的测量值反投影（unproject）到共享的机器人中心坐标系，拼接成统一的球面距离图像（spherical range image）及二值有效性掩码（binary validity mask），使下游策略能区分已覆盖区域与未观测盲区。策略通过强化学习训练，并采用激进的相机随机化（camera randomization）策略。
AI.result: 策略零样本泛化到最多七相机的未见布局；随总空间感知覆盖度增加，成功率从78%提升至95%。在物理四旋翼上进行的真实飞行试验（障碍走廊与户外森林环境）验证了跨相机配置的零样本迁移能力以及对在线传感器突发失效的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何统一表示结合相机随机化训练，可有效解耦导航策略与具体传感器布局，实现跨异构深度传感配置的零样本部署，并在真实环境中具备鲁棒性。

title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.

AI.tldr: 本文通过8-bit与4-bit量化Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在20个确定性工具任务和5种提示下的对比，发现量化对工具失败恢复的影响结论会随提示、评估目标与评分策略而反转，故单一设定无法得出稳健结论。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化可降低语言模型代理的部署成本，但其对临时工具失败恢复能力的影响可能依赖于评估方式。现有评估往往只采用单一提示、经过筛选的任务集与单一评分策略，容易得出不稳健的结论，因此需要系统考察这些评估选择如何影响量化代理鲁棒性的判断。
AI.method: 对比Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的8-bit和4-bit量化变体，在20个确定性工具使用任务和5种提示上进行评估。分析三类评估选择的影响：(1) 提示与评估目标（仅在本变体通过的任务上评分 vs. 两变体在同一批任务上评分 vs. 全流程评分）；(2) 评分策略（严格输出解析 vs. 宽松解析，对同一日志重新评分）；(3) 不确定性量化方式（按任务而非注入故障点）。
AI.result: 8-bit与4-bit的恢复对比随提示和评估目标改变方向：在两变体同提示下均无故障完成的任务上，差异对Llama为0至+20.2个百分点，对Qwen为-50.0至+35.0个百分点。全流程点估计在5种提示下均偏向8-bit Llama，而Qwen则随提示反转。评估目标同样可逆转结果：Llama在某一提示下，仅在本变体干净通过任务上评分时4-bit领先17.5个百分点，两变体同任务评分时无差异，全流程评分时8-bit领先28.3个百分点。评分宽松度是第三类选择：以严格输出解析对同一日志重新评分（该提示下8-bit Llama违规远多于4-bit），将+28.3转为-15.0，而Qwen基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 单一提示、单一筛选任务集与单一评分策略无法确立关于量化代理鲁棒性的稳定结论。评估应：(1) 在匹配任务上比较变体；(2) 为部署决策报告全流程成功率；(3) 明确说明评分策略；(4) 跨任务而非注入故障点量化不确定性。

title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种完整的条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）系统标定流程，将深度学习角点检测嵌入相机标定，并通过采样标靶白方格中心相位值标定投影仪，系统分析定位误差在全标定链中的传播。在混合数据上相机重投影误差由1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差约降低50%，三维重建几何精度提升。
AI.motivation: FPP实现可靠三维重建依赖精确系统标定，而标定精度高度依赖棋盘格特征定位的鲁棒性；在镜头模糊、标靶姿态倾斜等不利成像条件下定位会退化。现有深度学习角点检测器多以检测指标和相机重投影误差评估，未考虑其对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性及整体测量精度的更广泛影响。
AI.method: 构建完整FPP标定流水线：将深度学习角点检测集成到标准相机标定流程；通过采样标靶白方格中心的相位值标定投影仪；将角点检测定位误差显式建模为沿整个FPP标定链的传播过程，而非孤立任务。评估采用检测指标（精确率、召回率）、相机与投影仪重投影误差，以及相机-投影仪立体标定结果；在干净图像与退化图像的混合数据集上验证。
AI.result: 混合数据集上相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差约降低50%；重建制品尺寸评估显示几何精度优于传统流程；表明在不利成像条件下系统级标定鲁棒性增强，可实现更可靠的工业FPP测量。
AI.conclusion: 将深度学习角点检测纳入完整FPP标定框架并分析误差传播，能显著提升相机与投影仪标定精度及重建几何精度，增强挑战性成像条件下的系统级标定鲁棒性，为工业FPP测量提供更可靠保障。

title: Robust Importance Sampling for Rare Events via Constrained Gaussian Mixtures
summary: We study estimating rare-event probabilities $I = \mathbb{P}(g(\mathbf{X}) > γ)$ with $\mathbf{X} \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbolμ, \boldsymbolΣ)$ and general $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$. We address this problem through importance sampling, and propose a framework that substantially improves efficiency and robustness over baselines such as crude Monte Carlo, adaptive cross-entropy, variational-inference-based methods (including reverse- and forward-KL approaches), as well as Safe-ICE, Subset Simulation, and Sequential Monte Carlo, drawing on ideas from both rare-event estimation and cross-entropy optimization. The key contribution has two parts: first, we separate the problem into coverage, to overcome the cold-start barrier, and fitting, to refine proposals once a meaningful signal is available; second, we constrain the final GMM proposal so that it has finite importance-sampling variance (since coverage alone is not sufficient -- without safeguards, importance sampling may still suffer from infinite variance). Together, these ingredients yield expressive proposals; finite variance does not by itself guarantee practical stability at a fixed sampling budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial variance reduction, strong robustness across diverse benchmarks, and favorable cost--efficiency trade-offs, with the proposed approach often outperforming these baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and multimodal settings where competing methods frequently become unstable or fail. Our code is available at https://github.com/lorek/robust-cfi-is.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个结合稀有事件估计与交叉熵优化的重要性采样框架，通过"覆盖+拟合"两阶段分解与有限方差GMM约束，显著提升稀有事件概率估计的效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 估计高斯分布下任意函数的稀有事件概率 I=P(g(X)>γ) 时，朴素蒙特卡洛及自适应交叉熵、变分推断、Safe-ICE、子集模拟、序列蒙特卡洛等现有方法在高维与多模态场景下效率低、易失效，常受"冷启动"障碍与重要性采样方差无界问题困扰。
AI.method: 基于重要性采样，将问题分解为两个部分：一是"覆盖"（coverage），用于突破冷启动障碍；二是"拟合"（fitting），在获得有效信号后精炼提议分布；并对最终的高斯混合模型（GMM）提议分布施加约束，保证重要性采样方差有限，融合稀有事件估计与交叉熵优化思想。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，相较基线方法，所提方法实现显著的方差缩减、跨多类基准的强鲁棒性与良好的成本—效率权衡，在高维与多模态设置中常优于基线，而竞争方法往往不稳定甚至失败。
AI.conclusion: 通过覆盖与拟合分离并约束GMM提议分布使方差有限，可获得表达力强的提议分布；但有限方差本身不足以保证固定采样预算下的实用稳定性，所提框架整体上更高效、更鲁棒。

title: Humanoid Horizon: Extending Task Horizon in Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Parallel Training, Dynamic Starting, and Reward Gating
comment: Videos and results are available at https://haozhuo-zhang.github.io/Humanoid-Horizon-project-page/
summary: Cluttered indoor environments, where large and heavy objects are scattered across diverse surfaces, require humanoid robots to sequentially navigate, grasp, transport, and accurately place each item at its target location within a single uninterrupted episode. This long-horizon, whole-body loco-manipulation task remains a significant challenge for current methods. Previous approaches often suffer from two main issues: easy-reward bias, where training overemphasizes early transport stages at the expense of later ones, and catastrophic forgetting, where focusing on later stages leads to a decline in earlier-stage performance. In this work, we introduce Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework designed to overcome these limitations through three interrelated mechanisms. The Parallel Training Strategy organizes $N$ scenes into $S$ concurrent stage streams governed by a shared policy, ensuring all transport stages receive continuous gradient updates and removing the bottleneck of sequential optimization. The Dynamic Starting Mechanism updates each environment's initial state with terminal states from upstream rollouts, gradually broadening transition coverage and enhancing robustness at stage boundaries. Reward Gating sets the reward to zero for the rest of the episode in later-stage streams when the immediately preceding object is displaced beyond a set threshold, so the shared policy learns not to disturb a just-placed object and earlier placements are preserved throughout the episode. Collectively, these strategies achieve per-stage success rates exceeding 80\% on the two-object LHM-Humanoid benchmark (350 training scenes, 66 held-out scenes). As the number of sequentially transported objects grows beyond two, success declines with the horizon, but the degradation is graceful relative to the sharp drop seen in all baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Humanoid Horizon 统一策略框架，用并行训练、动态起始与奖励门控三机制解决长程全身移动操作中的易奖励偏差与灾难性遗忘，两物体基准各阶段成功率超 80%，长程下性能退化平缓。
AI.motivation: 杂乱室内环境下，人形机器人需在单次不间断 episode 中依次完成导航、抓取、搬运与精确放置的重型物体操作，属长程全身 loco-manipulation 任务。现有方法存在两大问题：一是易奖励偏差，训练过度侧重早期搬运阶段而忽视后期；二是灾难性遗忘，聚焦后期阶段会导致早期阶段性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 Humanoid Horizon 统一策略框架，含三个相互关联机制：(1) 并行训练策略，将 N 个场景组织为 S 个并发阶段流并由共享策略统一控制，使所有搬运阶段获得持续梯度更新，消除顺序优化的瓶颈；(2) 动态起始机制，用上游 rollout 的终止状态更新各环境初始状态，逐步扩大状态转移覆盖并增强阶段边界处的鲁棒性；(3) 奖励门控，当紧邻的前一物体被移动超过设定阈值时，将后期阶段流中该 episode 剩余奖励置零，使共享策略学会不干扰刚放置的物体，从而在整个 episode 中保留早期放置成果。
AI.result: 在两物体 LHM-Humanoid 基准（350 个训练场景、66 个留存场景）上，各阶段成功率均超过 80%。当顺序搬运物体数量超过两个时，成功率随任务时域增长而下降，但相比所有基线方法的急剧下降，其性能退化更为平缓。
AI.conclusion: Humanoid Horizon 通过并行训练、动态起始与奖励门控的协同设计，有效缓解易奖励偏差与灾难性遗忘，在长程全身移动操作任务中实现高阶段成功率与较优的长时域可扩展性。

title: TSRN-RTVD: Real-Time Video Deblurring System
summary:
As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult.
  We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU.

AI.tldr: 提出TSRN-RTVD视频去模糊系统，通过重建曝光期间的相机轨迹并用其引导复原，在单张消费级GPU上以30 FPS实时运行，GoPro数据集达到30.08 dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 手持与边缘设备拍摄导致相机抖动引起的运动模糊普遍存在，降低感知质量并损害下游视觉任务。高性能去模糊网络虽细节出色，但计算量大、结构复杂，消费级硬件无法实时承担，存在复原质量与端侧速度之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 显式重建曝光期间潜在的相机运动轨迹，将恢复出的运动信息作为引导信号驱动去模糊复原，从而把模糊的物理成因转化为引导锐化的线索。系统在单张消费级GPU上实现。
AI.result: 在单张消费级GPU上以30 FPS恢复视频，在GoPro数据集上达到30.08 dB PSNR；并在消费设备上实现模糊输入与去模糊输出的交互式并排可视化、实时吞吐量显示及恢复的相机轨迹屏上展示。
AI.conclusion: 将相机轨迹重建与去模糊耦合，可在消费级硬件上兼顾实时性与复原质量，为端侧实时视频去模糊提供可行方案，并提供演示视频链接。

title: Who Bears the Burden? Learning Responsibility for Shared Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Project page with code: https://lira-marl.github.io
summary: When multiple agents share a cost budget, a common Lagrange multiplier can enforce the aggregate constraint but does not determine how its penalty should be allocated across agents. Uniform penalties ignore heterogeneity in the rewards agents sacrifice, while agent-specific multipliers may still rely on the same aggregate cost signal. We introduce Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA), which learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon. The multiplier enforces the aggregate budget, while responsibility shares redistribute its influence without modifying the original rewards or constraints. For convex games under standard regularity conditions, varying these shares induces a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria in which active constraints remain at their budgets while welfare varies. To optimize responsibility before convergence, we derive a welfare gradient that accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution. Across CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive, spanning 3 to 400 agents, LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines. Grid and driving costs remain within budget, inventory violations decrease, and Harvest makes more effective use of available budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拉格朗日责任分配（LiRA），通过学习每个代理在共同拉格朗日乘子中的责任份额，在有限训练视界内优化社会福利，从而在保持聚合预算约束的同时更合理地分摊惩罚影响。
AI.motivation: 多代理共享成本预算时，共同拉格朗日乘子虽能强制聚合约束，却无法确定惩罚应如何在代理间分配。均匀惩罚忽视了各代理所牺牲奖励的异质性，而代理特定乘子通常仍依赖相同的聚合成本信号，因而无法有效实现差异化的责任分配。
AI.method: LiRA 为每个代理学习其在共同乘子中的责任份额，通过优化有限训练视界上的社会福利来调整分配，且不修改原始奖励或约束。作者在标准正则条件下分析凸博弈，证明改变责任份额会诱导归一化广义纳什均衡的平滑族；并推导同时考虑学习更新和数据分布变化的社会福利梯度，以在收敛前优化责任。
AI.result: 在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest 和 MetaDrive 四个环境、3 至 400 个代理的实验中，LiRA 相较均匀乘子和代理特定乘子基线将平均社会福利最多提升 29%。电网和驾驶成本保持在预算内，库存违规减少，Harvest 更有效地利用可用预算。
AI.conclusion: 责任份额可在不改变原始奖励与约束的情况下重新分配共同乘子的影响，形成兼顾预算执行与福利改进的均衡族；LiRA 为多代理预算约束下的责任分配提供了有效且可扩展的方案。

title: Communication-Free Obstacle Localization from Aggregate Wrench Measurements in Leader--Follower Cooperative Transport
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: We consider obstacle localization for a team of robots cooperatively transporting a rigid payload without explicit inter-robot communication. A leader robot directs the payload's motion, while follower robots assist and react to locally detected obstacles. The leader measures the followers' aggregate wrench, i.e., the combined force and torque they exert on the payload, but cannot directly distinguish their individual reactions. We design a follower control law that allows the leader to recover obstacle locations from these measurements. Each follower resists motion toward nearby obstacles, resulting in a piecewise-linear relationship between the payload's translational and angular velocity and the aggregate wrench. Changes between adjacent linear regions reveal an obstacle's bearing and distance and identify the responding follower. We give sufficient conditions for exact recovery at a fixed payload configuration and develop an adaptive probing procedure in which the leader applies translational and rotational inputs to the payload to obtain the required measurements. We demonstrate the performance of the proposed method in simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在机器人团队协同搬运刚性负载且机器人间无显式通信条件下、由领导者通过测量跟随者对负载施加的合力/力矩来反推障碍物位置的方法。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同搬运中，跟随者需要回避局部探测到的障碍物，但若机器人间无法显式通信，领导者难以直接获知障碍物位置；因此需要一种仅依赖负载处可测量力学信号的隐式信息传递与障碍物定位机制。
AI.method: 设计跟随者控制律：每个跟随者抵抗朝附近障碍物的运动，使得负载的平移/角速度与聚合wrench之间呈现分段线性关系；相邻线性区域之间的切换点包含障碍物的方位和距离信息，并可识别出相应的跟随者。给出固定负载构型下精确恢复的充分条件，并设计自适应探测流程——领导者对负载施加平动与转动输入以采集所需测量。
AI.result: 通过仿真验证了所提方法在障碍物定位与响应跟随者识别方面的性能。
AI.conclusion: 无需机器人间通信，仅利用领导者对跟随者聚合wrench的测量，即可通过分段线性模型和自适应探测恢复障碍物位置并识别响应者。

title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
summary: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attacca，通过在完整"搜索-交互"轨迹上训练视觉目标条件策略，并解耦目标图像与环境，显著提升长时程具身任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉目标条件策略多在目标已可见的孤立交互上评估，无法应对长时程连续执行中的情形：每项任务从上一步状态开始，智能体位置与朝向改变、世界被修改、下一目标可能不在视野内，导致无法在当前观测中定位目标而难以推进。
AI.method: 1) 在完整 search-to-interact 轨迹上训练策略，目标图像与执行环境解耦；2) 上下文解耦目标采样（context-decoupled goal sampling）：将每条演示与来自另一世界的类别兼容掩码目标图像配对，去除场景与位姿对应；3) 通过目标掩码预测头学习当前视角的稠密定位，作为动作模仿之外的辅助监督；4) 引入行为阶段条件（behavioral-phase conditioning），区分 Search、Approach、Interact 三阶段并随执行进程调整控制。
AI.result: 在 Minecraft 多个短时程与长时程具身任务上评测：干净成功率 39.0-47.5%，较最强基线提升 1.7-2.4 倍；长时程任务完成率为 54%、30%、28%，最高提升 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 解耦目标图像、稠密定位辅助监督与行为阶段条件能有效应对长时程具身任务中目标不可见的挑战，显著优于现有基线。

title: Whose Face Is It Anyway? A Multi-Model Audit of Facial Affect Recognition on Children, and Why the Gap Is the Head, Not the Features
summary: Facial affect models are trained almost entirely on adults, yet are increasingly applied to children in education, health, and developmental research. We present a controlled, multi-model audit of five AffectNet-pretrained expression models (EmoNet, EmotiEffLib, DDAMFN++, OpenFace 3.0, LibreFace) on children, across four child image datasets, the AffectNet-8 validation set, and two spontaneous child video datasets, through one shared harness. Three findings emerge. First, the child gap is model-agnostic: every architecture degrades from posed to naturalistic faces and shares the fear$\rightarrow$surprise confusion. Second, it is concentrated and corroborated across all five models: open-mouth faces (read as surprise, correlating with the AU26 jaw drop) and South-Asian children degrade systematically, with a smaller averted-gaze penalty, while closed-mouth faces, White and Black children, and direct gaze do not; the bias tracks expression morphology and specific populations, not skin tone. Third, the gap is diagnosable: a linear probe on frozen features reaches 0.75-0.91 on unseen children versus 0.48-0.66 zero-shot, so it lies largely in the classifier head, not the representation, whereas dimensional valence/arousal regression degrades sharply under domain shift. Building on this, recalibrating only the head on a little target data recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.28$ on the two largest child sets across all five models at negligible adult cost, though the gain is in-distribution and does not transfer across child collections. We will release the harness, per-sample predictions, and analysis code; the child face data stays license-locked and is never redistributed.

AI.tldr: 该论文对5种基于AffectNet预训练的表情模型（EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace）在儿童数据上进行受控多模型审计，发现儿童性能差距是模型无关的、集中在特定表情形态与人群上，且主要源于分类头而非表征；仅重校准分类头即可用极少目标数据显著恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 面部情感模型几乎完全在成人数据上训练，却被日益广泛应用于儿童的教育、健康与发展研究中，存在潜在的系统性偏差风险。作者希望通过统一的评测框架，系统量化现有主流模型在儿童群体上的性能差距并诊断其来源。
AI.method: 构建统一的评测工具（shared harness），对5个AffectNet预训练表情模型（EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace）在4个儿童图像数据集、AffectNet-8验证集以及2个自然场景儿童视频数据集上进行受控的多模型审计；通过线性探针（linear probe）区分分类头与表征的贡献，并测试仅重校准分类头的修复方案；同时评估维度价效/唤醒回归在域偏移下的表现。
AI.result: （1）儿童差距与模型无关：所有架构从摆拍面孔到自然面孔均出现性能下降，并共享恐惧→惊讶的混淆模式；（2）差距具有集中性且在5个模型中一致：张嘴面孔（被判为惊讶，与AU26下颌张开相关）和南亚儿童系统性退化，回避目光有较小惩罚，而闭嘴面孔、白人与黑人儿童、直视目光不受影响，偏差与表情形态及特定人群相关而非肤色；（3）差距可诊断：冻结特征上的线性探针在未见儿童上达0.75–0.91，而零样本仅0.48–0.66，说明问题主要位于分类头而非表征；而维度价效/唤醒回归在域偏移下急剧退化。仅用少量目标数据重校准分类头即可在最大两个儿童集上提升+0.13至+0.28，且对成人性能代价可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 儿童表情识别差距是系统性、模型无关且可诊断的，主要归因于分类头而非特征表征，可通过少量目标数据的头部重校准以低成人代价有效缓解，但该增益为分布内且不能跨儿童数据集迁移。作者将公开评测工具、逐样本预测与分析代码，儿童人脸数据因许可限制不进行再分发。

title: Source-Learned Reliance for Selective Test-Time Adaptation of Multimodal Time Series
summary: Multimodal wearable systems must remain reliable when sensor streams become noisy or unavailable. Existing multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) methods often assess reliability online, but cross-modal agreement can be misleading when sensors measure different physical processes, and evaluating alternative modality configurations adds inference cost. We propose CARAT, which decouples model reliance from runtime corruption detection to guide omission or attenuation, amortizing reliance estimation through source training. An asymmetric modality-dropout curriculum prepares a missingness-resilient backbone for omission and derives a frozen, backbone-specific reliance proxy from windowed input-projection gradient norms. At deployment, a lightweight one-class detector flags suspect streams, and the proxy guides a joint choice between replacing the suspect set with the backbone's trained missingness symbol and attenuating its representations before fusion, without candidate-subset evaluation. Across four wearable datasets, five corruption types, three backbones, and eight TTA baselines, CARAT achieves the highest overall macro-F1 and best mean rank (2.42), exceeding EATA, the strongest baseline, by 1.58 F1 points across 12 equally weighted dataset-backbone settings. Across five profiled configurations, CARAT uses 9.49% fewer GFLOPs and updates 47.82% fewer parameters than EATA. A pattern also emerges across sensing regimes: multimodal TTA methods such as PTA are competitive on IMU-dominated homogeneous datasets, whereas unimodal TTA methods like TENT and EATA match or exceed it on heterogeneous datasets. These results position CARAT as a practical default to wearable TTA, offering competitive robustness with modest computational requirements and benefits that vary across backbones and dataset regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARAT，一种多模态可穿戴系统的测试时自适应（TTA）方法。它将模型依赖度估计与运行时损坏检测解耦，通过源域训练摊销依赖度估计，利用非对称模态dropout课程训练缺失鲁棒骨干并导出冻结的依赖度代理，部署时用轻量单类检测器标记可疑流并以代理指导omission或衰减的联合选择。在四个数据集、五种损坏、三个骨干、八个TTA基线上取得最高macro-F1与最佳平均排名（2.42），较最强基线EATA提升1.58个F1点，且GFLOPs减少9.49%、更新参数减少47.82%。
AI.motivation: 多模态可穿戴系统在传感器流噪声或不可用时需保持可靠性。现有TTA方法在线评估可靠性，但跨模态一致性在传感器测量不同物理过程时会产生误导，且评估替代模态配置会带来额外推理开销。因此需要一种无需候选子集评估、计算开销适中的可靠性引导机制。
AI.method: CARAT将模型依赖度与运行时损坏检测解耦。训练阶段采用非对称模态dropout课程，训练出对缺失鲁棒的骨干，并基于窗口化输入投影梯度范数导出冻结的、骨干专属的依赖度代理。部署阶段使用轻量单类检测器标记可疑流，并由依赖度代理指导"用骨干训练的缺失符号替换可疑集"与"在融合前衰减其表示"之间的联合选择，避免候选子集评估，从而摊销依赖度估计成本。
AI.result: 在四个可穿戴数据集、五种损坏类型、三个骨干、八个TTA基线上，CARAT取得最高总体macro-F1与最佳平均排名（2.42）。在12个等权数据集-骨干设置中，较最强基线EATA提升1.58个F1点；在五个profiled配置下，GFLOPs减少9.49%，更新参数减少47.82%。此外发现跨感知机制的模式：PTA等多模态TTA在IMU主导的同质数据集上有竞争力，而TENT、EATA等单模态TTA在异质数据集上可匹配或超越之。
AI.conclusion: CARAT通过解耦依赖度估计与损坏检测，为可穿戴TTA提供了一种实用默认方案，在适度计算需求下具备竞争力强的鲁棒性，其收益随骨干与数据集机制而变化。多模态与单模态TTA方法的相对优势取决于同质/异质感知机制，提示未来工作需按感知机制选择适配策略。

title: SC3BF: Shifted Collision Cone Control Barrier Function for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: The collision cone used by velocity-space control barrier functions is conservative: it rejects every relative velocity aimed into an obstacle, however slow. We propose the \emph{shifted collision-cone CBF} (SC3BF), which adds a state-dependent \emph{allowance} to the cone condition, so the robot may approach the obstacle at a rate that grows with distance and with its own speed. SC3BF is enforced by an ordinary quadratic program, and its safe set is forward invariant under bounded inputs without a minimum forward speed or a clearance margin. We prove that a nonzero allowance preserving safety always exists, and derive one in closed form. Against three velocity-space baselines on a kinematic bicycle among up to $100$ moving obstacles, SC3BF reaches the goal more often and modifies the nominal input less than half as much.

AI.tldr: 提出移位碰撞锥CBF（SC3BF），在锥条件中加入状态相关容许量，使机器人可随距离和自速增大以一定速率接近障碍物，由标准QP执行，无需最小前向速度或安全裕度即保证前向不变性，并提供闭式容许量。
AI.motivation: 速度空间控制屏障函数所用的碰撞锥过于保守：无论多慢，只要相对速度指向障碍物就被拒绝，导致可行域过窄、过度修改标称输入、任务成功率低。
AI.method: 在碰撞锥条件中引入状态相关的容许量（allowance），构造移位碰撞锥CBF（SC3BF）；容许量随距离与自速增长；通过普通二次规划（QP）执行约束；证明存在非零容许量且保持安全性，并给出闭式解。
AI.result: 在运动学自行车模型、最多100个移动障碍物的场景中，与三种速度空间基线相比，SC3BF到达目标更频繁，且对标称输入的修改量不到基线的一半。
AI.conclusion: SC3BF在无最小前向速度与无安全裕度条件下即可保证安全集前向不变，显著降低保守性，兼顾安全性与任务效率，适合实时QP实现。

title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.

AI.tldr: OOPMAS：无需训练的多智能体系统自动设计框架，以“单查询”为粒度同时生成智能体集合与协作工作流，并通过动态技能库实现执行反馈驱动的上下文改进。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS自动化设计方法多在任务级产出单一固定工作流，对整个基准统一套用；但现实中同一任务内查询难度差异大，真实负载还混合多种任务类型，该假设失效，因此需要查询级自适应设计。
AI.method: 提出OOPMAS，以面向对象方式定义智能体类（专属角色、工具与持久状态），协作工作流表达为可执行main函数；构建动态技能库，从多轮优化中的执行反馈累积结构化经验，实现无需梯度更新或微调的上下文改进。
AI.result: 在涵盖代码、数学、问答的混合任务基准上达到89.6%准确率，较最强基线提升18.1个百分点；跨四个LLM骨干的模型替换实验显示一致的可扩展性，最强模型达92.4%。
AI.conclusion: 查询级粒度、对象化智能体与可执行工作流的组合，加上免训练技能累积，是提升异构负载下MAS自动化设计效果的有效路径，且随底层模型能力提升而稳定增益。

title: Event Detection in Table Tennis Videos using 2D Keypoints
comment: Accepted at the 9th International ACM Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events: (1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center. A small keypoint transformer combines them into a compact representation that is robust to changes in viewpoint, lighting, and background clutter. (2) The temporal sequences of these frame-based representations are processed by a transformer encoder that predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, indicating how close the current frame is to the next and previous ball-racket contact. One novelty is a new, temporal cosine-like target signal. Furthermore, we introduce viewpoint augmentation via 3D reprojection and frame-rate augmentation to improve robustness and generalization. Our extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1 score of 91.16% and a mean frame deviation between ground truth and predicted frame of 0.42 on the Latte-MV dataset and 73.08% / 1.16 on the challenging TTHQ dataset. Overall, our work demonstrates that 2d keypoint-based temporal modeling with our EventNet architecture is a promising and practical approach for automatic event detection in table tennis videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EventNet，一个两阶段流水线，用于乒乓球视频中帧级精确的关键事件（球拍触球）检测。第一阶段提取球员上半身姿态、球台角点和球心的2D关键点，经由小型关键点Transformer融合成对视角、光照和背景杂波鲁棒的紧凑表示；第二阶段用Transformer编码器处理这些逐帧表示的时间序列，预测每帧的"到事件时间"值。核心创新包括类时间余弦目标信号、基于3D重投影的视角增强与帧率增强。在Latte-MV上取得F1 91.16%、平均帧偏差0.42，在TTHQ上取得73.08%/1.16。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D球轨迹与球旋转估计方法通常要求关键事件（如球拍触球）已被预先标注，因而难以应用于较长的未剪辑视频。本工作旨在实现自动、帧级精确的事件检测，摆脱对预先事件标注的依赖。
AI.method: 提出EventNet两阶段流水线：(1) 提取双方球员上半身姿态、球台角点和球心的2D关键点，通过小型关键点Transformer融合为对视角、光照和背景杂波鲁棒的紧凑表示；(2) 用Transformer编码器处理这些逐帧表示的时间序列，为每帧预测两个时间到事件值，表示当前帧距下一次和上一次球拍触球的接近程度。创新点包括新的类时间余弦目标信号、基于3D重投影的视角增强以及帧率增强。并进行了广泛的消融实验。
AI.result: 在Latte-MV数据集上F1为91.16%、真值与预测帧之间平均帧偏差为0.42；在更具挑战性的TTHQ数据集上为73.08%与1.16。消融实验揭示各架构与训练要素的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 基于2D关键点的时间建模配合EventNet架构，是乒乓球视频自动事件检测的一种有前景且实用的方法。

title: Event-Driven Proactive Robot Assistance through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Assistance in collaborative manipulation is often initiated by user instructions, making high-level reasoning request-driven. In fluent human teamwork, however, partners often infer the next helpful step from the observed outcome of an action rather than waiting for instructions. Motivated by this, we investigate an event-driven formulation of proactive assistance, where human--object interaction outcomes initiate assistive reasoning without user-provided task specifications at inference time. To this end, we propose an event-driven framework that monitors workspace state changes with an event monitor and, upon event completion, extracts stabilized pre/post snapshots that characterize the resulting state transition. A frozen pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) then uses its semantic priors to infer the task context, decide whether assistance is appropriate, and, when needed, generate a sequence of assistive actions from the observed transition. To make outputs executable and verifiable, we restrict actions to a set of action primitives and reference objects via integer IDs.We evaluate the same framework across three distinct real world tabletop collaboration tasks without task-specific training or fine-tuning. The event-driven framework achieves performance comparable to variants given user instructions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出事件驱动的主动辅助框架，以人-物交互结果而非用户指令触发推理，冻结VLM据状态转移推断任务并生成可执行动作，在三个真实桌面协作任务上性能与给定用户指令的变体相当。
AI.motivation: 协作操作中的辅助多由用户指令触发，属请求驱动的高层推理；但流畅的人类团队协作中，伙伴常从动作结果推断下一步有用行为，而非等待指令。为此作者研究事件驱动的主动辅助，由人-物交互结果在推理时无需用户任务规范即启动辅助推理。
AI.method: 提出事件驱动框架：事件监视器监控工作空间状态变化，事件完成后提取稳定的前后快照以刻画状态转移；冻结的预训练视觉语言模型利用语义先验推断任务上下文、判断辅助是否恰当，并在需要时据观测转移生成辅助动作序列；为保证输出可执行且可验证，将动作限制为动作原语集合，并以整数ID引用对象。
AI.result: 在三个不同的真实桌面协作任务上评估同一框架，不进行任务特定训练或微调；事件驱动框架取得的性能与给定用户指令的变体相当。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的主动辅助可在无任务特定训练、无推理时用户规范条件下，仅凭观测到的状态转移实现与指令驱动变体相当的辅助表现，支持从动作结果触发协作推理的可行性。

title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型（LLMs）中的错觉模式感知（illusory pattern perception），发现LLMs比人类更易在随机数据中虚构有意义的关联，并通过稀疏自编码器（SAEs）揭示其内在机制。
AI.motivation: 错觉模式感知是人类一种已知的认知倾向，即在随机数据中推断出有意义的关系（俗称"连接不存在的点"），会导致系统性推理错误。作者关心LLMs是否也表现出此类感知倾向，从而在下游应用中产生系统性错误，而这一问题此前尚未被系统探索。
AI.method: 将经典心理学范式适配到三项任务上，直接与人类行为进行实证对比；并基于稀疏自编码器（SAEs）构建特征可解释性框架，分析模型内部表征。
AI.result: LLMs普遍表现出比人类更强的错觉模式感知：模型倾向于过度将高频正面属性与多数群体或大型组织关联，并更易从模糊事件中构建因果叙事。SAE分析表明，整体频率感知与分析性认知取向与错觉感知的出现相关。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了LLMs中一种此前未被充分探索的、类认知的错觉现象，可能影响LLM推理的可靠性，为理解与提升模型推理可信度提供了新视角。

title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance
summary: Counter-UAV systems based on thermal infrared detection must stay accurate as operational datasets evolve, yet sequential fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of prior tasks, a problem that remains insufficiently characterized in this domain. This continual-learning study measures the stability-plasticity trade-off in YOLOMG, a YOLOv5-based detector run as a single thermal-infrared stream with the motion channel disabled, trained sequentially across three anti-UAV benchmarks of rising scale difficulty: Anti-UAV-RGBT, Anti-UAV410, and CST Anti-UAV. Naive fine-tuning on CST yields a Forgetting Measure of -0.605 against the Stage 1 ceiling, corresponding to a 90% capability loss, with -0.572 occurring in Stage 3 alone. In contrast, knowledge distillation from a frozen teacher is associated with FM = -0.033 +/- 0.004 across three seeds, corresponding to 95% retention. Because no Stage 2 no-KD control is included, this result establishes retention under KD training rather than a causal KD effect. Per-stratum analysis shows large-target detection collapsing to near zero within the first epoch, despite an inter-stage cosine similarity of 0.987 over the gradient-updated weights, pointing to scale-conditioned gradient imbalance, rather than weight drift, as a candidate mechanism. Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH), a 300-exemplar buffer balanced across four UAV size strata, roughly halves the forgetting (FM = -0.605 to -0.311) and keeps large-target detection non-zero. An ablation attributes the gain primarily to scale stratification rather than herding: random-stratified replay performs at least as well (FM = -0.221 versus -0.311 for SSH). These replay results are single-seed and should therefore be treated as preliminary.

AI.tldr: 本研究在热红外反无人机检测中量化了持续学习的稳定性-塑性权衡：朴素微调造成约90%能力损失（FM=-0.605），知识蒸馏可保持95%保留率（FM=-0.033），基于尺度分层的样本回放（SSH）可将遗忘减半，但消融显示增益主要来自尺度分层而非herding。
AI.motivation: 反无人机热红外检测系统需随运行数据集演进而保持精度，但序贯微调会导致对先前任务的灾难性遗忘，而该领域对此问题刻画不足。本文旨在度量热红外反无人机检测中持续学习的稳定性-塑性权衡，并探究缓解遗忘的机制。
AI.method: 以基于YOLOv5的YOLOMG为检测器，关闭运动通道、仅用单路热红外流，按难度递增顺序在三个反无人机基准（Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV）上序贯训练。对比朴素微调、冻结教师知识蒸馏（KD）、尺度分层herding（SSH，300样本缓冲、按四类UAV尺寸分层）及随机分层回放；用遗忘度量（FM）在三种子下评估，并进行逐层分析与消融。因未设Stage 2无KD对照，KD结果仅表明KD训练下的保留性，而非因果效应。
AI.result: 朴素微调在CST上相对Stage 1上限的FM=-0.605，对应90%能力损失，其中Stage 3单阶段即贡献-0.572。冻结教师KD在三种子下FM=-0.033±0.004，对应95%保留。逐层分析显示大目标检测在第一个epoch内即崩塌至近零，而梯度更新权重的阶段间余弦相似度达0.987，提示机制为尺度条件下的梯度失衡而非权重漂移。SSH将遗忘从-0.605降至-0.311并保持大目标检测非零；消融表明增益主要来自尺度分层而非herding，随机分层回放FM=-0.221，优于SSH的-0.311。回放结果为单种子，属初步结论。
AI.conclusion: 热红外反无人机检测中的序贯微调存在严重灾难性遗忘，知识蒸馏与样本回放均可有效缓解；遗忘的主要机制可能是尺度条件梯度失衡而非权重漂移，尺度分层是回放增益的关键因素，herding本身贡献有限。KD缺乏无KD对照、回放仅单种子，相关结论需谨慎对待。

title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"激活去噪的并行量化"，将上游量化误差建模为噪声并施加鲁棒性正则，在保持并行效率的同时逼近串行量化的精度，并以更一般的线性变换配合度量加权舍入扩展了正交旋转方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型训练后量化中，逐层并行量化可扩展性好，但误差会沿残差流逐层累积且无人校正；串行量化虽通过在前序层已量化输出上重新校准来抑制误差累积、精度更高，却受串行调度瓶颈限制，难以规模化。因此需要一种既保持并行、又能缓解误差累积的手段。
AI.method: 从鲁棒性视角出发，将上游误差视为噪声而非逐层重校准：对每层施加对噪声鲁棒的正则化，通过预处理步骤加度量加权舍入实现；该正则逐层叠加后形成随深度复合的平滑性惩罚，抑制量化误差在模型中的放大。此外，将权重乘以更一般的线性变换（不再要求如正交旋转那样保持模型函数），并发现该变换与鲁棒正则互补、效果可叠加。
AI.result: 实验中，该鲁棒正则化在单次并行量化过程中恢复了串行量化相当一部分的精度收益，而耗时仅为后者的一小部分；所引入的线性变换与正交旋转互补，二者效果可复合叠加。
AI.conclusion: 将复合量化误差视为鲁棒性问题，为大规模下更高效、更准确的LLM量化提供了有原则的理论基础。

title: How Much Planning Is Enough? Reducing Search and Computation in World-Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed control through decision-time action search, but their deployment efficiency is often limited by conservatively large planning budgets. We show that competitive task performance can be achieved without agreement with the Full-budget action, that sufficient budgets vary across model--task pairs, and that iterative planners repeatedly encode solve-invariant context. To address these inefficiencies, we propose {SufficientPlan}, a simple deployment framework that requires no modification to pretrained world models or planner updates. Its {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} component uses paired closed-loop evidence to search for and certify a reduced model--task-specific budget within a predefined Full-performance tolerance. Its {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} component caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions. Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks show that SufficientPlan substantially reduces search budgets and planning latency while maintaining competitive control performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SufficientPlan 部署框架，通过配对序贯预算认证（PSBC）寻找并认证模型-任务特定的缩减规划预算，同时用静态上下文复用（SCR）跨搜索迭代缓存观测与目标表示，从而在不修改预训练世界模型和规划器的前提下大幅降低搜索预算与规划延迟，并保持竞争力控制性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型通过决策时动作搜索实现目标导向控制，但其部署效率常受限于保守且偏大的规划预算。作者观察到三个可优化现象：无需与全预算动作一致也能取得竞争性任务性能；不同模型-任务配对所需的充分预算不同；迭代规划器反复编码求解不变的上下文。这些低效问题驱动了本文的框架设计。
AI.method: SufficientPlan 是一个无需修改预训练世界模型、也无需更新规划器的部署框架。其核心包含两个组件：1）配对序贯预算认证（PSBC）：利用配对的闭环证据，在预定义的“全性能容差”范围内搜索并认证一个缩减后的模型-任务特定预算；2）静态上下文复用（SCR）：在搜索迭代间缓存观测与目标表示，同时保留依赖候选的规划过程与最终选定的动作。
AI.result: 在多个世界模型骨干和视觉控制任务上的实验表明，SufficientPlan 显著降低了搜索预算和规划延迟，同时维持了具有竞争力的控制性能。
AI.conclusion: 规划预算存在可压缩空间，且充分预算随模型-任务配对变化；通过在部署阶段引入预算认证与上下文复用，可在不触碰预训练世界模型与规划器的情况下实现效率与性能的良好权衡。

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap.
