Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

AI.tldr: 当财务信息缺失时,大模型的投资建议会被"身份"大幅左右:披露信息越少,同一财务状况下不同身份画像的建议股票配置差异越大。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地向大语言模型咨询理财问题,却很少完整描述自身财务状况。论文关注这一"信息缺口":模型在财务证据不足时究竟依据什么给出建议,即身份(性别、家庭规模等画像信息)如何在缺乏财务事实时主导投资建议,以及这种偏差应在何种披露水平、以何种身份空间维度被审计。
AI.method: 固定财务状况,仅改变"投资者被描述为何种身份",将提示中的财务证据从8条事实递减至0条,测量建议股票配置的变化幅度。构建96,600条提示(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct),基于100份财务档案、138种身份画像与7种披露条件。采用双向聚类自助法(重复提示只计一次),报告比率与置信区间;分解身份对画像内建议变异的解释比例;检验各属性交互项在按画像聚类标准误后的显著性;并用线性探针与消融实验考察网络内部性别方向的可解码性。
AI.result: 同一财务状况下两个画像的平均建议差异从完整披露时的4.78个百分点升至无任何财务事实时的10.34个百分点;双向聚类自助法给出比率2.16(95%区间1.69–2.79),仅剩一条事实时已达1.69倍。身份在完整披露时解释画像内建议变异的5%,无披露时达96%。家庭规模是唯一随证据撤回而影响力稳定增长的属性。按画像聚类标准误后,会议版本中多数属性特定交互项失去显著性,性别转而表现为完整披露也无法消除的小额长期差距。仅声明风险偏好即可产生相当于2–7条通用事实的摆动幅度。无事实时,模型一句话理由中提及从未被告知的收入、债务与储蓄,且这些虚构财务对大家庭更常趋于不利。网络内部各层性别均可线性解码,但在五层消融性别方向后,总体身份摆动不变。
AI.conclusion: 基于此类模型的咨询系统应当在用户实际可能达到的披露水平上进行审计,并跨整个身份空间而非逐个属性评估;身份效应在缺信息时被显著放大,且难以通过单方向消融消除。

authors: Heyam Bin Jahlan Areej Alhothali Abeer Alhothali
title: Transferable Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack on Black-Box Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: The rapid integration of Vision Language Models (VLMs) into sensitive systems introduces critical safety vulnerabilities that remain unexplored in exist studies. While adversarial attack robustness has been extensively studied for image-based models, the susceptibility of VLMs to temporally-aware adversarial attacks against video in driving context poses a distinct and under examined threat. In this paper, we introduce novel adversarial attack against video targeting VLM models used for autonomous driving scenes named Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack (STCA). Our attack comprise from three stages: modalities expansion, Spatial attack, and STCA attack. In modalities expansion, we propose caption-guided frame selection method in order to ensure that adversarial perturbation target the most semantically significant frames. Secondly.In spatial attack, we craft effective perturbation and preserve high similarity. Then the perturbed video generated fed into STCA stage that disrupt cross-frame temporal coherence using motion guided mask. Our method operate under black box threat model against victim target VLMs, relying solely on transferability from white-box surrogate model.We conduct our experiments on the BDD100K and nuScenes autonomous driving datasets across three VLM models: Video LLaVA-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Dolphin. Experimental results demonstrate spatial attack achieves an ASR with high SSIM. Our finding reveal that existing video language model, remain highly susceptible to adversarial attack in autonomous driving scenarios, underscoring the urgent need for robust defense for VLM models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向自动驾驶视频VLM的时空一致性对抗攻击STCA，通过模态扩展、空间攻击与时空一致性攻击三阶段，在黑盒迁移设定下显著提升攻击成功率，揭示现有视频语言模型的安全脆弱性。
AI.motivation: VLM正快速融入敏感系统，但现有研究多聚焦图像模型的对抗鲁棒性，忽视了驾驶场景下视频VLM面对时间感知对抗攻击的脆弱性，这一威胁尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出STCA攻击，含三阶段：模态扩展（基于caption引导的帧选择，锁定语义关键帧）、空间攻击（生成扰动同时保持高相似度）、STCA攻击（利用运动引导掩码破坏跨帧时间一致性）。整体在黑盒威胁模型下，仅依赖白盒代理模型的迁移性攻击受害者VLM。
AI.result: 在BDD100K与nuScenes自动驾驶数据集上，针对Video LLaVA-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Dolphin三个模型实验。空间攻击在保持高SSIM的同时取得较高ASR，表明现有视频语言模型在自动驾驶场景下仍高度易受对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频语言模型在自动驾驶场景中对对抗攻击高度脆弱，凸显为VLM构建鲁棒防御的迫切需求。

title: Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator
comment: 50 pages (19 main text and references, 31 Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过数值案例表明，波基4f光学处理器上运行的混合Fourier神经算子，其最坏器件误差远大于随机采样器件的最大误差，随机测试只能估计超阈概率，而最坏器件搜索能给出误差上界下界。
AI.motivation: 波基处理器有潜力为神经算子提供快速、节能的Fourier层，但现有验证多基于随机采样器件，无法回答在制造与对准偏差下误差可能达到多大（即最坏情况）。作者希望揭示随机测试的局限，并量化实际最坏器件误差。
AI.method: 采用风格化数值案例：混合Fourier神经算子将四个谱层部署在仿真的相干4f处理器上，含32个带容差的旋钮（半宽为代表性值而非标定值）。对120个模型（4任务×6训练方法×5随机种子），在确定性仿真器上固定一次随机静态误差抽样，比较搜索得到的最坏器件与N个随机合格器件的最大误差；并用20次新静态抽样、均匀/Sobol'采样、共享旋钮、第二串扰模型、0.25–2的盒尺度及像素级器件模型做稳健性检验。
AI.result: 搜索器件的留出误差为200个Monte Carlo器件最大值的1.08–3.10倍、1000个的1.06–2.71倍；20次新抽样中120个模型有116个仍超过200个随机器件最大值。均匀采样下抽到该器件的概率每模型至多0.37%（双侧95% Clopper-Pearson）。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上误差达标称的3.7–39.9倍；用随机与梯度搜索器件微调在全部20个任务-种子对中给出六种方法里最低的搜索误差。对两个热交换器量，针对性搜索在全部39个模型中均超过1000个随机器件的最坏值，故也超过Wilks 95/95界限（59个的最坏值）；对11个模型的平均压力，无随机器件超过1%误差阈值，而搜索器件超过。
AI.conclusion: 随机测试只能估计误差超过阈值的频率，无法表征误差可达多大；最坏器件搜索给出误差规模的下界。因此波基Fourier层的可靠性评估必须结合最坏器件搜索，且训练/微调应纳入搜索器件以降低最坏误差。

title: From Legs to Wheels: Embodiment-Aware Human Motion Retargeting for Mobile-Base Humanoids
summary: Human video offers a scalable source of robot demonstrations, yet most human-to-humanoid retargeting methods assume a legged robot with human-like kinematics. This assumption does not hold for mobile-base humanoids equipped with a wheeled base, vertical lift, and two arms. Human walking must be expressed through base motion, while torso bending may require coordinated lift and arm motion. We address this mismatch with a task-conditioned framework that assigns reconstructed human motion to base, lift, and arm responsibilities before robot-specific realization. The allocator preserves the human-derived path, stabilizes heading, separates turn and translation when needed, retimes commands to satisfy base limits, and repairs lift and arm trajectories. A deployment adapter then converts the reference to 50 Hz commands using stationary-base detection, deadband and slew-rate filtering, time-consistent playback scaling, and separate linear and angular gains. We evaluate the resulting references with human-derived task-space comparisons, policy-free simulation replay, and a qualitative execution on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: 该文针对带轮式底盘、升降柱与双臂的移动基座人形机器人，提出任务条件化的人类动作重定向框架，将重建的人体运动分配给底盘、升降与手臂，并通过部署适配器转为50 Hz指令。
AI.motivation: 人类视频是可扩展的机器人示教来源，但现有人到人形重定向方法多假设机器人具有类人腿式运动学，不适用于轮式底盘+升降+双臂的移动基座人形机器人——人类行走须由底盘运动表达，躯干弯曲可能需升降与手臂协同。
AI.method: 任务条件化框架：在机器人特定实现前，将重建的人体运动分配给底盘、升降与手臂职责。分配器保留人体路径、稳定朝向、必要时分离转向与平移、按底盘限制重定时指令，并修复升降与手臂轨迹；部署适配器通过静止底盘检测、死区与压摆率滤波、时间一致回放缩放、分离的线性与角增益，将参考转为50 Hz指令。
AI.result: 通过人体派生任务空间对比、无策略仿真回放，以及在实体机器人上的定性执行进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 该任务条件化分配与部署适配方法能桥接人类视频运动与轮式移动基座人形机器人的运动学不匹配，生成可部署的50 Hz参考指令。

title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的测试时融合框架 ThinkFuse，通过对比段级不确定性变化与轨迹级不确定性趋势，选择性干预不可靠推理片段，融合辅助推理路径，在数学与知识密集型推理任务上超越基线且更高效。
AI.motivation: 小型推理模型（SRMs）虽能通过长链式思维（CoT）在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但一旦推理进入错误路径便难以自我纠正；现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号决定触发时机，易受瞬时不确定性波动误导，反而强化不稳定的推理轨迹。
AI.method: ThinkFuse 是一个免训练（training-free）的测试时融合框架。它比较段级（segment-level）不确定性变化与轨迹级（trajectory-level）不确定性趋势，以识别不稳定推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合进主模型的推理轨迹中，实现选择性干预。
AI.result: 在数学与知识密集型推理基准上优于基线，在不同模型族组合下均取得稳定增益；即使使用更小的主模型仍保持鲁棒性。分析显示其融合触发次数更少、生成 token 更少，体现选择性触发的高效性。
AI.conclusion: ThinkFuse 通过全局趋势与局部变化的对比实现选择性测试时融合，有效纠正 SRMs 的错误推理路径，兼顾性能与效率，为免训练测试时增强提供了新思路。

title: Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
summary: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DT-R2S2R（数字孪生驱动的Real2Sim2Real）数据生成流程，用数字孪生重建自动驾驶场景并条件化扩散模型，无需目标区域真实图像即可合成照片级驾驶数据，在3D检测任务上接近甚至超越目标域真实数据训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 相机3D感知依赖大规模标注数据，向新目标区域部署需重新采集与标注，成本高。现有生成式增强存在两难：标签条件方法需要它本要替代的标注；仿真器条件方法虽有免费标注却缺乏对特定真实环境的视觉 grounding。
AI.method: 构建地理配准的数字孪生（DT-R2S），在孪生中重建真实驾驶片段；以几何对齐的仿真器渲染为条件训练扩散模型，得到数字孪生grounded的Sim2Real模型（DT-S2R）；在孪生覆盖范围内的已重建场景与新颖仿真场景中，基于低成本但地理配准的仿真数据合成照片级驾驶图像，用于训练多样3D检测器。
AI.result: 在多个3D检测器上验证生成数据有效性；DETR3D在完全不使用目标区域图像训练的情况下，达到目标区域真实数据oracle mAP的93.18%；与现有目标域外真实数据简单协同训练甚至超过该oracle。
AI.conclusion: DT-R2S2R可在有数字孪生覆盖的区域显著降低人工现场采集与标注成本，为3D感知规模化提供实用基础。

title: Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models
summary: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文指出JEPA式世界模型中"下一步预测+防坍缩正则"不能保证保留可控不稳定模态，为此引入逆动力学（动作重构）损失，从理论与实验上证明其可学习到"控制感知"的表示。
AI.motivation: 机器人系统存在不稳定模态，微小扰动若无反馈纠正会无界增长；从高维视觉观测中控制此类系统，需要能保留这些模态的表示。虽然JEPA能联合嵌入地学习表示与动力学，但作者发现常规训练目标可能导致关键可控不稳定模态被坍缩，从而使基于该表示的镇定变得不可能。因此需要一种机制，保证学习到的视觉表示保留对控制至关重要的特征。
AI.method: 在世界模型训练中增加动作重构目标（逆动力学损失），以促使表示具备控制感知性。理论层面在�线性系统上证明：精确动作重构使编码器在有限时域可达子空间上为单射，即编码器不会丢弃任何在H步内可由动作序列到达的状态方向；并证明随时域H增大，有限时域可控性Gramian的主特征子空间收敛于可控不稳定子空间。实验层面在非线性视觉控制任务（CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze）上验证结论的推广性。
AI.result: 理论证明了动作重构→编码器在有限时域可达子空间上单射，以及可控性Gramian主特征子空间随H收敛到可控不稳定子空间；实验显示该类控制感知表示学习在CartPole、Walker2D和PointMaze上带来收益，表明线性理论结论可推广到非线性视觉控制任务。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠下一步预测与防坍缩正则不足以保证保留可控不稳定模态；加入逆动力学（动作重构）损失可获得控制感知表示，从而在理论上保证不丢失可达状态方向，并在实际非线性视觉控制任务中提升控制性能。

title: Post-Grasp Kinematic Repair for Robotic Insertion via Object-in-Gripper Reorientation
summary: A stable grasp does not guarantee kinematically feasible robotic insertion because the object-in-gripper transform may force the robot towards singularities or joint limits along the prescribed insertion path. We study post-grasp kinematic feasibility repair through object-in-gripper reorientation. Given an achieved grasp and a fixed insertion path, we seek a small reorientation that restores kinematic feasibility. Sequential IK can miss such candidates by following an unfavorable joint-space path, while the nonsmooth feasibility landscape makes the search computationally expensive. We evaluate candidates using a branch-aware IK graph that maximizes the minimum feasibility margin over the discretized insertion path and use a learned task-conditioned prior to improve query ordering. The selected reorientation is executed through tactile-based extrinsic manipulation. In UR5e simulations, the planner without learned ranking reduces mean reorientation over successful trials by 51.5% compared with grid-based sequential IK. Adding learned ranking reduces this planner's mean planning time by an additional 51.1%. Real-robot experiments validate the complete pipeline.

AI.tldr: 针对稳定抓取后仍可能因物体-夹爪位姿导致插入路径运动学不可行的问题，提出通过重定向物体-夹爪位姿来修复抓取后运动学可行性。
AI.motivation: 稳定抓取并不保证机器人插入操作在运动学上可行，物体-夹爪变换可能使机器人在预定插入路径上接近奇异位形或关节极限。
AI.method: 将问题建模为在已实现抓取和固定插入路径下寻找小幅重定向以恢复运动学可行性；采用分支感知IK图评估候选，最大化离散化插入路径上的最小可行性裕度，并引入学习到的任务条件先验优化查询顺序；选定重定向通过基于触觉的外部位姿操作执行。
AI.result: 在UR5e仿真中，未使用学习排序的规划器相比基于网格的顺序IK，将成功试验的平均重定向减少51.5%；加入学习排序后，规划器平均规划时间进一步减少51.1%。真实机器人实验验证了完整流程。
AI.conclusion: 通过物体-夹爪重定向可有效修复抓取后的运动学可行性，分支感知IK图与学习排序显著提升规划效率，触觉外部位姿操作用于执行重定向，并在仿真与真实机器人上得到验证。

title: DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models
summary: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DIPrune，一种面向多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的无训练剪枝框架，通过将剪枝重表述为任务损失扰动最小化问题并引入层间动态语义演化评分，缓解了现有方法因任务无关设计和不可靠注意力估计导致的语义退化，在LLaVA与Qwen-VL上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs无训练剪枝方法依赖视觉冗余或文本-视觉注意力来降低计算开销，但因任务无关设计或注意力估计不可靠，常导致语义退化。作者经实证分析发现，其根源在于浅层显著token通过数值惯性持续压制新出现的语义token，使深层推理所需信号被过早丢弃。
AI.method: 从任务导向角度，首先将无训练剪枝重表述为最终任务损失扰动的最小化问题，并推导出可处理的逐token上界作为代理目标；该表述揭示了一个此前被忽略的、刻画跨层梯度的层间项。基于此提出DIPrune——一种基于排序的框架，采用双重重要性评分机制，联合优化层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化。
AI.result: 在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上的大量实验表明，DIPrune持续取得最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将无训练剪枝纳入任务损失扰动最小化框架并显式建模层间语义演化，DIPrune有效缓解了浅层显著token的数值惯性压制问题，验证了任务导向、双重评分设计在MLLM剪枝中的有效性。

title: Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization
comment: This paper has been accepted in ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing (MobiHoc) 2026
summary: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于基础模型（FM）的actor-critic算法，嵌入共识式去中心化多智能体强化学习（MARL）架构，用于提升随机接入（RA）网络优化中MARL的收敛速度，并给出其收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 随机接入（RA）是处理多终端不可预测流量的基础MAC层调度方案。MARL虽可用于优化RA无线网络，但其依赖经验驱动的分布式策略学习，每个优化任务都需大量训练开销，限制了实际部署可行性。
AI.method: 设计FM辅助的actor-critic算法，嵌入基于共识的去中心化MARL架构；在局部奖励交换与非线性值函数近似条件下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 收敛性分析表明，所提算法达到与传统MARL（采用critic模型交换与线性近似）相同的收敛阶。数值结果表明，基于FM的方法显著提升了RA网络优化中MARL的训练速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用基础模型可有效提高MARL在多样化RA网络优化任务中的效率，在保持理论收敛保证的同时显著加速训练，提升其实用性。

title: MIM-VLA: Learning Physical Interaction Representations from Gripper Motor Feedback
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Jaeyoung Lee and Jiyeon Koo contributed equally
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies infer grasp actions primarily from visual observations and robot state, but do not explicitly represent the physical response observed after contact. We present MIM-VLA, a motor-feedback-based architecture that encodes recent gripper current, position, velocity, and signal validity as a 128-dimensional interaction token. A motor-only Motor Interaction Module (MIM) is pretrained with human-reviewed contact and interaction-phase labels and then conditions only the gripper-action pathway of SmolVLA; arm actions and the position-control interface remain unchanged. The same token supports the MEM selector VLM that compares candidate interactions and produces evidence-conditioned selections and explanations. We evaluate MIM-VLA in three real-world settings: comparing the interaction resistance of visually different objects, disambiguating visually similar real and replica objects through active probing, and gently grasping fragile objects, including held-out instances. Across 13 object pairs, MIM-VLA selects the higher-resistance object in 75.0% of trials, compared with 48.8% for the SmolVLA baseline. For the evaluated tasks, the approach uses motor feedback already available from the gripper and does not require an additional tactile array, force-torque sensor, calibrated force estimate, or direct current control.

AI.tldr: 提出 MIM-VLA，利用夹具电机反馈（电流、位置、速度、信号有效性）构建128维交互token，仅调节SmolVLA的夹爪动作通路，在真实场景中实现物体阻力比较、相似物辨识与脆弱物体轻抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略主要依赖视觉观测与机器人状态推断抓取动作，缺乏对接触后物理响应（如阻力、刚度）的显式表征，导致在视觉相似或需力感知的任务上表现受限。
AI.method: 将近期夹具电流、位置、速度与信号有效性编码为128维交互token；用人工审核的接触与交互阶段标签预训练纯电机交互模块（MIM）；以该token仅条件化SmolVLA的夹爪动作分支，手臂动作与位置控制接口保持不变；同一token驱动MEM选择器VLM，对候选交互进行比较并给出带证据的选择与解释。
AI.result: 在三类真实场景中评估：视觉差异物体的交互阻力比较、通过主动探测区分外观相似的实物与仿制品、脆弱物体的轻柔抓取（含未见实例）。13对物体中，MIM-VLA在75.0%的试验中选择阻力更大的物体，SmolVLA基线为48.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在评估任务中，该方法仅使用夹具已有的电机反馈，无需额外触觉阵列、力/力矩传感器、标定力估计或直接电流控制，即可显式引入接触后物理响应信息，提升力敏感抓取决策能力。

title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
summary: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic SemS闭环语义感知框架，在通信可行配置集内动态控制感知配置与时长，通过因果Transformer、KV缓存与语义效用网络联合实现下一配置选择与语义早退，降低感知成本并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 现有语义感知（SemS）多为开环设定：感知配置与观测调度在推断前固定，无法随任务级证据演化而调整，导致资源利用不优；需要在AI-RAN的通信约束下实现闭环、任务驱动的感知控制。
AI.method: 提出Agentic SemS闭环框架：1）配置条件因果Transformer从流式观测更新语义信念；2）KV缓存支持跨配置变化的高效状态更新，避免重复处理完整历史；3）语义效用网络在扣除感知代价后估计各可行配置下获取下一观测块的任务级收益；4）由continuation utility联合支持下一配置选择与语义早退；5）将期望语义增益与条件互信息关联，给出继续在线感知的信息价值解释。
AI.result: 在Widar3.0上以六种仿真感知配置实验：相比全序列High，资源高效的Agentic设定将归一化累计感知成本降低25.33%，同时达到85.79% Macro-F1；在相同效用检查点下，语义早退相较无早退的自适应感知再降低12.35%成本，Macro-F1仅下降0.97个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 闭环、效用驱动的Agentic SemS可在通信可行约束下自适应感知配置与时长，在显著降低感知成本的同时保持较高任务精度，并且其继续感知决策具有条件互信息/信息价值层面的理论解释。

title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolarScale 基准，将全 Stokes 偏振重建中缺失的辐射尺度作为显式预测与评估目标，系统评测了七种骨干模型与三种预测策略在尺度估计、物理约束与下游任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有从类 RGB 输入推断偏振的方法仅预测归一化 Stokes 分量或相对描述符，辐射尺度被约分掉，导致无法进行完整 Stokes 重建；该尺度此前未被作为显式预测和评估目标，缺乏统一基准。
AI.method: 基于已有的三色全 Stokes 测量构建 PolarScale 基准，以逐场景归一化总强度图像 s0（场景参考线性图像，非消费级 sRGB 照片）为输入，要求模型预测归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 及逐场景尺度；由于尺度已从输入中约去而物理上不可辨识，因此采用数据集条件下的语义尺度估计，并与常数尺度对照进行对比评估，同时引入角度、自一致性与物理边界指标；在七种复原类与生成类骨干、三种预测策略上评测，并设置显式描述符监督实验。
AI.result: 最强复原模型尺度估计平均相对误差为 3.6-4.3%，优于常数对照的 5.7%，物理边界违例像素少于 0.25%；两个生成式基线尺度坍缩至近零；显式描述符监督提升描述符精度（MAE 下 23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR）。预测的全 Stokes 表示改进漫反射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但漫反射/镜面分离中学习尺度仅与常数对照持平。
AI.conclusion: PolarScale 确立了辐射尺度作为偏振重建的显式预测与评估目标，表明复原类模型可较好估计该语义尺度并提升多项下游任务，而生成式模型存在尺度坍缩问题，且尺度学习在部分任务上尚未超越常数对照，揭示了该方向的局限与改进空间。

title: Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning
summary: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出GRADE数据为中心框架，通过状态感知样本选择器和自校准步级门控控制进入LoRA子空间的梯度，解决梯度冲突、静态选样和子空间饱和问题，在七数据集、三骨干上稳定超越LoRA及强基线。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调在低秩子空间内适配异构指令数据，存在三类结构性问题：梯度冲突相互抵消、静态数据选择无法跟踪学习动态变化、子空间饱和导致后续更新覆盖有用方向。作者认为有效适配需控制哪些由数据诱导的梯度进入LoRA子空间以及进入时机。
AI.method: GRADE（GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe）包含两个机制：一是状态感知选择器（state-aware selector），持续接纳与演化中的多任务梯度场对齐的样本；二是自校准步级门控（self-calibrating step-level gate），拒绝在接近饱和时可能引发破坏性覆盖的更新。
AI.result: 在三个当代骨干模型与异构的七数据集指令池上，GRADE在准确率和鲁棒性上优于强数据选择与PEFT稳定化基线；是唯一在每个架构上都稳定优于标准LoRA的方法，并产生更连贯的梯度轨迹与更少的破坏性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: SLM适配的成功不仅取决于选择哪些数据，也取决于允许哪些梯度进入并在受限更新子空间中持续存在，即数据选择与梯度门控需协同设计。

title: Safe Multi-Robot Collaborative Transport Using Density Functions
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical density-based model predictive control framework for safe collaborative manipulation by multiple quadrupedal robots. The framework enables a team of robots to push a shared object to a desired pose using only the initial and goal poses, without requiring a precomputed reference trajectory. A centralized box-level MPC optimizes contact forces while enforcing a control-density constraint for goal convergence and obstacle avoidance. Each robot then solves its own distributed robot-level whole-body MPC, under a stated shared-information assumption, to track its moving contact location while accounting for static obstacles and the time-varying positions of neighboring robots. The approach is evaluated in MuJoCo using whole-body contact dynamics for two and three Unitree Go2 quadrupeds collaboratively pushing rigid objects through narrow passages. Comparisons with matched Control Barrier Function and RRT* based tracking baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed density-based formulation for push-only, force- and torque-coupled manipulation tasks. Implementation videos are available at https://jaggu2606.github.io/go2-density-mpc-pushing/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层密度模型预测控制框架，使多台四足机器人无需预计算参考轨迹，仅依据初始与目标位姿即可协同推动共享物体，并在MuJoCo仿真中对两台和两台以上Unitree Go2进行验证。
AI.motivation: 多足机器人协同推物任务需要同时处理接触力协调、目标收敛与避障问题，传统方法依赖预先计算的参考轨迹，难以应对狭窄通道等复杂场景，因此需要一种无需参考轨迹的安全协同操纵方法。
AI.method: 采用分层密度模型预测控制框架：上层集中式box-level MPC优化接触力，并施加控制密度约束以保证目标收敛与避障；下层每台机器人求解分布式robot-level全身MPC，在共享信息假设下跟踪其移动接触点，同时考虑静态障碍物与邻居机器人的时变位置。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中基于全身接触动力学，让两台和三台Unitree Go2四足机器人协同推刚性物体穿越狭窄通道。与控制屏障函数（CBF）及RRT*跟踪基线相比，所提出的密度形式在仅推、力与力矩耦合的操纵任务中表现更有效。
AI.conclusion: 密度模型预测控制框架能够在无需预计算参考轨迹的条件下实现多四足机器人安全协同推物，且优于CBF和RRT*基线方法，适用于复杂狭窄环境中的力-力矩耦合操纵任务。

title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DHCG框架，将多智能体系统设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，通过Planner、Worker、Generator三模块动态构建分层协作图，并引入动作感知偏好优化训练Planner，在多个推理基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统编排方法存在组合方式受限、依赖关系错位、规模不灵活等问题，难以在执行过程中根据推理需求自适应调整，因此需要一种能在执行中动态确定智能体组成与规模的机制。
AI.method: 将MAS设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，动态决定系统组成与规模；提出DHCG框架，协调Planner、Worker、Generator三个模块，基于查询和演化中的执行反馈从零逐步构建动态分层协作图。Planner在每步根据反馈生成一组互补角色并按需将相关信息路由到各角色，可提前终止或逐步扩展协作图；同时引入动作感知偏好优化来训练Planner。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理和领域特定推理基准上进行系统评估，DHCG在对比方法中取得最优平均性能，较单智能体基线提升13.06分，优于静态和动态MAS基线2.77–8.02分；额外实验表明其在不同Planner骨干和未见Worker模型上具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DHCG通过动态构建分层协作图并优化Planner决策，有效克服了现有MAS在组合、依赖与规模上的局限，在多种推理任务上达到领先水平并具备良好泛化性。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 QuAR，一种无需反向传播、不更新模型参数的单次前向 TTA 方法，通过在冻结量化器输入处重校准激活以对齐源校准统计，在量化 ViT 的分布偏移下恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化使 ViT 适配边缘设备的算力与内存预算，但量化模型在分布偏移下尤为脆弱。现有 TTA 方法多依赖反向传播或额外前向/参数更新，开销大，且轻量级特征/逻辑层方法只能部分恢复精度。更关键的是，一个量化特有的失效模式未被直接针对：偏移下激活在冻结量化器已校准区间内的分布发生变化，导致码分布失真，进一步放大精度下降。
AI.method: 提出 Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR)，一种面向量化 ViT 的单次（single-pass）TTA 方法，既不反向传播也不更新任何模型参数。其核心是在冻结量化器的输入端重校准激活，将测试流的运行逐通道统计量映射回源校准统计，从而缓解逐通道错配、恢复码分布。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-C、ViT-B 上，QuAR 在 3/4/6/8 比特权重-激活精度下取得无反向传播 TTA 方法中最高的平均精度：8 比特时超出最强基线 2.28 个百分点，3 比特时超出 4.00 个百分点；延迟降低 46%，内存开销仅 0.17 MB（峰值推理内存的 0.01%）。诊断分析表明增益源自量化器处逐通道错配的降低。单一固定配置在连续流、非独立同分布标签偏移、七个 OOD 套件及三种其他骨干网络上均保持领先。
AI.conclusion: QuAR 通过对齐量化器输入端的激活统计，直接针对量化特有的码分布失真问题，在无反向传播、无参数更新、极低内存与延迟开销的约束下显著优于现有无反向传播 TTA 方法，且具备良好的泛化性与稳定性。

title: Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows
summary: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出全局传输（Global Transport, GT）——一种与类别无关的最优传输耦合，在无分类器引导（CFG）下能一致地提升条件图像生成性能，并指出条件流的耦合设计应在有引导流下评估。
AI.motivation: 最优传输耦合已被证明能降低无条件流模型的训练方差，但其在条件生成中的作用尚不明确。为每个条件分别构造耦合在现代图像基础模型的大规模或连续条件空间中不可行，因此需要一种可扩展的耦合设计。
AI.method: 提出Global Transport（GT）：一种全局的、类别无关的最优传输耦合，计算时无需类别标签。GT可让不同条件关联到源噪声的不同区域，从而在无引导时反而降低性能；但与分类器引导（CFG）结合使用时，效果显著提升。研究在离散类别与连续文本两种条件、多种模型规模、以及模型规模和采样预算变化下对GT进行评估，并分析耦合选择如何改变引导轨迹。
AI.result: GT在无引导条件下会因条件与源噪声区域绑定而恶化性能；但在与CFG结合时，GT在离散类别和连续文本条件图像生成中、跨模型规模与采样预算均一致提升生成质量。性能反转表明耦合选择在引导流下才体现优势。
AI.conclusion: 条件流的耦合应在推理时所用的有引导流下，结合经验与理论进行评估，而非仅基于无引导生成。耦合设计因此成为引导流设置下一个简单的训练时改进轴，无需修改现有架构、采样器或引导机制即可提升性能。

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 RA-MoWE 框架：利用"工作流亲和度嵌入"对查询聚类，生成可复用的专家工作流，并用编码器预测嵌入以在推理时选择专家，兼顾个性化与优化成本。
AI.motivation: 面向整个任务集合优化的单一工作流会忽略单个查询所需推理策略的差异；而针对每个查询单独搜索新工作流又会重复昂贵的优化过程。因此需要在"全局通用"与"逐查询定制"之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 用一组固定参考工作流对查询求解，得到"工作流亲和度嵌入"，记录哪种推理策略对该查询有效，据此聚类查询；2) 以每个簇的查询及平均嵌入来初始化并借助执行反馈迭代精炼出专用工作流（专家）；3) 训练嵌入编码器，从查询文本直接预测该嵌入，使新查询无需先执行参考工作流即可选择对应专家。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、科学、编程四个基准的 300 条查询测试集上，相比在参考工作流中选择，RA-MoWE 平均任务得分提升 4.04 个百分点，同时推理阶段语言模型调用次数减少 27.7%。
AI.conclusion: RA-MoWE 通过亲和度嵌入聚类与嵌入预测，实现了可复用专家工作流的生成与低成本选择，在提升任务性能的同时显著降低推理开销，验证了"聚类—定制—可预测选择"路线的有效性。

title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Image-Based Visualization Reading
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material. Accepted by the VISxGenAI workshop at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Stevens幂律引入AI模型可视化阅读能力的测量，通过无图例的相对量级估计任务评估十二种视觉变量，使算法模型的视觉编码感知可量化、可与人类比较并更易解释。
AI.motivation: AI模型已广泛用于图表理解，但其"先天"感知机制（尤其是对视觉编码的心理物理特性）尚不清晰；缺乏可量化、可与人类感知对照的评估手段，导致模型的可解释性不足。
AI.method: 借鉴心理物理学中的Stevens幂律作为测量框架。被试为算法模型，实验中不提供图例：模型先观看参考视觉表示并估计其量级，再对同一表示的后续图像相对于该参考进行量级估计。该范式覆盖十二种视觉变量（visual variables）。
AI.result: 在十二种视觉变量上完成了对算法模型读数行为的评估，得到可测量的幂律参数化结果，从而能够将模型的视觉编码阅读能力与人类感知进行直接对比。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使算法模型如何阅读视觉编码变得可测量、可比且更易为人类所解释，为揭示模型内建的感知机制提供了新途径。

title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.tldr: TAFFY是一种表格基础模型，通过上下文多样性先验与任务条件循环Transformer增强从上下文中推断任务特定预测关系的能力，在6个分类和5个回归基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的性能主要取决于模型能否在推理时从可用上下文中推断出任务特定的预测关系。现有方法在上下文推断能力上仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出TAFFY，包含两个核心组件：(1) In-Context Diversity Prior：通过在共享因果过程上施加受控干预与分布偏移，构建多个相关环境来采样合成预训练上下文，形成上下文内多样性以学习更全面的任务特定表征；(2) Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer：迭代且选择性地复用一组共享Transformer块来精炼上下文表征，并用任务条件门控调制最终隐状态更新，实现任务自适应的迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在6个分类和5个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY取得最低平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 上下文多样性与任务条件循环精炼机制相互配合，使模型能从上下文对比中识别预测关系，并为每个任务动态调制上下文整合，验证了该设计在表格基础模型上的有效性。

title: Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part I: Methodology
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) have significantly advanced in real-world deployment in recent years, yet safety continues to be a critical barrier to widespread adoption. Traditional functional safety approaches, which primarily verify the reliability, robustness, and adequacy of AV hardware and software systems from a vehicle-centric perspective, do not sufficiently address the AV's broader interactions and behavioral impact on the surrounding traffic environment. To overcome this limitation, we propose a paradigm shift toward behavioral safety, a comprehensive approach focused on evaluating AV responses and interactions within the traffic environment. To systematically assess behavioral safety, we introduce a third-party AV safety assessment framework comprising two complementary evaluation components: the Behavioral Competency Test and the Driving Intelligence Test. The Behavioral Competency Test evaluates the AV's reactive behaviors under controlled scenarios, ensuring basic behavioral competency. In contrast, the Driving Intelligence Test assesses the AV's interactive behaviors within naturalistic traffic conditions, quantifying the frequency of safety-critical events to deliver statistically meaningful safety metrics before large-scale deployment. In Part II of this study, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS) is tested to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 论文提出从传统"功能安全"转向"行为安全"的范式，构建由行为能力测试与驾驶智能测试组成的第三方AV安全评估框架。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶汽车虽加速落地，但安全仍是其普及的关键障碍。传统功能安全方法以车辆为中心，仅验证AV软硬件的可靠性、鲁棒性与充分性，无法充分刻画AV与周边交通环境的交互及其行为影响，因此需要新的安全评估范式。
AI.method: 提出以评估AV在交通环境中响应与交互为核心的行为安全范式，并设计第三方AV安全评估框架，包含两个互补组件：行为能力测试（Behavioral Competency Test）在受控场景下评估AV的被动/反应性行为，确保基本行为胜任力；驾驶智能测试（Driving Intelligence Test）在自然交通条件下评估AV的交互行为，量化安全关键事件发生频率，从而在大规模部署前给出具有统计意义的安全指标。
AI.result: 作为研究第二部分，使用一个开源L4级自动驾驶系统（ADS）对所提方法进行测试，以验证该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 行为安全评估为AV安全提供了以交通环境交互为中心的新视角，第三方框架兼顾受控场景下的基础能力验证与自然工况下的统计安全度量，有望在大规模部署前系统评估AV安全水平。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps 是一个多智能体工作流编排框架，通过从历史工作流中学习智能体协作先验，并按需扩展智能体池，提升复杂知识任务的端到端通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统的编排层大多是无记忆的：每个新任务都从零开始分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功执行的经验。
AI.method: 提出三个耦合机制：(1) 转移概率矩阵，从历史工作流中统计智能体成对协作频率，并通过层内排序优化、概率阈值化边建议和传递约简作为软引导构建 DAG 工作流；(2) 充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，通过语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，用 LLM 生成专用智能体并同步注入协作矩阵；(3) 分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句嵌入做快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信度情况调用 LLM 验证。
AI.result: 在代码、数学和问答混合测试集上，WorkflowOps 的端到端通过率优于近期工作流构建基线；在结构化、可分解且历史智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上增益最大；相比纯 LLM 路由方法，LLM 路由调用减少超过 80%。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史协作先验并进行按需智能体扩展，可有效改进多智能体工作流编排的效率与效果。

title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 UniCounting，将固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数建模为过完备提案集上的实例感知结构推断，仅训练一个 3267 参数的关系头即可在 COCO clean500 上优于校准的 OWLv2-All80。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数通常只针对单一指定目标，需要图像特定的示例、文本查询或目标类别，且只输出一个计数。论文转而研究固定词表、免图像查询的多类别计数：每次运行固定一个全局词表，模型仅凭一张 RGB 图像预测完整的分"类别—计数"向量，且不被告知图中出现哪些类别。
AI.method: 将计数转化为对过完备提案集的实例感知结构推断。使用冻结的 SAM 2.1 生成掩码，冻结的 DINOv2 与 OpenCLIP 提供关系和类别特征。一个 3267 参数、类别共享的关系头基于实例掩码派生监督预测同实例亲和度。随后通过稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与背景边距准入，把每个被接纳的连通分量转换为一个计数，并给出可复现的组证据。仅训练关系头，不使用计数或密度图目标。
AI.result: 在 COCO clean500 上，UniCounting 的点估计向量 ℓ1 误差与缺失类虚假质量低于校准的 OWLv2-All80，微观存在 F1 相当。在相同解码器下，所学关系相较掩码包含、掩码 IoU、CLIP 和 DINO 均降低两类误差，并揭示出碎片化—合并之间的权衡。另在 OmniCount-sub、FSC-147 和 CARPK 上报告了迁移诊断结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多类别计数重构为过完备提案上的实例级关系推断，并仅训练轻量关系头，可在不依赖计数或密度图监督的情况下实现更优的向量计数精度，同时揭示分割提案的碎片化—合并权衡；迁移诊断进一步考察跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets
summary: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出描述GFlowNet混合模型的通用理论框架，区分连续索引(CI)与离散索引(DI)集合，并据此提出Stratum-Conditioned GFlowNets，实现并行训练并加速收敛与模式覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有GFlowNet集成方法虽能改善状态空间探索与收敛，但给基础模型带来显著运行时开销，且其概念联系尚不清晰。作者希望建立统一理论框架以厘清混合GFlowNet的本质，并在不增加额外计算的前提下提升学习效率。
AI.method: 首先提出描述GFlowNet混合的通用理论框架，细分为连续索引(CI)和离散索引(DI)两类。CI GFlowNets通过随机特征展开解释，可证明提升图结构任务的表达能力并经谱移动降低学习不稳定性；DI GFlowNets涵盖已有GFlowNet训练方法，并作为新提出的Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets的基础。SC GFlowNets受马尔可夫链Doob h变换启发，按给定模块函数分解状态空间，各组件采样其特定子集，支持集中式与组件级易并行训练。
AI.result: CI GFlowNets在图结构任务中可证明增强采样器表达能力并减少学习不稳定性；DI GFlowNets统一了现有方法；SC GFlowNets支持集中式与组件级易并行训练，显著加速学习收敛与模式覆盖，且不引入任何不可忽略的额外计算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为GFlowNet集成提供了统一理论视角，并基于此提出高效的SC GFlowNets，在保持计算开销不变的同时提升收敛速度与模式覆盖，为GFlowNet的并行化训练提供了新思路。

title: Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part II: Assessment Results
summary: Third-party evaluations of autonomous vehicle (AV) safety can play a vital role in improving public acceptance, building consumer confidence, and establishing effective safety standards. In Part I of this study, we propose a dedicated third-party testing initiative for systematically evaluating AV behavioral safety. In this paper, we validate our proposed framework using Autoware.Universe, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS), tested both in simulated environments and on the physical test track at the University of Michigan's Mcity Testing Facility. The results indicate that Autoware.Universe possesses 6 out of 14 behavioral competencies and exhibited a crash rate of 3.01x10^-3 crashes per mile, approximately 1,000 times higher than the average human driver crash rate. During the tests, we also uncovered a number of unknown unsafe scenarios for Autoware.Universe. These findings underscore the necessity of behavioral safety evaluations for improving AV safety performance prior to widespread public deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过仿真与实车测试验证了第三方行为安全评估框架，发现开源L4系统Autoware.Universe仅具备14项行为胜任力中的6项，碰撞率达3.01x10^-3次/英里，约为人类驾驶员的1000倍。
AI.motivation: 第三方评估对提升公众接受度、建立消费者信心和制定有效安全标准至关重要，而现有AV安全评估缺乏系统化的行为安全测试方法。
AI.method: 在仿真环境和密歇根大学Mcity实体测试场中，对开源L4自动驾驶系统Autoware.Universe进行测试，以验证所提出的第三方行为安全评估框架。
AI.result: Autoware.Universe仅具备14项行为胜任力中的6项，碰撞率为3.01x10^-3次/英里，约为人类驾驶员平均碰撞率的1000倍；测试中还发现了若干未知的不安全场景。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了在广泛部署前开展行为安全评估以提升AV安全性能的必要性。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出"自我参照社会偏好"，让智能体在无法观测同伴奖励时，用自己的奖励模型评估他人结果，从而学习合作行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习中的社会偏好方法通常要求智能体观测同伴的奖励信号，但许多真实交互中智能体（如同人类）只能观察他人的行为与结果，无法获取其私有奖励，这限制了方法的适用性。
AI.method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励的模型，将其应用于其他智能体被观测到的状态转移，从自身视角评估他人结果，并把这种"自我参照评估"输入标准社会偏好。研究两种整合方式：修改学习奖励，或用于加权策略更新。
AI.result: 在Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境（分别需要志愿、公共品贡献与资源节制）中，智能体在未观测他人奖励的情况下均学会合作，包括独立学习失败的情境，且常比能获取真实奖励的智能体产生更公平的联合收益分配。有效整合点依社会偏好而定：不平等厌恶最适合在奖励中结合价值前瞻，而纯利他偏好更适合策略更新加权。在部分可观测下，策略更新方式仍支持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取他人的奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件：社会偏好可以建立在对他人结果的自我参照评估之上，而该评估源自对其行为的观测。

title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 UP-MOPD：将多教师在线策略蒸馏中的冲突约束施加在优化器更新步上，而非梯度上，通过投影越界候选位移缓解 AdamW 下梯度修正失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏可整合不同领域专长，但来自不同教师的梯度相互冲突会阻碍知识融合。现有梯度修正方法在朴素 SGD 下直接约束参数更新，而在 AdamW 等优化器中，动量、自适应缩放与权重衰减会使被修正的梯度产生一阶上仍恶化某领域损失的更新，因此需要将约束作用点从梯度转移到优化器更新上。
AI.method: 方法为 UP-MOPD（Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation）。先让原始混合梯度照常更新优化器状态并生成候选位移；随后仅对违反领域约束的候选位移进行投影，取欧氏距离下距候选点最近的可行更新，再提交给参数。与梯度投影、更新拒绝两种基线形成对比。
AI.result: 在医学与通用领域实验中，UP-MOPD 在训练后期将 IFEval-loose 准确率较 vanilla M-OPD 提升 2.96 分，八项指标平均分 60.03，优于梯度投影的 59.00 与更新拒绝的 59.15。在涵盖数学、代码与指令遵循的公开基准上，六项任务平均分最佳（32.67），在 LiveCodeBench v5 领先，IFEval 并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将约束施加于优化器更新步（而非梯度）来降低领域间干扰，UP-MOPD 在多教师在线策略蒸馏中能更有效地整合多领域能力，验证了更新投影范式的有效性。

title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
summary: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互补特征域（CFD）理论，将预测价值刻画为由表示及其实现族共同诱导的、由上下文索引的贡献系统，并证明香农信息保持不蕴含该贡献系统的保持。
AI.motivation: 既有研究通常以香农信息量衡量表示变换是否“无损”，但信息保持未必意味着预测贡献保持。作者希望区分信息保持与依赖实现的贡献，并为多表示预测中的贡献变化建立定量规律。
AI.method: 以CFD理论形式化表示与实现族共同诱导的上下文贡献系统；构造可逆表示变换，在受限决策族下保持目标信息却改变预测贡献；定义CFD贡献缺陷度量受控重编码下上下文贡献的变化；对有界Lipschitz效用，证明每个联盟效用偏移受重编码前后可达动作集之间行为距离的约束。
AI.result: 理论上，每个上下文贡献缺陷被相应联盟不相容性之和所界定；精确行为闭包导致不变性，而补偿越精确则贡献越趋恢复。受控ECG实验显示，非线性双射重编码保持冻结时频表示中的信息，却改变固定仿射学习器的准确率，施加精确逆变换可恢复所有测试联盟的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将信息保持与依赖实现的贡献相分离，为多表示预测提供了定量的转变规律。

title: A Belief-State World Model for Catheter Navigation under Sparse Fluoroscopy: A Planar Proof of Concept
comment: Presented at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026) Workshop on Surgical Digital Twins (SurgTwin). 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Endovascular catheter navigation relies on continuous fluoroscopy, exposing patients and clinical staff to ionizing radiation throughout the procedure. We investigate whether a physics-based world model can sustain the navigation task between deliberately sparse X-ray acquisitions, and whether the model can signal when its internal state estimate is no longer reliable. We formulate sparse-fluoroscopy navigation as a partially observable Markov decision process where a Cosserat rod simulator supplies transition dynamics, sparse noisy projections provide observations, and a particle filter maintains a belief over the device state, reduced in this implementation to a tip state with a geometric contact proxy. We evaluate this formulation in a deliberately simplified setting: a synthetic planar vessel phantom with a quasi-static rod model and simulated projections, without clinical or animal data. In this setting, the belief-state model tracks the simulated tip with a root mean square error of 1.30 mm while acquiring observations at one fifteenth of the continuous rate (0.97 mm at every frame, 1.51 mm at one thirtieth), reported 90 percent credible intervals achieve 0.92 empirical coverage, and the belief-derived contact risk estimate discriminates unsafe contact events with an AUROC of 0.68. These results constitute a proof of concept on a simplified simulation rather than a demonstration of clinical readiness; their purpose is to establish that calibrated belief, rather than point-estimate accuracy alone, is the essential property a sparse-imaging world model must deliver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于物理世界模型的稀疏透视导航框架：以Cosserat杆模拟器提供转移动态、稀疏含噪投影作为观测、粒子滤波维持器械状态信念，在简化平面血管体模上验证其能在1/15透视率下跟踪器械尖端并输出校准的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 血管内导管导航依赖连续透视，使患者与医护人员全程暴露于电离辐射。已有工作多关注点估计精度，而稀疏成像下"模型何时不再可信"这一不确定性校准问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将稀疏透视导航建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）：状态转移由Cosserat杆模拟器给出，观测为稀疏含噪投影，用粒子滤波维护器械状态信念分布（实现中简化为尖端状态加几何接触代理）。在合成的简化平面血管体模上评估，采用准静态杆模型与模拟投影，不使用临床或动物数据。
AI.result: 信念状态模型在1/15连续透视率下跟踪模拟尖端，RMSE为1.30 mm（每帧采集时0.97 mm，1/30率时1.51 mm）；报告90%可信区间的经验覆盖率0.92；由信念导出的接触风险估计对不安全接触事件判别AUROC为0.68。
AI.conclusion: 该结果是简化仿真中的概念验证，并不代表临床可用性。其核心论点是：稀疏成像世界模型必须具备的关键属性是校准的信念分布，而非仅追求点估计精度。

title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
summary: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP），并开发营养智能体“善量仁”，通过约束规划建模、精确检索增强生成缩减候选集、以及帕累托原则引导的LLM迭代精化，输出带明确食材与分量的全量化膳食方案及营养合规报告，并已上线微信小程序。
AI.motivation: 膳食营养规划在慢性病管理与健康维持中至关重要，但实际应用需同时满足个性化约束与多维度营养目标，二者常相互冲突；且用户约束会随反馈演变，导致通用指南与可执行方案之间存在明显鸿沟。
AI.method: 首先形式化提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP）；随后构建营养智能体ShanLiangRen：将膳食规格、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言需求转化为个体化约束规划实例；采用精确检索增强生成（RAG）从大规模食材与食谱空间中缩减可行候选集；最后在确定性营养计算与约束验证反馈下，由LLM依据帕累托原则迭代修订候选方案。
AI.result: 系统可输出包含明确食材与分量的全量化膳食计划，并生成营养合规报告，展示约束满足情况与营养素区间达成度；系统已作为微信小程序ShanLiangRen在线发布，并提供演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过问题形式化与智能体系统设计，缓解了通用营养指南与个性化可执行膳食方案之间的落差，实现了兼顾个性化约束与多维营养目标的可落地膳食规划。

title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
summary: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架GeoPID，从几何视角分解VLM多模态信息为冗余、模态独有与协同成分，并据此在推理时选择性放大视觉独有子空间，平均相对准确率提升7.63%。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型虽表现优异，但往往对视觉信息利用不足、过度依赖文本上下文，亟需理解并缓解这一模态失衡问题。
AI.method: GeoPID基于视觉与文本表示子空间之间的几何关系，将多模态信息分解为冗余(Redundant)、模态独有(Modality-Unique)和协同(Synergistic)三部分；在22个VLM与14个基准上分析后，提出一种免训练的推理期干预技术，沿视觉独有子空间选择性放大视觉表示，无需更新任何模型参数。
AI.result: 对22个VLM和14个基准的分析显示，当问题强依赖视觉定位时，正确预测具有更强的视觉独有成分；所提干预使视觉定位能力增强，平均相对准确率提升7.63%。
AI.conclusion: 从几何角度刻画模态信息结构可有效诊断并缓解VLM的视觉欠利用问题，且免训练干预即可显著提升视觉定位性能，为多模态分析提供新视角。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
summary: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 该论文训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）探测GraphCast天气模型的内部表征，发现其将大气河强度（以IVT度量）编码为稳定的内部变量，尽管IVT既非输入也非预测目标；Matryoshka SAE进一步揭示概念的重要度排序及相互关系，干预实验证实其因果作用。
AI.motivation: 现有AI天气模型虽已媲美业务预报，但其内部如何表征大气仍是未解问题。特征归因只能揭示哪些输入模式重要，无法说明模型内部计算了什么、如何组合信息。作者希望找到一种方法定位模型内部真正依赖的变量，为评估这些变量在气候变暖下是否依然有意义奠定前提。
AI.method: 在GraphCast上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）以提取其习得概念，聚焦大气河现象。对比标准SAE与Matryoshka SAE两种结构，并以整层水汽输送（IVT）作为大气河强度的度量指标。通过跨网络深度的概念追踪及定向干预验证因果性。
AI.result: 标准SAE与Matryoshka SAE均显示GraphCast将大气河强度（IVT）计算为一个稳定的内部变量，而IVT既非模型输入也非训练目标。与标准SAE非结构化的概念检索不同，Matryoshka SAE能按重要度排序概念并揭示概念间关系。大气河概念在网络各深度层持续存在，定向干预证实其因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种定位模型内部变量并判定模型实际依赖哪些变量的途径，是追问这些变量在气候变暖导致现象变化时是否仍具意义的前提条件。

title: No Need to Stop the Fleet: Localized Anomaly Isolation via Dead Zones in AGV Fleets
summary: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) fleets in production and logistics environments rely on a system-wide emergency stop to handle local anomalies such as malfunctions, hazards, or contaminated areas. While safe, this approach halts the entire fleet even when only a small area is affected, causing unnecessary downtime. This paper proposes dead zones --- a formally defined localized isolation approach that serves as an additional fail-operational mechanism for situations where a full system-wide halt is not strictly needed. Rather than shutting down the entire fleet, a dead zone isolates the anomalous area, allowing unaffected robots to continue operating normally. We introduce two operational strategies: basic dead zone handling, in which affected robots enter a dead zone and stop, and dead zone handling with escaping, in which robots that are sufficiently far from a dead zone reroute around it. For escaping on counterclockwise trajectories we prove collision-freedom with a bounded arrival delay for all escaping robots, provided a minimum pairwise separation is kept between robots. Experimental evaluation confirms the theoretical guarantees and characterizes the throughput tradeoffs between all three approaches: full emergency stop, basic dead zone handling, and dead zone handling with escaping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"死区"（dead zone）概念，作为一种形式化定义的局部隔离机制，用于AGV车队在非全局停机场景下的故障可运行处理，并给出两种操作策略及理论保证与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有AGV车队在遇到局部异常（故障、危险区域、污染区）时依赖全局紧急停止，虽安全但会中断整个车队，造成不必要的停机损失。作者希望提供一种补充性的故障可运行机制，在无需全局停机时仅隔离异常区域，使未受影响的机器人继续正常工作。
AI.method: 1）形式化定义"死区"这一局部隔离方法；2）提出两种操作策略：基础死区处理（受影响机器人进入死区并停止）和带逃逸的死区处理（距死区足够远的机器人绕行）；3）针对逆时针轨迹上的逃逸行为，在机器人间保持最小成对间距的前提下，证明所有逃逸机器人无碰撞且有界到达延迟；4）通过实验评估验证理论并刻画三种方案的吞吐量权衡。
AI.result: 实验验证了理论保证，并刻画了三种方案——全局紧急停止、基础死区处理、带逃逸的死区处理——在吞吐量上的权衡关系。理论上证明了逆时针逃逸在满足最小成对间距条件下的无碰撞性与有界到达延迟。
AI.conclusion: 死区机制可作为全局紧急停止的补充性故障可运行方案，在局部异常场景下减少不必要的车队停机。两种策略在安全性与吞吐量之间存在可量化的权衡，带逃逸策略在保持安全保证的同时提升系统运行效率。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将海表温度（SST）区域多步预测建模为条件数值生成的方法，用文本上下文加图衍生连续前缀替代序列化SST网格，并借助LLM完成预测与解释。
AI.motivation: SST预测依赖本地时间持续性、区域空间依赖和随预测日期变化的环境条件，现有方法难以在不将整个SST网格文本化的情况下，把这种异构条件有效呈现给大语言模型。
AI.method: 将历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录和静态海洋知识构成文本上下文；用静态图编码持久地理—气候关系，动态图编码近期SST相关性与局部热带气旋影响；两个图神经网络生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合后注入LLM输入。
AI.result: 在南海SST预测任务上，完整配置在十个预测步中取得对比方法里最优的MAE和R²。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在不文本化完整SST网格的前提下实现区域多步预测，并附加基于规则模块将预测趋势与环境因子方向匹配知识条目，返回可溯源的赛后上下文解释。

title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对半监督学习中类分布与标签空间双重不匹配问题，提出"轮毂-辐条"潜空间几何结构，结合证据分类器提升特征判别性和不确定性分离，实验取得最高3.25%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统半监督学习假设标注数据与未标注数据具有相同的类分布和标签空间，但现实中未标注数据常呈类别不平衡且包含未知类样本，导致类分布与标签空间的双重不匹配。这会引发多数类主导潜空间、未知类样本被过度自信误分类，进而降低特征判别性和伪标签质量。
AI.method: 提出"轮毂-辐条"(hub-spoke)潜空间几何结构：已知类均匀分布在中心轮毂周围，每类围绕其原型形成紧凑簇；轮毂作为锚点，提供专门面向高不确定性未知类样本的低证据区域。该结构集成证据(evidence)基分类器，通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，并将高不确定性未知类样本引导至轮毂，从而增强特征判别性与不确定性分离。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进方法，在多种设置下最大提升达3.25%。
AI.conclusion: 通过轮毂-辐条潜空间几何与证据分类器的结合，可有效缓解双重不匹配下的多数类主导与未知类误分类问题，提升特征判别性与伪标签质量。

title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WareFly-VLA——面向智能仓库中语言引导无人机人体搜索、定位与跟踪的逼真VLA框架与数据集，含507个遥操作飞行片段和8,504个高分辨率RGB转换，并建立四种开源VLA架构的统一基准，揭示语言条件空中控制远未解决。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作与地面移动导航中已取得显著成果，但无人机在智能仓库中的语言条件控制仍基本未被探索，主要障碍在于缺乏同时提供连续底层飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述和真实工业环境的基准。现有数据与评测无法支撑该方向的系统研究。
AI.method: 构建WareFly-VLA：基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim采集的逼真无人机VLA框架与数据集，包含507个人工遥操作飞行片段、8,504个高分辨率RGB转换，每个样本配有目标工人的外观描述与同步的四自由度控制指令。覆盖目标接近与人员跟随两类空中任务，涵盖遮挡、远距离搜索、高度变化和杂乱场景。在无泄漏的片段级协议下、两种控制频率上，对SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0和OpenVLA四种开源VLA架构建立统一基准评测。
AI.result: 结果显示仓库中语言条件空中控制远未解决：严格泛化设置下性能显著下降；连续动作建模始终优于离散动作标记化；单帧输入下仅前向通道可被可靠学习；当前基础模型接口从地面与人形本体向空中平台迁移效果差。同步的视频、语言、动作、位姿与难度标注亦支持世界模型研究。
AI.conclusion: 数据集、基线与评测协议已公开，为智能仓库中语言接地的空中自主性研究提供支撑，并指出连续动作建模、跨本体迁移与严格泛化是未来关键方向。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk.
