These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 该文研究序列内容充分性，用信息论分解区分输入歧义、表示损失与读出失配，提出CANOPE框架，并证明几何规律性不足以保证可恢复的序列内容与下游可用性。
AI.motivation: 探究一个表示是否保留输入中可用的有序目标信息，即"顺序内容充分性"。现有表示学习方法常以几何规整性（如各向同性高斯性、潜在一致性）作为质量指标，但作者质疑这类指标能否真正保证目标信息可恢复并支撑下游任务。
AI.method: 1) 信息论分解：将误差拆分为输入歧义、表示损失与读出失配三部分；2) 构造"可恢复视图"（recoverable views），使完美一致性与联合各向同性高斯性可与零目标信息共存，并给出确定性规范锚点带来的限制；3) 用token log-loss给出单侧信息损失上界，通过固定惩罚岭回归分析说明仅凭秩无法决定预测风险；4) 基于上述结论提出CANOPE——非自回归框架，含有序潜在画布（ordered latent canvases）、规范token监督与几何正则化。
AI.result: 在40,000条验证序列上，给定正确目标长度且存在强自然扰动时，潜在一致性（PL0）与token接地（PL2）的池化秩几乎相同，但位置Recall@1分别仅为13.5%与98.8%。在3,930条LJSpeech验证语音上，冻结PL2配合训练好的MatchaTTS读出，在文本被扰动时WER为21.54%，而冻结PL0为99.22%；端到端MatchaTTS达到10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的文本设定下，几何规律性本身并不能保证可恢复的序列内容，也不能保证有效的下游访问；池化层面的相似度指标可能严重掩盖位置信息的丢失，评估表示充分性需依赖位置级与token级证据。

title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
summary: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出图像比特流细粒度理解（IBFU）任务与基础模型BFG，通过比特流语义编码器与细粒度语义生成器直接在编码域生成描述，无需完整解码像素，在比特流损坏场景下表现稳定，适应隐私友好的AIoT应用。
AI.motivation: 传统像素域视觉理解需完整解码图像，导致像素级视觉内容在处理流程中暴露，隐私风险高；同时AIoT场景中图像比特流在传输与存储中易受损坏，现有视觉语言模型在此类条件下性能严重下降。因此需要一种直接在编码比特流上进行细粒度理解、且对损坏鲁棒的范式。
AI.method: 提出BFG基础模型，包含两部分：Bitstream Semantic Encoder（BSeE）直接从未完全解码的编码比特流中建模语义表示，不做显式像素重建；Fine-grained Semantic Generator（FSeG）以自回归方式将比特流语义转化为细粒度自然语言描述。同时构建大规模CFU-D数据集，涵盖完整比特流及多种损坏类型与严重等级的损坏变体，用于训练与评估。
AI.result: BFG在比特流损坏下仍保持稳定的细粒度描述生成。例如在Stanford Dogs Caption数据集上，平均CIDEr仅从0.6339略降至0.6077；而Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT等视觉语言模型则出现严重性能下降。
AI.conclusion: BFG为AIoT中隐私友好的细粒度视觉理解提供了可行范式，证明了在编码比特流域直接进行语义理解与生成的有效性与鲁棒性，避免了像素域暴露并适应实际损坏比特流场景。

title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
summary: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

AI.tldr: 该论文将在线主动特征获取（AFA）建模为组合式带背包的赌博机（BwK）问题，提出改进的遗憾上界与线性复杂度算法 LP-Chain，并在合成数据上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 在线 AFA 需在样本到达时更新预测器，但现有方法或基于深度强化学习缺乏性能保证，或仅优化成本调整后的奖励而未强制全局预算约束。作者希望为在线 AFA 提供带有理论保证且能处理全局预算、组合动作与动态奖励的统一框架。
AI.method: 将在线 AFA 形式化为组合式 BwK 问题，该问题同时耦合特征获取与预测，并具有组合复杂度、演化奖励、全局预算和结构化辅助信息等特性。利用基数感知置信界与子集更新结构推导更优的遗憾上界；为规避指数级动作空间，提出 LP-Chain 变体，以随特征数线性增长的规模搜索成本感知的特征子集链。
AI.result: 在该组合框架下获得了优于标准 BwK 的遗憾上界；LP-Chain 在合成数据上取得了与现有方法可比的预测性能，并优于基于 HEDGE 的 BwK 和基于深度 RL 的在线 AFA 基线，同时随特征数增加具有良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在线 AFA 提供了兼具理论保证与实用性的 BwK 建模范式，并通过 LP-Chain 在效率与性能间取得平衡，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Pareto-Optimal Entropy-Regularized Trajectory Optimization
summary: Trajectory optimization (TO) under nonlinear dynamics, actuation limits and collision avoidance constraints is a fundamental problem in robotics, albeit especially challenging due to its highly non-convex nature. For this setting, Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) is an efficient second-order shooting method, yet its local structure renders it vulnerable to suboptimal basins. Sampling-augmented variants mitigate this susceptibility through stochastic exploration, but often sample only around the few trajectories they retain for reoptimization, based solely on their cost which restricts exploration breadth. We introduce Pareto-Optimal Entropy-Regularized DDP (PER-DDP), an entropy-regularized population framework derived from the free-energy/relative-entropy inequality. Our method combines prior-guided sampling that shapes exploration around each retained trajectory, with expanded rollout evaluations that probe these sampling policies beyond the few retained candidates, and Pareto filtering for preserving task-constraint alternatives across iterations. This decouples sampling effort from the optimization population size and broadens exploration without sacrificing the second-order structure that makes DDP effective. Across multiple systems and hundreds of environments, PER-DDP achieves higher success rates than state-of-the-art sampling-augmented TO methods and finds reliable solutions in environments beyond the reach of all baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PER-DDP，一种基于自由能/相对熵不等式的熵正则化种群框架，通过先验引导采样、扩展的rollout评估和Pareto过滤，解耦采样开销与优化种群规模，在多种系统和数百个环境中取得比现有采样增强型轨迹优化方法更高的成功率。
AI.motivation: 非线性动力学、驱动限制与避碰约束下的轨迹优化高度非凸。DDP作为高效二阶打靶法易陷入次优盆地；采样增强变体虽通过随机探索缓解，但仅围绕少数基于代价保留的轨迹采样，探索范围受限。
AI.method: PER-DDP从自由能/相对熵不等式推导出熵正则化的种群框架，融合三项机制：(1) 先验引导采样，围绕每条保留轨迹塑造探索分布；(2) 扩展rollout评估，对这些采样策略进行超越少数保留候选的探测；(3) Pareto过滤，在迭代间保留任务-约束的多样化备选解。
AI.result: 在多种系统和数百个环境中，PER-DDP的成功率高于当前最先进的采样增强型轨迹优化方法，并在所有基线方法均失效的环境中找到了可靠解。
AI.conclusion: 通过将采样开销与优化种群规模解耦，PER-DDP在不牺牲使DDP有效的二阶结构的前提下扩大了探索范围，验证了熵正则化与Pareto多样性保持相结合的有效性。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 提出连续记忆机器（CMM），通过矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态分工，结合Transformer双向读写机制，在算法、上下文学习与循环推理任务上超越多种基线，且保留可解释注意力模式。
AI.motivation: 传统循环神经网络将信息压缩为单一向量型循环状态，迫使短期计算与长期保留共享同一表示；既有改进虽增加记忆容量或分离时间尺度，但缺乏生物学中"神经元级快速处理"与"长期保持"的结合。
AI.method: 基于Continuous Thought Machine（CTM）构建CMM：采用矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态。短期记忆追踪近期神经活动，由唯一参数化的神经元级模型学习利用活动模式进行计算；持久长期记忆用于存储信息以备后用。一个Transformer联合更新两种记忆，提供表达力强的双向读写机制，使每个存储可重组自身内容并互相读写。
AI.result: 在算法任务、上下文学习与循环推理任务中，CMM优于广泛的基线集合，相比先前记忆增强网络展现出更强泛化能力，同时保留CTM可解释的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过分离且互通的短长期矩阵记忆与Transformer读写机制，缓解单一循环状态瓶颈，兼顾快速神经元级处理与长期保持，兼具性能、泛化与可解释性。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无状态语言智能体（SLA）框架，将研究状态从智能体会话中剥离，由外部框架持有候选方案与实测结果并为每次调用重建角色化上下文，在软件工程、内核优化与算法设计任务上以更少token取得最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 长周期自动化研究系统中，单纯增加推理并不带来进展：智能体反复重放增长的历史、彼此重复工作、在消耗token的同时停止实验。而多数评测预算短或基准过早饱和，掩盖了这些失效模式。作者将其归因于两个设计选择：研究状态存放在哪里，以及谁决定下一步尝试什么。
AI.method: 提出无状态语言智能体（SLAs），遵循"有状态搜索+无状态智能体"原则：智能体调用之间不携带对话，由框架持有研究状态（候选解与测量结果），并为每次调用重建全新的、角色特定的上下文。在SLA框架中实现：无状态Advisor读取框架汇总的跨搜索方向证据并分配具体实验，并行Worker执行实验。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计任务上，与三个近期框架对比，预算最高达十亿token。SLA在所有任务上取得最佳最终结果，并以减少超84%的token达到最强内核基线的最终性能。共享检查点消融显示，聚焦上下文与显式任务分配均有贡献且效果可在完整运行中复合；Advisor消耗少于0.6%的token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用SLA，将持久研究状态置于智能体会话之外；并表明短评测周期会误判研究系统及其组件。

title: Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control
summary: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出微型神经策略（MNP），结合进化策略与统计模型检验进行策略搜索，将神经网络压缩至0.5–7.5 kB并实现安全鲁棒的实时机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 嵌入式设备计算资源受限，传统神经网络策略体积大、难以在微控制器上实现安全且鲁棒的实时控制，需要兼顾安全性、鲁棒性与部署可行性的轻量化策略。
AI.method: 将进化策略（ES）与基于统计模型检验（SMC）的验证整合进策略搜索流程，以压缩神经网络规模；在Cartpole与四旋翼任务上开展大规模训练与评估，变化控制频率与网络结构，并在仿真验证后通过零样本迁移到物理系统进行部署测试。
AI.result: MNP在仿真与零样本sim-to-real迁移中均保持安全性与控制性能；策略内存占用0.5–7.5 kB，可在微控制器上部署，实时推理抖动低于25 ns，芯片空闲时间超过97%。
AI.conclusion: MNP为资源极度受限的机器人系统提供了一种高实用性方案，证明结合ES与SMC验证可在不牺牲安全性与鲁棒性的前提下大幅缩减策略规模并实现安全的sim-to-real部署。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMA，一种数据生成与训练流水线，仅凭一份"Model Spec"即可让模型利用自身推理能力实现安全对齐的自我改进，且泛化到分布外场景。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在软件工程、数学等易验证目标上具备递归自我改进能力，但对齐难以验证，导致能力增长可能脱离安全对齐，尤其在自主科研与网络安全领域风险加剧。现有方法依赖可验证反馈做能力自改进，或用更强模型/人工数据做对齐监督，形成外部监督瓶颈。作者追问：当前模型能否自我改进安全对齐。
AI.method: SIGMA包含两步：(1)规格引导的任务合成——以候选模型作为任务设计智能体，生成多样化的对齐困境场景，并转化为压力测试其对Model Spec理解的训练任务；(2)自我评判的对齐训练——用监督微调与基于评分量表（rubric）的强化学习，模型自身充当奖励模型。
AI.result: 仅在单轮对话数据上训练，却在多轮智能体环境中提升安全对齐：AgentHarm有害性从22.6降至14.8，Agentic Misalignment从79.1降至3.8；优于Deliberative Alignment与Constitutional AI基线，并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 平衡无害性与有用性的Model Spec、用于安全审议的测试时推理、以及任务设计智能体产出的高质量评分量表，是实现有效自我改进的关键。模型可在无外部监督瓶颈下自我提升安全对齐。

title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
summary: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

AI.tldr: 该文提出ConnectomeX/FlyVision——一种保留果蝇视觉回路特性的可训练架构（并行ON/OFF处理、循环计算、群体图交互），在分类与医学影像任务上以极小参数量取得有竞争力甚至更优的表现。
AI.motivation: 生物连接组（connectome）编码了视觉计算的结构化解法，可能为人工视觉提供可复用的归纳偏置。作者希望验证这类连接组启发的计算是否能从紧凑识别任务扩展到大规模自然与生物医学视觉任务，并在参数效率上优于传统CNN。
AI.method: 以FlyVision为核心构建ConnectomeX：保留并行ON/OFF通路、循环计算与群体级图交互，并可在不同任务间缩放容量；在ImageNet-1K上提供Base与Large，以及带学习低频分支的Large local-k7模型。BrainAGE将其扩展至容积T1加权MRI：用共享的ImageNet预训练FlyVision Large编码器处理每例扫描的24张矢状、冠状、轴状切片，再以置信度调制的高斯投票融合切片级年龄估计。
AI.result: MNIST 99.34%（80,608参数）；CIFAR-10 78.03%（81,408参数）。ImageNet-1K：Base 60.79%、Large 66.25%（1.8M/3.7M参数），Large local-k7加低频分支66.53%，对比ResNet18 69.25%（11.7M参数）。22类皮肤病：Large 63.78%准确率、95.28% macro-AUROC（2.99M参数）。四分类胸片：ImageNet预训练Base/Large为92.60%/92.76%（1.33M/2.97M参数），高于预训练ResNet18的91.56%（11.18M）。BrainAGE在433例留出扫描上三轴融合MAE 5.98年，R²=0.868。
AI.conclusion: 在224×224分类任务中，最佳FlyVision配置与ResNet18的差距在ImageNet-1K和皮肤病分类上不超过3个百分点，并在胸片分类上以显著更少参数实现超越；表明保守的连接组启发式计算可从紧凑识别扩展至大规模自然与生物医学视觉，具备良好的参数效率与迁移性。

title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture.
  We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自监督图表示（SSL）能否为监督式OOD节点分类提供互补信号，提出Co-Train与Dual-Space Retrieval两个与骨干无关的框架，并在四个图基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 图分布随时间和领域变化显著，GNN的分布外（OOD）泛化仍是难题。监督与自监督图表示学习目标不同、视角各异，作者希望探究SSL表示能否补充监督信号以提升OOD节点分类。
AI.method: 提出两种与GNN骨干无关的框架，在不同学习与预测阶段利用互补信息：1）Co-Train：联合学习监督与SSL表示，并在训练中自适应融合；2）Dual-Space Retrieval：在两个表示空间中进行非参数预测，并在推理时通过置信度感知融合合并预测。监督与SSL编码器分别参数化，无需共享相同GNN结构。采用DGI和GRACE两种SSL目标，在四个涵盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，结合多个GNN骨干进行评估，并辅以表示分析和消融实验。
AI.result: Co-Train在多个骨干与SSL目标下持续优于强监督OOD基线；Dual-Space Retrieval作为灵活的非参数替代方案取得具竞争力的性能。跨骨干、跨SSL目标的结果以及表示分析与消融实验均表明，SSL表示为监督表示提供了互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 自监督表示可有效补充监督表示，在不同设置下提升OOD节点分类性能；所提框架具备通用性与灵活性。

title: Towards Efficient Robotic Manipulation Models with Self-Recursive Pruning
summary: Network pruning can reduce parameter redundancy in robotic policies. However, generic pruning criteria are tailored for image recognition tasks and commonly designed to preserve weight magnitude, local reconstruction, or language-model likelihood rather than closed-loop action behavior. Directly applying these pruning algorithms to robotic tasks yields unsatisfactory performance. In this paper, we propose Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment (LCAM) pruning, a training-free method for unstructured pruning of pre-trained robotic manipulation policies. Specifically, we first rank connections using row-normalized weight contribution, activation moments measured on calibration demonstrations, and the sensitivity of output directions to the action-prediction loss. We further design a self-recursive coarse-to-fine procedure: importance is recalibrated after each nested coarse pruning stage, while held-out offline action distortion guides fine-grained budget allocation after a sparsity knee. Our algorithm is free from costly recovery training and simulator rollouts after pruning. Experiments on three LIBERO suites with competitive robotic policies, together with evaluations on OpenVLA, show that LCAM attains competitive performance across a broad range of pruning ratios. Notably, on LIBERO-Object with OpenVLA, our LCAM achieves 84.0% success at 50% unstructured pruning, retaining over 90% of the dense policy's success rate. Promising results on real-world robotic ping pong further demonstrate the effectiveness of our pruning algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出LCAM剪枝：一种免训练的非结构化剪枝方法，用于预训练机器人操作策略，在多种LIBERO任务与OpenVLA上保持高成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用剪枝准则面向图像识别任务，侧重权重幅度、局部重建或语言模型似然，而非闭环动作行为；直接应用于机器人任务效果不佳，且现有方法常需昂贵的恢复训练或仿真回滚。
AI.method: LCAM基于三项指标排序连接：行归一化权重贡献、在标定示范上测得的激活矩、输出方向对动作预测损失的敏感度；并设计自递归粗到细流程：每级嵌套粗剪枝后重新校准重要性，在稀疏度拐点后由留出离线动作失真指导细粒度预算分配。全程无需恢复训练与仿真回滚。
AI.result: 在三个LIBERO套件及OpenVLA上，LCAM在广泛剪枝率下取得有竞争力表现；LIBERO-Object + OpenVLA在50%非结构化剪枝下成功率84.0%，保持稠密策略90%以上成功率；真实世界乒乓球任务亦验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: LCAM通过面向闭环动作行为的剪枝准则与自递归粗到细流程，实现了免训练、无需仿真回滚的机器人策略非结构化剪枝，在仿真与真实任务中均有效。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 提出Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRG)，一种无需特权模型访问或训练数据的推理时框架，通过将任务成功声明分解为基于轨迹证据的子声明并逐级估计与聚合置信度，在多个基准、模型和框架上实现了更优校准的置信度估计与风险感知决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM agent时，判断是否信任其输出或进行干预需要校准良好的成功置信度。然而agent置信度估计困难：成功证据分散在异质且相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；前沿LLM内部信号访问受限、agent rollout成本高、训练数据可能缺失或迅速过时。
AI.method: CRG是一个推理时框架，从单条轨迹估计agent完成任务的概率。它以"agent完成了任务"这一声明为起点，将其分解为扎根于轨迹证据的上下文子声明，对每个终端声明估计置信度，再聚合为整体置信度估计。
AI.result: 在三个agentic基准、三个骨干模型和三个agent框架上，CRG相比verbalized、基于采样和白盒代理基线，产生更好的校准置信度和更强的风险感知决策。研究还发现仅看校准误差可能有误导性：白盒代理基线看似校准良好但区分度接近随机。消融实验表明CRG的改进来自声明级置信度估计与聚合，而非仅图构建。CRG还暴露了每个置信度估计下的声明和轨迹证据，可在决策时审计。
AI.conclusion: CRG为无特权访问、无训练数据的agent置信度估计提供了有效方案，提升校准与风险感知决策，并具备可审计性。同时提示评估需同时关注区分度，避免单纯依赖校准误差指标。

title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
summary: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于SIREN隐式神经表示的CT-超声可变形配准框架，利用CT解剖先验（HU值刚度、接触区位移先验、扇形几何正则）约束形变，NGF优化，配准精度较刚性初始化提升17%。
AI.motivation: 超声与术前CT的slice-to-volume配准有助于微创手术中定位CT可见的软组织，但探头接触引起软组织形变，使刚性配准失准，现有方法难以在形变下保持准确对齐。
AI.method: 先用机器人辅助光学跟踪完成刚性配准，再逐帧用SIREN估计可变形变换。由CT的HU值近似组织刚度作为空间变化正则，抑制骨等刚性结构形变；加入两项物理约束：接触区位移先验（使探头面下组织受压）与基于波束方向和凸阵视场的扇形几何正则；以NGF为损失优化参数。
AI.result: 相比刚性初始化，配准对齐提升17%，优于经典可变形基线方法，且拓扑折叠接近零。
AI.conclusion: 将CT解剖先验与探头接触物理约束融入隐式神经形变建模，可在软组织变形下实现更准确且拓扑保持的CT-超声配准。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示on-policy distillation (OPD)的安全风险：一个安全对齐但被植入后门的教师模型可将其隐藏的恶意行为传播给原本干净的学生模型，仅3%投毒率即可达到最高70%的攻击成功率，并提出Lazy Defense缓释方法。
AI.motivation: 近期研究将OPD用于提升大语言模型安全性并取得较好效果，但这些方法通常假设教师模型与训练数据是可信的。本文旨在揭示这一被忽视的威胁：教师模型即使安全对齐，也可能携带后门，并在蒸馏过程中将恶意行为传递给学生模型。
AI.method: 在作者提出的威胁模型下，使用安全对齐但被植入后门的教师模型对初始干净的学生模型进行on-policy distillation，系统考察投毒率、训练轮数以及KL散度形式（top-k KL vs. sampled-token KL）对后门传递的影响，并测试一种简单缓释方法Lazy Defense（通过裁剪KL奖励使更新更保守）。
AI.result: 低至3%的投毒率即可使蒸馏后学生模型达到最高70%的攻击成功率(ASR)；增加训练轮数会放大风险，仅10个中毒样本在16个epoch后ASR达67%；常用的top-k KL通常比sampled-token KL更快加速后门传递，使触发条件驱动的有害行为更早出现；Lazy Defense可延迟低投毒率下的后门传递。
AI.conclusion: OPD能够传播后门，且存在放大该风险的关键训练选择；Lazy Defense仅能延迟而非根除后门传递。研究强调必须正视并解决OPD的安全风险。

title: One for All, All for One: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering via Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: Deep generative models often produce structured outputs composed of interacting components. Modelling these outputs with a single model requires learning both the component distributions and their interactions. We pursue a modular alternative: reuse independently trained component generators and learn only how to coordinate them to produce coherent structured outputs. Our framework, Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering (CMDS), treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable generative primitives and coordinates their reverse processes through a learned control. We formulate coordination as a stochastic optimal control problem, balancing an assembly-level reward that specifies the desired properties of the combined output against deviations from the pretrained dynamics. The learned control amortises this optimisation, allowing reuse across new task instances. Experiments show that CMDS can recover a known target distribution, satisfy different spatial constraints with the same trained control, and recover individual sources from degraded mixtures. Across multi-agent maze navigation, articulated robot planning, and text-conditioned human motion, CMDS turns frozen models into coordinated multi-agent generators.

AI.tldr: 提出CMDS框架，将冻结的预训练扩散模型作为可复用生成基元，通过学习的控制协调其反向过程，以随机最优控制方式生成结构化组合输出。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型常需生成由相互作用的组件构成的结构化输出，而单一模型需同时学习组件分布与组件间交互，代价高且难以复用。本文追求模块化方案：复用独立训练的组件生成器，仅学习如何协调它们以产生一致的结构化输出。
AI.method: 将协调建模为随机最优控制问题：在保持接近预训练动力学（偏离惩罚）的同时，最大化描述组合输出期望属性的装配级奖励。学习的控制对优化进行摊销，从而可跨新任务实例复用。
AI.result: 实验表明CMDS能够恢复已知目标分布，用同一训练控制满足不同空间约束，并从退化混合中恢复各个源。在多智能体迷宫导航、关节机器人规划及文本条件人体运动任务中，CMDS将冻结模型转化为协调的多智能体生成器。
AI.conclusion: CMDS通过学习的控制协调冻结扩散模型的反向过程，实现了模块化、可复用的结构化生成，在多种多智能体与条件生成任务中有效。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出PAIR构建用户条件化应用状态，评估并训练提升跨用户可靠性。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上运行，但其跨用户可靠性问题尚未被充分研究；缺乏可控制地评估同一任务在不同用户条件下表现的手段。
AI.method: 1）PAIR（个性化应用状态实例化与渲染）流程：构建用户条件化的应用状态，从而对同一任务在不同用户间进行受控评估；2）RePAIR（个性化感知交互奖励强化学习）训练方法：利用跨用户子目标结果差异进行学习，提升用户条件化移动环境下的可靠性。
AI.result: 在六个智能体上，任务成功率随用户存在显著差异；用户条件化UI上下文中的子目标达成率一致偏低（下降6.98–15.4个百分点）；当个人目标取自用户自身内容时，差距进一步扩大（8.77–22.0个百分点）。此类失败常表现为选择其他条目而非目标条目，且在目标暴露前尤为明显。RePAIR在未见用户上相比其监督微调基线提升：用户条件化SAR +5.87个百分点，all-success +7.50个百分点，整体任务SR +9.42个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式地从跨用户差异中学习可提升GUI智能体的可靠性；PAIR与RePAIR为个性化条件下的受控评估与训练提供了初步有效证据。

title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
summary: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在合成人体动作数据集上自监督预训练视频Transformer，提出以人体为中心的掩码策略，缩小了与Kinetics预训练的差距。
AI.motivation: 主流动作识别模型依赖Kinetics-700等网络爬取视频预训练，存在未获被摄者同意的伦理问题；BEDLAM2.0等基于动捕的合成视频数据集提供了伦理替代方案，但直接用标准VideoMAE掩码策略在合成数据上预训练效果远逊于Kinetics预训练。
AI.method: 提出以人体为中心的掩码方案（human-centric masking scheme），利用人体关键点和人体边界框区域引导掩码，使模型在预训练中关注人体动作的结构与动态。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome上，该方法显著优于合成数据上的标准VideoMAE预训练；在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设置下，预训练不使用任何真实帧，弥合了与Kinetics预训练差距的49%。
AI.conclusion: 以人体为中心的掩码策略有效提升了合成数据自监督预训练的效果，为符合伦理的动作识别模型提供了可行路径，并将公开预训练模型。

title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MS-ECG-FM心电基础模型，通过与多类临床报告（心电、超声、放射、出院报告）对比对齐训练，在扩展检测基准上全面超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG基础模型仅以心电解读报告作为唯一监督信号，而解读报告只覆盖临床医生常规识别的部分波形信息，导致表示学习忽略ECG中更广泛的诊断信号。
AI.method: 构建MS-ECG-FM心电基础模型，采用对比对齐方式，将ECG表示与多种不同临床笔记类型（心电报告、超声心动图报告、放射报告、出院报告）进行对齐训练。
AI.result: 在扩展的ECG检测基准上，MS-ECG-FM在ECG可检测的各类病症上全面优于现有方法，包括在减少导联配置下亦表现优异。不同报告对不同诊断领域改善表示，多源对齐可捕获互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 多源临床报告对比对齐可弥补单一解读报告监督的局限，产生跨临床多样化任务一致且强健的ECG表示。

title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
summary: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

AI.tldr: CropSentry：低成本地面多机器人系统，通过多模态叶片感知实现作物早期胁迫检测，总体分类准确率84.12%。
AI.motivation: 现代农业中作物早期胁迫检测对提升效率、减少时间/资金/人力浪费十分必要，但高光谱成像、AI系统等技术成本高、复杂度大，中小规模农户难以应用，因此需要一种低成本、易用且可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出 CropSentry 低成本地面多机器人系统：由两个自主机器人逐行连续采集叶片颜色与环境数据，进行多模态叶片感知；观测结果经空间映射后发送至主机器人，主机器人以颜色编码的行段生成实时网页仪表盘展示作物健康状况。
AI.result: 实验共采集63次观测，总体作物健康分类准确率为84.12%，其中健康植株82.60%、营养缺乏植株88%、患病植株80%；10次从机器人观测中实现100%的无线通信成功率。
AI.conclusion: 多机器人近距离叶片巡检能够在保持低成本、易获取和可扩展的前提下检测作物早期胁迫，为农户提供及时信息，改善资源利用与作物管理。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 针对论证挖掘（AM）高质量结构标注数据稀缺的问题，本文提出一种新颖的对抗强化学习数据合成框架，通过生成器与判别器的对抗循环联合优化，同时提升合成数据的结构准确性与多样性。在三个基准数据集上，无论全数据还是低资源设定，均持续提升AM性能。
AI.motivation: 论证挖掘（AM）受限于高质量、结构标注数据集的稀缺。尽管LLM在合成数据生成方面展现出潜力，但生成既结构准确又足够多样的合成AM数据仍是难题。
AI.method: 从新视角重新审视AM的合成数据生成问题，提出一种新颖的对抗强化学习框架。该框架在对抗循环中联合优化生成器与判别器：生成器产生结构化的AM实例，判别器通过区分真实数据与合成候选样本提供学习信号；借助对抗反馈，生成器逐步提升生成论证数据的结构准确性，同时保持多样性。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架在全数据与低资源两种设定下均持续提升AM性能，验证了其有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗强化学习框架能同时兼顾合成AM数据的结构准确性与多样性，有效缓解数据稀缺问题，并在多种数据条件下具备稳定的性能增益与可扩展性。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation），通过回溯修订发起时的发现状态并重执行新旧Meta-Skill，在共享条件下对比其差异，将比较结果蒸馏为可复用的Meta-Experience，使Meta-Skill学习从分支结果转向改进过程本身的变化。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体通过生成与修订Skill持续提升，Skill的发现与精炼过程本身成为可学习对象。Task-Skill直接作用于任务执行，而Meta-Skill治理智能体如何发现与改进未来Skill，其价值通过后续搜索过程体现。然而现有方法从原始Skill搜索轨迹与分支结果中改进Meta-Skill，分支表现混淆了初始发现状态与产生该搜索过程的Meta-Skill修订两者的影响，难以刻画某次修订究竟改变了什么，导致更新偏向依赖有利状态的修订，而非真正改进过程的修订。
AI.method: HMED构建面向自改进智能体的Meta-Experience机制。它回溯一次修订所源自的已完成事件，从同一恢复的发现状态出发，分别重执行现行Meta-Skill与修订后的Meta-Skill，使该修订相关的改变在共享条件下被观察。每次比较被蒸馏为一条Meta-Experience——一种结构化记录，可被未来更新复用，从而使即使最终未被保留的修订也能贡献学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准以及开源与闭源模型上，HMED在Skill发现性能上持续优于强基线，使Meta-Skill学习超越分支结果，转向关注改变改进过程所带来的后果。
AI.conclusion: HMED通过回溯重执行与Meta-Experience蒸馏，解耦了初始发现状态与Meta-Skill修订的效应，为自改进智能体的Meta-Skill学习提供了更可靠的信号来源，并在多基准与多模型上验证了其有效性。

title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出Knee3DVLM——一种序列感知的视觉语言模型，利用全容积DESS与液体敏感TSE膝关节MRI预测57个MOAKS二元诊断目标，双序列融合配置在1,074例留出队列上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中的应用日益增多，但在膝关节MRI上仍受限，尤其是临床实践中互补序列（DESS与TSE）的联合解读尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: 构建序列感知的VLM（Knee3DVLM），输入为全容积DESS和液体敏感TSE MRI，输出57个源自MOAKS、按解剖位置解析的二元诊断目标以支持结构化报告；在受试者不重叠的OAI数据划分上比较DESS单序列、TSE单序列及DESS-TSE配对三种配置，并做与3DReasonKnee队列对齐的次要多分类分析。
AI.result: 在1,074例留出检查中，融合模型达到平均准确率72.98%、平衡准确率71.17%、平均ROC-AUC 78.96%、宏平均ROC-AUC 78.74%，为三种配置中最高；在五个病理类别的多分类分析中，数值上优于已报告的最强3DReasonKnee配置。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用双序列、全容积建模以实现全面的膝关节MRI评估。

title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
summary: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出归一化精确解体积（NESV）度量，量化固定宽度单层Transformer在给定任务上的精确解参数比例，并建立四个任务的渐近界，揭示其与长度泛化的关系，进而通过体积分析定位INDEX任务的误差源并改进模型结构。
AI.motivation: 现有关于Transformer表达性的研究只能说明其是否"能够"解决某任务，却几乎无法预判所学解能否泛化到更长输入长度。作者希望找到一个可度量的量，用以刻画解随输入长度增长的脆弱性，并借此指导模型结构改进。
AI.method: 提出NESV（归一化精确解体积）：在长度n的所有输入上都取得精确解的参数在有限参数区域中所占比例。针对固定宽度、单层、注意力按log n缩放的Transformer，对FIRST、MAJORITY、INDEX、PARITY四个任务推导NESV的渐近上下界；并针对INDEX进行误差来源分解，设计能结构性消除其中一项误差的改进模型。
AI.result: NESV渐近界为：FIRST为Θ(1)，MAJORITY为Θ(1/(n log n))，INDEX为Θ(1/n³)，PARITY为0。该排序与以往经验结果一致：精确解体积随长度衰减越快，长度泛化越难。对INDEX的体积分析发现两项随n增长的误差源；改进模型理论上将界提升至Θ(n⁻¹)，实验中在10倍训练长度下准确率达85%，而原模型为60%。
AI.conclusion: 体积分析可作为一种识别长度敏感性具体来源的有效方法，为任务相关的模型改进提供可操作的洞察，并可作为表达性研究与长度泛化之间的桥梁指标。

title: Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions
summary: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements. Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot's trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出力感知运动框架，将无约束负载上的外部交互视为指令，结合柔顺载物策略与因果力估计器，通过估计器在环数据聚合与微调训练，实现四足机器人在载物行走中辨识并柔顺应对外部交互。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人被期望在人类环境中边搬运物体边移动，但当人直接与负载而非机器人交互时，无约束负载带来的外部作用力与负载自身运动难以区分，机器人需在仅用机载测量的条件下辨识有意交互，同时保持负载平衡与运动稳定。
AI.method: 将负载交互建模为塑造"机器人-负载"整体系统运动的指令；解耦力感知运动学习与无约束负载上的力估计；采用柔顺载物策略配合因果力估计器，通过估计器在环的数据聚合与微调进行训练，从机载测量预测交互力，并据此柔顺响应。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，所得控制器能够维持稳定的载物行走运动，对外部交互表现柔顺顺从，并利用推断出的力支持人类引导下的机器人轨迹改变。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠机载测量即可在无约束负载条件下区分并柔顺响应外部交互，实现稳定载物运动与人引导的轨迹调整，验证了力感知运动框架与估计器在环训练的有效性。

title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.tldr: TRACE：通过rollout引导的QAT与量化信息缓存，对齐训练与rollout的FP4量化路径，在MoE LLM的RL训练中实现与BF16相当的性能，并带来最高5.4倍rollout加速。
AI.motivation: RL后训练LLM在rollout生成阶段存在巨大的计算与显存开销，低精度rollout成为高效训练的关键动机。但现有FP4 RL方法仅在训练路径与rollout路径上各自优化量化精度，未直接缩小两条量化执行路径之间的差异，导致train-rollout不一致问题未被有效解决。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE）FP4量化框架，面向MoE语言模型的RL训练。核心包含两部分：(1) rollout引导的量化感知训练（rollout-guided QAT），利用rollout侧量化结果指导训练侧FP4舍入决策，直接降低train-rollout差异；(2) 高效的量化信息缓存方案，选择性保留深层网络的尾数与scale信息，以降低引导机制带来的存储与通信开销。
AI.result: 在四个大规模MoE语言模型、覆盖推理、代码与长时程RL任务上进行评估。结果显示TRACE支持FP4权重/激活与FP4 KV-cache联合rollout，RL性能与BF16 rollout相当，rollout加速最高达5.4倍；相比对BF16训练策略进行事后FP4量化，最终FP4性能显著更优。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过直接对齐训练与rollout的FP4量化路径，缓解了两路径量化误差独立优化带来的差异，在MoE LLM的RL训练中兼顾效率与性能，验证了低精度rollout用于高效RL训练的可行性。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 该论文跳出"内部指标"（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度）来评估世界模型，转而从外部衡量：构建完整十英雄MOBA的多智能体世界模型，仅在梦境中训练策略，再在真实游戏中与内置对手对战评估。通过异步Dyna循环，策略在radiant方真实对局胜率达70.2%，而仅梦境训练为0%。
AI.motivation: 以往世界模型的评估都是"从内部"进行的——依据预测损失、策略在想象中获得的回报，或生成帧的逼真程度。这种内部视角无法揭示模型在真实下游任务中的实际价值，也无法暴露模型被利用（model exploitation）等问题。作者希望提出一种"从外部"评判世界模型的方法，即直接用真实游戏中的胜负来检验世界模型的效用。
AI.method: 1) 构建结构化、多智能体的完整十英雄MOBA世界模型（206个单位，每英雄每tick行动，单局长达6000 tick）；2) 仅在梦境中以1400 tick的自由运行想象回合训练策略（dream-PPO）；3) 真实游戏不提供梯度，只提供策略自身的对局作为世界模型的训练数据，并通过在线评估来筛选和锚定策略；4) 以连续异步Dyna循环运行，让世界模型在策略自身的对局分布上不断修正。
AI.result: 在从未用于任何决策的种子上，该策略作为radiant方取得70.2%的真实对局胜率（600局中421胜，95%置信区间66.4–73.7），相比仅梦境训练的0%以及加入循环前的33.7%显著提升。作为dire方则零胜，内置对手自我对战时同样零胜。四个关键发现：1) 模型利用在梦境内部不可见，所有未锚定的运行在几次更新内即崩溃，而没有任何梦境内指标能追踪该崩溃；2) 在训练语料上准确的世界模型，在策略自身对局上严重失真，Dyna在此修复它，在策略配方固定时带来+9.2个百分点的真实胜率；3) 策略逐机制地继承了世界模型的保真度特征——模型能表征宏观博弈但无法表征群体控制、施法时机和致命性，策略因此靠全图施压取胜，几乎不进行协同团战。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型应当从外部、以真实下游任务表现来评判。Dyna式循环通过在策略自身对局上持续修正世界模型，能显著提升真实性能；而模型利用、训练语料与实际策略分布之间的偏差，都是从内部视角无法察觉的。策略的行为会忠实继承世界模型的保真度轮廓。作者开源了世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评估协议以及所有策略与日志。

title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，利用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在网格化数据上进行迭代式二维空间关系推理，在数独、迷宫最短路径等图像类任务上取得当前最优且具高泛化性的可解释结果。
AI.motivation: 现代学习方法在空间推理任务上仍存在明显不足：难以利用被感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题。
AI.method: 提出自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，采用可变形卷积（deformable convolutions）动态适应感受野，在图像等网格状数据结构上对二维空间关系进行迭代推理。
AI.result: 在公开基准（如基于图像的数独求解、迷宫最短路径寻找）上取得了当前最优（state of the art）且可理解的结果，并展现出较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: aNCA 通过可变形卷积与迭代空间推理，为图像类空间推理任务提供了兼具可解释性与泛化性的有效方案。

title: RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation
summary: Long-horizon urban navigation requires sequential local decisions whose errors can compound over time. Imitation learning (IL) rarely learns from failures, while physical trial-and-error reinforcement learning (RL) is costly. Action-conditioned world models can provide imagined feedback by predicting visual consequences for candidate actions. However, a frozen world model may become less reliable as the policy evolves. In this paper, we introduce RIWANAV, a post-training framework that casts the coupled adaptation of a world model and an action model (policy) as task-specific recursive self-improvement (RSI). Each cycle alternates two updates. The world model evaluates policy actions through imagined outcomes, providing comparative feedback for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). The improved policy then constructs a grounded self-curriculum, selecting expert-consistent action-video pairs by behavioral novelty and prediction error. The refined world model supplies feedback for the next policy update, closing the recursive self-improvement loop. Experiments show that RIWANAV outperforms training baselines and prior methods, validating the proposed recursive self-improvement loop between the policy and world model. Real-world trials further demonstrate its practical applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RIWANAV 后训练框架，将世界模型与动作模型的耦合自适应建模为任务特定的递归自我改进（RSI），通过交替的"想象反馈驱动策略优化"与"自课程构建世界模型微调"闭环，在长时程城市导航任务上优于基线方法，并完成真实环境验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程城市导航依赖序贯局部决策，误差会随时间累积。模仿学习（IL）难以从失败中学习，而真机试错式强化学习（RL）代价高昂。动作条件世界模型可为候选动作预测视觉后果、提供想象反馈，但冻结的世界模型会随策略演化而逐渐失真，二者需要协同自适应。
AI.method: 提出 RIWANAV 后训练框架，把世界模型与动作模型（策略）的耦合自适应形式化为任务特定的递归自我改进（RSI）。每一轮循环包含两次交替更新：(1) 世界模型通过想象结果评估策略动作，为组相对策略优化（GRPO）提供比较性反馈，从而改进策略；(2) 改进后的策略构建有依据的自课程（grounded self-curriculum），依据行为新颖性与预测误差筛选与专家一致的动作-视频对，用于微调世界模型；精化后的世界模型再为下一轮策略更新提供反馈，闭合递归自我改进回路。
AI.result: 实验表明 RIWANAV 优于训练基线与已有方法，验证了策略与世界模型之间递归自我改进闭环的有效性；真实世界试验进一步证明其实际可用性。
AI.conclusion: 策略与世界模型的递归式协同自改进是缓解长时程导航中误差累积、降低真机试错成本的有效范式，并在真实场景中具备落地潜力。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个重复运行评估框架，用"主题漂移"和"数量分歧"两个指标衡量AI智能体在非结构化语料上重复执行知识工作时的可重复性，并证明基于分类体系锚定的智能体（TGA）显著更稳定。
AI.motivation: AI智能体被日益广泛地用于自动化处理大规模非结构化数据的知识工作，此类自动化要求可重复性：当底层证据不变时，智能体的类别、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间发生实质性漂移，即使单次答案看似合理。然而现有评估多关注单次输出质量，缺乏针对重复运行一致性的评测方法，因此需要建立相应的评估框架与操作指标。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估框架：对语义等价类别进行对齐，并定义两个操作指标——主题漂移（返回类别集合的归一化变化）与数量分歧（持续存在类别的计数变化）。在三个反复出现的客户反馈任务上评估八种前沿模型，语料规模从100到5000条记录，使用多种提示，并比较三种执行设计：原始生成、无分类体系的层次化分解、以及使用持久化主题、子主题与记录级预测的分类体系锚定智能体（TGA）。
AI.result: 在Claude Opus 4.8与固定1000条记录语料的设定下，TGA相较原始生成和层次化分解将主题漂移降低86%–88%，且匹配主题的数量分歧为零。TGA比筛选中的所有原始模型更稳定，在各语料规模下均保持稳定优势，并在主题匹配标准变严或变松时仍维持该优势。
AI.conclusion: 分类体系锚定能够为反复进行的知识工作产生更一致、更可重复的输出。尽管评估聚焦客户反馈，该框架面向更广泛的非结构化语料重复综合任务，如财务报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献。

title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: MedCORE：面向临床标准的结构化视觉-语言诊断框架，在三种影像模态上均超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型直接将图像特征映射到疾病标签，跳过了临床医生系统评估形态与纹理标准的结构化推理过程，导致诊断透明度不足，可能影响临床安全部署。
AI.method: MedCORE将诊断过程分解为临床定义的准则；对每条准则进行空间定位；通过多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据；用图注意力网络建模准则间依赖并细化表示；将准则表示与临床文本描述对齐，用类级视觉原型强化，并以不确定性校准加权聚合、按比例折减低置信证据。
AI.result: ISIC 2018：89.2%准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；BUSI：96.1%准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；IDRiD：84.3%准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC。均优于强CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念型与原型型基线。
AI.conclusion: 在皮肤镜病灶分类、乳腺超声病灶表征、糖网分级三种异质模态上验证，MedCORE通过显式结构化准则推理实现一致性提升，兼顾诊断透明度与性能。

title: HygieneRoboBench: Benchmarking Hygiene-Aware Planning for Household Robots
summary: Contact with contaminated objects can spread hazards through a household robot's grippers, tools, and shared surfaces, while new contacts can make an existing plan unsafe. Existing benchmarks do not jointly assess how planners identify hygiene risks from contact history and plan safe continuations after new contact events. Planners must do so within time and resource limits while respecting user priorities. We introduce HygieneRoboBench, with 624 instances across 134 task families, to evaluate safe resolution of household tasks from a given execution history. Tasks capture contamination through two grippers and shared objects, treatment costs, and user priorities. We combine controlled history, profile, and event comparisons with independent plan evaluation. These assess safe resolution, cost efficiency under user priorities, and responses to contact events. Evaluation of LLM-based and symbolic planners shows that safely completing a task does not guarantee the lowest execution costs under the user's priorities. To address this problem, we introduce Hygiene-NSP. It combines LLM-based grounding, contact-history reconstruction, and CP-SAT to jointly plan hygiene treatment and task execution under user priorities. Hygiene-NSP achieves safe resolution and optimal safe resolution rates of 94.4% and 90.4%, respectively. Both rates are higher than those of the evaluated baseline planners on the full dataset. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HygieneRoboBench 基准与 Hygiene-NSP 规划器，用于评估并求解家庭机器人在接触污染历史下兼顾卫生处理与任务执行的安全规划问题。
AI.motivation: 受污染物体可通过夹爪、工具和共享表面传播危害，新的接触事件可能使原计划不再安全。现有基准无法联合评估规划器从接触历史中识别卫生风险并在新接触事件后规划安全续作的能力，同时规划器还须在时间与资源约束下尊重用户优先级。
AI.method: 构建 HygieneRoboBench，含 134 个任务族、624 个实例，覆盖双夹爪与共享物体的污染传播、处理成本及用户优先级；采用受控的历史、画像与事件对比结合独立计划评估，考察安全求解、用户优先级下的成本效率及对接触事件的响应。进一步提出 Hygiene-NSP，融合 LLM 事实落地、接触历史重建与 CP-SAT，在用户优先级下联合规划卫生处理与任务执行。
AI.result: 对基于 LLM 与符号规划器的评估显示，安全完成任务并不保证在用户优先级下具有最低执行成本。Hygiene-NSP 的安全求解率与最优安全求解率分别达 94.4% 和 90.4%，在完整数据集上均高于所评估的基线规划器。
AI.conclusion: 卫生安全与用户优先级下的成本最优性之间存在差距，需联合建模接触历史、卫生处理与任务执行；Hygiene-NSP 通过 LLM 落地加 CP-SAT 优化的组合在该基准上取得了更高的安全与最优安全求解率。

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.

AI.tldr: DAEDALUS 通过“探索者-求解者”双智能体自生成练习任务并提炼启发式规则，在无需既有任务或预言验证器的条件下自举可复用智能体记忆，在多个基准上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在新环境中缺乏操作知识，需自行摸索工具行为与环境约定；缺乏过往尝试记忆会导致跨任务重复犯错，增加失败率与轨迹长度。现有方案依赖人工编写指南或基于训练任务与预言验证器的程序性记忆，均需环境先验知识。
AI.method: 提出 DAEDALUS，在无既有任务与预言验证器的情况下自举可复用记忆。方法配对两个智能体：探索者与环境交互，生成有挑战但可解的任务；求解者尝试这些任务。每次求解失败提炼一条启发式规则，仅当求解者在上下文中反复使用该规则并成功后予以采纳。这些结果同时反馈给探索者以调整后续任务难度。被采纳的启发式规则被整合为记忆库，供测试时使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、τ²-bench 与 AutomationBench 上，相比无记忆基线，DAEDALUS 平均成功率提升最高 15.9 个百分点，pass^5 提升最高 2.2 倍；与使用训练任务的方法相比具竞争力，且推理成本低于多数方法。小规模探索预算即可显现性能增益，其启发式规则也能惠及其他模型家族的智能体。消融实验表明，求解者轨迹是提炼有效启发式的关键信息，而对早期发现进行因子化可提升探索的成本效率。此外，DAEDALUS 生成的任务在按性能排序模型时可作为基准任务的代理。
AI.conclusion: DAEDALUS 证明了无需环境先验知识即可从自生成练习中自举可复用智能体记忆，兼顾性能、成本效率与跨模型泛化性，并具备作为模型评估代理任务的潜力。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何对齐分数（基于 Gram 行列式的几何体积）在模态退化下的响应机制，提出方向性几何响应（DGR）指标，证明响应主要由位移在体积梯度方向上的投影决定，而非位移幅度本身。
AI.motivation: 基于 Gram 行列式的几何对齐分数可紧凑建模模态间高阶一致性，但其对模态退化的响应机制尚不清楚。作者追问：多模态几何分数的响应是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅度决定，还是由方向等更复杂的几何因素决定。
AI.method: 使用 MSR-VTT（N=878）与 DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结表征群组，施加受控视频模糊与音频噪声；分析分数所定义的关系几何的响应。对 Gramian 体积做闭式一阶展开，得到 DGR：位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，同时刻画干净工作点、位移幅度与位移方向。与仅依赖幅度的替代方案及预设的增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps) 进行对比评估。
AI.result: 位移幅度最多解释绝对响应样本外方差的 15%，且幅度匹配的样本对响应系统性不同，说明标量幅度无法组织该响应。绝对一阶 DGR 项以样本外 R^2 0.838-0.969、匹配幅度排序准确率 0.864-0.963、响应符号准确率 0.909-0.989 解释观测响应；而无需方向信息的替代方案在相应评估协议下表现弱或不稳定。预设的增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps) 未通过可预测性与干净排序门限检验。
AI.conclusion: DGR 使用观测到的退化态位移，是解释性量而非部署期预测器：几何响应取决于表征在何处运作、退化将关系几何移动多远，以及朝哪个方向移动。方向与局部几何结构（而非单纯位移幅度）是决定多模态几何分数响应的核心因素。

title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .

AI.tldr: 提出WASD，一种基于Wasserstein距离与Sinkhorn散度的LLM知识蒸馏方法，利用token嵌入构建代价矩阵引入语义信息，在指令跟随、数学推理与代码生成任务上持续提升蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 自回归大模型能力提升伴随推理时算力与显存开销剧增；知识蒸馏可将大教师模型知识迁移至小模型。但现有LLM蒸馏方法主要依赖在各词表索引上逐点比较概率值的散度（如KL、前向/反向KL），未显式利用token级语义信息。
AI.method: 提出WASD（Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation）。以token嵌入构造代价矩阵，用Wasserstein距离度量教师与学生输出分布差异，从而将token级语义引入分布对齐；为保证可计算性，采用Sinkhorn散度近似，并推导出梯度等价的目标函数，可高效优化且无需引入额外网络。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族与不同规模上实验表明，WASD在指令跟随、数学推理、代码生成等多样任务上一致优于现有蒸馏方法，验证了token空间语义信息对LLM分布对齐的重要性。
AI.conclusion: token空间中的语义信息对LLM蒸馏中的有效分布对齐至关重要；基于Wasserstein的语义感知蒸馏是提升小模型蒸馏性能的有效途径。实现已开源。

title: Fast Non-Parametric Heteroscedastic Imitation Learning With Geometric Priors
summary: When learning probabilistic policies from human demonstrations, data-efficient learning and fast adaptations to new scenarios are key requirements. One popular way to achieve intuitive and reliable adaptations is through non-parametric, typically kernel-based, methods. However, existing solutions either fail to account for the geometry of manifolds common in robotics, limiting data efficiency, or, when geometry-aware, provide unreliable uncertainty estimates or require retraining to adapt. We propose a non-parametric approach leveraging geometric priors in scenarios of data scarcity and heteroscedastic uncertainties for probabilistic modeling. We utilize the method to formulate policies based on time or robot state, where non-separable diagonal kernels allow capturing uncertainty relations between degrees of freedom for same-sized in- and outputs. Fast updates, requiring less than 3 ms for a trajectory involving both position and orientation are possible through an optimized formulation. Our approach supports both manifold-valued input and manifold-valued output with large orientation changes. Using task parameterization, adaptation to different object poses is easily possible. We evaluate the approach on a set of toy examples and on real robot manipulation tasks both in autonomous execution and in shared control scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用几何先验的非参数概率建模方法，用于从人类演示中学习概率策略，支持流形输入/输出、异方差不确定性、快速更新与任务参数化适应。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示学习概率策略需要数据高效且能快速适应新场景。现有非参数（多为核方法）方案要么忽略机器人中常见的流形几何，导致数据效率低；要么虽具几何感知能力，却提供不可靠的不确定性估计或需重新训练才能适应。
AI.method: 提出一种在数据稀缺与异方差不确定性场景下利用几何先验的非参数概率建模方法。基于时间或机器人状态制定策略；采用不可分离对角核，在相同维度的输入输出间捕捉各自由度之间的不确定性关系；通过优化公式实现快速更新；支持流形值输入与流形值输出（含大姿态变化）；借助任务参数化实现适应。
AI.result: 包含位置与姿态的整条轨迹更新耗时少于3 ms；在若干玩具示例以及真实机器人操作任务中进行了评估，涵盖自主执行与共享控制场景。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在数据稀缺下结合几何先验实现高效概率建模，兼顾流形输入输出、可靠不确定性估计与快速自适应，适用于真实机器人操作与共享控制任务。

title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

AI.tldr: 提出SPEEDRUNBENCH基准，通过9款游戏的速通任务评估前沿LLM智能体的策略形成能力，发现其在简单平台游戏中接近人类世界纪录，但在更长更复杂游戏中仍落后于人类。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体已能解决人类有可测解法的复杂任务，关键问题是它们能否超越人类已有解法。当缺乏上下文或训练数据时，人类既有方案不足，发展复杂策略的能力变得至关重要。速通实践需要对游戏机制的深刻理解与非正统玩法探索，是研究策略形成的理想场景。
AI.method: 构建SPEEDRUNBENCH基准，覆盖9款不同游戏，要求智能体反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已有知识，并在长时程动作序列上进行推理，以不断挑战"比自己及他人更快"这一递进难题。
AI.result: 实验表明，前沿智能体在简单平台游戏中接近人类世界纪录，但在实际预算下，在更长、更复杂的游戏中仍落后于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: SPEEDRUNBENCH是研究智能体策略形成能力的有效测试平台，同时因其几乎总有更快的通關时间等待被发掘，成为抗饱和的评估度量。

title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories.
