To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSJEV，一种面向遥感场景分类的一次性多模态决策框架，将分类重构为候选条件化的多模态判别决策过程，通过OnePass Decider直接估计类别概率，在三个基准上性能优越且推理成本低。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感场景分类方法存在三类局限：任务特定视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间；CLIP类方法通过静态图文对齐进行识别；多模态大模型（MLLM）对具有明确候选类别的分类任务引入不必要的token级自回归生成，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出RSJEV一次性多模态决策框架，将场景分类重构为候选条件化的多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表示、任务指令与候选类别语义；设计OnePass Decider提取多模态决策状态，并在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，从而消除自回归解码，同时保留视觉-语言交互。
AI.result: 在UC Merced、AID和NWPU-RESISC45三个遥感场景分类基准上，RSJEV性能优于代表性的CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；同时显著降低推理成本，仅用0.8B参数的紧凑模型实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明状态条件化的多模态决策机制对高效遥感图像理解是有效的，为分类任务提供了一种兼顾性能与效率的新范式。

title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization.It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity.Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出神经运动层级网络(NHN)，从任务监督中学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态，在emg2pose与emg2qwerty上以更少参数取得更优解码性能。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电(sEMG)是 wearable、非侵入式的人机接口，但群体规模解码困难：sEMG与神经肌肉活动的关系随用户和会话变化，任务相关动态跨越通道与多个时间尺度；直接从任务标签学习波形到输出的映射，会把"记录变异性"与"协调运动活动"混为一体而无法显式区分。
AI.method: NHN 以受神经运动组织启发的层级结构构建潜在状态：自适应记录统计量同时保留相对强度；时空编码器采用参数高效的通道交互，并用多时间尺度历史调制特征；由此得到已学习运动基元的候选激活，经时间积分与连续加权形成神经运动状态。文中还从理论上刻画了核心机制的高效性、时间行为与优化特性。
AI.result: emg2pose上，相对Hadidi等人最佳任务专用变体，NHN在Regression与Tracking的全部三种泛化划分中把用户平均角度误差降低0.52%–2.84%，参数减少48.42%–48.51%。emg2qwerty上，相对SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search字符错误率零样本降低19.40%、微调后降低30.42%，参数减少65.86%。
AI.conclusion: 生理学引导的潜在神经运动状态推断，能够支撑参数高效的sEMG解码。

title: Magnet-Aware Control of Legged Robots
summary: Autonomous robots can increase uptime and reduce human exposure in Big Science facilities, but strong magnetic fields needed for their operation corrupt sensors and induce pose-dependent mechanical wrenches that destabilize robots and challenge conventional reactive controllers. This paper presents a control framework for modeling, estimating, and dynamically compensating for spatially varying magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots to improve robustness in these fields. We introduce a custom physics plugin for the MuJoCo simulator to model magnetic forces on rigid-body elements, alongside an inverse field-estimation framework to infer the latent magnetic field directly from quadruped dynamic responses and any number of sensor readings. Furthermore, we develop a Magnet-Aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) architecture that predicts and counteracts magnetic perturbations during locomotion to increase the range of magnetic fields in which the robot can operate. The effectiveness of the framework is validated through both simulation and physical hardware experiments. We show our method increases the the maximum rejectable disturbances from magnetic field in the force space by a factor of 2.5 and and between 1.6-2 times in torque space compared to a non-compensated system. Within the proposed magnetic field, this constitutes an increase in the area in which the robot can operate by 29,34% of which 10,84% would have previously caused an immediate collapse to non-compensated controllers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向腿足机器人的控制框架，用于建模、估计并动态补偿大科学装置中随空间变化的磁场力/力矩扰动，提升机器人在强磁场下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大科学装置中的自主机器人可提高运行时间并减少人员暴露，但强磁场会干扰传感器并产生与位姿相关的机械扰动力矩，导致机器人失稳，传统反应式控制器难以应对。
AI.method: 1) 为MuJoCo开发自定义物理插件，对刚体单元的磁力进行建模；2) 提出逆磁场估计框架，从四足机器人动力学响应及任意数量传感器读数中推断潜在磁场；3) 构建磁感知模型预测控制（MPC）与全身控制（WBC）架构，在运动过程中预测并抵消磁扰动。
AI.result: 仿真与实机实验验证了框架有效性：相比无补偿系统，最大可抵抗磁扰动力提升2.5倍，力矩空间提升1.6–2倍；可运行区域增加29.34%，其中10.84%的区域在无补偿控制器下会导致立即失稳。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过磁场建模、在线估计与磁感知MPC/WBC补偿，显著扩展了腿足机器人在强磁场环境中的可运行范围与扰动容忍度。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 αTransfer 范式：在同系列模型中，合并系数上的性能分布高度一致，因此可在小代理模型上搜索最优合并系数并直接迁移到大模型，显著降低模型合并的成本。
AI.motivation: 模型合并通过参数算术将多个微调检查点合并为单一模型，但寻找最优合并系数需大量搜索；随模型规模与数量增长，搜索空间组合爆炸且显存需求高，代价过高。
AI.method: 观察到同一模型族内不同规模模型在合并系数上的性能分布高度相似（分布相似性）；据此提出 αTransfer：在小代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，再直接将其迁移到更大的目标模型，无需在大模型上重复搜索。
AI.result: 在多种合并方法、模型族与任务上验证 αTransfer：视觉 Transformer 上实现 6× 加速与 70% 显存降低；大语言模型上实现 20× 加速与 85% 显存降低，且性能相当。
AI.conclusion: αTransfer 是一种高效且可泛化的模型合并扩展方法，利用同族模型的分布相似性避免大模型上的昂贵系数搜索。

title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出前瞻学习(Prospective Learning)及自我回溯蒸馏(SRD),利用事后轨迹经验监督交互前的预见性预测,在奖励对比稀缺时补充RLVR学习信号。
AI.motivation: RLVR依赖交互后的标量结果奖励,在组相对目标下当同组rollout奖励相同时信号消失,即使轨迹中蕴含任务要求与失败模式的信息。研究问题:事后经验能否教会智能体在行动前应预见什么。
AI.method: 前瞻学习用事后经验监督来自交互前视角的预见预测,实例化为SRD:完成轨迹揭示有用知识与应避免的陷阱,SRD将这种特权后见蒸馏为同一策略的轨迹盲预见。预见仅作训练目标,推理时无需显式生成。
AI.result: 在10个工具集成推理与长时程智能体任务上,SRD相较RLVR与自蒸馏基线提升最高达24.2个百分点。当37%-98%的rollout组奖励均匀时优势尤为明显。2B设置下98%组全失败时,RLVR成功率为0.0%,加入SRD达60.6%(相同rollout预算)。
AI.conclusion: 事后智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改进行为,还可用于在交互前塑造预测性表征,为RLVR在奖励对比稀缺场景提供互补学习信号。

title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

AI.tldr: 冻结的VideoLLM内部已存在线性可读的"证据就绪"信号，可据此构建回答时机策略以提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 流式视频-语言模型不仅要决定答案内容，还需判断当前问题所需证据是否已到达。现有系统将此判断作为独立训练的触发器，本文探究未被修改的模型是否本就内在计算了这一信号。
AI.method: 从带时间戳的证据（而非模型输出）标注就绪标签，在7个模型上对冻结激活做线性探测；以字节级相同的窗口做问题条件对照（仅改问题）；在延迟匹配的回答选择上与不确定性估计器比较；并与已发布的训练触发器的读出一致性/正交性进行对比；最终提出Readiness Gating回答时机策略。
AI.result: 就绪信号在7个模型中均可解码（AUROC 0.733-0.905）；无本族视频训练的探针仍可泛化；问题条件性强（66.1%的配对读反）；错误回答中AUROC仍为0.722；优于不确定性估计器及其有监督组合，且比置信度更贴近人类判断；训练触发器与就绪近似正交；Readiness Gating在相同视频时长下最高提升+9.75个百分点，且增益随任务精度余量变化。
AI.conclusion: 证据就绪性可由冻结VideoLLM的激活线性读出，且问题条件、与置信度/不确定性独立、对错误答案仍存在；利用该信号可在极低开销下改进回答时机与准确率，增益大小由任务可用精度余量决定。

title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
summary: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.

AI.tldr: 提出BAR框架，在医学知识图谱上进行预算感知的LLM推理，通过证据图精炼、计划-导航-验证循环和强化学习策略，提升出院后风险预测性能与引用精度，同时控制成本。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录中出院时观测与下游并发症之间的依赖关系（如共病级联、药物-疾病相互作用）缺失，导致出院后风险预测困难；外部医学知识图谱可补充这些依赖，但追溯它们需要满足三个性质：图谱探索成本有界、检索证据按来源质量区分、推理依据可引用以供回溯审查。现有基于LLM的方法无法同时满足这三点。
AI.method: BAR将原始知识图谱精炼为疾病特定证据图，边携带支持分数与溯源记录，形成质量标注的推理空间；LLM通过"计划-导航-验证"循环在此图上推理：分解问题为步骤、在患者特定预算下检索证据、验证失败时修正；训练推理策略，奖励函数对比有无获取证据时的预测，并结合获取成本与引用完整性项。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，覆盖8种疾病和3个预测时间窗，BAR相比最强基线AUPRC提升3.4个百分点，引用精度从59.8%提升至77.9%，仅消耗预算上限的62-65%。
AI.conclusion: BAR通过预算感知的LLM知识图谱推理，联合满足成本有界、质量区分与可引用三重需求，显著优于现有方法。

title: NMPP: Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning for Agile UAV Flight in Cluttered Environments
summary: Flying a quadrotor through a cluttered environment requires not only planning a collision-free reference trajectory based on perceived obstacles, but the reference also needs to be dynamically feasible and within the actuation limits of the vehicle, so that the controller can track it precisely. Existing methods either optimize a smooth polynomial inside a convex corridor, which limits agility, or treat obstacles as soft costs traded against tracking performance. We propose a Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning (NMPP) that imposes perceived obstacles as hard geometric constraints and hands a full-state reference to an obstacle-blind SE(3) controller. Our planner achieves a 58-67 % lower position RMSE than a linear Model Predictive Control trajectory planner and a 41-70 % lower RMSE than a polynomial trajectory planner. It also completes all forest flights with up to 9.5 m/s speed without collisions, and achieves 86 % flight success rate under a more aggressive speed profile where a state-of-the-art planner has only 26 % success rate. The real-world deployment showed reliable execution flying up to 5.5 m/s in an unknown cluttered environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非线性模型预测规划（NMPP），将感知到的障碍作为硬几何约束，并把全状态参考交给盲障碍的SE(3)控制器，从而在杂乱环境中实现精确、高动态的无碰撞飞行。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼穿越杂乱环境时，参考轨迹不仅需基于感知障碍实现无碰撞，还必须动态可行且满足执行器限制，以便控制器精确跟踪。现有方法要么在凸走廊内优化平滑多项式（限制敏捷性），要么将障碍作为软代价与跟踪性能折衷。
AI.method: 提出NMPP：将感知障碍施加为硬几何约束，并向不感知障碍的SE(3)控制器提供全状态参考。
AI.result: 位置RMSE比线性MPC轨迹规划器低58-67%，比多项式轨迹规划器低41-70%；在森林飞行中以最高9.5 m/s速度完成全部飞行且无碰撞；在更激进速度剖面下达到86%飞行成功率，而某最先进规划器仅26%；真实部署中在未知杂乱环境下以最高5.5 m/s可靠执行。
AI.conclusion: NMPP通过硬约束与全状态参考、结合盲障碍SE(3)控制器，在跟踪精度、敏捷性与飞行成功率上显著优于现有规划方法，并具备真实环境部署能力。

title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
summary: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计三个实验室的三值语言模型导出流程，发现文档化的“先转bf16再导出”步骤会使部分三值码偏离fp32量化结果，并在微调端点上造成严重的贪婪GSM8K严格准确率崩塌；两类兼容性补救方法均可恢复至在线评估的非劣效标准。
AI.motivation: 三值语言模型（如BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E、BitCPM）以高精度潜权重微调后，需经由导出步骤生成三值码部署；实验室文档化流程在导出前先将潜权重转为bf16。作者怀疑该bf16中间转换会改变最终部署的三值码，从而影响模型行为，因此对多家实验室的流程进行审计并量化其后果。
AI.method: 审计三个实验室的发布检查点：比较fp32量化结果与部署码的不一致比例；分析不一致码的成因（bf16舍入落在阈值上、ties-to-even映射为零）；验证未修改的onebitllms导出器能否逐字节复现Falcon-E发布版本。在微调端点上，以匹配“学习率-到-bf16-ULP比值”的方式选择学习率，比较文档化导出与在线评估的贪婪GSM8K严格准确率；另对BitNet 2B-4T施加bf16保存-重载。评估两种兼容性补救方案：(1)直接写入训练量化器的码；(2)调整bf16输入直到未修改工具输出这些码，均以4点严格准确率非劣效标准检验。最后通过随机化干预初始距阈值距离，考察码选择对距离的依赖。
AI.result: 发布的检查点中，fp32量化与部署码的不一致率为：Falcon-E和BitCPM为0.83–1.77%，BitNet 2B-4T为1.530%；Falcon-E和BitCPM的不一致大多源于bf16舍入恰好落在阈值上、ties-to-even将其映射为零；未修改的onebitllms导出器可逐字节复现全部四个Falcon-E发布版本。微调端点上，文档化导出将贪婪GSM8K严格准确率从58.79%降至0.78%（Falcon-E-1B-Base），从36.13%降至0.39%（BitCPM-CANN-0.5B）；bf16保存-重载使BitNet 2B-4T严格准确率下降27.54个百分点而末位数字准确率上升。两种补救方案在三个模型上均满足相对于在线评估的4点严格准确率非劣效标准。
AI.conclusion: 文档化的bf16中间转换导出是导致部署三值码偏离训练量化器码、并引发微调模型准确率灾难性下降的关键缺陷；该偏差在多个模型家族中可复现且成因明确（阈值附近的bf16舍入与ties-to-even）。直接写入训练量化器的码或调整bf16输入以令原工具输出目标码，是可在三模型中满足非劣效标准的两类兼容性补救。随机化干预还表明，微调所改变的码选择具有距离依赖性。

title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

AI.tldr: 提出 POLAR 护栏框架，通过双层可逆性本体为工具调用型小智能体赋予分级可逆性评分并执行前剪枝，在 τ²-bench 上部分模型-域有提升但整体不稳健。
AI.motivation: LLM 工具使用智能体在动态环境中面临操作风险，但多数安全机制仅在错误发生后响应；现有前置方法（微调思维链、将自然语言护栏编译为运行时检查）缺乏结构化、可审计的判定依据。
AI.method: POLAR 是一种面向小规模工具调用智能体的护栏框架，基于结构化双层本体评估动作可逆性：为每个动作推导候选逆操作序列，据此给出分级可逆性评分，低于阈值的调用在执行前被剪枝。
AI.result: 在 τ²-bench 六个智能体模型上评估：airline 域中六个模型里四个平均任务奖励提升 0.11–0.18；但十八个模型-域单元中仅八个整体改善，retail 域及更强模型常出现回退。
AI.conclusion: POLAR 提供了可审计的结构化检查并刻画了其任务效用权衡；需注意奖励并非防止危害的直接度量。

title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
summary: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sparse2comm：将不可靠协同视为渐进式恢复，通过稀疏特征编码、延迟感知对齐与自校准融合，在超低带宽下鲁棒提升协同3D检测。
AI.motivation: 协同感知可提升自动驾驶3D检测，但受带宽受限与通信不可靠制约；丢包、传输延迟与空间失配会共同退化协同特征流。现有方法多仅降低通信成本或补偿单一退化类型，对耦合扰动处理不足。
AI.method: 提出Sparse2comm框架，把不可靠协同建模为对退化协同特征的渐进式恢复。1) 稀疏特征编码：以随机掩码采样的前景特征作为通信内容，自车据此重建稠密语义表示，稀疏到稠密机制从稀疏观测推断缺失的物体中心内容，同一表示兼顾超低带宽与丢包恢复；2) 延迟感知对齐：在语义恢复特征上预测运动流以补偿延迟消息；3) 自校准融合：以自监督方式估计残余空间偏移，再进行自适应跨智能体融合。整体按有序流水线恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V、V2V4Real上，Sparse2comm保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单一及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。相比选择性特征通信基线Where2comm，混合设置下AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升+20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
AI.conclusion: 将通信压缩与多类退化补偿统一为分层恢复流程，可在低带宽条件下有效应对丢包、延迟与空间失配的耦合影响，为鲁棒协同3D检测提供可行方案。

title: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A single model adversarially pretrained at scale can achieve optimal robustness on new tasks without additional task-specific training. Specifically, we show that, for a family of Gaussian-mixture classification tasks, a sufficiently deep linear transformer adversarially trained across tasks can asymptotically attain the robust Bayes error on previously unseen tasks through in-context learning from clean demonstrations. By contrast, a standardly trained model cannot. We further analyze convergence under gradient flow, an accuracy--robustness trade-off, and demonstration complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗预训练得到的鲁棒性能否无需额外对抗训练即迁移至未见任务。作者证明：对一类高斯混合分类任务，足够深的线性Transformer经大规模对抗预训练后，可通过上下文学习（in-context learning）在未见任务上渐近达到鲁棒贝叶斯误差，而标准训练模型无法做到。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练是抵御对抗攻击最可靠的防御之一，但其计算开销对每个任务都需重新付出。鲁棒基础模型提供了一种替代方案：只需对抗预训练一次，再通过轻量适配将鲁棒性迁移到下游任务。然而一个根本问题尚未解决——预训练阶段获得的鲁棒性，能否在不再进行对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务？
AI.method: 作者针对一类高斯混合分类任务，采用足够深的线性Transformer进行跨任务对抗预训练，并分析其通过上下文学习（基于干净示范）在新任务上的表现；同时从梯度流（gradient flow）角度分析收敛性、精度–鲁棒性权衡以及示范复杂度。
AI.result: 研究给出肯定回答：单个经大规模对抗预训练的模型无需任务特定训练即可在新任务上取得最优鲁棒性。具体地，充分深的线性Transformer在跨任务对抗训练后可渐近达到未见任务的鲁棒贝叶斯误差，而标准训练模型无法达到。作者进一步刻画了梯度流下的收敛、精度–鲁棒性权衡与示范复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 对抗预训练获得的鲁棒性可以在无需任务特定对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务，前提是模型具备足够深度与规模，并能通过上下文学习利用干净示范。该结论为构建可复用的鲁棒基础模型提供了理论支持。

title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
summary: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.

AI.tldr: EgoLAP：通过语言动作思维链联合人类与机器人轨迹预训练的VLA框架，将运动意图抽象为语言动作，实现跨具身迁移，真实任务进度达80.1%。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人类数据可突破昂贵的机器人示教限制，但人类与机器人的具身差异（embodiment gap）使原始人类轨迹难以直接作为控制监督信号。作者的关键洞察是：底层动作虽具具身特异性，但其运动意图可捕获跨人类与机器人可迁移的任务相关结构。
AI.method: 提出EgoLAP——一种VLA预训练框架，通过学习共享的、基于语言的动作思维链（language-based action chain-of-thought），联合人类与机器人轨迹进行训练。具体将运动意图表示为结构化、时间抽象的语言动作，并与基于场景几何、物理和物体可供性的运动级推理相配对。
AI.result: 在大量真实世界与仿真实验中，EgoLAP将人类经验迁移至机器人控制的效果优于其他动作表示，真实任务平均进度达80.1%，较其他动作表示提升2.3倍。运动级推理亦优于结合子任务、物体框与视觉轨迹的复合推理格式。
AI.conclusion: 以运动意图为核心的语言动作思维链是实现人类经验向机器人控制迁移的有效监督目标，运动级推理优于显式空间/视觉标注式推理，为跨具身规模化机器人学习提供了可行路径。

title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

AI.tldr: QRAKEN 是一个免训练、本体无关的神经符号流水线，通过离线蒸馏生成的 TTQL（包含多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例及类-属性共现矩阵）来引导 LLM 生成 SPARQL，并用确定性语法、词表与数据模型检查迭代精化；在 CK25 上严格 F1 达 0.643–0.652，较最强复现参赛系统相对提升 30%–32%。
AI.motivation: 自然语言访问 RDF 知识图谱是语义网的核心目标，LLM 虽推进了 Text-to-SPARQL，但在陌生图上常生成语法有效却违背实际数据模型的查询（按 schema 预期而非实际填充数据推理）。因此需要将生成过程锚定在图谱的经验证据上，而非依赖本体/schema 假设。
AI.method: 免训练、本体无关的神经符号流水线。离线蒸馏器产生 TTQL：填充多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例的紧凑描述，外加类-属性共现矩阵。在线阶段由 TTQL 引导 LLM，并以确定性语法、词汇表与数据模型检查提供诊断用于迭代精化。
AI.result: 在 CK25（首届国际 Text2SPARQL 挑战赛）上，基于 QLever 快照在匹配条件下重算：GPT-4.1 mini 严格 F1 = 0.643 ± 0.026，GPT-5.4 = 0.652 ± 0.012，较最强复现参赛系统相对提升 30% 与 32%，优于使用相同基础模型族的系统。消融显示 TTQL 模式是主要驱动（相比仅 shape 基线 +0.31 严格 F1）；精化循环提供低成本安全网，拒绝共现矩阵不支持的 triple 模式。相比自动推导的 SHACL，TTQL 严格 F1 高 64%。两个本地 35B 4-bit 开源权重模型在零边际成本下达到最强复现参赛系统水平，且相对 shape-only 与 SHACL 基线的 TTQL 优势依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明经验模式优于单纯 schema 暴露，TTQL 对陌生图上的 Text-to-SPARQL 有显著增益且成本可控；但结果仅来自单一、相对较小的基准，属初步经验信号，主要局限是在高度开放的跨领域图上单体式 TTQL 注入效果受限。

title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
summary: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨联邦学习在皮肤病变分割中的可行性，在ISIC 2018与PH2数据集上验证其性能接近集中式训练且优于本地训练。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌早期检测与病灶精确勾画至关重要，病变分割是计算机辅助诊断的基础步骤。传统深度学习分割模型依赖集中式训练，需将图像与标注掩膜汇聚到中央服务器，这在医疗场景中引发隐私问题，并需要大量集中式计算资源。
AI.method: 使用ISIC 2018皮肤病变分割挑战赛的训练集与验证集模拟分布式学习环境，构建联邦学习分割模型，并在ISIC 2018测试集和PH2数据集上评估其性能与泛化能力。
AI.result: 联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，并持续优于各本地独立训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明联邦学习可在不集中汇聚医学图像的前提下实现协作式皮肤病变分割，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Towards an Extensible Benchmark for Spoken Dialogue with Social Robots
comment: Accepted to and presented at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Human-Robot Dialogue
summary: Language models provide a plug-and-play interface between humans and robots, but important challenges remain when speech, dialogue, fast interaction, and collaboration are required. We propose a benchmark for the community to use as a way to explore common spoken dialogue artifacts between robots and humans, including requests for clarification, interruptions, embodied signals (e.g., head nods or facial cues), and time constraints. We also explain our vision to extend the benchmark for other aspects of human-robot interaction that are important to the larger research community. To facilitate the benchmark, we further propose using \textit{Retico}, a real-time communication framework that fulfills important technical requirements to enable robots to have spoken dialogue capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于人机语音对话交互的基准测试，并倡议使用实时通信框架Retico来满足机器人语音对话的技术需求。
AI.motivation: 语言模型为人机交互提供了即插即用接口，但当涉及语音、对话、快速交互与协作时仍存在重要挑战。作者希望为社区提供一个可探索机器人与人类之间常见语音对话现象的基准。
AI.method: 提出一个基准，用于探索机器人与人类之间常见的口语对话现象，包括澄清请求、打断、具身信号（如点头或面部线索）以及时间约束；并提出使用实时通信框架Retico以满足机器人具备语音对话能力所需的重要技术要求。作者还阐述了将该基准扩展到其他重要人机交互方面的愿景。
AI.result: 该工作提出了基准及配套的实时通信框架Retico，作为支持机器人语音对话能力的技术基础，并为社区提供探索人机口语对话现象的平台。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准与Retico框架，可推动人机语音对话交互研究，并具备向更广泛人机交互方面扩展的潜力。

title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"执行一致性"定义，通过状态使用、信息交接与终态一致等职责及其证据条件来判定任务是否满足，并指出相同记录可对应合规与违规执行；为此提出CAVERT框架从日志中抽取关系并进行一致性诊断与恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有工作关注共享记忆对智能体动作的协调以及记录的正确性，但记录正确并不意味着动作满足任务要求。记忆治理与故障诊断只负责规范或检查所记录信息，本身无法说明这些信息是否足以判定任务职责是否被履行，因此需要一个基于职责与证据条件的执行一致性判定标准。
AI.method: 作者将执行一致性定义为约束状态使用、信息交接与最终状态一致的职责集合，并给出判定职责是否履行的显式证据条件。通过受控地移除回执、动作依赖、响应有效性等证据，检验保留记录在合规与违规执行间的可区分性；并借助自然日志标注验证所定义违规在真实执行中的存在。进一步提出CAVERT框架，从日志中抽取被支持的关系并应用该判定标准，用于一致性诊断与恢复。
AI.result: 受控移除证据后，82.4%的相反标签执行对变得不可区分；恢复证据后，97.9%的合并对可被重新区分。自然日志标注能够在实际执行中识别出所定义的违规。CAVERT在全部12组基准-执行器设置中，一致性诊断均优于契约提示的LLM与规则基线；在相同门控与执行器限制下，其在全部4个评估环境中也优于规则引导的恢复方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出智能体记忆与执行接口为可靠判定所应保留的执行证据，表明仅靠记录正确不足以判定职责履行，需保留回执、动作依赖、响应有效性等关系证据，CAVERT验证了该定义在诊断与恢复上的实用价值。

title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
summary: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

AI.tldr: 本文以预训练 Stable Diffusion 为骨干，用 2D 基础模型的伪深度监督微调激光雷达条件深度模型，并在训练中随机抽取不同线束预算，量化从重度稀疏激光雷达输入中可恢复的扫描信息量。
AI.motivation: 高线束激光雷达成本高昂，但感知流程往往需要密集角度采样，因此需要探索在有限线束预算下能恢复多少激光雷达扫描信息，并刻画恢复能力与分辨率之间的权衡。
AI.method: 使用预训练 Stable Diffusion 作为骨干网络，以 2D 基础模型生成的伪深度作为目标，微调一个激光雷达条件深度模型；训练时对激光雷达条件按不同线束预算随机抽取（decimate）；在 nuScenes 上基于物理上严格留出的真实线束进行评估，并将“恢复能力”与“拟合精度”分开报告。
AI.result: 模型在极稀疏区间优势最大：从 4 线束输入获得 δ_{1.25} 精度 66.8%，而散点插值仅 45.1%；按类别分层的误差分析表明，平面表面最先恢复，而引入深度不连续性的物体最早退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了由基础模型引导的激光雷达增强中的恢复—分辨率权衡，表明该类方法在重度稀疏的激光雷达输入下最具价值，可用于缓解高线束激光雷达成本与密集采样需求之间的矛盾。

title: Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/OFAG, allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OFAG，一个面向属性图聚类的"一次训练、处处可用"基础模型。它基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN），从合成属性图中学习可复用的聚类推理策略，采用维度无关的信号级图编码器与超球聚类目标，单次前向即可输出聚类友好表示。在十个数据集上，一个冻结模型在 NMI、ACC、ARI、F1 上取得最优平均性能与平均排名，且全部处理仅需 12.43 分钟，比次快基线快 6 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 属性图聚类需联合利用节点属性与图拓扑，但其无监督特性使模型选择与适配极为困难。现有方法通常为每个输入图单独训练和调参，流程昂贵且脆弱，难以迁移到特征空间、结构模式及属性—结构相关性各异的图。
AI.method: 提出 OFAG 基础模型。基于 Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFN），在覆盖潜在簇、节点属性与图结构的广泛先验下生成合成属性图，从中学习可复用的聚类推理策略。为处理不兼容的特征空间，采用维度无关（dimension-agnostic）的信号级图编码器，将每个特征通道视为一个图信号并建模其对共享图滤波器的响应。训练使用超球（hyperspherical）聚类目标，推理时单次前向即产生聚类友好的节点表示。
AI.result: 在十个数据集上，单个冻结的 OFAG 模型在 NMI、ACC、ARI、F1 四项指标上均取得最佳平均性能与平均排名；全部十个数据集总耗时 12.43 分钟，比第二快基线快 6 倍以上，在聚类质量上比次优方法快近 28 倍。
AI.conclusion: OFAG 实现了无需图特定训练、微调或超参搜索的一次性训练与直接跨图应用，验证了属性图聚类"一次训练、处处可用"的可行性。代码与预训练权重已开源，实践者可直接应用于自有属性图数据集而无需额外训练或调参。

title: PhoneBot: A Low-Cost Open Humanoid Robot Platform Reusing Smartphones
summary: The adoption of humanoid robots in education and research remains limited by high hardware costs, complex sensing systems, and substantial computational requirements. This paper presents PhoneBot, a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its primary sensing and computing unit. By using a smartphone's integrated inertial measurement unit (IMU), camera, wireless connectivity, and onboard processing capabilities, PhoneBot reduces hardware costs and simplifies the system architecture. The robot combines a modular lower-body structure driven by 13 low-cost actuators with a torso-mounted smartphone that supports perception, control computation, and user interaction. We describe the mechanical design, software architecture, and real-time communication framework that support stable locomotion and capabilities including vision-based human following, conversational interaction, filming, and mobile telepresence. Experimental evaluations demonstrate reliable walking, perception-driven interaction, and straightforward deployment using off-the-shelf consumer smartphones. With fully open-source hardware and software designs, PhoneBot provides an affordable, reproducible platform for education, research, and rapid prototyping. More details are available at https://phonebot.dev.

AI.tldr: PhoneBot：以智能手机为核心感知与计算单元的低成本开源人形机器人平台。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在教育科研中受限于高硬件成本、复杂传感系统与高算力需求，难以普及。
AI.method: 复用智能手机的IMU、摄像头、无线通信与本地算力，替代专用传感器与计算模块；硬件上采用13个低成本执行器驱动的模块化下肢结构，躯干搭载手机；并配套机械设计、软件架构与实时通信框架。
AI.result: 实验显示可实现稳定行走、基于视觉的人体跟随、对话交互、拍摄与移动临场等功能，并可基于市售消费级手机直接部署。
AI.conclusion: PhoneBot以全开源软硬件提供可负担、可复现的平台，适用于教育、研究与快速原型开发。

title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
summary: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 DSV-Mem 基准，评估对话式 MLLM 智能体的"密集型有状态视觉记忆"能力，覆盖专业工作流中多版本、频繁更新、需精确追踪状态的重型视觉工件场景。27 种配置下最强基线低于 45%，表明状态演化（尤其是治理更新次数）是主要困难来源。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式多模态大模型（MLLM）智能体基准多聚焦非正式日常交互与个人生活场景，特征为摄影类自然图像、孤立静态工件和回忆型问题。而专业场景涉及结构化、信息密集、经历频繁修订与权限更新的工件，以及需跨多个工件版本进行状态协调与精确追踪的组合式查询，这一能力尚未被充分探索，因此需要专门的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 DSV-Mem 基准，包含专家审阅的场景与 1,000 道问题，分为五类用户导向类别：当前状态、历史状态、派生状态、变更历史、冲突/拒答。采用受 Hartley 信息量启发的准则，偏好需要更广泛视觉证据核查的问题。同时提出生成式评测套件构建框架（harness），将状态转移合成与对话填充解耦，从而可规模化生成评测集。
AI.result: 在覆盖前沿与开源权重模型以及多种记忆管理方法的 27 种配置上进行评测，最强基线得分低于 45%。关键发现：1）多模态性与信息密度均增加难度，但状态演化（尤其是治理更新次数）是被测因素中的主导因素；原始对话/大海捞针长度、OCR 与算术并非主要瓶颈；2）模型常在回答前未依据先前状态更新验证用户前提；3）增加推理投入与记忆管理方法收益有限，而状态感知设计更有效。
AI.conclusion: 专业工作流中的有状态视觉记忆是当前对话式 MLLM 智能体的显著短板，现有模型与记忆管理方法难以应对状态频繁演化的挑战；状态感知设计（而非单纯增加推理投入或通用记忆管理）是更有前景的方向。基准与代码将公开释放，以推动该方向的后续研究。

title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
summary: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE) 框架，将预训练模型中稀疏的、对来源敏感的内部组件视为"取证储备"，通过结构约束实现轻量适配，仅用 500 张标注图像和不到 0.2% 的可训练参数即可实现竞争性的生成图像伪造检测性能。
AI.motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠的伪造检测对维护视觉信息可信度至关重要。然而现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型的表征，未能充分利用模型内部的取证知识来指导检测，因而存在局限。
AI.method: 1) 使用 Forensic Lens (F-lens) 将各层与各 token 组的激活分解为独立组件，依据其在真实与生成图像间的响应差异进行全局筛选，识别储备位点与方向；2) 将选定方向映射回隐状态空间，构建固定的储备子空间，仅在识别出的位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；3) 固定主干参数、已拟合的参考分类器和子空间基，仅训练 FRA 系数图，生成受子空间约束的输入相关残差更新，增强既有取证响应。
AI.result: 仅使用 500 张标注训练图像、可训练参数预算低于主干 0.2% 的情况下，RGE 在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即取得竞争性性能；并在涵盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八种编码器上一致优于对应的冻结检测器。
AI.conclusion: RGE 有效激发了预训练视觉模型中广泛共享的潜在取证能力，表明内部取证知识可被显式定位并转化为结构约束以指导轻量适配，为高效、通用的生成图像伪造检测提供了新思路。

title: Extending Pathwise Gradients to Discrete Random Variables via Finite-Order Relaxation
summary: Pathwise gradients are preferred for continuous random variables because they are unbiased, low variance, and work with a single sample. For discrete variables, however, the pathwise identity cannot generally be exact for every differentiable function. We propose a general framework to construct finite-order exact pathwise gradient estimators for a range of common discrete variables such as Poisson. The estimator is the least-norm solution among all solutions that are unbiased for polynomials of degree at most. The resulting estimators preserve the hard forward sample, require no temperature tuning, and can be implemented in a few lines of codes. Against other admissible solutions, our estimator is unique and minimizes weight variance; in contrast, prior works use categorical variables or augmented representations to approximate non-categorical variables that induces excess variance and computations. To understand approximation bias for functions beyond the prescribed class, we also derive a non-asymptotic bias bound. In experiments our low order methods match or improve tuned baselines across linear, nonlinear and hierarchical latent-variable models, while out-speeding competitors in every runtime benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种构造离散随机变量有限阶精确路径梯度估计器的通用框架，该估计器为在所有对某阶多项式无偏的解中范数最小者，保持硬前向采样、无需温度调节，且实现简单，在实验中匹配或优于调优基线并更快。
AI.motivation: 路径梯度对连续随机变量具有无偏、低方差、单样本可用等优点，但对离散变量，路径恒等式一般无法对任意可微函数精确成立。现有工作用类别变量或增广表示来近似非类别变量，会引入额外方差与计算开销。本文旨在为泊松等常见离散变量直接构造有限阶精确的路径梯度估计器。
AI.method: 提出通用框架构造离散变量的有限阶精确路径梯度估计器：在满足对次数不超过某阶多项式无偏的所有解中，取范数最小的解（least-norm solution）。该估计器保持硬前向采样，无需温度调节，几行代码即可实现。针对超出规定函数类的函数，推导非渐近偏差界以刻画近似偏差。
AI.result: 与其他可行解相比，该估计器唯一且最小化权重方差；相较之下，先前方法使用类别变量或增广表示近似非类别变量，导致过多方差与计算。实验中，低阶方法在线性、非线性及层次潜变量模型上匹配或改进了调优基线，并在所有运行时基准中快于竞争者。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为泊松等离散变量提供了有限阶精确的路径梯度估计器，兼具无偏性、唯一性与最小权重方差，无需温度调节，实现简便，在精度与运行效率上均具优势，为离散变量重参数化梯度估计提供了新的通用方案。

title: LBA-CBF: Rapidly Adaptive Safety Filters via Parallel Dynamics Inference
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) certify commands through an assumed dynamics model, so an abrupt, unmeasured regime change can undermine the certificate exactly when safety matters most. We present Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF), which rank a finite bank of candidate dynamics by recent prediction error over a short look-back window and enforce the high-order CBF condition against every model within a tolerance of the best, spanning best-fit adaptation to full-bank robust filtering. The dynamics may depend nonlinearly on the unknown parameters, and no switching model or continuously parameterized estimator is required. We prove that any feasible filtered input satisfies the true CBF condition whenever a safety-representative candidate is retained. In quadrotor simulation with abrupt wind reversals and an unknown payload, LBA-CBF is safe and reaches the goal from all random initial conditions, matching an oracle, while adaptive and robust baselines achieve 0-88% success. Banks of up to 250,000 models run inside the control loop, and Crazyflie 2.1 and F1TENTH experiments demonstrate adaptation to wind, payload release, and varying tire-road friction. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF)，用短回溯窗口内的预测误差对有限候选动力学库排序，并对所有落在最优容差内的模型同时施加高阶CBF约束，实现突发动力学变化下的安全控制，无需切换模型或连续参数估计器。
AI.motivation: CBF的安全证书依赖假设的动力学模型，当发生突发且不可测的工况改变（如阵风反转、负载变化）时，原证书失效，而这恰是安全最关键的時刻。现有自适应/鲁棒方法或需连续参数估计器，或过于保守，难以在突变场景下同时保证安全与任务可达。
AI.method: LBA-CBF维护一个有限候选动力学模型库，根据近期短回溯窗口内的预测误差对候选模型排序；以预测误差最优的模型为基准设定容差，对所有误差落在容差内的候选模型施加高阶CBF条件。动力学可非线性依赖未知参数，无需切换模型结构或连续参数估计器。通过容差可在"最优拟合自适应"与"全库鲁棒滤波"之间连续插值。理论上证明：只要保留一个具有安全代表性的候选模型，任何可行滤波输入均满足真实CBF条件。
AI.result: 在带突发风向反转与未知负载的四旋翼仿真中，LBA-CBF在所有随机初始条件下均安全并到达目标，性能匹配oracle；自适应与鲁棒基线成功率仅0–88%。模型库规模可达250,000个模型并实时运行于控制回路内。Crazyflie 2.1与F1TENTH实机实验验证了对风扰、负载释放及变化的路面摩擦的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: LBA-CBF通过回溯预测误差排序加容差内多模型CBF约束，为突发动力学变化提供了一种无需切换模型和连续估计的安全滤波框架，仿真与实机均验证其在可扩展性与适应速度上的优势。

title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
summary: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑模型合并中"在任务向量张成的子空间内搜索合并系数"这一标准做法的隐式正则化，发现去掉该正则化（直接优化合并模型权重）反而能显著提升性能，甚至优于部分现有合并方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法为在多任务上表现良好，通常借助额外数据集搜索任务特定权重更新的最佳线性组合系数。作者指出，这种做法隐含了一种正则化：把候选模型限制在任务特定权重更新所张成的子空间内。本文旨在探究这一正则化是否真的有益。
AI.method: 作者移除该隐式正则化，直接在权重空间中优化合并模型权重（而非仅优化子空间内的组合系数），并在多种架构、多个领域以及每类仅一个样本的极端数据受限场景下与常见合并方法及现有方法进行对比；同时分析了在子空间之外存在更优多任务权重的现象，并研究了使用额外数据集的不同策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，去掉该正则化后，常见合并方法在多架构、多领域乃至极端数据受限场景下性能显著提升；直接优化预训练模型权重甚至优于部分现有合并方法。分析显示更优的多任务权重存在于子空间之外，且可通过多种方法找到。
AI.conclusion: 该工作呼吁重新审视现有模型合并流程，鼓励更广泛地探索权重空间，并重新思考任务算术所诱导的隐式正则化。

title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartBmkAgent，从稀疏的错误分类学规格出发，按需构建完整的图表问答（Chart QA）诊断样本，实现"目标对齐"的自动化基准构建。
AI.motivation: MLLM 能力快速演进，而基准开发滞后，难以及时探查新出现的能力缺口。现有 Chart QA 自动化构建方法将"目标引导"与"从零生成"割裂：目标引导型依赖预先准备的数据、图表或模板，从零生成型只保证产物有效性，均无法显式控制新合成的要求与内容是否仍与外部指定的诊断目标保持一致。
AI.method: 提出 ChartBmkAgent：以稀疏的错误分类学规格为输入，生成完整 Chart QA 样本。构建过程中由一个中心化 harness 统辖多个专用 agent，要求每个阶段提供与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每次验收决策的依据，从而将已识别的能力缺口转化为有针对性的诊断证据。
AI.result: 在覆盖全部 300 个分类学样本上，MLLM 准确率区间为 32.7%–84.3%，且呈现不同的类别画像，说明生成样本能揭示能力差异。三组源模型比较中，定向后续问题得分 50.0%，匹配对照为 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶）；六组跨模型比较方向一致。多个评估模型判定 86.4% 的样本确实测得其指定错误类别，为"目标保持"提供实证。
AI.conclusion: ChartBmkAgent 证明了可从稀疏规格按需生成目标对齐的诊断数据：所生成样本既保留了指定错误类别的诊断意图（86.4% 达标），又能有效区分不同模型能力（准确率跨度 32.7%–84.3%，跨模型比较方向一致），从而缩短基准开发周期，支持对新观测到的能力缺口开展即时探查。

title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

AI.tldr: 视频-语言模型的评测准确率受采样网格相位这一未被报告的因素显著影响；PHASEFUSION 通过多相位网格后验平均，在相同预算下提升稳定性并保持准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅报告采样率（rate），忽略相位（phase）参数。仅改变半帧步长的相位偏移即可使23.6%的问题答案不同，而总分差异不足1分；跨两个系列四个版本仅改相位即可改变约五分之一的答案（控制选项顺序后）。因此需要指出相位是被遗漏的重要评测变量，并给出缓解方案。
AI.method: PHASEFUSION：对三个相位偏移网格（密集网格的多相分量）分别解码，并对各选项后验概率进行平均融合；同时用单次前向的答案边际（answer margin）来标记仅由选项顺序变化引起的波动。
AI.result: 融合方法在预设容差内（logit 打分）达到与32帧单次前向相当的准确率；同时将对三个网格同时施加半步步长相位偏移所改变的答案比例从18.2%降至10.1%。
AI.conclusion: 报告结果时应同时给出相位约定与帧预算，否则应对相位进行边缘化；否则基于均匀网格的评测将把相位噪声误当作模型差异。

title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EESD（演化环境流式数据集）与ServeLearnBench基准，覆盖零售客服、银行和销售话术生成三大领域，含53个环境窗口和7,718个任务，系统评估了持续学习型智能体在隐式、动态知识环境下的适应能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在真实环境中的正确行为依赖隐式、未公开且随时间变化的环境知识。现有持续学习评估基准仅提供部分覆盖：或直接给出目标知识，或假设静态环境，或虽支持持续适应但规模与知识多样性有限，导致这类方法的有效性与局限尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 形式化定义"演化环境流式数据集"（EESD）：智能体需从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修订潜在环境知识，且隐藏策略会随时间演化。构建ServeLearnBench基准，涵盖零售支持、银行、销售话术生成，包含53个环境窗口与7,718项任务。对5种学习框架（RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime）与6个模型（GPT-5.6 Terra、Opus 5、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 Flash）进行评测，共28个模型-框架组合、252次学习运行。
AI.result: 评测得出三项主要发现：(1) 任务能力与"从经验中学习"的能力之间存在显著差距；(2) 持续适应代价高昂，且可能使原本正确的行为退化；(3) 探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ServeLearnBench为诊断上述局限、追踪智能体通过服务经验实现持续可靠改进的进展，提供了一个受控的测试平台。

title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://www.jaibardhan.com/depthworld. 32 pages including supplementary material, 15 figures, 7 tables
summary: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出标定流水线与 DepthWorld 世界模型，引入 DROID-3D 数据集，实现多视角 RGB 与深度的联合预测，兼顾几何一致性与视频先验。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视频的世界模型仅用 RGB 训练，逐帧看似正确但无法构成一致的 3D 世界；而弥补这一差距需要两方面进展：面向操作任务的大规模 3D 监督，以及不破坏预训练视频先验、可吸收该监督的架构。
AI.method: 1) 标定流水线：结合学习到的立体深度与联合因子图，汇聚同一物理机器人采集的所有 episode，联合恢复其共享运动学参数与每场景外参，应用于 DROID 得到 DROID-3D 数据集（稠密度量深度与重标定的多视角外参）。2) DepthWorld：基于 Stable Video Diffusion 的世界模型，通过空间隐变量分块（spatial latent tiling）联合预测多视角 RGB 与深度，并保持预训练 VAE 不变。
AI.result: DROID-3D 在 90% 的 episode 上，外部相机重投影误差低于 0.7 px。在相同训练预算下，加入深度监督使 RGB 预测相比仅 RGB 的同等基线提升 +1.48 dB PSNR，同时输出可用于下游几何推理的准确度量深度。
AI.conclusion: 深度监督不仅提升了 RGB 预测质量，还同时提供准确的度量深度，表明在大规模标定 3D 监督下训练的世界模型可兼顾视觉保真度与 3D 几何一致性。

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的测试时智能体自适应框架，通过测试时记忆演化与规则对齐协作提升长程法律推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 法律智能需支持长程、多角色、案件状态不断演化的可靠决策，但真实场景中案件在事实、证据与程序语境上高度异质，静态智能体策略难以应对；且法律推理跨角色与程序阶段相互依赖，全局可靠性与单一角色能力并不等同。
AI.method: 研究免训练的测试时智能体自适应，提出方法：1）测试时记忆演化，从既有案件检索可复用经验，适配当前事实与程序语境，并固化积累经验供后续决策；2）规则对齐协作，依据行为与程序要求校验并修正角色特定动作，实现跨角色、跨阶段的协同决策。
AI.result: 在J1-EVAL与LegalWorld上、五种骨干模型均取得相对代表性推理与智能体基线的稳定提升，交互与计算开销合理；消融与案例研究显示两组件在经验适配与跨角色协同上互补，提升长程法律推理的可靠性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 免训练测试时自适应可有效应对案件异质性与跨角色依赖，记忆演化与规则对齐协作互为补充，为长程法律决策提供可靠且高效的方案。

title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Selective-RL，通过隔离并选择性地迁移强化学习阶段的参数更新，实现从语言模型到视觉语言模型的免训练推理能力迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于端点的模型合并方法在迁移推理能力时，会将模型间固有的差异与推理后训练阶段获得的改变相混淆，无法清晰刻画能力迁移的来源。作者希望从训练阶段更新的角度出发，仅隔离由强化学习（RL）引起的参数变化，从而使迁移更精准。
AI.method: 作者先形式化地围绕训练阶段更新（RL 引起的参数变化）来定义能力迁移。接着发现该更新的各成分在跨模型可迁移性上差异显著：主导方向比完整更新更易迁移。基于此，提出 Selective-RL：隔离 RL 阶段更新，保留其主导的矩阵级方向并保持幅值，再将其迁移到 VLM 的语言模块。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族、五个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL 在 15 组比较中的 12 组优于全更新插值，其中在 Qwen 接收模型上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点。匹配的对照实验表明，仅靠更新幅值或任意低秩均无法复现这些增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"后训练中获得的"与"跨模型可迁移的"能力之间的区别，从训练阶段视角为跨模型能力迁移提供了新思路：选择性迁移 RL 更新的主导方向优于迁移完整更新。

title: The Geometry of Empowerment
summary: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文将赋权（empowerment）最大化与技能学习相联系，提出新的几何框架，用以解释赋权与结构中心性之间的关系，并揭示了信息几何与奖励几何之间的区别。
AI.motivation: 赋权作为衡量智能体主动控制环境能力的信息论量，其与“能广泛通向未来结果的结构中心状态”之间的联系一直是未解问题。论文旨在回答赋权与结构中心性之间的长期开放问题。
AI.method: 将赋权最大化与技能学习方法相链接，构建新的几何结构来分析和解释赋权。
AI.result: 分析回答了赋权与结构中心性之间关联的开放问题，并揭示了信息几何与奖励几何之间的差异，阐明了其对构建可扩展赋权最大化方法的重要理论意义。
AI.conclusion: 赋权可通过新几何视角得到更深入理解，信息与奖励几何的区分对可扩展赋权最大化方法具有重要理论启示。网站与代码见 https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/。

title: PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation
summary: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.

AI.tldr: PEARS：物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，结合触觉反馈实现预训练策略的样本高效在线自适应。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略在部署时遇到分布外（OOD）条件会显著性能下降，需要通过真实交互进行后训练。但基于强化学习的后训练通常需要大量环境交互，在操作任务中每次试验缓慢、昂贵甚至具破坏性，因此需要样本高效的在线自适应方法。
AI.method: PEARS由三部分组成：(1) 物理引导力推理（PFR）模块，利用VLM中编码的物理先验，从视觉结果与触觉交互历史诊断失败，并更新任务适配的接触力边界；(2) 高频混合力-位置控制器，在接触过程中执行这些力边界；(3) 触觉条件扩散引导强化学习，调整冻结的流匹配策略的潜噪声，以纠正自由空间运动与接触时机误差，而不更新基础模型。
AI.result: 仿真中，PEARS相比最强逐任务基线将成功率提升12.4–37.4个百分点；达到特定成功率阈值所需交互回合数相比最快基线最多减少53.2%。真实实验中，白板擦除任务成功率95%，移液管液体吸取任务成功率90%。
AI.conclusion: 将PFR模块与策略引导相结合，可加速自适应过程并减少昂贵的交互次数，验证了物理先验与触觉反馈在提升样本效率方面的有效性。

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

AI.tldr: PIP：面向具身零样本协作的伙伴意图预测方法
AI.motivation: 在具身场景下，伙伴会间歇性离开视野，导致现有方法（零样本协作）中的伙伴表征模糊、隐藏状态不确定。作者希望联合解决“伙伴表征”与“隐藏状态推断”两个挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP)，包含两个组件：(1) Joint-view VAE——将双方局部观测的并集所包含的丰富训练期证据蒸馏为伙伴表征，使其仅凭自身局部观测即可获得；(2) Partner-state Belief 网络——从自我智能体的交互历史中推断伙伴的隐藏位置与行为倾向。
AI.result: 在 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO 以及一个 Melting Pot 子环境中评测，并在 Burrito-PO 上开展人类评估。PIP 在三个基准上均取得最高平均性能；人类评估与诊断性分析进一步支持其与未见伙伴的协作能力，以及在伙伴被遮挡条件下两个组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PIP 通过联合建模伙伴表征与伙伴隐藏状态信念，有效提升具身零样本协作在伙伴间歇性不可见条件下的性能与泛化能力。

title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
summary: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FocusGate，一种带门控与可弃权的免注视先验集成方法，用于视频注视点预测。逐帧门控依据离焦图的形状统计决定是否采信估计器，使被拒帧严格退化为基线，并通过中位秩归一化实现零参数弃权。在电影、体育与网络视频上取得显著增益，且附加于四个监督模型（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）后全部 16 个模型-域组合的 shuffled AUC 均提升，仅增加 1% 延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有视频注视点预测主要由依赖注视数据训练的监督模型主导，而免注视先验（gaze-free priors）虽携带这些模型未吸收的信号，但其可靠性因帧而异，无条件融合会在部分场景（如体育、网络视频）产生负面甚至无效效果，因此关键在于判断何时应当信任这类先验。作者希望以"何时采信"为核心，构建可弃权的门控融合机制，从而在有信号时增益、无信号时不损害基线。
AI.method: 提出 FocusGate：免注视先验的门控集成，成员可弃权。设计逐帧门控，读取离焦图（defocus map）的三个形状统计量，仅在估计器平均表现优于随机水平的帧上进行选择；被拒帧的预测严格退化为基线。采用中位秩归一化（midrank normalisation），使全零先验在零参数下自然弃权。对比了门控融合与无条件融合，并将 FocusGate 作为附加模块接入四个监督预测器（包括 NTIRE 2026 冠军模型）。
AI.result: 门控融合在电影、体育和网络视频上均显著为正，而无条件融合在体育上产生负面影响、在网络视频上无效果。将 FocusGate 加入四个监督预测器后，全部 16 个模型-域组合的 shuffled AUC 均提升，其中 15 个显著，一个域为预注册且仅评测一次；同时仅增加冠军模型 1% 的推理延迟。独立使用时，在电影域以 16 帧因果均值在 shuffled AUC 上超过 TASED-Net 与 UNISAL。
AI.conclusion: 免注视先验在被选择性信任时可提供有效增益，逐帧门控与可弃权机制是关键：它既能保证无信号场景下不劣于基线，又能在有信号场景下带来显著提升。FocusGate 具有良好通用性，可即插即用地增强多种监督模型且几乎不增加延迟。

title: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
summary: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究PFN（如TabPFN）统计自适应性的学习机制：在位置估计任务中，softmax注意力可计算经验累积生成函数导数，兼顾区分数据族与构建估计器；通过softmax混合专家或GLU组合注意力专家，在足够预训练任务下分别对高斯、均匀及混合任务达到近优与阶最优速率。
AI.motivation: PFN在预测与估计任务上已媲美经典统计方法，其"统计自适应性"（在不知道真实数据生成模型的情况下，性能接近为该模型量身定制的方法）原因尚不清晰，作者希望通过受控的位置估计问题揭示这种适应性是如何被学习到的。
AI.method: 构造受控位置估计任务：每组任务为未标注样本，其分布族隐藏（高斯、均匀、对称高斯混合）。分析标量输入下softmax注意力等价于经验累积生成函数的导数，从而同时提供区分数据族的特征并形成在样本均值与中距（mid-range）之间插值的估计器。用softmax混合专家或门控线性单元（GLU）组合注意力专家，并进行分阶段梯度流分析。
AI.result: 在约Ω̃(n^{1+ε})个预训练任务下，学到的估计器在高斯任务上渐近有效，在均匀任务上达到minimax速率的一个n^ε因子范围内，在收缩方差机制的混合任务上达到阶最优；这些保证可推广到新位置与更长上下文。风险分解区分了专家误差、路由误差与归一化误差：softmax门控强制归一化与精确平移等变性，GLU则须自行学习，其动力学分为快速偏差消除与缓慢专家选择两阶段。端到端实验重现了预测的专家专门化。
AI.conclusion: softmax注意力几何（经验累积生成函数导数）是PFN实现统计自适应的核心构件，架构选择（softmax vs GLU门控）通过归一化与等变性约束决定学习动力学，理论预测与实验一致。

title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
summary: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/

AI.tldr: QF3 是一种在线离策略强化学习算法，通过流匹配与经滤波的评论家动作梯度联合训练流策略，能从零学习人形运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件，训练速度较 FPO++ 提升 10 倍。
AI.motivation: 流策略已成为从演示学习机器人行为的标准策略类，但强化学习对于改进预训练流策略或通过交互从零学习仍至关重要。现有流 RL 方法多为在策略方法，效率低，且难以从零训练高维人形运动任务并迁移到真实硬件。
AI.method: QF3 使用流匹配加上评论家动作梯度来训练流策略，梯度通过流输出的一步预测进行反向传播。为保证评论家与其一步预测的可靠性，仅在保持接近回放动作的动作维度上应用评论家梯度（滤波式 Q 梯度）。
AI.result: QF3 是首个能从零训练人形运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件的离策略流 RL 方法；配合高吞吐离策略训练方案，训练人形运动与动作跟踪策略的速度比近期在策略流 RL 方法 FPO++ 快 10 倍（墙钟时间）；并在 ABC-Sim 与 Robomimic 任务上成功微调预训练流式操作策略。
AI.conclusion: QF3 既能从零学习机器人策略，也能精炼从演示获得的策略，验证了离策略流 RL 在效率与泛化性上的优势。

title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
summary: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters.
