Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

AI.tldr: 在107组镁合金挤压条件下，比较传统统计描述符、视觉嵌入与图神经网络三类微观组织/织构描述符，用于反推合金成分与工艺参数；传统描述符在合金识别上显著优于学习式嵌入。
AI.motivation: 合金研发正向流程（配方→组织→性能）已较成熟，但反向从目标组织追溯配方仍依赖专家经验。作者希望验证这一"逆向步骤"能否被机器学习习得。
AI.method: 使用包含14种合金、107个挤压条件的内部数据集，每个条件配有光学显微照片与X射线织构测量。比较三类描述符：(1)传统晶粒与织构统计量；(2)预训练图像编码器的视觉嵌入；(3)晶粒网络上的图神经网络。每类描述符配接预测头，完成两个任务：Task A由工艺预测合金成分，Task B由成分预测工艺参数。采用5折交叉验证。
AI.result: 传统描述符在留出条件中正确识别合金的比例为65%，而始终猜测最常见合金的基线为17%；学习式嵌入的识别率低于30%。工艺参数可恢复但噪声更大：相比仅用成分，加入微观组织可使温度误差约减半。由于合金与压机设置数量有限，两个任务的答案均为离散值；尊重顺序、从已知选项中挑选的预测头优于直接回归自由数值的预测头。
AI.conclusion: 在数据规模有限时，简单、可解释的传统组织统计描述符在逆向推断上优于学习式表示，且离散且有序的输出建模更契合实际工艺条件。逆问题可被部分学习，但噪声显著，仍需谨慎对待。

title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
summary: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

AI.tldr: PDB 用可复用的目标混合权重与逐帧变形的源控制点直接相乘重建目标网格，无需 cage、坐标或解码器，仅自监督训练即可跨身份迁移，兼顾表情保真与表面伪影抑制。
AI.motivation: 跨不同网格结构进行面部表情迁移时，难以在保持面部运动的同时避免表面伪影（artifacts）。现有方法通常依赖预定义 cage、预计算坐标、逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解，限制了对任意网格的适配性并易引入表面瑕疵。
AI.method: 提出 PDB（Point-Based Deformation Blending，基于点的变形混合）。从源中性表情对预测一小组变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重；权重对每个目标仅计算一次并在各帧复用，控制点随源表情变化。用 ReLU 保证权重非负且可为精确零，再做行归一化。目标网格由权重与控制点直接相乘重建，无需预定义 cage、预计算坐标、学习的逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解。仅使用自迁移重建监督训练，即可支持跨身份迁移，无需成对的跨身份训练表情。
AI.result: 实验表明迁移准确、推理快速，且学习到的权重具有局部支撑性。表情准确性与局部表面保持的联合评估显示，相比所评估的稠密位移方法，表面伪影减少，同时保留预期运动；感知评估在自迁移与跨迁移中均支持表情保真度与视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: PDB 以点基变形混合实现了与网格结构无关的面部动画迁移，通过权重复用与直接重建在保证表情保真度的同时减少表面伪影，且仅需自迁移监督即可跨身份迁移。

title: MASKerade: Token-Routed Mask Experts for Dense-to-MoE Upcycling
summary: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. Dense-to-MoE upcycling reuses pretrained dense models to construct such systems, commonly by copying feed-forward networks (FFNs) into independently trained experts. We introduce MASKerade, a dense-to-MoE training method that instead learns experts as sparse subnetworks of a frozen pretrained FFN. Each expert is defined by a learned binary mask, and a token-level router selects which masked FFNs to execute and combine. The router and mask scores are optimized jointly, while the underlying FFN weight values remain unchanged. This formulation supports neuron-structured, semi-structured, and unstructured experts within the same routing architecture. Our main configuration uses four 2:4 experts with top-2 routing, where two half-dense expert passes have the nominal FFN arithmetic of one dense pass, without requiring independent expert weight matrices. On five vision-language benchmarks with Qwen and Gemma backbones, this configuration achieves the highest performance among the compared baselines. Comparisons across mask granularities, routing interventions, and compute-matched controls distinguish the effects of learned connectivity from expert activation count. These results establish mask learning over frozen weights as a practical alternative for constructing token-routed MoE experts.

AI.tldr: 提出MASKerade方法：在冻结的预训练FFN权重上学习二值掩码来定义专家，实现稠密模型到MoE的升级，在五个视觉语言基准上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密到MoE升级方法通常将FFN复制为独立训练的专家，需要为每个专家维护独立的权重矩阵，参数开销大。作者希望探索一种无需独立专家权重矩阵、更参数高效的专家构建方式。
AI.method: MASKerade将每个专家定义为冻结预训练FFN上的稀疏子网络，用可学习的二值掩码表示；token级路由器选择执行并组合哪些被掩码的FFN。路由器与掩码分数联合优化，而底层FFN权重保持不变。该框架同时支持神经元结构化、半结构化和非结构化专家。主配置采用四个2:4专家和top-2路由。
AI.result: 主配置中两次半稠密专家前向的标称FFN算术量等于一次稠密前向，且无需独立专家权重矩阵。在Qwen和Gemma骨干的五个视觉语言基准上，该配置在对比基线中取得最高性能。跨掩码粒度、路由干预和计算匹配对照的比较，区分了学习到的连接性与专家激活数量的效应。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结权重上进行掩码学习是构建token路由MoE专家的一种实用替代方案。

title: LFHE: Local-First Heuristic Evolution for Bounded Local Topology Search in Decentralized Learning with Non-IID Data
summary: Decentralized learning is highly sensitive to communication topology under non-IID data. Adaptive peer-selection methods can exploit local model information, but broader peer discovery may require increasingly large control state, whereas direct spectral optimization typically relies on graph-wide information. We study the intermediate setting of bounded local topology search and propose Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a representation-driven rewiring framework whose candidate discovery and scoring use only ego-neighborhood and friend-of-a-friend (FoF) information. The structural score admits an exact interpretation through graph Dirichlet energy: its sum across clients equals twice the representation Dirichlet energy, which under standard linear consensus dynamics governs the instantaneous dissipation of representation disagreement. LFHE combines this state-dependent structural signal with early exploration and degree control, while algebraic connectivity remains an offline graph diagnostic. Under bounded sparse degree, its FoF candidate state remains local rather than expanding toward population-wide peer tracking. Across four image, speech, and text benchmarks, LFHE achieves competitive decentralized learning performance. Matched-protocol controls identify the structural term as the principal empirical topology-selection signal, while comparison with broader peer discovery exposes a trade-off between predictive performance and discovery-state locality. Together, these results motivate state-aware bounded local topology search between pairwise peer selection and globally informed topology optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE)，一种仅依赖 ego 邻域与朋友的朋友（FoF）信息的表示驱动重连框架，在有限局部拓扑搜索下实现竞争性的去中心化学习性能。
AI.motivation: 去中心化学习在非 IID 数据下对通信拓扑高度敏感。自适应对等选择可利用局部模型信息，但更广的对等发现需要越来越大的控制状态，而直接谱优化通常依赖图全局信息。本文研究二者之间的中间设定——有界局部拓扑搜索，旨在兼顾预测性能与发现状态的局部性。
AI.method: 提出 LFHE，候选发现与打分仅使用 ego 邻域和 FoF 信息。结构分数通过图 Dirichlet 能量获得精确解释：其在各客户端上的总和等于两倍的表示 Dirichlet 能量，在标准线性一致性动态下支配表示不一致的瞬时耗散。LFHE 将该状态相关结构信号与早期探索、度控制相结合，代数连通度仅作为离线图诊断指标。在有界稀疏度约束下，FoF 候选状态保持局部，不向群体级对等跟踪扩张。
AI.result: 在四个图像、语音和文本基准上，LFHE 取得具有竞争力的去中心化学习性能。匹配协议对照实验表明结构项是主要的经验性拓扑选择信号；与更广的对等发现相比，揭示了预测性能与发现状态局部性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在成对对等选择与全局知情拓扑优化之间，采用状态感知的有界局部拓扑搜索。

title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架EC-RAG，将长视频组织为显式事件链进行事件级检索增强，在Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上稳定超越帧级检索基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时往往独立处理各帧，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有的检索增强方法多停留在帧级或片段级，无法建模事件随时间的演化及事件间关系。
AI.method: EC-RAG为免训练框架：先将视频切分为语义连贯的片段，用多模态信号表示每个片段，再按时间顺序链接为结构化事件链，保留时序并刻画事件间关系；给定查询后，在链中定位相关事件并从对应模态汇聚支持证据。具备事件级抽象、事件级多模态融合（语音、文本、视觉）以及即插即用兼容现有LVLM主干三大特点。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上的实验表明，该事件中心设计持续优于帧级检索基线，证明时间结构建模对长视频理解的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 以事件为中心的检索增强方式能更可靠地定位与推理长视频内容，且无需额外训练或依赖专有模型，具有良好的实用性与可扩展性。

title: SIFT: Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer for Multi-Task Personalized Filter Ranking at Airbnb
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at GRAIL 2026: Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Search filters help guests navigate vast catalogs in two-sided marketplaces like Airbnb, and recommending the right filters can meaningfully lift booking conversion. Many such production filter-ranking systems, however, represent the guest through hand-engineered, pre-aggregated features generated by ETL pipelines. This makes it expensive to maintain and difficult to extend for new filter types or contextual dimensions (trip length, group size). We present SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer), a ranking model built on transformers that learns guest preferences directly from raw behavioral sequences. SIFT replaces manual feature engineering with a unified guest representation that feeds multiple prediction tasks, including booking likelihood, filter engagement, and ordinal capacity thresholds (e.g., 2+ bedrooms) -- a general framework for filter ranking in two-sided marketplaces that accommodates both boolean and numeric-range filter types. Extending SIFT to new filters requires only adding a new head, not a new feature pipeline. To keep serving fast, this guest representation is computed offline on a daily cadence rather than at request time. Offline, SIFT improves booking and amenity-engagement PR-AUC by +51.9% and +62.8% respectively over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SIFT increased engagement with recommended filters by +20.0%, overall filter usage among searchers by +0.72%, and usage of the newly-supported bedroom, bathroom, and bed filters by +3.9%, +10.7%, and +0.52% respectively. Demonstrating the system's extensibility, we rapidly integrated a novel hotel-intent filter using the same shared representation, driving a +3.8% lift in uncancelled hotel bookings and a +0.76% lift in overall marketplace bookings. SIFT is now fully deployed in production, serving scalable personalization to millions of guests.

AI.tldr: SIFT 是一种基于 Transformer 的搜索筛选器排序模型，直接从原始行为序列学习用户偏好，替代手工特征工程，已全量部署并显著提升转化。
AI.motivation: 现有生产系统的筛选器排序依赖 ETL 手工生成、预聚合的游客特征，维护成本高，且难以为新筛选器类型或情境维度（行程长度、出行人数）扩展。
AI.method: 提出 SIFT（Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer）：基于 Transformer 从原始行为序列学习游客偏好，用统一游客表示驱动多任务预测（预订概率、筛选器互动、序数式容量阈值如 2+ 卧室）；该框架兼容布尔型与数值区间型筛选器，扩展新筛选器仅需新增预测头。为加快服务，游客表示按天离线计算而非请求时实时计算。
AI.result: 离线：预订与设施互动 PR-AUC 较生产基线分别提升 +51.9% 与 +62.8%。在线 A/B：推荐筛选器互动 +20.0%，搜索用户整体筛选器使用 +0.72%，新支持的卧室、浴室、床位筛选器使用分别 +3.9%、+10.7%、+0.52%。新增酒店意图筛选器带来未取消酒店预订 +3.8%、整体市场预订 +0.76%。
AI.conclusion: SIFT 已全量上线生产，为数百万游客提供可扩展的个性化筛选器排序，并验证了以共享表示快速扩展新筛选器的可行性。

title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多语言临床数据集MedConv（300例，英/丹/德），并结合ACI-BENCH基准，构建了一个受控临床评估框架（蕴含指标+LLM成对比较，8个PDSQI-9维度），比较Corti与两款基于通用AI的商用环境记录软件。结果显示Corti的API文本生成能力与领先商用记录软件相当或更优，且其可配置API可针对特定文档场景微调质量维度。
AI.motivation: 环境文档（ambient documentation）系统正快速普及，但其对临床笔记质量的影响尚缺乏充分刻画；同时缺少多语言、可复现的评估资源与方法，难以对商用环境记录软件进行公平比较。
AI.method: 构建MedConv多语言数据集（300个临床问诊，覆盖英语、丹麦语、德语）；结合ACI-BENCH基准；提出受控临床评估框架，融合蕴含（entailment）指标与LLM评判的成对比较，比较维度采用PDSQI-9中的8个维度；以此对比Corti平台与两款基于通用AI的主流商用环境记录软件。
AI.result: Corti基于API的文本生成基础设施与领先商用记录软件持平或更优；其可配置API具备足够灵活性，可针对特定文档使用场景微调各质量维度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了可复用的环境文档系统评估方法与数据集（MedConv），支持未来可复现的系统比较，并表明可配置的API式临床AI平台在笔记质量上具备竞争力与场景适配性。

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍基于LogiKEy方法论的逻辑教学实践，以经典高阶逻辑（HOL）作为通用元逻辑，在单一证明助手（如Isabelle/HOL）中通过语义嵌入编码多种对象逻辑，服务于计算机科学、数学和哲学混合背景的学生。论文给出从命题逻辑到模态逻辑、动态认知逻辑、道义逻辑直至哥德尔本体论论证的递进式课堂案例序列，并对"嵌入HOL是否为逻辑一元论"的质疑作出回应，同时反思三年教学经验并讨论方法的可移植性。
AI.motivation: 在逻辑课堂中引入证明助手具有教学价值，但面向计算机科学、数学与哲学混合背景的学生群体时，如何设计一套统一、可比较且能循序渐进展示多种逻辑（经典与非经典）的教学框架，仍是需要解决的问题。作者希望借此论证证明助手在逻辑教学中的合理性与可行性。
AI.method: 采用逻辑多元主义的LogiKEy方法论：以经典高阶逻辑（HOL）作为通用元逻辑，通过定义语义的方式对经典与非经典对象逻辑进行语义嵌入；借助单一证明助手（如Isabelle/HOL）及其自动定理证明器和（反）模型查找器，构建一个学生可学习、实验和比较不同逻辑的统一环境。教学设计上使用递进式课堂案例序列，每一步的过渡由前一表示的局限、对更显式建模资源的需求或新的应用所驱动。
AI.result: 案例序列展示了清晰的逻辑递进路径：说谎者与真话者谜题将命题逻辑引导至模态逻辑；智者谜题进一步引向动态认知逻辑；Boolos的奇特推理说明高阶元逻辑的价值，即使在自动证明搜索中亦然；Chisholm悖论将序列带入道义逻辑，并由标准道义逻辑过渡到二元道义逻辑；哥德尔本体论论证则将内容提升至研究级别的形而上学论证。
AI.conclusion: 论文反驳了"将所有内容嵌入经典HOL属于一元论而非多元论"的异议，回顾了该课程三年的教学经验，并概述了该方法在Isabelle之外的平台上的可移植性，表明LogiKEy方法论可作为逻辑教学中具有普适性与可推广性的框架。

title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
summary: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RenderBench，一个包含12个重建真实场景的benchmark，用于评估render-to-real视频生成能力，提供配对真实目标视频与可编辑3D数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 评估"从代理渲染生成真实视频"的能力需要同时具备真实目标视频和几何配准的可编辑3D副本，而传统上构建此类数据需要大量人工建模、标定与动画工作，因此缺乏系统化的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建流程融合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助3D编辑：将每个场景分解为静态物体与动态演员，与采集相机配准，并经多视角几何与时间一致性验证后纳入。每个评估单元包含外观参考图、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染及渲染器原生场景标注。评测时将迁移模型与配对真实视频对比，保留PAI-Bench-C兼容的结构投影，并利用场景标注按物体、可见性、关节与运动定位失败。
AI.result: 首个版本保留14个配准样本中的12个（85.7%），含1,496对真实-代理帧。所有发布场景通过文件完整性与环境编辑审计；代理诊断得到深度si-RMSE为0.2170，实例mIoU为0.3673。
AI.conclusion: RenderBench提供了配对的真实观测与可编辑场景状态，可同时评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持能力。

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/

AI.tldr: 提出 Learn2Play Bench，用规则新颖/反直觉的文本游戏评测 LLM 智能体从交互经验中学习的能力，并给出经验保留、人机差距与 harness 影响三方面发现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准所评测任务多已在指令中给出规则或属于预训练模型熟悉的内容，难以区分"从交互中学习"与"利用已有知识推理"这两种能力，因此需要能隔离交互学习效应的评测环境。
AI.method: 设计一批规则新颖或反直觉的文本游戏构成基准；游戏提供可复现反馈与自动评分，支持跨重复尝试的受控评测；通过改变游戏实例（instance）检验学到的知识能否迁移到新情境；在骨干模型、自演化方法与 agent harness 三个维度上开展对比实验。
AI.result: (1) 经验保留：相比把经验总结为规则或策略，保留完整的动作与反馈记录更能支撑有效学习；(2) 人机差距：顶尖人类玩家的峰值分数高于被评测智能体，人类探索的策略更多样、重复动作更少；(3) Harness 影响：固定骨干模型时，更换 harness 可提升性能并降低估计推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为理解 LLM 智能体如何从经验中学习提供了可控评测手段与经验性证据，并为后续提升其学习能力指明方向。

title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SpaTime——一种将因果几何token逐帧融入语言模型的流式VLM，并用响应时间损失监督作答时机；同时构建StreamVSTI-Bench与StreamVSI-Bench流式基准，在StreamVSTI-Bench上取得49.2%总体精度并将平均响应时间误差降低66%。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需在视频仍在到达时进行3D空间推理，并在观测足够时尽快作答。现有含3D几何先验的VLM空间推理能力强但只能离线运行（须等完整视频）；流式VLM可因果处理帧并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式3D表示。二者优势无法兼得。
AI.method: SpaTime在每一帧将因果几何token融合进语言模型，仅依赖当前已观测帧；为监督作答时机，提出响应时间损失，将逐帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，并惩罚其与真实响应帧的距离。评估方面，将VSTI-Bench与VSI-Bench改造为流式版本StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench。
AI.result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上，SpaTime总体精度达49.2%，相比最强流式基线，平均响应时间误差降低66%。
AI.conclusion: 将因果几何表示与流式VLM结合，并通过可微的期望响应时间损失显式监督作答时机，可同时提升流式3D空间推理的准确性与响应及时性，为在线具身空间问答提供了有效范式。

title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with Smart Racket
summary: The AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition introduced smart table tennis rackets that collect extensive player swing data, enabling research on table tennis big data. These data support in-depth analysis of players' return techniques and swing-force consistency, improving the accuracy of player skill assessment. This study focuses on six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets and proposes TTNet, a novel deep learning model with multitask learning capabilities, to advance table tennis data analysis and related applications. TTNet combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNet), and self-attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict four player attributes: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level. We adopt a two-stage training strategy that incorporates data augmentation and task-specific loss functions to improve generalization on imbalanced data. Our approach achieved second place on the official competition leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多任务深度学习模型TTNet，基于智能乒乓球拍的六轴传感器数据，同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄与技术水平，采用两阶段训练并在AI CUP 2025竞赛中获第二名。
AI.motivation: 智能乒乓球拍可采集大量挥拍数据，为乒乓球大数据分析提供基础。通过分析球员回球技术与挥拍力度一致性，可提升球员技能评估的准确性，但如何从六轴传感器数据中有效提取信息并同时预测多项球员属性仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出TTNet模型，融合卷积神经网络（CNN）、残差网络（ResNet）与自注意力机制，实现多任务学习，同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄和技术水平四项属性；采用两阶段训练策略，结合数据增强与任务特定损失函数以提升在不平衡数据上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 该方法在AI CUP 2025智能乒乓球拍数据分析竞赛官方排行榜上获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: TTNet通过多任务学习有效利用六轴传感器数据进行乒乓球球员属性预测，验证了融合CNN、ResNet与自注意力机制并结合两阶段训练策略的有效性，可推动乒乓球数据分析及相关应用发展。

title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段闭式框架，消除低秩量化误差补偿（LQEC）中\"对称标定\"与\"仅最小化二阶项\"两大简化，在2比特下显著降低困惑度并恢复更多精度损失。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩补偿器（LQEC）存在两个共同简化限制其效果：一是采用对称标定，在全精度权重与补偿权重上使用相同激活进行评估，所得补偿目标本质上是高秩的，导致固定秩预算只能捕捉一小部分；二是仅最小化损失的二阶项，而补偿后的模型并非平稳点，每层仍残留比所施加补偿更大的first-order下降方向，且任何重建目标都无法吸收它。
AI.method: 提出两阶段闭式框架。阶段一：在Fisher加权非对称目标下，将每层输出与全精度模型对齐，使秩预算集中于可压缩的秩目标上。阶段二：在补偿后的模型上重新测量统计量，并施加秩约束的自然梯度步，以吸收残余的一阶信号。每个适配器均由一次截断SVD得到，反向传播仅用于收集统计量。
AI.result: 在QuIP#下2比特量化时，Qwen3-8B的WikiText-2困惑度从12.43降至10.26，Qwen3-4B从21.11降至13.22。在留出的C4语料上，相对FP16的差距恢复率分别达到51%和84%，而最强基线为31%和63%。在七任务零样本平均、更高比特宽度以及不同量化器下均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除对称标定与仅二阶优化的两个简化，所提两阶段闭式框架在不需训练的情况下显著提升激进权重量化的补偿效果，验证了非对称Fisher加权目标与秩约束自然梯度步的有效性，并在多模型、多任务、多比特宽度及多量化器条件下展现出一致优势。

title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
summary: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子纠缠多模态融合网络（QEMFN），一种混合量子-经典框架，将参数化纠缠作为结构化归纳偏置引入图像-文本融合，在COCO-5k与Flickr30k检索任务上以相同参数预算和冻结CLIP骨干超越多种经典融合基线，并提供量子度量与真实超导硬件上的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言系统通常依赖拼接、注意力、双线性池化或张量交互等经典算子进行图像与文本嵌入融合，缺乏对融合机制本身的结构化、可解释归纳偏置。作者希望探索可训练的量子纠缠能否作为一种可解释且可在当代硬件上执行的融合机制。
AI.method: 将预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧致潜空间，编码为角度参数化量子态；经模态内与成对跨模态纠缠电路处理；通过测量得到融合表示用于检索。在参数预算匹配且CLIP骨干冻结的条件下，与多层感知机、张量融合、FiLM、跨注意力、紧凑Transformer及去量子化的同拓扑类比等经典基线对比。消融实验隔离量子模块贡献；量子侧分析涵盖Meyer-Wallach纠缠能力、可表达性、面向贫瘠高原界的梯度方差、控制训练进度下的熵-性能相关性，以及针对纠缠组件的干预研究。执行环境包括基于采样估计、噪声建模的模拟后端，以及采用零噪声外推的真实超导设备。
AI.result: 在匹配参数预算和相同冻结CLIP骨干下，QEMFN在COCO-5k与Flickr30k上均优于全部经典融合基线。消融验证了量子模块的独立贡献；量子侧分析给出纠缠能力、可表达性与梯度方差的量化指标，并观察到熵与性能的相关性。框架可在采样估计、噪声模拟后端及真实超导设备（配合零噪声外推）上运行。
AI.conclusion: 本文不主张量子计算优势，其贡献在于该框架及一套受控的经验与量子侧评估，表明可训练纠缠可作为一种可解释、硬件可执行的融合机制，且规模适应当代量子设备。

title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
summary: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

AI.tldr: 提出将路径-流对齐作为流匹配的统一训练目标，联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，并通过随机路径正则化抑制路径过拟合，在ImageNet-256×256上提升FID且不改变推理架构。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径，仅学习速度场，路径本身未被优化。作者希望将路径也作为可学习对象，从而获得更优的训练目标。但单纯使用对齐损失并不能可靠地指导路径学习，存在路径过拟合问题：对齐损失下降而样本质量反而恶化，其根源是诱导概率路径中出现低熵瓶颈，样本被路由经过过度集中的中间边缘分布。
AI.method: 方法上，联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，共用同一对齐损失：流网络匹配路径速度，路径网络则将自身速度对齐到当前流。针对路径过拟合，提出随机路径正则化，在保持精确端点的前提下隐藏路径网络的部分源信息，从而为随机训练路径边缘分布提供显式熵下界，抑制学习采样器中的瓶颈。该正则化不改变推理时架构与采样器。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256×256上使用SiT骨干网络，方法在各模型规模下一致提升FID，并可扩展至model-guidance训练，推理时架构与采样器保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 路径-流对齐可作为流匹配的有效统一训练目标，但需配合随机路径正则化以避免路径过拟合。该正则化通过熵下界抑制低熵瓶颈，使联合路径-流训练真正有效，在图像生成任务上带来稳定的质量提升。

title: CANDLE: Cortical Null-Space Decomposition for Noninvasive Brain Source Imaging
summary: Electrophysiological source imaging (ESI) aims to estimate cortical source activity from noninvasive electrophysiological measurements such as electroencephalogram (EEG). However, ESI is fundamentally ill-posed because source activity is substantially higher-dimensional than sensor observations, resulting in non-unique solutions. Recent learning-based approaches address this ambiguity by learning data-driven source priors, yet they often struggle to generalize across subject-specific cortical geometries. To address this, we propose CANDLE, a learning-based ESI model that estimates source activity on subject-specific cortical geometries. CANDLE learns a prior over the null space induced by the source-to-sensor mapping derived from T1-weighted MRI, restricting learning to unobservable source components while preserving geometric constraints. To train CANDLE, we develop a whole-brain simulator spanning over 1,100 subject-specific cortical geometries with source configurations derived from over 26,000 statistical brain maps. Trained exclusively on simulated data, CANDLE outperformed prior ESI methods on simulated source activity estimation and generalized to two empirical tasks: (i) intracranial stimulation localization from simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and (ii) epileptogenic zone estimation from presurgical interictal EEG. Our project page is available at https://candle-esi.pages.dev}{https://candle-esi.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: CANDLE是一个基于学习的电生理源成像模型，通过在由T1加权MRI导出的源-传感器映射零空间上学习先验，实现个体化皮层几何上的源活动估计，并在模拟与两项临床任务中超越既有方法。
AI.motivation: ESI本质上是不适定问题：源活动维度远高于传感器观测，解不唯一。现有学习类方法虽通过数据驱动源先验缓解歧义，但难以泛化到个体特异的皮层几何结构。
AI.method: 提出CANDLE：在个体特异性皮层几何上估计源活动。模型学习由T1加权MRI得到的源-传感器映射所诱导的零空间上的先验，将学习限制在不可观测的源成分，同时保留几何约束。为训练该模型，构建了覆盖1100多个个体皮层几何、源配置来自26000多张统计脑图的全脑模拟器，仅使用模拟数据训练。
AI.result: 在模拟源活动估计上优于既有ESI方法；并泛化到两项实证任务：(i) 由同步记录的 scalp EEG 进行颅内刺激定位；(ii) 由术前发作间期EEG估计致痫区。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习零空间先验并依托大规模个体化几何模拟训练，CANDLE在无需真实数据训练的情况下实现了跨个体的源成像泛化，具备临床转化潜力。

title: Revisiting Temporal Regularization for Smooth Control in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning policies can produce nonsmooth action oscillations that hinder deployment on physical robots. Existing architectural and penalty-based approaches seek spatial smoothness by directly reducing sensitivity to changes in state inputs, but their broad constraints can degrade task performance as stronger smoothing is pursued. Temporal regularization instead constrains action differences along observed transitions, but has been considered unable to provide the spatial smoothness needed under observation noise. We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness. Building on this finding, we propose Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness (CATS), which combines a temporal penalty with linear ramp-up. We highlight temporal regularization's ability to provide spatial smoothness while better preserving task performance than explicit spatial regularization. Through linear ramp-up, CATS allows the policy to learn rewarding behavior before progressively smoothing its actions, improving return preservation and both temporal and spatial smoothness. Experiments in both simulation and the real world show that CATS substantially reduces action oscillation without degrading task performance, with little computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 CATS 方法，仅用带线性递增权重的时间平滑惩罚，即可在保证空间平滑的同时维持任务性能，显著减少动作振荡。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略会产生不平滑的动作振荡，影响真机部署。现有架构设计与惩罚方法通过直接降低对状态输入的敏感性来追求空间平滑，但约束过宽，平滑越强任务性能越差；时间正则化只约束沿轨迹的动作差分，被普遍认为无法在观测噪声下提供所需空间平滑。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明时间惩罚可界定“共享同一后继状态的当前状态”之间的期望动作差异，揭示其隐含的空间效应，并在实验上验证该效应可扩展为空间平滑。基于此提出 CATS（Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness）：将时间平滑惩罚与线性 ramp-up 权重结合，使策略先学习高回报行为，再逐步增强平滑约束。
AI.result: 仿真与真实机器人实验表明，CATS 在不降低任务性能的前提下大幅减少动作振荡，同时提升时间与空间平滑性，且计算开销很小。
AI.conclusion: 时间正则化本身即可提供空间平滑，且比显式空间正则化更好地保留任务性能；线性 ramp-up 是兼顾回报保持与平滑性的关键机制。

title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示正交投影类LoRA方法在LLM持续学习中存在"正交困境"，并提出无回放的CoDe-LoRA方法，通过自适应零空间投影与语义路由平衡通用知识积累与任务特化，在四个骨干网络和三个基准上取得最佳平均精度。
AI.motivation: LLM需持续适应演进任务，但面临灾难性遗忘。现有基于正交投影的低秩适配（如O-LoRA）虽能隔离任务参数，却因过严的几何约束导致"正交困境"：僵化的参数隔离阻碍了语义相关任务间共享表征的迁移与积累。
AI.method: 提出无回放方法CoDe-LoRA，将学习过程解耦为"通用知识巩固"与"任务特化知识解耦"两部分，采用自适应零空间投影机制与语义路由，以在知识积累与任务特化适配之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在四个骨干网络和三个持续学习基准上的实验表明，CoDe-LoRA取得了最佳平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: CoDe-LoRA有效缓解了正交困境，在无需回放的情况下兼顾知识迁移与抗遗忘，验证了通用知识巩固与任务特化解耦相结合的有效性。

title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
summary: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal

AI.tldr: 在MEG-MASC和MOUS语音检索中，上下文先验通过重塑候选分数改善解码，但置信度也由此读出，导致先验遗留的错误变得更自信而准确率不反映。作者发现"置信度排序反转"现象，并提出分层读取局部与先验分数以改进选择性解码。
AI.motivation: 上下文先验虽然能提升神经到语言解码性能，但置信度却从被先验重塑后的分数中读出，造成"先验遗留的错误可能更自信，而准确率不变无法暴露该问题"。因此需要研究先验如何塑造置信度，并寻找更可靠的置信度估计方式。
AI.method: 在MEG-MASC和MOUS数据集上研究语音检索：使用局部解码分数、加性浅融合组合的上下文先验，并以融合后前两名的间隔（margin）作为置信度；分析初始错误预测中置信度与修复的关系；提出分数层面的解释；通过仅改变融合权重的因果干预验证；并尝试将局部分数与先验分数分开读取以改进选择性解码。
AI.result: 在初始错误预测中发现了置信度排序反转：当正确候选初始排名靠前时，间隔越大越易修复；排名靠后时则相反。MEG-MASC上汇总正确性AUROC为0.87，但区分修复与残留错误的AUROC从初始排名2-3的0.70降至排名21-50的0.39。排名20以外的错误（位于反转区域）占融合后全部错误的46.6%。因果干预验证了反转会随融合权重变化向更深排名移动；在词级LM先验下，它会在准确率增益达峰后继续移动。分开读取局部与先验分数可将解码窗口从56.7%提升到74.5%，且92%的输出集合仍包含正确候选。
AI.conclusion: 上下文融合后的置信度应保留每个预测背后的局部与上下文证据，而不仅是融合后的分数。分开读取局部与先验分数可显著改善选择性解码的覆盖率和可靠性。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
summary: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后训练提升方法，将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）模型中的高斯按目标类别进行语义标注，融合多视角信息并经阈值筛选与连通组件扩展，实现从高斯到网格顶点的标签迁移。
AI.motivation: 同一高斯在不同视角下的类别判定常不一致：高斯可能在某些视角被遮挡，且检测器置信度随视角变化；同时真值以标注网格给出，因为两次训练不会产生相同的高斯，导致高斯与网格两种表示之间无法直接对应。因此需要一个能融合全部视角信息、并能在两种表示间进行标签迁移的语义提升方法。
AI.method: 提出一种逐类别的后训练提升方法：同时累积目标与非目标证据，并按各高斯在每个视角中的可见性加权；随后用两个阈值对各高斯进行过滤，主阈值β选取高置信度种子，较低阈值γβ用于补充其周围的连通组件。评估时将标签从高斯迁移到同时可见且被标注的网格顶点，从而把误差来源分解为2D检测器、提升过程与表示间迁移三部分。阈值与迁移算子在七个Replica验证场景上确定。
AI.result: 验证场景平均mIoU在使用数据集标注掩码时为0.93，使用YOLO掩码时为0.65；在十个留出的ScanNet++测试场景上为0.80和0.54，且所有场景与类别使用相同参数。与按视角分别对证据做阈值化的旧版本相比，测试mIoU提升0.24，并可对两个数据集的所有类别和场景使用单一阈值。
AI.conclusion: 多视角证据融合与双阈值筛选显著优于逐视角阈值化，并实现了跨数据集、跨类别的统一参数设置；误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器，说明提升与标签迁移环节的精度已较高。

title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting uses the continuations of historical segments similar to the current context as references for a forecaster. Most existing methods build the retrieval memory once from the training segment, leaving observations revealed after deployment unavailable as references, and generally do not calibrate how much the retrieved information should influence a frozen forecaster. We identify two key determinants of retrieval utility for a frozen forecaster: whether the history still reflects the current state, and whether the correction it induces aligns with the forecaster's residual errors, an alignment that can shift between validation and deployment when the memory becomes stale. We propose FreshCast, a plug-in retrieval framework that keeps the forecaster frozen, continuously updates a non-parametric memory with new observations, forms a memory forecast through relational kernel regression, and calibrates its weight in closed form on the validation segment. Under a simplified generative model, we characterize the optimal combination gain through the second-order relation between forecaster error and memory correction, and show that a sufficiently long look-back can make periodic memory information redundant. Across seven benchmarks and ten forecasting architectures, FreshCast reduces average MSE for every evaluated forecaster and input length, by 14.6% and 5.6% at input lengths 96 and 720, and achieves lower MSE than the evaluated retrieval-augmented and online baselines in their comparison settings. Ablations show that freezing the memory at the end of training removes most of the gain, identifying post-training observations as a primary source of improvement. For a frozen forecaster, useful historical references must remain timely and provide information that helps correct its remaining errors.

AI.tldr: FreshCast是一个即插即用的检索增强框架，通过持续更新非参数记忆并闭式校准权重，在冻结预测器上提升时序预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强时序预测方法在训练段一次性构建记忆，导致部署后新观测不可用，且未校准检索信息对冻结预测器的影响权重；作者识别出检索效用的两个关键决定因素：历史是否仍反映当前状态，以及诱导的修正是否与预测器残差误差对齐。
AI.method: 提出FreshCast：保持预测器冻结，持续用新观测更新非参数记忆，通过关系核回归形成记忆预测，并在验证段以闭式解校准其权重；在简化生成模型下刻画最优组合增益与预测器误差和记忆修正间二阶关系。
AI.result: 在七个基准和十种预测架构上，FreshCast对所有预测器和输入长度均降低平均MSE，输入长度96和720时分别降低14.6%和5.6%，并在比较设置下MSE低于评估的检索增强和在线基线；消融显示训练结束时冻结记忆会消除大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结预测器而言，有用的历史参考必须保持时效性并提供有助于修正其剩余误差的信息；训练后观测是性能提升的主要来源。

title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
comment: 34 pages, 24 figures, 8 tables. Games: https://www.aisafety.fun. Preregistrations: https://osf.io/wda8q, https://osf.io/q2j3y, https://osf.io/8kreb
summary: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

AI.tldr: 将"对齐是否随模型规模变容易"重构为可测的标度律族：对每类风险r，维持固定安全目标所需对齐负担B_r(N)=a_rN^α_r。α_r<1则标度有利，≈1持平，>1则累积"对齐债务"。论文给出三种负担操作化并区分观测/审计/真实对齐，证明四条定理，提出可预注册协议并两次实施（Pythia对抗训练再分析、Qwen2.5/Qwen3试点），并发布四款浏览器游戏。作者不对当前前沿模型所处区域做断言。
AI.motivation: 现有关于"对齐随规模变易或变难"的争论多基于孤立发现，隐含把对齐当作单一属性，缺乏可比较、可预注册的定量框架。本文主张应按风险类别分别测量标度指数，以判定规模效应究竟是有利、持平还是累积债务。
AI.method: 1) 将对齐负担建模为幂律B_r(N)=a_rN^α_r，N为能力代理，与正比于N的预算比较；2) 给出三种负担操作化（含"修正消耗能力余量"的玩具模型）；3) 区分观测对齐、审计对齐与真实对齐；4) 证明四条命题：最大指数（而非平均）决定长期区域；α>1时任何维持余量下限的策略须超指数增长；正幂律混合下小模型拟合低估大尺度指数；无误报的审计不会高估真实对齐；5) 提出可预注册协议并做两次缩减版实施。
AI.result: Pythia分类器对抗训练数据的预注册再分析：将攻击成功率压至10%以下所需算力按N^0.60增长（标度有利）。Qwen2.5 0.5B–72B试点：真实性指数-0.05、陈述性倾向0.48（均属标度有利，但顶部局部斜率趋近1；Qwen3 0.6B–14B复现）；谄媚0.89（加两个72B种子后0.83）与植入后门均未能确定——后门在触发已知时可被快速移除，但在五个规模中的四个上可挺过盲态安全训练。另发布四款浏览器游戏呈现这些规律。
AI.conclusion: 对齐应按风险类别逐一测量标度指数，长期区域由被修正风险中的最大指数决定，混幂律特性会使小模型拟合低估大尺度指数。经验上Pythia对抗鲁棒性与Qwen真实性呈有利标度，谄媚与后门则未定，提示结论高度依赖风险类型。作者明确不对当前前沿模型属于哪一区域作断言，呼吁以可预注册协议累积可比证据。

title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSFP4量化方案，通过联合优化对角平滑矩阵与块缩放因子，在NVFP4格式下最小化线性投影的矩阵乘积量化误差，兼顾舍入与GPTQ式误差补偿两种舍入方式，在保持约94-97%厂商预填充吞吐的同时取得最优平均精度。
AI.motivation: NVFP4具有紧凑存储与原生张量核心加速优势，适合LLM推理，但其精度保持高度依赖精细的量化设计。现有方案难以在NVFP4下同时兼顾平滑（smoothing）与缩放（scaling）的协同优化，导致量化误差偏大，因此需要一种能联合优化二者以最小化矩阵乘积量化误差的新方案。
AI.method: 提出OSFP4方案：对每个线性投影使用对角平滑矩阵，其元素经过优化以在NVFP4下最小化平方矩阵乘积量化误差，并显式考虑所用舍入过程（最近舍入或GPTQ式逐次干扰消除）。方法需要对平滑元素与块缩放进行联合优化，为此通过分析一个乘性抖动（multiplicative-dither）FP4量化器来替代固定确定性量化器，从而便于联合优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相应量化设置下，OSFP4在所评估的对比方法中取得最高平均精度，同时在所测工作负载上保留了约94-97%的厂商NVFP4预填充吞吐。代码已开源（https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4）。
AI.conclusion: OSFP4通过联合优化平滑与缩放，在NVFP4量化下实现了精度与吞吐的优良折中，验证了针对舍入过程建模并采用乘性抖动量化器进行分析的有效性。

title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
summary: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了基于patch的高光谱图像分类中同类别训练-测试空间重叠导致的数据泄漏问题，提出OP和AOR两个度量指标，并在Pavia University数据集上通过多种模型验证随机采样会显著高估分类性能。
AI.motivation: 基于patch的学习利用局部光谱-空间信息提升了HSI分类性能，但从同一图像中随机进行训练-测试采样会导致空间patch重叠，从而引发数据泄漏，产生过于乐观的性能评估。论文旨在揭示并量化这一被忽视的评估缺陷。
AI.method: 提出两个度量指标：重叠百分比（OP）用于量化全局重叠的测试patch像素比例；平均重叠比率（AOR）用于度量受影响测试patch中的局部重叠严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，采用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba，对比随机与非随机空间采样，并进行patch尺寸分析（5x5至19x19）。
AI.result: 随机采样下深度patch模型取得高精度，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；非随机空间采样下性能大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。patch尺寸从5x5增至19x19使随机采样重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。
AI.conclusion: 随机patch评估会显著夸大分类性能，对强烈依赖空间上下文的模型尤为明显；HSI分类研究应采用无重叠的采样协议以获得可靠评估。

title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中特权上下文设计对策略漂移的影响，通过改变内容与来源两个维度，发现内容对KL漂移与参数更新几何的影响大于来源。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD工作同时改变特权上下文、模型、数据和训练设置，难以隔离特权上下文设计本身的效果；本文受持续学习中减少灾难性遗忘的启发，试图厘清特权上下文选择如何影响策略漂移。
AI.method: 在内容维度（示范、反馈、改写）与来源维度（外部、带验证器的自生成、无验证器的自生成）共九种组合、三个数据集上，用OPSD训练Qwen2.5-7B，并测量目标任务准确率、先前任务保持率、相对基础策略的反向KL及参数更新几何。
AI.result: 固定来源时，改变内容带来的KL中位数跨度大于固定内容而改变来源的跨度，逐token KL比值为5.1倍，逐序列KL为2.2倍；参数更新几何呈相同模式，共享内容适配器的更新对齐度（平均余弦0.571）高于共享来源者（0.255）。
AI.conclusion: 特权上下文应被视为OPSD稳定性设计的一部分，因为它与策略移动的距离和方向相关，这对持续学习具有重要意义。

title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现非线性记忆网络中顺序的测试时训练(TTT)并不优于固定基底的并行TTT，根源在于单次遍历序列时非线性记忆的优化难度；为此提出DeltaTTT，用逐层学习替代两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化，每层设定局部预测目标并以状态依赖的delta规则更新，从而在保留非线性读出的同时实现分块并行计算。
AI.motivation: 顺序测试时训练(Sequential TTT)通过连续更新适配记忆网络，理论上每步更新依赖网络先前状态，应能利用已学知识并更好整合新信息。但作者发现这一预期优势在非线性记忆中并不稳定成立：固定基底的并行TTT基线反而优于其串行版本。进一步探究表明，关键困难在于非线性记忆在单次遍历序列时比线性记忆更难优化。
AI.method: 为缓解上述优化困难，提出DeltaTTT：将两层记忆网络的联合内循环优化替换为逐层(layerwise)学习。每层分配一个局部预测目标，并通过状态依赖的delta规则进行更新。该形式在保留非线性读出的同时支持分块并行计算(chunkwise parallel computation)。
AI.result: 在DeltaNet和LaCT骨干网络上进行实验，结果显示在语言建模和检索任务上相较其循环基线均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 顺序TTT在非线性记忆中的理论优势难以实现，主要受限于优化难度；采用逐层、局部目标与delta规则的DeltaTTT能够有效改善优化，兼顾非线性表达能力与并行效率，并在语言建模与检索任务上验证了有效性。

title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
summary: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Sensor-Language-Action（SLA）建模范式，以语言为感知与行动的语义接口，连接多模态传感器观测、自然语言与动作。作者构建了覆盖 11.6 万余人、79 种传感器模态、60 个动作组的大规模基准，并提出统一模型 OpenSLA，在临床预测、手术室与代谢健康任务上超越现有最优方法，并展现出语言引导的证据定位与零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有传感器模型多止步于感知层面：或识别状态、或预测结果，而动作建模往往被分离处理，依赖任务特定且通常封闭的标签空间，导致感知与行动割裂、动作表示难以跨任务迁移与解释。
AI.method: 提出 SLA 建模框架，将多模态传感器观测、自然语言与动作纳入统一模型，用语言作为感知与行动之间的语义接口，使异构动作可被表示、预测与解释，同时保持对底层传感器证据的接地（grounding）。构建大规模 SLA 基准，涵盖 116,000+ 个体、79 种传感器模态、60 个动作组，并配套多维度描述（captioning）流水线，对齐用户情境、传感器动态与动作证据。在此基础上提出 OpenSLA 统一模型，支持分层动作预测、状态理解与动作解释。
AI.result: 在临床预测、手术室、代谢健康等真实任务上的大量实验表明，OpenSLA 性能优于当前最先进方法；并具备语言引导的证据定位与对未见动作、未见人群队列的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以语言为语义接口统一感知与行动，是构建通用传感器-语言-动作模型的有效路径；OpenSLA 及其基准为跨模态、跨任务的传感器驱动动作预测与解释提供了可扩展的基础。

title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: BASA提出一种后端无关的稀疏注意力机制，用跨DiT块的移位局部窗口注意力替代视觉自注意力，在消除网格伪影的同时实现接近理论值的实际加速。
AI.motivation: DiT全注意力的二次复杂度使高分辨率生成代价高昂；分区窗口注意力虽高效但阻断了跨窗口交互，产生网格状伪影；细粒度滑动窗口注意力虽恢复交互、提升质量，却因不规则计算模式导致理论与实际加速差距大，且需针对各硬件后端定制内核。
AI.method: BASA将视觉自注意力替换为移位的局部窗口注意力，通过跨DiT块的结构化窗口移位方案，使某层被窗口边界分隔的token在后续层中实现通信，从而达成全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影；设计不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核，可直接部署于现有注意力后端。
AI.result: 在FLUX上实现超过理论估计90%的实测加速，在Wan上取得4.52倍注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BASA以后端无关的方式兼顾视觉质量与实用加速，弥合了理论稀疏性与实际加速之间的差距，具备良好的可部署性。

title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

AI.tldr: VeriFine 是一个通过策略、训练课程与评判器协同演化来扩展验证能力的智能体框架，实现具身推理中的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 自我改进策略不断暴露新的失败模式，导致评判器需验证的内容持续变化。现有固定评判器同时限制了优化反馈和有效训练样本的发现，阻碍进一步自我改进；该问题在需兼顾空间定位、因果推理与安全决策的具身推理中更为突出。
AI.method: 提出 VeriFine 框架，包含两个循环：策略改进循环使用评分标准评判器诊断反复出现的失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；当进展停滞、验证成为瓶颈时，评判器改进循环针对高信息量失败案例选择性查询人类指导，通过"协同主动校准"（人类与智能体解决分歧、趋近物理推理的客观评分标准）来精炼评判器，修订后的评判器再指导下一阶段的数据选择与策略优化。
AI.result: 在驾驶和机器人导航任务上的实验表明，在强化学习和监督微调两种设定下，策略能力与评判器能力均实现持续自我改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明扩展验证能力可支撑策略失败模式不断演化下的持续自我改进。

title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.

AI.tldr: LeanPlan 是首个利用 LLM 生成启发式函数、并由机器检查其可采纳性以求解最优规划的系统，在 Lean 4 中实现启发式、证明与规划器，在多个规划竞赛域上优于 Scorpion。
AI.motivation: LLM 能生成引导搜索的启发式函数，在满意规划（satisficing planning）中达到先进性能，但这些启发式不保证可采纳性（admissibility），可能导致次优计划。因此需要一种能生成可采纳启发式并对其正确性进行机器验证的最优规划方法。
AI.method: LeanPlan 输入域描述与训练任务，采用智能体循环（agentic loop），借助规划器反馈迭代改进可复用的领域特定启发式、其可采纳性证明以及所需的域假设。系统在 Lean 4 中实现该启发式、其证明以及带机器检查的接地（grounding）与搜索的高效规划器。
AI.result: 在国际规划竞赛的十个域及三个新域上进行评估，测试任务规模最高达训练任务的 57 倍。使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 驱动智能体循环，成功为所有域生成启发式及其可采纳性证明；所得启发式下的 LeanPlan 通常比最先进的 Scorpion 规划器扩展更少状态，并总体上求解更多任务。
AI.conclusion: LLM 生成的启发式可经机器检查其可采纳性，从而用于保证最优性的规划；LeanPlan 将启发式生成、形式化证明与高效搜索统一于 Lean 4，展示了在可扩展任务上超越现有最优规划器的潜力。

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
summary: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出 CtrlCache，一种免训练、控制感知的缓存框架，用于交互式视频世界模型的分块自回归生成，在无需重训练的情况下实现1.21x–1.41x的DiT加速并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需在高效生成视频块的同时忠实响应用户控制。现有分块自回归+少步去噪方案每块仍需多次昂贵去噪迭代；免训练缓存虽可降本，但其复用决策主要依赖模型内部去噪动态，未显式考虑控制切换。而交互生成中存在一个未被利用的信号：控制信号在去噪前即可获得，据此制定的调度无需额外前向计算。
AI.method: 先分析不同控制条件下相邻视频块，发现动作变化处结构相似度下降、低频结构比高频细节更持久。基于此提出CtrlCache：1）动作感知调度与刷新策略，跨块与块内检测动作变化，将每块标记为initial、transition、turning或steady状态；在选定的内部去噪步，initial与transition块保留完整计算，turning与steady块复用同一块内最近一次完整计算步的transformer残差；2）频率混合历史先验引导，在steady交互阶段利用低频结构的持久性，从前一干净latent引入互补信息，且无需额外DiT前向。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0与LingBot-World v1/v2上评测，CtrlCache实现1.21x至1.41x的DiT骨干加速，无需模型重训练，且在三个模型上WBench Overall分数均优于原始推理。
AI.conclusion: CtrlCache通过显式利用控制信号制定免训练缓存调度，将计算资源按控制状态差异化分配，并结合频率混合历史先验，在多种交互式视频世界模型上同时实现推理加速与生成质量提升。

title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories
summary: This study formulates individual route reproduction as a shortest-path problem over learned driver-specific latent link costs. The central idea is that, once such latent costs are inferred from contextual information, observed routes can be reproduced without enumerating alternative route sets. We propose a neural pipeline that includes a perception model that embeds context covariates, which comprises individual characteristics, trip-specific attributes, and network-level traffic states, into the personalized link costs. A constrained optimization (CO) layer, which determines the shortest path (SP) based on these estimated costs, follows the perception encoder. To enable end-to-end training, we employ decision-focused learning to align the predicted shortest paths with observed routes. The implicit maximum likelihood estimation (iMLE) provides an approximate gradient of the loss function that contains the non-differentiable CO layer. Furthermore, a regularization term anchors the latent cost distribution to the empirical scale of observed link travel times, mitigating the scale ambiguity inherent in shortest-path supervision. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms baseline route choice models in path reproduction. The learned latent costs, interpreted as proxies for perceived travel costs, provide plausible explanations for heterogeneous route choices.

AI.tldr: 本文将个体路径复现建模为在学习的驾驶员特定隐式路段成本上的最短路问题，提出感知编码器+约束优化层+决策聚焦学习的端到端神经流水线，用iMLE近似梯度并用正则项锚定隐式成本尺度，实验证明其在路径复现上优于基线选择模型并能解释异质性路径选择。
AI.motivation: 传统路径选择模型通常需要枚举备选路径集，难以灵活处理个体异质性且预测与决策环节脱节。作者希望直接从上下文信息推断个性化的隐式路段成本，从而无需枚举备选路径即可复现观测路径。
AI.method: 构建神经流水线：感知模型将个体特征、出行属性与网络层面交通状态等上下文协变量嵌入为个性化路段成本；随后约束优化（CO）层基于估计成本求最短路（SP）；采用决策聚焦学习实现端到端训练，以iMLE为非可微CO层提供损失函数的近似梯度；并引入正则项将隐式成本分布锚定到观测路段行程时间的经验尺度，以缓解最短路监督中的尺度模糊问题。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，该框架在路径复现任务上优于基线路径选择模型；学习到的隐式成本可作为感知出行成本的代理，为异质性路径选择提供合理解释。
AI.conclusion: 将路径复现转化为隐式路段成本上的最短路学习是可行且有效的，决策聚焦学习与尺度正则化能支撑含非可微优化层的端到端训练，兼顾预测精度与可解释性。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出并行多智能体系统因"重探索成本"与"对齐成本"而常慢于串行单智能体，提出以预测输出token而非墙钟时间衡量成本的判据，并据此设计SquidAgent，实现显著吞吐与速度提升。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体虽能解决复杂多步任务，但串行执行延迟高。理论上并行多智能体应带来近线性加速，然而现有并行系统常慢于单智能体基线。作者将这一差距归因于并行执行引入的两种隐性成本：并行工作节点重建编排者已持有上下文的"重探索成本"，以及协调独立生成输出间不一致的"对齐成本"。
AI.method: 提出原则性决策判据：仅当某层的关键路径成本加重探索与对齐开销低于对应串行成本时才并行该层。因LLM对墙钟时间估计校准差，改用预测输出token作为成本度量。据此构建SquidAgent：在单次规划步骤中估计全部token预算；每个工作节点直接从编排者会话分叉以消除重探索成本；用预生成的共享约定块替代事后协调，将对齐转为有界的前置成本；由确定性调度器逐层应用判据。
AI.result: SquidAgent相较Claude Code实现2.2倍平均吞吐提升与2.6倍平均墙钟加速，相较最强多智能体基线实现2.0倍吞吐提升。
AI.conclusion: 并行多智能体的加速瓶颈在于重探索与对齐两类隐性成本；以LLM可靠估计的预测输出token为成本度量，并配合会话分叉消除重探索、共享约定块前置有界对齐成本，可在逐层确定性调度下实现显著吞吐与延迟收益。

title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MASC多智能体自校准框架与CRPC-Bench基准，用于心理咨询中保持一致性的来访者角色模拟。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多用于咨询师培训和心理咨询研究中的来访者模拟，但可靠模拟要求来访者在长程交互中保持心理一致性。现有角色扮演方法多依赖静态画像提示，易出现人设漂移、不现实的高度配合，以及心理状态、沟通行为与情绪不一致的问题；同时缺乏能同时评估稳定来访者特征与动态心理演变的统一测试平台。
AI.method: 提出MASC（多智能体自校准框架），结合潜在构念对齐，用于心理咨询中一致的来访者角色扮演。MASC将构念引导生成、协同精炼、一致性验证与基于记忆的修正整合为闭环校准回路，在对话推进过程中检测并纠正不一致。同时构建CRPC-Bench基准，覆盖会话层面的画像信息与大五人格特质，以及轮次层面的心理状态、沟通行为和情绪表达，包含38个动机式访谈来访者画像并附人格与情绪标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，MASC在画像、人格、可接受性（receptivity）以及轮次级一致性方面均优于现有方法，其中异构配置取得最强的总体表现。
AI.conclusion: MASC与CRPC-Bench为AI辅助心理咨询研究与培训中开发及评估心理一致的来访者模拟提供了统一基础。

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
summary: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

AI.tldr: ALIVE 是一个让插入视频中的物体"活起来"的框架：仅凭编辑后的首帧和指代新增物体的指令，即可生成与源视频内容连贯的交互（如被拿起、被操作）。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑工具能插入物体，但难以让插入物体参与交互（如被拾取或操纵），缺乏与源视频内容的协调行为。
AI.method: 构建 35,800 个编辑配对数据，融合 3D 渲染、模型生成与真实世界视频，并加入 ROSE 的通用编辑配对；每对仅在目标物体是否存在上不同，同时保留周围动作，以教会编辑器协调的物体行为与源内容保持。训练一个 VLM，从相同输入预测交互引导。提出 ALIVE-interaction 基准，用统一的 VLM 协议评估交互保真度、源保持度和视觉连贯性。
AI.result: 无 VLM 引导时，ALIVE 在两个基准上的 Overall 指标分别比最强基线提升 43.9% 和 4.4%；VLM 预测的引导在无需额外用户输入的情况下，进一步将 ALIVE-interaction 分数提升 0.95 分。
AI.conclusion: ALIVE 通过专用数据与 VLM 交互引导，实现了插入物体与源视频内容的连贯交互，并显著优于现有基线，同时提出的基准为交互保真度等提供了统一评估协议。

title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
summary: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed.
